jobs.title: Model Validation Senior Manager
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰 £85,000 - £105,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits 

⭐Our Model Oversight team

The second line of defence Model Oversight team (that’s us!) provides support to our colleagues in Borrowing, Fincrime Fraud, Finance and Operations to help Monzo grow safely. We’re looking for a Model Validation Senior Manager - Gen AI to lead the teams’ oversight of Generative AI models/use cases (primarily built across Monzo’s Operations squads) to provide assurance that the models/use cases we use are not only good for Monzo but what's best for our customers.

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

Driving the embedding of the Model Risk Framework for Generative AI use cases across Monzo
• Lead the collaboration with the first line of defence teams to strengthen policies, standards and procedures for Generative AI model, use case, system design and build, implementation, governance, monitoring and use. Helping to embed best practice of Generative AI across the business.
• Own the setting and maintenance of Generative AI validation methods, evidence expectations and reusable technical assets with relevant 1LoD modelling teams, applicable across all model risk areas.
• Convert modelling/validation experience into controlled playbooks, tests and working examples that can be applied to 2LoD Validation standards and processes for all Generative AI models, use cases, systems overseen by the 2LoD Model Oversight team.
• Coach Generative AI validation methodologies, to 2LoD Model Oversight colleagues, whom already have transferable Machine Learning skills, to reduce reliance on any single specialist for the validation of Generative AI models, use cases, systems so it can be consistently applied across Financial, Credit and Fincrime/Fraud models. 

Leading the 2LoD Oversight of Operational Model Risk
• Perform, and oversee, independent model validations of new Operational models (primarily Generative AI models, use cases, systems), and changes to existing, using proportionate modelling techniques depending on the level of complexity applied. This includes writing clear and impactful model validation reports and presenting the findings in relevant committees.
• Build relationships with first line of defence modelling teams that develop Operational Models, and wider risk teams, to support the embedding of the model risk framework to help Monzo grow safely.
• Review ongoing model performance monitoring to ensure Operational models are performing within risk thresholds and providing support to the relevant model development team when further action is required
• Monitoring and measuring the overall level of Operational model risk that Monzo operates, and driving action plans with first line teams and appropriate governance forums to mitigate residual model risk within desired risk appetite.

Being a senior advocate of Model Risk Management best practices
• Support the effective operation of the Model Risk Oversight Committee as a regular attendee, contributing to the group discussion to improve model risk management.
• Promote and help embed a strong risk culture, making risk meaningful and relevant to everyone at Monzo. You will share best practice that is easy for everyone to understand.

🤩We’d love to hear from you if…
• You are highly motivated and energised by the idea of bringing positive impact to our customers and Monzo
• You are self-motivated and thrive in a fast-paced environment
• You have great attention to detail while keeping an eye on the big picture
• You are a great communicator, able to articulate complex problems
• You can provide effective challenge whilst building strong, respectful relationships
• You are keen to grow your knowledge in both business and technology

And, from a technical and knowledge perspective, you should have:
• Robust Data Science or Machine Learning background with strong Python capability
• Experience with design of Generative AI evaluation frameworks, architectures, methods, practical tooling and platform alignment.
• Knowledge of Gemini implementations and change assessment
• Experience of managing a modelling project through its full lifecycle
• If possible, some understanding of some of the following:

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

The Strategic Institutional Partnerships (SIP) team signs bespoke partnerships with banks, payment providers, wealth platforms and other financial or tech intermediaries. Some want to offer crypto trading, custody or stablecoin services to their own clients (B2B2C). Others want to use OKX liquidity and infrastructure for their own business (B2B). None of these are standard onboardings. Each one needs its own commercial terms, contracts, technical integration, and regulatory alignment on both sides.

You take each partnership from signed intent to live, growing volume. You are the one person accountable to the client and to every OKX team involved: Legal, Compliance, Product, Engineering, Operations, and Institutional Coverage. You negotiate the deal, run the project, and hand over a partnership that is already producing volume.

Your initial market focus is the EU, where OKX operates under MiCA and MiFID II. The role itself is global. You report to the Global Head of Strategic Partnerships.

What You'll Be Doing
• Commercial Project Coordination. You act as the central instance coordinating the execution of commercial projects with strategic partners within the Strategic Partnerships team, effectively ensuring timely delivery of high-scale projects and ensuring the transfer of knowledge between the individual SP members who act as primary relationship managers to Strategic Partners.
• Solution structuring. You determine the ideal product solution and commercial setup to maximize value with the strategic partner, validating feasibility and alignment with product and local market teams.
• Commercial negotiation. You lead or co-lead negotiations with a rep of the respective OKX office; from term sheet to final terms: pricing, rebates, volume commitments, SLAs, liability, exclusivity, and service scope. You align final terms with the Head of SIP before they go to C-level sign-off.
• Contracting. You run the contract process with OKX Legal and the client's legal team. You supply the commercial inputs and manage/guide the negotiations.
• Client relationship ownership. You are a main contact for the client's decision makers and project sponsors throughout the entire lifecycle. You run steering meetings, manage expectations, resolve escalations, and nurture relationships with decision makers.
• Solution implementation. With Product and Engineering, you turn the commercial agreement into a delivery plan. That covers the integration model, custody and settlement flows, fiat and stablecoin rails, and reporting. You own scope, timelines, and trade-offs. When a client requirement needs a product decision or custom work, you work with product teams to ensure alignment with the product roadmap and you make sure the commercial value merits any custom builds.
• Regulatory and compliance alignment. You coordinate due diligence, KYB, outsourcing assessments and regulatory notifications between OKX Compliance and the client's compliance and risk teams, so that regulatory requirements on either side do not hold up go-live.
• Product Expertise. In-depth understanding of OKX's trading systems, stablecoin and RWA ecosystem.
• Launch and ramp. You plan go-live with the client. For B2B2C partners this includes the commercial launch: end-client communication, marketing support, and incentive structures during GTM campaigns. After launch, you track volume and client ramp against the business case and act when it falls behind.
• Handover. Once a partnership is live and stable, you hand it to the Institutional Relationship Managers with documented terms, technical setup, open items and ramp targets. You stay accountable until they accept the handover.
• Portfolio and reporting. You leverage AI to run and coordinate several complex projects at the same time. You report status, risks, expected and realized business impact to SIP leadership and keep pipeline and project records up to date.
• Feedback into origination. You share what you learn in implementation so SIP structures better deals. Over time, you originate and close partnerships of your own.
• Team building. As deal flow grows, you help build a small delivery team of project managers and solution engineers.

How We Measure Success
• Time from contract signature to go-live
• Volume, revenue, and client ramp at 90 and 180 days after launch - especially for key strategic markets
• Number of complex projects delivered in parallel without missed milestones
• Handovers to Institutional RMs with no escalation back to SIP

What We Look For In You
• 10+ years in commercial roles at banks, crypto exchanges or brokers, payment or stablecoin companies, or fintech infrastructure providers. At least 3 of those years leading client-facing delivery of complex B2B or B2B2C partnerships.
• Banking knowledge from the trading, wealth management or transaction banking side. You know how banks make product decisions, onboard vendors and approve new products.
• Crypto trading systems. Working knowledge of order routing, API and FIX connectivity, custody models, settlement, and pre-funding and credit arrangements.
• Stablecoin ecosystems. You understand issuance, on- and off-ramps, and stablecoin use cases in payments and treasury.
• Negotiation and contracting. You have personally led commercial negotiations and taken contracts through legal review to signature.
• Cross-functional delivery. You have run projects across legal, compliance, product and engineering teams, on both the client's side and your own, and taken them live.
• AI native. Strong use of AI tools (e.g. Claude, GPT) for project management, stakeholder coordination, and reporting to run a large portfolio with a small team

Nice to Haves
• Experience on the bank or payment provider side of launching a crypto or stablecoin product
• Additional European languages
• Background in investment banking, consulting or another structured deal-execution environment
• A track record of originating, structuring, and closing your own deals

Location

Flexible. Initial market focus is the EU.

Perks Benefits

Competitive total compensation package

L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

Various team building programs and company events

We are looking for a Finance Accounting Analyst to join our Brazil team and take ownership of core day-to-day accounting, accounts payable, and tax-compliance operations.

This is a strong opportunity for someone early in their career who wants hands-on exposure to financial regulation, crypto, and Brazil’s tax reform.

• Accounts Payable Expense Management
• Process vendor invoices, employee reimbursements, and weekly payment batches in line with internal policies and approval matrices.
• Validate vendor documentation and apply the correct tax treatment before payment.
• Review withholding taxes on vendor payments (IRRF, PIS/COFINS/CSLL, INSS, ISS), and keep payment files and supporting documents audit-ready.
• Tax Compliance Support
• Issue electronic invoices for company operations, ensuring accuracy and compliance with municipal and federal requirements.
• Support the monthly review of VAT and CIT calculations and maintain supporting documentation.
• Support tax-to-accounting reconciliations and coordinate with our outsourced accounting firm on filings and information requests.
• Help us follow and prepare for the Brazilian tax reform (IBS/CBS) transition, including the impact on invoicing, vendor payments, and ERP configuration.
• Audit Controls
• Support external audit and group-level audit requests: prepare PBC lists, schedules, and reconciliations.
• Follow documented controls and flag exceptions or gaps. Contribute to SOPs and process improvements as we build a controlled environment suited to a regulated entity.

• Solid knowledge of IFRS and BR GAAP/CPC. Familiarity with tax is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior /Staff AI Engineer
jobs.location: Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR; Singapore, Singapore
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About the Team

We sit on the front lines of OKX's security and compliance mission. Our charter is to build the flexible, scalable, and intelligent AI systems that detect and prevent identity fraud, account takeover, and large-scale organized abuse — in real time and at the scale of a global financial platform. We own the core identity-risk capabilities that decide, millions of times a day, whether an account can be trusted: identity trust signals, behavioral risk modeling, relationship and cluster intelligence, and face, liveness and document verification. We work shoulder-to-shoulder with Product, Risk, Compliance, and Engineering to turn the hardest adversarial problems in crypto into production-grade defenses that protect good users and the open financial system.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to design, build, and own key identity-risk and trust models at OKX. You will build models that combine identity verification results, device and geo data, and user behavior into trust and risk signals, and use graph and clustering methods to uncover organized, industrialized fraud. This is an end-to-end, research-to-production role: you will own algorithms in your domain and ship models into real-money, high-risk, large-scale production environments.

You will be a hands-on technical contributor who works closely with Product, Risk, and Compliance, and who helps raise the technical bar of the team. Your domains span:
• Identity trust risk modeling — fusing verification scores, device, geo, and behavioral data into identity-quality and trust signals.
• Cluster relationship intelligence — graph and clustering methods to identify account farms, mass registration, and coordinated attacks.
• Behavioral risk modeling — behavioral features and sequence models for account takeover and abnormal-session detection.
• Biometric multimodal signals — face embeddings, liveness/anti-spoofing, DeepFake and injection defense, document forgery and AIGC detection, used as inputs to identity trust and the risk layer.
• AI agents — applying agentic AI to scale investigation, detection, and operational defense.

What You'll Be Doing
• Build identity trust risk models: Design and ship coarse-to-fine risk models that fuse face/liveness/document verification scores, device, IP and geo signals, and behavioral data, for high-concurrency real-time decisioning.
• Uncover organized fraud with graph clustering: Build entity graphs across accounts, devices, faces, documents and templates, and apply community detection, clustering, and GNN methods to detect fraud rings and large-scale abuse.
• Develop behavioral features sequence models: Engineer real-time and offline behavioral features, and build sequence models to detect account takeover, bot/script behavior, and abnormal sessions.
• Leverage biometric multimodal signals: Turn biometric features (face embeddings, face quality, liveness and anti-spoofing results) and document-forgery and DeepFake signals into reliable identity-trust inputs for risk decisions, including biometric similarity for cross-account linkage and duplicate-identity detection. Work with the face, liveness, and document teams, or build models yourself.
• Drive execution collaboration: Deliver measurable results while managing ambiguity; partner with backend, product, infrastructure, risk, and compliance teams to integrate models into the production decision chain. Own metric definitions, the balance between false positives and missed fraud, pass rate, monitoring, and drift handling.
• Advance applied R D: Experiment with graph learning, multimodal fusion, and AI agents; stay current with academic and industry advances and translate them into practical defenses.
• Raise the technical bar: Contribute to design reviews, share applied-AI best practices, and mentor junior engineers.

What We Look For
• 5+ years of hands-on experience building risk-control, fraud-detection, or identity-trust models, including significant experience deploying ML systems into production.

• Behavioral modeling: Solid experience with behavioral feature engineering and sequence modeling, including real-time feature pipelines.
• Deep AI/ML expertise: Strong proficiency with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow, and solid experience with production ML systems.
• Strong technical coding

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a seasoned backend engineer to design, build, and scale the backend systems powering OKX’s DEX trading products. You will own critical parts of the trading lifecycle—from quote discovery and order management to transaction submission, execution tracking, and reconciliation. Working closely with product, frontend, smart contract, and infrastructure teams, you will deliver secure, reliable trading experiences across multiple blockchain ecosystems. This is a hands-on engineering role with meaningful architectural ownership and opportunities to grow into technical leadership.

 

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Design and develop backend services for quote aggregation, order management, transaction orchestration, and execution tracking.
• Build reliable integrations with DEX protocols, liquidity sources, blockchain RPC providers, and indexing services. Define clear order and transaction state models, with robust handling of retries, duplicate requests, partial failures, and recovery.
• Ensure trading services remain reliable under high concurrency, traffic spikes, and degraded external dependencies.
• Implement appropriate rate limiting, concurrency controls, resource isolation, and graceful degradation.
• Optimize database access, transaction boundaries, caching, and asynchronous processing. Establish monitoring, alerting, load testing, and incident-response practices for critical trading flows.
• Support trading workflows across multiple blockchain ecosystems. Handle transaction submission, confirmation tracking, failed or dropped transactions, and chain reorganizations.
• Build data synchronization and reconciliation mechanisms to maintain consistency between backend records and on-chain execution.
• Translate product requirements into practical technical designs and production-ready services.
• Own features through implementation, testing, rollout, and post-launch operation. 

 

What We Look For In You
• 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience, including ownership of production systems.
• Strong proficiency in Java and its backend ecosystem. Solid understanding of concurrency, distributed systems, relational databases, caching, and messaging systems.
• Experience building high-availability services and diagnosing performance or reliability issues in production.
• Understanding of blockchain transactions, smart contract interactions, and common DeFi trading mechanisms.
• Ability to independently drive a feature from technical design through production deployment. Strong ownership, sound engineering judgment, and effective cross-functional communication.

jobs.title: AI・次世代業務システム開発リード（マネージャー候補）
jobs.description:
PayPayについて/About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

▼業務推進本部の紹介

業務推進本部は事業の成長を支える「攻め」と「守り」の両輪として、PayPayの決済・金融・データ領域を横断し、「安心・安全」かつ「効率的な業務オペレーション」を実現する組織です。オペレーション戦略立案、企業データ活用、リスク管理、AIやテクノロジーを活用し多岐にわたる領域で業務変革を推進し、PayPayの安心・安全な金融サービス基盤を支えます。 

業務推進本部 Recruiting FactBook

今回の募集ポジションは【基盤企画部】となります。
AIの活用を前提とした次世代の業務オペレーション基盤の企画と開発をリードしていただきます。また、業務オペレーションの効率化と品質向上を目的に、テクノロジーを駆使した自動化・システム化をリードしていただきます。現場の課題を構造的に把握し、RPA・ワークフローシステム・データ連携基盤・AIソリューションなどを用いて、業務のDX（デジタルトランスフォーメーション）を推進します。

▼基盤企画部の役割とミッション
・役割：AI・データ分析・システム開発の知見を活かして、PayPayの業務オペレーションを抜本的に進化させるために、先端技術を取り入れながら新しいITソリューションを次々に企画し開発自体を推進していきます。20代後半～40代の20名ほどの組織です。
・ミッション：IT投資効果を最大化することでPayPayグループ事業へ貢献することが部全体のミッションとなります。

※他社よりも圧倒的なスピードで、最新技術を取り入れた基盤の企画や、実開発の経験を積むことが出来ます。

▼募集の背景
キャッシュレス決済を中心に急拡大を続けるPayPayは、今、新たな金融・生活サービスへと事業領域を大きく広げています。この変革期において、私たちは業務構造を再定義し、盤石な成長基盤を築くことを急務としています。そこで、プロセス設計、基幹データ整備、リスク管理といった多岐にわたる領域で、経営戦略に直結するテーマを自ら企画し、推進できる方を募集します。PayPayの未来を共に創り上げていく、意欲あるあなたの挑戦をお待ちしています。

【具体的な業務内容】

PayPayの成長を支える多様な業務変革を推進。今回は2つのポジションで採用募集をしており、または複数領域を担当いただきます。いずれの領域においても、単なる改善に留まらず、変革を仕組み化し推進する力が求められます。

《具体的な業務内容》

①機械学習エンジニア
PayPayが保有する大規模な決済・ユーザー・加盟店データを活用し、機械学習・AIによって、不正利用対策やAML、各種審査業務の高度化・自動化を推進していただきます。単なる機械学習モデルの開発にとどまらず、業務課題の理解から、データ分析、モデル設計・開発、システムへの実装、運用・継続的な改善までを一貫して担い、AI・データの力でPayPayのオペレーションを変革していくポジションです。

・アカウント乗っ取り（ATO）など、不正利用の検知・防止を目的とした機械学習モデルの設計・開発・改善
・AML領域におけるリスク検知・スコアリング等のAI／機械学習モデルの開発
・ユーザー・加盟店等に関する各種審査業務の高度化・自動化に向けたAIモデルの企画・開発
・大量の決済・ユーザー・加盟店データを活用した特徴量設計、データ分析、モデル評価
・開発した機械学習モデルの業務システムへの実装、および本番運用を見据えた仕組みの構築
・モデルの精度・効果のモニタリングおよび継続的な改善
・業務担当、データサイエンティスト、エンジニア、リスク・コンプライアンス部門などとのクロスファンクショナルな連携

②業務領域エンジニア
PayPayの「AI民主化・開発の民主化」を支える技術基盤を構築し、AI・データ・クラウド技術を活用した業務オペレーションの抜本的な変革を推進していただきます。特に、業務の自動化・高度化を実現する次世代業務基盤をはじめとした基盤の開発・展開を担い、人による作業を前提とした従来の業務プロセスから、AIやシステムが自律的に処理を行う新たな業務オペレーションへの転換を目指します。単に決められたシステムを開発するだけではなく、業務部門とともに課題を発見し、解決策の企画・設計からPoC、開発、実装、業務への導入までを一貫して担うポジションです。技術と業務の双方を理解し、PayPayグループのオペレーション変革を実現する実働部隊として活躍していただきます。

・次世代業務基盤の設計・開発・テスト、およびPayPayグループへのスケール展開
・生成AI（LLM）やAI Agent、自然言語処理などを活用した業務自動化・業務支援機能の企画・開発
・業務特化型RAGなど、生成AIを業務へ組み込むためのシステム・データ設計および実装
・各種業務システムやSaaS、AI、データ基盤を組み合わせたEnd-to-Endの業務自動化
・業務部門の課題分析、およびシステム・AIを活用したTo-Be業務プロセスの設計
・データ連携基盤、API、ETL／データパイプラインなど、業務自動化に必要となる機能の設計・開発
・PoCによる技術検証から本番開発・導入、運用を見据えた継続的な改善
・エンジニア、データサイエンティスト、機械学習エンジニア、業務担当など、他部門とのクロスファンクショナルな連携

 

▼本ポジションの魅力

・圧倒的なスピードで進んでいく、様々な規模の開発プロジェクトに携わることが出来ます。
・生成AIや新しいフレームワークなど、先端技術を取り入れた基盤構築の企画と実装にチャレンジできます。
・専門性を持つ幅広い部署のメンバーと共に、企画・実行力を磨ける環境です。
・自身が企画立案したソリューションが全社やグループ会社に展開されます

 

必要な経験/スキル

①機械学習エンジニア
・Pythonを使った開発経験
・機械学習の基本的な知識と、モデルの学習・評価経験
pandas、scikit-learn、PyTorchなどを用いたデータ分析・モデル開発経験
・学習データの加工、特徴量の設計、評価指標の選定経験
・Gitを使ったチーム開発経験
・開発したモデルをAPIやバッチなどで業務システムに組み込んだ経験

②業務領域エンジニア
・Java、Pythonなどを用いたアプリケーション開発経験
・APIやバックエンドサービスの設計・開発経験
・要件に基づく設計、実装、テストの経験
・SQLやデータベースを用いた開発経験
・Gitを使ったチーム開発経験
・業務要件を整理し、システムの機能やデータ構造に落とし込んだ経験

 

あると望ましい経験/スキル

・モデルの本番運用、再学習、精度監視などの経験
・AWS、GCP、Azureなどのクラウド利用経験

jobs.title: Data Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
About PayPay

PayPay is a FinTech company that has grown to over 75M (as of August 2026) users since its launch in
2018. Our team is hugely diverse with members from over 50 different countries.

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_ 

We dare to believe that we do not need a clear vision to create a future beyond our imagination. PayPay will always stay true to our roots and realize a vision (future) that no one else can imagine by constantly taking risks and challenging ourselves. With this mindset, you will be presented with new and exciting opportunities on a daily basis and have the opportunity to grow and reach new dimensions that you could never have imagined. We are looking for people who can embrace this challenge, refresh the product at breakneck speed and promote PayPay with professionalism and passion.

※ Please note that you cannot apply or be selected in parallel with PayPay Corporation, PayPay Card Corporation and PayPay Securities Corporation.

 

Job Description

The Data Infrastructure team builds and operates the platform that powers data workloads across PayPay Group. We own the Databricks Lakehouse environment, the cloud infrastructure underneath it, and the tooling that keeps it running — from workspace provisioning and access governance to monitoring, alerting, and incident response.

This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and data platform engineering. You'll design and build AWS infrastructure using Terraform, support Databricks workspace and account operations, and improve platform reliability through SRE practices. Day to day, that means writing IaC, responding to operational issues, shipping platform services, and working directly with data engineers across the group to keep their workloads running smoothly.

We're looking for someone who can carry projects independently, thinks about systems beyond the ticket in front of them, and wants to go deeper on data infrastructure as a discipline. You don't need to know Databricks on day one — but you should be comfortable with AWS, Terraform, and the fundamentals of running production infrastructure.

Main Responsibilities
• Design, build, and manage AWS cloud infrastructure using Terraform, following IaC and GitOps practices
• Operate and improve the Databricks Lakehouse platform — workspace provisioning, configuration management, and day-to-day reliability
• Build and maintain platform services and tooling that support data engineers across PayPay Group companies
• Strengthen system reliability through SRE practices: monitoring, alerting, dashboarding, and incident response
• Implement and enforce data governance and security controls in line with compliance requirements
• Collaborate with data engineering teams on infrastructure needs for their projects and workloads
• Participate in on-call rotation and operational support for the data platform

Qualifications
• 5+ years of experience in infrastructure or platform engineering
• Hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code workflows
• Working knowledge of AWS — IAM, VPC, S3, EC2, and multi-account setups
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent)
• Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, or similar)
• Scripting ability in Python and/or Shell
• Solid fundamentals in Linux/Unix, networking (DNS, HTTP, basic OSI model), and security best practices

jobs.title: 経営企画担当（事業管理(FP&A)）/ リーダー候補
jobs.description:
PayPayについて

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50か国の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_

我々は自分たちの想像を超える未来を創るためにあえて明確なビジョンは必要ないと考えています。常にDay1であるスタンスを忘れずに、誰もが想像できないようなビジョン（未来）を実現していくのがPayPayです。
この壮大なビジョンに前向きに取り組み、他社に真似できない圧倒的なスピードでプロダクトを磨き上げ、日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、自ら課題発見し、周囲と協力して新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

◆組織・チームについて

経営企画部では、PayPayグループの事業成長と収益性向上を支えることをミッションとしています。
短期・中長期の経営計画策定や進捗管理、各種KPI・損益の予実分析、経営陣への報告・改善提案を通じて、経営課題の解決や戦略施策の実行を支援しています。また、これらを支える管理会計基盤の整備・運営にも取り組んでいます。
チームには、事業会社・金融機関・コンサルティングファームなど、多様なバックグラウンドを持つメンバーが在籍しています。それぞれの専門性を活かしながら、経営陣や各事業部門と近い距離で、グループ全体の経営課題に取り組める環境です。

▼募集の背景

PayPayグループの事業規模・領域の拡大に伴い、経営計画の策定や予実管理など、グループ全体を見据えた経営管理機能のさらなる高度化を進めています。
本ポジションでは、中長期事業計画・年度予算の策定やKPI・損益分析を中心に、経営課題の特定から改善施策の検討・推進まで、FP A領域を主体的に担っていただける方を募集しています。

【具体的な仕事の内容】

PayPayの経営企画部門において、中長期事業計画・年度予算の策定、予実管理を中心としたFP A業務をご担当いただきます。
• 中長期事業計画・年度予算の策定
• 経営上の重要アジェンダや特命プロジェクトの推進
• 月次KPI・損益の着地見込作成、実績分析・予実差異分析、および経営層向けレポーティング
• 決算に伴う会計処理や会計方針の変更に関する検討、経理部門との調整
• 管理会計システムの運用および改善推進
• 収益性改善に向けた財務管理プロセスの設計・構築・運用改善
• 株主、経営層向けの個別報告・分析対応

▼本ポジションの魅力
• 経営の意思決定に直接関与：
経営陣と近い距離で、経営計画の策定や業績分析を通じて、重要な経営判断や事業成長に貢献できます。
• 分析から改善施策まで一気通貫： 
予実管理やKPI分析にとどまらず、収益性改善に向けた施策の検討・推進まで携わり、FP Aの専門性を高められます。
• Fintechグループならではの経営テーマ：
決済・カード・銀行・証券など複数の金融事業を横断し、幅広い経営課題に取り組むことで、経営企画としての経験を広げられます。

必要な経験/スキル

以下のいずれかの実務経験をお持ちの方（目安：3年以上）
• 事業会社における経営企画・事業企画・FP A・管理会計等の経験
• コンサルティングファームにおける経営管理・財務戦略・事業計画策定等の支援経験

あわせて、以下のスキル・経験をお持ちの方
• 財務諸表や事業KPIを用いた分析、および経営課題の特定・改善提案に関するスキル

Financial Modeling Valuation Analysis

• Perform quarterly and event-driven valuations for private equity/venture-style investments, including waterfall/allocation analyses across complex capital structures (preferred stock, SAFEs, convertible notes, warrants).
• Develop and refine valuation methodologies in line with AICPA Private Equity and Venture Capital Valuation Guidelines.

• Drive continuous improvement of valuation templates, market data inputs, and benchmarking practices.

• 10+ years of relevant experience in valuation, financial modeling, investment banking, or private equity/venture capital, with a focus on private company or illiquid investment valuation.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Prime
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Prime team's mission is to build Bitstamp's prime brokerage for institutional clients — the platform that lets hedge funds, market makers, and professional trading firms onboard, fund, trade, borrow against, and settle positions at scale. We build the systems that move real institutional money: cross-venue settlement, credit against collateral, matched-book lending, and the bridge that brings tokenized securities to our order book — together with the client- and ops-facing surfaces that make them usable, from institutional onboarding and account configuration to reporting and the backoffice tooling our operations run on every day. These are correctness-critical systems where a wrong answer can't be cheaply undone — getting them right is the whole job.

As a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer, you will own the design and end-to-end delivery of features across that whole surface — from the Prime backend services down to the frontend and backoffice screens that expose them. You'll lead other engineers through problems of high ambiguity, set the technical bar for how we build for failure and not just the happy path, and follow a problem across the full institutional lifecycle rather than stopping at a boundary. Flexibility is the job: some weeks that's a settlement edge case in the backend, others a client onboarding flow or an ops dashboard, and you're happy owning whichever the work needs.

This role is based in our London office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

Requires participation in an on-call rotation to support business needs.

What you’ll do
• Lead the design and end-to-end delivery of features across the stack — from Prime backend services (settlement, on-exchange credit, lending, tokenized securities) through to the frontend and backoffice screens clients and ops teams rely on.
• Own the client- and ops-facing journeys across the institutional lifecycle — onboarding, account configuration, reporting, and the tooling that lets operations run the business safely.
• Author detailed designs and break work into reviewable steps, making failure states, invariants, and recovery explicit before you ship — on flows where a wrong answer moves real money.
• Uplevel the team through design-focused code review and mentorship, and move fluidly between backend and frontend as the work demands rather than handing off at a boundary.

What you bring
• A track record of independently delivering complex, high-ambiguity projects with long-term impact, operating them in production and owning every line you ship.
• Strong full-stack range in production — a modern backend (we work primarily in Python/Django and Go) and a component-based frontend (we use Vue) — with the judgment to know where a given problem is best solved and a genuine willingness to own whatever the feature needs, wherever it lives in the stack.
• Hands-on experience building financial systems — user balances, ledgers, risk engines, settlement, onboarding/KYC, or payments — where correctness is non-negotiable and mistakes are expensive.
• Strong design judgment: you enumerate the failure paths, name your invariants, and can point at the constraint, test, or alert that enforces each one.
• Excellent communication: you drive alignment across teams and stakeholders, give substantive design-level review feedback, and mentor engineers to raise the bar around you.

🎁 What we offer
• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career and shape the future of global institutional finance
• Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership
• Top-tier health benefits to fuel your work, including 100% employer-paid private medical insurance for you and comprehensive coverage for dependents, alongside mental health and wellbeing support programs
• Aviva Pension Scheme with highly competitive company matching to secure your future
• Lifestyle Wallet: A highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account to offset expenses like wellness, learning, childcare, and more
• Access to the best AI tools on the market with continuous AI skill-building opportunities for all employees
• Time to recharge: Generous paid time off, company holidays, sick time, parental leave, and paid volunteer time off
• Exceptional office

experience:

Catered meals, fully stocked snacks, team social events, and modern workspaces in our London location

jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The role:

SoFi’s Affiliate Marketing Team is seeking a Senior Affiliates Manager to join us as we continue to expand and evolve our affiliate partnerships across multiple verticals. This role will lead our “Banking” vertical, with primary ownership across our Checking Savings, Smart Card, Invest, and Crypto products. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams to shape and execute affiliate strategy, drive growth and performance across the portfolio, and ensure strong operational and compliance discipline. You’ll also lead internal stakeholder and partner engagement while overseeing key areas including reporting and analytics, forecasting, budgeting, and program optimization. 

What you’ll do:
• Lead the Banking affiliate portfolio across Checking Savings, Smart Card, Invest, and Crypto, owning strategy, performance, and growth across the vertical
• Develop and execute affiliate strategies that drive sustainable, efficient growth, balancing volume, acquisition economics, member quality, and long-terMat business objectives
• Build, manage, and grow high-value affiliate partnerships, from prospecting and negotiation through activation, optimization, and expansion
• Translate performance data, market insights, and partner trends into clear strategic recommendations and actionable growth opportunities
• Own portfolio-level forecasting, budgeting, performance management, and optimization, ensuring affiliate investment is aligned to business goals and deployed efficiently
• Use data and analytics to continuously optimize campaign strategy, partner mix, placements, creative, and channel economics
• Identify opportunities to improve the affiliate funnel from lead through revenue, partnering with internal teams and affiliates to unlock incremental growth and improve performance
• Establish and evolve the affiliate partner strategy, including prioritization, relationship development, recruitment, and expansion of strategic accounts
• Serve as a senior affiliate leader and trusted strategic partner to Business Units, Growth Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Compliance, and other cross-functional teams, aligning stakeholders around priorities and driving initiatives from strategy through execution
• Lead executive-level and cross-functional conversations with the ability to influence decisions, resolve complex issues, and represent Affiliate Marketing's perspective across the organization
• Identify opportunities to strengthen the Affiliate organization’s strategy, operating model, processes, and capabilities to support continued growth and long-term channel scalability
• Mentor and develop team members, sharing affiliate expertise and helping build a high-performing, data-driven culture across the channel
• Highly self-motivated and success-driven professional, capable of generating relationships through own initiative

What you’ll need:
• 3+ years in Affiliate Marketing
• 7+ years of experience
• Bachelor’s degree
• Strategic, data-driven mindset with demonstrated experience optimizing, scaling, and growing performance-based partnerships
• Proven ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and business recommendations
• Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence internally and externally, and across functions and levels
• Experience with affiliate marketing platforms and data/reporting tools such as Impact, Tableau, Snowflake, or similar
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment while balancing competing priorities and driving results
• Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to independently manage a broad portfolio of urgent priorities
• Understanding of and commitment to affiliate compliance, including applicable state and federal regulations and internal policies
• Experience in financial services or fintech preferred

Committee Manager

Location: Cardiff & London

Reporting to: Senior Assistant Company Secretary

Closing date: Tuesday, 27th October at 9am.

About Starling 

At Starling, we are on a mission to provide people with a fairer, smarter, and more human alternative to traditional banks. We are building a leading digital bank, driven by fast technology, fair service, and honest values. Our vision is to create a banking industry that serves everyone, which we accomplish by developing best-in-class proprietary technology, offering an exceptional customer experience, and establishing a strong, sustainable business.

Our five core values – Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim for Greatness – are at the heart of everything we do, guiding our strategy and shaping our culture. We're a branchless, largely paperless bank, committed to responsible banking, sustainability, and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

Working Hours: You will work a 37.5 hour week, with shifts between 9am - 5:30pm, Monday - Friday.

Hybrid working: All Starling colleagues spend a minimum of 10 days per month in the office with flexibility to work the rest from home.

The Opportunity:

Managing the effective end-to-end operation of executive risk committees, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and best practices. This role involves supporting senior stakeholders, maintaining high standards of corporate governance, including minute taking, ensuring committees are well organised, efficient, and aligned with the Bank’s strategic objectives.

What You'll Do:

Committee Management
• Schedule and manage committee meetings, ensuring alignment with the Bank’s governance calendar.
• Support agenda drafting in collaboration with committee chairs and Risk Reporting, ensuring strategic priorities and regulatory requirements are addressed.
• Support the preparation of high quality committee papers, ensuring quality assurance.
• Act as a trusted advisor to the committee chairs and committee members on governance procedures and regulatory obligations.
• Take accurate, concise, and confidential minutes, capturing key discussions, decisions, and action points.
• Co-ordinate action status updates in a timely manner.
• Lead periodic reviews of committee terms of reference, ensuring they maintain alignment with business and regulatory needs.
• Supporting the Senior Assistant Company Secretary with support of Parent Committees.

Governance and Compliance
• Monitor committee compliance with regulatory and statutory requirements (e.g., PRA, FCA).
• Ensure adherence to the Bank’s governance framework and policies.
• Support the department’s responsibilities in respect of the Bank’s risk environment.
• Support periodic reviews of committee effectiveness, contributing to improvement initiatives.

Stakeholder Engagement
• Liaise with senior executives and external advisors to facilitate governance activities.
• Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure smooth communication and collaboration.
• Provide guidance and training on governance processes to committee members and stakeholders, as required.

Documentation and Reporting
• Maintain accurate records of committee activities, including action and decision logs, and other supporting documents.
• Ensure secure and effective document management in line with the Bank’s data governance policies.

What You'll Bring:
• Experience in governance, company secretariat, or committee management.
• Experience working with senior stakeholders and executives.
• Experience within a UK financial services institution, ideally banking (preferred).

Behaviours & Competencies:
• Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including minute-taking and drafting.
• Attention to detail, with a commitment to excellence and maintaining high standards of accuracy.
• Sound judgement and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information.
• Comfortable using new technology, including AI tools, to improve the speed and efficiency of processes.
• Proactive and solution-oriented, with a focus on continuous improvement.
• Collaborative, able to build strong relationships across diverse teams.
• Resilient and adaptable to changing priorities and regulatory environments.

Why Join Starling?
• Make an Impact: Work on projects that directly shape the future of banking and improve the financial lives of our customers. Starling is technology-led, and you'll have the freedom to accomplish your goals in innovative ways.
• Culture of Excellence: Be part of a collaborative, empowered, and forward-thinking team. We encourage experimentation, ownership, and a relentless focus on "doing the right thing.”
• Growth and Development: We are committed to your professional growth, offering opportunities to learn new technologies, take on new challenges, and own interesting things from day one.
• A Bank That Cares: We're a Living Wage employer, committed to flexible working, and dedicated to creating a fair, open, and safe working environment with compassion and inclusion at its core.
• Comprehensive

Benefits:

We offer a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package, including:
• Company-enhanced salary sacrifice pension scheme (7% employer contribution)
• Private Medical Insurance with Vitality including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton.
• 25 days holiday (plus take your public holiday allowance whenever works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Life Insurance at 4x your salary.
• 16 hours of paid volunteering time a year.
• Ability to buy or sell annual leave.
• Generous family-friendly policies.
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• Incentivised refer a friend scheme
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasingOur Commitment to Equality

Starling Bank is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Starling Bank are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. When you provide us with this information, you are doing so at your own consent, with full knowledge that we will process this personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice. By submitting your application, you agree that Starling Bank will collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Lending) - Engine by Starling
jobs.description:
At Engine by Starling, we are on a mission to find and work with leading banks all around the world who have the ambition to build rapid growth businesses, on our technology. 

Engine is Starling's software-as-a-service (SaaS) business, the technology that was built to power Starling, and two years ago we split out as a separate business. 

Starling has seen exceptional growth and success, and a large part of that is down to the fact that we have built our own modern technology from the ground up. This SaaS technology platform is now available to banks and financial institutions all around the world, enabling them to benefit from the innovative digital features, and efficient back-office processes that has helped achieve Starling's success.

We draw upon our experience as knowledgeable bankers, and best in class technologists to become the chosen option for these banks, and preferred partners for leading consultancies.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Engine - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Lending team. At Engine, our Lending domain covers our platform’s existing and new lending products such as overdrafts, unsecured loans, mortgages and credit cards, as well as cross-cutting lending capabilities such as origination and collections. 

This role is pivotal within Engine’s Product & Technology function, in making sure we understand the client needs and build the right products. 

We’re looking for an experienced product manager with experience in either 0-1 build or significant enhancements of lending products. Experience with mortgages or secured term lending in particular is helpful but not essential. Demonstrable track record of developing high quality products that enable business growth is essential.

You’ll work closely with the Business Development, Customer Success and Engineering functions to design solutions that meet client needs and drive our product strategy. 

You’ll enjoy problem solving, getting to the detail, and understanding how clients can make the best use of our product, whilst designing ways to improve it. Your work will span product strategy, client-facing requirements gathering & solution design, and product ownership in an Engineering context. You’ll have a technical mindset and enjoy working collaboratively with Engineering leadership to build scalable products for different market contexts. 

What you’ll get to do
• Take ownership of a best-in-class lending product by scoping out breakthrough features, and owning the end-to-end delivery of your sub-domain(s) in close alignment with the Product and Engineering domain leaders.
• Own the Roadmap, vision and strategy for your sub-domain, contributing to the overall lending roadmap
• You’ll work cross-functionally with engineers, designers, document writers, and QA to drive the design and delivery of improvements to the product that align with the vision of the business, taking into account existing and potential clients.
• You’ll confidently and independently prioritise incoming tasks and clearly communicate ‘the what’ and ‘the why’ of each decision to both internal and external stakeholders.
• You’ll manage deadlines and be responsible for proactively raising delivery risks that may impact our client projects.
• You’ll develop a close relationship with our Delivery and Customer Success teams, taking the lead on assessing feature requests and client requirements as a key input into overall feature and roadmap definition.
• You’ll work closely with our Business Development team by helping the team understand Engine’s capabilities in your domain and joining early-stage Sales conversations as an SME.
• You will be responsible for being the champion of the feature, telling different teams and clients about the product, and adapting your style of communication and materials to different stakeholders
• You’ll manage difficult conversations with senior stakeholders both internally and externally, balancing strategic direction and pragmatic decision making.
• Proven product

experience:

You have been a Product Manager or Product Owner with demonstrated experience building and shipping complex and impactful products
• Lending product track record: You’ve built or significantly improved lending products before and are excited to own an ambitious sub-domain within Engine’s lending.
• Eager Learner: You have an appetite for learning, listening, and growing within an organisation that is constantly expanding
• FinTech/Banking Exposure: Prior experience or a strong baseline understanding of FinTech, or a regulated banking/lending environment.
• Technical Foundation: A product or engineering background, technical experience, or deep technical curiosity.
• Clear Communication & Stakeholder Management: You can clearly explain the "what", "how", and "why" behind the product backlog to your engineering and design triad, and you navigate risks and tradeoffs excellently. You’re comfortable presenting in front of clients and can work closely with Client Success to manage expectations.
• Ways of working and leadership: You use your PM experience to contribute to team-wide improvements to ways of working and product process. It would be nice to have experience managing or coaching other PMs, but this is not essential.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:
• 45 minutes with someone from the product team.
• 1.5 hours with two more people from the team including a case study
• 45 minutes with two members of the senior leadership team.
• 33 days holiday (including public holidays, which you can take when it works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Incentives refer a friend scheme
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasing

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

jobs.title: AML & Prohibited Activities (Investigations) Analyst (6 months contract)
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:
• Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About the team:

Ongoing Monitoring sits in our first line of defence (1LOD) operations’ department, responsible for monitoring the activity of our SME customers (‘members’) for the purpose of preventing, detecting and reporting sanctions, money laundering, terrorism financing, tax evasion, bribery and corruption, money mules and fraud. 

It's an opportunity to work with an amazing team across multiple geographies, including analysts, team leaders, product and engineering managers, data scientists and operations managers. The role has exposure to many senior stakeholders across the business and is at the heart of what we do to protect our customers.

What we’re looking for: 

Here at Tide, we are looking for someone who
• has a good understanding of Financial Crime Typologies including money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, and sanctions evasion, bribery, tax evasion, and suspicious activities reporting.
• is passionate and proactive, who will help ensure Tide is taking all relevant steps to detect and prevent all aspects of financial crime.
• understands financial crime in a global financial set up with specific focus towards UK and Europe Geography.
• has exceptional communication skills in English (both Written and Speaking).
• can use expert judgement to recommend if a case warrants filing of a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) 

This role is a key element of our ongoing monitoring team sitting within the first line of defence. You’ll be responsible for ensuring we put our genuine members first, through monitoring transaction types and behaviours across our customer base, whilst spotting and investigating potentially suspicious activity. 

As an Alert Review analyst you’ll be performing tasks related to the following

Transaction Monitoring Alert Review Analysis:
• Monitor and investigate alerts generated by automated transaction monitoring and sanctions screening systems.
• Conduct comprehensive, risk-based reviews of customer accounts and transaction histories to identify suspicious patterns or activities that deviate from a customer's normal behavior.
• Synthesize information from various sources, including customer profiles (KYC/CDD), public records, adverse media, and internal data.
• Assess the transactional activity in the context of financial crime typologies across a variety of payment types and financial products offered.
• Draft a concise, yet comprehensive report on findings prior to discounting the alert or reporting suspicious activity.
• Contact the member (customer) via email, chat or by phone to seek additional contextual information without tipping off.
• Contact representatives of partner banks via emails in cases where a fin crime investigation is required on Tide’s member

Suspicious Activity Reporting (SAR) Recommendations:
• Draft and present detailed, well-reasoned SAR recommendations to experts responsible for filing SARs to regulatory authorities.
• Construct a clear, concise, and defensible narrative outlining the suspicious activity, the investigative steps taken, and the rationale for the recommendation.
• Ensure all supporting documentation and evidence is accurately compiled and included in the case file for audit purposes.

Sanctions Screening:
• Analyze potential sanctions hits against international lists (e.g., OFAC, EU, UN, HMT) for cross border payment transactions.
• Apply a risk-based approach to differentiate between a true match and a false positive based on criteria like phonetic similarities, aliases, and supporting data.
• Escalate confirmed sanctions hits to management immediately for asset blocking or reporting.

Other tasks as part of the role
• Gain in-depth understanding of the technology and tools that aid in the alert review and analysis.
• Proactively calling out potential efficiencies in our tools and processes used for transaction analysis
• Managing your own case load to meet performance targets (Productivity, Quality and Customer experience)
• Participate in internal and external training programs related to fraud offences detection and prevention and other subjects that may form part of the day-to-day work requirements.
• Treating Tide members fairly by taking responsibility to ensure that their needs are met
• Make recommendations for process improvements to prevent future occurrences of fraud
• Establishing good relationships with various departments throughout the organisation to ensure good operational synergy
• Participate in internal and external training programs related to fraud offences detection and prevention and other subjects that may form part of the day-to-day work requirements.
• Treating Tide members fairly by taking responsibility to ensure that their needs are met

What makes you a great fit: 

You are open to flexible shift timings and patterns, it will be five days working with two days off not necessarily weekends.
• You have 2 to 4+ years of experience in a Transaction monitoring, Financial Crime risk related role in financial services
• You have a keen eye for process improvements, looking how we can work leaner and more robustly.
• You have an analytical mind and are able to digest large data sets and spot patterns and trends with ease
• You have exceptional communication skills, written and verbal. Are able to communicate with our members (including via telephone) , internal stakeholders regulatory bodies if required
• You have C1/C2 level of spoken and written English

What you get in return:
• Group Life Insurance
• 27 days holiday
• 3 days for L D or volunteering time off per year
• We invest in your development with a professional L D budget per year
• Snacks, light food, drinks in the office
• Enhanced family-friendly leave
• Sabbatical leave

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

 

Disclaimer

This role requires strong leadership skills, along with a deep understanding of fraud prevention, risk management, and compliance within the payments ecosystem.

Your team will be responsible for the monitoring of the transaction and behaviours across our customer base, ensuring we put our genuine members first, whilst spotting and investigating potentially suspicious activity. This role is a key element of our team, so we’re looking for someone who is a passionate investigator, possesses good knowledge on merchant payments, who will help reduce risk to tide, and let our members get back to doing what they love.

• Develop strategies to reduce fraudulent activities across merchant card payments and ensure merchants meet compliance requirements.

• Foster a collaborative team environment focused on continuous improvement and high operational efficiency.
• Representing your area in front of different stakeholders, including internal and external auditors.

• You are willing to work in flexible shift patterns.
• 3-5 years of experience in merchant banking, card acquiring, merchant acquiring, transaction monitoring, or merchant card payments with automated processes and data driven decisioning tools/culture.
• Proven leadership experience, with a track record of managing teams in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
• Deep understanding of card acquiring processes, merchant acquiring systems, payment networks (Visa, MasterCard, etc.), and fraud detection methodologies.
• Analytical mindset with a proven ability to interpret complex transaction data and identify fraud patterns.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience in handling escalations and coordinating cross-functional teams.

jobs.title: FinCrime Operations Senior Analyst - RFI

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Global KYC and Onboarding
jobs.description:
We are the Global KYC and Onboarding squad in the Servicing department and we have a mission: to enable teams at Wise to expand and fine-tune the business in a "config change" manner all across the globe, while remaining compliant and safe for the customers. There are three teams in the squad: Business Onboarding Verification, Personal Onboarding Verification and Wise Platform Verification (our B2B platform).

 

The scale we operate at: In FY2025, 15.6 million people and businesses used Wise, we onboarded over 5.9 million new customers (~500k/month), and moved £145.2bn across borders (~£400m/day) across 160+ countries and 40+ currencies. Our verification systems aren't supporting tools — they're core production infrastructure that protects customers, enables growth, and must stay reliable under constant change in regulations, policies, and evolving threat patterns.

 

All of the teams are diverse, cross-functional groups passionate about solving complex problems with elegant solutions. We bring together backend and frontend engineers, mobile developers, designers, data analysts, and product managers who collaborate closely to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Our teams are responsible for the critical verification journeys that business and personal customers complete before using Wise's products. We own the entire verification lifecycle – from document collection flows and automated review systems to agent tooling and compliance monitoring. We operate with high ownership in a bottom-up, transparent culture, make data-driven decisions, and celebrate both technical excellence and customer impact. Right now we're focused on building KYC/FinCrime as a configuration-driven product, refactoring and building new scalable microservice systems, and increasing automation using ML/AI where it genuinely improves decisioning, review quality, and operational efficiency — with safe fallbacks and clear observability. As a team that touches both regulatory requirements and customer experience, we have unique opportunities to innovate in a space traditionally resistant to change.

 

By joining one of our teams, you'll directly impact these customers by transforming a traditionally frustrating experience into one that's fast, intuitive, and fair. Your code will help individuals and small businesses access global banking faster, enable entrepreneurs to pay international employees on time, and allow people like you and your teammates support their families across borders without friction. We're not just building verification systems – we're removing barriers that stand between our customers and their financial freedom.

 

We need like-minded engineers in all the teams in the squad, so we'll use the interview process to discover where your unique skills shine brightest. Ultimately, we want to match you with the team that perfectly aligns with your experience and sets you up for success!

 

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own large-sized, impactful projects within the domain. Your responsibilities span end-to-end:
• You will own the technical roadmap for your areas of ownership, ensuring they address important technical debt, reliability, scalability, and security concerns.
• You will be instrumental in designing and implementing robust backend systems that provide clean APIs and interfaces to hide the internal complexity.
• You will drive the integration with various risk and mitigation systems to ensure that Wise is compliant.
• You will take initiative to identify and solve impactful problems both within your team and beyond, contributing to high-impact cross-team initiatives.

 

What we expect from you:
• You have 4+ years of experience working with any language, asynchronous message queues (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ), and have architected and built highly scalable microservices.
• A strong product mindset and a deep passion for both customer experience and regulatory compliance.
• You will prioritize work with a holistic view of the customer and business impact, making data-driven decisions to solve complex, ambiguous problems.
• Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and architectural concepts clearly to diverse audiences, including product managers, designers, and other engineering teams.
• You demonstrate a commitment to writing clean, testable, maintainable, and highly performant code, and you are a strong advocate for best coding practices and rigorous code reviews.
• Proven ability to identify and lead the technical delivery of large-scale, organisationally-complex projects, adept at anticipating and escalating organizational blockers.
• Extensive experience working with relational and non-relational databases, including advanced query optimization, schema design, and data lifecycle management for sensitive information.

 

What does success look like?
• You’ll have deeply embedded yourself within our mission, owning and delivering quarterly goals for the team, significantly impacting our ability to scale and improve verification processes.
• You’ll own the technical roadmap for your areas, ensuring it supports both immediate delivery needs and long-term strategic objectives, including addressing technical debt and improving system health.
• You’ll leverage your expertise to identify the right solutions to solve ambiguous, open-ended problems, driving tough prioritization decisions that deliver clear business and customer value.
• You’ll consistently define and implement technical solutions or efficient operational processes that level up your team and contribute beyond it, mentoring other engineers and sharing best practices.
• You’ll inspire a high-performing team environment where ideas are shared, technical excellence is pursued, and continuous learning is embraced.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I - Risk Control & Governance
jobs.description:
Job Description

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Engineer to join the Risk & Control Governance team / Risk Assessment Group. You'll be instrumental in building the governance, assurance, and data foundations that ensure every risk decision at Wise is consistent, explainable, auditable, and continuously monitored.

This role works at the intersection of the Risk API platform, Product, and Financial Crime (FinCrime) teams — offering a unique opportunity to build the systems that give Wise confidence in every risk assessment it operates at scale.

You will be the driving force behind the platform's trustworthiness and integrity, focusing on:
• Data Governance: Building and maintaining data ownership, lineage, and quality monitoring systems that ensure every risk decision is powered by trusted data.
• Control Assurance: Designing continuous monitoring and validation systems that verify controls perform as intended — including trigger validation, drift detection, coverage analysis, and control health scoring.
• Auditability & Explainability: Implementing end-to-end audit trails, change history tracking, and explainability tooling that enables one-click regulatory evidence generation.
• Scalable Solutions: Designing robust, high-throughput solutions that handle large volumes of data and can be quickly understood and scaled across multiple distinct risk domains.

 

What will you be working on?

You will join the team at a pivotal moment, with your contributions being immediately visible and critical to the success of the entire Risk Assessment platform's governance layer.

The core challenge for the team — and your immediate focus — is to build the assurance and governance foundations that the platform currently lacks, ensuring every control can answer: Was the right trigger used? Was the right data available? Was the right decision made? Is the control still effective?

 

Your immediate impact will be to:
• Build Data Trust: Implement data quality monitoring, data contracts, and lineage tracking that give the organisation full traceability from risk decisions back to source data.
• Deliver Continuous Assurance: Design and build automated monitoring systems that continuously validate control effectiveness — detecting drift, false positives/negatives, and coverage gaps before they become incidents.
• Enable Auditability: Create audit trail infrastructure and explainability tooling that dramatically reduces the effort required for regulatory reporting and compliance evidence generation.
• Integrate with Risk API: Work closely with the Risk API team to embed governance and assurance capabilities into the core platform, ensuring clean integration points and shared data contracts.

Qualifications

What do you need?
• Strong Backend Engineering: Proven experience building high-throughput, data-intensive systems in any language. Hands-on expertise with Kafka, SQL and NoSQL databases, and designing for scale and reliability.
• Data Engineering Aptitude: Experience with data quality frameworks, pipeline orchestration, or lineage tracking. You understand what it takes to make data trustworthy at scale.
• Systems Thinking: Ability to reason about complex distributed systems, identify failure modes, and design solutions that are both robust and operationally simple.
• Ownership & Autonomy: Comfortable operating with ambiguity, defining your own work from high-level objectives, and driving delivery end-to-end without close direction.
• Collaborative Mindset: Ability to work effectively across team boundaries — particularly with the Risk API team, Product, and FinCrime stakeholders — to align on contracts, data models, and integration patterns.

Additional information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

jobs.description:
A bit about the role

We are looking for an Internal Audit Senior Manager (FinCrime) to join our Brussels based growing EU IA team. 

Your main task will be to coordinate the financial crime internal audit process within the company and externally with partnering firms. You will make recommendations to improve governance, risk management and internal controls. You will be responsible for planning, assigning, and supervising the operational activities of the team as well as completing your own tasks. 

The role presents a great opportunity to focus on the development and delivery of audit engagements in a fast paced environment, focussed on data driven audit techniques and continuous monitoring. Relevant experience working in assurance, risk or control roles and deploying technology enabled assurance is key to driving the internal audit agenda.

We are a growing team, therefore you have the unique opportunity to collaborate and shape the operations, methodology and approaches of the Internal Audit function, both regionally and globally.
