jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Send High Volume
jobs.description:
The Send High Volume team tackles the challenges unique to customers sending large amounts internationally — think relocators moving their life savings, people managing investments abroad, or businesses running a global enterprise.

For most of them, sending an amount this big is nerve-wracking. A tiny shift in the exchange rate can cost thousands, higher risk and scrutiny mean slow-downs at every step (navigating daily and monthly limits, proving the legitimacy of funds, waiting on risk clearance from banks on either side, etc.), and possibly a far more severe consequence of missing the payment timelines.

They monitor, and worry throughout — Did it arrive? Why is it held? Will the rate hold? When it works, it's magic. When it doesn't, it's one of the most stressful things they'll ever go through.

Our mission is to make sending £5M just as effortless as sending £500, matching our products to the unique needs of these customers:
• Predictability and simplicity of process: seeing upfront what's needed and how to navigate a transfer this big, instead of hitting surprises mid-way.
• Predictability of price and ETAs: a consistent, reliable forecast, so they can plan their expenses, budget and timelines with confidence and peace of mind.
• Accessibility and quality of support: having a fast, direct access to a representative who specialises in the navigating the complexities of their route, and shows the same urgency and care they feel themselves.

What You’ll Do

You'll be one of the engineers shaping how we build for our highest-value customers. You'll own the technical design and delivery of large, high-stakes projects, and stay accountable for what you build long after launch. Day to day, that looks like:
• Leading the technical design of large projects — breaking ambiguous problems down into milestones the team can deliver, writing and reviewing RFCs, making technical decisions around the solutions we build.
• Building the hardest parts yourself — designing reliable, secure, and API-first solutions with clean, well-documented interfaces within our existing micro-services architecture using Java/Spring, Kafka, and relational databases.
• Owning what we run in production — being accountable for the availability, reliability and security of the team's systems. That means setting the bar for observability and testing, being part of the on-call rota, leading incident response and post-mortems, and paying down tech debt before it turns into risk.
• Multiplying the team — mentoring and coaching engineers, onboarding new joiners, spreading knowledge so nobody (including you) is a single point of failure, and interviewing regularly to keep raising our hiring bar.
• Shaping the roadmap — giving strong, product-minded feedback on the roadmap and working closely with product, design, analytics and operations, so we're always working on the most impactful thing and delivering at a predictable pace.

It's backend-focused and AI-first, but the role spans all of Wise: you'll redefine UX, reshape architecture and fix foundations wherever the biggest problems are.

• Challenge first line teams on the development of controls and provide approvals on any control changes, new products or features

A Bit

About You:

• Travel. You must be willing to travel to our other offices as required.
• Must already be legally authorized to work in the US, we cannot provide Visas for this role
• This is NOT a remote position, this is a full-time position that will be located in New York, NY. Wise requires three days of in-office work.

Nice to haves:

Conheça o Inter 
Pioneiros, mudamos o mercado ao lançar o primeiro banco digital do Brasil e seguimos criando tendências com tecnologia de ponta. Evoluímos para um Super App Financeiro Global, com soluções completas e inovação de primeira. Aqui, o trabalho tem propósito: construir oportunidades reais, transformar a vida das pessoas e o mercado financeiro. Esse é o nosso Jeito Inter de Fazer. Se você quer fazer parte dessa mudança e deixar um legado, seu lugar é aqui.

Vem ser Sangue Laranja.

Get to Know Inter 
As pioneers, we transformed the market by launching Brazil’s first digital bank and continue to shape the future with cutting-edge technology.
We have evolved into a Global Financial Super App, delivering complete solutions and leading innovation. Here, work has purpose: creating real opportunities, transforming people’s lives, and reshaping the financial market.
This is the Inter way of making things happen. If you want to be part of this transformation and leave your mark, your place is here.

Become Sangue Laranja.

Buscamos Pessoas Desenvolvedoras Mobile Ios/Android | Pleno, Sênior e Especialista

O Inter tá crescendo: novos produtos, novos mercados e uma escala cada vez maior.
Por isso, a gente tá procurando pessoas desenvolvedoras Mobile que queiram construir o futuro da arquitetura do nosso Super App.
Se você curte mais resolver problemas do que repetir padrões, seu lugar é aqui com a gente.

O desafio

Você vai construir os serviços distribuídos que fazem nosso Super App funcionar pra milhões de pessoas. Seu objetivo será garantir alta disponibilidade e baixa latência, com decisões de arquitetura que impactam de verdade a experiência de quem usa o app.
Mais do que só implementar, a gente quer que você participe das decisões técnicas e ajude a evoluir o jeito que a gente faz tecnologia no Inter.

 

No seu dia a dia, você vai:
• Desenvolver e manter aplicativos nativos [Swift/SwiftUI | Kotlin/Jetpack].
• Implementar telas, navegação e integração com APIs.
• Garantir testes e boas práticas de código e arquitetura (ex.: MVVM).
• Participar de code review e cerimônias do time.
• Apoiar decisões de arquitetura e evolução do app.
• Contribuir para padrões, performance e guias técnicos do time mobile
• Atuar usando IA e tecnologias para automatizar a produção de código

Obrigatório
• Graduação completa em área tecnológica
• Experiência em desenvolvimento nativo para iOS ou Android: Para iOS: Conhecimento em Swift, guidelines da Apple e gerenciamento de dependências. Para Android: Conhecimento em Kotlin, guidelines do Google, Jetpack Components, Coroutines e MVVM.
• Conhecimento em testes unitários e instrumentados para garantir a qualidade do código;
• Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial

Diferenciais
• Experiência com Server-Driven UI ou fluxos complexos (onboarding, formulários).
• Conhecimento de CI/CD para mobile (Fastlane, Gradle, Xcode Cloud).
• Prática de testes unitários e de UI.
• Conhecimento da outra plataforma (iOS e Android) ou React Native/Flutter.
• Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)

E pra simplificar a sua vida, olha só o que a gente oferece:
• Vale-alimentação e vale-refeição
• Plano de saúde e odontológico completo
• Seguro de vida
• Day Off no seu aniversário
• Licença parental estendida
• Programa Baby On Board (Sala de Amamentação): um espaço tranquilo e preparado no escritório pra quando as mães retornarem da licença maternidade.
• Auxílio-creche/babá
• WellHub (antigo Gympass) e Grupo de Corrida Inter: Acesso a academias e estúdios no Brasil todo e um grupo pra você correr e se conectar com a galera do Inter.
• Espaço CARE4U: Serviços de cabelo, manicure e muito mais, sem complicação.
• Vantagens exclusivas no Super App: Você tem acesso a benefícios como o Duo Gourmet, que te dá pratos em dobro nos melhores restaurantes, e muito mais
• Cartão Prime Inter: Um cartão com benefícios exclusivos
• Programas de treinamento e capacitação: A gente investe no seu desenvolvimento com cursos, workshops e plataformas de aprendizado pra você nunca parar de crescer

Como funciona o processo
• Conversa inicial
• Avaliações técnicas
• Entrevista com Talent
• Entrevista com liderança
• Proposta

Buscamos Pessoas Desenvolvedoras Salesforce | Pleno, Sênior e Especialista

O Inter tá crescendo: novos produtos, novos mercados e uma escala cada vez maior.
Por isso, a gente tá procurando pessoas desenvolvedoras Salesforce que queiram construir o futuro da arquitetura do nosso Super App.
Se você curte mais resolver problemas do que repetir padrões, seu lugar é aqui com a gente.

O desafio

Você vai construir os serviços distribuídos que fazem nosso Super App funcionar pra milhões de pessoas. Seu objetivo será garantir alta disponibilidade e baixa latência, com decisões de arquitetura que impactam de verdade a experiência de quem usa o app.
Mais do que só implementar, a gente quer que você participe das decisões técnicas e ajude a evoluir o jeito que a gente faz tecnologia no Inter.

 

No seu dia a dia, você vai:
• Configurar objetos, campos e automações nativas (Flow, Process Builder).
• Desenvolver customizações em Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC) e Aura.
• Criar relatórios e dashboards para equipes de negócio.
• Projetar e desenvolver integrações síncronas (REST/SOAP) e assíncronas com sistemas internos e externos.
• Aplicar versionamento (Git/SFDX) e participar de pipelines de CI/CD.
• Monitorar logs, performance e governança do ambiente Salesforce.
• Documentar ajustes e manter dados consistentes conforme políticas do CRM.
• Participar de refinamentos, propor alternativas de solução e conduzir code reviews.

Obrigatório
• Graduação completa em área tecnológica
• Experiência com Salesforce
• Sólido domínio de Apex, LWC, Aura, SOQL/SOSL, padrões de desenvolvimento assíncrono, arquitetura orientada a eventos e limites da plataforma (governor limits).
• Experiência com múltiplas clouds (Sales, Service, Experience ou Field Service) e integrações via Middleware (MuleSoft, Dell Boomi).
• Proficiência em Git e pipelines de CI/CD.
• Experiência com metodologias ágeis
• Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial

Diferenciais
• Certificações Salesforce: Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer I, Platform Developer II, Agentforce Specialist, Application Architect, Integration Architect, System Architect, Technical Architect (CTA).
• Vivência com MuleSoft, Marketing Cloud, Experience Cloud, Financial Services Cloud ou OmniStudio.
• Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade (New Relic, Datadog).
• Conhecimento em outras linguagens de programação (.NET, Python, Java).
• Inglês intermediário/avançado.
• Vivência com estratégias de multi-org, CI/CD avançado e automação de testes end-to-end.
• Atuação com Tableau CRM, Intelligence ou Data Cloud.
• Participação ativa em fóruns de arquitetura ou grupos de usuário Salesforce.
• Experiência com AI Cloud, Einstein, Slack e integrações com plataformas de dados (Snowflake).
• Reconhecimento na comunidade (Salesforce MVP, speaker em eventos como Dreamforce, publicações).
• Participação em conselhos consultivos (Customer Advisory Boards).
• Experiência em governança de ecossistemas complexos (1000+ usuários, multi-org, multi-cloud).
• Experiência em programas globais de adoção de AI Cloud, Data Cloud e integrações omnichannel

A missão de um Analista de Produtos é atuar como ponte entre o que os clientes precisam e o que o negócio busca alcançar, transformando oportunidades em soluções bem definidas, viáveis e relevantes. Seu papel envolve compreender o cliente, interpretar dados, escolher o que deve ser priorizado, detalhar escopo, antecipar riscos e trabalhar em conjunto com várias áreas para garantir entregas consistentes. Cabe ao analista promover a evolução contínua do produto, equilibrando experiência, resultados e tecnologia para criar produtos eficientes e de alto valor.

No seu dia a dia, você vai:
• Priorizar demandas: O backlog costuma ser maior do que a capacidade do time e o analista precisa tomar decisões que equilibrem viablidade financeira, impacto no cliente, urgência e complexidade técnica. Essa priorização exige capacidade analítica e negociação com stakeholders.
• Transformar problemas e necessidades em soluções: O analista deve identificar dores, validar hipóteses e transformar insights em um escopo bem definido. Muitas vezes as demandas chegam vagas, contraditórias ou sem dados, exigindo investigação, refinamento e alinhamento com diversas áreas.
• Construir escopos completos e detalhados: Garantir que o produto cubra todos os cenários como fluxo, exceções, regras de negócio, impactos operacionais e riscos. Um escopo incompleto gera retrabalho, desalinhamento e atrasos no desenvolvimento.
• Alinhar stakeholders com interesses diferentes: O analista precisa conciliar expectativas de Tecnologia, UX, Growth, Marketing, Jurídico, Operações, Atendimento e outras áreas. Isso envolve comunicação clara, gestão de conflitos, influência e capacidade de defender decisões de produto.
• Compreender limitações e possibilidades técnicas: Mesmo não sendo um desenvolvedor, o analista precisa entender conceitos como APIs, integrações, arquitetura e restrições do sistema. Isso permite escrever requisitos melhores, medir complexidade e dialogar com times de Tecnologia.
• Tomar decisões: Definir e acompanhar KPIs, medir impacto, analisar métricas de uso e interpretar tendências fazem parte da rotina. O desafio está em combinar dados quantitativos (dashboards, SQL, KPIs) com dados qualitativos (pesquisa, feedbacks, testes).
• Conduzir entregas com agilidade e qualidade: O analista precisa equilibrar ritmo de desenvolvimento, qualidade da experiência do cliente e estabilidade operacional, além de realizar testes e validações adequados.
• Saber lidar com incertezas e mudanças: O analista deve ser resiliente e adaptável em um ambiente onde as prioridades podem mudar e limitações técnicas podem surgir.

O que buscamos

Obrigatórios:
• Experiência prévia em desenvolvimento de produto ou projetos.
• Gestão de produtos: Domínio de frameworks como Scrum, Kanban, Lean, Agile e OKRs, roadmapping e técnicas de priorização.
• Análise de Dados: SQL básico, Excel, uso de ferramentas de métricas (Tableau), definição e acompanhamento de KPIs, métricas de produto (MAU, churn, NPS, LTV, CAC).
• Conhecimento de Negócios: Análise de mercado e benchmarking, entendimento de modelos de negócios (SaaS, marketplace, B2B, B2C), estratégia de precificação e go-to-market.
• Noções Técnicas: Familiaridade com APIs, integrações, arquitetura de software, entendimento de ciclo de desenvolvimento.
• Utilização de Ferramentas: Figma, Miro, XWiki, etc.
• Gestão de Projetos e Stakeholders: Planejamento e acompanhamento de sprints e documentação clara de requisitos.

Além das experiências tradicionais, buscamos uma pessoa preparada para o novo cenário de produtos potencializados por Inteligência Artificial, capaz de desenhar experiências usando AI como copiloto, definir comportamentos de agentes, estruturar Skills reutilizáveis e acelerar a construção de soluções por meio de ferramentas de IA, contribuindo para elevar a produtividade e a maturidade do Design em escala.

• Liderar tecnicamente iniciativas estratégicas de Design nas frentes de Investimentos e Seguros.
• Definir diretrizes e boas práticas para garantir consistência entre produtos e jornadas.
• Projetar experiências complexas considerando interfaces conversacionais e experiências potencializadas por IA.
• Desenhar fluxos agenticos, definindo objetivos, contexto, memória, ferramentas e comportamento dos agentes de IA.

• Apoiar designers na construção de soluções para desafios de alta complexidade.
• Atuar como parceiro estratégico de Produto, Tecnologia, Dados e Negócio na definição de soluções.
• Estruturar descobertas, hipóteses e recomendações baseadas em dados, pesquisas e comportamento dos usuários.

jobs.title: Open Application
jobs.location: Barcelona, Spain; Berlin, Berlin, Germany; București, Bucharest, Romania; Vienna, Vienna, Austria
jobs.description:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

Open Application

Didn't find a position that matches your profile? No worries - we’d still love to hear from you! Just send us your CV, and our Talent Team will take a look at your profile to see if we have a fit for you.

 

What’s in it for you
• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

 .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

• Seamless partnership with Product, Engineering, Risk, and Legal teams in a fast-moving, regulated environment is critical to shape the product roadmap, validate customer problems, and ensure feasible, compliant feature implementations.

• Behavioral analytics, A/B testing, and funnel metrics should naturally drive your design decisions to proactively identify opportunities that boost customer engagement, adoption, and retention.
• A proven track record of thriving in fast-moving, highly regulated environments will demonstrate your ability to successfully negotiate solutions that satisfy strict Risk and Compliance requirements without compromising the end-user experience.
• High customer empathy and excellent stakeholder management skills are necessary to build long-term user trust while championing a product-driven, highly collaborative culture across the organization.

Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

People at Brex

The People team builds and sustains the culture that powers Brex. We focus on talent, growth, and the employee experience — creating an environment where high-agency individuals can thrive. From hiring to development, we design systems that grow with scale and challenge people to reach their potential. It’s a team for builders, coaches, and culture-shapers.

What you’ll do

As a People Business Partner, you'll act as a trusted advisor and coach to senior GTM leaders and managers, helping them navigate org design, workforce planning, and change management while driving a culture of high performance. In this role, you'll also partner closely with Employee Relations, Compensation, and People Operations, and lead org design conversations that keep GTM's structure aligned with business strategy as it grows.

This role is designed for someone who thrives operating at the intersection of strategic advisory and hands-on execution, and who wants to deepen their partnership with revenue-adjacent and customer-facing organizations at a fast-scaling fintech company.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our Seattle office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Act as a trusted advisor and coach to senior leaders and managers across Sales Development and Post Sales (Customer Experience, Implementation, and Solutions Consulting)
• Drive a culture of high performance by coaching leaders on setting clear expectations, delivering effective feedback, and applying performance management consistently across their orgs
• Use data and org health metrics to identify trends, diagnose root causes, and recommend proactive interventions to GTM leadership
• Lead org design with GTM leaders, ensuring structure and headcount plans align with business strategy and growth targets
• Partner with Employee Relations on complex, sensitive employee matters, escalating themes and risks as needed while maintaining discretion and sound judgment
• Support bi-annual promotion and performance calibration cycles for your client groups, ensuring rigor, consistency, and fairness in outcomes
• Drive cross-functional People projects in partnership with other People Business Partners and People teams

Requirements
• 5+ years of experience working in People Business Partner, Employee Relations, or other closely related functions
• Demonstrated experience advising senior leaders on org design, workforce planning, and organizational change
• Strong understanding of performance management practices in high-performance cultures (feedback, coaching, calibration, documentation)
• Experience partnering with Employee Relations on sensitive employee matters, with sound judgment on when and how to escalate.
• Proven ability to build trusted, credible relationships with senior leaders and influence outcomes without direct authority
• Comfort using data to tell a story, identify trends, and drive decisions
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client groups and competing priorities
• Clear, concise communicator, both written and verbal
• Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion

Bonus points
• Experience supporting Customer Experience, Implementation, Sales Development, or other GTM/revenue-adjacent functions specifically
• Familiarity with HRIS and performance systems like Workday or Lattice
• Experience building or scaling manager enablement, coaching, or leadership development programs

What success looks like
• GTM leaders and managers see you as a trusted, strategic thought partner
• Performance, promotion, and calibration cycles run smoothly and predictably across your client groups
• Org design and workforce planning decisions are grounded in data and aligned with business strategy
• Risks, trends, and underperformance are surfaced early, with thoughtful escalation to Employee Relations and People leadership
• You're building the scope and credibility to grow into a senior/lead People Business Partner role supporting larger or more complex client groups.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $144,640 - $180,800. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue for Brex and every member of our team directly affects our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current customers. Our winning culture recognizes big team wins and celebrates individual accomplishments. We ensure that top performers are recognized and have built a competitive environment to motivate and unify the team

What you'll do

As a Startup VC Partnerships Manager, you'll be the face of Brex in the startup ecosystem. You'll build trusted relationships with top-tier VCs, accelerators, incubators, law firms, and high-growth founders, and turn those relationships into a steady stream of new customers.

The role has two sides that reinforce each other. On the community side, you'll represent Brex in the market by hosting events, driving engagement, and creating meaningful connections that bring real value to founders. On the partnerships side, you'll identify and cultivate partners from the ground up, build tailored go-to-market plans for each one, onboard them into the Brex ecosystem, and manage the relationship over time.

Success will be measured by your ability to bring in new startups, grow Brex's market share among top venture networks, develop new channel relationships, and deliver high-quality experiences that strengthen Brex's position in the startup space. If you have a track record of exceeding targets and a passion for building mutually beneficial relationships, this is a chance to make a significant impact in a fast-growing environment.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

Sales and pipeline
• Drive top-of-funnel customer acquisition for newly incorporated, Pre-seed through Series B companies through direct sales, strategic partnerships, relationship building, and high-impact community events
• Consistently hit targets by converting partner relationships into a steady stream of client referrals
• Serve as a product expert, articulating Brex's value proposition to partners and founders

Partnerships
• Identify, cultivate, and deepen relationships with high-potential VCs, accelerators, incubators, law firms, and other ecosystem partners
• Craft and implement tailored go-to-market strategies for each partner
• Facilitate smooth onboarding of new partners and their teams, and be the connective tissue between partners and the Brex ecosystem
• Conduct regular performance reviews with key partners and use the data to optimize each relationship

Community and brand
• Expand your existing network of top-tier founders and VCs who are eager to support your efforts
• Launch initiatives that bring founders and VCs together in meaningful and differentiated ways
• Be the respected brand and face of Brex for Startups. You are the flag bearer for Brex and everyone should know you in the market

Value add to founders
• Leverage your network, your colleagues' networks, and your skills to help founders on several fronts: accessing capital (debt and equity), sourcing talent for key roles, and connecting them with potential customers

Cross-functional and operations
• Work closely with marketing, growth, direct sales, underwriting, operations, finance, revenue operations, and product engineering to drive co-marketing opportunities, onboard new clients, and inform the product roadmap
• Maintain strong data hygiene in Salesforce and leverage tools such as Hex, Retool, Scratchpad, Botdog, Rings, Harmonic, Pitchbook and Nooks
• Use AI tools (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, Granola, etc.) to work more efficiently

Requirements
• 2+ years of experience in venture capital, at a startup, or in a partnerships or closing sales role
• Established network within the startup ecosystem and proven experience working directly with VCs and founders
• Strong understanding of the venture community and how to drive partnerships within it
• Demonstrated track record of consistently hitting targets and quotas
• Experience building communities both virtually and in person, with a passion for events and activations with partners
• Ability to deliver tailored, consultative solutions that align with partners' needs and business goals
• Ability to evaluate partnership performance, identify areas for optimization, and implement data-driven solutions
• Proven ability to build trust and credibility with internal and external stakeholders
• Self-starter with strong leadership skills, intellectual curiosity, a collaborative mindset, high EQ, and a positive, winning attitude
• Thrives in a fast-paced, evolving startup environment

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is USD $135,600 - $169,500. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate's location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. jobs.description:
About the role

Chime's Data Science Machine Learning team builds the models, services, and platforms behind how millions of members manage and grow their financial lives. We're hiring AI/ML Engineers across several teams, Trust Safety, Lending, Growth, and Foundation Models, and you'll be matched with the team where your background, experience and interests fit best.

In this role, you'll build and deploy machine learning systems on some of the richest transactional and behavioral data in fintech, turning it into decisions that protect members from fraud, expand access to credit, and power the personalized experiences and marketing that help millions of members get more out of products like MyPay, Instant Loans, and SpotMe — along with the foundational models the rest of our teams build on. This is a highly applied role: you'll own problems end to end, from framing the question through to a model running in production and moving a metric that matters.

In this role, you can expect to
• Build, train, and deploy deep learning and classical ML models on large-scale financial, transactional, and behavioral datasets
• Take models from problem framing through to production — training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration — and stay accountable for how they behave once they're live
• Design and improve the systems around the model: feature pipelines, batch and real-time inference, monitoring, and retraining
• Partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Risk to turn ambiguous business problems into ML solutions, and to make sure the solution is the right one
• Connect model performance to member outcomes and business metrics, and use experimentation to prove impact
• Contribute to the shared ML platform, tooling, and standards that the rest of the team builds on
• Help identify where AI/ML creates measurable impact for members — and where a simpler answer is the better one

To thrive in this role, you have
• Experience building and deploying deep learning models in production, with a solid grasp of architecture choice, training dynamics, and evaluation — and the judgment to model design choices
• Solid machine learning fundamentals: classical modeling, evaluation design, and knowing which metric actually answers the question in front of you
• Hands-on experience across the end-to-end ML lifecycle — training, experimentation, optimization, deployment, and monitoring
• Comfort with messy real-world data, including label definition, leakage, class imbalance, and train/serve skew
• Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and distributed compute such as Spark or PySpark
• Working knowledge of modern ML infrastructure — AWS and tools such as SageMaker, Airflow, Kafka, Redis, and Snowflake — and an MLOps mindset for keeping production systems healthy
• The ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments, and to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical partners

Nice-to-Have

Experience in any one of these is a plus, and helps us match you to the right team.
• Trust Safety — fraud, risk, abuse detection, or adversarial modeling
• Lending — credit or underwriting models, and familiarity with model governance, explainability, and fairness requirements
• Growth — personalization, recommendation, marketing measurement, or experimentation at scale
• Foundation Models — transformers on tabular or semi-structured data, large-scale pretraining, ML platform work, or applied research with a publication record

jobs.location: Chicago, IL, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA
jobs.description:
About the role

We are hiring a Business Control Manager to join our Compliance team at Chime, where you will be responsible for strengthening the first line of defense by partnering with business units to ensure they operate in compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements and internal policies. You will own the control environment for an assigned Business Unit (identifying risks, designing controls with the business, and validating that those controls work) and contribute to the compliance and control frameworks the Business Control Management team is building. As a key player in our compliance team, you will support various departments, including product, engineering, legal, and operations, to ensure our business practices align with regulatory standards and best practices.

The Business Control Manager will work across product, engineering, legal, and operations, and you will monitor how regulatory change affects the controls in your domain as Chime continues to scale. This role offers the chance to build the control environment for a fast-moving product area from the ground up, at a company that values innovation and consumer protection.

In this role, you can expect to
• Own the control environment for your assigned business unit - maintain the control library, keep control records current, and drive enhancements as products and processes change.
• Evaluate new products, features, and material process changes for regulatory risk before launch - reviewing business requirements early in scoping, identifying regulatory touchpoints, and proposing control designs and residual risk summaries.
• Run proactive reviews of existing processes and control environments - full risk identification, severity assessment, control gap analysis, and control maturity evaluation
• Map identified risks to the specific regulatory obligations they implicate, and maintain risk, obligation, and control records in our GRC platform so that coverage and gaps are visible and auditable.
• Design preventive, detective, and directive controls with the Engineering or Product owner who will build them - agreeing control type, frequency, automation level, and the evidence the control must produce - then validate after implementation that the control is operating as designed and the gap is closed.
• Own the compliance control workstream for incidents in your business unit: perform gap analysis from the root cause analysis, identify the control gap and the obligation it affects, design the control with the Engineering or Product owner, track implementation against SLA, validate the control once live, and close the compliance issue.
• Classify control gaps by root cause and use that data to surface systemic weaknesses - recurring patterns within your business unit and across business units - and turn them into recommendations that go beyond any individual control.
• Translate regulatory change in your business unit into control impact - working with Regulatory Affairs and Compliance Advisory to assess what a change means for existing controls, and advising the business on the adjustments required.
• Perform ongoing reviews of business procedures, member-facing disclosures, marketing, and complaint data to identify compliance risks, and partner with stakeholders on corrective action.
• Build durable working relationships with product, engineering, legal, and operations partners, and support bank partner, internal audit, and regulatory examination requests relating to controls in your business unit.
• Help business partners understand the controls they own and why they exist - through working sessions, documentation, and day-to-day partnership rather than formal training delivery.
• Maintain auditable records of risk and control decisions - including recommendations the business declines, with the rationale and residual risk documented - to a standard that lets Legal, Compliance, or Internal Audit reconstruct how a decision was reached. Contribute to regular reporting to Compliance Governance on control changes, new risks, and open items.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 4+ years of experience in regulatory compliance, risk management, or internal controls within the financial services or fintech sector. At least 3+ years of experience working in consumer protection laws, including Reg Z, Reg E, UDAAP, or similar regulations.
• Strong understanding of key consumer protection regulations, including but not limited to EFTA, TILA, UDAAP, and other financial regulatory frameworks.
• Hands-on experience documenting risks, controls, and issues in a GRC platform - AuditBoard, Archer, ServiceNow IRM, LogicGate, or similar.
• Demonstrated ability to advise product, engineering, risk, and operations teams on consumer protection and regulatory risk, including holding a position when a business partner pushes back.
• Strong analytical skills - you can take an incident, a process, or a requirements document and identify where the control should sit and what it needs to produce as evidence.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain regulatory concepts to technical and non-technical partners and influence decisions.
• A track record of taking a control from problem statement to validated and documented - independently, on a deadline, without needing the process defined for you.

jobs.description:
About the role

We’re hiring a CRM Manager to join our Lifecycle CRM Marketing team. You’ll own the technical foundation behind how Chime engages members across email, push, in-app, and SMS. This is a hands-on, technical role. You’ll lead principal-level projects that make our CRM programs scalable, reliable, and healthy, including the processes the team runs on, the health of every channel, and new tools and capabilities. You’ll operate with a high degree of independence, lead through ambiguity, and know when to escalate, partnering closely with Lifecycle Marketing, Engineering, Data Engineering, Product, Data Science, Analytics, and Legal Compliance. You’ll also help define how Chime’s CRM ecosystem evolves through data, AI, automation, and real-time personalization.

In this role, you can expect to
• Own the strategy, roadmap, and day-to-day health of Chime’s CRM platform and channel ecosystem, setting a clear technical direction tied to member experience and business outcomes.
• Lead principal projects to implement, integrate, and scale new tools and capabilities, from defining requirements and evaluating vendors through rollout, adoption, and measuring impact.
• Monitor and improve channel health across email, push, in-app, and SMS, including deliverability, sender reputation, opt-in and reachability rates, frequency and fatigue management, and preference and consent management.
• Design and improve the processes behind lifecycle execution, including campaign intake, build standards, QA, governance, and documentation, so the team can move faster with fewer errors.
• Partner with Engineering and Data Engineering on the data foundations of CRM: event and attribute design, data flows into the platform, APIs and webhooks, and real-time triggering.
• Build and refine complex, data-driven journeys and personalization logic (e.g., Liquid, Connected Content, dynamic segmentation) and set the bar for technical execution across the team.
• Use AI tools and automation as a core part of how you work, and help lead the team toward more automated, agent-assisted, and personalized member journeys.
• Own outcomes for your area, connecting platform and channel improvements to reach, engagement, operational efficiency, and downstream metrics such as retention, primacy, and LTV.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 6–8+ years of experience in CRM, marketing operations, marketing technology, or lifecycle marketing, with a significant focus on the technical and operational side.
• Deep hands-on expertise with at least one enterprise CRM or marketing automation platform such as Braze, Iterable, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including advanced journey building, segmentation, and personalization.
• A track record of leading tool implementations, migrations, or major platform integrations end to end with cross-functional and technical partners.
• Strong knowledge of channel health and deliverability, including authentication, list hygiene, reachability, and consent management across email, push, and SMS.
• Working knowledge of data infrastructure such as SQL, event schemas, APIs, webhooks, and CDPs or reverse ETL tools (e.g., Segment, mParticle, Hightouch, Census), and comfort with analytics tools such as Hex, Looker, or Statsig.
• Experience designing and running operational processes like QA frameworks, governance models, and intake systems that scale across a team.
• Experience bringing AI and automation into your daily work, and a clear point of view on how CRM technology and lifecycle marketing are changing.
• The ability to turn technical complexity into clear recommendations, influence senior partners, operate independently, and recognize when escalation is appropriate.
• Deep member obsession and the judgment to balance member experience, compliance, and business needs.
• It’s a plus if you have experience in fintech or another regulated industry; are comfortable with HTML/CSS and templating languages; have built monitoring or alerting for channel health; or have designed automation- or agent-driven journeys.

jobs.description:
About the Role

We're hiring a Sr. Growth Marketing Manager to own and drive measurable growth outcomes across Chime Enterprise's B2B2C funnel — the path that turns eligible employees at our employer partners into enrolled, funded, and engaged Chime members.

Chime Enterprise is Chime's B2B business, with a vision to be the premier HR benefits platform dedicated to holistic financial wellness. Our flagship product, Chime Workplace, gives employers an all-in-one financial wellness suite at no cost — spanning capital management (including MyPay at Work), capital growth, credit building, and rewards and loyalty (Salt). Sales and Customer Success win and onboard employer partners; once a partner is live, we gain access to their workforce — their eligible employees. Converting those eligible employees into Chime members is the challenge this role owns, and mastering it unlocks one of the most powerful and defensible distribution channels at Chime.

This role is embedded directly within the cross-functional Chime Enterprise growth effort and operates as the growth owner, not just a marketing advisor. You'll sit at the intersection of growth strategy, experimentation, performance analysis, and product marketing craft: identifying opportunities, prioritizing and running experiments, and driving metric movement against clear goals. While the role retains core product marketing strengths — research, positioning, and messaging — it goes further by owning results and tradeoffs.

In this role, you can expect to

Growth Ownership Strategy
• Own end-to-end growth strategy and outcomes for Chime Enterprise's employee-side funnel, from opportunity sizing through roadmap delivery against quarterly and annual goals.
• Serve as the embedded growth lead for Enterprise, co-owning planning with Enterprise Product, Engineering, and Analytics and with Growth Marketing's channel teams.
• Build a repeatable model for converting eligible employees into members that scales across partners rather than being rebuilt deal by deal.

Funnel Experimentation
• Drive performance across the B2B2C funnel — worksite awareness, enrollment, funding, direct deposit, and early retention — with deep ownership of employer landing pages, eligibility flows, and in-product onboarding.
• Own the Enterprise experimentation roadmap, designing reads that hold up at partner-sized cohorts and deciding what to scale, iterate, or sunset.
• Lead creative and messaging execution for experiments and launches across paid, lifecycle, and owned surfaces.

Offers Qualified Acquisition
• Own incentives, promotions, and offers that drive qualified acquisition of primary banking relationships — balancing cost per enrollment, activation quality, and long-term value, within partner agreement and compliance guardrails.
• Partner with Lifecycle to connect enrollment, onboarding, and retention into one journey.

GTM Measurement
• Lead GTM for employer launches, building the playbooks, campaign kits, and reporting that Sales, Customer Success, and GTM/Ops reuse at every go-live.
• Track pacing against goals and translate results into clear briefs and recommendations for Enterprise and Growth Marketing leadership.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 8+ years of experience in growth marketing, product marketing, performance marketing, or a related role (level dependent).
• Proven experience driving measurable growth through experimentation and optimization, including owning a funnel metric end to end.
• Experience marketing to end users through a partner, employer, or channel relationship — B2B2C, workplace or benefits marketing, marketplace, or embedded distribution — and comfort operating when you don't fully control the audience or the channel.
• Strong analytical skills; ability to define success metrics, track performance, extract insights, and reason clearly about statistical confidence when sample sizes are constrained.
• Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams, plus commercial partners like Sales and Customer Success.
• Strong storytelling and communication skills — able to translate insights into action, and to speak credibly to both internal stakeholders and external HR partners.
• Strong executive communications and the ability to influence and instill confidence.
• Nice to have:

HR tech, benefits, payroll, or earned wage access experience; familiarity with tools like Looker, Braze or Customer.io, and web experimentation platforms; comfort operating in a regulated environment.

jobs.title: Staff AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role

Chime's Data Science Machine Learning team builds the models, services, and platforms behind how millions of members manage and grow their financial lives. We're hiring a Staff AI/ML Engineer on our Lending and Cashflow team to lead the modeling behind cash flow underwriting and surface member insight: using members' transaction and deposit data to make fair, accurate credit decisions for people that traditional credit scores often miss.

In this role, you'll build and deploy machine learning systems on some of the richest transactional and behavioral data in fintech, turning it into the credit decisions behind products like MyPay, Instant Loans, and SpotMe. This is a highly applied role: you'll own problems end to end, from framing the question through to a model running in production and moving a metric that matters, and you'll set the technical direction for how Chime underwrites with cash flow data.

In this role, you can expect to
• Lead the design, training, and deployment of deep learning and classical ML underwriting models that turn members' transaction and cash flow data into credit decisions, from approval and line assignment to loss forecasting
• Take models from problem framing through to production — training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration — and stay accountable for how they behave once they're live
• Design and improve the systems around the model: feature pipelines, batch and real-time inference, monitoring, and retraining
• Partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Risk to turn ambiguous business problems into ML solutions, and to make sure the solution is the right one
• Connect model performance to member outcomes and business metrics, and use experimentation to prove impact
• Set the technical roadmap for Lending ML and raise the bar across the team through design reviews, mentorship, and shared standards for model development, validation, and governance
• Help identify where AI/ML creates measurable impact for members — and where a simpler answer is the better one

To thrive in this role, you have
• A track record of leading the design and deployment of deep learning models in production, including multi-quarter initiatives that span teams, with a solid grasp of architecture choice, training dynamics, and evaluation, and the judgment to make model design choices
• Solid machine learning fundamentals: classical modeling, evaluation design, and knowing which metric actually answers the question in front of you
• Hands-on experience across the end-to-end ML lifecycle — training, experimentation, optimization, deployment, and monitoring
• Comfort with messy real-world data, including label definition, leakage, class imbalance, and train/serve skew
• Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and distributed compute such as Spark or PySpark
• Working knowledge of modern ML infrastructure — AWS and tools such as SageMaker, Airflow, Kafka, Redis, and Snowflake — and an MLOps mindset for keeping production systems healthy
• The ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments, influence technical direction beyond your own team, and explain model decisions clearly to engineers, risk partners, and senior leaders

Nice-to-have

Experience in either of these is a plus:
• Credit or underwriting models, and familiarity with model governance, explainability, and fairness requirements, such as adverse action reason codes and fair lending testing
• Cash flow or alternative-data underwriting: building credit features from bank transaction data, such as income and expense detection, balance trends, and transaction categorization
• Deployed transformer models in production

In practice, that means earning member trust through secure, seamless experiences; preventing fraud and abuse; reducing unnecessary friction; and meeting regulatory obligations while enabling responsible growth.

TLMs at Chime manage a team of 3-5 engineers: Setting the hiring bar, coaching and developing talent, and driving all formal people management activities. They own execution and delivery for the squad. They stay in the code, authoring and shipping features alongside their team.

jobs.title: Creative Director - Brand Narrative
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
jobs.description:
In 1977, Charles and Ray Eames began a film with a picnic beside Chicago’s lakefront. Over the next nine minutes, Powers of Ten traveled out toward distant galaxies and back into the microscopic world inside a human hand. An enormous subject became a journey you could follow, built around a simple change in perspective. Images, language, movement, and sound brought the idea to life together. 

That’s the kind of creative thinking we’re looking for at Mercury: finding a compelling idea inside something complex, then bringing together the people and crafts that make it unforgettable.

We’re looking for a Creative Director to build and lead Brand Narrative, a new team within Brand Creative. You’ll turn company strategy, product truths, customer insight, and cultural observations into original concepts for our most important launches, campaigns, and brand moments. You’ll originate ideas yourself and stay closely involved as they become finished work.

Your background might be in art direction, design, or copywriting. What matters is your ability to develop exceptional concepts, recognize the best idea wherever it comes from, and bring the whole creative studio together to make it real. Whatever your starting discipline, you’ll bring deep experience in film-led storytelling.

You’ll lead Brand Narrative in close creative partnership with your peers leading Brand Design and Writing. Together, you’ll shape concepts, language, and visual expression from the beginning, bringing distinct perspectives and shared ownership to the work. You’ll contribute strong ideas of your own, invite others to challenge and improve them, and build on theirs. This is a role for someone who enjoys making work together, not developing ideas in isolation and handing them off.

You’ll also shape what Brand Narrative becomes. That means building its culture, developing its people, and establishing ways of working that make the entire studio more creatively ambitious. The opportunity is to make great work while building a team that can keep making it.

What you’ll do

In your first year, your focus will be roughly 70% leading creative development for our highest-priority launches and campaigns, and 30% building the Brand Narrative function.
• Originate and lead big creative ideas. Partner with Product Marketing and Brand Marketing on the brief, then turn the agreed audience, opportunity, and product proof into original creative concepts. Develop ideas that can take distinctive forms across film, social, out-of-home, digital, experiences, and partnerships.
• Bring ambitious concepts to life with your creative peers and the full studio. Work side by side with the Brand Design and Writing leads and their teams from the earliest explorations through delivery. Develop ideas together, exchange thoughtful critique, and make creative choices that draw on each discipline’s expertise. Stay hands-on, contribute through your own craft, and partner closely with Motion and Production throughout. For film, remain closely involved through scripts, visual development, production, and the final edit.
• Build audience and distribution thinking into the idea. Shape concepts around how people will discover, watch, and share the work. Work with marketing partners to consider channels and viewing contexts from the beginning, so the work belongs where people encounter it rather than simply being resized to fit.
• Push beyond the first good answer, and learn quickly. Lead thoughtful concept development and critique. Use rough scripts, prototypes, and AI tools to test ideas quickly, learn, and move the strongest work forward. Know when to keep exploring and when to commit, then protect what makes an idea interesting through feedback and production.
• Find opportunities before a brief arrives. Bring curiosity about Mercury’s products, customers, and the wider world. Develop proactive ideas and cultural opportunities that give the brand something meaningful to say or do.
• Help decide where creative ambition matters most. Partner early with Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, Product Design, Comms, and Insights. Help identify which moments deserve our largest creative investment, present recommendations to senior leadership, and use results from marketing and insights partners to inform what comes next.
• Build and lead Brand Narrative. Define the team’s purpose, priorities, creative standards, and ways of working. Help hire and develop the team, shaping its structure and capabilities. Set clear expectations, and coach people to grow their judgment and conceptual strength.
• Create a culture where the best idea wins. Make room for experimentation, honest feedback, and contributions across disciplines. Lead with generosity and conviction, share ownership of the work, and help people challenge one another without making creativity a competition for credit.
• Build practices that strengthen the work. Establish a clear path from insight and an agreed brief to concept and execution, with useful critique and close collaboration throughout. Develop relationships with external creatives and agencies who can add a distinctive perspective or capability when needed.

What you’ll bring
• A strong creative foundation in art direction, design, or copywriting. Your portfolio shows original concepts developed into ambitious, well-crafted work across multiple formats. You can explain what you contributed, how the idea evolved, and how collaboration made it better.
• Deep film experience. You’ve developed film-led ideas from concept through production, with strong instincts for story, scripts, performance, pacing, and sound. You understand how these choices work together to make an audience feel something, not just make a film look good.
• A track record of deep creative collaboration with design and writing peers. You’ve led ambitious multidisciplinary work from concept through production by building trusted partnerships. You bring a clear point of view, listen closely, work through creative disagreements constructively, and recognize when someone else’s approach makes the work stronger. You can show how your collaborators shaped the outcome, not just what you personally originated.
• Strong taste, cultural awareness, and product curiosity. You can get close to a complex business or product, find the human truth within it, and turn that understanding into something clear, surprising, and memorable.
• Experience developing creative people and shaping how a team works. You give specific, useful feedback, set a high bar with care, and create an environment where people can take creative risks. You’re excited to build a new function, including the everyday practices that give it a culture.
• Clear communication and sound judgment. You can rally people around an ambitious concept, explain why it deserves investment, and navigate competing perspectives without losing the idea. You take ownership in ambiguous situations and balance creative ambition with the need to move work forward.

What success looks like

A year in, you’ll have led major launches and film-led campaigns from original concept through finished work, with Brand Design and Writing as creative partners from the beginning. The studio’s disciplines will have shaped the work together, with audience and distribution informing the creative approach.

Brand Narrative will have a clear identity, shared creative standards, and working practices that help people test and develop stronger ideas together. Alongside planned launches, you’ll have established a pipeline of proactive opportunities that gives Mercury more ways to express its product ambition with originality and cultural relevance.

Please include a portfolio featuring film-led work and broader campaign concepts. We’d love to understand your role in developing the ideas, the choices you made through production, and how you brought the work to life with others.

jobs.title: Head of Product - Interfaces
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
jobs.description:
In the early 1980s at Bell Labs, Gerald Ash and his colleagues questioned a rule that AT T's long-distance network had followed for decades; a call climbed a fixed hierarchy of switches until it found an open path. They modeled the idea, simulated it, and tested it until it held. In 1984, AT T put Dynamic Nonhierarchical Routing (DNHR) into the national network, which became the basis of global real-time telephony routing that came after it.

At Mercury, customers reach us through Dashboard, Mobile, Command, our API, and Model Context Protocol (MCP). Each request should take the best path to the work, whatever surface it starts on. We're looking for a Head of Product, Interfaces to design that network. You'll set one direction across these surfaces and lead the PMs who build them. You'll also build the shared capabilities that let every Mercury team reach customers well: navigation, tasks, notifications, and agent interactions. AI is central to the role. The job is to find where AI removes real work, and to make it dependable enough to trust with money.

This is a hands-on leadership role reporting to the VP of Product. You’ll develop people while staying close to customers, prototypes, product decisions, and shipped quality.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

As part of this job, you will:
• Set the product direction for Interfaces. Connect Dashboard, Mobile, Command, and API/MCP through a clear view of customer needs and the role of each surface
• Lead and develop the PM team. Build clear ownership, coach product judgment, hire strong people, and help the team deliver excellent work
• Shape Mercury’s AI experience. Partner with the Command team to turn new AI capabilities into useful products that help customers complete financial work
• Improve the core product experience. Make it easier for customers to understand their finances, find the right action, and move between devices and workflows
• Build shared capabilities. Help Mercury teams deliver through common foundations such as navigation, tasks, notifications, and agent interactions
• Make quality part of product development. Work with engineering, design, data, and research partners to evaluate behavior, understand failures, and improve through evidence
• Design for customer control. Make consequential actions understandable, permissions clear, and progress and results easy to inspect
• Connect the portfolio across Mercury. Partner with teams building banking*, Spend, Books, Payroll, and other products to bring their capabilities into shared experiences
• Own the tradeoffs. Balance immediate customer needs, new opportunities, and the platform investments that make future work faster and better

What we’re looking for:
• 10+ years of direct product management experience, with 5+ years leading product managers: hiring, coaching, org design, and performance management
• A track record of shipping products that customers value, with a clear account of your own decisions and contribution
• Experience leading PMs and working across multiple teams or a broad product area; enthusiasm for developing people while staying close to the work
• Excellent product judgment and a strong sense of design quality, simplicity, and customer experience
• Substantial practical experience with AI products. You can discuss what you built, how you evaluated it, where it failed, and what changed as a result
• The ability to turn ambiguity into a clear direction and a sequence of useful releases
• Strong technical judgment and the ability to work with engineers on complex product and platform decisions
• Experience aligning teams around shared capabilities while staying responsive to their different needs
• Clear communication and the confidence to make recommendations, explain tradeoffs, and challenge assumptions
• A habit of using customer conversations and product evidence to improve decisions
• The willingness to own the full outcome, including work outside a narrow product remit
• A high bar for your own work and a thoughtful, direct approach to helping others improve

We care about depth and judgment. Be ready to explain what you built, why you made the decisions you did, and how you helped your team get better.

Why this role:
• You’ll shape the experiences that connect Mercury’s products to customers. The opportunity spans making financial software clear and useful and creating new possibilities with AI
• You’ll help people do familiar things with less effort and discover better ways to manage financial work
• You’ll have a broad portfolio, close partnership with company leaders, and the chance to build a team that combines strong product craft with ambitious, practical use of AI

About us

Job Title: Data Privacy Protection Director

Department: Compliance

Reports to: Chief Compliance Officer

Location: Lagos, Nigeria

 

About this role

The Data Privacy Protection Director provides expertise and support in data privacy and protection matters, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements such as the Nigerian Data Protection Act (NDPA) 2023 and other relevant data protection laws. The role oversees the entire data protection strategy, driving the implementation of policies and procedures that safeguard personal data and maintain the organization’s reputation for data security. You will also be responsible for managing the organization’s compliance framework, including conducting Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) and overseeing data breach response efforts.

 

Responsibilities
• Governance Framework: Implement a data privacy governance framework (including Binding Corporate Rules) to manage data use in compliance with the Nigeria Data Privacy Act (NDPA) 2023.
• Policy Development: Set standards, formulate policies, and establish procedures for the organization to meet NDPA 2023 and other relevant regulations and requirements.
• Stakeholder Awareness: Ensure that employees, third-party processors (TPPs), vendors, and data subjects are fully informed about their data protection rights, obligations, and responsibilities.
• Regulatory Liaison: Serve as the primary point of contact and liaison for the Nigeria Data Privacy Commission (NDPC), other regulators, financial institutions, and customers on data privacy and protection-related matters.
• Query Incident Resolution: Handle queries, complaints, claims, and notifications from regulators, law enforcement agencies, and data subjects, ensuring prompt feedback and resolutions.
• Impact Assessments: Work with product managers, project managers, and other internal stakeholders to conduct data privacy impact assessments (DPIAs) to ensure compliance with NDPA 2023 and extant regulations.
• Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with IT teams to ensure that IT systems and procedures comply with NDPA and other relevant regulations.
• Security Coordination: Collaborate with the information security team to maintain records of customer data and data processing activities, while sustaining a data security management plan, a data breach response plan, and data retention structures.
• Training Strategy: Develop strategies to ensure continuous engagement with key internal and external stakeholders, and deliver targeted data privacy training to various business functions, TPPs, and vendors.
• Privacy Audits: Coordinate and conduct routine privacy audits, including a comprehensive review of the active privacy governance framework.
• External Auditing: Work closely with the Data Privacy Compliance Organization (DPCO) to conduct external regulatory audits and provide guidance and advice on privacy-related regulatory issues.
• Regulatory Monitoring: Monitor updates to local data privacy laws and regulations and make proactive recommendations to executive leadership when appropriate. 

 

Experience Background
• Educational Background: A Bachelor’s degree in Law, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. A Master’s degree in information security or law is highly preferred.
• Required

Experience:

Minimum of 10 years of hands-on experience in data protection, compliance, or a related field, with a deep operational understanding of the NDPA and other relevant data protection laws.
• Proven Track Record: Demonstrated experience managing data privacy in complex organizational settings, including executing data protection audits, leading DPIAs, and managing data breach responses.
• Professional Certifications: Relevant certifications in data protection/privacy (such as CISSP, CIPM, CIPP, CPT, CDPSE, or CDPO) are highly preferred. 

 

Skills Competencies
• Regulatory Insight: Mastery of data privacy legislations, framework applications, and financial sector compliance structures.
• Analytical

Skills:

Strong capability to break down complex system flows, audit technical processing records, and discover potential vulnerabilities in data privacy management.
• Ethical Integrity: Uncompromising commitment to confidentiality, objectiveness, and ethical compliance standards.
• Effective Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to successfully collaborate with regulators, external bodies, and internal cross-functional stakeholders.
• Leadership: Strong capability to direct compliance sub-functions, spearhead company-wide training initiatives, and influence technical or product decisions. 

 

What success looks like in this role
• Perfect Regulatory Standing: Total alignment with the NDPC, resulting in smooth external regulatory audits and zero compliance violations or penalties.
• Flawless Risk Mitigation: Active, seamless execution of DPIAs for all internal structures, products, and tool variations prior to deployment.
• Proactive Incident Management: Rapid and completely documented closure of queries, compliance gaps, and unexpected breach notification vulnerabilities within strict timelines.
• High Organizational Maturity: An established and well-maintained culture of data safety where employees and third-party partners clearly follow data processing protocols. 

 

Why join us
• Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities.
• A collaborative and supportive work culture dedicated to professional development and continuous learning.

jobs.title: Product Auditor
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

What We Do

At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Role Overview

The Product Auditor provides independent assurance over the design, implementation, and operating effectiveness of product controls across payment, wallet, settlement, switches and other related products across the organisation

The role ensures that new and existing products are deployed with adequate financial, operational, security, and regulatory controls, safeguarding the organization against revenue leakage, settlement failures, regulatory breaches, and technology-driven risks.

The Product Auditor will independently evaluate product risk exposure and control maturity prior to scale.

Key Responsibilities 

Audit Universe Risk-Based Planning
• Maintain a living Product Audit Universe covering all payment products, features, and integrations ranked by risk.
• Own the annual Product Audit Plan, ensuring coverage is allocated dynamically based on risk ratings, product complexity, regulatory sensitivity, and change velocity.

Product Design Control Assurance
• Review PRDs, business rules, and transaction workflows to identify logic gaps, unmitigated risk paths, and missing exception-handling routines before products reach production/go-live.
• Analyse product path scenarios, verify Maker-Checker enforcement, and provide formal control design sign-off before any material release goes live.

Live Product Assessment ( Continuous Audit Review)
• Periodically assess live payment products to confirm they continue to operate within approved design parameters.
• Detect configuration drift, identify silent divergence from original PRDs, and analyse live transaction data for emerging risk patterns.

Go-Live Readiness Control Gate
• Execute mandatory pre-production Product Audit reviews as an independent control gate for all material releases.
• Confirm reconciliation logic, exception queues, and fallback controls are tested and functional.
• Escalate critical deficiencies with risk ratings and hold recommendations where a product is not safe to release.

Transaction Logic Mathematical Integrity
• Interrogate the Fee Engine using SQL to mathematically prove that commissions, VAT, discounts, and splits are posted with complete precision.
• Validate duplicate prevention mechanisms and ensure transaction integrity within complex, multi-step payment sequences, and test reversal, refund, and chargeback logic to confirm financial symmetry is maintained in every scenario.

Settlement Ledger Integrity
• Trace fund flows, confirming continuous synchronisation between wallet sub-ledgers and the General Ledger.
• Assess reconciliation logic for breaks and evaluate the authorisation, documentation, and reversibility of manual settlement overrides.

Product Change Configuration Integrity
• Confirm that all product modifications: fee tables, routing rules, limit parameters passed through an approved change management cycle.
• Identify silent changes made outside formal release processes and audit the integrity of product master data to ensure it is access-controlled, version-tracked, and consistent with approved product terms.

Vendor Third-Party Product Risk
• Assess controls over vendor-managed product components, evaluate SLA performance against contractual commitments, and identify single-vendor dependency risks within critical payment flows.
• Evaluate the organisation's ability to detect unilateral changes in third-party API behaviour, fee logic, or settlement processes.

Control Advisory Stakeholder Engagement
• Engage product and engineering teams early in the design cycle to provide informal control advisory, reducing findings at the formal review stage without compromising independence.
• Participate in design reviews and architecture discussions, and build a control-by-design culture across product teams. 

Incident Review, RCA Regulatory Alignment
• Lead post-incident reviews for product failures,producing structured RCA reports that identify underlying logic failures, not just surface symptoms.
• Assess corrective actions for adequacy and track findings to verify closure.
• Ensure product logic complies with CBN guidelines, PCI DSS, and consumer protection obligations at the design level, and evaluate the regulatory impact of new features before release.

Reporting Governance
• Prepare risk-rated audit reports for Executive Management and the Audit Committee, leading with findings, financial impact, and required action.
• Maintain a Product Risk Register, deliver quarterly control maturity updates, and ensure governance bodies are never surprised by a product failure that was visible at the design or portfolio review stage.

Required Knowledge Skills 

Technical Skills
• Advanced SQL for independent data extraction and transaction interrogation
• Payment systems architecture : Wallets, card processing, direct debit, settlement, and reconciliation
• API and integration literacy (Basic)
• End-to-end transaction lifecycle knowledge: Authorisation, posting, clearing, settlement, and exception handling
• PRD and process flow analysis: translating product documentation into control flowcharts
• Mathematical precision: fee calculations, interest computations, and split payment structures
• Pattern recognition: detecting anomalies, outliers, and irregularities in large transaction datasets

Audit Risk Skills
• Risk-based audit methodology: IIA Standards and COSO framework applied to financial products.
• Control design logic and evaluation
• Root cause analysis
• Regulatory knowledge: CBN payment system regulations, PCI DSS, NDPR,Nigerian consumer protection obligations etc

Interpersonal Professional Skills
• Stakeholder engagement
• Professional scepticism and independence
• Risk-rated report writing

Tools Platforms
• SQL (PostgreSQL / MySQL / MSSQL)
• AdvancedExcel / Google Sheets
• Claude / AI Tools

Qualifications
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative discipline
• Experience:

3–5+ years in Product Audit, Systems Audit, Financial Data Analytics, or Payment Operations within a fintech or financial services environment
• Certifications: CISA, CIA, or CFE preferred. ACA / ACCA is acceptable when combined with strong technical product experience and data analytics.
• Sector Knowledge: Demonstrated hands-on familiarity with payment product architecture, wallet systems, and regulated payment flows in a Nigerian or comparable market context.

What We Offer You
• Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’re human, we listen, and we look out for one another.
• Learning: We’re big on growth. You’ll find an environment focused on knowledge sharing, training, and helping you reach your potential.
• Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, and an annual bonus, along with other great benefits.

What to Expect in the Hiring Process
• A preliminary phone call with our recruiter.
• An interview with the hiring team.
• A final conversation with a member of our executive team.
