jobs.title: Programa de Estágio C6 Bank 2027.1 💛🖤
jobs.description:
Sobre o Programa de Estágio C6 Bank

Seu jeito de pensar pode mudar o que vem depois.

Começar uma carreira é também começar a construir novas possibilidades. No C6 Bank, você não entra só para acompanhar: desde o início, participa, aprende fazendo, traz novas perspectivas e ajuda a transformar ideias em ação. Aqui, queremos conhecer o seu jeito de pensar. Aquele que faz perguntas, questiona o que já existe, aprende com as trocas e encontra novas formas de fazer acontecer.O Programa de Estágio C6 Bank é um convite para assumir o protagonismo da sua jornada, se desenvolver a partir de desafios reais e construir, junto com a gente, o que vem depois.

 

Onde você pode atuar?

Temos oportunidades em diferentes frentes do banco. Em todas elas, você terá a oportunidade de aprender fazendo e contribuir para desafios que fazem parte do nosso negócio:
• Comercial: impulsiona o crescimento da base de clientes e o relacionamento com eles, atuando na aquisição, gestão de carteira e desenvolvimento de parcerias.
• Negócios: responsável pela estratégia e evolução dos produtos e serviços financeiros, com foco na experiência do cliente e geração de valor.
• Tecnologia: constrói e escala as soluções que sustentam o banco digital, com foco em eficiência, segurança e inovação.
• Operações: garante que tudo funcione com excelência no dia a dia, buscando novas formas de melhorar processos e a experiência do cliente.
• Áreas Corporativas: dão suporte estratégico ao banco, contribuindo para sua governança, eficiência e crescimento sustentável. 

Independentemente da área, uma coisa é comum: por aqui, você terá espaço para aprender, contribuir, fazer perguntas e construir junto.

Qual é o perfil dos futuros talentos do C6 Bank? 

Buscamos pessoas curiosas, que tenham vontade de aprender e coragem para questionar o óbvio.Gente que não espera ter todas as respostas para começar, mas que sabe fazer boas perguntas, escutar diferentes perspectivas e transformar aprendizado em ação.

Valorizamos quem assume protagonismo, trabalha em parceria e usa a autonomia com responsabilidade para experimentar, testar e evoluir constantemente. Porque, para a gente, uma nova perspectiva pode ser justamente o começo de uma nova solução.

 

Para participar, é importante:
• Estar cursando ensino superior em áreas como Administração, Economia, Relações Internacionais, Ciências Contábeis, Direito, Marketing, Engenharias, Matemática, Física, Ciência da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência de Dados e áreas correlatas.
• Ter previsão de formatura entre julho de 2028 e dezembro de 2029.
• Ter disponibilidade para estagiar 6 horas por dia, em modelo 100% presencial, na região dos Jardins, em São Paulo.

Quais serão as etapas do processo seletivo? 

Queremos conhecer mais do que o seu currículo. Ao longo do processo, você encontrará oportunidades para mostrar como pensa, constrói em grupo, toma decisões e transforma ideias em caminhos possíveis.
• Nitrogênio: triagem de currículos
• Ferro: dinâmica online em grupo
• Ouro: entrevista com a liderança
• Titânio: painel presencial
• Carbono: proposta

Durante essa jornada, você poderá encontrar desafios, cases e ferramentas que fazem parte da realidade de trabalho de hoje, incluindo a inteligência artificial. Mais do que saber usar uma tecnologia, queremos entender como você faz perguntas, analisa informações, toma decisões e usa diferentes recursos de forma crítica e responsável.

 

Ao longo de todo o processo, nossa comunicação será por e-mail. Por isso, fique de olho na sua caixa de entrada, e no spam também.

Seu próximo passo começa com o seu jeito de pensar. Vem desafiar o óbvio, construir com a gente e ser CSixer. 💛🖤

• Vale-Refeição
• Plano e saúde e odontológico

PARA UMA VIDA EXTRAORDINÁRIA

Lead Data Scientist, Credit Risk
jobs.location: Chicago, IL, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Credit Risk Data Scientist who is data-driven, has strong analytical and technical skills, and operates with a high degree of ownership. In this role, you will lead the credit strategy that lets Chime lend to people before they have a relationship with us — starting with Instant Loans for new members (top of funnel) and expanding to future unsecured credit products such as credit cards. You'll develop risk policies and strategies to manage credit risk throughout the member lifecycle, and you'll work as a trusted cross-functional partner with product, growth, data engineering, machine learning, and analytics teams, interacting with business stakeholders across many departments.

In this role, you can expect to
• Own credit strategy for new-to-Chime applicants across the member lifecycle, starting with Instant Loans for prospects (top of funnel) and extending to future unsecured products such as credit cards and/or lines of credit
• Develop and evolve channel-specific credit policies (pre-approval / prescreen, direct mail, open application, referrals, and affiliates) that support growth while balancing risk, unit economics, and member experience
• Design and continuously iterate acquisition, loan amount / line assignment, pricing, line management, repayment, and collections strategies
• Leverage credit bureau (e.g., Experian), alternative, and internal Chime data to underwrite applicants with no prior Chime relationship; build credit models and policies hands-on and in partnership with our DSML team
• Lead test-and-learn: design and read out champion/challenger tests and controlled ramps, and quantify trade-offs among approvals, losses, direct deposit conversion, and lifetime value
• Partner with Finance and Strategy to size new channels and forecast approval funnels, vintage losses, and unit economics; set launch criteria, guardrails, and expansion triggers
• Collaborate with data teams to build data infrastructure and early-read monitoring and dashboards (first payment default, delinquency, vintage and roll rates) that help senior management understand credit risk trends and exposures
• Work with cross-functional teams including DSML, Product, Design, Engineering, and Decision Platform to test and implement risk models and strategies in production, including accurate adverse action reasons
• Partner with Compliance, Legal, Fair Lending, Model Risk Management, Fraud, and our bank partners to document, approve, and govern credit policies
• Mentor and work collaboratively with other credit risk data scientists to develop strategies, share knowledge, and raise the team's analytical bar

To thrive in this role, you have
• A Master's degree (required) in Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Math, Finance, Computer Science, or another quantitative discipline; a PhD is a plus
• 7+ years of analytical or data science experience in Financial Services, preferably at a FinTech company
• 4+ years of experience building and managing risk for unsecured credit products such as installment loans, lines of credit, or credit cards; acquisition / underwriting experience strongly preferred
• Hands-on experience with credit bureau data and prescreen, pre-approval, or direct mail credit programs
• Experience with credit furnishing, bankruptcies, delinquency, and write-off policies, and working knowledge of consumer lending regulation (FCRA, ECOA / Reg B, fair lending, adverse action)
• Excellent SQL and Python skills, advanced Microsoft Excel skills, and experience working in Looker or a similar business intelligence tool
• A strong grounding in statistics and machine learning for credit, including scorecards / gradient-boosted models, swap-set analysis, vintage analysis, and experiment design
• Hands-on, detail-oriented leader with exceptional communication skills who can explain a trade-off to executives and defend the math behind it
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, complex environment and meet ambitious deadlines while ensuring flawless completion
• A strong passion for Chime's mission and solving challenging analytical problems for the business
• Nice to have:

subprime or near-prime lending, affiliate or marketplace lending, credit card line management, or cash-flow / alternative-data underwriting experience

About the role

This role will play a critical role in shaping Chime’s corporate narrative and reputation as a public company. You'll shape the company’s major moments and how we show up with reporters, investors, policymakers, and corporate stakeholders across quarterly earnings, corporate announcements, executive engagements, and high-stakes issues. 

You're a sharp writer, strategic thinker, reliable partner that stays calm headed when things move fast. You think ahead, catch the details others miss, and can drive a workstream from idea to execution with little direction. You build trust with senior leaders, reporters, and cross-functional partners, and you're excited to grow into a broader role as the function grows.

You'll report to the Director of Corporate Communications and work closely with the rest of the Corporate Affairs team, along with Investor Relations, Legal, Finance, and Chime's leadership.

In this role, you can expect to
• Support our corporate announcements and financial communications: Drive communications for quarterly earnings and major company announcements, working with Corporate Affairs, Investor Relations, Legal, and Finance. You'll help shape the media strategy and own the press materials, briefing books, and outreach.
• Own the corporate narrative: Own our messaging source of truth and help drive how Chime's corporate story evolves. Make sure it shows up clearly and consistently across earnings, announcements, executive platforms, and our owned channels.
• Grow our media and influencer program: Expand Chime's relationships with business, financial, and fintech reporters, as well as the creators, Substack writers, podcasters, and emerging voices shaping the conversation. Bring proactive story ideas, land high-impact coverage, and own how we handle inbound requests.
• Raise our executives' profile: Manage Chime's executive visibility program. Recommend where our leaders should show up, what they should say, and brief and staff them for interviews and speaking engagements.
• Lead issues management: Own sensitive media inquiries from first triage to resolution. Recommend our response strategy, write statements and responsive materials, and bring together Legal, Risk, Security, and other partners through our issues and incident processes.
• Be our AI champion: Bring innovative, AI-first thinking to the whole communications team. Build and scale the tools and workflows that change how we work. Collaborate with Marketing to drive our broader answer engine optimization (AEO) work and ensure we show up where our stakeholders are looking for information. 

Keep the team running at a high level: Directly manage our agency partners, measure and report on the impact of our work, and keep leadership informed. You'll bring the project management discipline that keeps many workstreams moving at once.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 7+ years of experience in corporate, financial, or executive communications, in-house and/or at an agency. Experience in fintech, financial services, or consumer technology is a plus.
• Hands-on experience with public company communications, including quarterly earnings, and working alongside Investor Relations and Legal.
• Established relationships with business, financial, and technology reporters, with a track record of landing coverage and managing reporter requests.
• Experience preparing and staffing executives for interviews, panels, and speaking engagements.

• AI-first thinking and hands-on experience building AI tools and workflows that improve how a communications team operates. You turn recurring tasks into repeatable processes and help the broader function adopt AI in their work.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Corporate Security
jobs.description:
About the Company

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.

The Department: Real Estate and Corporate Security

In the emerging industry of digital assets, there is nothing more important than trust (which is why Gemini’s very first hires were Security experts). The Gemini Security team forms the backbone of all that we do and is as diverse as the number of challenges we tackle in the crypto space. From intelligence and investigations, to physical security technology, to securing cold storage systems and data centers to travel security and new office openings, enterprise risk security, and litigation support, security at Gemini ensures that our customers, clients, and employees are safe, secure, and supported.

The Role:

Senior Associate, Corporate Security

Gemini seeks a highly skilled Senior Associate to join our Real Estate and Corporate Security team, dedicated to ensuring the safety and security of our employees, physical locations, assets, and brand reputation at our 24/7 Operations Support Center in Arizona. Ideal candidates are seasoned security professionals with a strong background in law enforcement, exceptional customer service skills, and advanced expertise in technology and hospitality to protect personnel, sensitive information, and facilities. The Senior Associate will oversee on-site security operations, supervise contract guard staff, and maintain a safe, compliant workplace while serving as a front-line security presence and a representative of Gemini’s culture, balancing firm policy enforcement with professionalism and hospitality. Exceptional communication skills, adaptability, and a commitment to listening, learning, and problem-solving in response to shifting priorities and challenges are essential. Our office is currently in Tempe, AZ with a planned transition very soon to our Scottsdale, AZ office upon its opening. Join Gemini to contribute to a secure, welcoming environment while upholding our values of integrity and service excellence.

This role is required to be in person five days per week at our Scottsdale, AZ office.

Responsibilities:

General
• Employee and Visitor Safety: Oversee the security of the Operations Support Center by monitoring entry points, verifying and maintaining employee credentials, and conducting thorough check-in and screening processes for all visitors to ensure a safe workplace.
• On-Site Presence: Maintain a consistent on-site presence five days per week during standard daytime hours, with flexibility to work after-hours or weekend shifts as needed to support the Center’s 24/7 operations, with appropriate compensation provided.
• Policy Enforcement: Uphold physical security standards, including the Center’s clean desk policy and electronic device restrictions, to safeguard sensitive customer and company data.
• Primary Security Liaison: Serve as the primary point of contact for all physical security matters within the Center, addressing concerns promptly and professionally.
• Security Patrols: Conduct routine and ad-hoc security patrols to ensure compliance with physical and procedural safeguards, identifying and mitigating potential risks.
• System Operations: Manage and monitor CCTV and Access Control systems, ensuring proper functionality, timely response to incidents, and accurate logging of all security events.
• Global Security Culture: Contribute to the development of Gemini’s global security culture by collaborating with the Corporate Security team to refine strategies, policies, and best practices, fostering a cohesive approach to security across the organization.
• Professional Development: Participate in regular training to enhance security-related skills and stay current on industry best practices.
• Decision-Making: Exercise sound judgment and demonstrate an appropriate sense of urgency in addressing security matters, ensuring effective and timely resolutions.

Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. We work hard to create the easiest and safest banking* experience possible to simplify entrepreneurs' and business owners’ financial lives.The challenge is to do so while ensuring we protect Mercury, customers and the broader financial ecosystem from bad actors and harmful, illegal or unauthorized activities.

Our AML Investigations team is crucial in this mission and is responsible for detecting suspicious activity, conducting thorough investigations, and shutting down bad actors. This team is growing and we’re looking to hire an additional AML Risk Investigator to help us with Bank Partner Requests for Information, Transaction Monitoring, Financial Crime Investigations, Case Management and drafting Unusual Activity Reports. As a member of our Investigations team, you’ll help handle our transaction monitoring queues while balancing an eagle eye for risk with excellent user experience. To begin with, you’ll work to help make sure we have smart, risk-based monitoring in place and help build out our case management technology and processes.

You’ll need to learn how a really wide range of businesses work and bring your knowledge to bear on our processes and product. Some of this work is repetitive and requires close attention to detail, so we need someone who loves working fraud and anti-money laundering transaction queues and managing a variety of complex investigations.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

• Provide input as we implement new transaction monitoring rules and tune existing ones
• Review AML, and other financial crime alerts in our transaction monitoring queue and take action as needed
• Contact our users for information on their account usage and transactions
• Work with our partners and internal team members to review and assess information received from users
• Investigate and respond to Requests for Information (RFIs) from our Partner Banks, delivering clear, well-supported AML reviews on customer’s account activity
• Decision user accounts as needed, including locking or closing accounts
• Develop an understanding of expected activity for each type of user we work with
• Document investigative findings and escalate unusual or potentially suspicious activity to our Partners for SAR consideration
• Develop an unfailing eye for potential fraud or money laundering
• Investigate tools that would make your job easier
• Write clear documentation on current processes and help train future teammates

Some things that might make you successful in a role like this:
• Have experience in identifying money laundering, detecting fraud, or other financial crimes related behavior in banking, fintech, or other financial services through vendor AND in-house developed transaction monitoring rules
• Be fluent in the language of bank transactions, including ACH, check, debit card, credit card, and wire transfers, both domestic and international
• Understand the business banking landscape and have familiarity with international activity and ownership
• Exercise empathy and understanding when communicating with users
• Communicate complicated concepts with efficiency and clarity, both in speech and writing
• Manage relationships with external parties with confidence and kindness
• Work with efficiency and focus
• Understand how to keep an organized and clean inbox
• Love problem solving and making teams, product, and processes more efficient

• Enjoy thinking about how to automate as much of your job as possible

jobs.description:
About

the role:

As Mercury continues its rapid growth trajectory, navigating an increasingly complex regulatory, partner, and product landscape is critical. Compliance is not only a requirement, but a competitive advantage that enables Mercury to move faster, build trust, and launch innovative products responsibly. 

Nowhere is that more true than in AI. We believe we have a path to lead the US banking* industry into the AI era, and that how we choose to build and deploy AI will define our success over the next three years. 

We are building first-party agentic products, headless and agent-accessible banking through our API and MCP, and the internal platforms that let us build with AI at speed. Core to all of it is great governance—these systems must run on one trusted system of access, logging, and data controls that meets the requirements of our banking ambitions.

We are seeking a Lead Compliance Risk Manager to serve as the compliance advisor for Mercury's AI products. This is a new, high-visibility role and the first dedicated compliance advisory seat covering AI at Mercury. You will be the leading authority on AI product compliance risk for the Compliance Team—shaping how we build, how we govern, and how we explain ourselves to our partners and regulators.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Risk, Data, Legal, and Operations to ensure Mercury's AI products are compliant-by-design from concept through launch and scale. You will also help define the AI governance framework itself: the standards, controls, escalation paths, and documentation that allow a bank-partnered fintech to deploy agentic capabilities responsibly and at pace.

How this role fits alongside our other AI roles: this is a product compliance advisory role. Our Data AI Governance team owns enterprise governance frameworks, responsible-AI standards, AI use case intake and inventory, and risk classification; Model Risk Management owns model inventory, tiering, and validation. You will be a close partner to and a major consumer of both—running our AI products through their processes, applying their standards to real product decisions, and bringing them the product-level detail they need to see. You will also help extend our existing product compliance playbooks to cover AI features, in partnership with your manager and the rest of the Product Compliance team. Your mandate is the products, not the program. 

In this role, you will:
• Serve as the subject matter expert and primary compliance advisor for Mercury's AI and agentic products, including Command, our API, and agentic access methods such as MCP and CLI.
• Work closely with cross-functional risk and product teams to bring Mercury's AI products to market in a way that meets all relevant financial partner, regulatory compliance obligations, and our AI governance standards.
• Ensure all processes and products under your area of responsibility comply with applicable rules and regulations. Stay up to date with changes to applicable regulations, supervisory guidance, and emerging AI-specific law, and implement necessary updates to impacted products to maintain compliance.
• Support expansion for new product launches by scoping, defining, and communicating product and compliance requirements.
• Work cross-functionally to drive remediation efforts for products within your defined scope.
• Support the compliance function in defining and achieving departmental initiatives, maintaining relevant policies and procedures, developing documentation solutions, and liaising with auditors.
• Mentor and provide strategic guidance to compliance colleagues as AI capabilities spread across every product domain, and contribute to building a strong culture of compliance across Mercury.
• Work closely with our Risk team, which owns AI governance, as Compliance’s AI product expert to contribute product-level guidance to ongoing AI governance updates.

Core

responsibilities:
• Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Risk, Data, Operations, and Legal to bring Mercury's AI products to market in a manner that meets all relevant regulatory, financial partner, and network obligations.
• Advise product and engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle—discovery, design, evaluation, launch, and iteration—to ensure AI products are compliant-by-design rather than reviewed after the fact.
• Identify, assess, and document compliance risks specific to AI and agentic systems—including inaccurate or fabricated output, unauthorized or over-scoped agent action, inadequate consent and disclosure, unexplainable decisioning, disparate impact, data leakage across customers or organizations, prompt injection and third-party agent risk, and insufficient audit trail—and work cross-functionally to design pragmatic mitigation strategies.
• Define the compliance requirements for the platforms AI is built on, in partnership with the teams that own them: the LLM gateway all internal traffic routes through, the internal app platform, agent orchestration frameworks, and the data access and governance layer.
• Establish and refine AI-specific compliance standards for the department—what evidence a launch requires, what must be logged, what requires human review, what must be escalated, and what is out of bounds—and ensure those standards evolve as the organization and the technology grow.
• Support new product launches and expansions by scoping, defining, and communicating compliance requirements clearly and early, including for co-marketing and distribution partnerships with third-party AI platforms.
• Monitor regulatory, supervisory, and industry developments relevant to AI in financial services, assess impact, and drive implementation of required changes.
• Own and oversee multiple concurrent high-impact AI compliance workstreams, holding project owners accountable for results and ensuring each aligns with department and company objectives.
• Support remediation efforts for products within scope, including root cause analysis, corrective action planning, and execution tracking.
• Partner with executive leadership, partner bank compliance teams, and external advisors to guide high-level decisions on AI direction, presenting data-driven recommendations.
• Contribute to the broader Compliance function by supporting policy development, documentation standards, audit preparation, and examiner interactions.
• Help build and reinforce a strong culture of compliance across Mercury through collaboration, education, and influence—including raising the AI fluency of the Compliance team itself, and developing scalable tools, templates, and frameworks others can reuse.

You should have:
• 8+ years of experience in a compliance advisory, product compliance, or regulatory risk role, ideally within fintech or financial services, with a track record of being the recognized authority in your domain.
• Demonstrated experience advising on AI, machine learning, or model-driven products in a regulated environment—or comparable experience standing up a new compliance domain where no playbook existed.
• Working knowledge of the regulatory and supervisory framework relevant to AI in banking, including UDAAP, fair lending and ECOA/Reg B, FCRA and adverse action, Reg E and payments authorization, BSA/AML, GLBA and privacy, marketing and disclosure requirements, recordkeeping, complaint management, model risk management expectations, and third-party and vendor risk management guidance.
• Familiarity with emerging AI-specific regimes and frameworks and the ability to form a practical view on their application—such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, state AI and automated decisioning laws.
• Technical fluency to engage credibly with engineers on model behavior, evaluation and testing, agent permissioning and tool scoping, logging and observability, and data access controls—and to know which questions actually surface risk.
• Deep experience partnering with product and engineering teams on regulatory and compliance matters across the product lifecycle, including on fast-moving launches with external dependencies.
• Proven ability to own highly ambiguous, large-scale compliance problems and to create and execute a strategy to address them, without waiting for precedent.
• Experience designing compliance frameworks that span multiple product lines or departments, and improving systems and processes so that compliance posture evolves alongside business growth.
• Demonstrated success operating with senior stakeholders, including executives, partner banks, auditors, or regulators, and presenting data-driven recommendations that drive decisions.
• Strong project management skills, including the ability to define problems, create execution plans, manage several high-impact initiatives at once, and drive outcomes.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate regulatory and financial partner risk into terms stakeholder teams understand, and to resolve conflict around risk tolerance, resourcing, and timelines.
• Experience mentoring mid-level compliance professionals and raising the capability of a team, not just delivering your own work.
• Comfort operating independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, with sound judgment on when to move and when to escalate.
• Curiosity, adaptability, and genuine interest in engaging with frontier technology and the regulatory challenges that come with it.

jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
jobs.description:
About

the role:

Mercury is looking for a Model Risk Manager to help build and operate a practical, risk-based Model Risk Management program as we continue to scale and prepare for life as a regulated bank. 

Models support an increasingly broad range of decisions across Mercury, including credit underwriting, portfolio management, fraud prevention, BSA/AML, CECL, finance, liquidity, pricing, and operational processes. This role will provide independent review and effective challenge throughout the model lifecycle while helping Mercury apply governance proportionate to the actual risk of each model.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can move comfortably between technical analysis, regulatory expectations, and business context. You will conduct model validations, challenge assumptions and limitations, improve our model inventory and monitoring practices, and work closely with teams across Risk Ops, Data, Engineering, Product, Finance, Compliance, and Internal Audit. 

Showing up as a true collaborator, advisor and partner to the business will be key as we continue to build out this function and work towards our collective goals at Mercury. You should be comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where the objective is not governance for its own sake, but helping Mercury use models safely, responsibly, and effectively.

What you’ll do:
• Perform independent validations and reviews of internally developed and third-party models across areas such as credit, fraud, BSA/AML, CECL, finance, liquidity, pricing, and operational risk.
• Evaluate each model’s methodology, assumptions, data quality and lineage, implementation, and performance through reviews and testings such as outcomes analysis, benchmarking, back-testing, and sensitivity testing scaled to its risk and materiality.
• Provide credible and constructive challenges to model developers, owners, and users while maintaining effective working relationships with 1LOD.
• Assess model risk and materiality based on a model’s inherent risk, purpose, exposure, use, and potential impact.
• Help maintain a complete and accurate model inventory, including model ownership, risk rating, dependencies, limitations, validation status, monitoring requirements, and open issues.
• Review ongoing monitoring plans and results, including performance thresholds, overrides, data drift, model changes, and conditions that could make a model no longer fit for purpose.
• Evaluate vendor models and other third-party analytical products, including available documentation, transparency, performance, limitations, customization, and Mercury’s ability to monitor and control their use.
• Document validation conclusions clearly, identify issues, recommend proportionate remediation, and track findings through resolution.
• Support controlled model use when validation cannot be completed before implementation by helping establish appropriate limitations, compensating controls, monitoring, and approvals.
• Develop clear reporting on model risk, validation coverage, performance concerns, concentrations, dependencies, exceptions, and overdue remediation for management and governance committees.
• Help improve Mercury’s Model Risk Management Policy, standards, procedures, and templates.
• Use automation and analytical tools to make model inventory management, testing, monitoring, and reporting more efficient.
• Partner with Mercury’s Data and AI Governance teams to establish clear boundaries and handoffs between traditional model risk management and the governance of generative AI, agentic AI, and other analytical systems outside the formal model definition.
• Support regulatory examinations, Internal Audit reviews, and other assurance activities involving model risk.

What we’re looking for:
• 5+ years of relevant experience in model validation, model development, quantitative risk analytics, or a related discipline within banking, fintech, financial services, or consulting.
• Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, Financial Engineering or a related field. Master’s degree or PhD is preferred.
• Strong knowledge of model risk management principles and current regulatory expectations, including the revised interagency guidance reflected in SR 26-2.

jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

Senior Financial Control Analyst

📍London/Cardiff | 💰£56,000 - £75,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits

⭐ Our Financial Control Team:

Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges!

Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by… 

We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.

We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.

Your day-to-day:
• Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.
• Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.
• Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.
• Embrace the opportunity to improve and transform processes, driving incremental improvements through to adoption of AI.
• Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.
• Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.
• Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.
• Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.
• Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data.
• Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…
• You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment
• You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards
• You have a great eye for detail
• You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls
• You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors
• You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds
• You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)
• You embrace change and are motivated to improve and innovate process
• You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment
• What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰£56,000 - £75,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) 

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. 

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

• Recruiter Screening Conversation
• Initial HM Interview
• Role Specific Interview
• Behavioural Interview 

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

jobs.title: ICT GRC – Risk & Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
About the opportunity

Are you ready to take the next step in your career? As an ICT GRC - Risk Compliance Manager, you will play a pivotal role in shaping how we manage IT risks in an increasingly AI-driven financial landscape.

In this role, you’ll be at the forefront of risk management and compliance, ensuring our IT systems remain secure, resilient, and aligned with evolving regulations. You’ll work closely with tech, security, and compliance teams to strengthen risk frameworks, enhance resilience, and drive smarter decision-making.

As AI and automation become essential in risk management, you’ll help explore and implement automation and AI-driven solutions to improve risk assessments, identify emerging threats, and streamline compliance processes. This is an opportunity to not just keep up with change, but to help shape it.

If you're looking for a role where AI, automation, and ICT Risk and compliance intersect, and where your expertise can have a real impact, this is it.

In this role you will
• Function as a key member of the bank's risk function (Second Line of Defense), reporting directly to the Deputy CISO and maintaining close collaboration with First Line of Defense teams on matters of ICT risk management.
• Actively engage in the ICT Risk Management process, encompassing proactive risk assessment, analysis, treatment plan identification, mitigation, and ongoing monitoring.
• Drive the maturity of the ICT Risk Management framework in adherence to DORA act.
• Proactively conduct risk assessments to identify ICT risks within the bank's IT infrastructure and propose appropriate mitigation strategies.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product, technology, security, and other First Line of Defense teams, to identify and implement risk treatment plans.
• Maintain the ICT risk register, ensuring the accuracy and completeness of ICT risks.
• Proactively report progress and updates to the team, providing detailed reports and presentations on the status of identified risks, mitigation efforts, and compliance.
• Leverage artificial intelligence tools and technologies to enhance risk management and compliance processes.
• Ensure that all communication is clear, actionable, and aligned with the bank's overarching risk management strategy. Facilitate regular meetings with key stakeholders to discuss risk status, challenges, and next steps, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and proactive risk management.

 

What you need to be successful

Background
• Bachelor`s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
• Professional certifications such as CISA / CISM / CRISC, or equivalent are highly desirable.
• Minimum of 6 years of experience in IT risk management, information security, and compliance, preferably within the banking or financial services industry.
• In-depth knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, such as MaRisk, BAIT, DORA and industry standards such as ISO 27001/27002, NIST, etc.
• Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, network security, application security, and cloud security.
• Should be able to leverage AI tools and techniques to enhance risk assessment, compliance monitoring, and the identification of emerging threats.

Skills
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and assess complex IT and information security risks.
• Possesses expertise in assessing, writing and managing IT risks, threats and the ability to connect it with the appropriate controls.
• Ability to proactively recommend improvements to the area based on your expertise, as well as drive and operationalize the necessary changes required
• Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
• Ability to manage the ICT Risk Management process from end to end
• Proficiency in using Enterprise GRC tools such OneTrust / ServiceNow GRC and ability to use AI-driven technologies for compliance and risk management is a plus.
• Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
• Strong report-writing and presentation skills.
• Fluency in English and German are required (spoken and written).

Traits
• Adaptable and open to learning, with a keen interest in staying up-to-date with the latest trends and developments in IT and information security.
• Detail-oriented and meticulous in ensuring accuracy and thoroughness in all tasks.
• Proactive and self-motivated, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Collaborative, able to work well with teams and stakeholders.
• Strong topic ownership and a bias for action.
• Critical thinking and a drive to improve the status quo.
• Both attention to detail and strong conceptual thinking.
• Flexibility in a fast-changing and agile environment.
• Actively help oneself and the team to be successful.
• Willingness to continuously learn and act upon direct feedback.
• High ethical standards and integrity, with a strong commitment to confidentiality and data protection.

What’s in it for you:
• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
• Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.
• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. 

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Sounds good? Apply now for this position.

• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. 

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities. 

Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

Equal opportunities for all

At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. jobs.title: DX企画推進担当
jobs.description:
PayPayについて/About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

▼組織・チームについて

データやテクノロジーを活用し、PayPayグループの経営管理を高度化することをミッションとしています。
グループ全体の経営・事業状況をタイムリーに把握できる環境の実現に向けて、経営管理に必要なデータ基盤の整備やKPIダッシュボードの構築を推進しています。また、AIや各種テクノロジーを活用した経営管理業務の自動化・効率化にも取り組んでいます。

▼募集の背景

事業規模・領域の拡大に伴い、経営管理に必要なデータやKPIも多様化しており、グループ全体を横断した経営管理基盤のさらなる高度化を進めています。
本ポジションでは、経営管理に必要なデータ基盤の整備から、経営KPI・重要指標を可視化するダッシュボードの企画・構築までを推進いただける方を募集しています。

▼具体的な業務内容

経営の意思決定を支えるデータ基盤およびKPIダッシュボードの企画・構築を中心に、経営管理領域のDXを推進いただきます。
• 経営層向けKPIダッシュボードの要件定義・構築
• クラウド型予算管理システムの運用・保守、追加改修の推進
• RPA等の自動化ツールの運用、および活用領域の拡大に向けた企画・実装
• AI等を活用した経営管理業務の高度化（Python・生成AIを活用した機械学習、自動化・効率化など）
• 事業拡大や経営管理要件の変化に応じた、グループ経営を支える経営管理基盤の構築および各種プロジェクトの企画・推進

※PayPayのグループ会社へ出向いただくケースがございます

▼本ポジションの魅力
• 経営の意思決定に直結するDX： 
KPIダッシュボードやデータ基盤の構築を通じて、自らの仕事が経営判断や事業運営に活かされる手応えを得られます。
• 上流から実装まで一気通貫： 
企画・要件定義から構築・運用改善まで携わり、経営課題をテクノロジーで解決する経験を積めます。
• データ・AIを横断した専門性：
 BI・データ活用を軸に、生成AIや自動化などにも領域を広げ、経営管理×テクノロジーの専門性を高めることができます。

必要な経験/スキル

以下のいずれか、または複数の実務経験お持ちの方（目安：5年以上）
• Tableau、Sigma等のBIツールを用いたダッシュボードの設計・構築経験
• SQLを用いたデータ抽出・分析、およびBigQuery、Snowflake等を活用したデータテーブル・クエリの実装経験
• 経営管理システム等における要件定義、設計・開発、導入・運用の経験
• システム開発・導入プロジェクトの企画・PM・PMO経験
• RPA等の自動化ツールを活用した業務改善・DX推進経験
• ChatGPT、Gemini等の生成AIを活用した業務改善・DX企画の経験

あると望ましい経験/スキル
• データ基盤の構築、データ分析、BIを活用したダッシュボード構築の経験
• 予算管理・管理会計システムの開発・導入・運用経験
• 生成AIを活用した経営管理業務・経営管理基盤の高度化経験
• SIer・コンサルティングファーム等におけるシステム開発・DXプロジェクトの経験
• 事業会社において、ビジネス部門と連携しながらシステム・データ活用を推進した経験

jobs.title: Account Executive – Accountant Channel
jobs.description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).
Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.
Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.
AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Join us as an Account Executive – Accountant Channel to turn France’s accounting firms into one of Qonto’s strongest growth channels. You’ll build your own pipeline of firms and close them end to end, under the guidance of Adrien Cannet, our Lead Accountant Channel.
➡️ What you’ll do
Build your own pipeline: You’ll source and prospect accounting firms across France, with no inbound to lean on.
Own the whole sales process end to end: qualify, understand how each firm works and where its pain sits and close the deal.
Turn firms into referral partners: You’ll get accountants recommending Qonto to their own client base.
Use AI to work smarter: You’ll lean on AI tools to prep calls, personalise outreach and speed up qualification.
➡️ What we’re looking for
Outbound

experience:

At least one year of full-time sales experience (CDI), with a track record of building your own pipeline.
You’ve closed a full cycle yourself: You’ve owned at least one deal end to end, from first call to signature.
You are fluent in French and English: Both are mandatory, with a minimum of C2 in French and C1+ in English.
You don’t quit: You keep working quiet accounts without losing energy or tact.
You’re AI-fluent: You use AI tools naturally to sharpen outreach, prep and follow-up.
➡️ What we can offer you
A channel with real impact: The accountant channel is one of Qonto’s strategic growth priorities, and it’s still being built.
Room to shape it: You’ll have the autonomy to test your own angles and help set the ways of working this team runs on.
Growth you earn: A clear growth path if you deliver.
Qonto’s sales school: Hands-on coaching and transferable skills that travel well.
➡️ Your future manager
You’ll report to Adrien Cannet, who leads the Account Executive team for the accountantchannel. With a strong SaaS sales background at Spendesk, Adrien joined Qonto via Regate in 2024 as an Account Executive and has since taken the lead on new business for the accountant channel. His management style is hands-on but empowering: through one-to-one coaching, he helps you get to the root of a stalled deal, sharpen your approach, and find a way forward, then trusts you to take the reins and close it yourself.

At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
 
By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
🔒 Your security matters to us
Recruitment scams are on the rise. Keep in mind, we will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates.

jobs.title: Technical Growth & MarTech Lead
jobs.description:
Technical Growth & MarTech Lead

Location: London

Reporting to: Head of Digital Performance 

Closing date: Tuesday, 20th October at 5pm.

About Starling 

At Starling, we are on a mission to provide people with a fairer, smarter, and more human alternative to traditional banks. We are building a leading digital bank, driven by fast technology, fair service, and honest values. Our vision is to create a banking industry that serves everyone, which we accomplish by developing best-in-class proprietary technology, offering an exceptional customer experience, and establishing a strong, sustainable business.

Our five core values – Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim for Greatness – are at the heart of everything we do, guiding our strategy and shaping our culture. We're a branchless, largely paperless bank, committed to responsible banking, sustainability, and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

Working Hours: You will work a 37.5 hour week, with shifts between 9am - 5:30pm Monday - Friday.

Hybrid working: All Starling colleagues spend a minimum of 10 days per month in the office with flexibility to work the rest from home.

The Opportunity:

We are looking for a Technical Growth & MarTech Lead to bridge the gap between our Growth Marketing, Data Science, and Engineering squads. Operating in a highly regulated and privacy-first financial environment, you will serve as the technical architect of our growth engine. You will build highly secure server-to-server conversion tracking pipelines, manage our app-first MarTech stack, and use custom scripting to safely integrate AI workflows into our BI and analytics environments.

What You'll Do:
• Fintech AdTech & Conversion Engineering: Build, audit, and maintain robust, privacy-compliant conversion tracking architectures across our app and web ecosystems. Deep focus on Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs like AppsFlyer/Adjust), SKAdNetwork, Conversion API integrations, Google Ads Server-Side GTM, and secure offline conversion imports.
• Data Infrastructure & BI Alignment: Partner directly with Starling’s Data Engineering and BI teams. Design clean event schemas, optimise attribution pipelines, and integrate our secure data warehouses with marketing platforms—ensuring absolutely zero leakage of sensitive PII.
• AI Tooling & Secure Automation: Utilise Python and JavaScript to automate marketing operations and interact with LLM APIs. Build custom scripts that empower the marketing team to leverage AI for creative scaling, optimisation, and analytics, strictly within our security and compliance guardrails.
• MarTech System Architecture: Own the technical implementation of our Customer Data Platform (CDP), product analytics, and automated CRM/messaging tools. Ensure our stack effectively drives cross-sell (e.g., overdrafts, business accounts, integrations) while adhering to strict customer consent models.
• Cross-Functional Translation: Act as the technical translator. Turn complex growth ambitions into clear, secure technical specifications for our backend and app engineers, while helping marketing teams understand data integrity, technical constraints, and platform logic.

What You'll Bring:
• Technical Growth

Experience:

6+ years of experience in growth engineering, MarTech architecture, or technical growth marketing, ideally within Fintech, banking, or another highly regulated, app-first industry.
• App-First Tracking Mastery: Deep technical understanding of MMPs, iOS/Android privacy frameworks (ATT, Privacy Sandbox), server-side tracking, and custom webhook implementations.
• Scripting & Data Querying: Advanced proficiency in SQL for interrogating complex BI datasets. Strong scripting skills in Python or JavaScript/Node.js for API integrations, AI workflow automation, and custom tool building.
• Data Stack Literacy: Hands-on experience working alongside data engineering teams on data modeling, event streaming (e.g., Kafka, Snowplow), and enterprise BI platforms (Looker, Tableau).
• AI Stack Proficiency: Practical experience leveraging AI and LLM APIs to build custom automation scripts or internal tools for marketing teams.

Qualifications:
• Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or equivalent technical practical experience.
• Strong understanding of UK financial regulations (FCA rules on financial promotions) and strict privacy laws (GDPR, UK DPA).
• Experience operating within secure cloud environments (AWS).

Behaviours & Competencies:
• Security & Privacy-First Mindset: Operating in a highly regulated financial environment.
• Hands-on Engineering Ownership: You need to be a builder, not just a manager. You will automate marketing workflows, interact with LLM APIs, and build secure server-to-server tracking pipelines.
• Expertise in AdTech & MarTech Ecosystems: Deep, specialised knowledge of Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs like AppsFlyer/Adjust), SKAdNetwork, Conversion APIs, Server-Side GTM, and Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) is essential.
• Cross-Functional Translation: You must act as a bridge. This means translating complex marketing goals into strict technical specifications for backend and app engineers, while also explaining technical constraints and data integrity to the marketing team.
• Strategic Collaboration: You will partner directly with Data Engineering, BI, and Growth Marketing squads to align event schemas, optimise attribution pipelines, and integrate secure data warehouses.
• Secure AI Adoption: You are expected to safely integrate AI workflows into BI and analytics environments, empowering the marketing team to use LLMs for creative scaling and optimisation within strict compliance guardrails.
• Product-Driven Growth: You will leverage the MarTech stack to actively drive cross-selling opportunities (such as overdrafts and business accounts) through automation and smart CRM tooling.

Why Join Starling?
• Make an Impact: Work on projects that directly shape the future of banking and improve the financial lives of our customers. Starling is technology-led, and you'll have the freedom to accomplish your goals in innovative ways.
• Culture of Excellence: Be part of a collaborative, empowered, and forward-thinking team. We encourage experimentation, ownership, and a relentless focus on "doing the right thing.”
• Growth and Development: We are committed to your professional growth, offering opportunities to learn new technologies, take on new challenges, and own interesting things from day one.
• A Bank That Cares: We're a Living Wage employer, committed to flexible working, and dedicated to creating a fair, open, and safe working environment with compassion and inclusion at its core.
• Comprehensive

Benefits:

We offer a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package, including:
• Company-enhanced salary sacrifice pension scheme (7% employer contribution)
• Private Medical Insurance with Vitality including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton.

When you provide us with this information, you are doing so at your own consent, with full knowledge that we will process this personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice. ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Tide facts:
• Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM:

Ongoing Monitoring is building the capabilities Tide needs to detect, prevent and manage financial crime, fraud and risk across the member lifecycle.

Within Ongoing Monitoring, we are creating a new Acquiring Fraud Risk team as part of the Ongoing Monitoring team. This team will focus on protecting Tide’s growing Merchant Acquiring business by reducing acquiring fraud, chargeback losses and operational risk across card-present and card-not-present payment journeys.

Merchant Acquiring is a fast-growing product within Tide. We are on a mission to provide the simplest and easiest ways for our members to get paid. As we scale Acquiring globally, we need strong monitoring capabilities that protect Tide from avoidable losses while keeping the experience smooth for genuine members.

ABOUT

THE ROLE:

As Senior Product Manager for Ongoing Monitoring Acquiring Fraud Risk, you will own the roadmap for Tide’s acquiring transaction risk monitoring capabilities.

Working closely with Engineering, Data Science, Fraud Operations, Risk and Acquiring Product teams, you will build and scale real-time monitoring solutions using rules engines, machine learning models and Agentic AI to reduce fraud losses, improve chargeback outcomes and manage Tide’s acquiring risk exposure across card-present and card-not-present payment journeys.

Product Management and Product Development

You will be responsible for:
• Owning and independently defining the product strategy, vision and roadmap for acquiring fraud and risk monitoring within Ongoing Monitoring
• Building scalable monitoring capabilities across card-present and card-not-present acquiring journeys
• Working with Engineering and Data Science teams to define and deliver real-time rules, risk signals, machine learning models and decisioning workflows
• Having end-to-end ownership of the acquiring fraud and risk monitoring product development lifecycle
• Prioritising product work based on risk reduction, commercial impact, operational effort, member experience and technical feasibility
• Creating clear product narratives for senior stakeholders across Product, Risk, Operations, Finance and Commercial teams

Data-Driven Product Development Acquiring Fraud Reduction

You will be responsible for:
• Using data to identify acquiring fraud patterns, merchant behaviour, loss drivers and control gaps
• Developing product capabilities that actively reduce acquiring fraud losses and help keep Tide within relevant card scheme thresholds
• Establishing and monitoring performance metrics such as fraud loss rate, chargeback rate, scheme exposure, false positive rate and operational efficiency
• Running experiments and targeted control changes to improve fraud prevention while minimising friction for genuine members
• Working with Finance, Risk and Operations teams to quantify the commercial impact of fraud and risk controls

Chargeback Management and Operational Risk

You will be responsible for:
• Building product capabilities that improve chargeback prevention, monitoring, handling and recovery outcomes
• Working with Operations to improve case management workflows, review quality and operational efficiency
• Improving visibility of chargeback drivers, merchant risk profiles and recovery performance
• Helping Tide reduce avoidable losses where chargebacks arrive after funds have already been settled to merchants
• Tracking and improving metrics such as recovery rate, chargeback handling time, operational cost per case and manual review effort

AI, Automation and Risk Decisioning

You will be responsible for:
• Identifying opportunities to use Agentic AI and automation to improve acquiring fraud and risk operations
• Working with Engineering and Data Science teams to build scalable, explainable and measurable AI-supported risk decisioning capabilities
• Improving the speed, consistency and quality of acquiring risk reviews
• Increasing automation where manual review adds cost without improving risk outcomes

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

You are an experienced Product Manager with strong acquiring risk knowledge. You understand the commercial reality of fraud, chargebacks, scheme exposure and operational handling in a live acquiring environment.

You are comfortable working with complex data, real-time payment flows, operational teams and senior stakeholders. You can turn messy risk problems into clear product priorities and measurable outcomes.

You will have worked in an acquiring bank, PSP, payments company, fintech, or in a large merchant with its own acquiring or payments risk team. You understand how acquiring fraud and chargebacks affect growth, margin quality, scheme standing and operational cost.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - FX Markets
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer II with deep systems thinking, data engineering expertise, and a product-oriented mindset to join our Treasury FX function — spanning both the Market Data and Risk Engineering teams.

Our team builds the real-time infrastructure that powers Wise's FX pricing, risk management, and trade execution. We aggregate market data from Bloomberg and Reuters, compute live exposure and VaR, execute hedges worth tens to hundreds of millions of pounds daily, and protect the business from adverse currency movements. Our systems are tier- 1 and serve 50+ internal consumers with sub-second freshness across 50+ currency pairs.

You will be the technical anchor across both engineering teams, owning the architectural direction of 14+ production services, from rate ingestion and distribution, through real-time risk calculation, to automated hedge execution. The primary mission: build Wise's first semi-automated trade and hedge execution platform in close coordination with FX dealers, quantitative researchers, and treasury controllers.

We operate on a strong belief in automation, programmatic implementation, and reusable design. We're looking for people who can step back and think holistically about the ecosystem, but also follow through and help implement the design; drawing on the resources across the rest of the Finance & Treasury tribe.

Our stack is polyglot and modern: Java 21 + Spring Boot 4.x, Python 3.12, Apache Flink (streaming), Kafka, gRPC + Protobuf, and Bloomberg/Reuters real-time feeds. This isn't typical CRUD — it's real-time financial infrastructure where a 1bps improvement in hedging efficiency saves millions.

We need a seasoned engineer who can architect streaming data pipelines, collaborate with quants on model productionisation, drive reliability across mission-critical systems, and translate complex business requirements from traders and risk managers into elegant technical solutions.

What will you be working on?

You will own the technical direction and architectural evolution of Wise's FX engineering stack, with immediate focus on:
• Architecting a semi-automated hedge execution platform, from exposure decomposition through model-driven hedge proposals to programmatic trade execution on external partners
• Building real-time streaming pipelines with Apache Flink for portfolio-split exposure computation, tenor interpolation, and hedge lifecycle event processing
• Evolving our rate infrastructure for 10x throughput with FX Forwards, new corridors, NDFs and work on cross-provider deviation alerting
• Building production infrastructure for quant models for VaR, beta-adjusted exposure management, dynamic pricing and FRP cancellations.
• Owning Kafka topology design and schema evolution across the full pipeline: rate ingestion → risk calculation → trade execution → analytics
• Driving technical roadmap across both teams, mentoring IC2/IC3 engineers, and leading incident response for Tier-1 critical services

Drive execution

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager - Treasury Safeguarding
jobs.description:
We're looking for an Implementation Manager to join our fast-growing Finance & Treasury Product team in London or Tallinn. This is a unique opportunity to have an impact on Wise's mission by making sure our customers' money stays safe as we launch new products and expand into new markets.

Your mission

Wise customers trust us to keep their money safe. Safeguarding is how we make sure that every penny we hold for customers is protected, in every country we operate in.

Today we run safeguarding across 11 legal entities and client asset protection (CASS) across
6. That means more than 500 bank accounts in scope, 5+ external audits a year, regular internal audit and regulator reviews, and several new legal entities launching every year.

As Wise grows, so does our Safeguarding team. Our global team builds and runs the automated controls and tools that every entity relies on, while regional teams own what happens locally. As the Implementation Manager, you'll connect the two. You'll make sure new products and entities are onboarded into our controls properly, and that incidents are handled quickly and transparently.

You'll work closely with the Safeguarding Product Manager, Safeguarding Engineering and Analytics, Treasury and Regulatory Product Compliance, Finance, Payment and Treasury Operations, and regional controllers around the world.

 

How you'll contribute to our mission

New product reviews, onboarding and approval

- Run the safeguarding review and approval process for new products and product changes, making sure every step is followed and nothing launches without the right controls in place.

- Follow up with product teams, Treasury Regulatory Product Compliance and Finance to keep projects moving.

- Keep a clear, up-to-date tracker of projects that need safeguarding support, and report on their status.

 

New entity launches

- Support new legal entities as they launch, working out how they'll be onboarded into our global systems and controls.

- Define how controls need to be set up locally for each entity, for example safeguarding timings.

- Work with Regional Finance and Compliance so that local controllers are ready to take ownership from day one.

 

Execution and implementation

- Plan and lead the work to integrate new Wise products into our safeguarding systems, together with product managers, engineers, data analysts and operations specialists.

- Own large, complex integrations from start to finish, and support the team with clear documentation: requirements, project plans, resourcing, testing and delivery.

 

Support

- Keep documentation of product flows and safeguarding calculations up to date.

- Get hands-on when things go wrong: help product and engineering teams understand the impact of an incident, drive it to resolution, and improve controls so it doesn't happen again.

jobs.title: Senior Product Analytics Manager (AL2), SEND
jobs.description:
The role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Analytics Manager to set the strategic direction for analytics in our Global Send Experience Squad. You’ll help the squad decide where to focus, which customer problems to solve and how Wise can grow its global money transfer business, which today drives 5% of all cross-border transfers in the world for personal customers.

You’ll work closely with Product, Design and Engineering to lead discovery across the remittance space: building a deep understanding of customer needs, finding the biggest opportunities and turning them into a clear product strategy. You’ll influence decisions across the factors that shape whether customers choose to send money with Wise—including price, speed and convenience—throughout the whole customer lifecycle, from a customer’s first transfer to the choices they make as a returning customer.

You’ll lead a group of senior analysts. Your focus will be on setting the team’s direction and helping the squad make its most important strategic decisions. You’ll coach analysts to partner closely with teams on day-to-day product questions, while staying hands-on with the most complex and consequential opportunities yourself.

You’ll help us answer questions such as:
• Where are the biggest opportunities to grow money transfers around the world?
• What matters most to customers when they decide where, when and how to send money?
• How do price, speed and convenience shape customers’ choices and behaviour?
• How could an AI-powered concierge help customers find and complete the right transfer, while making the experience simpler and more personal?
• How can we make the experience work better for both new and returning customers?
• Which customer problems should we solve to make the biggest difference to growth and customer value?
• How should we focus our product strategy to grow our money transfer revenues 10x over the next few years?

What you’ll be doing
• Set the strategic direction for the squad. Partner with Product, Design and Engineering to build a clear view of customer needs, market opportunities and the choices Wise should make next.
• Lead discovery and opportunity finding. Explore customer behaviour and the end-to-end transfer journey to identify unmet needs, friction and growth opportunities. Help the squad understand not just what is happening, but where it has the greatest opportunity to act.
• Influence the whole customer decision. Bring an analytical perspective to how customers weigh price, speed and convenience when choosing how to send money, across both new and returning customer journeys.
• Turn opportunities into product priorities. Size customer and commercial opportunities, develop clear points of view and help teams make focused, evidence-based choices about what to build and why.
• Lead and develop a group of senior analysts. Set a high bar for analytical thinking and impact, coach analysts in their work and careers, and create the conditions for them to support their teams effectively.

• Bring people together around a shared view. Communicate complex evidence clearly, influence senior stakeholders and help cross-functional teams turn strategic choices into action.
