jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel Banking Law
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity 

N26 is looking for a Senior Legal Counsel Banking Law to further expand our legal expertise. In this key role, you will be part of our Banking Law Litigation Team and serve as a strategic partner to management and the Executive Board.

Your focus will be on the legal architecture and risk mitigation for groundbreaking financial products. You will shape the future of digital banking by translating complex regulatory requirements into legally sound concepts, from scaling our banking, trading, and crypto offerings to entering new European markets. In doing so, you will balance agility with the highest standards of compliance, ensuring that our product vision always aligns with regulatory law.

In this role you will:
• Work within the N26 Legal Department in our Banking Law Litigation Team, contributing to the launch and scaling of forward-looking banking and financial products (e.g., Trading Crypto).
• Provide holistic advice to management and the Executive Board on all legal matters relating to existing and new banking, trading, and financial products.
• Evaluate complex regulatory requirements and develop legally sound concepts for new products in a dynamic environment.
• Collaborate closely with the Product and Compliance teams, ensuring that innovation and regulatory compliance go hand in hand.
• Act as the point of contact for regulatory audits and confidently manage communication with supervisory authorities.
• Independently coordinate collaboration with external legal counsel and ensure first-class advisory quality.
• Independently conduct court and dispute resolution proceedings, taking responsibility for the management of significant litigation across all instances.

What You Need to Be Successful:

Background:
• You are a fully qualified German lawyer (Volljurist) -and you have completed both the First and Second State Law Examinations.
• You have at least 4 years of professional experience, with a significant portion in banking and financial law at a renowned law firm and/or an international company (fintech experience is a plus).
• Comprehensive knowledge of banking and financial law, as well as adjacent legal fields, is required. Experience in other legal areas is welcome.
• Ideally, you have successfully completed the specialised lawyer course in banking and capital markets law (Fachanwaltslehrgang im Bank- und Kapitalmarktrecht) or already hold the title of Specialist Lawyer (Fachanwalt).
• Fluent in written and spoken German and English. Any additional language (especially French, Spanish, or Italian) is a plus.

Skills:
• Strong interest in technical and business contexts, as well as digital business models.
• Ability to work independently, make decisions, and defend them both internally and externally.
• Pragmatic approach to tackling new topics and legal areas, while closely monitoring dynamic regulatory developments.
• High level of integrity, dedication, and initiative, with no hesitation to take on personnel management responsibilities.

What’s in it for you:
• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
• Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds.
• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. 

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities. 

Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

Equal opportunities for all

At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.

We are committed to providing an excellent and accessible candidate experience. If you require any accommodations to make this process work for you, please let us know. We’re here to support you!

Discover more about Diversity Inclusion at N26: https://n26.com/en-eu/diversity-and-inclusion

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel Banking Law
jobs.description:
About the opportunity

N26 sucht einen Senior Legal Counsel Banking Law, um unsere rechtliche Expertise weiter auszubauen. In dieser Schlüsselrolle bist du Teil unseres Banking Law Litigation Teams und fungierst als strategischer Partner für das Management sowie den Vorstand.

Dein Fokus liegt auf der rechtlichen Architektur und Absicherung wegweisender Finanzprodukte. Du gestaltest die Zukunft des digitalen Banking, indem du komplexe regulatorische Anforderungen in rechtssichere Konzepte übersetzt – von der Skalierung unserer Bank-, Trading- und Krypto-Angebote bis hin zur Erschließung neuer europäischer Märkte. Dabei balancierst du Agilität mit höchster Compliance und stellst sicher, dass unsere Produktvisionen stets im Einklang mit dem Aufsichtsrecht stehen.

Deine Aufgaben:
• Du wirst innerhalb des N26 Legal Departments in unserem Banking Law Litigation Team arbeiten und bei der Einführung sowie Skalierung von zukunftsweisenden Bank- und Finanzprodukten mitwirken (z. B. Trading Crypto).
• Du berätst das Management und den Vorstand ganzheitlich in allen rechtlichen Fragen im Zusammenhang mit bestehenden und neuen Banking, Trading und Finanzprodukten.
• Du bewertest komplexe regulatorische Anforderungen und entwickelst rechtssichere Konzepte für neue Produkte in einem dynamischen Umfeld.
• Du arbeitest eng mit dem Product und dem Compliance Team zusammen und stellst sicher, dass Innovation und regulatorische Compliance Hand in Hand gehen.
• Du fungierst als Ansprechpartner bei regulatorischen Prüfungen und steuerst souverän die Kommunikation mit Aufsichtsbehörden.
• Du koordinierst eigenverantwortlich die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Rechtsberatern und stellst eine erstklassige Beratungsqualität sicher.
• Du führst eigenständig Gerichts- sowie Streitbeilegungsverfahren und verantwortest das Management bedeutender Verfahren über alle Instanzen hinweg.
 

What you need to be successful

Hintergrund:
• Du bist deutscher Volljurist und hast das erste und zweite juristische Staatsexamen mit überdurchschnittlichen Ergebnissen abgeschlossen.
• Du kannst mindestens 4 Jahre Berufserfahrung und einen wesentlichen Teil davon im Bank- und Finanzrecht in einer renommierten Kanzlei oder/und in einem internationalen Unternehmen (gerne auch Fintech) vorweisen.
• Umfassende Kenntnisse im Bank- und Finanzrecht und in angrenzenden Rechtsgebieten sind erforderlich. Erfahrungen in anderen Rechtsgebieten sind willkommen.
• Idealerweise hast du bereits einen Fachanwaltslehrgang im Bank- und Kapitalmarktrecht erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder führst bereits den entsprechenden Fachanwaltstitel.
• Deutsch und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift, jede weitere Sprache (insbesondere Französisch, Spanisch oder Italienisch) ist ein Plus.

Fähigkeiten:
• Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an technischen und betriebswirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen sowie digitalen Geschäftsmodellen.
• Du arbeitest eigenständig, triffst Entscheidungen und bist bereit diese auch intern und extern zu vertreten.
• Du bist bereit, dir pragmatisch auch neue Themen und Rechtsgebiete zu erschließen und dynamische regulatorische Entwicklungen eng zu begleiten.
• Du besitzt ein hohes Level an Integrität, Einsatzbereitschaft und Eigeninitiative und scheust dich nicht vor Personalverantwortung.

Das erwartet dich bei uns:
• Treibe deine Karriere voran und werde Teil eines der bekanntesten FinTech-Disruptoren Europas 🚀.
• Mitarbeiter-Benefits: Ein attraktives Budget für deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung, ein Home-Office-Budget, Rabatte auf Fitness- und Wellness-Mitgliedschaften, Sprach-Apps sowie Vergünstigungen für den öffentlichen Nahverkehr.
• Exklusive N26 Vorteile: Als N26 Mitarbeiter:in erhältst du kostenlosen Zugang zu einem N26 Premium-Konto sowie kostenlose Abonnements für Freunde und Familie.
• Treuebonus: Ein zusätzlicher Tag Urlaub für jedes Jahr Betriebszugehörigkeit.
• Freiraum Technologie: Ein hohes Maß an Autonomie und Zugang zu modernsten Technologien – während du in einem freundlichen, internationalen Team mit unterschiedlichsten Erfahrungen und Hintergründen arbeitest.
• Relocation-Paket: Unterstützung beim Umzug und Visum-Prozess für alle, die es benötigen.

Wer wir sind

N26 hat Banking für die heutige digitale Welt neu gedacht. Technologie und Design prägen alles, was wir tun – so bauen wir die globale Bankenplattform, die Menschen weltweit gerne nutzen.

Wir haben physische Filialen, Papierkram und versteckte Gebühren abgeschafft und durch ein elegantes digitales Erlebnis ersetzt. Menschen die Freiheit zu geben, so zu leben und zu banken, wie sie wollen – das ist es, was uns jeden Morgen antreibt und inspiriert.

Unser Hauptsitz ist in Berlin, weitere Standorte befinden sich in mehreren europäischen Städten wie Wien und Barcelona. Unser Team zählt über 1.500 Mitarbeiter:innen aus mehr als 80 Nationen.

Siehst du dich in dieser Rolle aufblühen? Wir freuen uns auch dann auf deine Bewerbung, wenn du nicht 100 % der Kriterien erfüllst. Vielleicht bist du genau die Richtige bzw. der Richtige für diese oder andere Positionen bei uns!

Chancengleichheit für alle

Bei N26 glauben wir, dass unsere Stärke in unseren Mitarbeiter:innen und den vielfältigen Perspektiven liegt, die sie mitbringen. Wir setzen auf diverse Teams, die Innovationen vorantreiben und den Geschäftserfolg sichern. Wir suchen aktiv nach Talenten mit unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen und begrüßen Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Kultur, sexueller Orientierung, Beeinträchtigungen, Neurodiversität oder Alter.

Wir setzen uns für einen hervorragenden und barrierefreien Bewerbungsprozess ein. Wenn du spezielle Unterstützung oder Anpassungen im Prozess benötigst, lass es uns bitte wissen. Wir sind gerne für dich da!

Erfahre mehr über Diversity Inclusion bei N26:

https://n26.com/en-eu/diversity-and-inclusion

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, AI Trading
jobs.description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Hong Kong, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

OKX's Trading Products team owns the core trading experience across Spot, Margin, and Perpetual/Futures — spanning the full user journey from pre-trade decision-making, through order execution, to post-trade settlement and risk management. As our trading volumes and product complexity continue to grow globally, we are looking for a Trading Product Manager who can own and evolve both the user-facing trading experience and the underlying trading mechanics that power it.

This role sits at the intersection of product design and trading logic. You will work on how users discover, price, place, and manage trades (pre-trade / trade / post-trade), while also owning the correctness and soundness of the core mechanisms beneath the surface — margin models, funding rate formulas, liquidation logic, risk parameter design, and order/matching behavior. You will work closely with engineering, risk, quant, and design teams to ship trading features that are intuitive for users and rigorous under the hood.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Start from users and the market to uncover real trading-experience needs — Continuously surface user pain points through user research, behavioral data, community feedback, and conversations with active traders, ensuring product direction is grounded in real signal rather than internal assumptions.
• Benchmark against industry best practices to build best-in-class trading product competitiveness — Continuously track developments in crypto and traditional finance markets and the latest moves from leading products, translating external insight into concrete product opportunities that keep our trading experience and competitiveness ahead of the industry.
• Build and continuously refine the end-to-end trading experience — Own the full journey across pre-trade (market data presentation, decision-support tools, leverage/margin setup, risk disclosures), trade (order flow, execution feedback, order book/depth interaction), and post-trade (position management, PnL display, settlement statements) — from defining requirements through to shipping the solution.
• Drive efficient cross-team collaboration with mature program-management execution — Bring a complete product methodology, independently write rigorous PRDs, and lead alignment and coordination across engineering, risk, quant, design, and compliance. Own the full project lifecycle — from requirements definition and solution design, through development scheduling, to launch validation and post-launch review — ensuring every stage closes the loop with a clear outcome, without relying on others to drive progress.
• Apply rigorous quantitative thinking to understand and reason about trading mechanics — Bring strong logical reasoning and quantitative analysis skills, with the ability to learn fast and quickly master core trading mechanisms such as margin, leverage, funding rates, and liquidation. Candidates with a deep understanding of trading systems are preferred.

What We Look For In You 

We are open to two types of candidates for this role:

(a) Experienced Trading Practitioners
• Prior hands-on experience in trading — either within crypto (exchange product, quant, trading desk) or in traditional finance (equities, futures, FX, derivatives) — with direct exposure to how trading products and mechanisms are designed and operated.
• Solid understanding of core trading concepts: margin/leverage, order types, market microstructure, risk management, and P L mechanics.
• Comfortable reading and reasoning through trading formulas (e.g. mark price, funding rate, liquidation price) and translating them into clear product logic.

(b) High-Potential Talent
• Strong quantitative/analytical foundation — a background in mathematics, physics, statistics, engineering, or a related quantitative discipline, with strong academic performance.
• High self-drive and fast learning ability — demonstrated track record of picking up complex, technical domains quickly and independently, even without prior trading experience.
• Genuine intellectual curiosity about financial markets and trading mechanics, with the rigor to work through formulas and edge cases rather than relying on surface-level understanding.

Common requirements for both profiles:
• 3+ years of product management experience (or equivalent hands-on experience in quant/trading roles for candidates from profile (a)).
• Strong technical intuition — comfortable discussing system architecture and data flows with engineers, and reasoning through quantitative models. You don't need to be a developer, but you think with the rigor of one.
• Excellent communication skills — able to write a precise, technically sound PRD, and to explain complex trading mechanics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• High agency and execution velocity — comfortable operating in ambiguity, moving from open question to shipped solution, and making decisions with incomplete information.
• Genuine passion for crypto and trading — actively uses trading products, understands order types and market microstructure, and can explain how margin, leverage, or liquidation mechanics work. Ideally, you have skin in the game.
• Proficiency in Mandarin is required to communicate effectively with internal engineering and product stakeholders in the China-based R D center.

Nice-To-Haves
• Experience with derivatives products (perpetual futures, options) either as a builder or an active trader.
• Familiarity with risk parameter design (margin tiers, liquidation engines, insurance funds) at an exchange or financial institution.
• Quantitative modeling experience (e.g. Python, SQL) sufficient to validate trading formulas or backtest mechanism changes.
• Prior work in a high-growth crypto exchange, trading firm, or fintech company.
• Fluency in English is preferred to better support communication with global product and business stakeholders.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

Please note that Hong Kong is a group-level service hub, and OKX does not carry on a business of operating a virtual asset trading platform in Hong Kong. 

Notice:

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Product Manager with a deep understanding of TradingView users, strong commercial judgment, and experience driving product growth. You will grow OKX's business within the TradingView ecosystem by identifying the most promising customer segments, defining why traders should choose OKX, and finding effective ways to acquire, activate, and retain them, with accountability for measurable business outcomes.

Your first priority is to establish how the business can grow and which opportunities warrant investment. You will validate growth hypotheses through user research, data analysis, and focused experiments before committing substantial engineering resources. Those insights will shape the product roadmap, investment priorities, and the TradingView integrations and trading experience improvements you deliver with engineering and partners.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Define the Growth Strategy and Business Opportunity — 

Identify high-potential customer segments, trading use cases, and market opportunities within the TradingView ecosystem. Assess competitive positioning, platform selection drivers, and OKX's differentiated value proposition. Build growth hypotheses and business cases that consider audience size, revenue potential, acquisition cost, and expected return, then set business goals, priorities, and a phased growth plan.
• Understand Users and the Trading Conversion Journey — 

Use interviews, behavioral data, and community feedback to understand how traders discover platforms, use charts and indicators, set alerts, connect accounts, place orders, and manage positions. Identify what motivates or prevents users from choosing OKX, making their first trade, and returning. Develop customer segments and conversion funnels, and turn insights into clear product, positioning, and lifecycle opportunities.
• Validate Growth Hypotheses and Improve Conversion and Retention — 

Design measurable experiments across acquisition, account connection, first successful trade, repeat trading, and reactivation. Use existing capabilities, onboarding, trader education, value proposition testing, and targeted campaigns to validate opportunities. Define success metrics, experiment costs, and criteria to scale or stop; expand approaches that work and use the evidence to inform subsequent product investment.
• Drive Go-To-Market and Ecosystem Partnerships — 

Work with marketing, regional, lifecycle, and TradingView partner teams on acquisition and go-to-market plans. Evaluate ecosystem visibility, communities, creators, educational content, and joint campaigns as potential channels. Define the customer proposition, distribution approach, conversion journey, and partner objectives, and assess channels by the active traders, retention, and business contribution they generate.
• Translate Growth Evidence into Product Delivery and Integration — 

Translate validated user needs and growth opportunities into a product roadmap, PRDs, and acceptance criteria. Define the minimum scope and engineering priorities required to achieve the business objective. Work with OKX engineering and TradingView technical teams to assess API integration, account authorization, market data, and order and position synchronization, and drive the necessary adaptation, testing, and launch to address specific conversion, trust, or retention problems.
• Own Business Outcomes and Continuously Refine Investment — 

Own metrics for newly acquired trading users, first-trade conversion, active traders, retention, incremental trading volume, and revenue contribution, taking acquisition, incentive, and delivery costs into account. Separate the effects of market conditions, incentives, and product improvements. Review growth initiatives and feature investments, reallocate resources based on results, and track connection success and trading reliability as measures of experience quality.

What We Look For In You
• Relevant product management experience in trading, fintech, or digital assets, with a track record of measurable product growth. You can explain how you identified opportunities, developed a growth strategy, and improved acquisition, trading conversion, retention, or revenue, including your personal contribution and results.
• A deep understanding of TradingView users and their practical use of charts, indicators, watchlists, alerts, and trading workflows. You can explain why different traders choose a platform, switch terminals, abandon an order, or continue using a service, and validate those insights through research and data.
• Strong commercial judgment and growth strategy skills. You can segment customers, assess opportunities, define differentiated positioning, select distribution channels, and build business cases. You validate demand and a credible path to growth through research and focused experiments before substantial engineering investment.
• Strong analytical and experimentation skills. You can analyze funnels, cohorts, and retention, design and evaluate growth experiments, and assess incrementality, acquisition cost, customer value, and incentive cost. You can distinguish short-term trading volume changes from sustainable growth.
• An understanding of trading products and their commercial drivers. You are familiar with spot and derivatives fundamentals and how instrument coverage, fees, liquidity, execution quality, and account and position workflows influence customer choice, conversion, and retention. You can translate these factors into product decisions.
• Experience delivering products that involve technical integration. You have worked with engineers on API or third-party platform integrations and can read interface documentation, understand account authorization and market data, order, and position synchronization, define business rules and acceptance criteria, and drive testing and launch. You connect technical constraints and implementation scope to user value and growth objectives.
• Strong English communication and cross-functional execution skills. You can work with TradingView partners, marketing, regional, product, and engineering teams on business opportunities, product priorities, and technical feasibility, aligning resources around shared outcomes.

Nice-To-Haves
• Experience growing a business within TradingView or a comparable trading-tool ecosystem, with examples spanning opportunity discovery, growth validation, and scaling.
• Experience with trader communities, creators, educational content, partnerships, or channel growth, with the ability to evaluate initiatives by active traders, retention, and revenue contribution.
• Experience growing products across regions or trader segments, with an understanding of differences in user behavior, customer propositions, and acquisition approaches.
• Experience with TradingView Broker Integration, Advanced Charts, Trading Platform, or comparable integrations, with an ability to explain how the work improved the user experience or supported growth objectives.

What Success Looks Like
• An evidence-based growth plan that identifies priority customer segments, OKX's differentiated value, promising distribution channels, and the business opportunity.
• Validated, repeatable approaches to acquisition, trading conversion, and retention, supported by research and focused experiments that guide engineering investment and resource allocation.
• Measurable, sustainable growth in active traders, retention, and revenue contribution, with acquisition and incentive costs taken into account.
• Delivery of the product capabilities and TradingView integrations needed to capture validated opportunities, with improvements to critical user journeys and ongoing measurement of their growth impact.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

About the Opportunity

OKX SG Pte. Ltd. ("OKX SG") is building a robust, scalable compliance function in support of our Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) regulatory obligations. As Compliance Manager, you will partner with the OKX SG CCO and cross-functional stakeholders across Compliance, Legal, Risk, Product, and Operations to advance our Capital Markets Services (CMS) program and maintain a compliance framework aligned with MAS expectations.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Assist in drafting, reviewing, and updating Singapore-specific compliance policies, procedures, job aids, controls descriptions, and governance documentation to support local regulatory requirements and licensing commitments.
• Support the enhancement and ongoing maintenance of OKX SG’s AML/CFT, sanctions and broader regulatory compliance framework in line with applicable MAS rules, notices, guidelines, and internal standards.
• Prepare clear, well-structured written materials for CCO, senior management, Board, auditors, and regulators, including governance decks, issue summaries, risk assessments, gap analyses, remediation updates, and regulatory briefing papers.
• Track regulatory commitments, licensing conditions, control enhancements, and remediation actions arising from internal reviews, external reviews, audits, or regulatory feedback. OKX SG’s compliance function is responsible for tracking and taking corrective action to remediate findings.
• Assist with the preparation and maintenance of management information, governance reporting, and status reporting across the compliance program for CMS.
• Support regulatory engagements, inspections, and information requests by organizing documentation, validating evidence, and helping prepare concise, accurate responses.
• Contribute to compliance training and awareness efforts for relevant stakeholders. OKX SG’s compliance framework requires training materials and attendance records to be maintained and risk-based training to be delivered where required.

 

What We Look For In You
• 8+ years of experience in regulatory compliance and financial crime compliance with a MAS regulated Singapore entity.
• Direct experience supporting regulatory license applications, major regulatory change programs, regulatory remediation or supervisory engagements in Singapore.
• Strong working knowledge of MAS Securities and Future Act and corresponding rules and regulations, notices and circulars
• Experience drafting and reviewing policies, procedures, regulatory submissions, governance papers and other formal compliance documentation.
• Strong program management skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, stakeholders and competing deadlines with minimal oversight.
• Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex regulatory or operational issues into clear written analysis and actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
• Proven ability to work cross-functionally across Compliance, Legal, Product, Operations, Risk, and business teams.
• Excellent written, verbal, analytical and interpersonal communication skills.
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in law, finance, business or another relevant field.
• Proficient in AI tools usage and able to automate work deliverables wherever possible
• Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CRCM, CFA or equivalent.
• Experience working in a global organization with matrixed stakeholders and shared service models.
• Familiar with digital assets, blockchain technology and the role of compliant innovation in expanding economic freedom.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards!

Robinhood’s Customer Experience team plays a critical role in Democratizing Finance for All! We are expanding our core customer experience team adding new executive office and social representatives. These team members play a critical role in the customer experience supporting escalated and high visibility cases. 

As a Customer Experience Escalations Specialist, you will investigate and resolve sensitive customer cases that require advanced problem-solving, sound judgment, and strong communication. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional partners to ensure timely resolution of complex issues while protecting the customer experience and the Robinhood brand.

Within this role, Executive Office team members focus on escalations and formal complaints originating from leadership, regulatory inquiries, or other high-risk channels. We partner closely with support, operations, compliance, and leadership teams to deliver thoughtful resolutions while upholding the highest standards of trust, accountability, and service excellence.

This role is based in our Denver, CO or Westlake, TX office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 5 days per week.

The team operates seven days a week from 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. ET. Employees will work either five 8-hour shifts or four 10-hour shifts per week, depending on business needs. Specific schedules will be determined after hire.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do
• Resolve customer escalations across support channels
• Investigate and resolve complex customer issues, including cases escalated by leadership, regulatory bodies, or high-profile customers.
• Partner with Compliance, Legal, and senior leadership to provide case summaries, risk assessments, and resolution outcomes.
• Conduct root cause analysis to identify drivers of poor customer experiences and recommend improvements.
• De-escalate sensitive customer situations while maintaining a high standard of professionalism and empathy.
• Manage and resolve high-visibility customer cases originating from social media and public platforms, ensuring timely responses, thoughtful engagement, and coordinated resolutions that protect the customer experience and Robinhood’s brand.

• FINRA Series 7 and 63 licenses required

• Experience managing highly escalated or sensitive customer situations
• Strong ownership, judgment, and ability to adapt to changing priorities
• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex issues, deliver thoughtful updates, and engage professionally with customers, executives, and cross-functional partners.

• • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career

As Director of Brokerage Risk, you will partner closely with brokerage leadership and cross-functional risk teams to refine risk management capabilities, lead the team's Data Analytics and Solutions function to surface actionable risk insights across the enterprise, and play an influential role in proposing and implementing strategic risk initiatives.

This role is based in our Chicago, IL office with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week.

jobs.title: Java Software Engineer - Getting Paid & Open Banking
jobs.description:
Starling is the UK’s first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking! We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way.

We’re a fully licensed UK bank with the culture and spirit of a fast-moving, disruptive tech company. We’re a bank, but better: fairer, easier to use and designed to demystify money for everyone. We employ more than 3,000 people across our London, Southampton, Cardiff and Manchester offices.

Our technologists are at the very heart of Starling and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Starling is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, discovering, to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five Starling values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Starling - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person.

Our Engineering Environment

Starling engineers are excited about helping us deliver new features, regardless of what their primary tech stack may be. Hear from the team in our latest blogs or our case studies with Women in Tech.

We value people being engaged and caring about customers, caring about the code they write and the contribution they make to Starling. People with a broad ability to apply themselves to a multitude of problems and challenges, who can work across teams do great things here at Starling, to continue changing banking for good.

We're seeking highly motivated engineers with at least 3-4 years of Java experience to play a key role in our Getting Paid & Open Banking team. In this role, you will develop and maintain innovative capabilities that empower businesses to collect payments seamlessly and integrate their accounts with third-party providers. We’re looking for engineers who have excellent attention to detail and can write clear, concise and maintainable code. You should have a strong understanding of delivering robust, scalable systems and a proven track record of engineering excellence. Experience with AWS and Postgres is highly desirable.

We’re open-minded when it comes to hiring; we care more about aptitude and attitude than specific qualifications. For the most part we code in Java, but you need not be an expert when you join us! We believe in clean coding, simple solutions, automated testing, and continuous deployment. If you care enough to find elegant solutions to difficult technical problems, we’d love to hear from you.

The main part of our Tech Stack is listed below. We don't ask that you have experience in all of this, but if you do, that's great!
• Java (makes up the majority of our backend codebase)
• AWS & GCP (we're cloud-native)
• Distributed service-based architecture
• Kubernetes (EKS)
• TeamCity for CI/CD (lots of teams are releasing code 15-20 times per day!)
• Terraform and Grafana

The Team:

The Getting Paid & Open Banking team plays a pivotal role at the edge of Starling, delivering tailored solutions that enable small to medium sized businesses to get paid; including features like Invoicing, Tap to Pay, and Settle Up for Business.

Our responsibilities also span maintaining our Open Banking API, our proprietary PSD2 public API, the Starling Marketplace, and the peer-to-peer ecosystem underpinning Confirmation of Payee.

As a direct participant in Open Banking, we are beginning to explore innovative ways to enhance our core banking product, with features like Easy Account Top Up, in the Starling app exemplifying this approach.

By joining our team, you will have the exciting opportunity to engage in both technical and product engineering; delivering real value to our customers while collaborating closely with external third-party partners.

Our process:

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:
• Initial phone call - ~45 minutes
• Take home technical test to be discussed in the technical interview - ~3 hours
• Technical interview - ~1.5 hours
• Final Interview - ~40 minutes
• 25 days holiday (plus take your public holiday allowance whenever works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasing

About us

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

Starling is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Starling are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. When you provide us with this information, you are doing so at your own consent, with full knowledge that we will process this personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice.

By submitting your application, you agree that Starling may collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. People with a broad ability to apply themselves to a multitude of problems and challenges, who can work across teams do great things here at Starling, to continue changing banking for good.

We're seeking highly motivated engineers with at least 3-4 years of Java experience to play a key role in our Getting Paid & Open Banking team. In this role, you will develop and maintain innovative capabilities that empower businesses to collect payments seamlessly and integrate their accounts with third-party providers. We’re looking for engineers who have excellent attention to detail and can write clear, concise and maintainable code. You should have a strong understanding of delivering robust, scalable systems and a proven track record of engineering excellence. Experience with AWS and Postgres is highly desirable.

We’re open-minded when it comes to hiring; we care more about aptitude and attitude than specific qualifications. For the most part we code in Java, but you need not be an expert when you join us! We believe in clean coding, simple solutions, automated testing, and continuous deployment. If you care enough to find elegant solutions to difficult technical problems, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Payments Director
jobs.description:
Starling is the UK’s first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking! We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way.

We’re a fully licensed UK bank with the culture and spirit of a fast-moving, disruptive tech company. We’re a bank, but better: fairer, easier to use and designed to demystify money for everyone. We employ more than 3,000 people across our London, Southampton, Cardiff and Manchester offices.

Our technologists are at the very heart of Starling and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Starling is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, discovering, to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five Starling values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Starling - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person. In Technology, we're asking that you attend the office a minimum of 1 day per week.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Payments Director to lead our Payments function and ensure that our payments services operate safely, reliably and in line with our regulatory and scheme obligations.

Sitting within Technology and reporting to the Chief IT Control Officer, this is a senior leadership role with responsibility for providing effective oversight and control of the Bank’s payments ecosystem. You will lead the Payments team, ensuring payment risks are understood and appropriately managed, regulatory and scheme requirements are met, and our critical third party relationships are effectively governed.

You will work across Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance and the wider business providing clear ownership and leadership when issues arise and helping us maintain a resilient, well controlled payments environment as the Bank continues to grow.

Why this role matters:

Payments are at the heart of our customers’ experience and are one of the most critical services we provide.

At Starling, we want to move quickly and continue to innovate, but we also need to ensure that our payments services remain safe, resilient, compliant and well controlled.

As Payments Director, you’ll play a central role in achieving the balance. You’ll bring together technology, risk, regulation, suppliers and schemes to ensure we understand our exposures, respond effectively when things go wrong and continue to strengthen our payments capability as the bank grows.

What you'll get to do

You will provide leadership and oversight across the Bank’s payments activities, with particular responsibility for:
• Payment risk and control - ensuring risks across the payments estate are identified, assessed and effectively managed, with a strong and proportionate control environment.
• Regulatory and scheme compliance - ensuring the bank understands and meets its obligations relating to payments, including applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards and payment scheme rules
• Scheme Management - owning and overseeing key relationships with payment schemes and networks, including Mastercard, ensuring obligations are met and changes, issues and risks are appropriately managed
• Supplier and third party management - providing effective oversight of critical payment suppliers and partners, ensuring appropriate performance, governance, risk management and escalation arrangements are in place
• Incident Management - providing senior leadership and oversight of payment incidents, ensuring issues are managed effectively from identification through to resolution, with appropriate stakeholder communication, root cause analysis and remediation.
• Operational Resilience - ensuring payment services are resilient and recoverable, with appropriate contingency arrangements, testing and oversight of critical interdependencies
• Change and emerging risk - assessing the risk and control implications of changes to payment products, platforms, regulation, schemes and suppliers, ensuring appropriate controls are embedded from the outset.
• Governance and reporting - providing clear and insightful reporting on payment risks, incident, supplier performance, compliance and emerging issues to senior management and relevant governance forums.
• Leadership - leading and developing a high performing payments team, establishing clear accountability and building strong relationships across Technology and the wider bank.

You will bring significant leadership experience within payments, ideally gained within a bank, fintech, payments provider or similar regulated financial services environment.

You will have a strong understanding of the payments landscape and the risks associated with delivering critical payment services. You’ll be comfortable operating at the intersection of technology, operations, risk and regulation, and able to translate complex payment issues into clear decisions and outcomes.

We are looking for someone who can demonstrate:
• Deep knowledge of payment services, payment schemes and associated regulatory requirements
• Strong experience of payments risk management, controls, and governance
• Experience managing relationships with card schemes, payment networks, processors and other critical third parties
• A strong understanding of technology and operational risk within a regulated environment
• Experience leading the response to significant payment or technology incidents and driving effective remediation
• Knowledge of operational resilience and the management of critical services and third party dependencies
• Strong stakeholder management skills with the credibility to influence senior leaders, suppliers, schemes and other external parties
• The ability to provide constructive challenge while remaining pragmatic and commercially aware
• Proven experience leading and developing teams in a fast-moving environment.

jobs.title: Head of Finance Business Partnering, Operations & Technology
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:
• Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT

THE ROLE:

As Tide continues to grow across multiple markets, strong financial management is essential to helping us scale responsibly, profitably and sustainably. As our Head of FP A, you will serve as a core strategic Finance Business Partner to multiple leadership teams. 

In this high-impact, multi-faceted leadership role, you will shape workforce strategies, lead complex investment cases, and oversee key operational expense drivers—from fraud loss P L and vendor contract structures to AI token costs and cross-functional capacity modeling. 

You will bring data-backed financial discipline and strategic oversight to ensure Tide continues gaining operational leverage as we launch new products and expand internationally. 

This is a highly visible global leadership role where you will partner closely with Directors, Product Engineering leads, and the Finance SLT to tell the story behind our numbers and ensure Tide balances ambitious growth with sharp operational and financial discipline. 

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

This is a global role in which you will:
• Partner with Leadership: Act as the key finance business partner to Product Engineering, Member Ops, Risk Fraud, and Enablement area leaders, shaping strategic, workforce, procurement, and investment decisions.
• Drive Business Cases Investment Funding: Design and build business cases for Member Ops investments and fraud/risk prevention tooling, managing them through the Finance SLT to sign-off and bridging BizOps to the CFO office.
• Lead Capacity Workforce Planning: Lead capacity modeling and workforce strategies, balancing trade-offs across stakeholders while aligning to finance and SLA targets.
• Set Budgets Target Efficiency: Set budget parameters and efficiency targets across operational teams, connecting Product Engineering roadmaps directly with operational delivery.
• Manage Commercials Vendors: Execute the commercial review framework for Member Ops vendors alongside procurement, managing contract structures, renegotiations, and make-vs-buy decisions.
• Own Fraud Loss P L Exposure: Own the fraud loss P L across forecasting, actuals tracking, and variance analysis, while leading multi-region fraud exposure scenario modeling.
• Align Cross-Functional Loss Assumptions: Connect the financial impact of Risk Fraud to Collections and Treasury, keeping loss, recovery, and provisioning assumptions aligned across teams.
• Own Narratives Reporting: Partner with operational directors to control the financial narrative on vendor outcomes and fraud performance reported to the CFO office, while reporting cost-to-serve and ROI to the SLT.
• Optimize Data Availability: Work closely with Data Engineering, BizOps, and Financial Reporting teams to ensure robust data availability for Risk reporting.
• Manage Enablement Operational Costs: Direct cost management across software consolidation, contractor spending, real estate/CAPEX, P E, and AI token usage. 

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR: 

You'll likely have:
• 10+ years of Commercial Finance FP A Leadership: Senior Finance Business Partner experience within high-growth fintech, digital banking, or tech environments.
• Operations Risk Expertise: Hands-on experience partnering with Member Ops and Risk/Fraud leaders on capacity modeling, SLAs, and multi-region fraud exposure.
• P L Loss Ownership: Experience owning fraud loss P Ls (forecasting, variance analysis) and aligning loss assumptions across Treasury and Collections.
• Opex Control: Proven track record in vendor contract renegotiations, make-vs-buy decisions, software consolidation, and managing AI/token costs.
• Investment Portfolio Strategy: Ability to build CFO-level business cases, model multi-horizon ROI, and manage pod/incubation funding models.
• Executive Influence: Clear communication skills to bridge operational metrics with financial narratives for the CFO and Senior Leadership Team.
• MBA or CA qualification

Most importantly, you'll enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, thrive on unlocking operational leverage as we scale, and care deeply about building sustainable financial foundations to support Tide's global growth. 

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN: 

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
• Competitive Compensation - competitive salary and share options
• Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays
• Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey
• Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide
• Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options
• Life Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection
• Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops
• Volunteering Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth
• Learning Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more
• WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually
• Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
• Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement
• Snacks Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent)

 

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

 

Disclaimer

 

It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
• Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
• All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
• Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
• Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

 

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

This is a high-visibility leadership role with significant regional scope. What you’ll do.
