• Strategic Leadership: Lead the business operations organization in the region, identifying and capitalizing on opportunities to enhance efficiency and performance. You will work closely with global heads to shape the future of the region, including location strategy and capacity planning.
• Team Leadership: Lead and develop a small team of high-performing BizOps managers, guiding them to execute on key operational improvements.
• Regulatory & Board Representation: Represent our operations confidently and credibly in front of regulators and our board of directors.
• Expansion and Growth: Collaborate with the North American leadership team on strategic expansion into new markets and regions.
• Talent Development: Grow and mentor local operational leaders, hire new talent, and establish effective local ways of working, including hybrid models and career growth opportunities.
• Execution in a Flat Structure: Embrace our flat organizational structure by being a leader who can both strategize and execute, getting your hands dirty to solve problems and drive projects forward.

 

Accountability & Success Metrics.

Your success will be measured by your ability to scale our regional operations efficiently and sustainably. 

While you will ultimately hold accountability for regional servicing metrics (including SLAs, efficiency targets and resolution quality), your primary focus will be on driving structural improvements. You will work in lockstep with our product teams to build forward-looking infrastructure that upgrades our operations.
• Operational Excellence: Proactively identify systemic operational vulnerabilities, lead high-impact automation projects, and drive contact deflection strategies to scale our volume without linearly scaling headcount.
• Strategic Planning: Translate product requirements into a sustainable servicing model and formulate both long-term strategies and actionable 6-month plans.
• Data-Driven Decisions: Build, track and execute against robust KPIs, using data to uncover operational insights and eliminate customer friction points.
• Location and Talent Strategy: Act as a "local office leader", owning decisions on location changes, and contributing to our hybrid work strategy. You will also provide key input into forecasting and hiring decisions.

jobs.title: Senior B2B CRM Manager
jobs.description:
We are hiring a senior regional CRM owner to grow Wise Business across APAC. Acquisition and conquest are central: helping businesses discover Wise, understand the value of switching from an existing provider and become active customers.

The person will work closely with Sales and regional Marketing, including above-the-line (ATL) and Brand teams, to build a repeatable lead pipeline and acquisition programme. They will own regional content adaptation and hands-on CRM delivery. We need someone who sets direction independently, communicates clearly and builds the relationships needed to deliver through a global organisation.

Your Mission:
• Own a prioritised regional B2B CRM roadmap, balancing acquisition, onboarding and activation with longer-term customer value.
• Partner with Sales on target audiences, qualification, lead handover, follow-up and feedback on lead quality and objections.
• Connect ATL and Brand campaigns to relevant lead capture, nurture and conversion journeys.
• Build acquisition and switching journeys, adapting propositions, proof points, tone, creative and channel choices for local business audiences.
• Deliver email, push and in-app campaigns end to end, including segmentation, personalisation, testing and QA.
• Work with Analytics to assess qualified pipeline, conversion, activation and incremental commercial impact, with clear definitions and outcome windows.
• Own campaign prioritisation, stakeholder communication, calendar coordination, deliverability and adherence to agreed customer-contact standards.

jobs.title: KYC Operations Senior Analyst - Deactivations
jobs.description:
As a Senior Analyst in KYC Operations in our newly established Deactivations Team, you will play a crucial role in strengthening Wise's commitment to regulatory compliance and protecting the integrity of our financial ecosystem. Your mission is to become the authority in enhanced due diligence (EDD) and to grasp the risks linked to Wise customers. You will thoroughly investigate complex KYC cases, equipped with the duty to guarantee that every decision is compliant, and accurate. This isn't just following a new process; it's about delivering justice and upholding our integrity when it matters the most. This role is a great opportunity for people who are interested in deepening their knowledge in the KYC domain. 

As a KYC Operations Senior Analyst, you will play a key role in supporting a financial crime program that is driven by Wise's mission for money without borders, transparency, and protecting customers. We are looking for someone with experience in enhanced due diligence, an excitement and desire to learn and grow with this new team, and strong organisational and communication skills.

Responsibilities
• Conduct Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) reviews based on customer’s risk profile. Take frequent risk based approach decisions while conducting customer reviews ensuring risk management standards are met.
• Review customer transaction history and provide insights into customer behaviour patterns that may indicate risks. Conduct periodic reviews and analyse changes in customers history and account usage.
• Review and assess high risk customer reports to provide analysis and approval as per the set policies and procedures.
• Exercise discretion in setting priorities, identifying customer records that require further review and taking action to obtain and follow-up on the information and/or documentation requested.
• Ensure that information and documentation provided by customers meet our risk appetite for onboarding and maintaining high risk customers.
• Conduct in depth analysis, using provided documentation or external sources (e.g. websites and company registries) ensuring that only customers within risk appetite are onboarded. Perform searches utilising internet sources and/or third-party vendors to obtain information on prospects and new/existing customers.
• Communicate with other internal teams when required to handle escalated or complicated cases.
• Provide guidance and responses to daily inquiries from peers, front-line and management regarding complex matters and case analysis, when appropriate.
• Maintain a high understanding of AML/CFT Regulations and how these impact the business, as well as Wise products and services.
• When warranted, be capable of drafting SAR narratives to report activity deemed unusual.
• Taking part in and leading projects related to Deactivations Team processes and guidelines. Assist in identifying improvement opportunities and contribute to policy updates, training materials, and standard operating procedures.
• Draft reports to internal and external stakeholders, periodically and when requested.
• Support Wise in internal and external audits and regulatory process related queries reviews.
• Effective communication with customers by the relevant communication channels that the team operates with.
• Perform your tasks and responsibilities within the expected key performance indicators set by the leadership team.

jobs.title: Head of Technical Accounting
jobs.description:
Join our finance team and help navigate us through a critical transformation

The Finance team is critical in supporting the Wise mission. We are now listed in the US stock exchange in 2026 and need to ensure our technical accounting team is set-up to meet the respective regulatory requirements.

We’re looking for a HEAD OF TECHNICAL ACCOUNTING to join us

We’re looking for a Head of Technical Accounting to join and lead our technical accounting team. You will play a pivotal role in ensuring the accounting for our new products and services is in accordance with US GAAP and IFRS to meet our reporting needs. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are passionate about financial leadership, we welcome you to apply.

Your mission
• The Technical Accounting team is responsible for understanding the why and how of different accounting areas. This includes documenting accounting position papers and explaining to Finance stakeholders, diverse teams across Wise as well as external auditors the accounting for these. You will be overseeing the team’s work and supporting them in the analysis of various accounting topics.
• Collaborate cross-functionally to embed accounting into the business - not just the books: You will collaborate with different teams in Finance to ensure correct application of IFRS and US GAAP and that processes and accounting policies are updated to reflect it.
• Design scalable processes and systems to support rapid growth and our listing in US stock exchange: You are taking ownership for the management of several high-stakes financial workstreams to ensure compliance with financial reporting standards for both internal and external reporting purposes.
• Act as the primary contact with auditors and other stakeholders from the Technical Accounting team side.
• Lead and mentor the Technical Accounting team and support them in the transformation journey. 

About you
• Very good US GAAP and IFRS knowledge. It would be beneficial, if you have a professional finance qualification such as the ACA, ACCA, CPA, or equivalent.
• You have prior experience (5+ years) as a Technical Accounting Lead, Senior Technical Accountant, Senior Accounting Adviser or Senior Audit Manager. You have managed accounting projects and demonstrated resilience to break through and overcome challenges.
• You have prior experience in the SOX controls framework and have improved accounting processes in light of the SOX requirements.
• You drive process improvements to enhance financial operations and reporting efficiency.
• You are able to work in a fast-paced environment, staying organized and ensuring execution of complex initiatives, driving impact at scale.
• You have excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
• You have robust communication skills and strong stakeholder management.
• You are an inclusive people leader, who develops talent and builds diverse teams.
• You are happy to travel on a quarterly basis internationally to other Wise offices (e.g. Tallinn) or for team offsites.

Nice to have
• Experience with capital markets transactions (IPO, debt/equity offerings, prospectuses/circulars)
• Financial services/fintech industry exposure

jobs.title: FinCrime Operations Team Lead - PEP
jobs.description:
Role & Job purpose

As a FinCrime Operations Team Lead you will develop and oversee the daily operations of a team of FinCrime Operations Analysts or Specialists. Your primary purpose is to ensure the effective mitigation of financial crime risks associated with Wise's customers, while maintaining a strong focus on operational efficiency, regulatory compliance and a customer-centric approach. You will foster a high-performing team, drive operational excellence, and act as a subject matter expert in KYC/AML/Fraud/Screening and financial crime prevention. You will be responsible for ensuring your team meets performance targets, maintains or elevates quality standards, and contributes to a culture of continuous improvement within the FinCrime Operations organization.

The FinCrime Operations Team Lead is a dual-focused leader, combining strong people leadership with domain and operational expertise. You will be instrumental in building and refining processes that prioritise customer impact while maintaining focus on the evolving risks within the financial services industry, specific product vulnerabilities, and the requirements set by regulations and partners. This includes supporting the development of compliant and scalable processes and possessing an understanding of financial crime risks associated with our customers, products, and tooling.

Job Responsibilities
• Team Leadership

You will lead by example, driving a customer-focused mindset across your team and the wider fincrime organization. You are instrumental in fostering a high-performance, results-driven culture defined by strong ownership and accountability. This involves building and nurturing high-performing teams that value knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and adaptability in our change-oriented environment. Fincrime Operations Team Lead demonstrates strong capabilities in timely conflict resolution and fosters open communication and guides effective mediation to ensure a positive working environment. You should be visible and actively engaged in team management. Your focus is on unifying the team behind shared goals (and wider FinCrime/servicing strategies) and driving collective actions.
• People management

Coach and develop a strong team of FinCrime Operations Analysts or Specialists with varying levels of experience, providing tailored guidance, and taking swift, decisive action to manage performance issues effectively, ensuring sustained excellence and growth. Provide regular, constructive, and actionable feedback to your direct reports. Coach and mentor team members to support their growth, develop their skills, and help them reach their full potential. Design and manage performance or development plans in identified areas. Conduct career map check-ins and make recommendations for demotions, promotions, salary raises, and other role related decisions.
• Operational management

You will oversee the daily operations of the team, ensuring adherence to relevant regulations and internal policies and processes. Identify and propose opportunities for process and tooling improvements. Collaborate with central functions and other operational teams as needed to increase operational efficiency or to ensure effective cross-team collaboration on joint initiatives. Provide guidance and support on complex, high-risk cases and escalations. Be on top of timely admin related tasks including but not limited to scheduling, training, hiring, interviewing, organising team activities, and others.
• Performance management

Measure team and individual KPIs and ensure performance targets and quality standards are consistently met while maintaining focus on customer experience and adherence to internal guidelines. Drive high-quality results for both the team and individuals, continuously enhancing overall quality outcomes. Conduct timely quality reviews, ensuring high decision accuracy and effectively communicate the importance of quality assurance. Conduct regular and impactful one on one coaching sessions (usually on a weekly or biweekly basis), provide clear and actionable feedback. Ensure tasks are managed timely and aligned with the team’s goals. Run team meetings to ensure that your team is kept up to date with the latest information, share best practices and enhance overall team spirit. Addresses underperformance promptly through coaching and setting SMART goals, and ensures all interventions are well-documented. Understand and be able to articulate how to move key metrics at team and individual level through efficient performance and task management.
• Expertise sharing

Be a subject matter expert in financial crime areas with the ability to obtain and maintain sufficient subject matter expertise required to train, develop and coach your team. Maintain a comprehensive understanding of our regulatory obligations, internal policies, domain-specific processes and best practices. Apply a risk-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Perform and support deep dives, understand root causes of problematic cases and propose solutions to senior leadership. Assist senior leadership with reviews and developing our processes, task management and in other operational areas as requested to ensure compliant and effective servicing function
• Issue Management and Escalation 

Escalate tooling or processing incidents, high-risk customer issues, control weaknesses, or other material problems to direct leadership in a timely and informative manner, following established protocols.
• Planning and execution

Be accountable for driving your direct team's performance outcomes, ensuring key performance indicators (KPIs) are consistently met and enhanced. Possess strong knowledge of team processes and tooling, leveraging data to support initiative execution. This involves taking full ownership of your team's results, setting targets for improvement, and providing insights to stakeholders. Set and progress towards goals, adeptly identifying and resolving blockers or issues, whether performance or metric-related, to optimize output and results.
• Stakeholder management and communication

Collaborate closely with stakeholders ensuring clear communication and coordination of actions. Your initiatives and reports are well documented and you choose the right platforms to communicate to a wider audience in a timely manner. The documentation has a clear scope and includes potential impact in different areas. You can communicate confidently with difficult stakeholders on varied operational or domain related topics. Proactively work on improving cross-team communication and collaboration, acting as the liaison between different layers of the organization and your own team. Employ impactful and inspiring communication skills, unifying individuals behind shared goals, and leverage strong presentation skills to convey vision and progress.
• Other: Perform additional tasks as assigned by your lead, demonstrating adaptability and a proactive approach. This includes actively participating in meetings, trainings, workshops, and internal events to support broader team and company objectives.

jobs.title: FinCrime Operations Team Lead - AML Investigations
jobs.description:
Job Description

We’re looking for a FinCrime Operations Team Lead - AML Investigations to join our team in Hyderabad. This role is a unique opportunity to have an impact on Wise’s mission by helping identify suspicious activity and through that keep Wise compliant. You personally can help us get closer to our mission of Money Without Borders! You will help us build a team in Hyderabad and get to join a larger team distributed in 5 different offices around the world.

The AML Investigation Team Lead is a people lead with a mindset that allows them to lead and support team members and build effective operational processes. Our investigators' daily task is to analyse payment patterns and identify suspicious activity. Lead's responsibility is to make sure investigators have all the right tools to do that and we are doing it the most efficient way.

 

Duties and

responsibilities:
• Have a strong ownership either over operational management and people leading or specific function within AML investigations domain
• Develop effective operational processes, task allocation, training and performance management to deliver regulatory obligations, risk management, quality assurance and great customer experience with a tightly managed cost base
• Developing and maintaining documentation of processes and projects within their area
• Measure and work towards improving team KPIs and meeting SLA-s
• Build, lead and develop AML operational team with a strong sense of community
• Work with other leads, product team and compliance teams to manage operational impact of changes and identify opportunities to improve the customer experience, increase automation or improve operational efficiencies

jobs.title: FinCrime Operations Senior Lead - AML Investigations
jobs.description:
As a Financial Crime Operations Senior Lead, you will be responsible for developing and managing a team of Financial Crime Operations Team Leads and Specialists for specific SME areas. Your key objective is to ensure the effective assessment and mitigation of risks related to high-risk customers, while strictly adhering to AML/CFT regulations and aligning with Wise’s risk appetite and internal policies. The specialists on your team will possess an in-depth understanding of the unique risks associated with complex business structures, varied customer types and activities, and country-specific challenges, as well as the strategies required to mitigate these risks effectively.

In this leadership role, you will act as a vital connector between your operational team, which includes team leads and specialists, and Wise's senior leadership. This involves clearly communicating the overarching strategic objectives to your team and transforming these goals into actionable and pertinent directives that drive process optimization and performance improvement.

You'll be instrumental in aligning Wise’s overall mission and strategy with performance expectations, ensuring that your team’s efforts are efficiently strategized and executed for optimal success. This includes developing and owning a strategic roadmap spanning several quarters your team, enhancing processes, and cultivating a positive and empowering work environment. You will support your team’s growth and independence through comprehensive training, mentoring, coaching, delegation, and recognition.

As an experienced operations manager, you will design and implement customer-focused processes while maintaining a vigilant awareness of the risks inherent in the financial industry, specific product offerings, and regulatory requirements. Your approach will ensure that Wise's operations continually meet the expectations of our partners and regulatory bodies.

Your mission:
• Leadership and people development: Drive team performance and cultural excellence to support sustainable business growth. Lead by example, demonstrating values and work ethic that inspire accountability, proactive problem-solving, and a growth mindset. Manage and develop a high-performing team by role modeling success behaviors. Focus on cultivating a high-performance culture through talent development, career check-ins, and recommendations for growth. Build strong teams by hiring, coaching, and fostering skills and competencies. Promote continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and inclusion to empower your team to innovate and excel.
• Performance management: Foster a culture of excellence in your team by consistently meeting KPIs and SLAs in our metrics-driven environment. Refresh performance expectations to match business needs and address underperformance with clear action plans. Implement strong performance frameworks, provide actionable feedback, and ensure every team member operates efficiently.
• Operational management: In this role, you'll turn high-level plans into actionable changes and lead your team to success. You'll create phased implementation plans to minimize disruption and set clear metrics to track progress. Focus on optimizing team structure by managing recruitment and strategically placing staff. Continuously identify and address redundancies and inefficiencies. You'll develop scalable, compliant processes and collaborate with product and operational teams to enhance customer experience, boost automation, and meet financial and service goals. Strong data literacy is essential for analyzing complex data and making informed decisions. Governance is crucial; you'll escalate issues promptly, provide clear updates to senior leadership, and contribute to a customer-focused culture that balances regulatory objectives with excellent customer service.
• Quality assurance: Ensure the highest quality standards for your group's tasks by making decisions within established frameworks. Lead root cause analysis, turn insights into improvements, and mitigate risks. Ensure quality standards are integrated into processes, tools, and initiatives. Understand impacts, focus on findings, and propose actions for better outcomes. Collaborate with other functions, offering expertise to enhance processes and elevate quality across the team and organization
• Domain knowledge and expertise: Be a subject matter expert in Financial Crime areas with the ability to train and coach your team. Maintain a comprehensive understanding of our regulatory obligations and internal policies. Apply a risk-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Be able to represent the operational team processes and policies when working with internal auditing and testing parties. Retain an understanding of the wider Financial Crime and regulatory landscape and take on best practices to your team. Own operational incident management: from initial detection to response and remediation. Liaise effectively with functions and stakeholders, ensuring clear and timely communication throughout. Be responsible for developing action plans, driving remediation efforts, and providing context and subject matter expertise during and after incidents. The Senior Lead supports product-related incident management, ensuring a response to all critical events.
• Project management: Effectively Lead projects from start to finish, prioritizing tasks and maintaining documentation. Communicate milestones, address blockers, and delegate tasks while monitoring progress. Articulate project impact and value, and engage with stakeholders from technical teams to senior management. Negotiate and influence cross-functional teams to drive momentum and align with strategic goals.
• Planning and execution: Ensure operational area plans are set in place and provide insights to other stakeholders. Take full accountability in delivering, updating and making sure your area is making progress on their goals by measuring the effectiveness of the output of the team. There is a clear strategy within your domain that is connected with the wider organisational key objectives, including impactful OKRs and goals based on these plans, and being able to confidently present plans to varied audiences.
• Stakeholder management and communication: Lead complex projects with multiple stakeholders, setting priorities and ensuring timely delivery. Partner with Product to support group objectives and advocate for customer success. Manage diverse relationships, anticipate issues, and share key insights. Engage stakeholders promptly and lead discussions effectively. Communicate clearly and tailor messages to the audience, using data to deliver impactful and concise messages. Adapt to diverse stakeholders with confidence, ensuring professional and effective interactions.

jobs.title: Senior Design Researcher - Account Sharing
jobs.description:
Your mission is to build the world’s best, truly cross-border shared accounts, for every kind of relationship – families, friends, children, partners, intergenerational care givers and receivers. You'll join a thriving research community of 30+ researchers in London and work embedded in the Shared Accounts team.

As a Senior Researcher, you'll be owning your expertise. You'll contribute by:
• Leading complex research - work on large projects that are often complex and ambiguous, helping teams make better decisions by framing problems, identifying opportunities, and translating evidence into action.
• Problem-solving excellence - proactively demonstrate exceptional problem-solving skills and holistic research thinking
• Taking ownership - regularly lead work and take responsibility for research decisions
• Collaborating - routinely work with other researchers and disciplines, often leading workshops and crits
• Planning strategically - able to explain how work streams should be planned, coordinated and sequenced
• Defining success - ensure key milestones and metrics are in place to measure and assess impact
• Storytelling and advocacy - strong cross-functional collaborator and accomplished storyteller; effective advocate of a research-led approach
• Using modern tools thoughtfully - leverage AI and emerging tools where they help accelerate research delivery, while maintaining research rigour

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Own complex work - lead large, ambiguous research projects with significant autonomy and impact
• Shape direction - influence how your team prioritises and sequences work to achieve squad goals
• Develop your expertise - continue growing as a research expert while expanding your strategic and leadership capabilities
• Be part of our mission to make money without borders the new normal

A bit about you…
• You must have experience doing research with children, young people and families, so that you can develop operational frameworks that are suitable for working with vulnerable groups including multi generational family units.
• You have deep experience with both generative and evaluative research; exceptional problem-solving skills and holistic research thinking
• You know how to choose the right research approach for different ambiguity levels, build decision confidence through well-designed studies, and connect user evidence to business outcomes
• You're comfortable working embedded in cross-functional product teams; able to work autonomously and collaboratively with PM, data, design and engineering
• You're able to guide teams on actioning insights and work closely with designers to ideate based on findings
• You have strong presentation and storytelling skills, especially when sharing impactful insights
• You're comfortable using modern research tools and thoughtfully applying AI where it can accelerate delivery without compromising quality

You're also…
• capable of prioritising and sequencing activities, addressing uncertainties and defining success
• self-directed; you can spot opportunities and take appropriate steps to action them with minimal guidance

And as a heads up, this role probably isn't for you if:
• Your experience is primarily market research and/or academia
• You don't have demonstrable experience leading UX research within the tech/product industry
• You're not comfortable working with significant autonomy on complex, ambiguous projects
• You don't have experience doing research with children, young people and families

jobs.title: Engineering Lead - Embedded Solutions
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an Engineering Lead to join the embedded finance team. Our mission is to build the world's best embedded finance platform for our partners. You’ll be working closely with multiple functions within our vertical from solutions engineering and business development to understand the pain points of some of the largest enterprises in the world. Together you’ll help partners such as Google, Deel, Ramp and Agoda, leverage Wise’s infrastructure to offer their customers world class embedded finance products through their own channels. This will help us transform the international payments experience for even more customers and have a significant impact on Wise’s mission.

This is a hands-on engineering lead role that will support the engineers in their growth and driving technical decisions in building reliable, scalable products. You will be working closely with a product manager in developing a long term vision and roadmap for the team and their domain. 

What will you be working on?
• This is a hands-on role so you will be designing, developing, and maintaining the team’s services.
• Mentoring and supporting a small team of engineers in their growth and development.
• Support the team in technical decisions to make sure we build a high quality product that is reliable and scalable.
• Working closely with a Product Manager to own and drive the team’s direction and product plans.
• Collaborate with teams across Wise to deliver real impact and expand the functionality we can offer to our partners on our platform.
• Ownership of the team’s services and product. Pushing best practices and high quality products.

jobs.title: Senior Finance Business Partner (12 Months FTC)
jobs.description:
As a financial technology company moving billions of GBP of customer money in over 70 countries, Wise must have bulletproof financials. We need timely, accurate, and scalable financial data to be compliant with regulations and make strategic business decisions to support our hyper-growth and financial objectives.

We’re on the hunt for a highly strategic Finance Business Partner to join our FP&A team in London. You’ll be part of the team that helps pilot the rocket ship.

Your mission:
• You will be a strategic partner to senior stakeholders across the business, helping them form long-term plans, and proactively identify insights to support decision making.
• You will be driving our planning process and improving our ability to forecast headcount and operating costs, enabling the business to continue growing sustainably and lowering prices for customers
• You will build frameworks (models and reports) to analyse Wise’s cost base, identify risks and opportunities and derive actionable insights
• You’ll provide deep dives on key business and financial metrics and focus on actuals to forecast variance comparison to drive accuracy, optimal decision making and develop strategy
• You’ll use this deep knowledge to help build a narrative on our results and manage communications and reporting to various stakeholders including Department leads and our leadership team

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Play a crucial role – in using data to help manage Wise’s financial growth sustainably and shape financial strategy to optimise growth investment and cost management
• Partner with Department leads - to help them understand their performance, cost base and assist them with decision making
• Own your own path to success – you’ll have a high level of autonomy and responsibility.
• Learn and grow – there’s a lot to be done!

jobs.title: People Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Onboarding support

jobs.title: Product Team Assistant
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Team Assistant to support our Product Team. This role will be based out of our Budapest office and is a unique opportunity to enhance the productivity of our leadership by managing complex logistics and key communications. You will ensure our leaders are prepared, organised, and focused on our mission to save billions for customers globally.

Your ability to anticipate needs and streamline administrative processes will be pivotal to your success in this role.

This is a unique opportunity to work in a fast-paced, global environment, supporting teams in a company that is changing the way money moves around the world.

As a member of the BOSS (Business Operations and Support Services) team, you’re a culture leader and a tactical partner. You own the logistics that keep our leaders focused on our mission, ensuring they are always prepared, effective, and empowered to drive Wise forward.

Your Mission
• Calendar & Meeting Management: Independently manage complex diaries across multiple locations and time zones for two or more senior leaders. • Team Collaboration: Positively contribute to the BOSS Team by providing active support and cover for other members. You will participate in Mission Days, and squad days.
• Ad-hoc Support: You will provide ad-hoc administrative support as required for other members of the team.
• Culture Champion: Positively contribute to making Wise a great place to work.

jobs.title: Acquiring Risk Fraud Analyst
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an Acquiring Risk Fraud Analyst to join our team in the Tallinn office. This role is a unique opportunity to have an impact on Wise’s mission, grow as an analyst, help save millions more people money and work in a disruptive, fast-growing and fun environment.

Your mission: 

Wise has already pioneered new ways for people to transfer money across borders and currencies. Our customers can also manage their hard-earned money with the world’s first platform to offer true multi-currency banking and convenient business solutions.

We have an awesome operational team handling Acquiring chargebacks; a unified team that works very closely with our dedicated engineering and product teams.

As a Acquiring Risk Fraud Analyst, you get to support your team’s operational success and bring your expertise to upscale the domain; driving detection and prevention focused initiatives with long-lasting impacts will be part of your daily work. 

Here’s how you’ll be contributing to Acquiring Risk team: 

Acquiring Fraud Prevention and Risk Management:
• Protect our Wise merchants from fraud chargeback losses
• Protect Wise from first party merchant fraud
• Proactively analyse merchant dispute trends and identify gaps in the acquiring fraud prevention rulesets in the pre-authorisation and post-authorisation flows.
• Acquiring fraud rule creation and optimisation to mitigate the impact of acquiring fraud on the following:
• Dispute rates (scheme compliance & fees)
• Chargeback loss rates (product cost)
• Wise merchant experience (rule precision)
• Understand and implement machine learning scores within static fraud rules to improve rule precision and recall.
• Contributing to longer term projects targeted at acquiring fraud reduction.
• Working with Acquiring Product and Engineering teams on rule engine improvements, and optimising the acquiring fraud customer journey from rule declines to rule alerts and dispute processing.
• Serve as a point of escalation for all things acquiring fraud prevention related to customer facing Ops teams.

Effective communication and teamwork skills
• Able to explain or present your work and key ideas in appropriate terms within their team and to their immediate stakeholders

Incident Management

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - APAC Onboarding & KYC
jobs.description:
Wise is building the best way to move and manage money across borders. To make that possible, customers need to be able to join Wise quickly, safely, and confidently.

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our Onboarding & KYC team in Hyderabad. You’ll own high-impact product work across APAC, helping Wise build onboarding and verification experiences that are low-friction for customers and prevent financial crime.

This is a senior role for someone who can operate in ambiguity, get deep into customer, regulatory, data, and technical details, and turn complex problems into shipped product outcomes.

What you’ll be doing
• Own product strategy and roadmap for APAC onboarding, KYC and financial crime mitigation initiatives, from discovery through delivery, launch, measurement, and iteration.
• Build and scale digital identity verification and eKYC experiences across markets such as Japan, Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, Thailand, Malaysia, Hong Kong, and the Philippines.
• Partner with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Operations, Risk & Compliance to balance conversion, customer experience, operational cost, regulatory requirements and financial crime risk.
• Lead complex localisation work, including integrating local identity providers, registry checks, and APAC-specific controls into Wise’s global platform.
• Improve customer onboarding outcomes such as first product adoption, verification completion, time-to-verify, manual review rates, cost-to-serve, and quality of fincrime decisions.
• Mitigating risk of financial crime by ensuring our in-product control environment accounts for country-specific financial crime risks.
• Use data, customer insight, operational feedback, and regulatory context to prioritise what matters most.
• Help generalise APAC’s strongest onboarding and KYC capabilities so they can be reused by other Wise product teams.
• Staying close to the details: customer journeys, dashboards, service architecture, regulatory interpretations, edge cases, incidents, and operational workflows.

Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

Your mission

As a Business Intelligence Analyst at Bitpanda, you’ll foster data driven decision-making by helping product, engineering, operations, finance and so many more teams collect, analyse and understand key metrics that drive growth that impacts millions of end users globally.

What you’ll do
• Engage and collaborate with Finance, Product and Operations to identify reporting needs and potential improvements.
• Enable analysts across the whole organisation and streamline dashboard creation.
• Contribute to the ongoing design of our self service BI visualisation platform and core data model to support advanced analytics and business intelligence.
• Unify business intelligence, data engineering and business stakeholders to build out data sets and models relevant to their core businesses.
• Ensure high data quality of the core data layer with dbt models with SQL.

Who you are
• Experience with BI Tools (Metabase, Tableau or similar), SQL, Git, dbt and Python is a plus.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to work, learn and grow across teams and functions.
• Solid experience with data-modelling (dimensional modelling, OBT or star/snowflake schemas), data quality frameworks and data visualisation tools.
• Minimum 3 years of professional business intelligence experience or analytics engineering or data analyst with a passion for Crypto and FinTech.
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, business informatics, applied mathematics and statistics or similar is preferred and Master’s degree is a nice to have.

What’s in it for you
• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.

jobs.title: Manager, Payment Operations
jobs.location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Operations at Brex

Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.

What you’ll do

Account Servicing owns what happens to a Brex account after it's live: money applied against statement balances, billing terms changed, auto-pay kept working, points debited and granted, credit performance reported to the bureaus, and accounts closed cleanly. 

We're hiring a manager to run that portfolio. You'll inherit a team with deep subject-matter expertise in specific queues, a set of in-flight migrations from other teams, and a real automation opportunity across the highest-volume work. The mandate is to hold the SLA and accuracy bar while systematically shrinking the manual surface area in a quickly growing environment.
• Payment application and wires. Wires applied against statement balances, including unmatched, partial, and misapplied payments. Support the expansion of wire coverage as we open up new corridors and use cases.
• Statement adjustments. Refunds and offline collections (manual balance adjustments), with the controls that keep adjustment accuracy high and every entry defensible in an audit.
• Billing changes. Due date changes, billing frequency changes, payment extensions, and grace period requests in close partnership with GTM, Credit, and Deal Desk teams.
• Auto-pay management. Manual pay exceptions, penny-pull (micro-deposit) verifications, and funding source changes.
• Vendor onboarding. Getting Brex set up correctly as a payee inside customers' third-party AP and procurement portals so invoices route, approve, and pay on time.
• Credit reporting. The monthly bureau submissions, plus end-to-end disputes management at the accuracy and timeliness standard regulation requires.
• Account closures. Customer-initiated, legal, and Terms-of-Service closures, including final balance settlement and rewards true-up. This is a newly transitioned part of the portfolio and will have operational process development needs from day 1.
• Points debits and rewards grants. Points debiting, merchant categorization changes, audits and true-ups, and non-automated partner referral grants.
• Automation and migration. Partner with Product and Engineering to cut average handle time and retire manual queues.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Salt Lake City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities:
• Coach, and develop a team of servicing specialists. Where a queue currently depends on one person's expertise, build redundancy so it doesn't.
• Set and defend SLAs, quality bars, and capacity models across workflows that behave very differently from one another.
• Define your own operational reporting cadences and measures to make staffing and prioritization decisions.
• Write and maintain the SOPs, QA sampling, and maker-checker controls that keep financial adjustments accurate and auditable.
• Be the escalation path for high-dollar, time-critical, and legally sensitive cases, working directly with Legal, Compliance, Collections, Treasury, Finance, Deal Desk, and CX.
• Own the automation roadmap for the team: find the candidates, quantify the case, spec the requirements, validate the before-and-after, and hold the line on the edge cases that automation tends to break on.

Requirements
• 5+ years in financial services or fintech operations, including 2+ years managing people directly; hiring, performance management, and development.
• Hands-on ownership of a servicing, billing, payment, or credit operations queue where errors move real money, plus the controls experience that comes with it: reconciliation, QA sampling, maker-checker review, audit trails.
• A track record of process improvement you can quantify. You've taken a manual, high-touch workflow and measurably reduced handle time, backlog, or error rate.
• Experience being the operational counterpart to Product and Engineering: writing requirements, aligning on priority, testing builds, and catching what the spec missed.
• Data fluency. You can pull, build, and defend your own numbers in SQL, spreadsheets, or BI tooling.
• Sound judgment under ambiguity and the discipline to escalate the right things. This team handles legal closures, bureau disputes, and balance adjustments where the wrong call has financial or regulatory consequences.
• Strong written communication. SOPs, escalation summaries, and cross-functional updates are a meaningful share of the work.
• A well-defined point of view on where AI can and should be applied in scaled operations

Bonus points
• Direct credit bureau furnisher

experience:

Metro 2 reporting, e-OSCAR, FCRA dispute handling, or data quality remediation.
• Commercial card, charge card, or business lending servicing background, as distinct from consumer.
• Working knowledge of wire and ACH (push and pull) mechanics, exception handling, return codes, micro-deposit verification, misapplied payment research.
• Rewards or loyalty operations experience, especially points liability, audits, true-ups, and clawbacks.
• Experience configuring a company as a vendor or payee in AP and procurement platforms (bill.com, Tipalti, Coupa, etc.).
• Experience absorbing workflows from another team without an SLA dip.
• Familiarity with support and ops tooling (Salesforce, Retool) and low-code workflow automation (Retool, Zapier, Backoffice

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $105,600 - $132,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

 

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

Operations at Brex

Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.

What you’ll do

Account Servicing owns what happens to a Brex account after it's live: money applied against statement balances, billing terms changed, auto-pay kept working, points debited and granted, credit performance reported to the bureaus, and accounts closed cleanly. 

We're hiring a manager to run that portfolio. You'll inherit a team with deep subject-matter expertise in specific queues, a set of in-flight migrations from other teams, and a real automation opportunity across the highest-volume work. The mandate is to hold the SLA and accuracy bar while systematically shrinking the manual surface area in a quickly growing environment.
• Payment application and wires. Wires applied against statement balances, including unmatched, partial, and misapplied payments. Support the expansion of wire coverage as we open up new corridors and use cases.
• Statement adjustments. Refunds and offline collections (manual balance adjustments), with the controls that keep adjustment accuracy high and every entry defensible in an audit.
• Billing changes. Due date changes, billing frequency changes, payment extensions, and grace period requests in close partnership with GTM, Credit, and Deal Desk teams.
• Auto-pay management. Manual pay exceptions, penny-pull (micro-deposit) verifications, and funding source changes.
• Vendor onboarding. Getting Brex set up correctly as a payee inside customers' third-party AP and procurement portals so invoices route, approve, and pay on time.
• Credit reporting. The monthly bureau submissions, plus end-to-end disputes management at the accuracy and timeliness standard regulation requires.
• Account closures. Customer-initiated, legal, and Terms-of-Service closures, including final balance settlement and rewards true-up. This is a newly transitioned part of the portfolio and will have operational process development needs from day 1.
• Points debits and rewards grants. Points debiting, merchant categorization changes, audits and true-ups, and non-automated partner referral grants.
• Automation and migration. Partner with Product and Engineering to cut average handle time and retire manual queues.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our New York City office. • Coach, and develop a team of servicing specialists. Where a queue currently depends on one person's expertise, build redundancy so it doesn't.
• Set and defend SLAs, quality bars, and capacity models across workflows that behave very differently from one another.
• Define your own operational reporting cadences and measures to make staffing and prioritization decisions.
• Write and maintain the SOPs, QA sampling, and maker-checker controls that keep financial adjustments accurate and auditable.
• Be the escalation path for high-dollar, time-critical, and legally sensitive cases, working directly with Legal, Compliance, Collections, Treasury, Finance, Deal Desk, and CX.
• Own the automation roadmap for the team: find the candidates, quantify the case, spec the requirements, validate the before-and-after, and hold the line on the edge cases that automation tends to break on.

• 5+ years in financial services or fintech operations, including 2+ years managing people directly; hiring, performance management, and development.
• Hands-on ownership of a servicing, billing, payment, or credit operations queue where errors move real money, plus the controls experience that comes with it: reconciliation, QA sampling, maker-checker review, audit trails.

What you'll do

You'll lead the Product Operations team and own the operational readiness for Brex's product launches: the enablement that must be in place before a customer ever touches a new feature. You'll also own Brex's product knowledge, the Help Center, and our internal knowledge base, plus the measurement that tells us whether it lands.

This is a role for someone who combines product manager, data, and operations skills and behaviors. You'll inherit a team that has already automated a large share of its own workflow, with a suite of production agents running much of the recurring work. Your job is not only to keep that running, but to push it further: expand what AI carries and reinvest the capacity it frees into the judgment work only people can do. We want to raise our evidence bar by using key metrics to hold ourselves accountable, focus on where the impact is greatest, and celebrate our wins. We treat AI as leverage, not as a deliverable, and we measure it by how it improves our efficiency and the quality of our deliverables.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our São Paulo office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities:

Launch readiness and enablement
• Own launch readiness, ensuring documentation, release notes, training, and tooling are ready for each release. Adapt processes and team capacity as EPD’s release cadence evolves.
• Lead and improve OLAB, the weekly cross-functional board that assesses launch impact and aligns teams on readiness.
• Engage early in launches, using customer and product insights to shape the product experience.
• Lead customer-facing escalations and crisis response, establishing a single source of truth, coordinating communications, and running retrospectives.

Documentation and product knowledge
• Own the lifecycle and quality of product documentation, keeping Help Center articles, internal knowledge, service descriptions, and implementation guides accurate, current, and clear.
• Partner with leadership and Engineering to structure and maintain product knowledge for people and AI systems.
• Turn AI support agent failure patterns into documentation improvements, with human validation of every AI-suggested change.

Data and automation
• Define actionable metrics for self-service, chatbot containment, knowledge adoption, and queue health, with clear thresholds, owners, and responses.
• Expand team automation and set standards for effective AI use, including where human judgment remains essential.

Team and cross-functional leadership
• Lead and develop a team of four product-domain owners, setting clear expectations and managing performance and career growth.
• Partner across product and customer-facing teams to deliver accurate, timely enablement, balancing readiness with delivery speed and making practical trade-offs.
• Communicate performance and strategy to CX leadership and executives, translating data into clear insights that drive decisions.

Requirements
• 4+ years in Product Operations, Product Management, Program Management, or a related function, ideally in fast-paced tech or fintech.
• Experience partnering with Product and Engineering through full launch cycles, with confidence navigating scope, sequencing, and trade-offs.
• Experience leading projects, mentoring teammates, or developing others. First-time managers are welcome.
• Proven ability to scale cross-functional processes and influence partner teams without formal authority.
• Experience owning documentation or knowledge at scale, maintaining quality as products evolve.
• Strong analytical skills, including defining metrics, building useful dashboards, and using data to prioritize.
• Hands-on experience integrating AI agents and automation into workflows, with measurable improvements in efficiency or outcomes.
• Clear, precise communication across technical and non-technical audiences, including presenting data to leadership.
• Sound prioritization under competing demands and adaptability as processes and business needs change.

Bonus points
• Background in fintech, financial services, or enterprise SaaS.
• Experience as a Product Manager.
• 1+ years managing or developing a team of 3+ individual contributors.
• Familiarity with structuring and maintaining product knowledge for AI systems at scale.
• Experience with self-service and containment metrics.
• Proficiency with tools such as Linear, Guru, Sanity, and Hex.
• Experience running cross-functional governance forums or advisory boards.
• A track record of turning operational insights into product roadmap changes.

Marketing tells the story of Brex to the world. From acquisition to activation, we translate product value into business results. What you'll do

Brex is looking for a strategic, data-driven Senior Field Marketing Manager to build and lead the field marketing motion for our Commercial segment.

Commercial represents one of Brex's largest growth opportunities. This role will be responsible for developing the segment strategy, identifying the markets and audiences with the greatest potential, and creating integrated programs that generate new pipeline and accelerate existing opportunities.

You will operate as the marketing lead for the Commercial business, partnering closely with Sales to understand their goals, test new approaches, and build repeatable programs that can scale. Your campaigns may include executive and customer events, industry programs, direct mail, digital experiences, partner activations, webinars, account-based plays, and other creative approaches.

The ideal candidate combines strong commercial judgment with hands-on execution. You are comfortable analyzing pipeline and campaign performance, presenting to Sales leadership, and managing multiple campaigns and stakeholders.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Own the field marketing strategy, annual plan, budget, and pipeline goals for the Commercial segment
• Partner with Commercial Sales leadership and set the planning rhythm across Marketing, Sales, and SDR
• Analyze account, pipeline, industry, geographic, and performance data to identify the highest-potential audiences
• Build integrated campaigns that combine in-person, digital, partner, content, direct mail, and account-based tactics
• Shape event strategy, from regional programs to targeted dinners. For larger experiences, partner with the Events team while owning the audience, objective, Sales plan, and pipeline outcome
• Test new campaign ideas, define success upfront, and turn what works into repeatable plays and documented playbooks
• Track results (pipeline, conversion, ROI) and present them to senior Marketing and Sales leaders

Requirements
• 7+ years of experience in B2B field marketing, demand gen, account-based marketing, or a related role, ideally in SaaS, fintech, or another high-growth technology company
• Experience owning marketing strategy for a defined customer segment, region, industry, or sales organization
• A track record of sourcing and accelerating pipeline through integrated programs
• A strong understanding of the B2B sales cycle and the ability to translate Sales priorities into focused marketing strategies
• Fluency in marketing and pipeline metrics, including the ability to analyze campaign performance, diagnose gaps, and clearly explain results
• Strong project management and executive communication skills, with comfort juggling multiple programs in a fast-paced environment
• Willingness to travel up to 40% for events, Sales meetings, and customer programs

Bonus points
• Experience building a field marketing motion or entering an underdeveloped segment
• Experience marketing to companies in the Commercial or emerging mid-market segment
• Familiarity with finance, fintech, spend, payments, ERP, or procurement audiences
• Experience using Salesforce and marketing analytics platforms to assess funnel performance and campaign impact
• Experience developing a business case for additional investment or team growth based on demonstrated results

Design at Brex creates the experiences that make complex systems feel effortless through thoughtful, scalable design. Whether crafting interfaces, shaping product strategy, or harnessing AI to empower our users, we obsess over quality and clarity. This is a team where creativity meets high craft, and where designers grow by building for ambitious customers.

What you’ll do

You’ll join the AI team, designing the agentic experiences at the heart of Brex’s intelligent finance platform. We’re building AI that doesn’t just answer questions, but does real financial work on our customers’ behalf. You will work with Product and Engineering teams to successfully communicate, evolve, and execute a strong product design standard that showcases Brex as a leader in financial innovation. You are a crucial component of our company’s growth and product launches through your contributions to short and long-term strategic direction, creating and maintaining high visual standards and a strong focus on user needs. You have an owner’s mentality, taking pride in your work and in your team’s work, and view what you do as a part-owner and builder of Brex.

This role will be based in our San Francisco or New York office. • You treat AI as a collaborator. You delegate real work to agents and can show how they’ve changed the way you design.

• You stay close to the models. You use frontier models daily, build intuition for what they can and can’t do, and design for where capabilities are heading.
• You question pre-AI interface primitives and invent patterns native to agentic products, rather than retrofitting chat onto existing flows.

jobs.description:
About the role

We are hiring a Business Control Manager to join Chime’s Compliance Business Control Management team, with a primary focus on control delivery for Growth Marketing and Chime Enterprise. You will partner with business and control owners to translate agreed risk outcomes into practical controls that provide the right level of risk mitigation while working effectively for the business. You will also help bring Chime’s broader enterprise control environment to light by identifying, validating, and documenting controls that are already operating across the business. Along the way, you’ll have opportunities to contribute to larger Compliance BCM and business efforts based on priorities and capacity.

In this role, you can expect to
• Partner with Growth Marketing and Chime Enterprise business and control owners to translate agreed risk and control outcomes into practical implementation plans, while supporting additional Compliance BCM portfolios based on priorities and capacity.
• Contribute to reviews of business requirements, projects, process or product changes, incidents, complaints, and regulatory developments by identifying relevant controls, operating practices, gaps, dependencies, and implementation considerations.
• Drive assigned control workstreams through implementation, validation, documentation, and closure, coordinating milestones, dependencies, evidence, and routine decisions with business and control owners.
• Evaluate Chime’s existing control environment by reviewing business activities, procedures, system capabilities, evidence, and current control records to identify controls already operating and potential coverage gaps.
• Assess whether existing controls provide appropriate coverage and recommend whether controls should be reused, enhanced, created, consolidated, or retired.
• Evaluate implementation readiness, coordinate control owner attestations, validate assigned controls against team standards, and maintain complete and current control records.
• Track gaps, exceptions, remediation commitments, and dependencies through closure, escalating material design, ownership, exposure, or delivery concerns and supporting remediation arising from incidents, testing, audits, or other findings.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 4 or more years of experience in business controls, regulatory compliance, operational risk, audit, operations, or a related discipline within financial services, fintech, or another highly regulated environment.
• Hands-on experience taking a control or process improvement from a defined problem or requirement through implementation, evidence review, documentation, and closure.
• Strong analytical skills and experience evaluating business processes, requirements, incidents, and control records to understand what is operating, identify gaps, and determine where clarification or additional risk mitigation is needed.
• Strong execution and project-management skills, including managing multiple workstreams, dependencies, decisions, and stakeholders while adapting to changing complexity, urgency, and team priorities.
• Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to partner effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, challenge incomplete evidence or unclear ownership, and escalate material concerns with sound judgment.
• Experience working in consumer financial services or another regulated environment, with working knowledge of regulatory and consumer protection risk frameworks such as EFTA and Regulation E, TILA and Regulation Z, UDAAP, or comparable requirements.

jobs.location: Chicago, IL, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA
jobs.description:
About this role

At Chime, we help our members achieve financial peace of mind. To do this we need features that are highly available and human technical systems that are resilient. That’s where you come in. You will be a member of our Incident Response team to help Chime improve our readiness, response and drive organizational change from incidents.

As an Incident Operations Manager on Chime's Incident Operations team (Platform Engineering), you'll manage incidents end to end: from declaration and coordination, through member communication and member remediation, to review and follow-through. You'll work across Engineering, Product, Member Experience (MX), Core Experience, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Finance, and lead through influence rather than authority. You'll bring a proactive, solution-oriented mindset and keep the member at the center of every decision. Alongside on-call work, you'll own defined improvement workstreams that make our response better every quarter.

In this role, you can expect to:
• Coordinate incidents end to end. Serve on the incident on-call rotation, including some after-hours coverage on weekends, nights, and holidays. Independently run incidents from declaration to resolution: setting severity, paging the right responders, running the bridge, confirming member impact, and driving mitigation decisions.
• Help drive communication during incidents. Draft clear, accurate member messages across in-app, push, inbox, email, and support channels; move them through Compliance and Legal approval within severity-based timelines; and keep Support and MX teams equipped with talking points.
• Drive member remediation to closure. Run the Remediating phase: define workstreams, DRIs, and exit criteria; partner with Data to size the impacted population; coordinate credits and bulk adjustments with Finance, Compliance, and Core Experience
• Keep stakeholders informed. Deliver timely status reports and sitreps for leadership, and supply impact summaries and timelines that Compliance and Legal use for bank partner and regulatory notifications.
• Close the loop. Facilitate incident reviews for the incidents you manage, capture learnings, and make sure corrective actions have owners and due dates.
• Get ahead of problems. Spot risks and gaps before they become incidents or repeat incidents, raise them early, and come up with a proposed solution.
• Improve how we respond. Own at least one program workstream, such as pre-approved member message templates, runbooks, or response metrics, and ship measurable improvements.
• Cross-train and share knowledge. Build working fluency on both the technical-command and member-impact sides of an incident, and help train coordinators and responders.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 3+ years in incident management, or a similar operational role, including hands-on coordination of live, customer-impacting incidents.
• A strong member focus. You think first about how an incident affects real people and their money, and you measure success by whether members are informed and made whole, not just whether systems are restored.
• A proactive, solution-oriented approach. You act before being asked, look for the next risk instead of waiting for it, and bring options and recommendations.
• Experience managing the customer side of an incident: writing customer-facing communications, working with support teams, and coordinating remediation.
• Calm, structured judgment under pressure; you know when to decide, when to escalate, and when to ask for help.
• Enough technical fluency to follow engineers through an investigation and ask good questions (observability, deploys, dependencies, distributed systems).
• Experience with incident and observability tools such as PagerDuty, incident.io, Datadog, Slack-based incident tooling, Jira, and Google Workspace.
• Clear, concise writing for different audiences: members, technical SMEs, compliance partners, and executives.
• Strong follow-through; you drive action items and remediation work to closure without being chased.

Nice to have
• Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or another regulated industry.

jobs.title: Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About the role

We are seeking a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join our Growth Marketing team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for setting the strategy and executing on lifecycle campaigns across all Consensys products. You’ll look for opportunities to ensure we are bringing a level of personalization in our communication to our users such that every touch point is driving value for our customers and the business. 

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of taking projects from start to finish with deep experience leveraging customer data to inform their strategy. You’ve developed multiple lifecycle programs at scale, have conducted hundreds of A/B tests, and have even launched new lifecycle channels from the ground up. 

 

What You’ll Do:

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – Universal KYC (MetaMask Passport)
jobs.description:
Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About MetaMask

MetaMask is building a future where users can unlock the full product stack through a single, seamless identity experience, enabling access to all features with trust, safety, and minimal friction.

Today, identity verification is fragmented across several product and onboarding experiences. Users are repeatedly asked to verify themselves across different services, creating unnecessary friction, inconsistent outcomes, and degraded trust.

Universal KYC (UKYC) is a new initiative to solve this problem by creating a single, reusable identity layer across MetaMask. At the centre of this is MetaMask Passport, a product designed to enable users to verify once and unlock multiple experiences across the MetaMask ecosystem.

This role sits at the intersection of platform and product experience. You will define the primitives, standards, and user journeys that make identity verification seamless, privacy-conscious, and globally compliant.

What you’ll do

You will own the vision and roadmap for Universal KYC and MetaMask Passport, defining how a reusable identity layer unlocks the broader MetaMask product stack. You will build the underlying identity platform, creating scalable verification primitives and standards that can be adopted across products. In parallel, you will design a seamless, low-friction KYC experience that reduces time-to-first-transaction while maintaining compliance integrity. You will drive adoption across MetaMask by partnering closely with internal teams to integrate a consistent identity layer, while balancing privacy, trust, and global regulatory requirements. Throughout, you will lead execution end-to-end, aligning cross-functional teams and delivering measurable outcomes.

What we are looking for:
• Proven experience building or scaling identity verification (IDV), KYC, or onboarding products
• Strong background in fintech, ideally with exposure to Web3
• Hands-on experience working with identity verification providers (IDV vendors) such as Sumsub, Veriff, Onfido, Persona, or Stripe Identity
• Familiarity with compliance workflows, including KYC, KYB, and customer due diligence (CDD) processes
• Track record of delivering platform products adopted across multiple teams
• Ability to operate across both technical systems and user experience

What Success looks like:
• Increased KYC completion rates and reduced onboarding friction
• Reduced time-to-first-transaction across KYC-gated flows
• Increased reuse of verified identity across products
• Improved transaction success rate through consistent verification outcomes
• Strong user trust with minimal friction and compliant execution

Attributes that will make you stand out
• First-principles thinker with strong product judgment
• Deep user empathy with a focus on reducing friction and cognitive load
• Strong understanding of trust, privacy, and compliance trade-offs
• Clear, structured communicator who drives alignment and momentum
• High ownership and ability to operate in ambiguity

Why This Role Matters

Universal KYC is a foundational unlock for MetaMask, enabling users to move from fragmented, repetitive identity verification to a seamless, reusable experience across the entire product stack. It establishes a scalable, privacy-conscious identity layer that strengthens user trust while meeting global compliance requirements. This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of access, trust, and growth, critical to unlocking the next phase of MetaMask’s evolution.
