jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer II - Scalable Growth
jobs.description:
About the role

We’re looking for a seasoned, senior Data Engineer with a strong software engineering background to join our Scalable Growth team within the Global Product Tribe.

In this role, you’ll report directly to the Scalable Growth Engineering Lead while embedding day-to-day with the Marketing Platform team. You will serve as the technical authority on data architecture, bridging the gap between platform engineering and analytics engineering. You’ll bring maturity, resilience, and scalability to our data infrastructure—building and shaping systems that handle high-volume streaming and batch data to fuel our global marketing engine.

If you thrive in an environment where you can scope complex problem spaces, mentor engineers in data best practices, and directly impact how Wise attracts millions of customers globally, this is the role for you.

How we work

Scalable Growth is dedicated to building enabling technology that helps Wise acquire customers at the lowest possible cost.

Within this space, the Marketing Platform team owns the data pipelines, internal tools, and integrations with third-party vendors (e.g., Meta, Google) that power our acquisition channels. As our dedicated data lead, you’ll work cross-functionally with engineers, product managers, digital analytics leads, and marketing stakeholders (Paid, Organic, CRM) to transform our marketing data infrastructure into a true platform product.

What will you be working on?
• Drive Data Architecture & Resilience: Audit, map out, and elevate our current data pipelines and streaming architectures. Establish best practices for monitoring, reliability, and scale across our data ecosystem (using Python, dbt, Airflow, Kafka, and Trino/Iceberg).
• Build the Unified Customer View: Productionize PoCs into scalable Airflow/dbt data workflows to lay the groundwork for our Customer Data Platform (CDP) datasets.
• Bridge Engineering & Analytics: Partner with analytics leads to define clear boundaries and standards for data ingestion, cleansing, and transformation—bringing a strong analytics engineering mindset (specifically via dbt) to raw data landing.
• Own MarTech Infrastructure: Work alongside Engineering Leads to bring technology ownership of MarTech systems (e.g., Braze, HighTouch reverse ETL) in-house, building end-to-end solutions rather than isolated data plumbing.
• Technical Scoping & Discovery: Take ownership of broad, ambiguous problem spaces. Uncover hidden challenges, propose robust architectural designs, and execute your own roadmap.
• Coach & Mentor: Elevate the data capabilities of software engineers in the squad through code reviews, architectural guidance, and hands-on mentoring.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Payin Platform
jobs.description:
Recurring Payin team owns the Direct Debit API that powers automated payments into Wise. Underneath this, we are building a platform that allows customers to easily schedule top-ups or business collections.

The platform is also built on top of our internal Payin Platform rails; which is a critical component to the Wise money-movement machine and we’re looking for an engineer motivated to come and help us build for this.

We primarily offer APIs for any partner looking to set up automated funding or pre-authorizations. From setting up GBP balance top ups automatically to allowing business partners collect EUR bills monthly without having the customer go through the flow every time; our platform aims to consolidate all these use-cases.

We aim to allow customers to give a one time permission (pre-authorization) for Wise to pull money across any payment method, a USD bank account or a EUR issued bank card; you name it.

Job

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services written in any language deployed on cloud infrastructure (AWS)
• Build and maintain RESTful APIs that serve millions of customers across web and mobile platforms
• Develop and optimise services powering the card pay-in payment method — one of the most popular payment methods, enabling Wise customers to move around £1 billion every month
• Design and implement database schemas, write and optimise SQL queries against PostgreSQL databases handling high-volume transactional data
• Build and maintain event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka for asynchronous processing of financial events across distributed services
• Develop and maintain a payment orchestration system that dynamically routes payments across Payment Service Providers to optimize for cost and reliability
• Write automated tests (unit, integration, and end-to-end) to ensure correctness and reliability of financial systems
• Conduct code reviews for team members, ensuring code quality, security, and adherence to engineering standards
• Participate in on-call rotations to monitor and respond to production incidents for Tier 2 critical services
• Collaborate with product managers, designers, analysts, and engineers across other teams to deliver cross-functional projects
• Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, scalability issues, and technical debt in existing systems
• Ensure development follows security best practices, particularly around handling of sensitive financial data and compliance with financial regulations

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager - Finance Systems
jobs.description:
How you’ll contribute to our Mission
• Our Finance Implementation team ensures that anything happening in Wise that has a financial impact is integrated into our financial systems and is properly recorded and controlled. This requires working closely with our finance, product and engineering teams on understanding how things work in Wise and how they translate into compliant financials
• You’ll be responsible for understanding the whys and hows of the Wise and Finance integration and communicate across all finance stakeholders and financial concepts to engineers
• You will figure out a plan and work with a team of implementation managers, engineers, analysts and operations specialists to ensure all
• You will support the team with clear documentation including requirements, detailed project plans, resource allocation, testing, delivery etc.
• You will work with our internal finance teams, such as Accounting, Tax, Reporting and Financial Planning & Analysis to ensure clean, accurate and compliant financials in all our entities worldwide in a timely manner

This role will give you the opportunity to
• Choose your path to impact – we believe people are most empowered when they can act autonomously. So rather than telling you what to do, you’ll work with your team to create a vision of your own. Of course, you can always gather feedback from smart, curious people across Wise but you’ll have the freedom to make your own calls
• Get amazing exposure to the full breadth and depth of our internal product finance systems while working with a group of amazing and dedicated implementation managers, engineers, analysts, and operations.
• Work in a world-class international Finance Team, learn a lot about fintech and finance and drive financial sustainability of Wise, while also building a high-volume, real time financial implementation system
• Be part of our mission to make money without borders the new normal

jobs.title: QA Engineer I
jobs.description:
We Are:
YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions – YouTrip and YouBiz – empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum’s Global Innovator 2025, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn’s Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions.

Job Description:

QA Engineer

We are looking for a detail-oriented QA Engineer who is passionate about delivering high-quality software and great user experiences. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional teams to plan, execute, and document manual test cases across our mobile and web applications. While automation experience is not required, a willingness to learn and collaborate with our automation team is highly valued.

You Will
• Design, document, and execute manual test cases for:
• iOS and Android Mobile Applications
• Web applications
• Backend Services / APIs
• Validate new features against acceptance criteria and UX expectations
• Participate in sprint planning, grooming, and review sessions to assess test scope and quality risks
• Perform functional, regression, accessibility, and release validation testing
• Log and track defects; work closely with engineering teams for proper resolution
• Support UAT and partner/vendor integration testing
• Perform build verification and release readiness checks
• Provide clear test results, documentation, and feedback to stakeholders
• Contribute to improving QA processes and documentation
• (Optional) Assist automation team by helping identify automation candidates and preparing test scenarios
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
• At least 3 years experience in software QA focusing on manual testing
• Strong understanding of QA methodologies, SDLC, and release processes
• Experience writing and executing test plans and test cases
• Hands-on experience testing iOS/Android mobile applications, web applications and backend services / REST APIs
• Familiarity with bug & test management tools (Jira, TestRail, etc.)
• Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail
• Good communication and collaboration skills

Nice to Have
• Understanding of basic automation concepts (Appium, Selenium, Postman, etc.)
• Exposure to CI/CD, device testing platforms (e.g., BrowserStack)
• FinTech or payments domain experience

jobs.title: Partner Operations Program Manager, Associate
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Operations

Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.

What you’ll do

Payment Partner Operations owns the operational foundation for Brex’s external partner ecosystem. You’ll define how we launch, manage, measure, and improve partner programs, from operating models and SLAs to reporting, fee reconciliation, issue management, and performance reviews.

You’ll work closely with Payment Partnerships, Operations, Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and external partners to build scalable, well-controlled programs that deliver reliable outcomes for customers and the business.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Sao Paulo office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Define and own the operating model for partner management, including processes, decision rights, governance, documentation, and escalation paths.
• Establish partner SLAs, KPIs, reporting cadences, and performance-review mechanisms; hold internal and external stakeholders accountable to them.
• Build reporting that provides clear visibility into partner performance, operational health, volume, quality, incidents, risks, and opportunities.
• Own fee reconciliation and related controls, ensuring partner invoices, contractual terms, payment calculations, and internal records are accurate and resolved on time.
• Lead operational readiness for new partners, products, workflows, and program changes, including requirements, launch plans, testing, training, and post-launch monitoring.
• Manage partner incidents and escalations, coordinate root-cause analysis, and drive durable corrective actions.
• Identify process gaps and automation opportunities that improve partner experience, reduce manual work, and strengthen control quality.
• Partner with Finance, Legal, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and Partnerships to resolve complex issues and translate partner needs into scalable operational solutions.
• Create executive-ready updates that synthesize performance, risks, financial impacts, and recommended actions.

Requirements
• 3+ years of experience in partner operations, payments operations, financial operations, vendor management, or a related role in fintech, banking, or another regulated environment (ideally 1+ years of direct partner experience).
• English proficiency/fluency, both written and speaking (note: interviews will be conducted in English)
• Demonstrated experience building operating programs, not just managing established workflows.
• Strong experience defining SLAs, KPIs, and governance structures and using them to improve external-partner performance.
• Experience with fee, invoice, or financial reconciliation processes, including investigation and resolution of discrepancies.
• Strong analytical skills and comfort using spreadsheets, data tools, SQL, or similar tools to build reporting and identify trends.
• Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence senior internal and external partners.
• Sound judgment, strong attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, high-stakes situations.
• A builder mindset with a bias toward scalable processes, clear ownership, and AI-centric automation.
• All applications must be submitted in English

Bonus Points
• Experience in payment rails, banking partnerships, card networks, fintech infrastructure, or money movement.
• Experience managing third-party vendors or regulated financial-services partners.
• Experience with audit-ready controls, compliance requirements, and contractual-performance obligations.
• Experience applying AI or automation to reconciliation, reporting, quality assurance, or operational workflows.

 

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Marketing at Brex

Marketing tells the story of Brex to the world. From acquisition to activation, we translate product value into business results. Our team spans Revenue, Product, and Brand Marketing, and works closely with nearly every function at Brex. We move fast, experiment often, and think deeply about customer behavior. If you want your creativity to drive growth and shape perception, this is the place.

What you’ll do

The Brex Marketing team is looking for an experienced Senior Marketing Operations Manager to architect and optimize our B2B sales-led and channel-driven GTM engine. This role will define and maintain the systems, processes, and operational rigor that align Marketing, SDR, Sales, and Partner teams.

We are looking for someone who is eager to design the future-state GTM tech stack—modernizing how leads flow, how insights are generated, and how operational workloads become more efficient through automation, AI, and agentic workflows. This person will champion operational excellence by improving lead management, automating revenue processes, increasing funnel velocity, and enabling more efficient cross-functional alignment.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Own and evolve the GTM systems architecture, ensuring Salesforce, Marketo, LeanData, ZoomInfo, Qualified, Outreach, and Clay.io work together as a best-in-class, integrated ecosystem.
• Lead the design, governance, and optimization of data orchestration workflows using LeanData, including routing, prioritization, handoffs, and conversion logic across Marketing, SDR, and Sales teams.
• Design and execute a future-state operational roadmap focused on scaling B2B demand generation, ABM, and partner-led growth through automation, improved data flows, and AI-powered insights.
• Build automated lifecycle processes for lead scoring, enrichment, qualification, and cross-functional handoffs using LeanData, Zapier, Clay, Segment, and AI agents.
• Enhance sales productivity by implementing agentic workflows (e.g., automated follow-ups, enrichment workflows, SDR assistance tools) in Outreach and Salesforce.
• Manage data governance across Salesforce, Marketo, and Segment, ensuring reliable attribution, reporting, and pipeline visibility.
• Create AI-informed dashboards and reporting on pipeline performance, lead velocity, conversion, campaign effectiveness, and partner impact.
• Partner with RevOps, Sales Systems, and Engineering to operationalize cross-functional processes that reduce manual work and improve efficiency.
• Support partner/VAR motions through automated attribution, routing rules, partner engagement workflows, and integrated co-marketing processes.
• Continuously evaluate new tools, AI capabilities, and operational improvements that elevate our GTM infrastructure.

Requirements
• 4+ years in Marketing Operations or Revenue Operations supporting B2B sales-led funnels.
• Hands-on experience administering Marketo, Salesforce, and LeanData.
• Deep expertise with lead routing, lead-to-account matching, and data orchestration workflows using LeanData or similar workflow automation tools.
• Proven ability to design automated workflows, operational processes, and scalable cross-system integrations.
• Experience using AI-driven tools or agentic workflows to automate SDR tasks, enrich lead data, or accelerate GTM execution.
• Strong analytical, system design, and documentation skills; able to translate business needs into scalable technical workflows.
• Experience collaborating with Sales, SDR, RevOps, and System/Engineering teams.

Bonus Points
• Experience in FinTech or enterprise B2B SaaS environments.
• Familiarity with conversational marketing/ABM platforms like Qualified.
• Experience with tools like LeanData and Outreach in support of lead routing and SDR/BDR workflows.
• Experience with paid funnel operations is a plus (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, etc.).
• Understanding of partner/VAR operational workflows and partner attribution logic.
• Ability to design scalable integrations using tools like Segment, Zapier, or Workato-style platforms.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $134,696 - $168,370. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

jobs.description:
About the Role

People increasingly find financial products by asking ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode instead of scrolling search results. Chime's Organic Growth team helps members find Chime without paid media. Chime is already one of the most visible brands in AI answers in several core banking categories, and we want to widen that lead.

We're hiring an AEO Content Strategist to own the content and citation work that wins in AI search. You'll run Chime's blog from planning through publishing, run our AI-powered content workflows, and earn Chime coverage on the third-party sources AI models trust most. You'll partner closely with our Principal, AI Search Strategy SEO, who sets Chime's AI search strategy, priority categories, targets, and measurement. You'll own the content that helps us hit those Visibility targets.

This is a hands-on role with plenty of room for strategy. In the same week you might find a citation gap in a high-value category, brief a publisher partner, move a refreshed article through compliance review, and publish it in our CMS.

In this role, you can expect to
• Own Chime's blog and editorial content plan for SEO and AEO. You'll turn priority categories, prompt data, and member insights into a sequenced roadmap that helps Chime own its story and earn accurate, positive citations in AI answers.
• Run the editorial calendar and keep a steady publishing cadence. Structure content so AI models can find, understand, and cite it, with clear answers, clean formatting, and accurate, current product details (like rates, limits, and eligibility) in Contentful.
• Lead content across Chime.com, including product launches and seasonal moments with Product Marketing. Lift conversion on the blog and site through inline CTAs, email capture, stronger conversion paths, and regular CRO testing.
• Manage the day-to-day relationship with AirOps, our AI content optimization platform, and automate manual steps in the content lifecycle, from drafting and optimization to disclosures and CMS publishing. The goal is faster turnaround without losing quality.
• Lead offsite visibility with affiliate and publisher partners, and manage the AI visibility budget. Find where Chime is missing from the sources AI answers cite, brief partners on accurate product information, and track placements from request to live.
• Move content through Legal Compliance and partner bank review, managing a high-volume queue and using AI-assisted pre-review tools to speed up approvals.
• Work with PR, Brand, Social, YouTube, and Help Center so what the web says about Chime is accurate and consistent.
• Track citations, AI visibility by topic, rankings, traffic, and enrollments. Run experiments on format, structure, and CTAs, and bring what you learn to the weekly organic performance review.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 5+ years of experience in editorial strategy, content strategy, or SEO content, with a track record of growing organic visibility, traffic, or conversions.
• Hands-on AEO/GEO knowledge: how LLMs and AI answer engines choose and cite sources, and how content structure, accuracy, and third-party coverage affect visibility.
• Experience with AI content tools and workflows (for example AirOps, Profound, or LLM-based writing and optimization tools), and real enthusiasm for automating repetitive work.
• Experience publishing in a regulated industry such as financial services, fintech, insurance, or healthcare, including managing content through legal and compliance review.
• Hands-on experience with a CMS (Contentful preferred) and with Jira or similar ticket-based workflows.
• Experience managing freelancers, agencies, or external partners, including timelines, quality, and budget.
• Strong writing and editing skills, a sharp eye for accuracy, and the ability to turn performance data into clear recommendations.
• Ability to manage many workstreams and stakeholders at once in a fast-changing area, with little supervision.

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are hiring a Business Control Manager to join Chime's Compliance Business Control Management team. You will own the control strategy, business relationships, and results for the Membership, App and AI Experience, and Trust and Safety portfolios. Working with the Enterprise BCM Lead and business partners, you will translate new initiatives, existing business activities, regulatory requirements, incidents, and other changes into clear control outcomes and practical plans.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who can move comfortably between strategy and delivery. You will assess current control coverage, lead material control decisions and implementation work within your portfolios, and ensure controls are validated, documented, and maintained. Business and control owners remain responsible for implementing and operating their controls; you will provide the structure, challenge, and partnership needed to produce durable results.

You will also contribute across the Enterprise BCM team by supporting Enterprise work when priorities and capacity require it, and by helping identify shared exposure themes and common control approaches across portfolios.

In This Role You Can Expect To
• Own the control strategy and coverage view for assigned portfolios, using business activities, regulatory requirements, existing controls, gaps, and dependencies to set priorities.
• Evaluate new initiatives and the existing environment through reviews of process or product changes, incidents, complaints, findings, and current control practices. Determine whether controls should be reused, enhanced, created, consolidated, or retired.
• Lead control design and implementation with business and control owners, establishing clear objectives, scope, ownership, evidence, exception handling, delivery plans, and closure criteria while keeping control ownership and operation with the business.
• Assess control readiness, coordinate owner attestations, and determine whether controls meet the agreed validation criteria. Arrange an independent reviewer when your involvement in implementation requires additional separation.
• Lead control responses to incidents, issues, complaints, and findings by connecting root causes to control gaps, establishing remediation expectations, and confirming affected controls are revalidated before closure.
• Maintain reliable control records and use coverage, implementation, validation, and exception data to identify recurring themes, recommend shared approaches, and communicate results and remaining exposure to leadership.
• Build strong relationships across business, product, engineering, operations, legal, compliance, risk, and data teams, and support bank partner reviews, audits, examinations, and other assurance activities.

To Thrive in This Role You Have
• 7 or more years of experience in business controls, regulatory compliance, operational risk, audit, or a related discipline within financial services, fintech, or another highly regulated environment.
• Experience independently owning a complex portfolio or control environment, setting priorities, leading cross-functional decisions, and moving work from assessment through validated and documented closure.
• Demonstrated ability to evaluate business activities and control coverage, distinguish control gaps from documentation or mapping gaps, and develop practical responses.
• Hands-on experience designing or enhancing controls with business, product, engineering, operations, or data teams and defining the evidence needed to demonstrate that controls operate as designed.
• Sound knowledge of consumer financial protection and regulatory risk, including EFTA and Regulation E, TILA and Regulation Z, UDAAP, or comparable frameworks.
• Strong judgment, influence, and communication skills, including the ability to challenge senior partners constructively, work through competing priorities, translate complex requirements, and identify when leadership escalation is needed.
• Strong execution and organization skills, including managing multiple workstreams, dependencies, decisions, exceptions, and control records within a GRC platform or comparable system of record.

About the role

As a Senior Business Analyst, TPRM, you will support the assessment and ongoing oversight of third party relationships, including vendors and partners, throughout the third party risk management lifecycle.

You will assess third party risk, conduct business due diligence, and coordinate additional risk assessments with cross-functional partners. You will help ensure risks are appropriately identified, documented, and addressed while working closely with business owners, risk partners, and Chime’s bank partners.

This role requires strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple assessments and stakeholders. You will serve as a trusted partner to the business while contributing to the continued development and maturity of Chime’s TPRM program.

In this role, you can expect to
• Review and challenge Inherent Risk Questionnaires (IRQs), working with business owners to understand vendor relationships, validate information, and determine appropriate inherent risk and criticality ratings.
• Coordinate due diligence activities with cross-functional risk partners and subject matter experts across areas such as Information Security, Privacy, Compliance, Enterprise Risk Management, and Legal.
• Conduct business due diligence, including reviews of corporate registration, reputational information, insurance coverage, and other relevant documentation, and coordinate additional activities such as background checks.
• Manage assigned third party assessments through completion, coordinating with business owners and cross-functional risk partners to address questions, follow up on outstanding requirements, and escalate concerns as appropriate.
• Facilitate vendor approval processes with Chime’s bank partners, including coordinating assessment information, responding to follow-up requests, and tracking approvals through completion.
• Identify and document issues arising from TPRM assessments and partner with relevant stakeholders to track third party risk issues and remediation activities through resolution.
• Support ongoing monitoring and periodic reassessments of third party relationships, including reviewing changes that may impact the inherent risk rating, criticality rating, or due diligence requirements.
• Clearly document TPRM assessments, risk decisions, and supporting rationale in accordance with program requirements.
• Provide guidance to business owners and stakeholders on TPRM requirements, processes, and expectations.
• Contribute to the continued development and maturity of the TPRM program through process improvements, tooling enhancements, reporting, and updates to policies, procedures, standards, and supporting documentation.
• Support internal audits, regulatory examinations, bank partner oversight, and other program activities as needed.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 4+ years of experience in Third Party Risk Management, Vendor Risk Management, Operational Risk, Compliance, Audit, or a related risk management function.
• Experience with third party risk assessments, due diligence, and related third party risk management activities.
• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to challenge information, identify gaps or inconsistencies, synthesize information from multiple sources, and make well-supported risk-based decisions.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience working across business owners, risk and control functions, and cross-functional teams.
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assessments, approvals, and competing priorities.
• Experience contributing to risk program initiatives such as process improvement, policy and procedure development, tooling enhancements, reporting, audit support, or similar activities.
• Familiarity with regulatory expectations and industry practices for third party risk management, including applicable interagency guidance.
• Experience in financial services, fintech, banking, or another regulated environment is preferred.
• Familiarity with Third Party Risk Management platforms, workflow tools, and reporting solutions is a plus.

jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Senior Instructional Designer, you will join Chime’s Operations and Member Experience Learning Development team to design highly engaging, interactive, and modern learning strategies and experiences for our agents across our BPOs. You will apply your knowledge of adult learning methodologies to drive business outcomes through the development of a broad range of innovative learning solutions (e.g. instructor-led, virtual instructor-led, digital, self-paced, micro-learning, social learning) that promote transfer, retention, and application. You are a creative and analytical problem solver, and you have a passion for customer service. 

Your work - execution and continuous improvement - will impact thousands of BPO employees and millions of Chime members. This role requires someone who thrives in a flat, fast-moving organization using lightweight processes, creative ideas, and quick iteration to make a significant impact. 

In this role, you can expect to
• Act as a learning consultant to our Disputes Experience line of business; gaining a deep understanding of the business and metrics to craft and recommend learning strategies to drive strong business outcomes.
• Proactively collaborate with team members, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to identify training needs and objectives.
• Flex your analytical muscle to evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs and uncover opportunities to enhance agent skills and performance through learning
• Apply adult learning principles and instructional design standard methodologies to create engaging interactive learning solutions and compelling course content, material/media (audio, video, simulations, games, etc.)
• Own the end-to-end design and development of learning content, including modes of assessment to measure the effectiveness and application of training.
• Analyze and apply trends and standard methodologies in instructional design and learning technologies to continue to elevate all agents' learning experiences.
• Design learning that reflects an understanding of the diversity of learning styles to ensure that your learning solutions resonate with our increasingly global and diverse audience. 

To thrive in this role, you have
• You have an eye for design, a serious obsession with learning and a proven ability to tie learning events to measurable outcomes that reflect our mission and culture.
• Subject matter expertise in adult learning theory and instructional design best practices in all modalities with the ability to convert strategies to effective and engaging learning experiences.
• 7+ years of experience designing and developing multi-modality learning (eLearning, instructor-led, video, etc.), including system simulations, branching scenarios, and other in-depth e-learning solutions
• Experience analyzing source material and creating design documents to share with developers
• Experience leveraging AI tools in your daily workflow to accelerate learning outputs, while evaluating those outputs to maintain learning quality and business outcomes
• Experience working in an agile and waterfall (ADDIE) design environment
• Excellent communication and relationship skills with strong capabilities to partner with team members across all levels.
• Strong data analysis skills with experience designing an evaluation strategy using data/metrics to meet business and learning objectives and drive performance improvements.
• Demonstrated experience designing and developing high-impact blended learning solutions in 2 or more learning authoring tools: i.e. Articulate 360 (Rise Storyline), Camtasia, Adobe Captivate, Adobe Premiere Pro, iSpring Suite, Canva, etc.
• Ability to create and manage clear project plans outlining stakeholder responsibilities, timelines, needs, and risks.
• Experience driving outcomes through vendor partnerships and contact centers is a plus.
• Strong aptitude in graphic design, video and audio production is a plus.
• Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally, approx. 10% of the time.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Chime’s Data Science and Machine Learning team is building models, services, and platforms that transform how millions of users manage and grow their financial lives. We are looking for a hands-on Tech Lead Manager with deep technical expertise in machine learning and data science, particularly within the Growth and Marketing domain. Beyond technical proficiency, we value creativity, user empathy, and strong collaboration.

As a Tech Lead Manager within our Growth and Marketing team, you will lead a talented group of data scientists and machine learning engineers to develop innovative growth and marketing models. These models will provide critical insights into acquiring, retaining and growing Chime members, broaden access to credit, and ensure financial inclusivity. You will play a pivotal role in creating innovative, ground-up products while driving the development of cutting-edge acquisition and retention models and solutions. If you are passionate about marketing, growth, customer acquisition and retention models, this role could be a great fit for you.

In this role, you can expect to
• Lead and inspire a high-performing team of data scientists and ML engineers, ensuring the successful development and deployment of machine learning solutions for customer acquisition, conversion and retention.
• Drive strategic direction for ML initiatives in marketing, engagement, and growth by identifying opportunities where AI/ML can optimize our customer funnel.
• Oversee the end-to-end development of machine learning models such as lifetime value prediction, churn risk modeling, customer segmentation, marketing attribution, referral recommendations, and personalized communications.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product, growth, and engineering teams to align machine learning initiatives with business objectives.
• Leverage transactional and behavioral data to enhance customer targeting, optimize acquisition spend, and improve retention strategies.
• Establish ML best practices, including model development, validation, deployment, and monitoring, ensuring scalability and business impact.
• Advocate for a data-driven culture, partnering with business leaders to drive strategic decisions through experimentation and predictive analytics.
• Stay ahead of industry trends, bringing cutting-edge AI/ML techniques into our marketing and growth strategies.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 7+ years of experience developing machine learning models for marketing and growth, from inception to production, with a focus on customer acquisition, engagement, and retention.
• 5+ years of experience leading data science teams, with a proven track record of mentoring, coaching, and driving impactful machine learning solutions.
• Strong expertise in marketing and growth analytics, including experience with customer segmentation, LTV modeling, churn prediction, referral systems, and multi-touch attribution.
• Deep understanding of AI/ML techniques, including classification, clustering, reinforcement learning, optimization, deep learning, and NLP for customer engagement.
• Hands-on experience deploying machine learning models in real-world production environments, integrating with marketing tech stacks and growth platforms.
• Strong product intuition with the ability to work iteratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

Responsibilities:
• Provide dedicated end-to-end trade support to assigned trading desks, perform trade bookings, trade verifications, balance and position reconciliations, P&L attributions

• 5+ years of working experience on the Trading floor as Trading Assistant or Trade Support or in relevant functions such as Middle Office, Product Control in a financial services or crypto trading firm

• Excellent problem solving skills, detailed oriented mindset with a high degree of accuracy
• Positive and proactive, critical thinker who strives for continuous improvement
• A product owner, results oriented, think outside of the box and can deliver under pressure
• Thrive to work in a dynamic environment, passionate about cryptocurrency and blockchain

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in annual digital payment transaction value.

About The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Relations Partner to join the Corporate Affairs and R D teams. You will work closely with our engineering teams to tell the story of what we’re building in a language that other expert engineers understand.

jobs.title: Field Credit Officer (Abia)
jobs.description:
About Us: 

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest-growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere.

Job Title: Field Credit Officer 

Reports to: Regional Credit Manager 

Employment Type: Outsourced 

Work Mode: Onsite

About this role: 

As a Field Credit Officer, you would be saddled with the duty of onboarding and managing businesses that would access our credit products. You would be tasked with growing your loan portfolio while maintaining profitability by ensuring that all loans are repaid as and when due. As a result, you would play a vital role in the assessment of these businesses during their credit application and leverage innovative tools we have developed to help you monitor their performance during the course of the loan.

You would also be responsible for making deductions from several information sources about the 5Cs of credit, with capacity, character, and capital as major priorities. Make recommendations to management before, during, and after the disbursement of a loan facility as to the best actions to be taken, considering several economic factors.

Responsibilities:
• Identify and onboard viable businesses within your assigned geographical area to open business accounts with Moniepoint
• Engage customers to ensure optimal usage of accounts to allow them to qualify for access to credit
• Review and approve (or decline) loan requests by thoroughly analyzing all the data available
• Embark on physical visitation to potential borrowers’ business places for evaluation of business books, taking inventory and turnover into consideration
• Meet gross loan portfolio targets and portfolio profit targets by maintaining a healthy number of loan customers while ensuring that all loans in portfolio are performing
• Monitor active loan portfolio to ensure continued use of business account and loan repayment performance
• Perform all other credit-related functions as may be assigned by a supervisor 

Experience Background:
• Minimum of an OND in any business-related discipline
• Minimum of 2 years’ experience in a sales role for credit products in a financial institution
• Demonstrable knowledge of credit risk analysis
• Good knowledge of financial analysis is an added advantage
• Must be resident in Abia - Ohafia, Osisioma, Abia North, and Abia Central

Skills Competencies:
• Apt attention to details
• Proven simple/complex analytical skills
• Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
• Agility and perseverance 

What success looks like

in this role:
• Consistent achievement of gross loan portfolio targets and portfolio profit targets.
• Maintaining a healthy, performing loan portfolio with minimized default rates through rigorous physical visitations and monitoring.
• Successful onboarding and engagement of viable businesses that actively utilize Moniepoint business accounts.
• Accurate credit risk assessments based on key factors like capacity, character, and capital. 

Why join us:
• Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities.
• Opportunity to work with Africa’s fastest-growing fintech and make a direct impact on business growth across the region.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Sales Management Tools
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why Pakistan

Pakistan is home to the third-largest concentration of technology team members at Moniepoint, and it's one of the fastest-growing markets we hire into, with real headroom for growth in seniority and scope. We look for people here who understand first-hand what it means for financial services to be difficult to access, and who want to work on problems at a genuine international scale - changing how banking works across emerging markets.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Sales Management Tools, to join us in Pakistan.

About The Role

Sales Management Tools owns MonieCRM, the operating system for Moniepoint's 50,000-strong sales network. This is not a CRM we bought — it is a workforce operations platform built entirely in-house for a multi-level field sales hierarchy, and it is how those teams run their day to day: the portfolio of businesses they manage, their own teams, their goals and performance, the physical and digital resources they need in the field, and an emerging AI-assisted support layer. Sixteen capabilities span onboarding and network management, pipeline and portfolio, performance and goals, compensation, and sales experience and support.

A significant part of the domain moves money. The platform owns wallets, commission calculation and attribution, cashout and welfare funds for a network that drives the overwhelming majority of company revenue — which makes financial correctness, not just availability, a core engineering requirement of the role.

Alongside that, the domain covers partner management, a rewards and retention platform serving tens of millions of users, and our marketing technology stack, including the engineering and customisation of Braze, the platform we use for customer engagement. The mandate is modernisation and reliability: re-architecting systems that have grown very quickly and making them dependable at a scale of more than 20 million users. This is a platform engineering and legacy modernisation challenge first and foremost, and prior CRM or SalesTech experience is genuinely not required.

Who You Are
• You have 10–15 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
• 5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not years spent overseeing teams who write it.
• At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
• You have proven platform engineering experience at scale — building and running complex distributed systems, not feature delivery alone.
• You have navigated legacy migrations and re-architecture projects at 20M+ user scale.
• You have strong backend engineering skills in high-throughput, data-intensive distributed systems, and are proficient in Java and Spring Boot.
• You have managed and developed large engineering teams of 20 or more members.
• Experience building systems where financial correctness matters — commissions, payouts, wallets, ledgers or equivalent — is a strong advantage.
• A fintech or payments background is strongly preferred. CRM or SalesTech domain experience is nice to have and explicitly not required.
• Exposure to customer engagement or marketing automation platforms such as Braze is a plus, but not a requirement.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.
• Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
• Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
• Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
• Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
• Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
• No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
• Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
• Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like In The Role
• Legacy systems modernised and re-architected, with measurable improvement in reliability and performance.
• Commissions and earnings calculated, attributed and paid accurately and on time, at network scale.
• A sales and marketing platform that scales with a rapidly growing agent network across multiple markets.
• Commercial teams able to move faster because the tooling beneath them is dependable.
• A high-performing engineering team with a strong bench of managers and senior engineers.

Why Join Us
• Own the platform behind the commercial engine of one of Africa's largest digital banks — the system 50,000 people rely on to do their jobs and to get paid.
• A genuine platform modernisation mandate with the autonomy and backing to see it through.
• Be part of a mission-driven company impacting millions of businesses and individuals across Africa and beyond.

What To Expect In The Hiring Process
• 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
• 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
• 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
• 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder Group CTO (the hiring manager).

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

jobs.title: Data Director, Payments
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍London or UK Remote | 💰 £150,000 - £200, 000 + Equity + Benefits 

About our Data Discipline 

We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.

Our Data discipline is centralised, but deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers and Analysts work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers, Marketers and other specialists. This means Data is not a downstream service: we help shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.

Our Payments team ⭐

At Monzo, payments are more than just moving money from A to B. They are a core part of how customers experience trust, speed, and financial control every day. As a Data Director in Payments, you would help shape seamless local payment experiences, ensuring customers can pay and get paid reliably while continuing to modernise the infrastructure that powers millions of transactions behind the scenes.

The role also sits at the intersection of Monzo’s broader ambition to build truly borderless banking and expand into new markets. That means designing products and payment capabilities that work effortlessly across geographies, currencies, and customer needs, while helping Monzo scale into new markets with the same simplicity and transparency that defines the brand today.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to help shape Monzo’s payments strategy to make Monzo's global ambitions a reality, enabling revenue and customer growth with a resilient, self-serve banking platform. 

To succeed, you should be excited about solving tough, ambiguous business problems with analytical rigour, commercial viability and execution effectiveness

Your day-to-day
• Establish yourself as a trusted member of the Payments Leadership team, enabling better decisions across Payments and the wider Data Discipline
• Co-drive Payments strategy and product decisions with Product and Engineering, bringing Data into discovery early to shape priorities and challenge thinking
• Identify untapped opportunities for commercial optimisation, including across pricing, commercialisation, investment and customer growth
• Set the data strategy for Payments, including the operating model, team priorities, architecture, technical debt and key metrics and drivers
• Translate between technical, product and commercial perspectives to help teams make clear, high-impact decisions
• Develop and scale a high-performing team of data professionals sharing accountability for product and business outcomes.

You should apply if:

What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!
• You have experience driving payments innovation and product strategy forward in a fast-growing business
• You combine deep Data expertise with strong product and commercial judgement.
• You can move comfortably from detailed metrics or architecture discussions to customer strategy, pricing and business outcomes
• You are an empathetic people leader who can build trust quickly, raise the performance bar and retain excellent talent
• You have experience growing and leading a full stack data team, including individual contributors and managers across Data Science, Analytics Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering and Analytics
• You have experience collaborating with senior cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing and risk/control functions

 

The Interview Process

After an informal ~30 min recruiter call, our interview process involves 2 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!
• Initial Call (1 hour) You'll meet with one of our senior data leaders.
• Loop Stage - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as behavioural and leadership interviews. You can have this all in one day or split these across multiple days, whichever your prefer.

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on tech-hiring@monzo.com

 

How we work 💻:

Locations Flexible Working : 

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. 

We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. 

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

What’s in it for you

💰Base salary £150, 000 - £200, 000 + Equity + Benefits 

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK 

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

jobs.title: Head of Compliance, EU & UK
jobs.description:
About the Team:

Compliance at OKX is a trusted partner to the business. We're a team of risk-minded problem solvers who make sure OKX grows safely and sustainably. We advise on regulatory obligations, uphold strong controls, and continuously improve our processes so the business can scale responsibly.

 

What You'll be Doing:

As Head of Compliance, Europe UK, you'll lead the compliance program across OKX's European and UK entities. You'll report to the Deputy Chief Compliance Officer and Head of International Compliance, and take the regional function to its next level of maturity.

Your mandate is to build a robust, efficient compliance program that supports sustainable growth. You'll lead a team of Country Heads of Compliance and MLROs, bringing them together as a cohesive, high-performing regional team. Each will keep their local regulatory responsibilities and decision-making authority.
• Set the strategic direction and lead delivery of the compliance program across all OKX entities in Europe and the UK.
• Lead, support and develop Country Heads of Compliance and MLROs, strengthening consistency across the region while preserving local accountability and decision-making.
• Maintain the independence of the compliance function, with direct access to local Boards and the authority to challenge the business where needed.
• Review current workflows and improve them. Put in place scalable frameworks, and use data, automation and AI-enabled tools to improve the quality and timeliness of decisions while keeping controls strong.
• Work with first-, second- and third-line teams to build a control environment that meets or exceeds regulatory expectations.
• Act as a senior point of contact for regulators, leading or supporting examinations, inquiries and supervisory engagement.
• Partner with Business, Product and Legal on licensing scope assessments and compliance input for new products and market entries.
• Build strong partnerships with business leaders and stakeholders across Product, Legal, Operations and Risk, giving clear, practical guidance on the compliance implications of commercial decisions.
• Produce data-driven compliance reports for management and local Boards, using metrics, SLAs and KPIs that show the effectiveness of the compliance program.
• Take part in Board and committee meetings, as a member or as needed.
• Act as the escalation point for complex compliance issues, making sure they're resolved promptly and in line with the compliance program.
• Work with first-, second- and third-line teams to build a control environment that meets or exceeds regulatory expectations.
• Audit current workflows and remove unncessary friction. Implement scalable frameworks that reduce manual effort, and use data, automation and AI-enabled tools to speed up decision-making without compromising control integrity.
• Liaise with first, second, and third-line teams to build a control environment that exceeds regulatory standards while maintaining commercial agility.
• Oversee compliance reviews and investigations.
• Act as a senior point of contact with country regulators, including leading or supporting regulatory examinations, inquiries, and supervisory engagement.

 

What We Look For in You:
• 10–12+ years of compliance experience in financial services, fintech or crypto, with a track record of building and running effective compliance programs.
• A proven ability to solve problems, meet tight deadlines and deliver in a high-pressure environment.
• Experience working closely with Operations teams, balancing regulatory requirements with operational efficiency.
• Strong knowledge of EU and UK regulation, including MiCA, MiFID II, MAR, the EU AML framework (AMLD5/6, AMLR and AMLA), the Transfer of Funds Regulation (Travel Rule), DORA and GDPR, plus the UK cryptoasset regime.
• Strong people leadership, including leading teams spread across locations.
• Proven experience managing and developing senior compliance leaders, such as Heads of Compliance and MLROs, across multiple countries or entities, ideally within a regulated group.
• Comfort using data to measure performance, spot bottlenecks and justify resourcing.
• A proven ability to present the compliance program, risk posture and performance to Boards, regulators and senior committees.
• Clear, high-impact communication. You can explain complex regulatory concepts to product teams and operational challenges to regulators.

 

Nice to Haves:
• Experience scaling a crypto or high-growth fintech business in Europe.
• Prior experience in the crypto industry.
• Prior experience as a Country Head of Compliance or MLRO, or in another approved role.
• Experience working with the MFSA, FIAU, FCA or other European regulators.
• CAMS, an ICA Diploma or an equivalent certification.

 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and an education subsidy
• Team-building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare for employees and dependants
• More we'd love to tell you about during the process!

jobs.title: Head of Marketing Compliance
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Team

The Compliance Department at OKX is responsible for promoting a strong compliance culture and supporting the business in meeting its regulatory obligations and managing enterprise risk.

The Marketing Compliance function develops and applies standards for marketing and external communications across the markets in which OKX operates. Its remit covers advertising, promotions, social media, influencers and affiliates activity, and product launch communications for CeFi and DeFi offerings, from campaign planning through approval and post-campaign review. We work with Marketing, Product, Legal, Risk, and Compliance teams to assess regulatory requirements, put practical risk-based controls in place, and support timely and compliant go-to-market execution.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a strong leader to join our compliance team and continue building out our marketing compliance function. This role will involve building a marketing control framework supported by policies and procedures, developing review and approval processes, and working closely with Product, Marketing, and Legal teams to ensure marketing communications and initiatives comply with applicable laws, regulations, and internal standards.

This role blends strategic oversight with hands-on involvement in marketing lifecycle governance, from ideation through execution and post-campaign review and ongoing monitoring. The ideal candidate is a forward-thinking compliance leader who can balance regulatory rigor with business enablement in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Lead a marketing compliance function and scale up the team.
• Design and implement a scalable global compliance framework supported by policies and procedures governing marketing and external communications, including advertising, promotions, social media, and product launch communications.
• Develop and maintain marketing compliance policies and procedures tailored to the unique risks associated with both CeFi and DeFi offerings.
• Work closely with Legal and Compliance teams to define and operationalize a review and approval process for marketing and product communications, ensuring timely and compliant go-to-market execution.

• Leverage AI-enabled technological solutions to develop a holistic global marketing compliance controls framework that can scale appropriately with the business’ growth.
• Track, report, and remediate incidents or issues arising from marketing activities.
• Monitor global regulatory developments relevant to crypto marketing and advertising. Proactively assess and implement required changes to the marketing compliance program based on regulatory updates.
• Partner with Product, Legal, Risk, Central Compliance and Marketing teams to ensure all product launch communications and campaigns are fully compliant with global regulations and company policies.
• Support the business in making decisions while considering regulatory risks and compliance obligations.
• Develop materials to improve understanding of compliance and regulatory risks across teams and deliver regular training and knowledge-sharing sessions.

 

What We Look For In You
• Experience as a lead in compliance, legal, or marketing compliance roles, ideally within financial services or fintech.
• Ability to multi-task and work in a high-paced environment.
• Deep understanding of marketing regulations and standards across key jurisdictions (e.g., US, UK, EU, APAC).
• Experience in crypto, blockchain, or digital assets, with strong familiarity with both CeFi and DeFi ecosystems.
• Proven ability to design and implement compliance frameworks and controls from scratch.

• Experience engaging with regulatory bodies or supporting regulatory audits or exams.
• Prior experience in a high-growth tech or startup environment.

The team works closely with internal stakeholders, external security providers, emergency services, and law enforcement, as appropriate.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Senior Manager, Global Physical Security Operations to help lead and strengthen our global physical security operations.

Reporting to the Director of Physical Security, you will translate security strategy into practical operational measures, coordinate protective security activities across regions, manage security risks and incidents, and help ensure consistent execution of global security standards.

This position requires sound judgment, operational leadership, adaptability, and the ability to make proportionate, risk-based decisions in complex and rapidly evolving environments. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable planning security operations, responding to emerging threats, working with senior leadership, and improving existing security capabilities.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Protective Intelligence and Threat Assessment: Monitor and assess geopolitical developments, security threats, and concerning activities affecting personnel or company interests. Evaluate available intelligence and coordinate practical, proportionate risk-mitigation measures with relevant stakeholders.

• Security Vendor Management: Oversee third-party security providers supporting executive protection, guarding, secure transportation, intelligence, event security, and other specialized services. Coordinate vendor selection, suitability assessments, performance monitoring, and service improvements with relevant stakeholders.
• Security Technology and Program Improvement: Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to strengthen security technologies, threat monitoring, emergency preparedness, operational reporting, and performance metrics. Identify security gaps, recommend corrective measures, and provide clear updates to leadership.

• Strong analytical skills and operational judgment, including the ability to assess incomplete or rapidly changing information, evaluate threats, and make sound, proportionate, risk-based decisions under pressure.

jobs.title: 経営企画（生命保険領域のスペシャリスト）
jobs.description:
PayPayについて

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50か国の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_

我々は自分たちの想像を超える未来を創るためにあえて明確なビジョンは必要ないと考えています。常にDay1であるスタンスを忘れずに、誰もが想像できないようなビジョン（未来）を実現していくのがPayPayです。
この壮大なビジョンに前向きに取り組み、他社に真似できない圧倒的なスピードでプロダクトを磨き上げ、日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、自ら課題発見し、周囲と協力して新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

 

業務について

▼組織・チームについて

経営企画部では、PayPayグループの事業成長と収益性向上を支えることをミッションとしています。
短期・中長期の経営計画策定や進捗管理、各種KPI・損益の予実分析、経営陣への報告・改善提案を通じて、経営課題の解決や戦略施策の実行を支援しています。また、これらを支える管理会計基盤の整備・運営にも取り組んでいます。

▼募集の背景

PayPayグループにおける生命保険領域の強化に向けて、資本・規制・会計・保険数理など、複数の専門領域を横断した経営課題への対応が重要となっています。
本ポジションでは、生命保険領域の専門性を活かし、関係部門や外部パートナーと連携しながら、経営判断に必要な論点整理・分析・提言を主体的に推進いただける方を募集しています。

【具体的な仕事の内容】

成長戦略を踏まえ、生命保険領域における中長期事業計画・年度予算の策定や、資本・規制・会計・保険数理などの観点から経営上の重要テーマを検討いただきます。

具体的な業務内容例：
• 生命保険領域における中長期事業計画・年度予算の策定
• 資本・規制・保険会計・負債評価・ALM等を踏まえた経営課題の分析・検討、経営陣への提言
• 監査法人・外部パートナー等と連携した専門的な論点の検討・推進
• 関係会社・パートナー企業の業務・運用実態の把握および経営課題の検討への反映
• 経理・財務・リスク・法務・事業部門等と連携した部門横断プロジェクトの推進

▼本ポジションの魅力
• 経営の意思決定に直接関与：
生命保険領域の専門性を活かし、重要な経営課題の検討や意思決定に携わることで、経営視点をさらに高められます。
• 専門性を活かした幅広い経営課題への関与：
保険会計・資本・規制・数理などを横断した検討を通じて、生命保険領域の知見を経営企画・戦略領域へ広げられます。
• Fintechグループならではの事業環境：
決済を起点に金融領域を拡大するPayPayグループで、多様な専門性を持つ関係者と連携しながら、事業成長を支える経験を積めます。

必要な経験/スキル

以下の経験・スキルをお持ちの方（目安：5年以上）
• 生命保険会社における経営企画・財務・経営分析の実務経験
• 財務・管理会計・決算・事業計画等に関する数値分析、および経営層向けまたは対外向け資料の作成経験

あると望ましい経験/スキル
• 生命保険会社における日本基準（J-GAAP）またはIFRSに基づく決算・事業計画策定の経験
• 金融規制・当局対応（報告資料作成、折衝等）の経験
• 保険会計に関する知識（IFRS17の知識があれば尚可）
• アクチュアリー等の保険数理資格、または保険数理領域と連携したプロジェクト経験
• 複数部門の関係者と連携し、プロジェクトや業務を推進した経験

PayPayが求める人物像
• PayPay 5 sensesに当てはまる方

待遇・条件

雇用形態
• 正社員

勤務地
• Hybrid Workstyle
※所属組織のルールおよび業務指示に応じて出社対応頂きます。

勤務時間
• スーパーフレックス制（コアタイム無し）
• 原則：午前9時～午後5時45分（実働7時間45分＋休憩時間 1時間）

※PayPay独自の特別有給休暇制度で、本人/家族/ペットなどの病気/ケガ/通院付き添い等にご使用頂けます。

給与

jobs.description:

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

This org operates 24 hours a day around critical market functions — from market open to trade settlement — and when things go wrong, it matters.

As the Director of Engineering, Brokerage Platform, you will lead one of Robinhood's largest and most consequential engineering organizations. You will own the technical strategy, people leadership, and delivery execution for a broad, high-stakes platform — partnering closely with a dedicated TPM and engaging deeply with trading, crypto, and active trader product teams who depend on your org every day. This is not a role for someone who manages from a distance. You will need the engineering depth to challenge technical bets, the platform mindset to drive the investments that move the business forward, and the leadership presence to build and retain a world-class team in a domain where the stakes are always high.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week.

• Own the full engineering strategy and delivery for Brokerage Platform — spanning Market Data Symbology, Trading Platform, Clearing, and Brokerage Infrastructure — setting the technical direction and ensuring the org executes with reliability and conviction
• Lead and develop a large, distributed engineering organization of senior and staff-level engineers and engineering managers — building the talent, culture, and bench strength the org needs to sustain high performance over time
• Drive platform investments that have direct business impact — identifying the modernization, reliability, and scalability bets worth making, building the conviction behind them, and seeing them through to measurable outcomes
• Partner tightly with your TPM counterpart to manage a high volume of incoming asks from trading, crypto, active trader, and event contracts product teams — prioritizing ruthlessly and protecting engineering capacity for the work that matters most
• Own the reliability and operational health of systems that run continuously around market-critical functions — ensuring the org is prepared for high-severity incidents and has the processes and tooling to resolve them fast
• Engage deeply with cross-functional leadership across Robinhood — representing Brokerage Platform's roadmap, dependencies, and capabilities to product, ops, and executive stakeholders
• Champion platform modernization and technical debt reduction — driving initiatives like stack rewrites, sharding, multi-region scaling, and infrastructure abstractions that unlock velocity across the entire engineering org

What you bring

The Robinhood Wallet team’s mission is to democratize access to financial services worldwide by leveraging DeFi protocols and Robinhood Chain. The team builds non-custodial consumer products, self-custody experiences, and seamless cross-chain trading capabilities.

The Tokenization team’s mission is to bring both public and private equity to be tradable 24/7 on decentralized exchanges (DEXs) across the Robinhood Chain. Equity markets have been closed nights and weekends for a century; the team builds the connective tissue between traditional market infrastructure and on-chain systems—issuance, custody, and settlement—to change that.

The Robinhood Chain team designs and scales the underlying decentralized infrastructure across Robinhood. The team continuously improves Robinhood Chain to provide a best-in-class decentralized platform for trading real-world assets, builds specialized smart contracts, and provides infrastructure services for other Robinhood teams that rely on DeFi.

These roles are based in either our Menlo Park, or New York City offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.
