• Build the connective tissue between traditional market infrastructure (brokerage, ledgers, corporate actions) and on-chain systems, including smart contract integrations, chain indexers, and DEX trade flows.
• Develop product-facing features and platform enhancements that meet strict correctness and scalability standards.
• Identify and implement improvements to system performance, engineering productivity, and risk reduction.
• Collaborate closely with product, compliance, client, platform teams, and external partners to deliver impactful technical solutions.

What you bring
• 2+ years of experience in software development.
• Expertise in backend development using languages such as Go, Python, or Java, with a solid grasp of cloud-native architectures.
• Strong grasp of system design, data modeling, and software engineering fundamentals.
• Care for correctness-critical systems—idempotency, reconciliation, and reasoning carefully about failure modes when money is at stake.
• Strong ownership mindset, with a track record of delivering high-quality projects end to end in cross-functional environments and raising team-wide technical standards.
• Proven ability to simplify complex problems, make sound tradeoffs, and drive alignment across diverse stakeholders.
• Interest in blockchain fundamentals—EVM, smart contracts, wallets, on-chain settlement—or a strong appetite to go deep quickly.

• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career

jobs.title: Java Software Engineer - Finance and Accounting
jobs.description:
Starling is the UK’s first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking! We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way.

We’re a fully licensed UK bank with the culture and spirit of a fast-moving, disruptive tech company. We’re a bank, but better: fairer, easier to use and designed to demystify money for everyone. We employ more than 3,000 people across our London, Southampton, Cardiff and Manchester offices.

Our technologists are at the very heart of Starling and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Starling is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, discovering, to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five Starling values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Starling - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person.

Our Engineering Environment

Starling engineers are excited about helping us deliver new features, regardless of what their primary tech stack may be. Hear from the team in our latest blogs or our case studies with Women in Tech.

We value people being engaged and caring about customers, caring about the code they write and the contribution they make to Starling. People with a broad ability to apply themselves to a multitude of problems and challenges, who can work across teams do great things here at Starling, to continue changing banking for good.

We’re seeking highly motivated engineers with around 3-4 years of Java experience to play a key role in our Finance Engineering team. You will take part in writing and supporting key financial systems such as the bank’s ledgers and the systems that integrate with them.

We're looking for engineers who have good attention to detail and can write clear, concise and maintainable code. You should have a good understanding of the lifecycle of a project and be able to engage in this process with internal stakeholders, as well as experience in designing systems to solve problems. Experience with Postgres is highly desirable, and any experience with Netsuite would be a bonus.

We’re open-minded when it comes to hiring; we care more about aptitude and attitude than specific qualifications. We code mostly in Java, with some TypeScript, but you need not be an expert when you join us! We care about the quality and resilience of the systems we build, and if you’re motivated to find elegant solutions to difficult technical problems, we’d love to hear from you.

The main part of our Tech Stack is listed below. We don't ask that you have experience in all of this, but if you do, that's great!
• Java (makes up the majority of our backend codebase)
• Postgres
• AWS & GCP (we're cloud-native)
• Distributed service-based architecture
• Kubernetes (EKS)
• TeamCity for CI/CD (we release our changes frequently throughout the day!)
• Terraform and Grafana

The Team

The Finance Engineering team sits at the core of the bank, and is responsible for the correct accounting of every transaction that passes through the bank's systems. Our team focuses on correctness and accuracy of transactions, on recording the underlying story of money as it moves, and on supporting and automating the complex financial processes that take place behind the scenes.

We work directly with the treasurers and accountants that allow the bank to thrive, and with every project and system within the bank that has financial impact. This is a unique opportunity to work with some of Starling's mission-critical services and products.

Our process:

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:
• Initial phone call - ~45 minutes
• Take home technical test to be discussed in the technical interview - ~3 hours
• Technical interview - ~1.5 hours
• Final Interview - ~40 minutes
• 25 days holiday (plus take your public holiday allowance whenever works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasing

About us

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

Starling is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Starling are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. When you provide us with this information, you are doing so at your own consent, with full knowledge that we will process this personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice.

By submitting your application, you agree that Starling may collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

jobs.title: Java Software Engineer - Finance and Accounting
jobs.description:
Starling is the UK’s first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking! We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way.

We’re a fully licensed UK bank with the culture and spirit of a fast-moving, disruptive tech company. We’re a bank, but better: fairer, easier to use and designed to demystify money for everyone. We employ more than 3,000 people across our London, Southampton, Cardiff and Manchester offices.

Our technologists are at the very heart of Starling and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Starling is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, discovering, to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five Starling values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Starling - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person.

Our Engineering Environment

Starling engineers are excited about helping us deliver new features, regardless of what their primary tech stack may be. Hear from the team in our latest blogs or our case studies with Women in Tech.

We value people being engaged and caring about customers, caring about the code they write and the contribution they make to Starling. People with a broad ability to apply themselves to a multitude of problems and challenges, who can work across teams do great things here at Starling, to continue changing banking for good.

We’re seeking highly motivated engineers with around 3-4 years of Java experience to play a key role in our Finance Engineering team. You will take part in writing and supporting key financial systems such as the bank’s ledgers and the systems that integrate with them.

We're looking for engineers who have good attention to detail and can write clear, concise and maintainable code. You should have a good understanding of the lifecycle of a project and be able to engage in this process with internal stakeholders, as well as experience in designing systems to solve problems. Experience with Postgres is highly desirable, and any experience with Netsuite would be a bonus.

We’re open-minded when it comes to hiring; we care more about aptitude and attitude than specific qualifications. We code mostly in Java, with some TypeScript, but you need not be an expert when you join us! We care about the quality and resilience of the systems we build, and if you’re motivated to find elegant solutions to difficult technical problems, we’d love to hear from you.

The main part of our Tech Stack is listed below. We don't ask that you have experience in all of this, but if you do, that's great!
• Java (makes up the majority of our backend codebase)
• Postgres
• AWS & GCP (we're cloud-native)
• Distributed service-based architecture
• Kubernetes (EKS)
• TeamCity for CI/CD (we release our changes frequently throughout the day!)
• Terraform and Grafana

The Team

The Finance Engineering team sits at the core of the bank, and is responsible for the correct accounting of every transaction that passes through the bank's systems. Our team focuses on correctness and accuracy of transactions, on recording the underlying story of money as it moves, and on supporting and automating the complex financial processes that take place behind the scenes.

We work directly with the treasurers and accountants that allow the bank to thrive, and with every project and system within the bank that has financial impact. This is a unique opportunity to work with some of Starling's mission-critical services and products.

Our process:

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:
• Initial phone call - ~45 minutes
• Take home technical test to be discussed in the technical interview - ~3 hours
• Technical interview - ~1.5 hours
• Final Interview - ~40 minutes
• 25 days holiday (plus take your public holiday allowance whenever works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasing

About us

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

Starling is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Starling are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. When you provide us with this information, you are doing so at your own consent, with full knowledge that we will process this personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice.

By submitting your application, you agree that Starling may collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

jobs.title: Head of ICT, EU
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:
• Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM:

Tide is hiring an ICT Manager for Tide Platform S.A. (TPSA), our EU entity. The role is based in Luxembourg and employed by TPSA, reporting locally to Authorised Management and functionally to Tide's Chief Data and Technology Officer. It is the senior technology role in the entity, sits in the first line of defence, and exists because ICT decisions for TPSA are taken in Luxembourg, by the entity.

Tide's group engineering function builds and runs the platform. Your job is to set what TPSA requires of it, verify that it is delivered, approve the changes that affect the entity, and require remediation when our standards are not met. That covers the entity's ICT risk management framework, digital operational resilience strategy, DORA obligations, cloud estate and first line security requirements.

Much of the role is outsourcing. TPSA's technology and business support reach it through an intra-group arrangement with Tide Platform Ltd, our FCA-regulated UK subsidiary, and a third-party estate of thirty arrangements supporting critical or important functions, spanning Luxembourg and our branches and subsidiaries in Germany, France, Bulgaria and Romania. Independent second line oversight sits with our Business Information Security Officer and Operational Risk Manager, and assurance with Internal Audit.

ABOUT

THE ROLE:

As ICT Manager, EU you will:
• Own the entity's ICT Strategy, the ICT project roadmap and digital operational resilience strategy
• Act as Service Owner for the intra-group arrangement with Tide Platform Ltd, setting service levels and evidence rights, monitoring performance and assessing material change
• Direct the outsourcing lifecycle for the entity, from due diligence and contractual protections to registers, monitoring, exit strategy and CSSF notification. We intend for you to take on the Outsourcing Officer mandate, subject to appointment by Authorised Management
• Own the entity's position on criticality and concentration risk across the third-party estate, including cloud, and the exit strategies behind it
• Be accountable for TPSA meeting its DORA obligations in practice: asset and critical function classification, incident management, resilience testing and exit planning
• Set the entity's first line ICT security requirements, verify they are met, and govern how TPSA uses AI
• Report ICT and third-party risk to Authorised Management and the Board Risk and Compliance Committee, and lead our ICT dialogue with the CSSF, including audits and regulatory examinations
• This is the role that makes our EU business real. You will shape how fast we open new European markets, and how much of Tide's platform capability we bring with us.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR: 

The ideal candidate will have:
• Extensive experience running or governing ICT in a regulated financial institution, including DORA delivery
• Deep third-party and outsourcing risk experience across the full lifecycle, from due diligence and contracting to monitoring and exit
• Intra-group delegation models, sub-outsourcing, data location and concentration risk
• Direct experience with the CSSF, and a clear understanding of Luxembourg expectations on local substance
• Fluent in modern cloud and engineering practice, including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and cloud-native architecture, with the depth to form your own view of a cloud configuration
• ISO 27001 ISMS implementation, and frameworks such as NIST CSF and PCI DSS
• The ability to write for a regulator, and the presence to hold your position with a group function that does not report to you
• CISSP, CISM or CISA preferred. Fluent English, with French, German or Luxembourgish useful

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN: 

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
• Compensation - The gross annual salary for this position ranges from €119,000 to €148,750 additionally we offer equity too.
• Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
• Parental Leave – Maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
• Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
• Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
• Volunteering Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
• Learning Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
• Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

 

Disclaimer

 

It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
• Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
• All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
• Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
• Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

 

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Engineering Lead - Account Management
jobs.description:
We're looking for an Engineering Lead to join the Account Management team. This team is building the Current Account and Everyday banking experience products, which sit at the heart of Wise. The team owns how customers hold, organise and move their money day to day - their main account and Jars, the home screen they open, the flows they use to move, convert and add funds - and the ledger and money-movement systems underneath that the rest of the company builds on top of. Our mission is to make Wise the account customers reach for every day, and ultimately the last account they'll need to open.

The role spans engineering, product and people. You'll go broad across all three rather than deep in any one. You'll guide the team, own where it takes its systems technically, and partner with your Product Manager and Design to ship what customers rely on - staying close enough to the code to make sound architectural calls and unblock the team when it matters.

 

What you'll be doing
• Lead the team's engineers - own what they ship and their well-being, and build a clear view of how to grow each of them.
• Stay hands-on: write code, review designs and PRs, and drive whole features across backend, web and mobile, coordinating delivery across all three.
• Own the team's technical roadmap. Decide how the systems evolve, keep reliability and tech-debt risk in check, and make the architectural calls that matter.
• Partner with your PM and Design, and give sharp feedback on what's worth building and why.
• Work across boundaries with the teams we build alongside: Account Sharing on joint accounts, Send on how money moves in and out, Wise Platform on products they build on top of account.

What you'll need to succeed.

We don’t expect candidates to tick all the boxes. If you have most of the below and want to grow into the rest, we'd love to hear from you.

 

Technical
• Strong backend engineering background, close to the code to guide senior engineers through hard problems.
• Deep understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures and microservices, and comfort making high-impact architectural decisions.
• Track record of owning the reliability, scalability and correctness of critical systems at scale.
• Comfortable in a JVM codebase, or confident you'll get there fast - we're on Java/Kotlin and Spring Boot.

Leadership
• Experience leading a team of engineers and owning what they deliver.
• Leadership through trust: you give people context and direction and let them own their work.
• A clear communicator who can hold a technical argument with engineers and explain it plainly to everyone else.

Product
• A product engineer’s mindset - you measure your work by customer and business impact.
• Bias to action and comfort with ambiguity: you move quickly without dropping quality.

Nice to have
• You use AI to build faster, and you're curious where it's heading.
• You've worked in fintech, payments or banking.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for mission-driven senior product engineers to join our Grow squad. We are hiring across two distinct phases of the product lifecycle: scaling a global success and building a new frontier from scratch.

The Mission:

Our goal is for the Wise Account to become the world’s primary financial hub. We’ve already started by helping customers earn over £50m every month on their balances. Now, we’re looking for engineers to help us lead the next evolution of global wealth.

The Work You’ll Do

Assets team:

We are turning the concept of a "bank balance" on its head. We’ve created a current account experience backed by real assets—government rates and global indices—where customers get daily returns with instant access and zero lock-ins.
• The Focus: Scaling a product already live in the UK, EU, Singapore, and Australia.
• The Tech: You’ll be architecting a high-availability "Yield Engine" that manages billions in assets while maintaining bankruptcy-protected custody and seamless, near-instant liquidity.

Investments team:

This is a true zero-to-one engineering challenge. We are moving beyond index funds to let customers invest in individual stocks and build long-term, tax-beneficial money pots (like ISAs and SIPPs) directly inside Wise.
• The Focus: Pure greenfield innovation. You will define the technical foundations, brokerage infrastructure, and trading interfaces from the ground up.
• The Tech: You aren't just shipping features; you are shaping the strategy and code for a brand-new pillar of the Wise ecosystem.

Why this is Unique
• Product Engineering Culture: We don't just hire "coders." We hire owners. You’ll work alongside PMs, Designers, and Analysts to decide what we build, not just how.
• Transparency: We don't hide fees or "eat" the yield. We charge a fair fee and pass the rest to the customer. You’ll be building a product you can actually be proud of.
• Extreme Scale & Precision: Whether you are scaling a global engine or building a stock brokerage, you'll be handling high-concurrency systems where data integrity and consistency are absolute.
• Autonomous Growth: You’ll have the freedom to choose the right tools for the job and the responsibility to fix what you break.

What do you need?

We are fully aware that it is uncommon for a candidate to have all skills required and we fully support everyone in learning new skills with us. So if you have some of those listed below and are eager to learn more we do want to hear from you!
• A strong product mindset and passion for user experience, you prioritise work with the customers in mind and make data-driven decisions to fix customer pain-points
• Great communication skills and the ability to articulate complex, technical concepts to non-technical audiences
• Ability to break down complex projects into incremental milestones that deliver customer value
• Ability to coordinate complex projects across different teams
• Experience in developing web applications and distributed systems in a production environment
• Experience with common design and architectural patterns coupled with a passion for writing clean code that is performant and well tested
• Knowledge of Java and Spring boot and experience with a messaging system, like Kafka, is a plus… but don’t worry we don’t expect you to know everything!

jobs.title: Senior Product Analytics Manager - Wise Business
jobs.description:
Your Mission:

We're looking for a Senior Product Analytics Manager to lead analytics for the Business Account Squad at Wise. 

You’ll lead a team of 5+ analysts who are embedded in the product teams that are building the primary account businesses use for their banking needs - globally! 

The Business Account Squad sits at the heart of our proposition for businesses, building solutions to ensure that businesses can successfully and safely start to use Wise; empowering them with the workflows and controls needed to run their finances globally with ease!

Robust analytical leadership is critical to ensure we proactively leverage data to shape our roadmap and drive high-impact initiatives, ensuring that every product decision makes moving money faster, cheaper, and easier for everyone, everywhere. 

This is an AL2 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here.

 

What you’ll be doing:
• Partner with Product/Engineering/Design leads to identify opportunities to improve our product and bring them to life; review team plans and progress, giving them effective feedback.
• Create and communicate a clear picture of progress against product goals. Ensure that we have clear goals, measurable KPIs, narrate our progress and drive action to accelerate progress.
• Own the data strategy for Business Account Analytics: define the roadmap to build the data and tools necessary to scale impact. Increase the speed and effectiveness of decision making across the squad.
• Lead, develop and support a team of high performing analysts. Support analyst professional development via performance feedback & coaching; hire and plan capacity and ensure that analyst efforts maximise impact.

jobs.title: Lead Analyst - Business Operations - Wise Business
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Lead Product Analysts to support our Business Operations team, working on Wise Business, our international business account. 

The Wise Business account helps small and medium-sized businesses across the world focus on what matters most to them: growth. 

An increasing share of our 625,000+ business customers – and the 45,000+ businesses that join them every month – trust Wise with their day-to-day finances. 

The Business Operations team operates at the intersection of Product and Servicing, ensuring that our servicing scales in line with the evolution of the product whilst tackling key pain points our customers experience in dealing with our servicing teams. 

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
• Derive actionable insights from data to drive the team's strategy and inform product decisions.
• Establish clear goals, define measurable KPIs, and develop compelling narratives to help your team understand their progress.
• Ensure accurate, impactful, fast decision making with high quality analysis, helping us to iterate faster.
• Build automated data pipelines and dashboards to minimise repetitive tasks and allow data self-serve.
• Identify & evaluate high impact opportunities, find ways to support & accelerate or identify and advocate for better alternatives
• Take ownership of complex cross-team projects; in particular help product & operational teams across Wise Business better understand and size the impact of friction originating from their domains on customer retention so they can better prioritize fixing them.

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst - Financial Crime
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Product Analyst who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders to join our Global Fraud Squad. In this role, you’ll help Wise scale safely and efficiently by uncovering gaps in our fraud controls and strengthening our intelligence through analytics. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams to turn insights into action, improving how we detect, prevent, and respond to fraud.

How you’ll contribute

Proactive detection & insights sharing
• Proactively hunt for anomalies, blind spots and gaps in controls using transaction, event and case data.
• Build Rules and features for our detection engine to catch fraudsters.
• Deliver frequent findings and recommended actions to the squad that lead to operational fixes.
• Drive root-cause and cohort analyses to diagnose why controls succeed or fail and propose prioritized remediation.
• Understand customer experience due to our controls and drive continuous improvements.

Drive KPI Performance
• Partner with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Operations and other Analysts to define and own fraud KPIs across Wise products and markets
• Identify, prioritise and drive initiatives with our product managers
• Link business outcomes to control-level metrics, define and own performance for your team

Analytical leadership in new market launches
• Be the primary analytical contact for fraud workstreams on new market launches
• Run pre-launch risk scenario modelling to estimate exposure and operational load.
• Provide clear go/no-go recommendations that balance risk, cost and customer impact.

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Choose your path to impact – pick high-leverage problems, create the vision and own execution.
• Grow as a Product & Fraud Analyst – develop deep fraud domain expertise and combine it with your analytical skills.
• Work cross-functionally – partner with PMs, engineers, analysts, investigators, compliance and operations across markets.
• Be highly visible – your analysis will regularly inform Product and Risk Committees and shape strategic decisions.
• Deliver measurable change – your work will protect millions of customers while enabling Wise’s growth.

jobs.title: Senior Partner Operations Manager (German Speaking)
jobs.description:
About

the role:

EMEA is Wise Platform's largest and most mature market. This role owns the operational relationship and volume retention for a portfolio of Tier 1 partners representing 10M+ GBP in annual revenue across the UK and Germany - some of the most strategically important and technically complex partnerships in Wise Platform globally. Knowledge of payments / cross-border payments industry and German language skills are a essential for this role.

You are a strategic architect and trusted operations and scalability advisor to partner leadership, responsible for identifying and closing operational gaps internally that unlock organic revenue before they become blockers proactively. 

This is not a reactive role.

You'll manage operational relationship of partnerships with complex product integrations (Cards, MCA, Correspondent send via API and Swift, Correspondent receive), navigate high-level stakeholder alignment, and influence Wise's own Product and Servicing roadmaps to ensure the platform evolves to meet the needs of our most demanding partners.

You'll operate with significant autonomy, represent the company with the senior partner’s stakeholders and build the frameworks and playbooks that scale the "Wise way of working" - not just for your own accounts, but across the CSM organisation.

 

Commercial & Relationship Ownership

Own the end-to-end operational relationship for Tier 1 EMEA partners - acting as a trusted advisor to partner-side operational and executive stakeholders, including senior leadership and product teams

Lead QBRs that frame operational performance in the context of commercial goals - shaping the partner's growth narrative and roadmap alignment

Independently drive operational success strategy and plans for owned accounts, partnering closely with the Account Manager to ensure operational roadmap aligns with commercial goals. 

Systemic Problem Solving & Roadmap Influence

Proactively identify and close operational gaps that unlock revenue - e.g. new currency expansion, Cards adoption, or reducing defect/RFI/contact rates that limit partner scalability and growth; 

Build data-backed business cases to secure buy-in from Product, Servicing, Compliance, and Engineering - resolving structural/systemic gaps in the company that affect not just your accounts but the wider Wise Platform partner base;

Represent Wise Platform in cross-functional initiatives, influencing the roadmap before problems surface for partners; 

Incident Command & Crisis Management

Ability to act as incident commander for cross-regional, high-severity incidents - coordinating tech, commercial, and operational stakeholders, drafting partner communications, and making the call on when/how to communicate with partners

Own post-incident follow-through: postmortem actions, remediation reviews, and translating incident learnings into reusable frameworks (runbooks, comms criteria, escalation playbooks)

Scaling the Function

Build frameworks and playbooks - for new products (e.g. metrics reporting or servicing flows on the new product), new markets, or cross-team processes - that scale beyond your own portfolio

Mentor and support other Partner Operations team members, helping them navigate operational blockers and develop their own account strategies

Contribute to the Partner Operations organisation's own scaling agenda - flagging and addressing systemic capacity issues (e.g. disproportionate incident load) to leadership with data to back it up

Data-Driven Operational Excellence

Own the core Service Level and Operational Scalability metrics for your portfolio: Payment Success Rate, Contact Rate, RFI Rate, Defect Rate, and Partner Health Score

Use advanced data analysis to identify non-obvious operational blockers and pitch API/process improvements with clear ROI framing for both partner and Wise

About you:
• Experience in project management, business operations and account management for Tier 1 enterprise clients in payments, fintech, or financial services
• Professional-level German proficiency (spoken and written) - required, given the portfolio will include few German-speaking partners;
• Proven experience working with Tier 1 relationships with $5M+ ARR clients, including executive-level stakeholder management
• Strong technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, webhooks, and payment rails in detail with partner engineering teams
• Experience leading incident/crisis response with external clients, including comms strategy and de-escalation
• Advanced data analysis skills - SQL/Looker/Lightdash or equivalent - used to build business cases;
• Demonstrated negotiation and strong presentation skills; comfortable pitching roadmap changes to senior partner stakeholders.

Bonus points:
• Experience with regulatory frameworks affecting cross-border payments (AML, KYC, sanctions screening, PEP/COAF-type reporting)
• Prior ownership of Tier 1 bank or major fintech relationships in EMEA specifically
• Additional language skills (French, Portuguese) relevant to other Tier 1 EMEA accounts
• Experience working in business operations.

jobs.title: Director, Product Analytics (APAC)
jobs.description:
Salary Range: 230,000 - 318,000 SGD base per annum + RSUs

We’re looking for an Analytics Director for the APAC Squad who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders, to lead a high-impact analytics team that is central to building out the product roadmap for this major Region. This is a unique opportunity to drive decision making in a diverse, high-potential region!

You’ll report to the Global Senior Analytics Director for Regional Expansion, and partner daily with the Product, Banking and Engineering leads for the APAC squad. Together, you will form a cross-functional group of key decision makers who own the challenge of driving the product roadmap in this Region. You’ll also be part of the Analytics community within Wise, giving you access to a global network of analytics professionals.

You’ll lead a team of c.10 passionate product analysts and support them to partner across product teams to drive data-led decision making and ensure robust measurement of the impact of the work we do! You will also support them in identifying insights to inform our planning process - all to ensure that we are enhancing our customer’s experience across the diverse countries in the APAC region. 

If you’ve previously led or helped to build analytics teams in fast-paced, scaling, global companies - we’d love to hear from you. 

Problems you’ll solve

in this role:
• Support the APAC squad to address the most important challenges for the Region using data and insights, and building relevant KPIs to measure impact and hold ourselves accountable
• Develop, coach and support a talented analytics team, unblocking them to influence the strategic roadmap for the Region
• Refine the analytical vision and plan for APAC and contribute to the Regional Analytics strategy globally (we are solving similarly complex problems across all Regions)

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Be part of a positive change in the world. Current banking systems don’t let us send, spend or receive money across borders easily. Or quickly. Or cheaply. So we’re building a new one. Our mission is to make money without borders the new normal
• Have a significant impact by shaping the next phase of analytics in a fast-paced, scaling, global company
• Learn from a global network of professionals. We have a large, diverse team of analysts and data scientists that you will work with and learn from by being part of the Analytics community
• Use all your experience and skills to bring new thinking and ideas to how we build an outstanding analytics function

jobs.title: Product Lead - APAC Growth
jobs.description:
Wise is one of the largest and fastest growing global fintechs. In this role, you’ll shape the strategy and lead development teams driving growth & expansion for Wise Consumer and Wise Business products across all markets in our fastest growing region.

Your mission:
• You’ll walk in the shoes of our customers and define what a seamless localised product looks like - something 10x better than anything else.
• You’ll redefine how people move money around the world - this is a chance to do something that matters, setting a new standard for global finance.
• You’ll define our long-term strategies and roadmaps for how we grow our already launched mature markets in the APAC region
• You’ll lead a team of 4+ Product Managers covering growth across all our APAC markets for Wise Consumer and Business products.

jobs.title: Head of Sanctions Service Delivery
jobs.description:
Your mission:

Wise has already pioneered new ways for people to transfer money across borders and currencies. Our customers can also manage their hard-earned money with the world’s first platform to offer true multi-currency banking.

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Head of Sanctions Service Delivery to Lead our growing Operations Team.

Here’s how you’ll be contributing to the team
• Lead 5 Senior Operations Managers and 500+ Sanctions Agents globally
• Coach, develop and performance manage the team to drive a high performance culture
• Hiring new staff as you build out your team

jobs.title: Billing and Settlement Operations Technical Lead
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Technical Team Lead to take ownership of two critical Global Cards Operations domains: Cards Billing Operations and Cards Settlement Operations. You will sit at the intersection of operations, product, and engineering, leading technical initiatives that drive down costs, eliminate junk fees, and ensure our scheme payouts are executed flawlessly and on time.

As the Technical Team Lead for Cards Billing & Settlements, you will be the operational owner and technical anchor for your domains. You won’t just be keeping the lights on—you will be re-engineering how we work. Your focus will be divided between two core missions:
• Cards Billing Operations: Maintaining and optimizing scheme and partner costs. You will spearhead technical initiatives to increase fee transparency, reconcile complex billing data, and aggressively root out and reduce junk fees.
• Cards Settlement Operations: Ensuring that settlement payouts to card schemes (e.g., Visa, Mastercard) are executed strictly on time, while continuously looking for structural ways to reduce settlement costs.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities & KPIs)
• Drive domain strategy and cost ownership

Define the strategy for Spend Billing and Settlement Operations, with a focus on reducing operational costs with schemes, including Visa and Mastercard while maintaining on-time payout SLAs and strong internal controls.
• Own the yearly roadmap and team OKRs

Translate business priorities into a clear roadmap, actionable OKRs, and team plans that support Product initiatives such as country launches, new products (add-ons, credit), contribution margin improvements, and operational scalability.
• Own Billing and Settlement performance

Be accountable for key domain KPIs, including settlement payout SLA, billing reconciliation rate, cost per transaction and avoidable cost reduction.
• Drive technical problem solving and automation

Lead root-cause analysis for settlement delays, payout discrepancies, billing issues, and control gaps. Ensure that incidents are driven to resolution. Design scalable solutions that reduce manual reconciliation and payout.
• Own audit, compliance, and control readiness

Ensure scheme mandates are effectively rolled out. Act as the main POC for external auditors to provide control evidence and ensure remediation actions are implemented timely. Continuously improve Billing and Settlement processes with appropriate checks, approvals, and accountability.
• Act as the main cross-functional point of contact

Partner with Finance, Treasury, Analysts, Payment Operations, Internal Controls across Tallinn and London to raise or resolve billing and settlement matters including, month-end reporting, internal controls reports, banking integrations (especially with US BIN sponsors).
• Manage, coach, and upskill the team

Directly manage the team, clarify ownership, support performance and growth, and upskill team members in project management, SQL, dashboards, automation thinking, and practical AI usage to improve efficiency.

jobs.title: Fraud Analyst (1 Year Contract)
jobs.description:
We Are:

YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions – YouTrip and YouBiz – empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum’s Global Innovator 2025, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn’s Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions. 

You Will:
• Conduct ongoing fraud alert reviews to identify for fraudulent charges using Fraud Monitoring System (“FMS”) for our consumer and business segments in Singapore and regionally.
• Perform investigations and analysis of all cardholders disputed transactions and make appropriate decisions on next steps, minimising financial losses without compromising customer experience.
• Collaborate with other key business functions to ensure a smooth end-to-end internal process to achieve customer satisfaction and safeguard company’s and users’ interests.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Salesforce
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level — from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.

What you’ll do

As a Salesforce Lead, you will be responsible for designing, testing, implementing, and supporting the Salesforce PaaS/Saas at Brex. You will work closely with functional leaders, organizational units, and subject matter experts to identify, develop and deploy new business processes including: Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Customer Account Management, IT and core business processes. We’re searching for someone with a record of success aligning business processes with Salesforce best practices, translating business requirements into technical specifications, and implementing the solutions. 

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Work collaboratively with functional business units and help translate business requirements into logical technical designs; defining technical solutions in Salesforce.com to support business work processes and bring the design to life through declarative or programmatic solutions
• Participate in cross-functional teams that address strategic business issues across departments (Marketing, Sales, Operations, Support, and others as needed) aligning business processes with Salesforce best practices
• Coordinate the evaluation, scope and completion of new development requests
• Use advanced declarative and programmatic tools to design, build, test, deploy, and support Salesforce solutions
• Coding and development according to current industry standards and best practices
• Manage change management and deployment process for Salesforce code base
• Conduct code reviews for ongoing projects to ensure high code quality and design patterns are followed

Requirements
• 7+ years of progressive experience in Salesforce development with Salesforce implementations in a complex B2B environment
• Ability to assess the impact of new requirements on Salesforce.com and all upstream and downstream applications, systems and processes
• Strong understanding of the Salesforce platform, with the ability to build custom apps and objects, formula fields, workflows, custom views, and other content of intermediate complexity
• Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills with the ability to work with key stakeholders across the organization; manage laterally and upward
• Ability to communicate effectively with diverse people and individuals at various levels within the organization
• Familiarity with advanced Apex programming concepts including core design patterns, limits and bulk patterns, efficient and reliable trigger handling, asynchronous operations and effective unit testing
• Experience with Salesforce APIs to integrate Salesforce with other tools and third-party applications
• Expertise using key Salesforce core programming languages (Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, HTML, XML, JavaScript, CSS, AJAX, SOQL, RestAPIs)
• Experience with CI/CD and deployment techniques in Salesforce
• English proficiency/fluency, both written and speaking (note: interviews will be conducted in English)

Bonus points
• Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I, Platform Developer II, Architect)
• Experience building Slack applications and integrating with Slack
• Experience working in a SCRUM or Agile methodology
• Previous non-Salesforce software engineering experience
• University or College Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related experience
• Front-end development experience with HTML, CSS, and the Lightning Design System
• Experience as a Salesforce Administrator or Business Analyst

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $240,000 - $300,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

As a finance team member, you will have a key role in collaborating with the Strategic Finance team to shape our business and financial strategy, while completing numerous high-impact initiatives at the company. You will help us build unit economic frameworks to better understand our business model to drive continuous improvement of KPIs, while collaborating with cross-functional business partners to evaluate the ROI of products, features, and initiatives. We are looking for an analytical problem-solver with a strategic mindset - someone who can do more than just crunch numbers! A key part of this role is the ability to understand the details while keeping sight of the broader strategy. This is a high-visibility role on a tight knit team. You will work day to day with Product, Analytics, Risk, Growth, Accounting, and Corporate Finance. The StratFin team routinely interacts with senior executives and cross-functional partnership is an everyday occurrence, so effective communication skills are a must!

In this role, you can expect to
• Support the development of unit economic frameworks to evaluate the ROI of various products, features, and business strategies and guide Chime’s decision-making
• Evaluate economic viability and drive strategy for Chime’s new and emerging products

• Guide and partner closely with our Analytics team to create dashboards and KPIs to track product health, as well as evaluate experimental results
• Champion the adoption of AI and automation across the forecast process, compressing close-to-forecast turnaround, standardizing recurring reporting, and reducing manual effort in Pigment and Sheets

• Minimum 4-7 years of relevant experience in strategic finance, FP A, investment banking, consulting, or business intelligence; prior experience at a high-growth technology or financial technology company a plus

Chime is at an inflection point. We're the leader in consumer financial technology, trusted by more than 10 million members. Our next chapter will be built on the strength of our brand, our technology, and our products. 

This role tells that story end to end. You'll lead Product Brand Communications with a clear mandate: make Chime a household name, establish us as the innovator in consumer finance for the AI era, and show mainstream America the full breadth of what we've built for them. You'll drive a step change in our consumer and technology brand and scale the team that gets us there.

You're equally formidable dreaming up a brand campaign that gets the country talking and orchestrating an integrated product launch that makes a splash. You partner closely with Brand Marketing and Product Marketing leadership from the start, shaping campaigns and launches into one cohesive narrative and amplify it across channels. You bring sharp brand and product comms chops, bold ideas, and a bias for action. 

As a member of the Communications leadership team, you'll report to the VP of External Communications and work closely with Marketing, Product, and Engineering leaders.

jobs.description:
About the role

We're looking for a Technical Lead Manager (TLM) to lead our CI/CD team, the group that owns how every Chime engineer builds, integrates, and safely ships code. Your team owns the integration and delivery surface: source and code intelligence (GitHub, Sourcegraph), continuous integration and build (CircleCI, Qlty), artifacts (Artifactory), and the release-safety layer that gets changes to production without breaking it. Your team's mission is continuous, safe, reliable, and efficient integration and delivery of features. Every merge and every deployment at Chime runs through what your team builds.

This is a player-coach role. Under Chime's Builder Operating Model, the TLM is a single accountable owner at the team level. You own both delivery and people for a small team, and you stay hands-on in the codebase. You'll spend about 40%+ of your time building, authoring PRs that land in production, with the remainder split across people management, planning, and other business processes. You'll lead a team of 4 engineers, own the roadmap for a high-leverage platform surface, and be directly accountable for the reliability of the pipelines and release systems in the critical path of every Chime team. You're expected to use AI coding agents and workflows to keep planning, operations, and delivery overhead low so you can stay in the code and operate the team.

In this role, you can expect to
• Build and ship, hands-on. Author and review PRs that land in production. Own the team's technical direction, architecture, and quality bar; partner with senior ICs and lead technical design discussions and technical planning.
• Lead and grow the team. Own full people management for the team: 1:1s, career coaching, performance feedback, promotion decisions, and hiring. Build an inclusive, high-trust team and own its health and engagement. Mentor engineers toward Staff or a future TLM path.
• Own the CI/CD platform. Set direction and delivery for the build and integration systems (GitHub, CircleCI, Artifactory, Sourcegraph, Qlty etc): fast, reliable, self-service pipelines with strong documentation and low-friction adoption so every product team ships faster with less support burden.
• Be accountable for safe delivery at scale. Own the release-safety toolkit (Release Guard, canaries and progressive delivery, feature flagging with Tuner, and rollback) and the operational discipline behind it: incident prevention, incident response, SLAs, and blameless learning for systems in the critical path of every deploy.
• Balance the platform-team tension. Weigh new capabilities against keep-the-lights-on work, security remediation, and dependency upgrades, and make those trade-offs legible to engineers, cross-functional partners, and leadership.
• Champion AI-driven velocity. Use AI coding agents and tooling to scale yourself and your team across planning, coding, and ops/triage, and introduce workflows that measurably improve team velocity.
• Own cross-functional coordination. Serve as the XFN point of contact for your platform's capabilities. Coordinate inbound requests and outbound dependencies, partner with client engineering teams and sibling platform teams (Release Enablement, Developer Foundations) on scope and delivery commitments, and tie-break technical decisions.
• Partner across the Platform Org. Work closely with product engineering teams, security, Core Infrastructure, and other Engineering Services leaders on shared roadmaps, dependencies, and other initiatives.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 5+ years of software engineering experience and 2+ years leading or managing engineers, including hiring, performance management, and career development, with the appetite and ability to stay hands-on in the codebase.
• A track record of delivering CI/CD, build/release, or developer-productivity systems: continuous integration, build pipelines, artifact management, or progressive delivery.
• Hands-on experience with CI systems (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, or comparable), build pipelines, and artifact management in production (must-have).
• Hands-on technical depth you can still exercise: you author and review production PRs and can lead technical design, not just delegate it. Strong development experience in Ruby, Go, Python, or comparable languages.
• Experience with progressive and safe delivery: canaries, release gating, feature flagging, and rollback strategies.
• Strong understanding of operating production systems at scale: reliability, observability, incident response, and the operational discipline platform ownership demands.
• The judgment to balance delivery velocity against safety, reliability, and technical-debt realities, and the communication skills to make those trade-offs clear to engineers and executives alike.
• Demonstrated use of AI coding agents and tooling to accelerate development and team velocity, with a concrete example of the impact on your team's output.
• A customer-obsessed mindset toward internal developers. You measure success by the productivity and reliability experienced by the engineers who build on your platform.
• Excellent written and verbal communication and a collaborative, low-ego approach to cross-team leadership.
• Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Argo CD, or GitOps-based deployment in production.

Nice to haves
• Experience with code intelligence and quality tooling (Sourcegraph, Artifactory, code-quality and linting systems).
• Familiarity with common monitoring, logging, and observability platforms (e.g., Datadog).
• Experience in financial services or other high-reliability, regulated environments.

jobs.title: Data Director, EU
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍 London, Barcelona, or UK Remote | 💰 £150,900 to £204,100 + stock options benefits | ✅ Visa sponsorship relocation available

 

About our Data Discipline 

We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.

Our Data Discipline is deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers and other disciplines. This means Data is not a downstream service, and instead we shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.

 

Our EU team ⭐

Our EU Data team is a full-stack Data team, and together we're building Monzo's presence across Europe from the ground up. We're entering new markets, learning what customers in each one need and finding product-market fit for Monzo. 

 

Our mission is to make money work for everyone, everywhere. As Data Director for EU expansion you'll lead the Data team and shape our product strategy as we grow, deciding where we place our bets, working out what to measure before there's a playbook, and making sure each new market learns fast enough to compound into the next.

 

You'll work closely with EU leadership (our EU CEO, Country Managers and VP of Product) and Monzo's global Leadership team (the CTO, Head of Data and other Data Directors), sitting on the EU Tech Leadership team and helping shape our global data strategy. To do this well you'll need to relish ambiguity, bringing analytical rigour and commercial judgement to bets that often have to be made before the data is complete.

 

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

You'll own the full learning loop that EU expansion runs on, and you'll co-own the product development loop alongside EU Leadership, Product and Engineering. In a new market that often means building those loops from scratch, so you're accountable not just for measuring what happens, but for framing the questions, defining what good looks like, and building the systems that answer them. You'll be a senior voice on the EU Tech Leadership team, the person who reframes the hard problems and puts a number on the trade-off between what's valuable for customers and what's valuable for the business.

Shaping product and commercial strategy:
• You'll decide where Monzo should bet as we enter each new European market, sizing the opportunity and finding product-market fit for the products and segments most likely to win.
• You'll use sharp commercial judgement to work through the ambiguity of building in a new market, from pricing and positioning to the levers that drive growth, bringing Data into strategy early so we shape priorities rather than react to decisions already made.

Owning the data strategy and the learning loops:
• You'll set the data strategy for EU and stand up the foundations each new market needs, from the events we log and the metrics and experiments we design to the forecasts markets learn from.
• Lead the goal-setting process for EU Expansion, bringing clarity to metric selection and target setting, in close partnership with Finance.

Changing how decisions get made:
• You'll represent Data directly at the ExCo level, building a shared language of metrics and analytical reasoning so that Data drives EU strategy rather than reporting on it.
• You'll drive cross-collective collaboration, spotting the high-leverage connections across the business, for example how savings features drive engagement in our Wealth collective.

Building and leading a high-performing team:
• You'll build, grow and retain a high-performing, full-stack Data team, where everyone shares accountability for product and business outcomes.
• You'll raise the performance bar, develop the next generation of Data leaders, and model an inclusive, high-craft Data culture as we scale.

 

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

What we're doing here at Monzo excites you, and the idea of helping take it across Europe especially so!
• You're a strategic data leader who has operated at Director level or above, and you're energised by zero-to-one ambiguity, having built or scaled a data function in a new market, product line or business from an early stage.
• You move comfortably from detailed metrics and data architecture to customer strategy, commercial outcomes and product-market fit, and you're happy to be the opinionated voice in the room that reframes the trade-off.
• You lead through learning loops and hold a high technical bar, because you've built or owned the measurement a business relies on to set goals, run experiments and improve, with the judgement to know which methods and investments will pay off.
• You have experience leading company-wide or division-wide goal-setting, defining high-clarity metrics, setting targets and partnering closely with Finance.
• You change how organisations make decisions, not just how one project turns out, and you have experience of the cross-collective collaboration that connects the dots across different business areas.
• You're an empathetic people leader who has grown full-stack Data teams of both individual contributors and managers, comfortable representing Data at ExCo and to C-level peers, and you know what it takes to attract, develop and retain top talent.

 

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps
• 30 minute recruiter call
• 45 minute call with the hiring manager

jobs.title: Product Manager - Product Factory
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a passionate, technically-minded Product Manager - Product Factory to join our Core Systems team. Our mission is to disrupt traditional core banking technology standards by building highly configurable, modular, and automated solutions that enable rapid financial product launches across Europe, backed by automated compliance and seamless data flows.

The Core Systems segment is split between our Barcelona and Berlin, which serve as the primary product and tech hubs for N26 globally.

What is the "Product Factory"?

The Product Factory is the central engine room of N26’s core banking platform. Rather than hardcoding software from scratch for every new country or account type, the Product Factory builds the modular "building blocks" (flexible APIs, internal configuration engines, and a centralized product catalog) of the bank.

As the Product Manager for this group, you will own the internal platforms that allow N26 to dynamically mix, match, and launch new financial products (like specialized savings accounts, premium tiers, or localized lending features) in a highly competitive, scalable, and compliant manner.

In this role you will:
• Build Internal Self-Service Tools: Drive the strategy and execution for self-service product configuration and orchestration tools, enabling internal regional and market teams to launch or modify financial products without needing engineering intervention.
• Own Platform Strategy Roadmap: Define and execute the roadmap for N26's core product infrastructure, including the orchestration of transactional and gateway data flows that power our underlying financial systems.
• Manage the Central Product Catalog: Maintain and scale the central system of record for N26's financial features, interest rates, limits, and fee structures, ensuring high system availability and data integrity.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with other product managers, designers, and core engineers to continuously improve N26's platform architecture, ensuring it aligns with global business goals.
• Navigate Compliance Rollouts: Work closely with cross-functional domains, including Local Market Teams, Legal, Operations, and Compliance to ensure that automated compliance guardrails are baked directly into the Product Factory framework for seamless market rollouts.
• Vendor Third-Party Integration: Oversee technical relationships and integrations with high-engagement third-party core banking providers and external financial vendors.

What you need to be successful:
• Experience:

4+ years of Product Management experience, ideally gained within a FinTech, modern banking environment, core banking provider, or a highly complex platform/API-driven ecosystem.
• Technical Data Acumen: Strong familiarity with backend architectures, relational databases, system integrations, and building/managing internal API products. You speak the language of engineering effortlessly.
• Domain Knowledge: Proven experience working with centralized digital product catalogs, configuration engines, or complex financial orchestration systems.
• Vendor Management: Previous experience managing high-engagement third-party vendors and aligning external roadmaps with internal engineering goals is a major plus.
• Education: Undergraduate degree in a STEM field, Business, or Economics. An MBA, MS, or equivalent advanced degree is a plus.
• Execution Communication: An autonomous, adaptive operator with an entrepreneurial mindset, a strong bias for action, and exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
• Agile Mastery: A deep understanding of agile product development, continuous integration, and scalable delivery practices.

What’s in it for you:
• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
• Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds.
• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

Equal opportunities for all

At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.

We are committed to providing an excellent and accessible candidate experience. If you require any accommodations to make this process work for you, please let us know. We’re here to support you!

Discover more about Diversity Inclusion at N26: https://n26.com/en-eu/diversity-and-inclusion
