jobs.title: Senior Finance Manager, Settlement & Reconciliation
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity
• We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager, Settlement Reconciliation to lead and enhance our settlement and reconciliation operations across both digital assets and fiat.
• This role requires more than strong settlement operational experience. The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of trading and settlement system architecture, including how settlement systems interact with trading platforms, transaction data, custody/banking infrastructure, and finance/accounting systems.
• The role will serve as a key bridge between Finance, Settlement Operations, Product, Engineering, and other relevant stakeholders, translating settlement and accounting requirements into clear system, data, and reporting requirements.
• Candidates with experience in traditional financial markets, securities, banking, brokerage, clearing, custody, or other transaction-intensive financial institutions are highly preferred.
• The successful candidate will build a settlement and reconciliation function that is not only operationally effective, but also system-driven, highly reconcilable, and finance-ready.
• The individual should be able to understand a transaction from execution through settlement, reconciliation, and ultimately financial accounting, and work across Operations, Finance, Product, Data, and Engineering to ensure that the underlying processes and systems are scalable, controlled, and transparent.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Settlement Operations
- Lead and oversee day-to-day settlement operations across digital asset and fiat transactions.
- Ensure transactions are settled accurately, completely, and within the required timelines.
- Establish and continuously improve settlement procedures, controls, exception handling, and escalation mechanisms.
- Identify settlement breaks, operational risks, and process inefficiencies, and drive timely resolution.
- Support new products, transaction flows, and business models by assessing their settlement and operational requirements.
• Settlement System System Architecture
- Develop a strong understanding of the end-to-end settlement system architecture and transaction data flow.
- Understand how settlement systems interface with:
 - Trading systems and order/transaction engines;
 - Wallet, custody, and blockchain infrastructure;
 - Fiat banking and payment systems;
 - Data warehouse and reporting platforms; and
 - Finance, accounting, and general ledger systems.
- Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to define settlement-related system requirements.
- Translate operational and finance requirements into clear and actionable data, system, and reporting specifications for Engineering teams.
- Define the reports, data fields, transaction-level information, and reconciliation logic required to support settlement operations and financial accounting.
- Participate in system implementation, enhancement, UAT, and post-implementation validation from a settlement and finance-control perspective.
• Digital Asset Reconciliation
- Own and oversee Digital Asset (DA) reconciliation, including reconciliation among customer balances, internal ledgers, wallet/on-chain balances, custody records, and other relevant source systems.
- Investigate and resolve reconciliation differences, including transaction timing differences, system exceptions, missing transactions, and data inconsistencies.
- Work with Product, Engineering, Data, Wallet, and Finance teams to identify root causes and implement sustainable remediation.
- Establish appropriate reconciliation controls and monitoring mechanisms to ensure completeness and accuracy of digital asset balances and movements.
• Fiat Reconciliation
- Own and oversee Fiat reconciliation across customer balances, banking/custodian records, payment channels, internal operational systems, and the general ledger.
- Ensure customer fiat assets and liabilities can be reconciled to relevant operational and accounting records.
- Investigate reconciliation breaks and coordinate with Finance, Fiat Operations, Product, Engineering, banks, custodians, and payment service providers for resolution.
- Drive automation and system improvements to reduce manual reconciliation and operational dependency.
• Customer Transaction Reconciliation
- Oversee transaction-level reconciliation covering customer trades, deposits, withdrawals, transfers, settlements, and other relevant transaction activities.
- Ensure customer transaction records can be traced consistently across trading, settlement, operational, and accounting systems.
- Establish effective exception-management processes for unmatched or incomplete transactions.
- Support Finance and external audit requirements by ensuring transaction data and reconciliation evidence are complete, accurate, and traceable.
• Finance Accounting Support
- Partner closely with Finance to ensure settlement data and reports provide sufficient information for accurate and timely accounting.
- Understand how trading and settlement activities ultimately flow into financial records and the general ledger.
- Define operational reports and data outputs required by Finance for:
 - Accounting entries;
 - Period-end closing;
 - Balance sheet reconciliation;
 - Customer asset and liability reconciliation; and
 - Financial and external audit support.
- Identify gaps between operational systems and accounting requirements and work with relevant teams to develop scalable solutions.
• Process, Control Team Management
- Build and maintain robust settlement and reconciliation SOPs, controls, and governance frameworks.
- Drive automation and process improvements to improve settlement efficiency, accuracy, scalability, and control.
- Establish key operational metrics and monitor settlement exceptions, reconciliation breaks, aging items, and resolution timelines.
- Manage and develop the settlement team, ensuring clear ownership, effective prioritization, and strong execution.
- Act as a senior escalation point for complex settlement, reconciliation, and transaction-related issues.
- Collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders across Finance, Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and other relevant teams.

 

What We Look For In You
• Bachelor’s degree or above in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
• Significant experience in settlement, clearing, reconciliation, transaction operations, custody, or related financial operations, with experience in a managerial or senior leadership role.
• Strong experience with customer transaction reconciliation and transaction-level data analysis.
• Solid understanding of trading lifecycle and settlement processes.
• Prior experience in traditional financial institutions, such as banks, securities firms, broker-dealers, exchanges, clearing houses, custodians, payment institutions, or other transaction-intensive financial businesses.
• Strong understanding of how trading systems, settlement systems, reconciliation platforms, and accounting systems interact.
• Ability to understand system and data architecture and translate operational or finance requirements into clear requirements for Product and Engineering teams.
• Strong experience in designing or defining operational reports, reconciliation reports, and transaction-level data requirements.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex reconciliation differences and identify root causes.
• Strong understanding of operational controls, data completeness, accuracy, and transaction traceability.
• Excellent stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both Finance and technical teams.
• Strong ownership mindset and ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced and evolving business environment.

 

Nice to Haves
• Experience in cryptocurrency, digital assets, exchanges, fintech, brokerage, or other high-volume transaction platforms.
• Hands-on experience with digital asset / wallet / on-chain reconciliation.
• Experience with fiat payment, banking, custodian, or payment-service-provider reconciliation.
• Experience participating in settlement or reconciliation system implementation and transformation projects.
• Experience working with Product and Engineering teams on system design, data requirements, reporting logic, UAT, and process automation.
• Familiarity with accounting systems, general ledger processes, and period-end financial reconciliation.
• Experience supporting internal or external audit requests relating to transaction completeness, settlement, or reconciliation.
• SQL, data analytics, or other data-querying experience would be an advantage.

 

Perks Benefits

jobs.title: CSシステム企画（データ基盤推進・分析推進担当）
jobs.description:
PayPayについて/About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

 

業務について

▼CS本部 CSシステム企画部のご紹介
PayPayのCS部門のミッションである「そもそも困らせない」「困ってもすぐに解決できるようにする」の実現を目指し、ユーザーファーストの視点で日々の業務・運用改善に取り組んでいます。今回、そのなかでCSシステム企画部で複数名の採用募集をしております。急速なサービス成長、顧客数増加に伴いPayPayが提供するカスタマーサポートの利用者も増加しております。「人と機械を融合させて顧客体験を最大・最適化」をMissionに掲げ、ユーザーにより簡単に迅速に問題を解決できるようシステムによる高度化を進めています。配属予定部署は30歳代を中心に総勢20名ほどの組織です。企画から要件定義書の作成、開発依頼、運用保守など幅広くCSシステムに携わり、お客様が努力せず問題解決できるカスタマーサポートを提供できるように業務を進めてます。

▼募集の背景
カスタマーサポート領域では、生成AIの活用が急速に拡大しています。
これまで人が行ってきた問い合わせ対応の一部をAIが担うようになる中、今後は「AIを導入する」だけではなく、「AIの回答が適切だったのか」「どこに改善余地があるのか」をデータから継続的に評価し、精度を高めていくことが重要になります。
また、CSには問い合わせログ、応対履歴、顧客行動など多くのデータが蓄積されています。これらを活用し、顧客体験や業務効率の改善につなげるデータ分析機能についても、さらに強化していく必要があります。
そこで、生成AIとデータ分析の両面から課題を発見し、改善まで推進できる人材を募集します。

【具体的な業務内容】
急成長するPayPayのカスタマーサポート領域において、生成AIエージェントの利用が拡大するなかで、単に定量データやナレッジだけではなく、過去の判断データなどの非定型・データ構造化未対応のデータ整備の重要性がさらに高まっています。また、生成AIによる分析やデータ取り扱いの民主化が進むにつれ、データ分析基盤の整備・高度化も急務になっています。そうした、CS領域のデータ基盤・分析基盤の整備・利活用推進を担当いただきます。

●CSシステム企画担当（データ・分析推進担当）
・生成AIエージェントの品質評価、データ分析、継続的な精度改善
・問い合わせログや顧客行動データ等の収集・統合・分析
・CS領域におけるKPI設計、ダッシュボード構築・可視化
・データ分析を起点とした課題発見、改善施策の立案・効果検証
・生成AI／データ活用に必要なデータ基盤・ガバナンスの整備
・経営、開発部門、CS部門、関連部署とのプロジェクト推進

 

▼本ポジションの魅力
• カスタマーサポートを支えるシステムについて幅広く触れることができます
• 上流工程（企画設計など）〜下流工程（運用保守）まで一貫して携わることができるため導入後のエンハンスなど結果について追い求めることが可能です
• AIを活用したこれまでにないカスタマーサポートプラットフォームを構築中であり新しい技術、仕組みを体験、習得できます
• 本部署ではコールシステムエンジニア、データアナリスト、プロジェクトマネージャーなど様々な職種の方が在籍しており多くのことを学ぶことができます

必要な経験/スキル

・SQL等を用いたデータ抽出・集計・分析の実務経験
・BIツール等を活用したデータ可視化・ダッシュボード構築経験
・データ分析から課題を特定し、改善施策の立案・効果検証まで実施した経験
・生成AI・LLMをはじめとした新しいテクノロジーへの関心があり、自ら学習・活用できる方
・ビジネス課題を整理し、データ・システムを活用した解決策へ落とし込める方
・エンジニア・CS・企画など複数の関係者と協働してプロジェクトを推進できる方

・自発的に学習し、常に最新のテクノロジーを取り入れる意欲のある方
・チームワークを大切にし、協力して業務を進められる方
・ビジネスニーズを技術的なソリューションに変換することが得意な方

・CS拠点（四谷、札幌、福岡）への出社・出張が問題ないこと

あると望ましい経験/スキル

・提案力、交渉、調整力
・生成AI／LLMを活用したサービス・業務改善の経験
・AI・チャットボット・音声Bot等の回答精度分析／品質改善経験
・プロンプト設計、RAG、ナレッジマネジメントに関する知識・経験
・Python等を用いたデータ分析・データ加工経験
・BigQuery等のデータウェアハウスを利用した分析経験
・Tableau、Looker、Power BI等のBIツール利用経験
・A/Bテストや施策効果検証、KPI設計の経験
・カスタマーサポート／コンタクトセンター領域のデータ分析経験
・大規模な問い合わせログ・テキストデータの分析経験

PayPayが求める人物像

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Gold Growth
jobs.location: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

Robinhood Gold is our premium membership and one of the most important businesses at Robinhood. For one monthly fee, Gold members unlock a bundle of benefits, including boosted APY on uninvested cash, an IRA match, lower margin rates, professional research, access to the Robinhood Gold Card, and more. The Gold Growth team is responsible for growing that membership: how customers discover Gold, why they start a trial, what convinces them to become paying members, and what keeps them subscribed. Because Gold touches nearly every product at Robinhood, we reach customers across the entire app, and our work directly drives subscription revenue and how much of their financial lives customers choose to bring to Robinhood.

As Senior Product Manager, Gold Growth, you will own key levers of the Gold growth funnel and be accountable for business outcomes, not just feature metrics. You will decide where to invest across acquisition, trial-to-paid conversion, engagement, and retention, make clear trade-offs between growth, member value, and unit economics, and partner closely with data science to run high-velocity experiments, and read results with rigor. You will work hand in hand with design to craft simple, compelling consumer experiences, and you will operate with a high degree of autonomy: taking ambiguous problems, forming a point of view, and driving them to launch with little day-to-day guidance.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do
• Own the strategy and roadmap for Gold growth across the full member lifecycle, from discovery and trial to paid conversion, activation of benefits, and long-term retention.
• Drive business impact end to end, including new member growth, trial-to-paid conversion, churn reduction, and member lifetime value. Tie every product bet to the outcomes that matter for the business, not just the next metric on a dashboard.
• Build and run a high-velocity experimentation program with data science: generate hypotheses, size opportunities, design A/B tests, and turn results into decisions you scale or kill quickly.
• Make hard trade-off decisions across growth, member experience, and economics (for example, offers and pricing versus long-term profitability), back them with clear reasoning and data, and bring stakeholders along with you.
• Work hand in hand with design and engineering to build intuitive, persuasive consumer experiences, sweating the details of the entry points, paywalls, onboarding flows, copy, and UI that shape how millions of customers experience Gold.
• Operate as the owner of your area: find the highest-leverage growth opportunities, write the plan, rally partners across engineering, design, marketing, finance, legal, and compliance, and ship with minimal oversight.

What you bring
• You have 4+ years of product management experience, including at least 2 years building consumer-facing products where you owned the end-to-end UI/UX alongside design partners.
• You have a track record of driving measurable business outcomes in a growth context (acquisition, paid conversion, retention, revenue, or unit economics) and can clearly explain how your product decisions moved them.
• You have strong product judgment and are comfortable making trade-offs under ambiguity. You form opinionated recommendations, defend them with data, and change course when the evidence says so.
• You are analytically fluent and have partnered closely with data scientists on experimentation, funnel analysis, opportunity sizing, and impact measurement. Comfort digging into the data yourself is a plus.
• You hold a high bar for consumer craft. You care about the details of a great experience and can articulate why one design converts better than another.
• You are a self-starter who executes independently, creates clarity for others, and needs little guidance to take a problem from idea to shipped product.

What we offer
• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
• Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
• Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
• Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not
• Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
• Employer-paid life disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
• Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
• Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Together, these functions form a complete picture of what it takes to protect one of the most active financial platforms in the world. The team operates in an environment of genuine complexity: high-volume security events, sophisticated threat actors, and a constant arms race against adversaries who are increasingly leveraging AI to move faster and go deeper.

The threat landscape is changing. AI-powered attackers don't move like traditional adversaries — they are faster, more adaptive, and harder to track with static defenses. Robinhood's approach to this isn't passive. We are building dynamic, intelligent defensive systems designed to detect, deceive, and outmaneuver agentic attackers — and we need a Senior Staff Security Engineer to help us build them.

As a Senior Staff Security Engineer, Security Operations, you will operate at the intersection of operational security tradecraft and cutting-edge AI-driven defense. You will bring deep expertise across both the offensive and defensive sides of security operations and you will push the boundaries of what's possible when those disciplines are combined with modern AI tooling. This is a 0→1 technical leadership role for someone who doesn't just follow the security playbook, but looks to rewrite it.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, New York City, or Bellevue office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

• Lead offensive security research— applying deep red team, penetration testing, and application security expertise to proactively identify and close critical attack surfaces before adversaries find them
• Architect and build next-generation defensive capabilities that go beyond static detection — designing intelligent systems that actively engage, deceive, and track sophisticated threat actors including AI-powered attackers
• Drive Robinhood's AI-forward security strategy — not just using AI as a productivity tool, but as a core architectural component of how we build a synthetic workforce to scale against agentic and automated adversaries
• Identify emerging threat actor motivations and attack patterns especially in the AI space, translating intelligence into proactive defensive architectures that stay ahead of the threat curve
• Set technical standards and mentor security engineers within Security Operations, elevating the overall capability of the org

What you bring
• 12+ years of security engineering experience with demonstrated depth across both offensive security (red team, penetration testing, application security, vulnerability management) and defensive security (incident response, detection engineering, threat intelligence)
• Demonstrate impact by innovating with AI in Security Operations — You’ve moved orgs well beyond the chatbot experience and implemented measurable success in uplifting Security Operations with AI.
• Proven track record of technical leadership at the Senior Staff, Principal, or Distinguished level — you've set org-wide or company-wide security direction, not just executed within a team
• Deep expertise in application security — you understand how modern software is built and where it breaks, and you can operate equally well as a security engineer and a software engineer
• Strong background in threat detection and security operations — you understand how attackers operate and how to build systems that catch them faster
• A genuine, informed point of view on AI in the security domain — you're not using AI to write scripts, you're thinking about how AI fundamentally changes both the attack surface and the defensive toolkit
• Proficiency with cloud infrastructure security (AWS preferred), telemetry and observability tooling, and the technical underpinnings of large-scale detection pipelines
• Exceptional technical communication skills — you can write, brief, and influence at the executive level as well as go deep with engineers on implementation details

jobs.title: Senior Manager Credit Operations
jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Credit Operations to build and lead SoFi Bank's specialized credit operations function across residential and Commercial loans. This role will oversee complex workflows across the credit lifecycle, including scenario intake, underwriting exceptions, condo and co-op project reviews, complex residential underwriting, and Commercial small-balance CRE underwriting and portfolio management.

This l functional owner will set the operating model, priorities, resourcing, service standards, KPIs, KRIs, and governance routines for the function. The Senior Manager will partner closely with Sales, Operations, Underwriting, Credit Policy and Administration, Risk, Product, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Servicing, and senior leadership to deliver sound credit judgment, scalable processes, clear accountability, and a consistent member and business-partner experience.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned credit leader with deep expertise in residential and commercial lending, particularly jumbo and portfolio underwriting, HNW and UHNW borrower profiles, complex refinances, and small-balance CRE underwriting and portfolio management. This is an opportunity to define an important capability at the intersection of credit judgment, operating design, policy, and member experience.

What you'll do

Build and lead the Credit Operations function
• Set the strategy, operating model, priorities, and service standards for specialized credit operations across residential and Commercial loans.
• Lead day-to-day planning, prioritization, intake, complexity tiering, routing, escalation paths, and decision ownership for scenarios, exceptions, complex underwriting, and project reviews.
• Establish KPIs, KRIs, reporting standards, operating routines, and quality expectations for volume, aging, cycle time, service levels, rework, exception trends, and capacity.
• Build the function in phases, using demand, complexity, service levels, quality, and outcomes to guide staffing, workforce planning, and future investment.

Lead complex residential underwriting scenarios and exceptions
• Oversee jumbo, portfolio, high-balance, high-LTV, and other non-conforming transactions, including complex refinances and cash-out refinance structures.
• Guide decisions involving HNW and UHNW borrowers, complex liquidity and reserves, asset depletion, RSU and equity compensation, self-employed and business income, complex tax returns, trusts or LLCs where permitted, and layered risk.
• Own the front door for residential scenarios from Sales and Operations, providing early guidance on credit viability, structure, documentation, risks, and likely escalation requirements.
• Operationalize exception reviews with clear intake requirements, recommendation packages, approval routing, decision tracking, and recurring-theme analysis.

Lead Commercial small-balance CRE underwriting and portfolio management
• Lead small-balance CRE underwriting and portfolio management across origination, credit administration, annual reviews, renewals, modifications, portfolio monitoring, and borrower management.
• Oversee borrower and guarantor analysis, property cash flow, leverage, debt service, liquidity, structure, collateral, repayment sources, and other core elements of small-balance CRE credit.
• Set quality and turnaround standards for deal preparation, financial statement spreading and analysis, annual reviews, renewals, modifications, and other portfolio-credit activities.
• Partner with Commercial relationship managers, the CRE Development team, portfolio managers, credit officers, and business leaders to improve submission quality, portfolio discipline, and borrower outcomes.
• Monitor portfolio performance, credit quality, concentrations, collateral trends, and emerging risks; escalate material credit, operational, compliance, or servicing matters promptly.

Lead condo and co-op project reviews
• Lead the specialized condo and co-op project review function when agency or government approval is unclear, lender review is required, or portfolio lending is being considered.
• Oversee documentation, eligibility, curability, risk evaluation, conditions, overlays, escalation recommendations, and decision tracking for non-warrantable projects.
• Create review standards, decision guides, checklists, training, and escalation triggers that improve consistency for Operations and Underwriting.

Connect Credit Operations to Credit Policy and Administration
• Create the feedback loop from scenario requests, exception themes, underwriting outcomes, and condo and co-op reviews into Credit Policy and Administration.
• Partner on guideline updates, overlays, decision guides, training, and implementation so operational learnings are incorporated into the broader credit framework.
• Capture recurring questions, ambiguous guidance, documentation gaps, and precedent themes; translate them into policy clarification, process improvements, product requirements, or targeted training.
• Maintain clear traceability from the initial request through the decision, escalation, policy response, and change-management outcome.

Partner across the business and develop the team
• Build trusted partnerships with Sales so complex borrowers receive timely, clear, and commercially practical guidance before significant origination effort is incurred.
• Partner with Operations and the second line of defense on intake quality, handoffs, service levels, documentation expectations, escalation triggers, and the routing of routine versus specialized work.
• Align with Credit Decisions and Insights, Product, Valuation, Default, Capital Markets, Servicing, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and other control partners when work crosses functions.
• Hire, coach, and develop a team that values disciplined judgment, constructive challenge, responsiveness, documentation quality, and shared accountability across Home Loans and Commercial.
• Lead responsible use of AI-enabled research and decision-support tools within a human-in-the-loop control model; use workflow data and recurring questions to improve knowledge and consistency.

Skills that make someone successful in this role
• Deep experience in residential lending and commercial lending, including mortgage credit, secured lending, commercial real estate lending, commercial credit, portfolio management, underwriting, or credit administration.
• Strong understanding of jumbo and portfolio underwriting, complex refinances, high-LTV transactions, non-conforming credit, and specialized borrower profiles.
• Experience evaluating HNW and UHNW borrowers, including complex liquidity and reserve structures, asset depletion, equity compensation, self-employed income, complex tax returns, and layered risk.
• Experience leading small-balance commercial real estate underwriting and portfolio management, including borrower and guarantor analysis, property cash flow, leverage, debt service, liquidity, collateral, structure, and portfolio monitoring.
• Ability to solve highly complex credit and operational problems, exercise sound judgment in ambiguity, and make recommendations with clear rationale and disciplined escalation.
• Experience building operating models, managing workflows and resourcing, and developing KPIs, KRIs, credit quality metrics, portfolio reporting, and management-level updates.
• Strong understanding of bank credit policy, risk appetite, portfolio governance, regulatory expectations, audit readiness, controls, and consistent execution.
• Ability to influence senior leaders, Sales, Operations, Credit Policy, Underwriting, and control partners without relying solely on formal authority.
• Demonstrated experience leading teams through growth, process improvement, modernization, or operating-model change.
• Strong discipline around documentation, policy adherence, fair-lending awareness, governance, and responsible use of technology in credit decision support.

Qualifications
• 12 or more years of experience in residential mortgage underwriting, commercial lending, commercial real estate credit, credit risk, portfolio management, or a related financial services discipline, including at least 5 years of underwriting leadership or credit team management experience.
• Significant experience leading residential and commercial credit underwriting, portfolio management, credit administration, exceptions, scenario management, or a comparable specialized credit function, preferably within a regulated bank or financial institution.
• Deep experience underwriting or overseeing jumbo and portfolio transactions, including complex refinances and cash-out refinances.
• Experience evaluating HNW and UHNW borrowers and complex sources of repayment, liquidity, reserves, asset depletion, equity compensation, self-employed income, and layered risk.
• Experience leading small-balance commercial real estate underwriting and portfolio management, including deal preparation, financial statement spreading, annual reviews, renewals, modifications, and portfolio monitoring.
• Experience with condo and co-op project eligibility, non-warrantable projects, lender reviews, or portfolio project-risk assessment.
• Experience managing day-to-day operations, planning, prioritization, execution, resourcing, service levels, and capacity for a team or function.
• Experience modernizing credit policies, underwriting standards, operating procedures, reporting frameworks, controls, governance routines, or decision-support tools.
• Experience leading teams, developing talent, and managing individual contributors, specialized underwriters, analysts, portfolio managers, or other credit professionals.
• Familiarity with bank regulatory expectations, audit, loan review, fair-lending oversight, regulatory exams, credit loss forecasting, or enterprise risk management.

Compensation and Benefits

This role will be instrumental in conceptualizing, prototyping and implementing best-in-class AI-based solutions to meet risk management and compliance requirements.

This hands-on role will work closely with the Director of Risk Analytics, and will leverage your deep expertise to solve our hardest problems, mentor the next generation of engineers, and directly connect technical innovation to major business success. This is a crucial role for the independent risk function as we execute our mission to help more members get their money right.

What you’ll do:
• Architecture and Strategy: Define the long-term technical architecture and strategy for our next-generation AI platform, particularly focusing on robust, scalable agentic frameworks and LLM deployment patterns.
• Advanced LLM Orchestration: Architect and standardize the use of graph-based LLM orchestration, leveraging expert-level mastery of LangGraph to solve highly complex, multi-stage reasoning problems at scale.
• Distributed Agent Memory State: Develop robust, persistent infrastructure for agentic state management, ensuring that long-running agent workflows maintain context and reliability across distributed nodes and regional failovers
• Deep Model Optimization: Pioneer and institutionalize advanced parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) and compression techniques to maximize model performance and minimize operational costs across the organization.
• Model Serving Infrastructure: Support the development of a unified model serving platform designed to host internally fine-tuned and custom-trained models to ensure high-throughput, low-latency inference across diverse hardware footprints.
• Operational Excellence: Define and enforce high standards for AI operationalization, requiring mastery in designing and deploying comprehensive AI observability solutions and advanced tracing/testing frameworks that guarantee production quality, compliance, and reliability.
• Mentorship: Mentor senior and junior AI Engineers, elevating the overall engineering quality
• Cross Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with cross-functional teams to distill specific requirements, project roadmaps, and ensure accurate and on-time project deliveries
• AI Innovation: Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and advancements in GenAI, LLMs, and NLP, evaluating and experimenting with new techniques and tools to push the boundaries of AI innovation in the banking sector.

What you’ll need:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, or a related field. PhD is a plus.
• 8+ years software development experience, with 3+ years of hands-on experience in developing and successfully deploying production-level AI applications that have been used by real customers or internal stakeholders.
• Expert-level experience with LangGraph to model and orchestrate complex, stateful multi-step reasoning and control flow in LLM applications.
• Expert-level proficiency in developing sophisticated agentic solutions, with a portfolio demonstrating advanced use of planning, memory management, tool integration, and control flow.
• Deep understanding of Large Language Model (LLM) architectures, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and advanced text generation techniques.
• Proven experience implementing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) techniques (e.g., LoRA) to customize and optimize pre-trained models for specific tasks with minimal computational overhead.
• Deep expertise in building or extending inference engines (e.g., vLLM, NVIDIA Triton, or TGI) and managing the underlying Kubernetes/GPU orchestration for custom model deployments.
• Deep experience designing and institutionalizing AI observability solutions (e.g., LangSmith, Arize, Deepchecks) and advanced tracing and testing methodologies for LLM and agentic systems.
• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
• Expert level Python is required.
• React is strongly preferred.
• Experience with large-scale data handling, including unstructured and structured data pipelines, with a strong preference for Snowflake and DynamoDB.
• Experience developing and integrating AI-powered APIs and microservices architecture into banking applications.
• Experience with vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) techniques using systems like Elasticsearch, Pinecone, or FAISS for enhancing LLM performance.
• Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical concepts, drive consensus among senior technical leaders, and influence organizational AI strategy.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and an ability to work with complex, large-scale systems.
• Strong collaboration skills, with experience working in agile, cross-functional teams.

jobs.location: NC - Charlotte; FL - Jacksonville; TX - Frisco

Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager / Lead to own the product charter for Borrow Operations technology, with a strong focus on our Home Lending business.

A product manager charter defines the product's vision, scope, and business goals. This role uses that charter to lead cross-functional teams in discovering, building, and delivering a solution that operators and members rely on and that drives sustainable business value.

This is a Senior Manager role (M4). It owns one of IT Operations' most complex companywide programs: the application ecosystem that runs Home Lending from origination through underwriting, closing, and servicing. The leader sets direction, prioritizes the roadmap, and is accountable for reliability, control, and operational outcomes across Encompass 360, Blend, NICE inContact, SoFi-developed applications, and the vendor platforms connected to them.

The role leads a growing team of individual contributors who independently administer, configure, integrate, and automate the Home Lending application portfolio. They set the product vision, sequence the work, clear cross-functional blockers, and hold the team to outcomes: less manual work, faster fulfillment, stronger controls, and a platform that scales with Borrow volume.

The ideal candidate combines product judgment with enough technical fluency to partner credibly with application administrators, engineering, risk, compliance, and Home Lending operations. They are comfortable making decisions where the right product shape is not yet defined, and they know when a choice has long-range implications that need leadership alignment.

What You'll Do
• Own the product charter for Borrow Operations technology: vision, scope, success measures, and the business goals the roadmap exists to hit.
• Set and sequence the Home Lending application roadmap across origination, underwriting, document management, eSignature and eVault, bureau and third-party integrations, payments, servicing, regulatory data feeds, and employee lifecycle support.
• Lead a new team focused on the Borrow and Home Lending lines of business. Plan their work, coach them, and make resourcing and priority calls so day-to-day administration, projects, and platform improvements stay in balance.
• Lead cross-functional discovery with Home Lending Operations, Engineering, Product, Risk, Compliance, Security, Identity and Access Management, and vendors. Turn operational friction into scoped problems and delivered solutions.
• Decide what to build, configure, automate, or stop. Assess alternatives, operational risk, regulatory impact, and cost, and shape how IT supports Borrow operations.
• Influence function-level decisions by partnering with senior individual contributors and IT and business leadership. Consult leadership when a choice has long-range implications for the platform, the control environment, or the operating model.
• Hold the team accountable for reliability, security, and auditability of Encompass 360, Blend, NICE inContact, SoFi-developed applications, and related integrations, including SOX and regulatory requests.
• Sponsor automation that removes repeatable manual work in provisioning, configuration, data movement, and fulfillment, and measure whether it reduces cycle time and operational risk.
• Own intake and prioritization so investor, partner, servicer, and new-product onboarding is planned rather than absorbed as unscoped administration.
• Represent the product in operating reviews. Surface risks that could cause significant delays, cost, or resource constraints, and drive mitigation with the stakeholders who can act.
• Establish standards for how the team documents configuration, change, and runbooks so knowledge is not trapped with individuals.
• Develop the two Applications Administrators through clear expectations, feedback, and growth toward independent ownership of complex workflows.

• Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
• Demonstrated experience owning a complex, multi-system product or operations platform in lending, mortgage technology, or another regulated operating environment.
• Experience leading individual contributors, including planning work, coaching, and making priority and resourcing decisions.
• Experience defining a product vision and roadmap and delivering it with engineering, operations, risk, and compliance partners.
• Working knowledge of the mortgage or consumer lending lifecycle and the applications that support it, including origination, disclosures, underwriting, closing, and servicing.
• Enough technical fluency to direct work on configuration, integrations, identity, automation, and change control, and to review the judgment of the administrators who execute it.
• Experience making trade-offs among speed, reliability, control, and cost where a wrong call can affect members, operations, or the control environment.
• Ability to influence peers and senior stakeholders across functions, and to recognize when a decision has long-range implications that need leadership alignment.
• Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain product choices, risk, and operational impact to technical and non-technical leaders.
• A record of improving a live operating platform: fewer manual steps, clearer ownership, stronger controls, and measurable business results.

Nice to Have
• Direct experience with Encompass, Blend, or a comparable loan origination system, as a product owner or as the leader of the team that administers it.
• Experience with Optimal Blue, NICE inContact, eVault or eSignature, bureau integrations, or servicing platforms.
• Experience leading SOX, privacy, or regulatory control work for business-critical applications.
• Experience in FinTech, banking, or mortgage operations.
• Familiarity with ServiceNow or a similar system of record for change, incidents, and request fulfillment.

The role:

We are looking for a Manager of Crypto to join our Corporate Treasury team. This role will help define how SoFi manages crypto strategic balance sheet capability. The primary focus is on liquidity management, reserve sufficiency, and wallet strategy. Over time, this leader will help establish the infrastructure and policies needed to support potential future crypto activities such as lending, staking, and responsible yield generation. 

Critical to success in this role is the ability to independently drive complex projects forward and exercise strong problem-solving skills in an evolving environment. 

What you’ll do:
• Own SoFi’s crypto treasury and liquidity management strategy, with a primary focus on ensuring sufficient crypto assets are available to meet customer withdrawal demand and operational funding needs.
• Develop forecasting models for crypto withdrawal funding needs, including asset-level liquidity demand and gas funding requirements.
• Establish frameworks to manage SoFi Digital Assets (SOFID) reserves, including reserve sizing, monitoring, reporting, and escalation protocols.
• Define and optimize cold storage vs. hot wallet liquidity strategy, balancing customer experience, security, capital efficiency, and operational resilience.
• Evaluate and develop analytical approaches to model and evaluate the liquidity value and stressed outflows of tokenized deposits.
• Partner with product, operations, finance, risk, and engineering to build scalable liquidity processes and controls for crypto asset management.
• Design the treasury approach needed to support future products and capabilities, including crypto lending, staking, and other reserved-asset use cases.
• Evaluate and help shape future yield generation strategies for SoFi’s crypto balance sheet, with a strong focus on risk-adjusted return, liquidity, regulatory considerations, and capital preservation.
• Build policies, governance, and analytics to monitor crypto asset positions, liquidity buffers, concentration risk, and stress scenarios.
• Create reporting for executive leadership on liquidity exposure, reserve sufficiency, wallet allocation, and strategic balance sheet opportunities.
• Serve as a key thought partner in defining SoFi’s long-term crypto asset management strategy.

What you’ll need:
• 5+ years of experience in treasury, liquidity management, capital markets, digital assets, or related financial leadership roles.
• Deep understanding of crypto market structure, custody models, wallet infrastructure, liquidity management, and reserve frameworks.
• Experience forecasting and managing liquidity across multiple crypto assets, including operational funding needs and stress scenarios.
• Strong knowledge of hot wallet / cold storage tradeoffs, custodial architecture, and security considerations.
• Familiarity with crypto-native and institutional use cases including lending, staking, collateral management, and yield strategies.
• Strong analytical and financial modeling skills, with the ability to translate data into liquidity decisions and policy frameworks.
• Experience working cross-functionally with finance, risk, operations, product, and engineering teams.
• Executive presence and the ability to communicate clearly with senior leadership on strategy, risk, and capital allocation.
• A practical, build-oriented mindset with comfort operating in an evolving product and regulatory environment.

jobs.title: Customer Service Team Member
jobs.description:
Customer Service Team Member 

Location: Cardiff & Southampton

Reporting to: Customer Service Team Lead

At Starling, we are on a mission to provide people with a fairer, smarter, and more human alternative to traditional banks. We are building a leading digital bank, driven by fast technology, fair service, and honest values. Over the next months we will actively be recruiting for shift patterns which include Twilight & Overnight. Please select your preference of rotation and location on your application.

Our vision is to create a banking industry that serves everyone - by developing best-in-class proprietary technology, offering an exceptional customer experience, and establishing a strong, sustainable business.

Our five core values – Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim for Greatness – are at the heart of everything we do, guiding our strategy and shaping our culture. We're a branchless, largely paperless bank, committed to responsible banking, sustainability, and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

About

the role:

Our Customer Service team is at the core of our success - and our Customer Service Team Members are our greatest asset. As the point of contact for our customers, being able to respond to their needs in an efficient and timely manner - however and whenever they choose to speak to us - is what helps set us apart from the competition. The queries you deal with will be wide ranging, from the simple to the complex. It’s a varied yet challenging role and everyone at Starling gets the chance to own interesting things from day one.

Here at Starling we truly put our customers first - and we want to hire people who are driven to do the same!

The starting salary for this role is £28,000 FTE. We're looking for customer obsessed people, regardless of your background & experience if that's you, we want to hear from you!

The shifts, training & hybrid working: 

Evenings - 25 hours a week (current rotation below):

Evenings - 30 hours a week (current rotation below)

Cardiff Training for the role is 5 weeks in the office, weeks 1 & 2 will be full time 9:00 - 17:30 Monday - Friday followed by 4 weeks of your evening hours. After this, the team work 1 shift per fortnight in the office and the rest from home. 

Southampton Training for this role will be 5 weeks in the office, 9:00 - 17:30 Monday - Friday. After this, the team work 1 shift per fortnight in the office and the rest from home.

Overnight - 37.5 hours a week (current rotation below)

Training for the role is 5 weeks in the office, 9:00 - 17:30 Monday - Friday. After this, the team work 1 shift per fortnight in the office and the rest from home. 

Our contact centres are open 365 days per year. We’re passionate about improving work life balance and are committed to hybrid working patterns that give you a balance of home and office working.

The recruitment process:

Once we have reviewed your application we will be in touch to let you know if we are progressing your application further or not. If progressed, we will then invite you to book a call with someone from our talent acquisition team.

After the call, if the role seems like the right fit, we will invite you for a final stage video interview with a Team Leader from our Customer Services team. They will be able to give you even more insight into the role and life at Starling and talk to you about your experience and love of customer service! The interview will be made up of Q&A questions, role play activity and a written communication exercise.

We’re looking for people who are passionate about us and our product, so check out our App or read about our journey before meeting with us.

We will have start dates monthly from November - March.

You’ll support your customers by :
• Providing exceptional customer service via phone, email, live chat and social media.
• Showing ownership and accountability for offering solutions that help and benefit our customers.
• Maintaining high standards and continually striving to improve the service for our customers.
• Responding to customer complaints and escalating issues as necessary.
• Supporting a continuous improvement ethos within the contact centre.
• Actively seeking to improve processes and workflows.
• Working well within a dynamic team environment.

About you :
• Working in a contact centre environment is not essential - showing us you understand what great customer service looks like is.
• You’ll be comfortable talking to customers however they choose to reach out.
• You have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• No two days here are the same - you should be comfortable working in a fast changing environment.
• Money is an emotive subject and some interactions can be difficult, you’ll need to be resilient and able to help your customers when they need you the most.
• We will offer lots of training and guidance but Starling is a FinTech and you will need basic IT skills to navigate our laptops (MacBook) and systems.
• Knowledge of vulnerabilities. 

Why Join Starling?
• Make an Impact: Work on projects that directly shape the future of banking and improve the financial lives of our customers. Starling is technology-led, and you'll have the freedom to accomplish your goals in innovative ways.
• Culture of Excellence: Be part of a collaborative, empowered, and forward-thinking team. We encourage experimentation, ownership, and a relentless focus on "doing the right thing.”
• Growth and Development: We are committed to your professional growth, offering opportunities to learn new technologies, take on new challenges, and own interesting things from day one.
• A Bank That Cares: We're a Living Wage employer, committed to flexible working, and dedicated to creating a fair, open, and safe working environment with compassion and inclusion at its core.
• Comprehensive

Benefits:

We offer a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package, including:
• Company-enhanced salary sacrifice pension scheme (7% employer contribution)
• Private Medical Insurance with Vitality including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton.
• 25 days holiday (plus take your public holiday allowance whenever works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Life Insurance at 4x your salary.
• 16 hours of paid volunteering time a year.
• Ability to buy or sell annual leave.
• Generous family-friendly policies.
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• Incentivised refer a friend scheme
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasingOur Commitment to Equality

Starling Bank is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Starling Bank are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. When you provide us with this information, you are doing so at your own consent, with full knowledge that we will process this personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice. By submitting your application, you agree that Starling Bank will collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we will process, where we will process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

jobs.title: Database Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Starling is the UK’s first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking! Our vision is fast technology, fair service, and honest values. All at the tap of a phone, all the time. We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way.

We’re a fully licensed UK bank with the culture and spirit of a fast-moving, disruptive tech company. We’re a bank, but better: fairer, easier to use and designed to demystify money for everyone. We employ more than 3,000 people across our London, Southampton, Cardiff and Manchester offices.

Our technologists are at the very heart of Starling and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Starling is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, discovering, to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five Starling values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Starling - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person. In Technology, we're asking that you attend the office a minimum of 1 day per week.

Our Data Environment

Our Data teams are aligned to divisions covering the following Banking Services & Products, Customer Identity & Financial Crime and Data & ML Engineering. Our Data teams are excited about delivering meaningful and impactful insights to both the business and more importantly our customers. Hear from the team in our latest blogs or our case studies with Women in Tech.

We are looking for talented data professionals at all levels to join the team. We value people being engaged and caring about customers, caring about the code they write and the contribution they make to Starling. People with a broad ability to apply themselves to a multitude of problems and challenges, who can work across teams do great things here at Starling, to continue changing banking for good.

What you’ll be doing:
• Modernize and Scale the RDS Fleet: Ensure the reliability of our existing RDS footprint. You will use Terraform to maintain the databases and automate strategies for performance tuning
• Evolve Observability & Monitoring: Build deep, proactive monitoring and alerting for our global database fleet. You will leverage Java-based data collection pipelines and metrics platforms (Prometheus, Grafana, Dash0, Sentry, Humio) to detect performance regressions, slow queries, and health issues before they impact customers
• Fortify Business Continuity (BCP): Design and implement rigorous Business Continuity Planning and Disaster Recovery strategies. You will build Java-based automation that ensures data durability and rapid recovery across regions, guaranteeing our databases remain resilient.
• Architect Cross-Cloud Portability: Use CNPG (CloudNativePG) and cloud-native patterns to ensure our database layer remains provider-agnostic, allowing seamless deployment across clouds
• Build Java-Driven Applications: Enhance production-grade Java microservices to orchestrate database monitoring, automated failover, and replication workflows
• PostgreSQL

Experience:

You have hands-on experience working with Postgres databases. You understand core database concepts like query execution, indexing, locking, and performance tuning
• Systems Thinker: You believe infrastructure and database orchestration should be driven programmatically via Terraform and custom Java automation
• Distributed Systems Enthusiast: You are excited by the challenge of "multi-everything"—multi-tenant and multi-region data platforms—while ensuring data integrity, clean relational modeling, and mobility
• A Security & Observability Mindset: You focus on building deep observability (Prometheus/Grafana/Dash0/Sentry/Humio) and automated security guardrails directly into your Java services so the fleet is secure and monitored by design

Interview process

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:
• Stage 1 - 30 mins with one of the team
• Stage 2 - Take-home challenge
• Stage 3 - 60 mins technical interview with two team members
• Stage 4 - 45 min final with two data executives
• 25 days holiday (plus take your public holiday allowance whenever works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks

jobs.title: Product Manager - Engine by Starling
jobs.description:
At Engine by Starling, we are on a mission to find and work with leading banks all around the world who have the ambition to build rapid growth businesses, on our technology. 

Engine is Starling's software-as-a-service (SaaS) business, the technology that was built to power Starling, and two years ago we split out as a separate business. 

Starling has seen exceptional growth and success, and a large part of that is down to the fact that we have built our own modern technology from the ground up. This SaaS technology platform is now available to banks and financial institutions all around the world, enabling them to benefit from the innovative digital features, and efficient back-office processes that has helped achieve Starling's success.

We draw upon our experience as knowledgeable bankers, and best in class technologists to become the chosen option for these banks, and preferred partners for leading consultancies.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Engine - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person.

About the role

This role is pivotal within Engine’s Product & Technology function, in making sure we understand the client needs and build the right products. 

We are looking to grow our Product team across a number of areas, you could end up working on any number of domains we have, from Savings and Accounts to Cross Cutting Services. 

We’re looking for versatile, adaptable individuals who enjoy the challenge of a varied and collaborative role. Prior experience in the lending domain is helpful, but not essential.

You’ll work closely with the Business Development, Customer Success and Engineering functions to design solutions that meet client needs and support our product strategy. 

You’ll enjoy problem solving, getting to the detail, and understanding how clients can make the best use of our product, whilst designing ways to improve it. Your work will span product strategy, client-facing requirements gathering & solution design, and product ownership in an Engineering context.

Your skills and what you'll get to do
• Navigating Ambiguity: You are entirely comfortable working in an environment where the starting point is clear but the long-term path is undefined. You stay grounded through shifting priorities, view an evolving landscape as a learning opportunity, and thrive within a flat structure.
• Backlog & Ticket Management: You can write clean, detailed, and unambiguous user stories and requirements issues with explicit acceptance criteria.
• Technical Literacy: You understand the basic architectural stack of a product area (e.g., frontend vs. backend, what an API does) and enjoy getting into the technical details with engineers.
• Basic Data Analysis: You are competent with (or ready to quickly master) product analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, Amplitude, PostHog,...) to track feature usage and leverage quantitative data alongside user feedback to make small-scale trade-offs.
• Clear Communication & Stakeholder Management: You can clearly explain the "what", "how", and "why" behind the immediate feature backlog to your engineering and design triad, and you confidently flag blockers early to your manager.
• Active Listening & Coachability: You place a heavy focus on self-development; you actively seek out feedback, take structured notes, and demonstrate visible behavioural changes based on input.
• Dependability & Handling Ambiguity: You are highly dependable, deliver assigned tasks on time, and remain comfortable navigating ambiguity within a flat, fast-moving team structure.

Applications for this role will close on 19th October
• Professional

Experience:

2 to 5 years of experience in a product management / owner role, engineering, data, business analysis, or highly analytical role, ideally within a fast-paced environment.
• Eager Learner: A massive appetite for learning, listening, and growing within an organisation that is constantly expanding (Great to have).
• FinTech Exposure: Prior experience or a strong baseline understanding of FinTech, or a regulated banking/lending environment (Nice to have).
• Technical Foundation: A product or engineering background, technical experience, or deep technical curiosity (Nice to have).
• Execution Track Record: Experience managing your own time effectively, meeting deadlines, and delivering well-scoped tasks with some guidance.
• Educational Foundation: A relevant bachelor’s degree (or equivalent educational background) with a foundation in Maths or STEM subjects, would be desirable 

Interview process

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:
• 45 minutes with someone from the Product Management team
• 1 hour with two more people from the PM team, including a case study
• 45 minutes with two members of the senior product team.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:
• Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM:

We’re the UK’s leading provider of smart current accounts for sole traders and small companies. We’re also on a mission to save business owners time and money on their banking and finance admin so they can get back to doing what they love - for too long, these customers have been under-served by the big banks.

Funding Options joined the Tide family in early 2023 to lead their Partner Credit Services offering. Through their panel of 100 leading lender partners, Funding Options supports UK SMEs to get the right finance in place so they can trade, plan and grow with confidence. Through their multi award-winning platform, Funding Cloud, they can effectively match customers to the right lender and finance product that best suits their needs in minutes with funding decisions in as little as 20 seconds, giving every customer a 5 Star experience whether successful or not, through our sheer professionalism and outstanding standard of customer service.

Our offices are in London -UK, Sofia - Bulgaria, Belgrade - Serbia and Hyderabad -India, where our teams are dedicated to our small business members; revolutionising business banking for SMEs. 

We’re scaling at speed with a focus on hiring talented individuals with a growth mindset and ownership mentality, who are able to juggle multiple and sometimes changing priorities. Our values show our commitment to working as one team, working collaboratively to take action and deliver results. Member first, we are passionate about our members and put them first. We are data-driven, we make decisions, creating insight using data.

We’re also one of LinkedIn’s top 10 hottest UK companies to work for.

ABOUT

THE ROLE:
• Contact, engage and manage our commercial customers through their application process
• Build and nurture working relationships with our commercial lending partners
• Become confident in articulating the Funding Options proposition and service
• Outbound prospect customers from our your dedicated Accounts Portfolio
• Working closely with our Lead Generation team, including providing feedback and advice where appropriate
• Building on your knowledge of business finance, and gaining an in-depth understanding of the wide variety of lenders and products in the market
• Confidently articulating the different finance options available to customers across multiple business finance product classes
• Maintaining accurate, up-to-date information on any prospects that you speak with (in Salesforce)
• Monitoring and identify trends whilst adding new or enhanced customer profile information into Salesforce
• Keeping up to date on industry trends, market competition.
• Actively share stories and successes to the wider organisation through relevant comms channels.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
• We’re looking for a Strategic Finance Partner (Senior Commercial Finance Broker) to help build and scale our Account Management function. This is not a transactional role, it’s about owning and developing a portfolio of clients, becoming their go-to finance partner, and supporting their businesses as they grow.
• You’ll be responsible for building meaningful, long-term relationships with clients, taking the time to truly understand how their businesses operate, their growth plans, challenges, and how finance fits into their journey. Your role is to anticipate needs, identify opportunities, and guide clients through both opportunities and pressure points as they arise.
• Through structured, high-quality conversations, you’ll uncover funding requirements and match clients to the most appropriate products and lenders, not just for today, but in a way that supports their longer-term ambitions. You’ll bring a strategic lens to every interaction, ensuring clients feel supported, informed, and confident in the decisions they make.
• We expect you to deliver a consistently exceptional client experience, setting the standard for professionalism, ownership, and service. Whether a deal completes or not, every client interaction should reinforce your position as a trusted partner and leave them better informed and better prepared for their next step.

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
• Competitive salary and bonus
• Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing
• 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme
• 25 days holiday with the ability to buy extra days
• Professional L D budget

jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:
• Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE ROLE

Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.

You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.

As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring you will:
• Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms
• Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London
• Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you
• Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering
• Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows
• Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring
• Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework
• Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member
• Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap
• Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated

This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
• Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain
• Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation
• Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development
• Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators
• Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality
• Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities
