jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Enablement
jobs.description:
About the role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the AI Enablement team, you will build the internal platforms, primitives, and guardrails that make AI a trusted co-pilot for employees across Chime.

You’ll work on systems like Archimedes, Bosun, and easyRAG that power internal AI assistants, developer workflows, and retrieval-backed applications. These platforms make it easier for teams across the company to build, adopt, and scale LLM-powered tools safely and effectively.

This team defines Chime’s golden paths for AI: opinionated but flexible patterns that help teams move quickly while maintaining safety, reliability, cost control, and governance. In this role, you’ll help turn emerging AI capabilities into durable, reusable platform features that can be adopted across the company.

You’ll partner closely with Platform Engineering, Security, Risk, Legal, and product teams to build scalable, well-governed systems that support internal AI use cases from early prototyping through production adoption.

In this role, you can expect to
• Build and evolve internal AI platforms such as Archimedes, Bosun, and easyRAG, enabling teams to develop and scale LLM-powered applications and workflows
• Design and implement reusable platform capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, templates, and shared services that make it easier to build safe, high-quality AI-powered tools
• Prototype and productionize new AI capabilities, identifying high-leverage use cases and turning successful patterns into durable platform features
• Define and improve Chime’s golden path patterns for LLM usage, balancing developer velocity with safety, reliability, and cost efficiency
• Develop systems that let teams launch AI-powered assistants and workflows in a standardized, observable, and governed way
• Establish evaluation, observability, and cost-management practices across AI systems, including quality, latency, safety, and spend
• Partner with Security, Risk, and Legal to implement practical guardrails for responsible AI development and usage
• Drive consistency and standardization in how AI systems are built, deployed, and operated across the company
• Collaborate with engineers and partner teams across Chime to embed AI into internal tools, workflows, and employee experiences

To thrive in this role, you have
• Significant experience as a software engineer building distributed systems, platform services, or internal developer tools
• Hands-on experience building with LLMs or ML services and shipping production-quality features on top of them
• Strong coding skills in at least one of Python, Go, or TypeScript/JavaScript, with comfort working across services, CLIs, and internal tooling
• A platform mindset: you think in reusable primitives, contracts, and paved roads rather than one-off solutions
• Familiarity with AI-specific engineering concerns such as evaluation, prompt and version management, observability, cost control, safety, and data privacy
• Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders such as Security, Risk, Product, and Operations, and influencing direction through strong technical judgment
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
• Engineers are required to participate in on-call rotation. Being on call may include responding to incidents outside of regular working hours when necessary.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Lending
jobs.location: New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA
jobs.description:
About the role

Chime’s Lending org builds the products and platforms that give members access to fair, transparent credit and liquidity when they need it most, from Earned Wage Access through MyPay, to flexible overdraft with SpotMe, to longer-term Instant Loans, and the platforms that power credit decisions, funding, repayments, and servicing behind the scenes.

We operate some of Chime’s most consequential systems. Our teams build real-time money movement and decisioning infrastructure at scale, including underwriting and eligibility, ledgering and reconciliation, capital markets workflows, repayment systems, and financial transactions that must be correct, resilient, and auditable.

As a Senior Software Engineer in Lending, you’ll work at the seam between member-facing products and the platforms that make them possible. This is a role for engineers who want to own more than a single service or feature area. You’ll lead technical initiatives that cut across products, platforms, and partner teams, helping shape how Lending evolves as a system, not just how one team ships.

You’ll design and build backend systems where correctness, reliability, speed, and operational rigor matter deeply. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, Risk, Data Science, Analytics, Finance, and Operations to turn ambiguous opportunities into durable solutions, influence technical direction across team boundaries, and help raise the bar for how Lending engineers build together.

Why join Lending?

Work on systems that matter

The products and platforms we build directly impact millions of members and sit at the center of Chime’s mission to help everyday people unlock financial progress. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the work matters.

Own a bigger surface area

This role is designed for engineers who want broader scope. You won’t be limited to a narrow feature lane. You’ll work across product experiences and shared infrastructure, helping connect strategy, systems, and execution across Lending.

Build where product and platform meet

Some of the most interesting engineering work happens in the seams: where member experience depends on credit strategy, where product velocity depends on platform leverage, and where financial correctness meets business speed. This role sits in the middle of those seams and gives you meaningful influence over how they scale.

Operate in a fast-moving, high-accountability environment

Lending is a fast-paced fintech environment where we care about moving quickly and building well. We value thoughtful design, strong engineering judgment, high-quality code, and operational excellence. We also actively use AI where it can improve quality, speed, and leverage.

Grow your technical leadership

At L5, you’ll be expected to do more than deliver strong execution. You’ll lead through ambiguity, drive alignment across teams, shape architecture and engineering patterns, and improve how the org operates over time. This is a strong role for engineers who want to expand their influence and prepare for even larger technical scope.

In this role, you can expect to
• Lead end-to-end architecture and delivery of backend systems that connect member-facing lending products with shared platforms such as Credit Risk, Capital Markets, Repayments, servicing, and core financial systems
• Drive complex, cross-team initiatives from problem definition through architecture, implementation, rollout, and iteration, especially where multiple teams or domains need to move in sync
• Own technical problems with real business and member impact, and bring structure, momentum, and clarity when the path is not obvious
• Define and evolve APIs, integration patterns, and data contracts so product teams can move faster without compromising safety, correctness, or reuse
• Design for scale, resiliency, observability, and operational excellence, with strong handling of failures, retries, reconciliation, auditability, and edge cases
• Identify opportunities to turn one-off product needs into reusable platform capabilities that unlock future velocity across Lending
• Partner closely with Product, Design, Risk, Data Science, Analytics, Finance, and Operations to translate ambiguous problems into practical, high-leverage technical solutions
• Influence how product and platform teams work together by clarifying ownership, reducing integration friction, and improving the quality of technical decision-making across boundaries
• Participate in on-call and incident response, and lead efforts to turn production lessons into lasting improvements in systems, tooling, and engineering practices
• Mentor other engineers through design reviews, technical feedback, and hands-on partnership, helping raise the leadership capacity of the broader org
• Contribute to roadmap and strategy conversations by identifying where platform investments can unlock multiple product outcomes over time

To thrive in this role, you have
• 8+ years of experience building and operating production software at scale, with a strong track record of owning backend systems end-to-end
• Strong backend engineering fundamentals, ideally with Ruby on Rails or a comparable framework, and experience building APIs and distributed systems in production
• Experience with transactional databases, asynchronous processing, caching, and large-scale application architecture
• Strong system design judgment and the ability to make sound tradeoffs across correctness, scalability, resiliency, speed, and long-term maintainability
• A track record of leading complex projects that span multiple teams, systems, or business workflows
• Experience working in fintech, lending, banking, payments, risk, or other high-integrity domains where correctness, traceability, and operational rigor matter deeply
• A high-ownership mindset and comfort operating in ambiguity, including the ability to create clarity, drive alignment, and move important work forward without waiting for perfect structure
• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence across engineering and cross-functional teams in a low-ego, effective way
• A product mindset and strong instincts for connecting technical decisions to member experience and business outcomes
• Experience mentoring engineers and helping teams raise the bar on design quality, testing, operational excellence, and engineering ownership
• Curiosity, sound judgment, and a genuine desire to understand systems deeply and improve them over time

Nice-to-have
• Experience with lending or credit systems such as underwriting, eligibility, line assignment, limits, repayments, collections, servicing, or decisioning
• Experience with financial platform domains such as capital markets workflows, reconciliations, ledgering, accounting interfaces, partner integrations, or bank integrations
• Familiarity with experimentation, analytics, and data-informed systems used to safely evolve decisioning and product strategy over time
• Experience helping product teams adopt shared platform capabilities through strong APIs, abstractions, internal tooling, or platform patterns

Chime’s Machine Learning Platform (MLP) team builds and operates the infrastructure, tooling, and developer experience that powers machine learning across the company. We enable data scientists and ML engineers to develop, train, deploy, and monitor models reliably and efficiently.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Machine Learning Platform team, you will design and build scalable systems spanning traditional machine learning and emerging AI workloads, including model training, feature computation, real-time inference, foundation-model access, evaluation, and agentic orchestration. You’ll work at the intersection of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, applied machine learning, and AI product engineering.

This role focuses on creating secure, reliable, and reusable platform capabilities that help teams choose the right approach, from conventional predictive models to LLM-powered and multi-step agentic systems, while maintaining strong standards for evaluation, observability, governance, privacy, and cost efficiency.

In this role, you can expect to
• Design, build, and operate scalable ML and AI infrastructure on AWS.
• Design and operate shared platform capabilities for LLM and agentic workloads, including model access, prompt and configuration lifecycle, retrieval, tool integration, state management, and workflow orchestration.
• Build evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems, including offline benchmarks, regression testing, online quality signals, human feedback, and failure analysis.
• Establish observability, reliability, and governance for models and agents, covering traces, model and prompt versions, tool calls, latency, token usage, quality, safety, privacy, and cost.
• Help teams make principled architecture decisions across traditional ML, LLM-powered applications, and agentic workflows, and contribute to the platform’s technical roadmap.
• Build distributed training, batch inference, and large-scale processing systems using frameworks such as Ray or Spark.
• Build and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform.
• Support and evolve the feature store and feature pipelines.
• Develop data ingestion and streaming systems using technologies such as Kinesis, Kafka, Flink, or Spark.
• Improve CI/CD workflows for ML models, AI applications, and platform components.
• Partner closely with Data Science and ML Engineering teams to improve developer experience.
• Participate in on-call rotations to support production systems.

To thrive in this role, you have
• Knowledge of the machine learning development lifecycle, including data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
• Experience designing distributed systems and large-scale data or compute platforms on AWS using frameworks such as Spark or Ray.
• 5+ years of experience in ML or AI infrastructure, platform engineering, distributed systems, or production ML systems.
• Working knowledge of LLM application patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs, tool calling, agent orchestration, and evaluation of non-deterministic systems.
• Experience designing production systems that integrate ML or foundation models through reliable APIs, workflows, and data contracts.
• Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and infrastructure as code.
• Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
• Strong programming skills in Python, Go, Scala, Java, or similar languages.
• Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, version control, code review, and observability.

Nice-to-have
• Experience shipping LLM-powered or agentic systems to production.
• Experience with one or more of the following: model gateways, prompt lifecycle management, retrieval or vector search, tool execution, and agent orchestration frameworks.
• Experience building evaluation, tracing, and observability capabilities for non-deterministic AI systems.
• Familiarity with managed or self-hosted foundation model infrastructure, such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, or equivalent platforms.
• Experience operating GPU-based workloads and optimizing training or inference performance and cost; CUDA experience is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.location: Chicago, IL, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA
jobs.description:
About the role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Systems Engineer to own our macOS platform and drive endpoint management and device trust standards across Chime’s IT ecosystem.

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will drive multi-system initiatives across our IT domains – endpoint management, identity, and security tooling – with a primary focus on macOS and Jamf Pro. You’ll establish the technical standards other engineers work to, and partner cross-functionally on programs that affect IT Support, Security, and every Chimer with a laptop.

This is a role for someone who thrives in ambiguity: you’ll often define the problem before solving it, and align stakeholders around a technical direction rather than waiting for a specification. We believe a secure access platform can be built entirely in the cloud, leveraging tools such as Jamf, AutoPkg, Okta, osQuery, and CrowdStrike. Pairing closely with our Security team, this role makes sure our fleet stays in sync with all policies and posture checks before devices are allowed access to corporate data.

This role participates in an after-hours/on-call rotation for critical endpoint and device-management issues. Rotation frequency, response expectations, and escalation procedures will be communicated during the interview process. This position will report to the IT Engineering Manager.

In this role, you can expect to

macOS Platform and Endpoint Management
• Platform Ownership: Own the technical direction, operation, and continuous improvement of our Jamf Pro environment, including configuration profiles, smart groups, policies, MDM commands, and change standards.
• Software Delivery: Own our AutoPkg-based software pipeline: recipes, overrides, trust verification, and automated import into Jamf, alongside packaging, deployment, patch management, and disk encryption across the global macOS fleet.
• Automation Reusable Tooling: Build automations and shared tooling that accelerate work beyond your own – scripts, patterns, and integrations other IT engineers can adopt rather than rebuild.
• Provisioning: Own zero-touch provisioning and device enrollment (Automated Device Enrollment, Setup Assistant, bootstrap workflows) so new Chimers are productive on day one.
• Scripting API Integration: Use scripting and general-purpose languages (Python, Swift, Bash, Go) and vendor APIs to create custom integrations and eliminate manual IT operations.

Security, Governance, and Compliance
• Security Posture: Partner with Security to identify and mitigate risks to the fleet, enforcing a Zero Trust / BeyondCorp model through device trust, adaptive authentication, and least-privilege access.
• Device Trust: Connect device management to our identity provider (Okta) so device posture is a factor in authentication and application access.
• Compliance: Implement compliance processes and tooling to report configuration status, and assess and implement benchmark standards (e.g., CIS) against a documented, risk-based rationale.
• Reporting: Develop metrics and reporting reflecting the inventory, health, and compliance state of all devices.
• Troubleshooting: Serve as the Tier 3 escalation point for complex endpoint issues.

Standards, Collaboration, and Mentorship
• Technical Standards: Establish and document the endpoint standards the broader IT organization works to, and raise the bar on testing, monitoring, and maintainability through example and influence.
• Cross-Functional Delivery: Lead initiatives spanning IT Support, Security, and People teams – reconciling competing priorities and keeping stakeholders aligned from planning through rollout.
• Mentorship: Mentor peers, engineers, and technicians through technical guidance, documentation, enablement, and example.
• Support Enablement: Work with IT Support to identify pain points and implement systemic fixes that reduce ticket load rather than absorbing it.

To thrive in this role, you have
• Experience:

8+ years of hands-on experience managing macOS at scale with enterprise MDM (e.g., Jamf Pro, Kandji, Mosyle) and/or open-source tooling (e.g., Munki, Puppet, Chef).
• AutoPkg: Production experience building and operating AutoPkg recipes, overrides, trust controls, and automated promotion into an enterprise MDM environment is required.
• Apple Platform Depth: In-depth understanding of Apple’s MDM protocol and Configuration Profile specifications, including the shift to Declarative Device Management.
• macOS Fundamentals: In-depth understanding of installers and packages, LaunchDaemons and LaunchAgents, the preferences subsystem, system extensions, macOS built-in security tooling (Endpoint Security Framework, SIP, XProtect, Gatekeeper, openBSM), and unified logs.
• Scripting: Proficiency in at least one general-purpose or scripting language (e.g., Python, Swift, Bash, Go) for API interaction and automation.
• Security Model: Solid understanding of Zero Trust / BeyondCorp concepts and how endpoint posture feeds identity-based access decisions.
• Cross-Domain Judgment: Track record of decisions spanning multiple systems, balancing scalability, compliance, cost, and long-term maintainability.
• Working in Ambiguity: Comfort defining a problem before solving it, and aligning stakeholders around a technical direction.
• Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication for technical and non-technical audiences, including the structured documentation that scales understanding across a distributed team.

Nice-to-have
• Jamf Certified Admin (300/400) or equivalent demonstrated mastery of those knowledge domains.
• Familiarity with Windows endpoint management (Intune/Endpoint Manager, PowerShell, MSI packaging, WMI, registry) – Windows is a smaller part of our fleet.
• Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform) for managing SaaS and MDM configuration.
• Experience with osQuery, CrowdStrike, or comparable endpoint telemetry and EDR tooling.
• Experience integrating endpoint management with Okta for device trust and conditional access.

jobs.description:
About the role

As a Software Engineer on the AI Enablement team, you will contribute to the internal platforms, primitives, and guardrails that make AI a trusted co-pilot for employees across Chime.
You'll work on systems like Archimedes, Bosun, and easyRAG that power internal AI assistants, developer workflows, and retrieval-backed applications. These platforms make it easier for teams across the company to build, adopt, and scale LLM-powered tools safely and effectively.

This team defines Chime's golden paths for AI: opinionated but flexible patterns that help teams move quickly while maintaining safety, reliability, cost control, and governance. In this role, you'll build on and extend these patterns — shipping real features on production AI platforms while developing your depth in AI-specific engineering practices.

You'll collaborate with Platform Engineering, Security, Risk, Legal, and product teams to build scalable, well-governed systems that support internal AI use cases from early prototyping through production adoption.

In this role, you can expect to
• Contribute to and extend internal AI platforms such as Archimedes, Bosun, and easyRAG, helping teams develop and scale LLM-powered applications and workflows
• Build reusable platform capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, templates, and shared services that make it easier to develop safe, high-quality AI-powered tools
• Prototype and productionize new AI capabilities alongside senior engineers, turning successful patterns into durable platform features
• Apply Chime's golden path patterns for LLM usage, and help refine them as you deepen familiarity with the systems
• Build features that let teams launch AI-powered assistants and workflows in a standardized, observable, and governed way
• Learn and apply evaluation, observability, and cost-management practices across AI systems — including quality, latency, safety, and spend
• Partner with Security, Risk, and Legal to implement guardrails for responsible AI development and usage
• Collaborate with engineers across Chime to embed AI into internal tools, workflows, and employee experiences

To thrive in this role, you have
• Experience as a software engineer with a track record of shipping production-quality features in a distributed system or platform environment
• Hands-on experience working with LLMs or ML services, or strong curiosity and a demonstrated ability to ramp quickly into AI-specific tooling
• Solid coding skills in at least one of Python, Go, or TypeScript/JavaScript, with comfort working across services, CLIs, and internal tooling
• An emerging platform mindset: you think about reuse and building for more than one consumer, not just solving the immediate problem
• Familiarity with — or eagerness to learn — AI-specific engineering concerns such as evaluation, prompt and version management, observability, cost control, safety, and data privacy
• Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to teammates and cross-functional partners

Chime's Growth Engineering team is focused on building product experiences that directly move business metrics and help millions of people achieve financial progress. As a full stack Growth Engineer, you'll work across the stack - React and TypeScript on the front end, Rails and Go services behind it - to build features that drive member growth at Chime. You'll collaborate closely with product, design, data science, marketing, and analytics to experiment rapidly, drive measurable outcomes, and scale impactful solutions. This role is perfect for engineers who thrive in fast-moving environments, want to help define new products or experiments, and are passionate about helping Chime grow faster and smarter.

In this role, you can expect to
• Build and ship growth-focused consumer features end to end - React and TypeScript interfaces, the services and APIs behind them, and the experiments that measure them

• Improve reliability, scalability, and performance across the stack - from page load and funnel conversion on the client to latency and throughput in our services
• Contribute to a culture of technical excellence through mentorship, code reviews, and driving best practices

To thrive in this role, you have
• 2+ years of experience building scalable software in production environments
• Proven experience with both a modern front-end framework (React or comparable) and a server-side framework (Ruby on Rails, Go, or comparable)
• Experience designing APIs and working with transactional databases and caching, plus client-side state, performance, and component-driven UI
• Comfort owning a feature across the full stack, and eagerness to learn the parts you haven't touched yet
• A product mindset with a strong bias toward experimentation, iteration, and measuring impact

jobs.location: Chicago, IL, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA
jobs.description:
About the role

The Infrastructure Engineering organization comprises three sub-teams: Core Infrastructure (which manages the infrastructure systems that power Chime, including AWS, Networking, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Observability), Infra Platform, and Data Infra (which provides infrastructure support for the Data Engineering organization).

This role is on the Core Infrastructure team, where we manage the Infrastructure components that power Chime and make sure our members are able to use Chime products reliably. This includes our Cloud operations, Observability layer and Compute layer.

In this role, you can expect to
• Automate everything, including scaling, monitoring, and operations.
• Build tools to enable self-service both within the team and across all of Chime engineering. Tooling is written in Ruby on Rails and Go Lang.
• Design, build, and support Chime's cloud infrastructure using automation and infrastructure-as-code.
• Adapt new technologies to make Chime run as efficiently and reliably as possible.
• Partner with product development engineers to build services according to modern design patterns; for example, the 12 Factor App methodology.
• Develop strong relationships with engineers, managers, and other colleagues based on trust, empathy, and technical expertise.
• Be a constant advocate and adopter of AI tools and evangelize agentic AI workflows in a way that is safe and reliable.

To thrive in this role, you have
• More than 2 years of cloud and Infrastructure experience
• Strong development experience in Ruby on Rails and Go Lang.
• Previous professional experience in a DevOps/SRE/ProdEng role supporting customer-facing web services.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Lending
jobs.description:
About the role

Chime’s Lending org builds the products and platforms that give members access to fair, transparent credit and liquidity when they need it most, from Earned Wage Access through MyPay, to flexible overdraft with SpotMe, to longer-term Instant Loans, and the platforms that power credit decisions, funding, repayments, and servicing behind the scenes.

We operate some of Chime’s most consequential systems. Our teams build real-time money movement and decisioning infrastructure at scale, including underwriting and eligibility, ledgering and reconciliation, capital markets workflows, repayment systems, and financial transactions that must be correct, resilient, and auditable.

As a Software Engineer in Lending, you’ll work at the seam between member-facing products and the platforms that make them possible. This is a role for engineers who want to own more than a single service or feature area. You’ll lead technical initiatives that cut across products, platforms, and partner teams, helping shape how Lending evolves as a system, not just how one team ships.

You’ll design and build backend systems where correctness, reliability, speed, and operational rigor matter deeply. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, Risk, Data Science, Analytics, Finance, and Operations to turn ambiguous opportunities into durable solutions, influence technical direction across team boundaries, and help raise the bar for how Lending engineers build together.

Why join Lending?

Work on systems that matter

The products and platforms we build directly impact millions of members and sit at the center of Chime’s mission to help everyday people unlock financial progress. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the work matters.

Own a bigger surface area

This role is designed for engineers who want broader scope. You won’t be limited to a narrow feature lane. You’ll work across product experiences and shared infrastructure, helping connect strategy, systems, and execution across Lending.

Build where product and platform meet

Some of the most interesting engineering work happens in the seams: where member experience depends on credit strategy, where product velocity depends on platform leverage, and where financial correctness meets business speed. This role sits in the middle of those seams and gives you meaningful influence over how they scale.

Operate in a fast-moving, high-accountability environment

Lending is a fast-paced fintech environment where we care about moving quickly and building well. We value thoughtful design, strong engineering judgment, high-quality code, and operational excellence. We also actively use AI where it can improve quality, speed, and leverage.

In this role, you can expect to
• Independently own and deliver features end-to-end
• Design, develop, test, refactor and scale backend implementations of new and existing consumer product features
• Work with the mobile team to design and build strong, resilient APIs that power the member facing mobile app
• Collaborate with cross functional teams to understand member pain points and come up with solutions
• Proactively identify opportunities for improving the reliability and scalability of our systems
• Work across the engineering team to improve and uphold high technical standards
• Grow into owning larger components of the system over time

To thrive in this role, you have
• 3+ years building and operating production software at scale
• Experience with Ruby on Rails (or comparable frameworks) designing and running APIs
• Strong grasp of relational databases and caching, including safe schema changes/migrations
• Familiarity with distributed systems fundamentals (async processing, idempotency, retries, backfills) and exposure to high-scale architectural patterns
• Commitment to maintainable, well-tested code — including improving existing systems, not just shipping new ones
• Excellent cross-functional communication: clarifying requirements, weighing tradeoffs, delivering incrementally
• Curiosity about how things work, with a product mindset geared toward experimentation and measuring impact
• Interest in data-driven systems and third-party data integration (fintech/risk experience a plus)
• Start-up experience a plus

jobs.title: Tech Lead Manager, Data Integration Platform
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Tech Lead Manager on Chime's Data Intelligence Platform, leading the Data Integration Platform team, you will own the group that builds and operates the platform and infrastructure for the ingress and egress of first-party and third-party data into and out of Chime's ecosystem. Your team will be responsible for building and operating reliable, scalable, and secure integration pipelines and connectors that move data between Chime's internal systems and external partners, vendors, and data providers, powering analytics, experimentation, and AI-driven product experiences across Chime.

You'll partner closely with other Data Intelligence Platform squads as well as Product Engineering, Security, and Analytics teams to define integration patterns, data contracts, and SLAs that govern how data enters and leaves Chime, supporting both high-scale batch workloads and latency-sensitive real-time flows. Your leadership will directly impact how Chime ingests, exchanges, and delivers data - enabling trusted, self-serve, AI-ready data for Chimers across the company.

Chime’s data integration platform is entering its next phase. As our data ecosystem grows, we have a significant opportunity to simplify and standardize how data moves across streaming, batch, and third-party integrations. You will lead the evolution toward a unified, secure, and reliable data conveyance platform while helping advance Chime’s lakehouse architecture.

This is a manager-first, hands-on player-coach role. Your primary responsibility is leading and developing the team - setting direction and priorities, coaching engineers, and owning delivery and operational health. You will also remain technically engaged through high-leverage problems: shaping architecture, guiding designs, reviewing critical changes, and writing production code where it unlocks the team’s progress.

In this role, you can expect to
• Own the strategy and roadmap for Chime's Data Integration Platform, including ingestion pipelines, connectors, and the infrastructure that moves first-party and third-party data into and out of Chime's ecosystem.
• Stay hands-on through architecture, design and code reviews, and targeted production contributions focused on the highest-leverage platform problems, while coaching engineers and owning team execution.
• Design and evolve scalable, high-performance integration architecture that balances reliability, cost, and ease of use for both analytical and in-product data flows.
• Build and operate reliable connectors and pipelines for diverse sources and sinks across APIs, event streams, file transfers, and change-data-capture.
• Ensure performant and secure data movement by defining ingress/egress patterns, throughput and latency targets, schema evolution, and error handling / replay for key data flows.
• Collaborate across the Data Intelligence Platform and partner teams to define clear data contracts, schemas, and SLAs between producers, the integration layer, and consumers including external partners.
• Build tooling and automation for governance and compliance across sources and sinks (e.g., RBAC, PII protection, tokenization, lineage, and auditability), with particular attention to data leaving Chime's boundary, in partnership with Security, Risk, and Compliance.
• Manage and grow a team of engineers, setting clear expectations, providing coaching and feedback, and raising the bar on engineering quality and operational excellence.
• Establish strong operational practices, including on-call, incident management, postmortems, and SLOs for the integration pipelines and connectors your team owns.
• Stay ahead of industry trends in data integration, streaming, and ingestion/egress tooling, and thoughtfully introduce technologies that improve our platform's capabilities.

To thrive in this role, you
• Have 8+ years of experience in high-scale, high-reliability software development, with a focus on platforms, infrastructure, and data integration or data movement systems.
• Have 3+ years of experience managing engineering teams, including hiring, performance management, and developing engineers.
• Bring hands-on coding ability and a genuine desire to remain technical while leading a team. You are comfortable writing and reviewing production code, particularly where it resolves ambiguity or unlocks the team’s progress
• Have a track record of scaling products, platforms, and operations to support rapid growth in data volume, complexity, and criticality.
• Bring deep experience with data integration and movement components, such as ingestion and CDC pipelines, connector frameworks, event streaming, and API- and file-based (e.g., SFTP) data exchange alongside the data lakes/lakehouses (e.g., Iceberg) and warehouses (e.g., Snowflake) they feed and drain.
• Have proven expertise in system and data architecture for scalable, secure, and cost-efficient data platforms, including schema design, data contracts, and schema-evolution strategies across system boundaries.
• Are comfortable working with modern data and infrastructure technologies, such as Kafka, Flink, Spark, Airflow, Kubernetes, and connector/ingestion tooling (e.g., Debezium, Fivetran/Airbyte-style frameworks).
• Are hands-on proficient in Python (preferred) or a comparable language (e.g., Java, Scala), able to write, review, and ship production-quality code, and are fluent in SQL and performance tuning for analytical workloads.
• Have extensive experience in cloud-based data ecosystems, such as AWS (S3, DynamoDB, Redshift, Snowflake, EMR), GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow), or Azure equivalents.
• Understand data governance, security, and compliance best practices (e.g., RBAC, PII handling, auditability) especially for third-party data sharing and data crossing Chime's trust boundary and have helped design systems that meet regulatory and internal standards.
• Are deeply interested in the transformative potential of advanced AI systems and how to build AI-ready data foundations (metadata, lineage, semantic layers, and reliable data pipelines that feed them).
• Excel at building strong relationships with stakeholders across engineering, product, analytics, security, and finance, as well as external partners and vendors, and can translate between technical and business contexts.
• Demonstrate strong people leadership, with a track record of building a culture of belonging and engineering excellence.

jobs.title: SDE 2 Infra
jobs.description:
About Fam (previously FamPay)

Fam is India’s first payments app for everyone above
11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ young users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.

We’re reimagining how the next generation experiences fintech—going beyond payments to build a lifestyle brand that blends money, identity, and everyday experiences into one seamless, intuitive journey.

Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors.

About the team
The Core Infrastructure team builds the platforms and systems that power everything at Fam, from real-time app experiences to high-volume payments. It operates as a small, high-leverage team with deep ownership. Every service at Fam runs on the platform this team builds, so it cares obsessively about system fundamentals, operational excellence, and mechanical sympathy.
What our systems process
1 Billion+ API requests per day powering ~10M daily transactions for 10M+ users at 20,000+ RPS.
470+ node Kubernetes cluster (~2,500 vCPUs and ~8 TiB RAM) under active orchestration.
Dynamic, multi-dimensional auto-scaling powered by 195+ HPAs paired with Karpenter.
12+ TB of active transactional data (and counting) across our high-throughput database clusters.
Event Streaming - 400+ topics, and 3,800+ partitions at ~46,700 messages/sec
Our Next Chapter
While our core systems already handle massive scale, our next vision as a team is to turn infrastructure into a frictionless platform discipline.
We are building towards a world where internal engineering teams consume platform primitives compute, storage, and event streams via self-serve contracts without waiting on us. We're also laying the groundwork for AI-native platform operations, developing agent plane and agent skills so agents can safely interact & operate infrastructure primitives alongside our team. We look to the CNCF landscape for best-in-class tools our systems, with a long-term commitment to contributing back to open source.

 
Perks That Go Beyond the Paycheck
• Relocation assistance to make your move seamless.
• Free office meals (lunch & dinner).
• Generous leave policy, including birthday leave, period leave, paternity and maternity support, and more.
• Salary advance and loan policies for any financial help.
• Quarterly rewards and recognition programs, and a referral program with great incentives.
• Access the latest gadgets and tools.
• Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family, mental health support.
• Tax benefits with options like food coupons, phone allowances, car/device leasing.
• Retirement perks like PF contribution, leave encashment and gratuity.
 
Here’s all the tea on FamApp ☕️
FamApp focuses on financial inclusion of the next generation by providing UPI & card payments to everyone above 11 years old. Our flagship Spending Account, FamX, seamlessly integrates UPI and card payments, enabling users to manage, save, and learn about their finances effortlessly.
 
Revolutionizing Payments and FinTech
FamApp has enabled 10 million+ users to make UPI and card payments across India, removing the inconvenience of carrying cash everywhere. Users get to customise their FamX card with doodles, which lets them add a personal touch to their payments.
 
Trusted by leading investors
We’re proud to be supported by renowned investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital, and esteemed angels Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.
 
Join Our Dynamic Team
At Fam, our people-first approach is reflected in our generous leave policies, flexible work schedules, comprehensive health benefits, and free mental health sessions. We don’t mean to brag, but we promise you’ll be surrounded by some of the most fun, talented and passionate people in the startup space.
 
Want to see what makes life at Fam so awesome? Check out our shenanigans at @lifeatfam 😛
PS - We’re looking for someone with an AI-native mindset, who actively leverages AI in their day-to-day work, as we encourage and embed it across every level at Fam.

jobs.title: Product Director, Flex (Borrowing)
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍 London / UK | Salary dependent on experience + Stock Options + Benefits 

Flex is one of Monzo’s fastest-growing and most commercially significant products. Four years ago, we reinvented the credit card experience—building something simpler, more transparent, and genuinely useful. Today, over a million customers use Flex.

We’re looking for a Product Director to lead Flex into its next phase of growth.

This is a high-impact, deeply commercial role at the intersection of product and credit. You’ll define how we scale borrowing responsibly, expand into new segments, and continue building products customers genuinely love.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Credit, Data, Design, and senior leadership to identify new opportunities, optimise performance across complex segments, and deliver at pace.

What you’ll be working on… 

Set the strategy for Flex
• Set direction for one of Monzo’s most important revenue-driving products
• Identify and unlock new commercial opportunities across customer segments
• Navigate complex trade-offs between growth, risk, and customer outcomes

Drive commercial performance
• Work closely with Credit teams to shape propositions across multiple risk segments and cohorts
• Interrogate performance deeply — from unit economics to long-term profitability curves
• Identify and drive new commercial opportunities

Champion the customer
• Ensure Flex remains rooted in strong customer outcomes, not just revenue
• Push for simple, transparent, and delightful experiences
• Advocate for customer experience alongside commercial outcomes

Build and lead a high-performing team
• Manage and develop a team of Product Managers
• Deliver multiple high-impact initiatives through your direct reports
• Raise the bar on product thinking and foster a culture of high standard and high velocity

🌟 What We’re Looking For

Commercial Thinking
• Strong commercial instinct — you think in terms of trade-offs, economics, and outcomes
• Comfortable operating in complex environments (e.g. multiple segments and cohorts with different commercials)
• Able to engage deeply with Credit and Data partners
• Experience in lending, credit cards, or adjacent borrowing products

• You’re willing to challenge revenue-driven decisions when they conflict with good customer outcomes
• You have strong product taste and care deeply about experience quality

Execution Leadership
• Proven ability to deliver in fast-paced environments with multiple workstreams
• Comfortable going deep in the detail while leading through others
• Strong cross-functional leadership across technical, credit, and governance stakeholders

💰Base salary dependent upon experience + Stock Options + Benefits

➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here

jobs.title: Head of Product, Core Banking Systems
jobs.description:
About the opportunity

 

N26 is looking for a Head of Product - Core Banking Systems to partner with our Engineering, Treasury, Risk, and Banking Operations teams. In this role, you will own the Core Banking Systems product roadmap and lead a team of product business managers delivering foundational capabilities that power N26 — from rapid product configuration to balance sheet infrastructure and regulatory reporting.

You will work at the intersection of Core Banking architecture, financial data integrity, and compliance on one side, and real-world banking and product challenges on the other. Your mission is to transform Core Banking Systems from a cost center into a composable platform that enables product managers to configure and launch products in days, embeds compliance by design, and lays the foundation for growth beyond N26. You will be the connective tissue between technical platform excellence and business outcomes, ensuring that our core engine powers flawless banking across N26 and eventually external financial institutions.

 

In this role, you will:
• Own and drive the Core Systems product roadmap across Product Enablement (lending, deposits, payments gateway) and Balance Sheet Infrastructure (financial data products, treasury, books accounting), balancing near-term execution with long-term strategic horizons.
• Partner closely with N26 Product Segments and functional stakeholders across Treasury, Credit Risk, Risk Controlling, Accounting, and Regulatory Reporting on priorities, planning cycles, and shared OKRs.
• Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for Core Banking initiatives — from self-service product enablement and third-party vendor in-housing through migration, platform scalability, and iteration.
• Define and roll out core platform best practices across the organization — including product configuration standards (Product Factory), ledger data integrity, evaluation frameworks, and progressive rollout guardrails.
• Contribute to N26's company-wide strategy to establish single sources of truth for financial data, eliminate core vendor dependencies, and reduce risk concentration across endpoints.
• Support domain optimization by transitioning stable, non-core services to appropriate segment owners while maintaining operational excellence and zero material audit findings.
• Manage and develop a team of Core Systems Product Managers, fostering a culture of operational rigor, precision, and platform enablement.
• Act as a trusted advisor to other Product Tech teams looking to integrate with core banking engines, sharing best practices and enabling rapid go-to-market execution.
• Manage stakeholder communication across Product, Engineering, Finance, Treasury, Risk, Compliance, and senior leadership.
• Define and track domain KPIs that measure product enablement speed, system uptime, compliance metrics, OPEX cost savings, and balance sheet data integrity.

 

What you need to be successful:
• 5-7+ years of product management experience, with a significant portion focused on core banking systems, ledger infrastructure, payments, or core platform products.
• Proven experience partnering with Core Banking and Platform Engineering experts — you understand how transaction processing, ledgers, and accounting engines work and know how to build scalable platform products.
• Strong technical literacy — you understand backend platform trade-offs, core endpoint dynamics, multi-currency ledgers, and data pipelines, allowing you to engage credibly with engineering teams.
• Data-driven mindset — comfort working with complex financial datasets, defining meaningful operational and compliance KPIs, and making decisions grounded in evidence.
• Financial services experience required — familiarity with regulatory requirements, audit standards, compliance considerations, and the operational realities of banking.
• Agile practitioner — experience managing multiple mission-critical workstreams in fast-paced, high-availability environments.
• Excellent communication skills — the ability to translate complex technical and financial concepts for non-technical audiences and align diverse stakeholders around a shared vision.
• Strong translator between worlds — you can bridge the gap between Core Infrastructure experts and Product/Business stakeholders in both directions, ensuring mutual understanding and aligned priorities.

jobs.title: Head of Product - Lending
jobs.description:
About us 

N26 is Europe’s leading digital bank with a full German banking license. Headquartered in Berlin and operating across more than 20 markets, we are now entering our next stage of maturity. Our focus is on our growth engine while we strengthen robustness, scalability, and operational excellence. With new senior leaders joining to guide this phase, we are sharpening how we build, ship, and sustain products at scale.

As we continue to keep a strong product pulse. Our growth is driven by expanding into adjacent services like mobile connectivity and recently launching cards designed for kids. Our core strategy focuses on empowering customers to switch to N26 as their primary account. By embedding financial tools that are reliable and resilient, we ensure N26 is an essential part of everyday life. To lead this, we need a Director of Marketing [Paid] who understands how to communicate the value of a top-of-wallet banking experience.

About the role

With the financial sector facing significant digital transformation and heightened competition, N26 is seeking a focused leader to spearhead the expansion of our strategic Lending division. 

As Head of Lending, you will assume management of the Lending vertical, supervising the end-to-end lifecycle of our retail lending products operations, which currently cover consumer loans, overdraft facilities, and installment products. 

This product is critical to the banking business and the role empowers you to operate your own business vertical: designing the long-term Lending strategy roadmap, driving product adoption and growth, and ensuring strong P L performance in alignment with N26 Bank risk appetite and policies. You will build, nurture, spearhead a group of 4–6 direct reports, fostering a resilient and high-performing team that integrates seamlessly with the broader strategic ambitions of N26. Additionally, you will work closely with Engineering, Credit, Data Science, Design and senior management to identify new opportunities, optimise current portfolio performance and deliver with high standards and high velocity.

Based in Berlin or Barcelona.

Your impact
• Drive Sustainable Product Growth: define and execute the long-term retail lending strategy to expand the customer base, unlock new opportunities, and sustainably increase product adoption.
• Own the Roadmap and P L: take full ownership of the consumer lending product roadmap, from defining product future direction, priorities and product timeline and features to ensuring the cross-functional team meets deliverables and deadlines. You will own the outcomes of the P L and work closely with Credit Risk teams to shape and grow the lending portfolio.
• Team Management and Leadership: architect and scale an efficient lending organization, design high-performing team structures, establish clear governance, and embed success metrics across all areas of responsibility.
• Strengthen Cross-Functional Collaboration: become a connective tissue between Product, Credit Risk, Operations and Data Science, deeply understanding underlying credit risk models to ensure robust, compliant, and data-driven lending decisions.
• Market Development and Acceleration: scale market penetration and portfolio growth by identifying systemic levers that expand customer adoption of N26 lending products.

What you bring
• Strategic Product Business Leadership: a proven track record in senior Product Management leadership, P L ownership, demonstrating a balance of a strong product mindset and high-level business acumen. You are proficient in translating complex product strategies into scalable commercial success and measurable P L growth.
• Lending Domain Expertise: proven experience in banking, fintech, or the broader lending space (e.g., credit lines, BNPL, loans, mortgages etc).
• Team Leadership: you possess proven ability to build, nurture and grow high performing teams and you can create an innovative environment where top-tier talent can thrive and deliver exceptional business results.
• Data P L Fluency: you are deeply data-driven, possess a strong understanding of P L management, and know how to use data to make sharp product decisions that move the needle for the business.
• Stakeholder Management and Cross-functional Collaboration: you are comfortable working closely with different areas of the organization. Navigating between Product, Engineering, Credit Risk Management, Data Science and Operations, you can communicate effectively, manage expectations and balance human and operational resources.

 

What you can expect 

We recognize that our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring to our workforce. We strive to build talented and diverse teams to drive our business success and empower our people to reach their full potential.

We genuinely welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We're committed to creating an inclusive workspace where everyone feels valued and respected, free from harassment and discrimination. If there's anything you need to make the application process work for you, please let us know by reaching out to candidate.exp@n26.com. 

Visit our website to learn more about Diversity, Equity, Inclusion at N26.

jobs.title: Information Security Controls Manager - Cloud & AI Governance
jobs.description:
About the opportunity

We are seeking an Information Security Controls Manager to join the Information Risk Management (IRM) Segment within the Information Security (IS) Controls team at N26. As a member of this team, you will contribute to ensuring that Information Security Controls Framework processes are operated without any disruptions, with a specialized focus on strengthening our Cloud Security posture and AI Governance frameworks. N26 and its subsidiaries operate in a variety of regulatory environments and across international boundaries, while the IRM team helps N26 to navigate this complex, demanding, and rapidly evolving technological landscape.

In this role, you will:
• Frequently communicate with various stakeholders of all levels.
• Execution and review of the Information Security (IS) Controls Framework monitoring process, ensuring comprehensive coverage of cloud infrastructure and AI/ML deployments.
• Communicate, Collate and review the evidence received via monthly control review request tickets (TOE).
• Perform QA reviews, query and or seek clarification from stakeholders to achieve the objectives of controls effectiveness.
• Highlight the gaps/risks observed during reviews, raise non-conformities, particularly concerning cloud misconfigurations and AI model risks, and suggest improvements to the teams or stakeholders.
• Liaise with the CISO office and the DPO office to provide updates on a monthly basis over the status of controls, including compliance updates regarding cloud security and AI systems.
• Improve awareness of controls, security practices, and responsible AI utilization among stakeholders.
• Contribute to the team in developing KRIs tailored to traditional IT, Cloud environments, and AI use cases.
• Working independently and managing the IS Controls daily tasks.
• Review and update the design of the controls pages from a technical perspective and maintain the control calendar.
• Actively work on the change requests from stakeholders.
• Preparation and follow-up of Change Request tickets.
• Drafting and publishing of the monthly control reports other documentation (MoMs).
• Support the team and stakeholders during audits and coordinating the action items and evidence.
• Maintain controls team’s key documentation to ensure audit readiness.
• Equally participate in designing controls, developing working instructions and procedures that are required based on security standards and regulations such as ISO 27001, EU GDPR, DORA, SWIFT, NIS2, and the EU AI Act.
• Evaluate and map internal control frameworks to cloud security benchmarks (e.g., Cloud Security Alliance (CSA), BSI C5) and AI governance frameworks.
• Facilitate and make sure that all key processes have been documented in an easy and efficient process flow.
• Design and update working instructions to implement the requirements coming from the policies.
• Identify and surface process or tooling-related inefficiencies and support AI enabled process optimizations
• Mapping of Internal control framework to the various regulations/Standards.

What you need to be successful:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, relevant to information security or computer science.
• You have approximately 4-6 years of experience in an information security compliance, risk, or audit role.
• Demonstrated experience or strong knowledge of Cloud Security controls (AWS/Google Cloud preferred) and AI/ML governance risk frameworks.
• Previous hands-on experience or knowledge on security standards such as ISO 27001, ISO42001, NIST, BSI C5, and other regulatory requirements like DORA, EU AI Act, EU CRA EU GDPR.
• Good understanding of Information Communication Technologies (ICT) and Security controls. Previous experience related to audit/compliance frameworks and methodologies is a plus.
• Ability to communicate clearly with peers, as well as stakeholders of all levels.
• You are proficient in using Jira, Confluence and Google Workspace apps. (i.e. Docs, Sheets, Slides). Good understanding of Google Sheets features and formulas.
• Previous experience with Compliance tools is a plus (i.e. ServiceNow, OneTrust..).
• Ability to analyze and evaluate documentation, reports, data, flowcharts etc., for IT processes such as system development, cloud infrastructure management, and IT operations.
• Fluency in English is strictly required. German proficiency is a plus.
• You have insight into information security and are willing to become deeply acquainted with EU regulatory laws, standard banking requirements, as well as cloud-native banking IT-Systems.
• You have a hands-on mentality and are comfortable to share improvement ideas about existing processes.

What’s in it for you:
• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
• Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds.
• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. 

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities. 

Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

jobs.description:

As Senior Associate, Treasury, you will autonomously drive core treasury operations, liquidity and cash management, and investments (with a primary focus on public sector financing). In this role, you will:
• Trade Execution Portfolio Management: Evaluate potential investment opportunities, then price (Bloomberg experience required), execute, and log transactions across Front Office tools, focusing primarily on public sector financing and short maturities. Proactively manage money market products and the short-term book, including Repo and Reverse Repo portfolios.
• Liquidity Reserve Management: Oversee key liquidity functions, including Bundesbank cash pooling, Eurosystem minimum reserve requirements, overnight deposits, credit lines, and short-term portfolio hedging.
• Payment Systems Central Bank Operations: Serve as the primary deputy for key payment and settlement infrastructure (Target, ESMIG, MACCS) and oversee central bank account management.
• Audit, Compliance Governance: Support internal and external audits, enforce compliance with key banking regulations, and drive First Line of Defense (1LoD) risk management.
• Product Tech Initiatives: Lead New Product Process (NPP) implementations, vendor onboarding, core banking system enhancements, and automated reporting solutions using SQL.

Strong background in bank treasury operations, liquidity management, and money markets, with a preference for hands-on Repo/Reverse Repo and hedging experience.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About the Team 

The Financial Crime Quality Assurance (QA) team at OKX is responsible for maintaining and enhancing the quality of financial crime investigations across the business. We are a team of risk-focused professionals who independently assess investigation quality, promote consistency in decision-making, and ensure compliance with AML/CFT requirements, internal policies, and regulatory expectations. By working closely with Operations, Product, and Compliance teams, we help strengthen financial crime controls and drive continuous improvement across the investigation lifecycle.

 

About the Opportunity 

This is an exciting opportunity to join the Compliance Assurance Function of a regulated crypto business. As a QA Analyst, you will be responsible for conducting quality reviews of financial crime investigations, assessing investigator decision-making, and ensuring compliance with AML/CFT requirements, internal policies, and quality standards. You will work closely with Operations, Team Leads, and Product teams to drive continuous improvement, strengthen investigation quality, and support the effectiveness of the firm’s financial crime controls.

 

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Quality Reviews – Conduct daily independent QA reviews of investigator and Sanctions casework, including Transaction Monitoring, Name Screening, EDD, and other AML investigations. Evaluate accuracy, completeness, adherence to AML/CFT policies, regulatory requirements, internal procedures, and the quality of case narratives. Assess whether investigative decisions are well-supported, risk-based, and appropriately documented, including escalation and disposition outcomes. Identify defects, document findings, and provide clear, constructive feedback to investigators and team leads.
• Stakeholder Collaboration – Partner closely with the Financial Crimes Operations team, Team Leads, Product teams, and other stakeholders to communicate QA findings, discuss quality trends, resolve process gaps, and ensure consistent interpretation of policies and quality standards. Build strong relationships across AML and other cross-functional teams to support a holistic approach to compliance and risk management.
• Quality Calibration Internal QA Meetings – Participate in and facilitate regular QA calibration sessions to review complex or borderline cases, discuss grey areas, align on scoring methodology, and ensure consistency in quality evaluations across the QA team. Share key findings, emerging typologies, regulatory expectations, and best practices to improve review quality and reduce subjectivity.
• Performance Monitoring Reporting – Monitor investigator quality performance, analyze QA findings and recurring error trends, and prepare regular quality reports and dashboards. Identify systemic issues, emerging risks, root causes, and opportunities to strengthen controls and support management decision-making.
• Coaching Quality Improvement – Provide timely and actionable feedback to investigators and team leads to improve investigation quality, strengthen analytical skills, and enhance case documentation. Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for AML investigations by providing guidance on complex or high-risk cases, typologies, and regulatory expectations. Support remediation activities by validating corrective actions and tracking quality improvements over time.
• Policy Process Compliance – Ensure all reviews are conducted in accordance with internal AML/CFT policies, regulatory requirements, quality frameworks, and standard operating procedures. Escalate potential compliance risks, control weaknesses, or systemic issues identified during QA reviews.
• Continuous Improvement QA Framework – Support continuous improvement by recommending enhancements to investigation procedures, QA methodologies, workflows, scorecards, sampling frameworks, training materials, and quality controls. Contribute to AI-enabled quality tools such as QA Copilot and participate in UAT, process validation, and implementation of new quality initiatives.
• AML Projects Program Enhancements – Participate in AML-related projects, initiatives, and program enhancements as required. Provide QA expertise and support cross-functional initiatives aimed at strengthening AML controls, processes, and overall program effectiveness.
• Ad Hoc Responsibilities – Perform additional assignments and special projects as delegated by the supervisor, including process improvement initiatives, training support, root cause analysis, documentation updates, and cross-functional projects to strengthen the overall quality program.

 

What We Look For In You
• Bachelor's degree in law, finance, business administration or a related field; a relevant compliance certification (e.g. ICA, CAMS) is an advantage
• Prior experience in a compliance, legal or regulatory role within financial services, fintech or crypto industry is preferred
• Strong understanding of AML/CFT regulations, financial crime investigations, transaction monitoring, and QA methodologies, with the ability to evaluate investigation quality, assess decision-making, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and quality standards
• Strong analytical ability, with the capacity to assess regulatory obligations, identify gaps and produce well-reasoned written analysis
• High attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records and produce consistent, high-quality documentation
• Fluent in English with clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to convey compliance requirements to non-specialist colleagues
• Strong organisational skills, able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, prioritise effectively and meet regulatory deadlines
• Comfortable operating with limited supervision, escalating appropriately when required

 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager / Director, Trading Products
jobs.description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

OKX is building out its equities and tokenized securities business. This is a post-trade and brokerage systems product role — you will own the layer that sits between our users and the securities markets: order management, execution, settlement, asset servicing and reconciliation.

We have strong crypto product and engineering talent. What this role brings is depth in brokerage architecture and securities market structure: how these systems are built, why they are built that way, and what breaks at scale. You will be the internal authority on that, and your judgment will shape decisions that are expensive to reverse.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Own the brokerage core — order management, execution and routing, instrument lifecycle and trading status, settlement and reconciliation.
• Shape account, custody and clearing architecture, along with the operating model required to run it.
• Own corporate actions and asset servicing end to end, in both conventional and on-chain form.
• Define how securities risk and margin frameworks coexist with those of a 24/7 digital asset market.
• Bring market structure, execution quality and regulatory requirements into product decisions early, before they become blockers.
• Set the standard for rigour — write PRDs precise enough to build from, and lead alignment across engineering, risk, legal, compliance and treasury.

What We Look For In You 

Domain Depth
• 5+ years in post-trade or brokerage systems product management. We strongly prefer candidates from internet and licensed brokerages — Futu, Tiger, Interactive Brokers, Robinhood, Webull, Longbridge — as well as clearing firms and brokerage infrastructure providers.
• Architectural perspective. You have a clear view of where responsibility belongs across the order, execution, clearing, settlement, asset servicing and ledger layers, and of what goes wrong downstream when a boundary is drawn in the wrong place.
• Depth across the order and execution path. Order types and parameters, state machine design, idempotency across an external execution boundary, cancel/replace and partial-fill semantics, timeout and exception recovery. This is the core craft of the role.
• End-to-end ownership of at least one area beyond the order path — clearing and settlement, corporate actions and asset servicing, margin and risk, securities lending, or position and cash reconciliation.
• Commercial and historical perspective. You understand how a brokerage actually earns, how each revenue line constrains the systems beneath it, and why the industry made the structural choices it did.

Ways of Working
• Strong technical intuition. You are comfortable discussing system architecture and data flows with engineers. You do not need to be a developer, but you think with the rigour of one.
• You design for the exceptions — the halted symbol, the timed-out counterparty, the partial fill, the corporate action mid-flight — not just the order that goes through.
• You run programs, not just write specs. You produce rigorous PRDs independently, drive alignment across engineering, risk, legal, compliance and treasury, and own the full lifecycle from requirements through post-launch review.
• You write precisely, and can make complex mechanics legible to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
• High agency. You are comfortable taking an open question all the way to a shipped, reconciled system, and making calls with incomplete information.
• Proficiency in Mandarin is required to communicate effectively with internal engineering and product stakeholders in the China-based R D center.

Nice-To-Haves
• Product experience with margin financing or securities lending.
• Exposure to tokenized securities, digital asset custody, or on-chain settlement.
• Experience integrating with broker-dealer or clearing APIs, as either the integrator or the provider.
• Hands-on experience with multi-jurisdiction regulatory frameworks — SEC/FINRA, MiFID II, or equivalent.
• A track record of launching a brokerage product in a new market from zero.
• Fluency in English to support communication with global product and business stakeholders.
• Genuine curiosity about what happens when securities markets meet 24/7 markets.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!
