Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions.

Job Description:

Technical Program Manager

As a Technical Program Manager at YouTrip, you'll help our engineering organization deliver complex, cross-team programs that power payments for millions of customers and businesses across Asia Pacific. You'll bring structure to large initiatives that span mobile, backend, infrastructure, risk, and compliance. You'll turn ambiguous goals into clear roadmaps, keep teams across India and the region aligned, and make sure critical launches ship on time, safely, and at the quality our customers expect from a financial product.

You'll also help raise the bar for how engineering works at YouTrip by driving shared standards, better delivery processes, and the tools and practices that help teams move faster with confidence. This role needs a strong mix of technical understanding and people skills, so you can earn the trust of engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders alike.

Technical Program Management at YouTrip sits within our engineering organization and plays a key role in helping teams across India and the region deliver as one. TPMs are experienced technologists who create clarity, make sure we focus on the right priorities, drive execution, and manage risk on programs that depend on strong cross-team collaboration. You'll be joining a growing India team at an important stage, with real influence over how we build and scale.

Responsibilities:
• Lead the end-to-end delivery of multiple complex, technical programs at once, such as new market launches, card and payment network integrations, platform migrations, and regulatory or security initiatives.
• Work with engineering, product, design, QA, risk, compliance, and operations teams to define scope, requirements, milestones, and ownership.
• Build roadmaps that balance near-term deliverables with the longer-term technical direction of each program.
• Track progress, surface blockers early, and resolve cross-team dependencies across India and regional teams in Singapore and other markets.
• Anticipate risks across teams and systems, and put mitigation and contingency plans in place before they affect customers or deadlines.
• Use metrics throughout the program lifecycle (delivery health, quality, reliability, and business outcomes) so decisions are grounded in data.
• Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, from engineering teams to senior leadership, through status updates, reviews, and presentations.
• Coordinate release planning for mobile (Android and iOS) and backend services, including launch readiness, rollouts, and post-launch reviews.
• Drive improvements to engineering processes, such as planning cadences, incident follow-ups, documentation standards, and delivery tooling.
• Help teams work well together by building a collaborative, accountable, and enjoyable program culture.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• 8+ years of experience in technology, including at least 4 years as a Technical Program Manager, engineering manager, or in a similar delivery leadership role.
• A background as a software engineer or in a closely related technical role, with the ability to follow system design discussions and spot edge cases and risks in technical specs.
• Working knowledge of several technology areas, such as mobile development, backend and distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, data, or security, and the ability to pick up new ones quickly.
• Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or other regulated environments is a strong plus.
• Proven success delivering large programs across multiple teams, time zones, and locations.
• Comfort with ambiguity and a habit of creating clarity: you make sure goals, owners, dependencies, and risks are understood by everyone involved.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics simply to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Strong relationship-building

• A focus on outcomes over activity: you prioritize by impact, think strategically, and are still willing to dig into details to help the team deliver.

• Relevant certifications (e.g. PMP, CSM, SAFe) are a plus but not required.

jobs.title: Director, Head of Private Equity
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Partnerships at Brex:

The primary focus of the Partnerships team at Brex is to drive net new pipeline and revenue. We originate, launch, and scale partnerships across emerging distribution channels, embedded models, and other strategic bets that accelerate Brex's growth trajectory.

As Brex nears $1B in revenue, we are building a best-in-class Partnerships organization grounded in clear priorities and disciplined execution. Every member of our team directly contributes to top-line growth by expanding Brex's reach across key ecosystems, from technology platforms to financial sponsors who influence large customer networks.Within Business Development, the Private Equity Channel team is responsible for building partnerships with PE firms to drive new customer growth, generate pipeline, and increase engagement and monetization of existing customers.

Over the past 12 months, Brex's PE channel hit an inflection point, turning Tier 1 private equity firms into active referral sources for their portfolio companies due to demonstrable ROI. That model was proven through consistent in-market presence: dinners, conferences, events, and the trust that compounds across repeated value-added touchpoints. The channel is now at a critical scaling moment. With a proven playbook and a growing book of top-tier sponsor relationships, we are hiring a Director to take ownership of the entire PE channel — leading the team, sharpening the strategy, and raising the ceiling on what this channel can deliver.

What You'll Do:

We are hiring a Director, Private Equity Channel to lead and scale Brex's PE partnerships organization. Based in New York, you will own the full PE channel strategy: setting direction, managing and growing the team, holding the most senior sponsor relationships, and driving the referral engine that turns PE firms into durable, high-conviction distribution partners for Brex.

This is a player-coach role for a senior operator who has both the relationship credibility to command a room with managing directors and the management instincts to build a team around them. You will inherit a functioning playbook and existing tier 1 partners, and your mandate is to manage these key relationships while building and scaling the team.

Where You'll Work:

This role will be based in our New York City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities:
• Hire, develop, and manage a team of Partner Managers across East Coast, West Coast, and emerging PE geographies, setting the bar for performance and career growth
• Own the PE channel strategy end-to-end — target firm prioritization, coverage model, engagement motion, and referral conversion — and identify new growth vectors across geographies, firm tiers, and portfolio models
• Build the internal case for channel investment and headcount, presenting performance and roadmap to senior leadership
• Personally own and deepen relationships with the most strategic Tier 1 PE firms, serving as escalation point and executive sponsor across the team's book
• Represent Brex across the PE ecosystem at premier industry events, dinners, and conferences
• Partner with Marketing on field events and content, and with Sales leadership on handoffs and referral-to-close conversion
• Drive internal alignment with Finance, RevOps, and Partnerships on channel prioritization and metrics infrastructure during planning cycles

Requirements:
• 8–12+ years of experience in PE business development, financial services sales, partnerships, or a related senior role with consistent, demonstrable exposure to the private equity ecosystem.
• 4+ years of people management experience; track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing BD or sales talent.
• Established senior-level relationships within the New York private equity community; credible with managing directors and partners at leading PE firms from day one.
• Proven channel builder — experience standing up or significantly scaling a partnerships motion, not just maintaining one.
• Strong commercial instincts; able to connect PE relationship activity to pipeline generation, ARR outcomes, and executive-level narratives.
• Excellent written and verbal communication; executive-ready in both internal stakeholder management and external partner engagement.
• High organizational acumen — able to manage a team, a personal book of relationships, and strategic workstreams simultaneously without dropping quality.
• Based in New York; comfortable being in-market regularly for dinners, events, and partner engagements.
• Self-directed and entrepreneurial; able to operate with high autonomy while maintaining tight alignment with Partnerships leadership.

The expected OTE range for this role is $316,400 - $395,500. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

You’ll partner closely with Staff Engineers, product leaders, and GTM stakeholders to shape where we invest and how we deliver customer and business impact.

This role will be based in Vancouver. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We require three days per week in the office—Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday—and offer up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.

• Raise the technical bar through design reviews, hands-on implementation, operational excellence, and pragmatic engineering standards.
• Champion repeatable, secure, and high-velocity delivery across the group, including strong practices for code review, deployment safety, and operational excellence.
• Act as a force multiplier by mentoring senior engineers, improving how teams plan and execute, and developing the next generation of technical leaders.
• Collaborate with product, design, data, operations, and go-to-market partners to translate ambiguous business opportunities into scalable technical solutions.
• Bring an AI-forward mindset to how the group builds customer experiences, internal tooling, and engineering workflows.

Requirements:
• 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership across multiple teams or a large product area.
• Demonstrated ability to identify and drive ambiguous, cross-cutting problems to resolution without a narrowly defined charter.
• Deep experience designing, building, and operating large-scale backend or full-stack systems in production.
• Strong product and business judgment, with the ability to connect technical investments to customer experience, growth, and operational outcomes.
• Proven ability to influence across engineering, product, and business stakeholders without direct authority.

jobs.title: Senior Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About this role 

We’re looking for a Senior Design Engineer to join the Consensys Design team, supporting MetaMask - the most used wallet in crypto. This is a rare opportunity to bring beautiful, intuitive experiences to millions of users engaging with decentralized applications and Web3 technologies every day.

As a Senior Design Engineer, you'll turn complex flows into simple and delightful experiences across our app and browser extension. Working closely with designers, engineers, and product managers, you'll take ideas from prototype to production - sweating the animations, haptics, and micro-interactions that make every interaction feel considered, not just functional. You'll build in React and React Native with an eye for pixel-perfect execution, contribute to our design system, and build agentic workflows that help the team move faster without cutting corners. If you love making complex things feel simple, care about craft down to the smallest detail, and want that craft in the hands of 30M+ users, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

In one sentence: Make MetaMask interactions feel intuitive, fast, and delightful - across mobile and extension
• Build pixel-perfect interfaces in React and React Native, with obsessive attention to detail.
• Design and implement animations and micro-interactions that make every tap feel considered.
• Translate Figma designs into accessible, production-ready experiences with minimal handoff friction.
• Build agentic workflows and tooling that speed up design-to-code and day-to-day engineering work.
• Grow the MetaMask design system: reusable, accessible components built to scale across platforms.
• Move from idea to prototype fast and validate with real users.
• Push for craft everywhere - the small animation nobody asked for that makes an interaction click.

Key Experience
• Portfolio demonstrating delightful, polished interfaces and interactions - not just static screens, but the motion and detail that make them feel alive.
• Proven track record shipping high-traffic, consumer-facing products in React and React Native.
• Fluency in modern JS/TypeScript and cross-platform frontend architecture: performance, accessibility, and scalable UI patterns
• An eye for interaction design and motion - you know when animations and haptics earn their place and when they're just noise.
• Strong Figma literacy - you read a design file like code.
• Good judgment about when to polish and when to ship.
• Comfortable working autonomously across a distributed, global team
• Hands-on experience with crypto wallets, blockchain, or related Web3 products.

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range.

US pay range (not including bonus, equity or other benefits)

$149,000 $210,000 USD

In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3.

MetaMask is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

MetaMask is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices and we encourage all applicants to review our best practices to protect yourself, which can be found on our page.

MetaMask may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications, screening resumes, or conducting initial candidate assessments. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and improve efficiency — they do not replace human judgment. A human recruiter or hiring manager reviews every candidate, and all final hiring decisions are made by people, not AI.

It is a requirement of employment in this position that applicants may be required to submit to background and identity verification checks, including but not limited to employment, education, criminal record checks, and other such checks as determined necessary by the company.

jobs.title: CRM Manager
jobs.description:
Crypto.com is seeking a CRM Manager to lead the strategy and execution of cross-channel communications across our product verticals. Key functions will include driving platform retention, engagement, onboarding, and usage metrics, via channels including but not limited to push notifications, email, in-app etc.
The CRM Manager will work closely with Marketing, Product, Creative, Legal, Compliance, and MarTech teams to deliver campaigns that are timely, compliant, and audience-right. The CRM Manager must demonstrate a deep understanding of the company's products and the customer lifecycle, identify consumer touchpoints, and develop actionable strategies to meet business objectives and customers' needs. The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership and communication skills, be highly organized and detail-oriented, embrace AI as a force multiplier, and be capable of managing multiple projects and workstreams simultaneously in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment.

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Product Manager, User Onboarding & Growth (Crypto.com App)
jobs.description:
Our Product Management team drives product initiatives from inception through execution, makes impacts and launches products/features across our global footprint. We collaborate closely with engineers, designers, analysts, marketers, and other cross-functional team members to ship remarkable features and products.

Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own customer onboarding across the Crypto.com App and adjacent product surfaces. Onboarding is where regulatory requirements, customer acquisition, and time-to-first-value meet. Every improvement you ship should help more customers open an account compliantly, activate faster, and reach the products that matter.
Your mandate is to own the onboarding journey as both a growth product and a regulated platform: KYC and account opening, activation and referral mechanics, new-product onboarding, and a meaningful trading scope. Within six months, you will own the onboarding-and-growth charter and take on trading product work in addition to the onboarding charter. 
You will report to Onboarding squad Lead and work closely on the trading portion of the charter. You will run your roadmap with independence, make prioritization calls, and own the how and the when. 
If you have built onboarding in a regulated consumer fintech, parts of this will feel familiar. The difference is the breadth: one onboarding platform must support a growing set of products, regulatory paths, and trading journeys. The playbook is still being written.

Life @ Crypto.com
 
Empowered to think big. Try new opportunities while working with a talented, ambitious and supportive team.
Transformational and proactive working environment. Elevate employees to find thoughtful and innovative solutions.
Growth from within. We help to develop new skill-sets that would impact the shaping of your personal and professional growth.
Work Culture. Our colleagues are some of the best in the industry; we are all here to help and support one another.
One cohesive team. Engage stakeholders to achieve our ultimate goal - Cryptocurrency in every wallet. 
 
 
Are you ready to kickstart your future with us? 
 
Benefits
 
Competitive salary 
Medical insurance package with extended coverage to dependents 
Attractive annual leave entitlement including: birthday, work anniversary
Work Flexibility Adoption. Flexi-work hour and hybrid or remote set-up
Aspire career alternatives through us. Our internal mobility program can offer employees a diverse scope. 
Work Perks: crypto.com visa card provided upon joining 
 
Our Crypto.com benefits packages vary depending on region requirements, you can learn more from our talent acquisition team.

Founded in 2016, Crypto.com serves more than 80 million customers and is the world's fastest growing global cryptocurrency platform. Our vision is simple: Cryptocurrency in Every Wallet™. Built on a foundation of security, privacy, and compliance, Crypto.com is committed to accelerating the adoption of cryptocurrency through innovation and empowering the next generation of builders, creators, and entrepreneurs to develop a fairer and more equitable digital ecosystem.
 
Learn more at https://crypto.com.

jobs.title: Field Credit Officer (Ogun)
jobs.description:
About Us: 

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest-growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere.

Job Title: Field Credit Officer 

Reports to: Regional Credit Manager 

Employment Type: Outsourced 

Work Mode: Onsite

About this role: 

As a Field Credit Officer, you would be saddled with the duty of onboarding and managing businesses that would access our credit products. You would be tasked with growing your loan portfolio while maintaining profitability by ensuring that all loans are repaid as and when due. As a result, you would play a vital role in the assessment of these businesses during their credit application and leverage innovative tools we have developed to help you monitor their performance during the course of the loan.

You would also be responsible for making deductions from several information sources about the 5Cs of credit, with capacity, character, and capital as major priorities. Make recommendations to management before, during, and after the disbursement of a loan facility as to the best actions to be taken, considering several economic factors.

Responsibilities:
• Identify and onboard viable businesses within your assigned geographical area to open business accounts with Moniepoint
• Engage customers to ensure optimal usage of accounts to allow them to qualify for access to credit
• Review and approve (or decline) loan requests by thoroughly analyzing all the data available
• Embark on physical visitation to potential borrowers’ business places for evaluation of business books, taking inventory and turnover into consideration
• Meet gross loan portfolio targets and portfolio profit targets by maintaining a healthy number of loan customers while ensuring that all loans in portfolio are performing
• Monitor active loan portfolio to ensure continued use of business account and loan repayment performance
• Perform all other credit-related functions as may be assigned by a supervisor 

Experience Background:
• Minimum of an OND in any business-related discipline
• Minimum of 2 years’ experience in a sales role for credit products in a financial institution
• Demonstrable knowledge of credit risk analysis
• Good knowledge of financial analysis is an added advantage 

Skills Competencies:
• Apt attention to details
• Proven simple/complex analytical skills
• Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
• Agility and perseverance 

What success looks like

in this role:
• Consistent achievement of gross loan portfolio targets and portfolio profit targets.
• Maintaining a healthy, performing loan portfolio with minimized default rates through rigorous physical visitations and monitoring.
• Successful onboarding and engagement of viable businesses that actively utilize Moniepoint business accounts.
• Accurate credit risk assessments based on key factors like capacity, character, and capital. 

Why join us:
• Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities.
• Opportunity to work with Africa’s fastest-growing fintech and make a direct impact on business growth across the region.

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer - Intern
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

Software Engineering Internship (Summer 2027)

Closing Date: 1st of November 2026

📍London | 💰 £42,500 pro rata | Technology | L10 on the Engineering Framework

Engineering at Monzo

We have 500+ engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.

These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.

We contribute to open source software as much as possible. Our blog is a good place to learn even more about what we do.

Engineering Interns

As a software engineer intern at Monzo, you’ll be matched with a team where you’ll spend the summer working on a real project for our customers. We’ll pair you with a mentor who will support you to design and ship a solution to solve a real problem.

You’ll have the opportunity to work alongside engineers to learn more about software engineering and the types of challenges engineers at Monzo solve on a day-to-day basis.

You’ll spend your internship:
• Writing, testing and shipping code that supports new features for our customers
• Reviewing code for your colleagues, to pick up any improvements and learn from your peers
• Working with product managers, designers and data analysts on your team
• Learning about new technologies, engineering practices and what a full-time software engineering role looks like
• Proactively seeking out feedback to improve and accelerate your learning

What you’ll be using: 

We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies:
• Go to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial here)
• Cassandra for most persistent data storage
• Kafka for our asynchronous message queue
• Kubernetes and Docker to schedule and run our services
• AWS for most of our production infrastructure and GCP for most of our data infrastructure
• React for our public web apps and internal tools
• Kotlin for our Android app
• Swift for our iOS app

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…
• You are completing a degree in Computer Science or another technical field with exposure to programming and are graduating in 2028
• You enjoy learning about new technologies and have a passion for problem-solving
• You are available full-time for a minimum of 12 weeks between June and September 2027, we will have two June start dates to choose from
• You have the right to work in the UK without restrictions for the full 12-week internship and would not require visa sponsorship if offered a permanent position
• You can work from our London office on a hybrid basis to collaborate with your team and mentor, as well as attend intern events over the summer

Please note you must hold the right to work in the UK through the full duration of this internship. 

🙌What’s in it for you

💰£42,500 pro rata

📍This role will be based in our London office on a hybrid basis (2 days per week in office)

⏰ We offer flexible full-time working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team 

💻 Top-spec Macbook to use over the course of your time with us 

🧠 Knowledge-sharing sessions with your squad and wider discipline 

👯 Team and company wide socials / events 

🍝 Lunch on Monzo twice a week from a range of street food vendors 

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

Our application process involves three main stages:
• Submit your application with the short questions answered
• If you’re successful, we’ll invite you to complete an exercise to demonstrate your programming and problem-solving skills
• If all goes well, you’ll have your final interviews with members of our engineering team via Google Meet

The closing date for applications is 1st of November 2026, but we encourage you to apply as soon as possible as we will be extending offers on a rolling basis.

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

Check out our blog to hear from our recent Interns.

#EP-1

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. jobs.description:

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£79,900 - £95,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

Our Credit Oversight team⭐

Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and with the planned launch of new initiatives. As our lending portfolio grows, our second line of defence Credit Risk Oversight team is growing with it - and we’re looking for a Credit Risk Oversight Manager to join us!

Our Credit Risk Oversight team is crucial in providing support and challenge to our Borrowing teams in the first line of defence to help Monzo grow safely. We’re looking for someone (maybe you?!) with proven experience in consumer credit risk who likes getting into the details and analysing data to deliver independent assurance - and challenge - of credit risk management across the lifecycle. 

Ideally you’ll have experience and in-depth knowledge of retail unsecured or small business credit risk strategy within financial services. You’ll have seen first-hand how a credit portfolio performs at different stages of the credit cycle, and have hands-on experience in shaping or overseeing lending strategies. You’ll have a collaborative approach, and be comfortable working across a broad range of stakeholders. You’ll also be someone who likes getting into the details, analysing data and providing constructive challenges.

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

Providing ongoing oversight of credit risk - this includes analysing and understanding the performance of our existing lending products, developing and enhancing monitoring metrics and providing input to relevant committees and forums
• Partnering with our first line of defence teams to support credit strategy changes - including new product launches and pilots - ensuring that we deliver magical lending products for our customers while meeting our Risk Appetite
• Delivering deep insight, feedback and challenge on our credit strategies - including data-driven analysis and actionable counter-proposals - to support management decision making and shaping better outcomes for our customers
• Leading second line assurance work on thematic reviews
• Collaborating with our model validation and model development teams to ensure understanding of the models that underpin our credit strategies
• Providing credit expertise and input into relevant strategic projects and critical Monzo-wide processes, such as stress-testing and forecasting
• Supporting us in maintaining our Credit Risk Framework and making sure it is well embedded within the business
• Taking a balanced and proportionate approach to risk management, making sure that managing risks becomes part of everyone at Monzo’s day-to-day role

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you …
• Have a strong background in credit risk management within consumer or small business lending - experience in unsecured product, such as credit cards, loans or overdrafts would be particularly beneficial
• Have proven analytical skills, and can use these to interrogate data, build monitoring and look for early indicators of trends
• Have hands-on experience and/or understanding of how to use credit risk scorecards and NPV models to develop strategies for making credit decisions
• Have a solid technical toolkit; SQL or similar is a must-have, and experience using a data visualisation tool (such as Looker, PowerBI or Tableau) is a plus
• Are excited to explore how we can use AI tools to improve our credit and risk management processes
• Can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see Monzo’s tone of voice guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts
• Have a track record of building and maintaining trusting relationships with stakeholders, while providing effective and respectful challenge
• Are passionate about technology, and what we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply - even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £79,900-95,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) 

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. 

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps
• An initial call with our recruiter
• A call with one of our Credit Risk Oversight Managers, the hiring manager(s) for the role
• A take-home task
• Two competency, based interviews - one role specific technical interview and one behaviours and values interview

This process should take around 4-8 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

jobs.title: 法人金融事業グロース・事業開発担当
jobs.description:
PayPayについて/About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

 

業務について

▼PayPay金融戦略本部の紹介

金融戦略本部は、PayPayの顧客基盤・加盟店基盤や豊富な決済データと、グループ各社が持つ金融機能を掛け合わせ、AI時代の新たな金融体験を創り出す、事業開発のプロフェッショナル集団です。
給与デジタル払いをはじめとする、日常の資金移動を支える金融プラットフォームの構築に加え、PayPayアプリ上で利用できるポイント運用や、PayPay証券が提供するミニアプリの事業推進を担っています。
また、加盟店向けには、「PayPay資金調達」の事業推進に加え、銀行代理業として、PayPay銀行が提供する「PayPay店舗専用ローン」や法人口座の利用拡大を推進しています。
顧客課題の発見から、事業戦略の策定、サービス企画、グロースまでを一気通貫で担い、新しい金融の当たり前を事業として実現していきます。

▼関連コンテンツ
• PayPayでツクル金融のミライ_Vol. 01
• PayPayでツクル金融のミライ_Vol. 02
• PayPayでツクル金融のミライ_Vol. 03
• PayPayでツクル金融のミライ_Vol. 05
• その仕事はユーザーファーストか？業界の常識を超えた「金融」サービスへの追求
• 機械学習モデル×ユーザーファーストで、想定の5倍の成果を生んだ「PayPay資金調達」
• 給与デジタル払いで「人生の選択肢」を増やす。お金の流れを変えるサービスを日本で初めてリリース
• 金融を“変える側”に回る選択 — 価値を起点に仕事をする事業開発

▼募集の背景
スマホファーストな金融サービスのUIUXを拡充していくためには、ユーザーが抱える課題に対する解決策（そのほとんどは、まだ世の中に存在していません）をUIUXやサービスで実現することになります。
ところが、ユーザーが抱える課題は、目に見えないことが多いです。ユーザーに聞いても教えてくれません。
それを発見し課題を構造化して解決策まで昇華できるのは、金融サービスをより良くしていきたいと言う強い情熱がある人だけだと思っています。
本気のユーザー・ファーストな金融サービスを実現すること、それを新しく入ってくれる方に実行していただきたいです。

▼業務内容

コンシューマーのモバイル決済分野でユーザーの購入体験を大きく変えてきたPayPayですが、
これからはコンシューマーだけではなく、加盟店向けにもユーザーファーストな決済・金融サービスの発明にチャレンジしていきます。

グローバルには既に加盟店向けにユーザーファーストを追求したビジネスサービスが存在しています。
PayPayは後発ながら、それらに比肩する「誰でも・自然に・簡単に」利用できるサービスを発明し、事業がより便利になる世界を実現したいと考えています。

PayPayの金融事業を国内No.1にし、金融事業を通じてPayPayの収益拡大及び事業成長を担っていただきます。

【業務内容】
・加盟店向け金融サービスのB2Bマーケティング戦略の策定と実行
・市場調査、競合分析、ターゲット顧客の明確化
・PayPayのビッグデータを活用した、インサイトの抽出と戦略・施策への反映
・リードジェネレーション及びリードナーチャリング施策の企画・実行
・各種マーケティング施策の企画・実行・効果測定・分析・改善

【対象プロダクト】
・PayPay資金調達
・PayPay銀行代理業（口座媒介・PayPay店舗専用ローン）

▼本ポジションの魅力

＜ポジションの魅力＞
・PayPayのアセットを活用して、大きな市場に対する新規事業開発にチャレンジできる
・0→1フェーズで、調査・企画・開発・グロースまで、新規事業開発の一連のプロセスに携われる
・プロダクトの社内開発で、真にユーザーファーストなサービス開発に携われる
・グループアセットを活用して、グローバルな先進事例を踏まえた戦略立案・事業推進が行える

＜チームメンバー＞
・ビジネス向け金融に精通したプロフェッショナルなメンバーで構成されたチームです。メガバンクやコンサル、SaaS企業など様々な業界出身の仲間で構成されております。

必要な経験/スキル

【必須要件】
・B2Bのデジタルサービス（金融、SaaS、Webサービス等）において、PLやトップライン（売上）を意識し、事業をグロースさせた中心的なご経験
 （※事業開発、マーケティング、プロダクトマネジメントなど、どの職種でのご経験かは問いませんが、どれか一つに卓越したスキル・能力をお持ちの方）
・急成長フェーズの事業会社（スタートアップ/ベンチャー）やコンサルティングファーム等、流動性が高くスピードが早い組織での勤務経験

【応募要件】
以下のいずれか、または複数のご経験をお持ちの方

＜事業開発・戦略系のご経験＞
・新規SaaS事業の立ち上げや、0→1、1→10フェーズをリードしたご経験
・事業計画の策定、KPI設計の実務経験
・BizDev（事業開発）やアライアンス戦略の立案・実行のご経験

＜マーケティング・グロース系のご経験＞
・The Model型の組織における、マーケティング戦略の立案・実行のご経験
・プロダクトのデータ分析に基づき、プロダクトレッドグロース戦略を企画・実行したご経験

jobs.title: Policy and Procedure Lead - Ongoing Monitoring
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:
• Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About

the Role:
• As a Lead, Policy and Procedure, you'll sit within Tide's Ongoing Monitoring function and take ownership of the design, drafting, and ongoing maintenance of our financial crime policies and procedures — covering AML, counter-terrorist financing, sanctions, fraud, and anti-bribery and corruption.
• Working at a senior level, you'll partner closely with senior stakeholders across Compliance, Risk, and Operations to make sure our policy framework stays current with UK regulatory expectations (FCA rules, the Money Laundering Regulations, and JMLSG guidance) and reflects how the business actually operates. You'll also play a key role in maintaining the wider financial crime control framework, translating policy requirements into practical, well-governed controls, and supporting risk management across our financial crime operations.
• This is a role for someone who enjoys precision and structure, but who can also see the bigger picture — balancing regulatory rigor with commercial pragmatism in a fast-growing, member-first fintech.

Some of the Things You’ll Be Doing:
• Owning the end-to-end lifecycle of Tide's Ongoing Monitoring crime policies and procedures — drafting, reviewing, version control, approvals, and periodic reviews.
• Designing and maintaining the Ongoing Monitoring control framework, ensuring controls are clearly mapped to policy requirements and regulatory obligations. Monitoring regulatory developments (FCA, HM Treasury, OFSI, JMLSG and other relevant bodies) and translating changes into timely policy and procedure updates.
• Partnering with Ongoing Monitoring Operations Product Teams, Second Line of Defence, and Risk teams to ensure policies are operationally workable and embedded in day-to-day practice.
• Supporting internal audits, regulatory examinations, and assurance reviews with policy documentation, control evidence, and subject matter expertise.
• Conducting gap analyses against new or changed regulation and guidance, and coordinating remediation where policy updates are needed.
• Providing SME guidance to the business on policy requirements. Contributing to the wider risk management framework across financial crime operations, including risk assessments.
• Building strong working relationships across first and second line teams to ensure consistent application of policy. 

 

What We Are Looking For:
• Significant experience in financial crime compliance, with a focus on policy, procedure, or control framework design within a UK-regulated bank, payments firm, or fintech.
• Strong working knowledge of the UK financial crime regulatory framework, including FCA requirements, the Money Laundering Regulations 2017, and JMLSG guidance.
• A track record of drafting and maintaining clear, practical policy and procedure documents, including managing governance and approval processes.
• Experience designing or maintaining a financial crime control framework and supporting risk management activity.
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to operate and influence at senior level across Compliance, Risk, and the wider business.
• Excellent analytical and drafting skills — able to translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, actionable policy.
• Experience with regulatory horizon scanning, gap analysis, and remediation planning.
• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with competing priorities.
• Experience supporting internal audits or regulatory examinations is highly desirable.

 

What you’ll get in return:
• Competitive salary
• Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing
• Hundreds of perks and discounts through Vitality Health Insurance (fitness watches, Waitrose cashback, gym membership etc.)
• 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme
• 25 days holiday with the ability to buy extra days
• Professional L D budget
• Referral bonus when you bring your friends to join Tide
• Access to ‘salary sacrifice’ benefits such as Cycle to Work scheme and pension contribution
• Spacious brand new office in Liverpool street with an all-day snacks bar
• Enhanced family-friendly leave
• 24 hours paid volunteering time off per year
• Flexible work from home or at the office arrangement
• Sabbatical leave 

 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

 

Disclaimer

 

It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
• Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
• All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
• Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
• Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

jobs.title: KYC Operations Senior Analyst - Deactivations
jobs.description:
As a KYC Operations Senior Analyst - Deactivations, you will play a critical role in ensuring that Wise adheres to regulatory and compliance requirements. You will be responsible for conducting enhanced due diligence, analysing customer activities, behaviour patterns, and ensuring that our KYC records are kept up to date according to our internal standards. You will be responsible for assessing and approving onboarding of high risk customers according to regulatory standards. This role is a great opportunity for people who are interested in deepening their knowledge in the KYC domain. 

Job Responsibilities
• Conduct Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) reviews based on customer’s risk profile. Take frequent risk based approach decisions while conducting customer reviews ensuring risk management standards are met.
• Review customer transaction history and provide insights into customer behaviour patterns that may indicate risks. Conduct periodic reviews and analyse changes in customers history and account usage.
• Review and assess high risk customer reports to provide analysis and approval as per the set policies and procedures.
• Exercise discretion in setting priorities, identifying customer records that require further review and taking action to obtain and follow-up on the information and/or documentation requested.
• Ensure that information and documentation provided by customers meet our risk appetite for onboarding and maintaining high risk customers.
• Conduct in depth analysis, using provided documentation or external sources (e.g. websites and company registries) ensuring that only customers within risk appetite are onboarded. Perform searches utilising internet sources and/or third-party vendors to obtain information on prospects and new/existing customers.
• Communicate with other internal teams when required to handle escalated or complicated cases
• Provide guidance and responses to daily inquiries from peers, front-line and management regarding complex matters and case analysis, when appropriate.
• Maintain a high understanding of AML/CFT Regulations and how these impact the business, as well as Wise products and services.
• When warranted, be capable of drafting SAR narratives to report activity deemed unusual.
• Taking part in and leading projects related to the team processes and guidelines. Assist in identifying improvement opportunities and contribute to policy updates, training materials, and standard operating procedures.
• Draft reports to internal and external stakeholders, periodically and when requested.
• Have a deep understanding of different business models, customer types, country risks and regulatory requirements across multiple geographies.
• Support Wise in internal and external audits and regulatory process related queries reviews.
• Mentor, and support KYC Operations Analysts, by providing training and coaching to enhance team capabilities.
• Effective communication with customers by the relevant communication channels that Wise operates with (e.g. phone, email, and chat).
• Perform your tasks and responsibilities within the expected key performance indicators set by the leadership team.
• Tasks that are related to the position and are assigned to you by your lead. Participating in meetings, training, internal and external events.

jobs.title: Senior Android Software Engineer - Grow
jobs.description:
Wise Assets is one of the fastest-growing features today, with Stocks and Interest live in the UK, EU, Singapore, Australia, Brazil and expanding further. Our customers now already earn £50m a month from their money held across the currencies on Wise. Holding money with a bank is non-transparent and unfair. It is non-transparent because you don’t know what the bank is doing with your money, who they are lending it to, and how much they are making from it. It is unfair because they provide you with free services, which you don’t know how much they cost to provide, and give you almost zero return for holding your money with them. Unfortunately, as interest rates have increased around the world, this problem is getting worse as banks pocket a greater share of this income.

The Wise Account is our antidote to holding money in a bank. With our Assets product, we enable our customers to decide how they want to hold their money. They can choose what it is invested in and what return it makes. We then charge a fair and transparent fee before returning the rest to them. It’s simple; it is our customers' money, so they should benefit from the return it generates.

What do you need?

We are fully aware that it is uncommon for a candidate to have all skills required and we fully support everyone in learning new skills with us. So if you have some of those listed below and are eager to learn more we do want to hear from you!
• Proven experience in building and deploying an application that delights customers
• Strong proficiency in Kotlin
• Familiarity with modern app architectures like Unidirectional Data Flow, Dependency Injection, Structured Concurrency with Kotlin Coroutines, amongst others
• Desire to write testable code
• Understanding of REST API design
• Strong product mindset and passion for user experience, with a focus on prioritising work that addresses user needs and making data-driven decisions.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
• Ability to collaborate effectively within a team, as well as independently and proactively solve problems.

Nice to Have:
• Any experience with declarative UI (Compose), Gradle, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) would be great!

…but don’t worry we don’t expect you to know everything!

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer - Wise Business
jobs.description:
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world's money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. For everyone, everywhere.

Staff Product Designer:

We’re looking for a Staff Product Designer to join the Business Chapter and help shape the experience of the Wise Business product.

You’ll work closely with product managers, content designers, researchers, engineers and analysts to integrate Wise into our customer’s day-to-day financial workflows, helping them send and receive money globally while minimising financial admin and manual bookkeeping.

Our business customers are often not just one person. You’ll be designing experiences that need to work for different users across shared workflows; whether it’s Business Owners, Finance Managers, Employees, Accountants or a combination.

 

Here’s how you’ll contribute:

How can we make it easy for small businesses to manage the financial complexity of working globally? How can we integrate with their other financial tools to reduce manual bookkeeping so they spend less time on admin? How can we support a business owner to safely delegate financial tasks while maintaining control? These are some of the challenges you’ll get a chance to work on in this role.

You will work as the product designer within a team in the Business Account Management Squad, reporting into the Group Design Lead. As well as working closely with the other members of your team, you will collaborate with designers across Wise to deliver consistent, scalable experiences. You will also mentor other designers in your squad.

Your work will focus on deepening use of the product and building trust with our business customers so that Wise becomes their everyday account. 

 

Here's how you'll be contributing:
• Owning design problems in your team and working through the detail to create solutions that balance the need to design ahead with delivering incremental value.
• Building a deep understanding of the unmet needs of business users and how the Wise experience can solve for those.
• Shaping the now, next and future state of the experience, and holding the work to the outcomes we've committed to.
• Bringing systems thinking to your work and collaborating with other teams to ensure we create one coherent experience.
• Building vision with substance through evidence backed direction that shapes the roadmap.
• Raising the standard around you, through feedback, crits and skill shares, and lifting the quality of design across the squad.
• Using AI in your daily practice where it earns its place, and showing the team what that looks like.

 

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Ship work you’re proud of. Craft experiences that make complex concepts or workflows feel simple, innovative, and easy to use.
• Own your impact. choose what to work on, define what success looks like, and see your work directly improve the experience of thousands of businesses.
• Work on something genuinely difficult. Regulatory considerations, multi-user workflows, product integrations, dozens of payment methods and features all have to add up to one experience.
• Be part of a positive change in the world. We're fixing a broken, greedy system, and giving businesses control of their money.

About you:
• You've been the most senior designer on a complex product area, owning ambiguous problems end to end. The title matters less than the scope.
• You think in systems. You've designed something that had to work across many markets, formats or edge cases without fragmenting into special cases.
• You practise evidence-based design, using data and customer insights to rationalise your decisions clearly and credibly to senior stakeholders.
• You’ve got a portfolio of well-crafted, impactful work that solves real, complex problems for real people.
• You default to prototyping, explore multiple approaches, and articulate the tradeoffs clearly enough to build conviction with senior stakeholders.
• You have a high craft bar and strong visual skills, and you've worked with design systems to produce work that scales.
• You make the designers around you better. You design in the open, give direct feedback, and share credit.
• You're already using AI tools in your practice and have a point of view on where they help and where they don't.

jobs.description:

the role:

Wise moves billions every month. Every single transfer runs through Send Experience.

We own the send flow end-to-end: the product millions of customers touch, the discovery layer that makes local payment networks like Pix and UP feel native, and the platform holding tens of millions of recipient accounts worldwide. Three teams. One of the highest-impact surfaces in fintech.

We're making international transfers feel as easy as sending a message. As an iOS product engineer, you won't just build that — you’ll decide what it looks like.

Our mission is to make sending money as easy as possible. As an iOS engineer, you’ll be working on making the app experience truly exceptional. International at heart, feeling local and frictionless.

How we work:

We’re a team split between London and Tallinn. We follow a hybrid working model, ensuring enough collaboration in-person and focus time where people find it best.

What will you be working on?:

Over 10 million customers will use what you build. That's not a vanity metric, it’s the weekly reality.

The role is UI- and product-focused. The work is deeply creative: flows that need to feel effortless whether it's a first transfer from São Paulo, or a hundredth from London. Where animation timing, information hierarchy, and interaction design are real engineering problems — not afterthoughts.

And this is not a ticket factory. You'll sit with product and design from day one of an idea, challenge what "best" looks like, and ship your answer. The strongest features we've built started with an engineer saying "what if we did it this way instead." We need more of that.

Concretely:
• Craft send experiences that feel local everywhere
• Build the future of recipient discovery: search, QR scanning, and more
• Push what our iOS app can do, with thoughtful transitions, responsive interfaces, and micro-interactions that make people smile

What do you need?:

• You've built app experiences people love and can show it

• A genuine eye for craft: you notice when a transition is 100ms too slow or a layout doesn't breathe
• You think in customer problems, not tickets: you push back when something doesn't make sense and propose what should exist instead

jobs.title: Manager, Growth Analytics
jobs.description:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

Your mission 

As the Manager, Growth Analytics at Bitpanda, you will build the core decision engine for our redesigned Growth organization. Your mandate is to establish trusted measurement, define clear customer economics, and deliver the high-impact analysis that dictates where the company invests. With direct access to decision-makers, you will build an analytics capability that materially shapes our customer acquisition, retention, and commercial outcomes.

 

What you'll do
• Set the Growth measurement strategy and operating model, establishing trusted, company-wide definitions for CAC, payback, LTV, cohort performance, and incrementality.
• Lead forecasting, performance reviews, and decision-grade analysis to drive faster, more reliable, and economically grounded capital-allocation choices.
• Build and mentor a high-performing team of analytics engineers and senior analysts.
• Partner closely with Finance, Data, Product, and channel leaders to establish source-of-truth reporting and automate critical data workflows.
• Elevate the quality of our experimentation and make insights widely accessible across the organization without compromising on strict analytical standards.

 

Who you are
• You have a proven track record of building or leading an analytics capability that goes beyond basic reporting to actively change commercial and product decisions.
• You are technically credible in SQL, data modeling, experimentation, and measurement, with the confidence and expertise to challenge weak analysis.
• You possess a deep understanding of acquisition economics, cohorts, incrementality, and forecasting to set the gold standard for the company.
• You excel at creating clarity from fragmented data, prioritizing the few specific models and metrics that materially improve business outcomes.
• You are a strong cross-functional leader capable of guiding analysts while fostering tight partnerships with Data, Finance, Product, and channel owners.

 

What’s in it for you
• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

 .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

jobs.title: Senior Candidate Experience Coordinator
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Recruiting at Brex

Recruiting is where every career at Brex begins. We’re the first point of connection for future builders and leaders, helping candidates see what’s possible. We partner with leaders across the company to find exceptional talent and build high-performing teams. We move quickly, think strategically, and take pride in creating a thoughtful, welcoming candidate experience from the very first contact. We don’t just fill roles, we shape the culture at Brex, finding the next generation of builders and leaders.

What you’ll do

You’ll join a team that cares deeply about people, precision, and impact. In this role, you’ll help bring exceptional leaders to Brex and see firsthand how hiring shapes our company’s future. You’ll grow your skills in recruiting, build trusted relationships with senior leaders, and be part of a collaborative, fast-moving team that values good judgment, curiosity, and continuous learning.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Coordinate complex, multi-stakeholder interview schedules across time zones with precision and discretion.
• Serve as the main point of contact for candidates, ensuring a professional, engaging, and confidential experience from first conversation to offer.
• Partner closely with recruiters, hiring leaders, and Executive Assistants to align priorities, anticipate conflicts, and maintain clear communication.
• Apply sound judgment to navigate last-minute changes, sensitive information, and competing demands with professionalism and tact.
• Streamline processes by identifying inefficiencies and implementing improvements that enhance speed, accuracy, and candidate experience.
• Support recruiting projects, inclusive of system audits, tool management, data pulls and reviews.
• Communicate proactively and effectively across teams to build trust, ensure alignment, and maintain a high bar for quality and service.

Requirements
• 2+ years of experience as a Recruiting Coordinator, ideally supporting senior-level stakeholders
• Experience with recruiting tools such as Google Calendar, Greenhouse, ModernLoop and Gem
• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent Brex with polish and professionalism
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with experience managing multiple priorities under tight deadlines
• Proven ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and good judgment
• Solutions-oriented mindset and proactive approach to problem-solving

Bonus Points
• Bring some technical comfort with AI and automation tooling like ATS APIs, Claude, Zapier and ChatGPT

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $69,600 - $100,050. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Anaplan Support Analyst
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍London or Remote (UK)| | 💰 £42,500 - £55,000 ➕ incentive awards tied to your performance | Benefits | Hear from the team

⭐ Our Finance Anaplan Centre of Excellence Team

As an Anaplan Support Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in driving the success of our Anaplan platform and supporting our broader Centre of Excellence (CoE). Working directly alongside our Lead Solutions Architect, Model Builders, and the FP A team, you will act as the key engine powering daily operations—managing change requests, facilitating user training, and getting hands-on with model building activities to enhance our financial planning ecosystem.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by…
• Implementing Change Requests: Managing, triaging, and delivering end-to-end Change Requests across our Anaplan models to ensure seamless business operations.
• Supporting Model Building: Collaborating closely with Lead Solutions Architect and Model Builders to assist in building, testing, and implementing new functionalities and enhancements.
• Providing Training Supporting End Users: Designing and delivering engaging training sessions and documentation to upskill end-users across FP A and Finance Business Partner teams.
• Maintaining Optimising Models: Maintaining data integrity, managing user access, monitoring model performance, and troubleshooting issues as they arise.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you have…
• Anaplan Expertise: Hands-on experience supporting and maintaining Anaplan workspaces/models (Anaplan Level 2 Model Builder certification or equivalent is highly desirable).
• Managed Change Requests Supported Systems: Proven track record handling Change Requests, user support tickets, and system enhancements in a CoE or support structure.
• Model Building

Skills:

Functional understanding of Anaplan model architecture and formula building, with the ability to assist in active model development.
• Experience Training Users: Strong communication and facilitation skills, with a passion for training and empowering non-technical users on Anaplan functionality.
• An Understanding of Finance: Solid foundational understanding of financial modelling, FP A principles, or finance workflows.
• AI Tooling: Familiarity with AI tools, including the ability to write effective prompts. You should demonstrate curiosity for how AI can be used to improve processes and solve problems more effectively.
• Domain

Experience:

Banking or financial services experience is a bonus, but not essential! We will consider candidates from non-financial industries

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £42,500 - £55,000 + incentive awards tied to your performance

📍 We're open to distributed working within the UK, with the expectation of working from the London office on occasional basis.

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. 

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps
• Phone call with Recruiter (30 mins)
• Technical video interview with Hiring Manager and FP A Lead (60 mins)
• Partnerships interview FP A team (30 mins)

Our average process takes around 3–4 weeks, but we will always work around your availability.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.
