jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
The role

This is not a testing role in the traditional sense. We're not looking for someone to catch bugs at the end of the pipeline and hand them back. We're looking for someone to own how quality happens across the entire product. As we like to put it: QA owns the testing strategy, not product quality. Product quality is shared by Product and Engineering.

Your job is to make sure the whole system is set up so that everyone can build confidence in what we ship, from the moment a feature is designed to the moment it's released. That means enabling engineers to test effectively, driving a quality mindset across teams, and building the systems and processes that support it, not just writing and running test cases.

We think about quality the way our users experience the product: as complete journeys, not as a checklist of acceptance criteria. If you read this and think "quality is someone else's problem once I've logged the bug," this role isn't for you. If you think in terms of "can the user actually achieve their goal here, and how do I make the whole team confident that they can," keep reading.

This is a senior role because it demands ownership. Not the word, the behavior: seeing what needs to happen and making it happen without being told, working across Product, Engineering, Data as a matter of course, and taking responsibility for the testing strategy of a feature end to end.

Core responsibilities
• Own the testing strategy for the features and areas you work on. Decide how confidence gets built, which validation happens at which layer (unit, component, integration, API, golden, E2E, accessibility, performance, security, manual, exploratory), rather than defaulting everything to end-to-end testing.
• Get involved early. Join discovery and specification reviews before development starts: clarify assumptions, surface edge cases, identify risks and dependencies, and ask the hard questions ("what happens if the API fails, if permissions are denied, if the user abandons the flow?").
• Design test cases as part of feature development, not after it. Covering user journeys, happy paths, edge cases, error handling, recovery, and regression.
• Enable engineers to own their part of quality. Give developers the test suites, regression packs, environments, and mock data they need to validate their own work before it reaches you, and help build a culture where they do.
• Do the testing that matters. Structured execution of prepared cases plus mandatory exploratory testing to find what predefined cases can't predict, like usability issues, cross-feature interactions, and wrong assumptions.
• Maintain a living view of test coverage per feature. So release decisions are based on measurable confidence rather than "the ticket is closed."
• Continuously improve the automation strategy and the process itself. Reduce flakiness, close coverage gaps, cut repetitive manual regression, and free up time for exploratory, accessibility, security, and performance work.
• Bring AI/LLM tools into the workflow. Use them to speed up test case design, automation scripting, and exploratory testing, and keep pushing the team's QA practices forward as new tools emerge.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
The role

As a Senior Data Analyst at Solflare, you’ll dive deep into data to uncover insights and trends that help us make better decisions about our product and its growth. You’ll work closely with product managers, engineers, and other teams to turn complex, raw data into clear and actionable insights. Your work will directly influence important decisions, from improving existing product features and identifying opportunities for new ones to shaping our market expansion strategy.

What makes analytics at Solflare particularly interesting is the depth and variety of data available to us. Since blockchain data is public, we can analyze user behavior at the individual transaction level across the wider Solana ecosystem, not just within Solflare. This means that a user’s journey does not necessarily start when they first open or create a Solflare wallet. Blockchain data allows us to understand parts of their activity before they become a Solflare user, including which wallets and protocols they used, how they transacted, where their assets moved, and how their behavior changed after adopting Solflare.

Analyzing the blockchain gives us the opportunity to answer questions that traditional product analytics often cannot. We can track market shares, explore how users interact with competing companies, where assets are moving, and which products or behaviors are gaining traction across the ecosystem.

By combining this on-chain information with our off-chain product data, such as app activity, event tracking, and internal user data, we get a uniquely rich view of the full user journey. You might investigate what users do on-chain after using Solflare, identify behavioral patterns connected to retention or churn, or uncover opportunities for new products, features, and integrations.

If you’re excited by complex data, curious about user behavior, and ready to work in a role where your insights can directly shape product strategy and company growth, we’d love to hear from you.

Core

responsibilities:
• Data collection: You’ll gather data from a variety of sources (databases, APIs, spreadsheets) and ensure it’s accurate, complete, and relevant to the business questions at hand.
• Data preparation: Actively contributing to our data pipeline, building and maintaining the transformation logic that turns raw data into analysis-ready datasets.
• Exploratory analysis: Use statistical techniques and data visualization to uncover trends, patterns, and correlations in the data. This will help guide the team in making data-driven decisions.
• Reporting & visualization: You’ll create clear and insightful dashboards, reports, and charts, making it easy for stakeholders to understand the findings and take action.
• Collaboration with teams: Work alongside product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to define key metrics and provide data-driven recommendations that shape the product roadmap.
• Data integrity: Ensure that the data is secure, well-documented, and accessible to those who need it most.

jobs.title: Head of People Partnering, UK  & Europe
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:
• Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM

The People Partnering team at Tide plays a pivotal role in driving business success by acting as strategic advisors and coaches to leaders at all levels. We provide expert guidance on organisational design, talent development, employee relations, and engagement, ensuring a positive and high-performance culture. Embedded within the business, we use data-driven insights to shape policies, pre-empt workforce challenges, and lead high-impact initiatives that enable Tideans to do work they love.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Head of People Partnering for UK Europe, you will:
• Design and implement a People Partnering strategy for the Tide’s UK Europe business that supports business objectives, enhances the employee experience, and fosters a high-performance culture.
• Act as a strategic partner and advisor to the CEO of Tide’s UK Europe business and the UK Europe management team, providing expert guidance on organisational design, workforce planning, performance management, and employee relations.
• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of People Partners, ensuring they are equipped to support leaders and teams across various markets. Foster a culture of collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
• Support business leaders in driving organisational change, equipping them with the necessary people management tools to ensure smooth transitions and sustained business performance.
• Partner with business leaders and the Director of People Experience to drive employee engagement, interpret survey insights, and implement targeted action plans to enhance team satisfaction, retention, and productivity.
• Ensure HR policies and programs align with relevant employment laws and industry best practices while managing cross-border employment complexities.
• Use HR analytics to inform people strategies, track key workforce metrics, and present actionable insights to business leaders.
• Oversee performance management, career development, and succession planning initiatives to build a strong talent pipeline and support internal mobility.
• Provide direct coaching to managers on complex employee relations matters, leadership development, and team effectiveness.
• Embed diversity, equity, and inclusion across all aspects of people partnering, ensuring it remains a core pillar of talent, engagement, and leadership strategies.
• Upholding and promoting the values of Tide in all interactions and decisions.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
• Progressive HR experience, including direct partnership with SVPs / C-Suite leaders.
• Extensive experience partnering with cross-cultural leadership teams.
• Experience with line management of both junior and senior People Partners.
• Good understanding of global HR practices and employment laws, particularly in India and various European countries.
• Strong client focus with outstanding judgement, critical thinking and analytical skills.
• Strong business acumen and the ability to align HR strategies with business goals.
• Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
• Demonstrated ability to drive change at pace and foster a positive organisational culture.
• Ideally experience leading HR for a commercial and operations client groups (not essential).

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
• Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options.
• Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
• Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
• Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
• Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
• Life Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
• Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
• Volunteering Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
• Learning Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
• WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
• Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
• Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
• Snacks Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

#LI-AC1 #LI-Hybrid

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

 

Disclaimer

 

It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
• Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
• All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
• Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
• Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

 

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Lead Marketing Analyst - Growth Enablement
jobs.description:
We are looking for a strategically-minded Lead Analyst to join our Marketing Analytics team. This role is centered on owning reporting and deepening our understanding of what actually drives marketing growth, while helping the wider team pursue the opportunities and gaps that matter most.

You'll focus on surfacing strategic opportunities from our Marketing Financials process and making them accessible for action across our analytics and marketing context. By using and streamlining emerging technologies and AI in the team, you will play an important role in the technical engine and processes that turn complex data into central resources, insights and clear prioritisation.

In this role, you'll spot the horizontal opportunities that don't surface within any single Marketing Analytics pillar, build the business case for the ones that matter, and hand them to the right team to execute. You won't own every initiative, but you'll be the one who sees the whole board and helps decide where the leverage is. You'll also shape how we operate as a wider team, defining and improving how we collaborate and prioritise.

You have the business acumen to know what makes a data product genuinely useful to marketing stakeholders at a strategic level and a real interest in enabling other analytics teams to pursue the opportunities you find. You'll keep data quality solid across a broad horizontal scope, building a clear, reflective view of past growth drivers while laying the foundation for future strategy, ideation, and understanding across the wider analytics team.

Your Mission

Your mission is to turn complex marketing data into a scalable engine for insights, growth driver explanation and strategic execution. You will own the technical set-up behind how we explain marketing performance, developing the automated tools (such as Streamlit apps, AI/agentic automation, and reporting tools) that make the drivers of our growth clear and easy to act on. You will further enhance productivity and prioritisation within the wider Marketing Analytics team leveraging these same technologies into effective and streamlined processes such as semantic layers, impact calculations and AI-skill alignment across teams.

Rather than just reporting the financials, you'll focus on the why to pinpoint the highest-value opportunities within our Marketing Financials process, working closely with the wider marketing, analytics, product, and regional teams to carry those opportunities through to execution and improvement. You'll also use your cross-team overview to strengthen how the wider Marketing Analytics team works, so that we prioritise, manage, and deliver initiatives effectively.

 

Key Responsibilities

Analytics Ownership
• Growth Driver Explanation: Build and maintain the reporting, tooling and infrastructure to explain marketing growth drivers, ensuring the wider business clearly understands the mechanics and the why behind our performance.
• Automating Insights: Lead the further productionising of our Marketing Financials process, shifting the focus towards automating driver analysis and providing deep-dives that uncover the core reasons behind growth performance.
• Opportunity Identification & Enablement: Proactively identify key opportunities and gaps within the Marketing Financials process and drive these into execution with the wider Marketing Analytics-team and stakeholders.
• Advanced Analytics Tools: Lead the development and deployment of advanced analytics consumption tools, including Lightdash reporting, Streamlit apps, and AI/agentic automation to provide clear, accessible explanations of growth drivers. Play a constructive role in streamlining usage of these tools across the wider Marketing Analytics team.
• Impact-Driven Delivery: Balance technical rigor with speed to deliver meaningful data products that translate complex growth drivers into clear business impact.

Leadership & Partnering
• Successfully collaborate with stakeholders across Marketing, Analytics and Regional teams, acting as the crucial bridge between identifying data-driven opportunities and executing them within the wider marketing context.
• Be a subject matter expert on technical infrastructure within the Marketing Analytics team, ensuring our systems are optimized for driver analysis and explanation rather than just standard reporting.
• Contribute to the overall analytics strategy, ensuring that tribe data and analytics are discoverable, leveraged, and heavily focused on actionable understanding.
• Effective project management and communication skills, with the ability to inform multiple horizontal initiatives in parallel, sequence them by impact, and keep the right stakeholders aligned from identification through to execution.
• Skilled at defining and improving ways of working across the wider Marketing Analytics team, establishing the practices and prioritisation frameworks that help multiple pillars collaborate efficiently and focus on the highest-impact work.

Required Qualifications
• 4+ years of hands-on experience in a marketing analytics, data engineering, or insights role, ideally at the start of your technical lead journey.
• Strong proficiency in SQL and advanced Python is required.
• Experience with modern data stacks, including dbt, data warehousing (e.g., Snowflake), and visualization/semantic layers like Lightdash or Looker.
• Proven competencies in identifying analytical opportunities within financial/marketing processes and reporting on them effectively
• Strong ability to understand the underlying mechanics of marketing to ensure technical products are meaningful and focused on explaining growth drivers.
• A focus on building systems and automated insights that drive measurable improvements in how the business understands and acts upon data.
• Experience and interest in project management, ways of working improvements and enabling wider teams in efficient collaboration. 

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience building data products, such as Streamlit apps, custom internal tools such as JIRA, or AI-integrated workflows.
• Familiarity with AI-native development workflows and tooling (e.g., Cursor, Claude, or GitHub Copilot) to accelerate the build of data products and automated agents.
• Proven ability to automate context around data, creating technical systems that effectively communicate and explain the drivers of growth to a wide stakeholder set.

"We know that some people are less likely to apply for a role unless they meet every single requirement. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every point, we’d still love to hear from you."

jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher  / Developer (Data Science) - Treasury  FX
jobs.description:
We are seeking a quantitative researcher or quantitative developer to join our Treasury FX Data Science team. You will help build and operate the models and production systems behind FX pricing, risk and trading. Your work will have a direct impact on Wise’s mission and millions of our customers.

About

the Role:

You'll join the Treasury FX Data Science team, helping own the quantitative models and production infrastructure that power how Wise manages FX risk across USD 250bn+ in annual FX volume - serving everyone from retail customers sending money abroad to tier-1 global investment banks via Wise Platform.

The wider Treasury FX team includes quants, traders, analysts, product managers and engineers working together to price, hedge, manage and scale FX operations within Wise in real time. Within that, the Data Science team owns a Python-first, production-grade quant platform which provides multi-instrument pricing, product modelling/monitoring, risk analytics and trading strategies. 

We’re hiring for two complementary focus areas:
• Quantitative Researcher: Bring deeper expertise in quantitative modelling to develop and improve pricing, forecasting, risk analytics and hedging methodology with rigorous backtesting and stakeholder engagement
• Quantitative Developer: Bring deeper expertise in quantitative engineering to develop and improve production services, shared quant libraries and engineering reliability. You are expected to 

Your focus will reflect your strengths, with opportunities to contribute across both areas and broaden your expertise. We expect depth in one area, with a strong shared foundation in Python, quantitative reasoning and production ownership.

What you’ll own
• A primary focus in either production quantitative engineering or applied quantitative modelling
• Python implementation of quantitative work from research or prototype through reliable production use
• Validation, backtesting and monitoring of model and service performance against realised outcomes
• Deployment, incident response, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement with stakeholders
• Shared quant libraries used across multiple services
• CI/CD pipelines, deployments and operational excellence
• Monitoring, alerting, and reliability for real-time pricing and risk systems

Where you’ll grow
• Market data management and onboarding new pipelines..
• Designing new quant infrastructure and systems with the engineering team.
• Backtesting frameworks, model validation and risk modelling alongside the Risk team (VaR, stress testing, scenario analysis).
• Customer behaviour modelling, pricing strategy and product development.
• Collaborating with product teams to translate quantitative insights into customer-facing decisions

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II- Regional Expansion
jobs.description:
We are expanding our Latam & Mea Payments Team and are looking for ambitious and highly skilled Senior Software Engineers to join the engineering team.

You will lead the development of the critical integrations enabling money movement across the Latam & Mea regions. By integrating directly with local payment systems and sophisticated cross-border payment systems, you will unlock essential functionality that accelerates our growth, building products that empower consumers and businesses to manage their finances globally.

Your Role:

Your role involves implementing integrations with local banks, payment providers, and connecting our platform to local payment systems as well as optimizing funnels to handle the complexities of cross-country money movement within your specific area.

This role requires a high level of technical and product excellence and a passion for building high-quality, scalable, and compliant solutions tailored for the unique financial infrastructure and regulatory landscape of our region. Beyond writing good code, you will propose solid technical designs, participate in code and design reviews, and collaborate with global engineering teams to build the core infrastructure that unlocks and grows new markets.

What You'll Be Doing:
• Design, develop, test, deploy and manage direct connections with local payment schemes and integrations with regional banks to establish foundation-level money movement capabilities across diverse international markets.
• Define the technical direction by advocating for high-quality designs, providing critical feedback in peer reviews, and actively shaping the future roadmap for our payments ecosystem.
• Take your local in-market learnings and work with global engineering teams to ensure the systems you build seamlessly influence and integrate with our worldwide platform.
• Participate in on-call rotations to support operational teams and address incidents, ensuring our platform remains secure and consistently available for our customers.
• Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and engineers in our other global offices, to align on product vision and technical implementation for regional expansion

jobs.title: Senior Product Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Product Operations is a small team of specialists at Wise. Our focus is the machine - the people, processes and practices - that builds our product. We work with autonomous product teams to help them move faster, stay aligned and build the right things for customers and partners.

Wise Platform is Wise’s infrastructure business. We work with banks, fintechs and global companies such as Monzo, Morgan Stanley and Google to embed Wise’s international money movement capabilities into the products their customers already use. That means Wise Platform teams solve both deep product infrastructure problems and practical partner problems: how to make cross-border money movement faster, simpler, more reliable and easier to scale through others.

You will act as the key Product Operations partner for Wise Platform. It is a complex, fast-growing area that brings together product, engineering, commercial, operations, compliance and partner-facing teams, so partners can build on Wise at scale.

In this brand new role and as the main point of contact for Wise Platform, you’ll be responsible for identifying and delivering ways to make Wise Platform product teams more effective. You’ll help teams improve how they plan, communicate, prioritise, learn from partners and measure progress. You’ll work closely with Wise Platform leadership and teams, while also connecting with other functions across Wise.

What this will involve:
• Helping Wise Platform teams improve planning, prioritisation and follow-through, so product development is focused on the most important partner and customer problems.
• Improving how roadmaps, priorities and launches are communicated across product teams, partner-facing teams and the wider Wise organisation.
• Creating better feedback loops between partners, commercial teams and product teams, so partner needs are understood, prioritised and acted on.
• Supporting clearer decision-making on which products and capabilities we should scale, where we should focus, and where we should avoid adding unnecessary complexity.
• Establishing useful rhythms, rituals and ways of working that improve alignment without adding unnecessary process.
• Helping teams use data to understand the speed, quality and impact of product development, and to continuously improve how they work.
• Leading and supporting cross-functional initiatives where Product Operations can bring clarity, structure and momentum.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Manager - Pricing
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Analytics Manager to join the Pricing Analytics team at Wise.

This role offers an opportunity to have a direct and measurable impact on Wise’s mission — money without borders. Built by and for people who live global lives. The team is responsible for helping ensure that Wise grows sustainably, and for ensuring our customers pay fair and transparent fees.

This is an AL2 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here.

What you'll be doing
• Your principal responsibility will be to make an impact and lead us to better decisions for the company and our customers
• Leading a team of analysts who will be responsible for curating datasets, surfacing metrics, some statistical modelling, and deeper dive analysis that we expect to influence the direction of the team and the company
• You'll be responsible for managing the Pricing Model, balancing the requirements of various stakeholders including Finance and Product, to ensure the company can deliver competitive and sustainable prices
• The team you’re applying for will be focussed on the following:
• Own and improve the pricing model, partnering with commercial and cost owners to drive strategic pricing decisions, to maintain low, fair fees for customers. Analyze and explain underlying unit economics and profitability drivers across customer cohorts.
• Build, optimize, and maintain scalable data models and pipelines to accurately allocate costs to products and transactions. Lead investigations into complex cost data to improve upstream data quality and allocation methodologies.
• Serve as the primary conduit between the analytics team and product teams, translating business needs into actionable data insights and influencing strategic prioritization.

What you'll bring
• 5-7 years experience as an analyst and 2-5 years leading others (can be overlapping)
• Experience working in a financial company
• Strong analytical ability
• Extensive experience using SQL to build and maintain complex data sources, and leveraging visualisation tools to surface critical insights
• Understanding of stats and statistical modelling (measures of central tendency, understanding of variance and testing)
• Demonstration of impact/going above and beyond basic role requirements
• Ability to self organise and manage stakeholders

Nice to have but not essential
• DBT experience
• Experience working in a Pricing function

jobs.title: B2B Growth Marketing Lead - APAC
jobs.description:
We're looking for a B2B Growth Marketing Lead to accelerate the growth of Wise Business across APAC.

This is a senior, hands-on role for an exceptional B2B growth marketer. You'll identify the markets, customer segments and opportunities with the greatest growth potential, then turn those choices into locally relevant campaigns that acquire valuable business customers.

You'll own the regional B2B growth strategy and bring it to life across both self-serve and sales-assisted acquisition. You'll move comfortably between market prioritisation, customer insight, campaign strategy, proposition development, detailed execution and performance optimisation.

You won't be starting with a large dedicated team or a finished regional playbook. You'll work through specialist teams across content, events, paid search and other channels, partner closely with Sales, and make the evidence-based case for additional regional investment when an opportunity requires it.

You'll be based in Singapore and work closely with our APAC Regional Marketing Lead and market teams. Singapore is your operating base, but you'll use evidence to determine where Wise Business has the strongest growth opportunities across APAC.

Your mission

Make APAC a major contributor to Wise Business growth by building a repeatable engine that identifies the region's best opportunities and turns them into locally relevant, commercially effective campaigns.

Help more micro and small businesses discover and choose Wise for their international money needs, while growing within our customer-value and payback requirements.

What you'll be doing
• Own the B2B growth strategy for APAC, using customer, market, product and commercial evidence to prioritise the most attractive opportunities.
• Develop and execute locally relevant, integrated campaigns that acquire valuable business customers across self-serve and sales-assisted journeys.
• Translate customer problems into clear growth hypotheses, propositions, campaign briefs, channel plans and measurement approaches.
• Work hands-on with specialists across content, events, paid search and other channels to take campaigns from idea to market without losing strategic quality or pace.
• Partner closely with Product Marketing and Sales on the Go-To-Market Plan and our ideal customer profiles delivering crucial market feedback.
• Connect campaign performance to new business profiles, customer quality, downstream value and payback - not just impressions, clicks or lead volume.
• Build credible business cases for regional investment outside established marketing activity, defining the opportunity, expected return, resources required and how the activity will be tested.
• Use performance and customer evidence to decide what to scale, improve, stop or redirect, creating a consistent pipeline of activity rather than isolated launches.
• Build a strong operating rhythm with the APAC Regional Marketing Lead and regional stakeholders, combining local context with the wider Wise Business growth strategy.
• Identify and propose issues or improvements to Wise Business from a regional product perspective to help strengthen the offering.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Securities & Commodities
jobs.description:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

Your mission

As Product Manager for Securities Commodities, you will own key feature execution and user flows for selected traditional financial products. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, and Business Operations to turn complex financial workflows into simple, transparent retail trading experiences. This is a high-impact opportunity for an execution-focused PM eager to build leading multi-asset investing experiences across Europe.

 

What you’ll do
• Take direct ownership of specific product flows within securities and commodities, such as equity trading interfaces, margin trading touchpoints, or RWA execution steps.
• Write clear, detailed product specifications, process flows, and user stories, serving as the primary day-to-day product contact for Engineering.
• Partner with UX, Design, and Data teams to turn complex financial concepts into transparent, high-converting retail experiences.
• Maintain fast shipping velocity and high task completion by actively collaborating with Engineering, Business Operations, and cross-functional partners.
• Track feature adoption and performance metrics to identify UX friction points and drive continuous optimizations.

Who you are
• 2–4 years of Product Management experience building trading, retail brokerage, or fintech products (ideally within a MiFID II or regulated environment).
• Good functional understanding of capital markets, order execution flows, clearing, and basic retail investing mechanics.
• Solid data-driven, analytical mindset with practical experience using product analytics to guide feature iterations.
• Strong structured communication skills to translate business and technical requirements into actionable product specs.
• Familiarity with multi-asset investing platforms.

What’s in it for you
• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

 .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

jobs.title: Counsel, Employment
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Legal at Brex

The Legal team helps the company grow responsibly, advocating for Brex and for the thousands of growing businesses we serve. We provide strategic advice and guidance to all Brex teams, protect Brex, advise on risk, and represent the company externally, negotiating with partners and interacting with regulators. Reimagining the financial system in a highly regulated environment requires creativity and resourcefulness, and we welcome the challenge.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

What you’ll do

You’re here to be a trusted legal partner to Brex’s People team, providing practical, business-minded advice on employment matters affecting Brex’s global workforce. Working in close collaboration with senior members of the Legal team, you’ll advise on day-to-day employment issues, help manage employee and contingent worker disputes, and support the development of policies and practices governing Brex employees and contingent workers. This is an opportunity to build deep employment law expertise while supporting a dynamic, high-growth fintech company.

Responsibilities
• Provide business-minded legal guidance and support to Brex’s People team on day-to-day employment issues, including performance management, terminations, recruiting, hiring, leaves of absence, employee accommodations, compensation and benefits, and wage and hour matters
• Support the development and implementation of policies and practices governing Brex employees and contingent workers, in partnership with the People team and senior Legal team members
• Assist in managing employment-related complaints, disputes, litigation, investigations, and responses to regulatory inquiries and charges (e.g. EEOC charges)
• Help manage outside legal counsel retained to assist Brex on employment matters, ensuring their work is efficient and drives value for Brex
• Identify employment- and contingent worker-related risks and recommend practical solutions for managing and mitigating them
• Research and analyze employment-related laws that apply in the locations where Brex employees and contingent workers work, including throughout the United States and in Brex’s international office locations, and monitor employment law developments and their potential impact on Brex
• Support the development and delivery of employment-related training to managers and employees
• Assist with responses to employee or contingent worker-related subpoenas, personnel records requests, and other information or legal requests and orders

Requirements
• 5+ years of experience counseling on employment law matters at a reputable law firm, an in-house or corporate legal department, or both
• Experience partnering directly with People / HR functions as their day-to-day legal advisor
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and manage competing priorities
• Practical, problem-solving mindset with the ability to navigate a dynamic, fast-paced environment
• Team player who collaborates effectively with colleagues and business partners to drive meaningful results
• Exceptional oral and written communication skills, with the ability to translate legal complexity into clear guidance for non-lawyers
• Juris Doctor (JD) and active bar membership in good standing of the bar of at least one U.S. state

Bonus Points
• 2+ years of experience at a high-growth tech company
• Working knowledge of California employment law
• Exposure to employment law outside the U.S., particularly in jurisdictions where Brex has offices
• Experience building or delivering employment-related manager training
• Financial services or other highly regulated industry experience

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $220,000 - $270,000 USD. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Legal at Brex

The Legal team helps the company grow responsibly, advocating for Brex and for the thousands of growing businesses we serve. We provide strategic advice and guidance to all Brex teams, protect Brex, advise on risk, and represent the company externally, negotiating with partners and interacting with regulators. Reimagining the financial system in a highly regulated environment requires creativity and resourcefulness, and we welcome the challenge.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our New York City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

What you'll do

Reporting to the General Counsel, you will lead Brex's Regulatory Affairs function and guide the company's relationships and interactions with its federal and state regulators, including the OCC, the Federal Reserve, FINRA, and state licensing agencies. You will ensure Brex proactively responds to a changing regulatory environment and delivers on its commitments to regulators accurately and on time.

This is a role for a strong program manager as much as a regulatory expert. You will run the end-to-end regulatory engagement lifecycle: exam preparation and logistics, fulfillment of supervisory requests, coordination of responses across Legal, Compliance, Risk, and business teams, and disciplined tracking of findings, commitments, and corrective actions through to closure. You will partner closely with Regulatory Affairs, Legal, and Risk counterparts at Capital One to align supervisory strategy and ensure consistent, well-coordinated engagement with regulators across the combined organization. You will also serve as a trusted advisor to senior management, synthesizing trends across the external regulatory landscape and translating them into practical guidance and early awareness of emerging focus areas. Finally, you will help bring together cross functional teams to help drive forward proactive regulatory requirements. 

Responsibilities
• Manage and foster productive relationships and interactions between Brex business functions and federal and state regulatory and supervisory staff
• Lead preparation and oversee execution of regulatory exams and other supervisory engagements, including logistics management, fulfillment of supervisory and information requests, and driving timely issue resolution
• Build and run the program management infrastructure for regulatory commitments: intake, tracking, ownership, milestones, evidence, and closure, ensuring the company delivers on commitments to regulators in a timely manner
• Identify potential risk areas and advise on corrective actions, ensuring remediation efforts are monitored and on track for timely and effective mitigation
• Provide thought leadership and strategic advisory support to senior management and the board regarding the regulatory environment and supervisory matters
• Synthesize trends across the external landscape and individual regulatory engagements, driving internal awareness of focus areas and potential sensitivities so the company meets and exceeds expectations set by law, regulation, and agency guidance
• Partner with Capital One Regulatory Affairs, Legal, and Risk teams on integration-related regulatory workstreams and coordinated supervisory engagement
• Develop scalable processes, playbooks, and reporting (including management and board-level artifacts) that give leadership a clear, current view of regulatory posture

Requirements
• Juris Doctor (JD) and active bar membership in good standing of the bar of at least one U.S. state
• 8+ years of experience in banking, financial services, risk management, audit, consulting, or regulatory agencies, or a combination
• 5+ years of experience working directly with banking regulators (e.g., OCC, Federal Reserve, FDIC, state agencies) and regulatory policy, including exam management and supervisory engagement
• Significant experience supporting integrated projects or programs where senior leaders and external stakeholders are your customers, with demonstrated PMO discipline: structured tracking, clear ownership, and reliable follow-through
• Working knowledge of commercial financial products (cards, payments, deposits, lending) and the associated regulatory frameworks and risk management practices
• Strong critical thinking, problem solving, and written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build consensus across a broad range of stakeholders
• Ability to lead with empathy when working with internal stakeholders and government agencies
• Comfort in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where priorities often change
• Willingness to be a team player who pitches in to help out on other products and topics; one of our key tenets is "One Brex"

Bonus Points
• Experience at a fintech or technology-forward financial institution operating under bank or broker-dealer supervision (OCC, Federal Reserve, FINRA, SEC)
• Experience navigating regulatory dimensions of M A integration between a fintech and a regulated bank
• Familiarity with three lines of defense frameworks and enterprise risk management practices

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $270,000 - $335,000 USD. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

About the team

MetaMask's design team is working to establish MetaMask as the premier wallet in fintech, elevating the craft of design and leading the industry as the next phase of decentralized finance unfolds. Our focus is reducing friction while preserving user trust, so more people can safely explore the world of Web3.

Prediction markets are one of the most exciting areas in consumer finance right now, sitting at the intersection of trading, sports, news, culture, and real world events. This is a big growth area for MetaMask, and we're looking for a Lead Product Designer to help shape where it goes next. This is a chance to take real ownership of the end-to-end Prediction Markets experience inside one of the most widely used products in web3 — helping define how people discover markets, understand what's happening, trade, manage positions, and come back as events unfold. The product is still evolving, so much of the experience is still there to be defined, and that's a big part of what makes this role interesting: we're not looking for someone to polish a finished product, we want someone who wants to help shape it. You'll work closely with Product and Engineering, have a strong voice in what we build, and take ideas from early thinking through to something real in the hands of users.

What you’ll do
• Own the Prediction Markets experience from early thinking through launch and iteration.
• Define how users discover markets, understand them, trade and manage their positions.
• Make complex ideas like probabilities, liquidity and market mechanics feel clear and easy to understand.
• Work closely with Product and Engineering to shape what we build, not just how it looks.
• Prototype quickly using AI to explore ideas and get to stronger solutions faster.
• Set a high bar for visual and interaction design, and use research and data to keep improving the product.

• Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with strong product instincts and attention to detail.
• Experience taking complex or ambiguous problems from early ideas through to shipped experiences.
• Comfortable using AI, code and modern design tools to explore, iterate and build quickly.
• High ownership, strong communication and the confidence to push work forward without waiting for a perfectly defined brief.
• Someone who genuinely loves sports and understands how fans follow teams, leagues, games and major sporting events.

Bonus points
• Experience in trading, investing, fintech, sports, betting, marketplaces or other high frequency consumer products.
• An interest in prediction markets and where the category could go.
• Experience working with market data, probabilities, charts or financial positions.
• Experience designing discovery, feeds, ranking or personalised content.
• Experience with crypto or web3, although deep crypto knowledge is not required.

About the role

This role runs the internal posture engine — the risk register, critical control monitoring, evidence, audit operations and GRC tooling. It keeps risk state current so the Lead and the Risk Committee decide from accurate data in the Risk Dashboard and reporting. Drata is the register of record. Named owners close gaps; this role keeps the register, evidence and audit operations current.

Responsibilities

Planning
• Operate the risk register from the Security Programme threat model: populate, track treatment, record acceptance decisions, follow up owners, and run the exceptions register.
• Keep the ISMS and security policy library current as part of audit readiness. Draft security standards when commissioned by the Lead.
• Run Drata as the control and evidence system — Statement of Applicability, framework crosswalk and automation.

Execution
• Run critical control monitoring: health check-ins, drift flags and Drata automation. Route drift to the SOC. Maintain the evidence file for Lead assessments and independent internal audit.
• Feed threat-assessment findings into the register and confidence ratings. Track which required assessments are current.
• Lead audit coordination and preparation: ISO 27001 and SOC 2 logistics, ISMS readiness, team prep, management-review pack, and customer due-diligence questionnaires.
• Coordinate the control register for external testing (red team, tabletop, pentest). Run security awareness and weekly alerts.

Tracking and evaluating performance
• Track residual risk, exceptions and gap-closure against appetite. Exceptions expire and are reported; the underlying requirement stays in force.
• Report register state and evidence health so the Lead and Risk Committee work from one view.

Achieving overall defined performance
• Be accountable for a current, defensible posture engine — register, evidence and audit operations.
• Ensure Drata collects evidence continuously, with automated evidence where coverage exists.

Qualifications
• Hands-on experience running a risk register, control library and audit cycle (ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2).
• Comfortable with GRC platforms (Drata or equivalent) and turning monitoring into evidence.
• Proven ability to coordinate audits and customer questionnaires with named control owners.
• Precise written work; register and Statement of Applicability quality matters.
• Strong stakeholder management with control owners and auditors.
• CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor, or equivalent professional certification.

About the Role
This is a mission-critical product leadership role at the heart of Crypto.com's regulated trading business. As Product Manager, Fiat & FCM, you will own the end-to-end fiat product strategy for our Futures Commission Merchant (FCM) and regulated US trading platform — the money-movement infrastructure that lets retail, private, and institutional clients fund and withdraw from a CFTC/NFA-regulated trading environment instantly, compliantly, and reliably.
FCM is one of Crypto.com's top growth priorities, and it's your anchor. But the mandate is broader: you'll own the banking-rail strategy that scales this model across markets and currencies, and over time, extends to Crypto.com's other business lines, defining which rails we use, which banks we partner with, how customer funds are segregated and settled, and how money moves in and out. You'll carry direct accountability for Total Funds Flow, acceptance rates, settlement speed, and cost-per-transaction across the platform.
Our team is globally distributed across APAC, EU, and US time zones, so you'll need to be comfortable working across time zones and communicate effectively with globally distributed teams.

jobs.title: Head, Group FP&A
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint is Africa's all-in-one financial ecosystem, empowering businesses and their customers with seamless payment, banking, credit, and management tools. In 2023, we processed $182 billion and are Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer.

Job Purpose

Builds and owns the Group's FP A framework, methodology, and reporting standards, giving Group leadership a single, reliable view of financial performance and outlook across the Group's subsidiaries and business units: Moniepoint Nigeria, Moniepoint Kenya, MonieWorld and Moniepoint Technologies.
This is a framework and consolidation role, not a day to day business unit finance role. Some subsidiaries and markets run their own standalone FP A team that owns local budgeting, forecasting, and reporting for that business; this role sets the Group standard those teams work within and consolidates their output. Wherever a subsidiary or shared function doesn't yet have a dedicated FP A resource, this role covers it directly. The intent is one Group framework, executed locally wherever a local team exists, with no duplicated effort.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Responsibilities:
• Design and own the Group's FP A framework: forecasting architecture, budget process, and management-reporting standards that every entity works to, including markets that maintain their own standalone FP A team
• Consolidate entity and BU-level forecasts, including those submitted by markets with their own standalone FP A team, into a single Group P L, balance sheet, and cash flow, with a working currency toggle and intercompany eliminations
• Own the annual Group budget calendar and process: templates, timelines, challenge sessions, and Board approval, without taking over the local budget-building work each entity's own finance team already does
• Produce the consolidated Group forecast (2026-28 and beyond), reconciled monthly to actuals, with a clear bridge explaining variances
• Work closely with the Group Financial Controller so actuals, the consolidation, and the forecast reconcile cleanly month to month, and closing timelines support the reporting calendar
• Run the monthly and quarterly reporting cycles at Group level: consolidated management accounts, Board packs, and investor-grade reporting

jobs.location: Australia; Sydney, New South Wales, Australia
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Commercial Director to lead the next phase of OKX's growth in the Australian market.

This is a critical leadership role responsible for building and executing our commercial strategy to increase market presence, market share, trading volumes and revenue in Australia.

You will own the commercial growth agenda end-to-end - identifying where and how we win, translating market and customer insights into actionable strategies, developing new growth channels and strategic partnerships, and leading go-to-market initiatives that accelerate customer acquisition, engagement and trading activity.

As part of a global exchange operating in a fast-evolving industry, you will also play an important role in connecting our global capabilities with the needs and opportunities of the Australian market. You will work closely with local and global Product, Marketing, Growth, Operations, Legal Compliance to ensure our commercial priorities translate into strong execution.

This is a builder role. We are looking for someone who can operate strategically while remaining execution-oriented - someone comfortable creating the commercial playbook, opening doors, testing new growth opportunities and building the capabilities and team required to scale them.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Own the Australian Commercial Strategy
• Develop and execute the commercial strategy and roadmap for Australia, with clear accountability for market share, active customers, trading volume, revenue and brand recognition.
• Identify the highest-impact growth opportunities across customer segments, products, channels and partnerships. Provide strong local market and customer insights.
• Establish clear commercial priorities, KPIs and operating rhythms, continuously reviewing performance and reallocating resources toward the highest-impact opportunities.
• Build the Growth Engine
• Develop and execute strategies to accelerate customer acquisition, activation, engagement, retention and trading activity.
• Identify opportunities to strengthen OKX's positioning and competitive differences in Australia.
• Build scalable commercial models and growth channels rather than relying solely on short-term campaigns or individual relationships.
• Work closely with Marketing, Product and Growth teams to improve customer journeys, propositions and conversion across the funnel.
• Lead Go-to-Market Strategy Execution
• Own the commercial GTM strategy for major products, services and market initiatives in Australia.
• Develop compelling local value propositions and determine the right customer segments, channels, partnerships and activation strategies.
• Work cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Compliance, Operations and Customer Support to translate GTM strategies into executable plans.
• Develop Strategic Partnerships Distribution
• Identify, evaluate and structure strategic partnerships that can materially accelerate OKX's growth and market presence in Australia.
• Explore new distribution channels and ecosystem opportunities that extend OKX's reach beyond traditional crypto acquisition channels.
• Navigate a Global and Regulated Environment
• Partner closely with Compliance, Legal and Risk teams to ensure commercial strategies and market initiatives are developed within applicable regulatory requirements.

What We Look For In You
• 10+ years of experience across commercial strategy, business development, growth, partnerships or related roles, with meaningful leadership responsibility.
• Strong track record of building or materially scaling a business, market or commercial function, ideally within crypto, fintech, trading, brokerage, financial services or another highly competitive digital and regulated business.
• Demonstrated ability to drive measurable commercial outcomes including market share, active customers, trading volume, revenue and brand recognition.
• Strong understanding of the Australian market, with the ability to identify local customer behaviours, competitive dynamics and growth opportunities.
• Strong commercial judgement with the ability to move between strategy and hands-on execution.
• Proven experience developing GTM strategies and translating them into successful market execution.
• Demonstrated ability to originate, structure and negotiate strategic partnerships and commercial arrangements.
• Strong analytical capabilities and comfort using data to diagnose performance, prioritise opportunities and make commercial decisions.
• Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders in a global matrix organisation.
• Comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial, fast-moving environment where priorities evolve quickly and leaders are expected to build rather than simply manage.
• Genuine interest in blockchain technology, digital assets and the evolution of financial markets.

Nice-To-Haves
• Experience at a crypto exchange or platform. Strong understanding of crypto trading products, customer segments and market structure.
• Experience in trading, brokerage, derivatives, fintech or other transaction-driven businesses where commercial success is measured through customer trading activity and AUM.
• Existing relationships across Australia's crypto, fintech, institutional, payments or broader financial-services ecosystem.
• Experience working across global and cross-cultural teams, particularly within an international technology or financial-services organisation.
• Familiarity with Australia's regulatory environment for digital assets and financial services.
• Degree in Business, Finance, Economics or a related discipline.
 

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means building a sustainable commercial engine for OKX Australia.

You will have established a clear strategy for where and how OKX wins in the Australian market, built the team and partnerships required to execute against it, strengthened our local market presence, and created measurable improvement across market share, active customers, trading volume, revenue and brand recognition.

You will have created a sustainable, commercial operating model that combines the scale and capabilities of a global exchange with strong local market execution.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

About the Team

OKX’s Legal team provides legal advice and guidance to the company across all coverage areas and geographic locations, and supports business growth and development by working with all teams within the company to help them achieve their goals. We are a high-functioning, collaborative and fast-paced group of lawyers who enjoy the cutting-edge nature of our work and our industry.

 

Our Americas Legal team is the primary legal partner to OKX's regulated businesses across the Americas region, advising on a broad range of topics including regulatory strategy, regulatory licensing, product launches, strategic partnerships and corporate matters. The Americas Legal team works cross-functionally with leaders across the company to help build and scale an innovative and compliant OKX platform.

About the Opportunity

This is an essential, high-profile role at one of the fastest-growing global cryptocurrency exchanges based in San Jose, CA. The Deputy General Counsel will play a central role in proactively shaping OKX's regulatory and legal strategy in the US and across the Americas. The Deputy General Counsel will act as a key partner and provide day-to-day counsel to senior business leadership of OKX's US business, including the coordination of efforts with Compliance, Risk, Operations, Finance and other functions. The Deputy General Counsel will stay abreast of all regulatory changes applicable to the digital asset space in the US, promptly communicate developments to OKX's senior business leadership, and help guide the business in identifying growth opportunities in the US. The position will coordinate the efforts of the legal function serving OKX's business in the US as well as the Americas more broadly, and will report to OKX's VP, Legal.

 

You'll work at the intersection of law, regulations, and product innovation - driving complex licensing initiatives, advising senior stakeholders on questions without clear precedent, and helping the business move quickly through an evolving regulatory landscape. We are looking for a hands-on legal leader with sharp judgment, strong interpersonal skills, and the desire to work with a top-notch legal team. The right candidate is not afraid to jump into novel and complex matters, and is willing to roll up their sleeves and work effectively under time pressure. We offer a competitive base salary and bonus structure as well as excellent benefits and an opportunity to work in a cutting-edge industry that will be the future of financial services.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Develop and advance a best-in-class regulatory strategy in the US and across the Americas, including the development and maintenance of strong relationships with regulators.
• Engage directly with regulators and business counterparties as a key point of contact for OKX, as well as interacting on a daily basis with senior executives at OKX.
• Identify growth opportunities and strategic initiatives based on proactive, timely, actionable analysis of US regulatory developments.
• Lead and manage attorneys covering various Americas regions so that legal efforts are coordinated and consistently achieve successful outcomes.
• Manage a wide range of legal requests and advise on legal risk with an eye toward achieving the strategic goals of the company's regional business leaders.

What We Look For In You
• Strong communication and leadership skills, and excellent judgment
• Self-starter who can contribute as both an individual and a team member, with limited reliance upon external counsel.
• Membership with a US state bar or equivalent.
• 12+ years of regulatory experience dealing with financial services laws and regulations in a highly-regulated environment.
• Prior experience can be in-house at a regulated financial firm or in the crypto industry (preferable), at a top-tier law firm, and/or at a regulator.
• Experience driving projects to completion on expedited timelines.
• Must be highly-driven, proactive, responsive and precise.
• Experience making strategic recommendations to senior management and senior legal team members.
• Comfortable navigating legal ambiguity.
• Experience advising on cross-jurisdictional legal and regulatory matters.
• Supervisory experience, and in particular, experience managing other attorneys.
• Enthusiastic about blockchain technology with experience advising on laws and regulations applicable in the crypto context.
• Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, growth-stage and multi-cultural environment and across global time zones.
• Ability to effectively advise and build trust with business teams.
• Superior organizational skills.

Nice to Haves
• Expertise in the US securities laws and regulations.
• Prior in-house experience in a financial services or crypto firm.
