jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Product at Brex

The Product team is at the forefront of Brex's mission to empower employees anywhere to make better financial decisions. With a deep understanding of the business, we identify and scope out the most impactful opportunities for Brex to tackle. We are responsible for aligning cross-functional teams — such as Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Design — on key decisions. We set strategy and drive products from inception to launch, enabling Brex to grow rapidly and help our customers reach their full potential.

Unlocking AI Agents for the Finance Admin

Companies buy Brex to run their spend, and the person on the hook for that is the finance admin — a controller, an accounting manager, a finance ops lead. Their job comes down to two things they can never quite get ahead of: making sure money is being spent compliantly and documented in time to close the books, and knowing where the company's money is actually going.

Today they do both by hand, at a scale that doesn't work. Roughly 4% of travel and entertainment spend is out of policy — for a company spending $10M a year, that's $400K in violations, duplicates, missing receipts, and overspend. Most companies never find it, because finding it means a human reading transactions one at a time. The ones who do find it either staff a review team or bolt on a separate audit product with its own login. On the other side, the questions that actually matter — where did spend grow this quarter, which team is drifting, what's driving the number — sit behind a queue for an analyst, or a spreadsheet the admin builds themselves at month-end. Nobody is continuously watching.

The AI team is working to give every finance admin two people they can't hire today: an auditor and a business analyst.
• The auditor. An agent that reads a company's own expense policy and audit rules and reviews every transaction against them — not a 10% sample. It investigates what looks wrong, gathers the missing context by going back to the employee who spent the money, groups what a human should look at, recommends the action, closes what it can safely close, and surfaces the patterns underneath: which policies are constantly broken, which employees are repeat risks, where the real exposure is. Done right, it turns expense compliance from a post-mortem into a first line of defense that runs on every transaction, and shrinks the review pile to the exceptions that genuinely need a person.
• The business analyst. An agent that answers the questions an admin would otherwise hand to an analyst — asked in plain language against their real spend data — then learns which numbers they care about, turns those into reports their whole company can use, and eventually watches those numbers and tells them when something is off. It starts as a junior analyst who runs queries on request and grows into the analyst for the entire business.

Together they add up to a single answer for the customer: am I in control of my company's money?

As a PM on Finance Admin AI, you'd take point on one of them with real, end-to-end ownership — which one, and how much of the other you pick up, is something we'll shape around where you're strongest and what the team needs when you start.

Both are early and real — in customers' hands, with the gaps that implies. And no one has a finished playbook for this: what makes an agent's judgment about a policy trustworthy enough to act on, how you evaluate an answer that has no single correct value, how you keep quality moving up as the models shift underneath you. You'll invent much of that, with the ownership and pace of a startup and the backing of an established company behind you.

What you'll do

You'll work on our core AI team building agents for the finance admin and own one of these end to end. You'll set its product direction, decide which capabilities to build and how they should behave, and spend real time with controllers and finance teams to learn what they'll actually trust an agent to do on their behalf. From there you go as deep as it takes to make it real: shaping agent behavior, writing and iterating prompts, designing the evals that prove it works, and digging into traces when it doesn't. You'll partner closely with engineering, design, and research, and you'll set the quality bar for agents that customers rely on to keep their spend clean and their numbers right.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in either our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York City office. You must be willing to work in the office at least three days per week on Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. Remote work is allowed up to four weeks per year, in increments of at least one week.

Responsibilities
• Own product direction for your area of the Finance Admin AI surface — the strategy, the roadmap, and the day-to-day calls on what ships.
• Translate messy, company-specific finance workflows — expense policies, review and approval chains, month-end close, the way each customer actually enforces its rules — into agent behavior that holds up in production.
• Define what "good judgment" means for an agent operating on someone else's money, and build the evals, prompting approaches, and feedback loops that get it there — then re-invent them as the underlying models and tooling shift.
• Get hands-on. Prototype, measure, read transcripts and traces, and iterate toward what actually works rather than what looks good in a demo.
• Earn autonomy incrementally: figure out where the agent should recommend, where it should act, and how a customer builds enough trust to let it move from one to the other.
• Work directly with finance admins at real companies, and let their usage — not assumptions — drive the next iteration.
• Set and defend a high quality bar for agents operating in a trust-critical, financial context.

Requirements
• You're an experienced product manager. You have a track record of owning complex, user-facing products end to end — setting direction and shipping to real users — with the scope and judgment this senior role calls for.
• You've built for company admins, and you've built it for customers. You've shipped software to the personas who keep a company running — finance, accounting, HR, payroll, IT, compliance, data — and you know how much this can vary from one company to the next. It matters that this was product you sold to other companies, not an internal system inside your own.
• Depth in company workflows or in data and reporting, and genuine interest in the other — the queues, approvals, and exceptions an admin works through, or how people get answers out of their own data and what it takes to model it so those answers are right.
• You have technical depth, and you've worked on systems without a single correct answer. Having built agentic software is a strong plus. Probabilistic, optimization-driven systems where "done" doesn't exist and the work is making it steadily better: AI/ML, search and ranking, marketplace matching, risk and fraud detection, game engines. You're comfortable when the spec is an outcome and a set of signals rather than a decision tree. Also, if you've shipped an agent that real users depended on — designed the evals, iterated the prompts, worked out where it should act on its own versus stop and ask, and lived through the failure modes — say so and tell us what you learned.
• You're comfortable with ambiguity and with systems you can't fully predict. You pull signal out of noise, make good intuitive bets, and ship and refine rather than holding out for a perfect answer. Perfect is the enemy of good here.
• Strong product taste and judgment about what's worth shipping to customers and what isn't.
• You move fast and go deep — comfortable prototyping, reading data, and getting into the details rather than working through layers.

Nice to have:

hands-on depth in prompting or eval design; familiarity with fintech, expense management, or accounting workflows.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $184,000 - $230,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst - Fraud
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

 

What you will get to do
• Investigate fraud attacks, quantify their impact, and present clear findings that drive prioritisation and response
• Propose and refine rule-based mitigations, working with fraud operations and engineering to see them through to implementation
• Build and maintain reporting and dashboards to monitor fraud trends, rule performance, and key operational metrics
• Work closely with fraud operations, data scientists, engineers, and product managers to ensure analytical insights translate into action
• Proactively identify emerging patterns and flag risks before they escalate

To succeed in this role, you should have
• Proven experience as a Data Analyst (Fraud), or a similar role (5+ years, can be made up for with accomplishments)
• Strong problem solving skills
• Advanced proficiency with SQL. you're comfortable writing complex queries to investigate and slice data across large datasets
• Experience in fraud, risk, or financial services; you understand how fraud attacks work and how to think about mitigation trade-offs
• A proactive mindset — you don't wait to be asked; you spot something unusual and you dig in
• Some exposure to Python or scripting for data manipulation and analysis
• Proficiency with a BI tool (PowerBI, Looker, Tableau, Superset, Redash, or any other alternative)
• Strong stakeholder management skills; you can communicate findings clearly to fraud operations, product managers, engineers, and senior leadership — and you know how to influence decisions with data across all of them.
• Comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams where priorities shift quickly.
• Proficiency with a spreadsheet tool (Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, or any other alternative)
• Enjoy autonomy and a flat structure: we have millions of customers and a flat hierarchy so any individual can have an outsized impact
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• A drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques
• A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or any other related field

Experience with the following would be a plus
• Data governance
• Python or any other scripting language
• Git or any other version control tool

What we can offer you
• Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We have built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
• Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
• Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process
• A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
• Technical take-home task (SQL test).

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). About the Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Audit Manager to help lead the delivery of OKX’s internal audit portfolio across the APAC region.

Reporting to the Head of Internal Audit, APAC, you will lead risk-based audits and advisory reviews covering operational, financial, regulatory, and technology-related risks. You will be responsible for the full audit lifecycle, from risk assessment and planning through fieldwork, reporting, and remediation monitoring.

You will work closely with senior business stakeholders, risk and compliance teams, external auditors, and regulators to provide independent assurance over the effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal controls. The successful candidate will have broad audit experience within financial services, fintech, cryptocurrency, or another highly regulated industry, together with a strong understanding of the risks associated with digital assets and blockchain technology. This role is based in Singapore.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Partner with Internal Audit leadership and business stakeholders to develop risk-based and regulatory-focused audit plans aligned with OKX’s strategic priorities, regulatory obligations, and emerging risks.
• Lead end-to-end audits, thematic reviews, and advisory engagements across APAC, including defining scope and audit procedures, supervising fieldwork, reviewing workpapers, and coaching audit team members.
• Ensure engagements are completed in accordance with professional standards and internal audit methodology, with conclusions supported by sufficient and appropriate evidence.
• Evaluate business processes and the design and operating effectiveness of key controls, identifying root causes, control gaps, and opportunities for operational improvement.
• Prepare clear, concise, and commercially relevant audit reports, and communicate findings and recommendations to senior management and business stakeholders.
• Work with control owners to develop practical corrective actions and monitor remediation to ensure that identified issues are addressed effectively and on time.
• Apply data analytics and other technology-enabled techniques to improve audit coverage, efficiency, and insight.
• Monitor regulatory developments and industry trends affecting cryptocurrency, blockchain, and financial services businesses across APAC.
• Support regulatory examinations, external audits, and related information requests to ensure they are handled accurately and efficiently.
• Contribute to the continued development of the Internal Audit function, including its methodology, risk assessment processes, reporting, and use of technology.

 

What We Look For In You
• • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related discipline. A relevant postgraduate degree or professional certification, such as CIA, CPA, or CA, is preferred.
• At least six years of relevant internal audit experience, including leading audit engagements within financial services, fintech, cryptocurrency, or another highly regulated industry.
• Broad audit experience across areas such as financial crime compliance, risk management, outsourcing and third-party risk, corporate governance, product, operations, and finance.
• Strong knowledge of audit methodologies, the IIA’s Global Internal Audit Standards, risk assessment practices, and internal control frameworks, with the ability to identify control weaknesses and develop practical, risk-based recommendations.
• Familiarity with regulatory requirements applicable to financial institutions and cryptocurrency businesses across APAC. Experience auditing regulated entities in Singapore and/or Australia is advantageous.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to present complex matters clearly, influence stakeholders, and work effectively across cultures and jurisdictions.

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

You will collaborate closely with top management to understand business objectives, identify opportunities, and develop strategic plans. You will be instrumental in driving key initiatives, optimising operational efficiency, and ensuring the smooth execution of strategic priorities across the Tide Member Operations function.

SOME OF THE THINGS YOU WILL BE DOING

Strategic Partnership Execution
• Work directly with the Regional CEO and SVP to define and execute the Member Operations strategy.
• Translate strategic objectives into actionable plans and initiatives, and monitor progress to ensure timely delivery.
• Conduct research and analysis to support key business decisions and special projects.
• Prepare presentations and reports for leadership meetings, executive leadership, and other key stakeholders.
• Act as a local lead for the MOPS teams based of Hyderabad

Member Journey Improvements Root Cause Analysis
• Identify critical customer journeys that impact experience and efficiency, and conduct deep-dive analysis and root cause investigations to uncover systemic inefficiencies.
• Conduct deep-dive analysis and root cause investigations to uncover systemic inefficiencies.
• Partner with Ops, Product, and Training teams to implement sustainable fixes, acting as a central point of contact for cross-functional initiatives to ensure alignment.
• Establish metrics to measure impact, ensuring a structured feedback loop for continuous enhancement.

• Act as a central point of contact for cross-functional initiatives, ensuring alignment and clear communication between teams.
• Identify and drive process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and productivity.

You'll bring a test-and-learn, data-driven approach to member marketing, partnering closely with the SVP of Member Engagement Marketing, Product, and Data Analytics teams to build deep relationships with existing members that increase usage, cross-sell, and grow lifetime value.

Core responsibilities will include:

Strategic Ownership
• Own the member engagement marketing strategy across the entire lifecycle — from onboarding and activation to retention and reactivation.
• Own the retention marketing strategy to grow revenue from the existing member base.
• Build cross-sell and upsell campaigns that deepen product usage and maximise member lifetime value.
• Identify high-potential member segments and create tailored journeys that boost engagement and reduce churn.
• Lead CRM marketing programmes across email, push, in-app, SMS, and WhatsApp focused on driving behavioural outcomes and monetisation.
• Lead nurture journeys that drive reactivation, repeat usage, and deeper financial engagement.

Analytics Data-Led Decision-Making
• Partner closely with Data Analytics to deeply understand the India member base and define KPIs tied to conversion, churn reduction, and engagement.
• Bring a test-and-learn approach: run A/B and MVT testing across CRM channels to continually improve targeting, content, and offers.
• Build a segmentation and targeting strategy based on lifecycle stage, member value, product uptake, and behavioural signals.
• Own dashboarding and reporting of all member marketing metrics and attribution, sharing results broadly with stakeholders.
• Apply AI/ML tools to accelerate marketing execution — e.g. testing more variants, sharpening targeting, and speeding up insight-to-action — with a track record of measurable gains in team speed or campaign performance.

Platform Tooling Leadership
• Hands-on experience setting up a team on a CRM platform. Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience is ideal; depth of hands on experience with CRM tooling, including ability to support key platform changes and team training.
• Ensure the India CRM tech stack is set up to support scalable, personalised, multi-channel campaigns post-migration.

Team Building Leadership
• Build and lead a high-performing team of CRM/lifecycle marketers, campaign managers, and content strategists in India — this is a team you will be building out, so hiring, structuring, and developing the right talent will be critical to success in this role.
• Motivate, coach, and grow your team while embedding a test-and-learn, data-driven culture.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Growth, Sales, Risk, and Customer Success teams, building strong networks across the business to deliver as 'one team'.
• Contribute to quarterly planning around revenue growth via member marketing.

India Market Leadership
• Represent Member Engagement Marketing within the India Business leadership team, acting as the senior on-the-ground owner for engagement marketing strategy and execution.
• Adapt global MEM strategy and playbooks to the India context — including regional language personalisation, and WhatsApp/SMS as primary engagement channels alongside email and push.
• Ensure marketing communications comply with India's regulatory requirements (e.g. TRAI/DLT registration and consent management for SMS and outbound calls).
• Identify cross-sell opportunities specific to India SME members (e.g. GST-linked invoicing triggers, credit and collections products) and build journeys that reflect local product adoption patterns.
• Partner effectively with UK-based Marketing, Product, and P E stakeholders across time zones, while owning delivery for the India market.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
• 12+ years of experience in B2C or B2B2C marketing, preferably in fintech, lending, banking, or consumer tech, with meaningful experience in the Indian market.
• Proven expertise in lifecycle, retention, and CRM marketing with demonstrable commercial impact (e.g. improved conversion, reduced churn, incremental revenue).
• Track record of building and leading high-performing marketing/CRM teams — ideally having built a team from the ground up or through a significant scale-up phase.
• Direct experience leading or contributing to a marketing platform/CDP migration, including local rollout and change management; hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud specifically will be a strong advantage given the migration this role will lead (comparable platforms: MoEngage, Adobe Campaign, or similar).
• Hands-on campaign experience across the full engagement channel mix this role covers — email, push, in-app messaging, SMS, and WhatsApp — rather than one or two channels in isolation.
• Deep understanding of cross-sell/upsell mechanics, revenue contribution tracking, and member behaviour insights.
• Strong working knowledge of marketing automation tools and customer data platforms (CDPs); highly analytical, comfortable using data to make decisions and build ROI-driven programmes.

The Accounts team is the platform layer at the centre of Tide's financial infrastructure. Every payment, every balance, every downstream service in Banking depends on this team getting it right. ABOUT

THE ROLE:

The Accounts team is about to split. The ledger is being carved out into its own dedicated team (the Ledger Team), with a mandate to treat it as the high-volume, high-criticality system it is: low latency, high availability, rigorous consistency guarantees. Today the ledger shares a team with account opening, lifecycle management, and compliance. As Tide has scaled across more markets and more complexity, the ledger needs dedicated engineering focus: its own team, its own SLOs, its own on-call practice, its own technical roadmap.

The EM we hire now will join to lead the full Accounts team through that transition. Working alongside the existing team, which includes strong staff-level IC experience, you will help design the seam between the two teams, work out where engineers land, and build the organisational and technical foundation for both. When the split lands, you will move across to lead the Ledger Team. A new EM will be hired to run the remaining Accounts team.

The ledger underpins every payment, every balance check, every statement across all markets. It needs to be engineered to the same standard as any large-scale financial system: fault tolerant, highly available, operationally rigorous. • Owning system stability and operational reliability: SLOs, observability, on-call practice
• Partnering with product, compliance, and internal operations teams to make sure what gets built is accurate, supportable, and compliant across all markets
• Growing engineers at every level. The team spans early-career through senior
• Aligning with other EMs across Banking on cross-cutting infrastructure decisions

Experience and background
• Meaningful engineering management experience. You have led teams through real delivery, not just been a strong tech lead. What matters is the quality of that experience, not the number of years
• A solid backend engineering foundation before moving into management, enough to earn credibility with the team and get into the detail when it matters
• Experience leading distributed, remote-first teams across time zones
• Proven experience leading technical teams, aligning with senior leadership on deliveries, and partnering with product
• Fintech or banking domain

experience:

you know the regulatory surface and what it means to run systems where correctness is not optional. High-volume transaction processing experience is a plus, whether in payments, FX, or similar domains
• Strong grasp of high-volume distributed systems: consistency models, fault tolerance, reliability patterns, SLOs and SLAs, observability tooling

Technical depth
• Technically fluent: you can read the code, follow the architecture, and engage meaningfully with design decisions and production problems. You do not need to be shipping features regularly, but you need to understand what your team is building and why
• Backend engineering in a strongly-typed language (our stack is Java/Spring Boot; we want someone confident in a similar language and willing to engage with ours)
• Experience with microservices in a cloud-native environment (we are AWS-heavy)
• Relational database engineering at scale: transactions, consistency guarantees, and write performance at volume
• Event-driven and async systems experience
• Distributed systems migrations at scale
• Exposure to agentic or AI-integrated systems, and engineering practises

How you work
• You set technical direction and hold others to it. You are the person the team turns to when something is hard
• You understand that building reliable systems is the job, not a nice-to-have
• You communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders (compliance, finance operations, risk) without losing precision
• You develop engineers at every level, with a plan for each person

• Containerised microservices in Java, Python Go
• Web Applications in AngularJS
• Hosted in AWS

• Docker, Terraform, ArgoCD and, EKS Coralogix for monitoring, observability and automated SLOs

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM:

The Manage Money team owns the systems that give Tide members precise, reliable control over how money moves within and around their account. That means internal transfers, direct debit mandate management, standing orders, sweep rules, and balance notifications. These features are what elevates Tide from a place to hold money to a tool that actively works for a member's business: money moving on schedule, obligations met automatically, spending managed without manual effort. The team builds global products, operating across the UK, India, and EU, with the different payment schemes, regulatory obligations, and banking partners each market brings.

ABOUT

THE ROLE:

The engineering challenge here is correctness and reliability at scale. Direct debit mandates involve scheme rules, dispute handling, and indemnity claims. Standing orders and sweep rules are time-based, rule-driven systems where there is no margin for error. A recurring instruction either runs exactly as configured or it does not. Holding that standard across multiple markets, multiple banking partners, and growing member volume is the core of this role.

You will own the technical direction of the team, work closely with product to shape what gets built, and set a high bar for reliability and engineering quality. This is a team with clear ownership and engineers who know their domain well. The work is to push that further: better observability, sharper SLOs, cleaner architecture, and a higher standard of practice across the team.

 

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:
• Leading a team of 7 engineers (backend and mobile) across Lithuania and Bulgaria
• Getting deep into the systems: mandate management, scheduling, sweep logic, internal transfer flows
• Setting engineering direction: reliability, correctness, observability, long-term architecture for systems that run on schedule with no human in the loop
• Owning system stability and operational reliability: SLOs, on-call practice, incident response
• Partnering with product to make sure what the team builds is right for members and compliant with scheme rules across all markets
• Growing engineers at every level. The team spans early-career through senior
• Aligning with other EMs across Banking on shared infrastructure and cross-cutting decisions

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

Experience and background
• Meaningful engineering management experience. You have led teams through real delivery, not just been a strong tech lead. What matters is the quality of that experience, not the number of years
• A solid backend engineering foundation before moving into management, enough to earn credibility with the team and get into the detail when it matters
• Experience leading distributed, remote-first teams across time zones
• Experience working cross-functionally: partnering with product, aligning with senior leadership on delivery, and building trust with non-engineering stakeholders
• Fintech or banking domain

experience:

you understand what it means to run systems where correctness is not optional. Experience with payment schemes (direct debits, standing orders, or similar scheduled/recurring payment infrastructure) is a strong plus
• Strong grasp of reliability engineering: SLOs, observability, scheduled and event-driven systems, and what happens when things go wrong at the wrong time

Technical depth
• Technically fluent: you can read the code, follow the architecture, and engage with design decisions and production problems. You do not need to be shipping features regularly, but you need to understand what your team is building and why
• Backend engineering in a strongly-typed language (our stack is Java/Spring Boot; we want someone confident in a similar language and willing to engage with ours)
• Event-driven and async systems experience
• Relational database engineering at scale: transactions, consistency guarantees, and correctness at volume
• Experience with microservices in a cloud-native environment (we are AWS-heavy)
• Some exposure to agentic or AI-integrated systems is a plus

How you work
• You set technical direction and hold others to it. You are the person the team turns to when something is hard
• You understand that building reliable systems is the job, not a nice-to-have
• You communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders (compliance, finance operations, risk) without losing precision
• You develop engineers at every level, with a plan for each person

Our tech stack

Java and Spring Boot microservices running on AWS, with PostgreSQL as our primary datastore. We use SNS/SQS for async and event-driven messaging. Observability is DataDog, with a migration to Coralogix underway. CI/CD runs through GitHub with automated testing and security scanning. New joiners typically have something in production within their first two weeks. Mobile is Flutter, web is Angular.

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
• The gross annual salary for this position ranges from €68,400 to €101,250 but we are also open to discussing the salary further, taking into account your expertise and contributions.
• 25 days paid annual leave
• 3 paid days off for volunteering or L D activities
• Extended maternity and paternity leave covered by the company
• Personal L D budget in the amount of 500 EUR per year
• Additional health dental insurance
• Mental wellbeing platform
• Fully covered Multisports card
• Food vouchers
• Snacks, light food, drinks in the office
• WFH equipment allowance
• Flexible working from home
• Sabbatical Leave
• Share options

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:
• Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About the team 

The Admin Services commercial team are responsible for driving adoption and usage of essential products for Small Business Owners. This includes Tide’s range of accounting packages, as well as invoicing, expense management, payroll and Company Formations / Company Secretariat services. Most of these are sold on a subscription basis, providing consistent value to members and a consistent revenue stream to Tide. The team works closely with Product, Finance, Business Insights, CRM and Operations teams to translate member and commercial insights into appealing product enhancements, effective positioning, and strategies that enhance engagement and retention. 

About the role 

We’re looking for an exceptional Lead Country Commercial Manager to drive revenue growth across Admin Services product by building out an Accountant GTM, building the foundations and eventually a scaled up program of partnering with Accountants to drive referrals and retention onto Tide products like Accounting, Invoicing and Payroll. In addition to this the role leads on driving the penetration and adoption of our Invoicing tool and the connected revenue associated with it. You will sit at the heart of Tide’s commercial function, and be responsible for collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand product performance, uncover opportunities, and work across multiple areas to deliver. This will require a relentless focus on the numbers and our members, product prioritisation, and detailed planning to ensure revenue targets are hit and customer lifetime value is always increasing.

The role includes close partnership with marketing teams to ensure seamless delivery of ‘always on’ campaign activity. This role will also own the strategy and launch approach for new product launches, ensuring that all channels and member touch points are considered. This includes end-to-end journeys and transaction channels. You’ll need to partner effectively with multiple stakeholders to make this happen – excellent organisation and communication skills essential.

Some of the things you’ll be doing:
• Revenue Ownership Forecasting: Partner closely with Finance and key stakeholders to set, track, and refine financial projections for Accountant initiatives/GTM and Invoicing ensuring revenue accountability and proactive identification of risks and opportunities.

Partnerships collaboration: working with Partnerships to identify the Accountant value proposition and then working with teams to turn Accountants into referrers and advocates for Tide
• Analytics-Driven Insight: with the support of the BI team you will analyse member behaviour, segment audiences, and measure subscription cohort performance. You will then translate this data into clear recommendations that shape product prioritisation, pricing, positioning and communications.
• Product Development: Leveraging the commercial and analytics insights, you will partner with the Product teams to address areas of opportunity. This will include shaping product positioning, product led growth, aligning on roadmaps and supporting successful product launches with tailored GTM strategies.
• Launch Strategy: You’ll support new feature launches across channels, partnering with excellent sales, and operations teams to deliver best-in-class experiments. You’ll facilitate brainstorm sessions / workshops to surface creative ideas and implementation plans.
• Stakeholder Management: As you’ll be working in a highly collaborative way, it will be key to communicate regularly with a wide range of stakeholders. This will include Tide’s Senior Leadership Team as well as the C-Suite.
• Commercial Competitor Intelligence: Lead ongoing commercial research and competitive analysis to monitor trends, and benchmark to translate it into actionable strategies that strengthen and differentiate Tide’s positioning and value proposition.
• Member Obsession: You will be or become an expert in the core motivations of our members in order to focus on bringing their voice to commercial and product design discussions.

What we are looking for
• Strong commercial acumen: Proven experience in driving commercial impact, partnering with finance to understand performance and identify opportunities to improve. Able to set and track clear KPIs across all initiatives to meet revenue goals.
• 5+ years’ experience leading ‘always on’ activity to drive commercial performance. This will ideally be with specific experience in Accounting, Invoicing or Expense Management products, ideally in a fintech environment – key is demonstrated ability to plan and deliver consistent activity that drives commercial impact.
• Strong analytical mindset: Able to review and interpret data to develop hypotheses and assumptions, turning insights into clear, actionable plans.
• Proven GTM track record – delivering holistic, high impact omni-channel campaigns (across sales, CRM, in-app contact points)
• Exceptional project management skills, able to juggle multiple launches and tactical tests in a fast-moving environment.
• Creative collaborator: Builds relationships across teams, crafts compelling messaging and navigates ambiguity with confidence.
• Self-starter attitude: Works backwards from targets, removes blockers proactively and adapts when priorities shift.

What you’ll get in return
• Competitive salary
• Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing
• Hundreds of perks and discounts through Vitality Health Insurance (fitness watches, Waitrose cashback, gym membership etc.)
• 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme
• 25 days holiday with the ability to buy extra days
• Professional L D budget per year
• Referral bonus when you bring your friends to join Tide
• Access to ‘salary sacrifice’ benefits such as Cycle to Work scheme and pension contribution
• Spacious brand new office in Liverpool street with an all-day snacks bar
• Enhanced family-friendly leave
• 24 hours paid volunteering time off per year
• Flexible work from home or at the office arrangements
• Monthly team socials (we’ve had themed bingo, online cocktail making sessions, wellbeing challenges and themed virtual pub quizzes)
• Sabbatical leave 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

 

Disclaimer

 

It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
• Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
• All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
• Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
• Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

 

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

ABOUT THE TEAM:

The Treasury team acts as 1st LoD and is at the forefront of driving financial excellence and supporting strategic growth. The Treasury team mission is to optimise the company's financial resources and investment, manage financial risks, ensure robust liquidity and effective cash management and comprehensive treasury operations.

Moreover the team collaborates closely with the product and business team to align financial strategies with business objectives. By contributing to impactful financial decisions, the Treasury team aims to enable sustainable success and growth.

ABOUT

THE ROLE:

As the Lead, Treasury Policy Procedures you will play a key role in designing, maintaining and governing Treasury’s policy framework and end-to-end Flow of Funds documentation across all products, legal entities and funding structures.

The role ensures Treasury activities are supported by robust governance, clear documentation and well-defined operating processes that meet regulatory expectations while enabling product innovation. Working closely with Product, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Legal and Operations, the role provides Treasury leadership throughout the product development lifecycle to ensure new products and changes are operationally sound, appropriately governed and accurately reflected within Treasury’s control framework.

This is a highly collaborative role requiring the ability to influence senior stakeholders across the business and drive high-quality outcomes without direct authority. 

Your responsibilities will include:

Treasury Policy Governance
• Own the Treasury policy framework, ensuring policies remain current, effective and aligned with the business strategy and regulatory expectations.
• Develop, maintain and periodically review Treasury policies, standards, procedures and governance documentation.
• Ensure Treasury controls are appropriately documented and embedded within operational processes.
• Coordinate policy approvals through relevant governance committees.
• Maintain a structured policy review programme and oversee remediation of policy gaps.

Flow of Funds Ownership
• Lead the design, preparation and maintenance of end-to-end Flow of Funds documentation for all products, payment journeys and legal entities.
• Produce clear, accurate and comprehensive Flow of Funds diagrams and supporting documentation.
• Ensure documentation accurately reflects operational processes, safeguarding arrangements, funding structures, settlement flows and Treasury responsibilities.
• Maintain documentation throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring it remains current as products evolve.
• Act as the Treasury subject matter expert for Flow of Funds during internal governance, audits and regulatory reviews. 

Product Partnership
• Partner with Product Managers from concept through launch to ensure Treasury requirements are incorporated into product design.
• Challenge and influence product designs to ensure they are operationally efficient, scalable and compliant with Treasury policies.
• Translate complex product designs into clear Treasury operating models and Flow of Funds documentation.
• Represent Treasury within product governance forums and change initiatives. 

Stakeholder Management
• Build strong relationships across Product, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Operations, Legal and Engineering.
• Influence senior stakeholders to adopt robust governance and documentation standards.
• Provide Treasury expertise on new business initiatives, acquisitions and strategic projects.
• Coordinate cross-functional reviews to ensure documentation reflects end-to-end business processes. 

Continuous Improvement
• Establish documentation standards and best practice across Treasury.
• Identify opportunities to simplify processes and improve governance.
• Drive consistency across products, countries and legal entities.
• Support regulatory reviews, internal audit and external audit requests relating to Treasury governance.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
• Significant Treasury experience within a fintech, digital bank or retail banking environment.
• Strong understanding of payment flows, safeguarding, liquidity management and Treasury operations.
• Experience developing Treasury policies, governance frameworks or operational procedures.
• Demonstrable experience producing and maintaining Flow of Funds documentation.
• Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence Product Managers and senior business leaders without direct authority.
• Strong written communication skills with the ability to simplify complex processes into clear documentation.
• Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives within a fast-paced environment.
• Experience supporting new product launches within a regulated financial services business.
• Understanding of payment schemes, acquiring, issuing, lending and customer funds.
• Knowledge of FCA or equivalent regulatory expectations relating to Treasury governance and safeguarding.
• Experience working with international or multi-entity Treasury structures. 

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
• Competitive Compensation – Competitive salary and share options.
• Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
• Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
• Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
• Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts.
• Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.
• Life Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
• Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
• Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.
• Volunteering Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
• Learning Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
• WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
• Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
• Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
• Snacks Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.

ABOUT

THE ROLE:

Exciting opportunity for an experienced leader to work in our Ongoing Monitoring team. As a member of the team, we're looking for someone who is passionate about customer experience and fighting financial crime and wants to help drive our business forward as we continue to grow and expand in new markets. 

Ongoing Monitoring sits in our first line of defence (1LOD) operations’ department, responsible for monitoring the activity of our SME customers (‘members’) for the purpose of preventing, detecting and reporting sanctions, money laundering, terrorism financing, tax evasion, bribery and corruption, money mules and fraud.

• 4+ years experience in analytics - financial crime experience preferred
• Strong SQL, excel and visualisation skills (python as well would be preferable) and able to handle complex data structures from multiple sources
• Experience in rule building, back testing and optimisation
• Experience of Fraud compliance and regulation
• Excited about working in a fast-changing environment and have the ability to adapt to the business challenges in front of you
• Communicating clearly with other parts of the business, explaining financial crime, our processes whilst also managing expectations.
• Experience building, reviewing, documenting and optimising business processes, isn’t a must have but would be advantageous

jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:
• Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

Über das Team:

Du wirst Teil eines engagierten und dynamischen Teams, das Tide’s Markterfolg in Deutschland vorantreibt. Das Tide Deutschland Team befindet sich in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase und vereint Experten mit fundiertem Wissen in den Bereichen Finanzdienstleistungen, Technologie und lokalem Marktverständnis. Als Teil dieses expandierenden Teams erhältst Du die einzigartige Gelegenheit, die Präsenz von Tide in Deutschland mitzugestalten und gemeinsam innovative Lösungen für Kleinunternehmer zu liefern. Dies ist Ihre Chance, eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Etablierung der Grundlage für unseren langfristigen Erfolg in diesem wichtigen Markt zu übernehmen. Partner Credit Services ist Tide’s KMU-Kreditplattform. Durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Kreditpartnern verbindet Partner Credit Services Geschäftsinhaber mit der passenden Finanzierung – für Gründer, die ihr Unternehmen auf die nächste Stufe heben wollen, für Unternehmer, die sich in einem schwierigen Markt behaupten, und für Führungskräfte, die ihre Strategie anpassen möchten.

Über die Rolle:

Als hochmotivierter Sales Team Lead Finanzierungsberatung leitest und entwickelst Du ein Team von Finanzierungsberatern, die deutsche KMUs bei ihren Finanzierungsbedürfnissen unterstützen. Diese Rolle ist entscheidend für die Steigerung der Teamleistung, das Erreichen der Umsatzziele und die Förderung einer leistungsstarken Vertriebskultur. Tide vermittelt Kredite an eigene Kunden mit Tide Geschäftskonto bzw. an Unternehmen, die noch kein Kunde bei Tide sind. Unseren eigenen Kunden bieten wir eine Beratung auf höchstem Niveau, die ebenfalls ebenfalls Kunden noch ohne Tide Geschäftskonto zu überzeugen weiß.

Als Team Lead stellst Du sicher, dass Du und Dein Team das Budget einhalten, kontinuierlich geschult und weiterentwickelt werden und stets höchste Standards im Kundenservice aufrechterhalten. Sobald Dein Team vollständig aufgebaut ist, liegt Dein Hauptaugenmerk auf Führung und Coaching. 

Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören:
• KPI-Verantwortung: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung, überwachst und steuerst die KPIs, Pipeline-Aktivitäten und den Deal-Fortschritt Deines Teams, um die Umsatzziele zu erreichen.
• Lead-Konvertierung: Du stellst sicher, dass dein Team die Konvertierung maximiert, indem es alle verfügbaren Finanzierungsprodukte unserer Partner ausnutzt.
• Teamentwicklung: Aufbau, Führung, Mentoring und Entwicklung Deines Teams von KMU-Finanzierungsberatern, um Performance-Ziele zu erreichen und zu übertreffen.
• Vertriebskultur-Entwicklung: Du förderst eine leistungsstarke Vertriebskultur, bist Role Model und zeigst Belastbarkeit auch in Zeiten von Ambiguität und Unsicherheit. Du stellst sicher, dass die Berater motiviert und eigenverantwortlich arbeiten und nach stetiger Verbesserung streben. Deine Teamkultur fördert die gegenseitige Unterstützung innerhalb des Teams und feiert gemeinsam Erfolge
• Coaching: Du coachst, gibst Feedback und bietest passende Schulungen an, um die Vertriebseffektivität und Produktkenntnisse des Teams zu verbessern. Du unterstützt die Berater bei der Strukturierung von Deals, der Überwindung von Einwänden und dem Abschluss von Finanzierungsanfragen wenn nötig.
• Zusammenarbeit: Aufbau und Pflege operativer Beziehungen zu wichtigen Ansprechpartnern unserer kommerziellen Kreditpartner.
• Management: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Head of Commercials und der Geschäftsleitung zusammen, um die Teamziele an den Unternehmenszielen auszurichten.
• Prozessoptimierung: Du identifizierst und implementierst Prozessverbesserungen zur Steigerung der Effizienz und Konvertierungsraten.
• Partner-Unterstützung: Du baust auf und pflegst starke Beziehungen zu Kreditgebern und internen Teams wie dem Partnermanagement, um Betriebsabläufe und Deal-Flow zu optimieren.

Wen wir suchen:

Die Rolle bietet eine spannende Gelegenheit, ein erfolgreiches Team in einem schnelllebigen Wachstumsmarkt zu leiten und zu gestalten. Wenn Du Dich in einer Führungsposition entfalten möchtest und eine Leidenschaft für Vertrieb, kommerzielle Finanzierung und Teamentwicklung mitbringst, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung!
• Mindestens 2 Jahre direkte Führungserfahrung eines Teams, vorzugsweise im deutschen oder einem anderen deutschsprachigen Markt.
• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer kundenorientierten Vertriebsrolle im Finanzdienstleistungssektor, idealerweise in den Bereichen Finanzierung, Kreditvergabe oder Kreditvermittlung.
• Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und fließende Englischkenntnisse sind ein Muss.
• Nachweisliche Erfolgsbilanz bei der konsequenten Erreichung und Übererfüllung umsatzbasierter Ziele.
• Starke Führungsqualitäten mit der Fähigkeit, ein Team zu coachen, zu motivieren, klare Erwartungen und Ziele zu setzen und zu entwickeln.
• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, um Einfluss zu nehmen und starke Beziehungen aufzubauen.
• Eine ergebnisorientierte Denkweise mit Detailgenauigkeit, Entschlossenheit und Tatkraft.
• Leidenschaft für außergewöhnlichen Kundenservice und die Sicherstellung des bestmöglichen Ergebnisses für die Kunden.
• Sehr gut organisiert und analytisch, fähig, verschiedene Prioritäten zu managen und auch effizient unter Druck zu arbeiten.
• Starke Problemlösungsfähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, Probleme schnell und effektiv zu beheben.

ABOUT THE TEAM:

Ongoing Monitoring is building the capabilities Tide needs to detect, prevent and manage financial crime, fraud and risk across the member lifecycle.

Within Ongoing Monitoring, we are creating a new Acquiring Fraud Risk team as part of the Ongoing Monitoring team. This team will focus on protecting Tide’s growing Merchant Acquiring business by reducing acquiring fraud, chargeback losses and operational risk across card-present and card-not-present payment journeys.

Merchant Acquiring is a fast-growing product within Tide. We are on a mission to provide the simplest and easiest ways for our members to get paid. As we scale Acquiring globally, we need strong monitoring capabilities that protect Tide from avoidable losses while keeping the experience smooth for genuine members.

ABOUT

THE ROLE:

As Senior Product Manager for Ongoing Monitoring Acquiring Fraud Risk, you will own the roadmap for Tide’s acquiring transaction risk monitoring capabilities.

Working closely with Engineering, Data Science, Fraud Operations, Risk and Acquiring Product teams, you will build and scale real-time monitoring solutions using rules engines, machine learning models and Agentic AI to reduce fraud losses, improve chargeback outcomes and manage Tide’s acquiring risk exposure across card-present and card-not-present payment journeys.

Product Management and Product Development

You will be responsible for:
• Owning and independently defining the product strategy, vision and roadmap for acquiring fraud and risk monitoring within Ongoing Monitoring
• Building scalable monitoring capabilities across card-present and card-not-present acquiring journeys
• Working with Engineering and Data Science teams to define and deliver real-time rules, risk signals, machine learning models and decisioning workflows
• Having end-to-end ownership of the acquiring fraud and risk monitoring product development lifecycle
• Prioritising product work based on risk reduction, commercial impact, operational effort, member experience and technical feasibility
• Creating clear product narratives for senior stakeholders across Product, Risk, Operations, Finance and Commercial teams

Data-Driven Product Development Acquiring Fraud Reduction

You will be responsible for:
• Using data to identify acquiring fraud patterns, merchant behaviour, loss drivers and control gaps
• Developing product capabilities that actively reduce acquiring fraud losses and help keep Tide within relevant card scheme thresholds
• Establishing and monitoring performance metrics such as fraud loss rate, chargeback rate, scheme exposure, false positive rate and operational efficiency
• Running experiments and targeted control changes to improve fraud prevention while minimising friction for genuine members
• Working with Finance, Risk and Operations teams to quantify the commercial impact of fraud and risk controls

Chargeback Management and Operational Risk

You will be responsible for:
• Building product capabilities that improve chargeback prevention, monitoring, handling and recovery outcomes
• Working with Operations to improve case management workflows, review quality and operational efficiency
• Improving visibility of chargeback drivers, merchant risk profiles and recovery performance
• Helping Tide reduce avoidable losses where chargebacks arrive after funds have already been settled to merchants
• Tracking and improving metrics such as recovery rate, chargeback handling time, operational cost per case and manual review effort

AI, Automation and Risk Decisioning

You will be responsible for:
• Identifying opportunities to use Agentic AI and automation to improve acquiring fraud and risk operations
• Working with Engineering and Data Science teams to build scalable, explainable and measurable AI-supported risk decisioning capabilities
• Improving the speed, consistency and quality of acquiring risk reviews
• Increasing automation where manual review adds cost without improving risk outcomes

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

You are an experienced Product Manager with strong acquiring risk knowledge. You understand the commercial reality of fraud, chargebacks, scheme exposure and operational handling in a live acquiring environment.

You are comfortable working with complex data, real-time payment flows, operational teams and senior stakeholders. You can turn messy risk problems into clear product priorities and measurable outcomes.

You will have worked in an acquiring bank, PSP, payments company, fintech, or in a large merchant with its own acquiring or payments risk team. You understand how acquiring fraud and chargebacks affect growth, margin quality, scheme standing and operational cost.
• You have strong product management experience, ideally 4+ years, with direct experience in acquiring risk, merchant risk, payment fraud, transaction monitoring or chargeback management
• You have experience working in an acquiring bank, PSP, payments company, fintech, or a large merchant with an established acquiring risk function
• You have a proven track record of actively reducing acquiring fraud, chargeback losses or merchant risk exposure
• You understand card-present and card-not-present acquiring journeys, including the different risk patterns across online, remote and in-person payments
• You have experience working with real-time rules engines, fraud monitoring systems, machine learning models, case management tools or risk operations workflows
• You are confident using data to identify loss drivers, prioritise interventions and measure control effectiveness
• You are comfortable working with Engineering, Data Science, Risk, Operations, Finance and Commercial teams
• You understand the balance between reducing risk and protecting the experience for genuine members
• You are pragmatic, organised and able to lead cross-functional delivery in a fast-moving environment
• You can communicate clearly with senior stakeholders and turn complex fraud and risk topics into simple commercial decisions
• You have a passion for solving members’ and agents’ pain points, coupled with your ability to apply product design thinking which sets you apart

• Experience with chargeback prevention, representment, recovery workflows or negative balance management
• Experience building AI or Agentic AI capabilities for fraud operations, risk review, case handling or operational decision support
• Experience working across multiple markets or with global acquiring products

jobs.title: Latam FinCrime Product Compliance and Risk Manager
jobs.description:
Wise is pioneering a new era of cross-border finance. As we expand our footprint in Brazil, we are looking for a FinCrime Product Compliance Manager to join our team.

In this Individual Contributor (IC), role you will be the bridge between complex Brazilian Financial Crime regulations and our Product/Engineering teams. Your mission is to enable the launch of innovative products and partnerships while ensuring our FinCrime risk profile is managed through robust, scalable, and customer-centric controls. You will ensure that Wise Brazil remains compliant with BCB Circular 3,978/2020 and other key regulations without compromising the seamless experience our customers expect.

 

Your Mission
• Enable Growth: Support the Brazil and Global Platform teams in launching new products and partnerships by deeply understanding FinCrime risks and designing associated controls.
• 1LOD Ownership: Act as a hands-on compliance partner within the product development cycle, translating regulatory requirements into technical specifications for engineers and product managers.
• Risk Management: Identify, mitigate, and oversee the FinCrime control environment, ensuring that our Brazilian offering adheres to both local mandates and Wise’s global risk appetite.

 

Key Responsibilities

Control Design & Product Innovation
• Collaborate with Product Managers and Engineers to design KYC, AML, and Anti-Fraud controls that are practical, scalable, and customer-oriented.
• Perform pre-launch and ongoing FinCrime risk assessments for new products and features.
• Ensure controls scale with the product by developing automated monitoring processes to mitigate financial crime risk effectively.

Regulatory Risk & Advisory
• Provide expert advice on existing and forthcoming BCB and CMN regulations (e.g., Circular 3,978/2020, among others).
• Translate "regulatory problems" into technical opportunities, helping teams build risk-based products from the ground up.
• Collaborate with 2LOD (Compliance) to stay ahead of regulatory shifts and ensure the Product team is aligned with current guidance.

Audit, Remediation & External Relations
• Issue Management: Oversee the remediation of FinCrime-related issues and ensure timely mitigation of regulatory risks.
• Audit Representation: Lead responses to regulatory audits and partner due diligence; challenge findings where necessary in collaboration with 2LOD.
• External Stakeholders: Represent Wise in meetings with Banking Partners and the Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), articulating our FinCrime framework and product logic with clarity.

 

What this role offers
• The chance to work at the heart of the product development cycle in one of the world’s fastest-growing Fintechs.
• Direct impact on how millions of customers move and manage money in Brazil.
• A high-autonomy environment where you are empowered to lead solution designs for complex regulatory landscapes.

jobs.title: Lead Analyst - Risk & Controls
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Lead Product Analyst who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders to partner with our product, engineering, risk and compliance teams to help drive data-driven decisions that would support building and scaling risk controls and assurance across our products.

The focus of this team is to ensure continuous regulatory compliance across all our product streams. We’re the team that builds guardrails that ensure that our customers can transact on the platform with a peace of mind, knowing that their accounts and funds are kept safe, and products adhere to global regulatory standards. 

How you’ll contribute:
• Scale and improve our risk data infrastructure to enable our regional teams to dissect metrics at granular levels to proactively identify and mitigate against drivers of risk.
• Building out the metrics to monitor our controls and ensure that they are performing as required, as well as supporting control testing processes.
• Establish control efficiency frameworks by analysing whether controls are effectively reducing risk while not adversely impacting growth.
• Partner with product, engineering, product risk and compliance and other cross-functional stakeholders to influence decisions with data around regional controls and risk.
• Partner closely with FinCrime to add a regional lens on global risk engines to ensure local risk typologies are monitored and appropriately managed. 

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Choose your path to impact – we believe people are most empowered when they can act independently. So rather than telling you what to do, you’ll work with your team to create a vision of your own. Of course, you can always gather feedback from smart, curious people across Wise but you’ll have the freedom to make your own calls
• Grow as a Product Analyst – Grow and inspire your team and others across Wise
• Get amazing exposure to the full breadth and depth of our product while working with a group of multi disciplinary teams of amazing, smart and dedicated product analysts, engineers, product managers, researchers, designers and many more
• The freedom to have real impact – The opportunities you’ll identify are key to Wise reaching future millions of customers and redefining how payments work internationally at scale

jobs.title: Regulatory Compliance Testing Manager, North America
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Regulatory Compliance Testing Manager to join our North America Compliance Monitoring and Testing team. You’ll independently assess whether regulatory controls work in practice and whether customers receive the outcomes our obligations require. You’ll lead risk-based reviews across U.S. consumer protection, payments, state money-transmission, safeguarding, disclosures, complaints, partner handoffs, and remediation.

This is a hands-on testing role. You’ll take reviews from scoping and population definition through evidence, analysis, findings, reporting, and remediation validation. You’ll work closely with Product, Operations, Legal, Risk, Engineering, and Analytics while bringing clear, credible second-line challenge.

Your mission:

Help Wise build a testing program that is rigorous, practical, data-led, and focused on real customer outcomes. You will provide independent assurance over non-FinCrime regulatory risks in North America and turn complex obligations, production evidence, and operational signals into clear conclusions and actions.

You’ll work alongside a Financial Crime testing counterpart and a separate monitoring-oversight lead. Your primary lane is independent regulatory testing: you will not own routine 1LOD monitoring or the overall monitoring framework, although you may provide quality assurance or challenge over related monitoring outputs.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Plan and execute risk-based regulatory testing and remediation-validation reviews from scope through final report.
• Translate regulatory obligations and customer-outcome risks into precise control questions, populations, evidence requirements, test procedures, and failure criteria.
• Test both control design and operating effectiveness, including whether controls work consistently in production and whether customer remediation is complete and reproducible.
• Define and reconcile complete testing populations before sampling; use data and analytics to stratify risk, identify exceptions, and support defensible conclusions.
• Review end-to-end processes that cross Product, Operations, technology, data, partner, and legal-entity boundaries.
• Assess U.S. consumer-protection and payments requirements, including areas such as Regulation E, UDAAP/UDAP, E-SIGN, complaints, disclosures, customer communications, scams and restrictions, and state money-transmission obligations.
• Evaluate state prudential and customer-funds controls where relevant, including safeguarding, permissible investments, liability-to-asset reconciliation, shortfalls, and selected regulatory-reporting evidence.
• Write clear workpapers, issues, remediation-validation conclusions, and management reports that distinguish evidence, regulatory judgment, customer impact, and inference.
• Challenge control owners and senior stakeholders constructively, agree practical corrective actions, and preserve independent second-line judgment.
• Use Internal Audit, Group, first-line, or external-review evidence thoughtfully, relying only where the entity, population, period, procedure, result, and retained evidence support the specific assurance objective.
• Support regulatory examinations, audits, partner due diligence, risk assessments, and governance reporting with accurate, well-organized testing evidence when needed.
• Contribute to the continued development of NorthAm CMT methodology, templates, data use, quality standards, and reporting.
