jobs.title: Credit Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint is an all-in-one financial services platform for emerging markets and the second-fastest growing company in Africa.

Since 2019, Moniepoint’s technology has powered over 3 million people, offering personal and business banking, payment, credit and business management tools to help them succeed. Moniepoint processed $182 billion in 2023 and currently processes the majority of the POS transactions in Nigeria.

About the role

We are seeking an analytical and execution-driven Credit Risk Analyst to serve as the embedded risk owner within one of Moniepoint’s consumer lending product squads. In this role you will bring together credit policy and portfolio management analytics to ensure every product and feature balances rapid growth with robust credit risk controls.

You will design, monitor, and refine credit policies and decision rules for your squad; oversee portfolio performance and compliance with CBN/MFB and KYC/AML standards; and partner with product, engineering, and operations to build “risk-by-design” products from day one. This role requires a rare mix of analytical depth, regulatory understanding, and product instinct - you will be at the centre of how Moniepoint manages risk at scale within your squad.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead end-to-end risk assessment design for new products and features within your squad
• Develop and maintain credit policies and decision rules aligned with company risk appetite
• Collaborate with the Decision Science team to develop credit scorecards
• Monitor portfolio quality and produce portfolio performance reports
• Partner with Decision Science to develop credit scoring models and monitor their effectiveness
• Identify and mitigate operational, fraud, and process risks in collaboration with wider teams
• Provide risk-based input on pricing, limits, and product design
• Maintain dashboards and analytics for repayment behaviour, cohort trends, and other risk KPIs
• Act as the squad’s liaison to central Compliance/Legal and escalate issues promptly
• Champion a “risk by design” culture by educating squad members on best practices

Requirements
• A minimum of 3 years experience in consumer credit portfolio management
• Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements (CBN guidelines, AML/CFT, Data Protection, etc.)
• SQL Essential, Python (NumPy, Pandas etc.) desirable
• Demonstrable experience in Credit Risk management (acquisition optimisation, portfolio management etc.)
• Ability to balance commercial goals with risk appetite
• Excellent communicator - can translate risk concepts for product/engineering
• A good knowledge of financial analysis is an added advantage
• An empathetic, inclusive and curious attitude

What we can offer you
• Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
• Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
• Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process
• A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters.
• A technical interview with the Head of Credit Risk
• An interview with a business lead
• A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the executive team. 

Moniepoint is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

jobs.title: Growth Lead, Northeast Asia
jobs.description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Hong Kong, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

 

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

 

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a product-driven marketing leader to accelerate the growth and adoption of OKX products across North East Asia.

This is not a traditional brand or events-focused marketing role. The role sits at the intersection of Product, Growth, Marketing and Business, with a strong focus on understanding CeFi products, identifying market opportunities, and translating them into measurable user and business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong product sense, understands crypto users and trading behavior, and is highly data-driven. You should be comfortable working closely with Product, BD, VIP, Affiliate and local market teams to identify growth opportunities, build GTM strategies, and continuously improve acquisition, activation, engagement, retention and monetization.

You will also need strong judgment when operating across different market and regulatory environments, ensuring that growth strategies, user targeting and marketing execution are appropriate for each market.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Own the product growth marketing strategy for NEA, with a strong focus on measurable business outcomes, including user acquisition, activation, trading activity, retention and revenue.
• Develop a deep understanding of CeFi products and crypto trading, including Spot, Derivatives, Earn, Copy Trading, Trading Bots, VIP products and other key trading tools, and identify which products and features can become meaningful growth drivers in each market.
• Build and execute product-led GTM strategies based on local user behavior, competitor dynamics and market opportunities rather than relying primarily on brand campaigns or offline events.
• Work closely with Product, Business, BD, VIP, Affiliate and regional teams to translate product capabilities into user acquisition, conversion and monetization opportunities.
• Use data to understand the full user funnel, identify growth bottlenecks and continuously optimize campaigns, product positioning, incentives, conversion journeys and user segmentation.
• Understand and effectively use different digital and growth marketing tools, including performance marketing, CRM, lifecycle marketing, referral, affiliate, KOL/influencer channels, promotions and incentive mechanisms.
• Develop clear user segmentation strategies across retail traders, active traders, high-value users and other relevant customer groups, and design differentiated product propositions and growth strategies for each segment.
• Act as the voice of NEA users to global Product teams by identifying product gaps, competitive disadvantages and emerging user needs, and help prioritize opportunities that can materially improve growth.
• Conduct structured analysis of competitors, including their products, pricing, incentives, campaigns, user journeys and growth mechanisms, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
• Establish clear KPIs and measurement frameworks for major marketing initiatives, with strong accountability for their impact on product adoption and business growth.
• Develop market-specific GTM strategies with appropriate consideration for local regulatory requirements, user targeting, communication boundaries and distribution approaches, working closely with relevant internal stakeholders.
• Build scalable growth playbooks that can be tested in individual NEA markets and expanded when proven successful.

What We Look For In You
• Strong CeFi and crypto product knowledge is essential. You should understand how centralized exchanges work and be familiar with major trading products, user journeys and the competitive landscape.
• Strong product sense — able to understand why users choose one product over another, identify product-market gaps, and translate product capabilities into compelling growth propositions.
• Highly data-driven and commercially minded. Comfortable using data to diagnose problems, prioritize opportunities and measure whether marketing initiatives actually contribute to user and revenue growth.
• Strong understanding of digital growth tools and mechanics, including performance marketing, CRM/lifecycle marketing, referral, affiliate, KOL channels, promotions, incentives and conversion optimization.
• Proven experience driving measurable business or product growth, rather than primarily managing branding, communications, events or community activities.
• Strong understanding of crypto user behavior, particularly active traders and high-value users. Direct crypto trading experience is highly desirable.
• Ability to work cross-functionally with Product and Business teams and influence priorities without relying on direct reporting lines.
• Strong market judgment and awareness of how growth strategies may need to differ across regulatory and market environments.
• Ability to balance growth ambition with responsible execution, including appropriate user segmentation, targeting, communication and channel strategies.
• Strong analytical capability in market research, competitive analysis, funnel analysis and campaign performance.
• Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to turn complex product and market insights into clear priorities and executable plans.
• Experience in major North East Asian crypto markets is highly preferred.
• Fluency in 1 or more NEA Language and English.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured primarily by the number of campaigns, events or impressions generated.

We expect this leader to demonstrate measurable impact on:
• Product adoption and active users
• Trading activity and revenue
• Acquisition and activation efficiency
• User retention and reactivation
• Conversion of high-potential user segments
• Successful adoption of priority products in NEA
• Identification and closing of meaningful product and market gaps
• Effectiveness of collaboration between Marketing, Product and Business teams

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

Please note that Hong Kong is a group-level service hub, and OKX does not carry on a business of operating a virtual asset trading platform in Hong Kong.

jobs.title: Growth Manager - Campaigns
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the role

You will own the EEA growth campaign engine, which mainly comprises of 4 types: Affiliate, Listing, Trade Earn, and New Product Launches. This is both a coordination and execution role. You will be the single accountable owner who turns a campaign concept into a shipped, measured, and reflected-upon outcome by orchestrating creative, media, lifecycle, BD, KOL ops, product marketing, and legal. The number on the campaign is yours. You drive the outcome.

What you will own
• Affiliate campaigns: Activation pulses on top of the always-on affiliate channel. Coordinated with BD and BD Operations.
• Listing campaigns: New token listing campaigns shipped within 24 hours of listing decisions. Tight loop with Listing PM, legal, comms, BD/KOL Ops, exchange ops.
• Trade Earn campaigns: Volume incentives, leaderboards, zero fee promos. Built around clear unit economics and incrementality, not vanity volume.
• Launch campaigns: Product and feature launches. Coordinated with product marketing, product team, social team, and lifecycle team.

What you will do
• Translate fuzzy stakeholder asks into clear campaign briefs that creative, paid, and lifecycle can act on without a six-revision loop.
• Build and own campaign plans with clear gates, dependencies, owners, and dates. Hold stakeholders accountable when slots slip.
• Define success metrics with analytics before launch, not after. Run holdouts where possible. Run reflection sessions within 7 days of campaign close. Publish learnings the team can reuse.
• Navigate MiCA and MiFID II constraints with legal. You will not be the lawyer, but you will know enough to flag the risks early and propose alternatives.
• Be the connective tissue between EEA Growth and Global Campaigns. Localise global playbooks to EEA markets. Push EEA-originated wins back to global for global execution.

What we are looking for

Must-haves:
• Four to seven years total experience, two-plus years coordinating end-to-end campaigns at a tier 1 regulated crypto exchange (Binance, Kraken, Bitpanda, Coinbase, or similar). You have shipped at least 10 campaigns with named numbers attached. And you have the receipts.
• Fluency in English and German, French, or Dutch.
• Hands-on familiarity with EEA regulator dynamics under MiCA and MiFID II. You have shipped campaigns under regulator review and lived to tell the tales.
• Strong brief-writing muscle. Strong project management muscle with strong stakeholder management across senior and peer levels.
• Analytical literacy: you can read a campaign dashboard, spot the wrong attribution, ask the right question of analytics, and present results to leadership.
• Budget discipline. You understand CAC payback, ROAS, incremental volume, LTV.

Who you are
• Competitive. You want your campaign on the leaderboard against Global. You want EEA to outperform.
• Crypto-native. You trade. You have a wallet. You know which tokens listed last week and which exchange ran the best campaign around it. You have opinions.
• Detail-oriented. You catch the wrong token contract address in a launch comms draft before legal does.
• Fast. The good campaigns ship within hours of the news, not days.

jobs.title: Quantum Cryptography Architect
jobs.description:
Starling is the UK's first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking! Our vision is fast technology, fair service, and honest values. All at the tap of a phone, all the time.

We are about giving customers a new way to spend, save and manage their money while taking better care of the planet, which has seen us become a multi-award-winning bank that now employs over 3,000 people across our offices in London, Cardiff, Dublin, Southampton, and Manchester. Our journey started in 2014, and since then we have surpassed 3.5 million accounts with 350,000 business customers. We are a fully licensed UK bank, but at heart, we are a tech-first company, enabling our platform to deliver brilliant products.

Our technologists are at the very heart of Starling and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be; innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Starling is to be a self-driven individual and take full ownership of everything around you: from building things, designing, discovering, to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five Starling values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid model

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Starling - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person. In Technology, we're asking that you attend the office a minimum of 1 day per week.

About Role & Team

The Security Architecture team at Starling is driving significant impact across the organisation, actively guiding and empowering teams across Security and the wider technology landscape. We are looking for a mid-to-senior level Information Security Architect to join our ranks.

While you will cover typical end-to-end security architecture across our modern tech stack, this role carries a strategic focus: Cryptography & Post-Quantum Readiness. As quantum computing capabilities evolve, we are looking to ramp up our Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) efforts. We are looking for a leader who will own the strategic design of our cloud-native and on-premise cryptography roadmaps, conduct cryptographic assessments, drive crypto-agility, and define our technical roadmap to keep Starling resilient against emerging future threats.

What you'll get to do
• Lead our Post-Quantum Strategy: Take ownership of Starling’s Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) initiative over the coming years; designing our crypto-inventory, evaluating PQC algorithms, and designing architectures built for cryptographic agility.
• Act as the Cryptography SME: Provide expert architecture and design guidance on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), key management, service mesh security, and transport layer protocols across our cloud environments.
• Enterprise Architecture Delivery: Architect secure, scalable solutions across AWS and GCP, translating complex security requirements into simple, pragmatic design patterns for engineering teams.
• Secure Architecture Governance: Lead and assist with secure design reviews and threat modeling initiatives, delivering actionable security guidance and continuous support to Engineering teams.
• Proof of Concept Development: Our architects enjoy a hands-on approach. When suitable, we design and build PoC solutions for engineers to refine or draw inspiration from.
• Collaborate & Influence: Work closely with software engineers, cloud architects, and security operations to review RFCs and ADRs, conduct threat models, and embed security seamlessly into the development lifecycle without adding friction.
• Drive Thought Leadership: Serve as a trusted advisor within our growing Security Architecture team, staying ahead of industry trends, threat vectors, and regulatory standards to elevate Starling's overall security posture.

Responsibilties
• Architect end-to-end security solutions for cloud-native applications, microservices, and modern banking platforms.
• Develop and lead our Post-Quantum Cryptography transition roadmap and crypto-inventory strategy.
• Perform threat modeling and technical risk assessments on new and existing platform architectures.
• Define, document, and promote enterprise cryptographic management standards (key lifecycle, hardware security, modern cipher suites).
• Review architectural design documents, RFCs, and ADRs to ensure alignment with security guardrails and regulatory requirements.
• Mentor engineering teams and provide guidance on cryptographic implementations, securely managing secrets, and data protection at rest/in transit.
• Support the rest of the Security Architecture team with daily security architecture activities (e.g. adhoc security architecture advisory services).
• Security Architecture

Experience:

Proven track record in a Information Security Architect or Senior Security Engineering role designing secure, distributed systems within modern cloud environments (AWS/GCP).
• Deep Cryptography Expertise: Comprehensive practical and theoretical knowledge of symmetric/asymmetric cryptography, PKI management, digital signatures, key management systems (KMS), and HSMs.
• Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Knowledge: Strong understanding of quantum computing threats to modern encryption, NIST PQC standards, hybrid key exchange, and strategies for achieving crypto-agility.
• Threat Modeling & System Design: Demonstrated ability to perform threat modeling on complex cloud-native applications, APIs, and microservices architectures (e.g. Kubernetes, ECS).
• Pragmatic Problem Solver: A firm believer that security should enable engineering speed, with the ability to design security controls that minimise developer friction.
• Communication & Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of distilling complex technical/cryptographic risks into clear guidance for both technical teams and senior leadership. 

Desirable
• Experience in Fintech, Banking, or highly regulated cloud environments (e.g. PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, NIST guidelines).
• Demonstrated background in a highly technical role (e.g. Security Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Penetration Testing).
• Experience in infrastructure,application, and AI security (e.g. container security, secure code reviews, secure integration of generative AI/ML).
• Practical experience leveraging and applying the SABSA (Sherwood Applied Business Security Architecture) framework to design business-driven, risk-aligned enterprise security architectures.
• Recognised industry security certifications (e.g. SABSA, CISSP, AWS Security Specialty, or specialised cryptography credentials).

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general, you can expect the below following a chat with one of our Talent Team:
• Stage 1: ~20 minute phone call with our Security Architecture Lead
• Stage 2: ~75 minute technical interview with the team
• Stage 3: ~30 minute final interview with the Security Architecture Director and CISO

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Starling - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person. In Technology, we're asking that you attend the office a minimum of 1 day per week.
• 25 days holiday (plus take your public holiday allowance whenever works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasing

About Us

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect - Engine by Starling
jobs.description:
Starling Bank is the UK’s first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking with more than 3,000 people in our UK offices and 4 MILLION customers in the UK! We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way. Now we present… Engine by Starling.

Engine by Starling is Starling’s software-as-a-service (SaaS) business, the technology that was built to power Starling Bank, and over a year ago we split out as a separate business. We are on a mission to find and work with leading banks all around the world who have the ambition to build rapid growth businesses, on our technology.

This SaaS technology platform is now available to banks and financial institutions all around the world, enabling them to benefit from the innovative digital features, and efficient back-office processes that has helped achieve Starling's success.

At Engine by Starling, our technologists are at our very heart and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Engine is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, and discovering to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Engine - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of our Sydney office in the CBD, so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person. 

About the role

As a Solution Architect (SA) you will use your understanding of the Engine technology and architecture to explain the Engine product, uncover client requirements and support the design of client solutions.

You will be involved in both the sales and delivery phases of a project as well as ongoing client success, collaborating with teams across Engine in Technology, Delivery, Product, Client Success and Business Development..

Supporting these activities on client sites means the role will require travel around Australia and New Zealand, and occasional further travel.

What you'll get to do:

This role blends deep technical expertise with strong communication and collaboration skills. You'll become an Engine expert, understanding its architecture, technology, and functionality, allowing you to effectively communicate its capabilities and value to both technical and non-technical audiences.

You’ll lead on technical designs during the Engine implementation phase, building relationships with a variety of stakeholders within clients and SI partners such as their Engineering leads and Service Owners. 

You will work closely with our clients and SI partners on the technical detail of implementing Engine, providing solutions to identified requirements and working with our Product and engineering teams to fulfil them. Your contributions will also extend to shaping Engine's product roadmap and supporting existing clients with additional capabilities to meet their strategic aims. You’ll help them maximise Engine’s current and future capabilities to solve their requirements and meticulously document scope and roadmap decisions to guide subsequent delivery waves, bringing in expertise from our Product Owners and engineering teams where required.

You will also be a technical champion for our existing clients, ensuring their ongoing success. This includes taking ownership of the technical aspects of client deliveries, collaborating closely with our SI partners to overcome challenges and achieve seamless integrations. You'll provide expert guidance to client engineering teams, using documentation, API specifications, and sequence diagrams to foster a deep understanding of Engine's architecture and functionalities. Additionally, you will collaborate closely with our Client Success team to troubleshoot technical issues, translate client needs into new technical requirements, and architect innovative solutions that enhance the Engine platform.

Must Have:
• Experience of end-to-end software engineering / solution architecture across the software delivery lifecycle
• Experience with software service design and integration, such as RESTful APIs, OpenAPI specification and sequence diagrams
• Experience of cloud infrastructure and large-scale cloud applications
• Experience working in a client-facing role and building relationships with stakeholders
• Strong interpersonal communication and collaboration skills. Experience delivering complex messaging to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have:
• Experience relating to retail or business banking, core banking, card processing or payments.
• Experience of delivery and implementation of core banking or large-scale digital transformation programmes, application migration and solution integration
• Commercial acumen with experience of building business cases
• Experience in a SaaS organisation in a Client Solutions or Client Engineering role
• Knowledge of financial regulations around the world

About you:
• You have a focus on delivery and getting things done for a client
• You have the ability to work well with people from a variety of levels, roles and technical backgrounds
• You’re able to communicate clearly about technical subjects
• You’re comfortable working in a varied role, collaboratively in a team, with a flat structure

jobs.description:
Notre mission et nos clients :
Nous créons la liberté pour que les PME réussissent, en proposant le premier espace de travail financier en Europe — avec la banque au cœur, enrichi d'outils financiers. Nous sommes fiers d'être notés 4,8 sur Trustpilot, sur la base de plus de 55 000 avis. Notre culture place la satisfaction client au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons, comme en témoigne notre Net Promoter Score de 75 (en savoir plus sur notre culture ici).
Notre histoire :
Fondé en 2017 par Alexandre et Steve, Qonto a grandi pour atteindre plus de 1 700 Qontoers, qui servent plus de 750 000 clients dans 8 pays européens. Rentables depuis 2023, nous n'en sommes qu'au début.
Nos convictions :
Nous recrutons sur les compétences et le potentiel. Avec plus de 80 nationalités, 45 % de femmes — dont 56 % au sein de notre équipe dirigeante — la diversité n'est pas un programme : c'est qui nous sommes. Nous avons construit un processus de recrutement sans discrimination, parce que les meilleures équipes se construisent sur le mérite.
L'IA chez Qonto :
L'IA est profondément ancrée dans notre façon de travailler (ici) — chaque Qontoer a un accès illimité aux meilleurs outils d'IA. Nous cherchons des personnes qui expérimentent sans attendre la permission, qui poussent l'IA au-delà de l'évident, et qui savent quand lui faire confiance — et quand la remettre en question.

En juillet 2026, Qonto a racheté Acasi pour construire la première offre bancaire et comptable vraiment intégrée pour les entrepreneurs. Notre conviction : les entrepreneurs méritent une comptabilité certifiée, intégrée directement à leurs outils, pilotée par des pros qui ont du temps pour conseiller plutôt que pour saisir. L'IA automatise ce qui peut l'être, et le métier se déplace vers ce qui a toujours eu le plus de valeur : le conseil et la relation client. 
En tant que Collaborateur Comptable Expérimenté ou Mémorialiste, tu rejoindras une équipe en hypercroissance au cœur de cette transformation, avec un portefeuille de clients indépendants à piloter en autonomie et un rôle actif dans l'évolution de notre solution.
➡️ Ce que tu feras
Conseil de confiance : Tu es l'interlocuteur principal de tes clients sur leurs enjeux fiscaux, financiers, juridiques et comptables — pas un exécutant, un référent. Parmi eux, une variété de dossiers comme des professions libérales, consultants, développeurs, RH indépendants, entreprises d’e-commerce, agents immobiliers ou encore holdings.
Pilote ton portefeuille : Tu prends en charge la tenue, la révision et les obligations fiscales de tes clients (TVA, liasses fiscales, dépôt des comptes), avec des outils pensés pour aller vite sur ce qui peut être automatisé.
Façonne notre produit : Tu es le lien entre tes clients et notre équipe produit. Leurs retours, leurs frustrations, leurs besoins — tu les remontres directement et tu participes à l'évolution de la solution Acasi.
Contribues aux clôtures : Tu travailles en équipe sur les clôtures comptables périodiques, en veillant à la cohérence et à la fiabilité des comptes.
Mentoring : Tu participes à la formation de nos profils juniors et fais office de mentor pour eux.
➡️ Ce qu'on recherche
Formation comptable : DSCG, Master CCA, ou EC mémorialiste — à n'importe quelle étape de ton parcours.
Une première expérience en cabinet : 3 ans minimum. Tu connais le rythme des échéances et tu es force de proposition pour ton équipe.
Appétence pour le digital et l'IA : Tu t'intéresses à ce que la technologie change dans le métier — et tu veux travailler dans un cabinet qui en fait un avantage, pas un sujet de peur.
Envie de construire quelque chose : Acasi n'est pas un cabinet figé. Tu veux participer à ce qui se construit — pas juste occuper un poste.
Langues : français courant indispensable pour la relation client. Anglais B1 minimum — nos équipes et nos outils sont en partie en anglais.
➡️ Ce qu'on t'offre
Être au cœur du réacteur : L'IA va transformer la comptabilité plus vite que n'importe quel autre secteur. Chez Acasi, tu n'observes pas cette transformation depuis les gradins — tu en es l'un des acteurs.
Un rôle produit rare : Tu as une voix directe sur l'évolution d'un logiciel comptable utilisé par des milliers de clients. Peu de cabinets offrent ça.
Autonomie réelle dès l'arrivée : Ton portefeuille est à toi. La taille et la complexité s'adaptent à ton niveau — mais la responsabilité, elle, est immédiate.
Une rémunération compétitive : Ton package est aligné sur ton niveau d'expérience et revu régulièrement — parce qu'on sait que les bons profils ont le choix.
Tu es mémorialiste ? Toutes les formations obligatoires du stage prises en charge par Qonto, du coaching mémoire & prépa DEC à disposition et du temps réellement bloqué pour les révisions.

Chez Qonto, nous sommes convaincus que la vraie diversité ne se résume pas à cocher des cases sur une grille de recrutement. Postulez, quelles que soient les cases que vous cochez — qui sait ? Vous avez peut-être la pièce manquante du puzzle que nous cherchions depuis le début.
En postulant, vous acceptez que Qonto traite vos données personnelles afin d'évaluer votre candidature. Vos données sont conservées jusqu'à 2 ans dans notre vivier de candidats. Consultez notre Politique de confidentialité pour tous les détails.

En moyenne, notre processus de recrutement dure 20 jours ouvrés. Plus d'informations sur notre parcours candidat ici.

🔒 Votre sécurité nous tient à cœur
Les arnaques au recrutement se multiplient. Nous ne faisons jamais appel à des plateformes tierces ou des agences qui demandent un paiement aux candidats.

jobs.title: Financial Crime Product Compliance & Risk Senior Manager
jobs.description:
The Product Compliance & Risk (PC&R) team sits at the centre of Wise’s product development function, supporting our cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional compliant-by-design products for our customers.

We’re seeking a highly motivated, customer-centric individual to join our team in Sydney, to help take our Australia and New Zealand (AU/NZ) financial crime risk management program to the next level.

This hands-on role will involve working closely with product teams globally and in APAC to ensure our controls strike the right balance between meeting compliance requirements whilst maximising customer experience.

Your mission: 

Wise has already pioneered new ways for people to transfer money across borders and currencies. Your mission is to enable our product teams to launch new products, grow our presence and manage compliance risks in AU/NZ through a deep understanding of financial crime risks and regulator expectations. 

This is a hands-on role, with high levels of ownership over:
• Designing and continuously improving our products and controls: Leverage your deep understanding of the Wise product, regulatory requirements and financial crime risks to support new product launches. This includes communicating requirements in clear, practical terms, and taking a risk-based, scalable approach with the customer experience front-of-mind when designing, uplifting and implementing controls.
• Financial crime risk management: Stay ahead of financial crime trends and the regulatory agenda in AU/NZ, assess and present risks quantitatively and qualitatively in clear and understandable terms, and work collaboratively to define and execute on risk mitigation plans.
• Regulatory change and remediation: Conduct regulatory gap analyses, define and scope actions to remediate gaps, and ensure implementation plans are executed in a timely manner. Collaborate with global teams to identify synergies with programs of work already completed or underway across the Wise Group.
• External engagements: Represent Wise through external engagements such as audits and regulatory inspections, including explaining and defending our financial crime controls, and developing and executing remediation plans.

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Play a key role in owning and shaping Wise’s financial crime risk management program in AU/NZ, including building and applying your knowledge and experience across domains - including AML/CTF (CDD, transaction monitoring, reporting), sanctions and fraud.
• Grow your hands-on fintech experience at full speed, with high levels of ownership and autonomy.
• Collaborate with our amazing teams both locally and globally to build state-of-the-art products for our customers that are compliant-by-design.

jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Partnerships at Brex

Sales is the growth engine at Brex. We bring in new customers, expand existing relationships, and drive the company’s bottom line. With unlimited territories and uncapped opportunity, your ambition sets the ceiling. We win together, celebrate often, and reward performance. If you want to sell a category-defining product with real ownership, this is your team.

What you’ll do

Brex’s Accounting Channel is undergoing exponential growth, and we are looking for a partner manager to accelerate the team. In this role, you'll be at the forefront of shaping and expanding our market presence, driving a critical engine of our company's success. We're on the hunt for a dynamic professional who excels at forging powerful alliances in the accounting and OCFO ecosystems. You’ll be responsible for building strong relationships, cultivating partnerships from the ground up, seamlessly integrating new partners into our ecosystem, and consistently hitting targets by transforming these connections into a steady stream of client referrals. If you have a history of exceeding expectations and a passion for creating mutually beneficial business relationships, this could be your chance to make a significant impact in a fast growing environment.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Identify, cultivate, and deepen relationships with high-potential accounting firms
• Craft and implement tailored go-to-market strategies for each partner
• Facilitate smooth onboarding of new partners and their teams
• Drive client referrals from our accounting partners to fuel revenue growth for Brex
• Serve as a product expert, articulating our value proposition to partners
• Be the connective tissue for partners to the Brex ecosystem
• Work cross-functionally across marketing, growth, direct sales, and product engineering to drive co-marketing opportunities, onboard new clients, and inform our product roadmap
• Conduct regular performance reviews with key partners
• Identify and build relationships with multiple stakeholders within accounting firms
• Become an expert in Brex's product, features, and workflows and augment the voice of our Accounting Partners

Requirements
• 3+ years in a closing sales or partnerships role
• Demonstrated track record of consistently hitting targets and quotas
• Ability to identify client needs through thoughtful questioning, active listening, and analysis; including but not limited to shared mutual referral goals, enablement sessions, and MBR/QBRs where necessary
• Ability to deliver tailored, consultative solutions that align with partner’s needs and business goals
• Ability to evaluate partnership performance, identify areas for optimization, and implement data-driven solutions
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with excellent listening skills
• Thrives in a fast-paced, evolving startup environment
• Proven ability to build trust and credibility with internal and external stakeholders.
• Passion for community events and activations with partners

Bonus points
• Experience in collaborating with accounting firms
• Accounting background (CPA certification or relevant industry experience is a plus)

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $135,600 - $169,500. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Senior Incident, Problem & Change Specialist
jobs.description:
Join a Challenger
At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions. 

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.

What's kept us moving? The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity. 

We can’t wait to get to know you! 

The Work
 
One of our goals is to fail small and learn fast. The Senior Incident, Problem & Change Specialist will focus on minimizing the impacts of production incidents while ensuring the organization learns quickly to become more resilient. 
The Incident, Problem & Change Specialist is accountable for tracking, and managing technology incidents experienced within the bank, while driving the restoration of services at pace. A key part of this role is effective communication across all stakeholders and teams within the bank, in both verbal and written form while working under pressure at a fast pace. 
The role is responsible for managing the processes, guidelines, standards and tools related to Major and other high priority Incidents. This encompasses performing Root Cause Analysis. 
The role is responsible for managing the lifecycle of Problems, with the aim of preventing incidents from happening or reoccurring. The Incident, Problem & Change Specialist will record and manage problems through to resolution by performing root cause analysis, coordinating third party analysis, and communicating with stakeholders. They will ensure workaround and solution suitability will establish service level objectives, indicators and agreements (SLOs, SLIs and SLAs) for critical systems and channels, including championing automated monitoring and data aggregating to streamline reporting of metrics. 
This role is also responsible for managing the lifecycle of Changes with the goal of ensuring appropriate due diligence and documentation exists to reduce risk and proactively have a rollback strategy to minimize impact if issues arise. As a gatekeeper for the Change process, this role ensures adherence to the Change Enablement standard, processes and Change Advisory Board (CAB) expectations. 
Success in this role will be demonstrated by ensuring that all major incidents are dealt with effectively and with minimum disruption to live service and SLAs. 

What we offer [For full-time permanent roles]
 
💰 Competitive discretionary bonus 
✨ Market leading RRSP match program
🩺 Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits
📝 Employee Share Purchase Plan
👶🏽 Maternity/Parental top-up while you care for your little one
🏝 Generous vacation policy and personal days 
🖥 Virtual events to connect with your fellow colleagues
🎓 Professional development and comprehensive Career Development program
💛 A fulfilling opportunity to join one of the top FinTechs and help create a new kind of banking experience
 
The incumbent will be working hybrid and in office time will be spent working from EQ Bank’s additional office space located at 2200-25 Ontario Street, Toronto, ON.

Equity, Diversity & Inclusion
EQ is committed to building an inclusive, accessible environment where every employee feels valued, respected, and supported. We believe our organization is stronger — and our people thrive — when we honour and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives. We’re equally committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally.
We provide a barrier‑free recruitment process and work environment. If you require accommodations at any stage, we will work with you to ensure you can bring your best self to the process and beyond.

jobs.title: Head, Innovation Hubs
jobs.description:
About us

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role

Moniepoint is building innovation hubs at three of Nigeria’s leading universities: Obafemi Awolowo University (OAU), University of Nigeria, Nsukka (UNN), and Ahmadu Bello University (ABU). Each hub is a cross-disciplinary platform, open to students from every faculty. The model is cohort-based, industry-connected, and built to produce technical talent ready for the job market, across software engineering, AI, product, data science, robotics, and design. The hubs train students in applied technical skills, connect them to working engineers, product leaders, and founders, and provide a path into industry at Moniepoint, at other technology companies, or through ventures of their own.

This is a building role. The hubs are entering their operating phase, and you will own the design of how they run and the teams that run them.

What you will own
• Programme design. You will design the operating model for all three hubs from the ground up: how cohorts are structured, how learning is sequenced, what “job market-ready” means at each level, and how graduates are assessed and certified. This is not adapting someone else’s playbook. It is writing one.
• University relationships. You will be the primary relationship owner with the Vice-Chancellors, deans, faculty leads, and student bodies at OAU, UNN, and ABU. These are institutional relationships that require both strategic seniority and sustained presence.
• Cross-faculty engagement. The hubs are not engineering faculty initiatives. They are open to students across every faculty: engineering, sciences, humanities, business, design. You will design the engagement model that brings students from across each university into the hub and keeps them in it through the full cohort.
• Industry and mentorship pipeline. The hubs derive their value from the connection between classroom and industry. You will build and manage the network of engineers, product leaders, and founders, inside Moniepoint and beyond, who mentor, assess, and hire from the hubs.
• Facilitators and standard. You will design the facilitator model, recruit the people who teach and assess, and own the standard those facilitators hold the cohort to. A single standard across all three hubs is non-negotiable; how it's delivered locally is yours to design.
• Infrastructure and operations. You will own the physical footprint of each hub, whether that means a buildout from scratch or working within an existing campus structure, and manage the timelines, vendor relationships, and hub-level budgets across three sites. You will define the staffing model for each hub and recruit the on-ground team that runs them day to day.
• Outcomes and accountability. You will set and own the metrics: graduate output, job placement, programme completion, cohort quality, employer satisfaction.
• Pipeline integration. The hubs are upstream of Moniepoint Academy and other talent programmes. You will design the connective tissue between hub graduates and Moniepoint’s internal pathways, so the strongest talent has a clear next step.

Who you are
• 10+ years of experience overall, with at least 5 in leadership roles owning programmes, teams, and budgets end to end.
• You have built or led a technical training or workforce development programme at scale, ideally across multiple sites. You have taken something from zero to one - designed the model, hired the team, and held the standard yourself.
• You have held institutional relationships at senior level across universities, government bodies, and industry partners. You know how to navigate Nigerian university administration, or you have done it elsewhere and can credibly do it here. You have hired and managed technical educators, and you know what separates someone who can teach from someone who can teach to a standard.
• You understand what good engineering education looks like and what employers in software, AI, product, and data science actually hire for. You don't need to write code, but you need the technical fluency to design a programme that produces hireable engineers, not credentialed graduates.
• You are rigorous about outcomes and impatient with programmes that look good in announcements but cannot prove what they produce.
• Experience in edtech, developer education, university-industry partnerships, or workforce development is a strong signal. Building something from scratch and owning it through to measurable outcomes is essential.

What success looks like
• Year one. Operating model live across all three hubs. Cohorts running on a common standard. The facilitator team hired and held to the same expectations regardless of site. First graduate cohort exited, with a clear placement record into Moniepoint and into industry.
• Year two. The hubs are recognised within Nigeria as the most credible cross-disciplinary technical training environment available to undergraduates. Employers, including Moniepoint, actively hire from the hubs. Cohort demand outstrips supply.
• Year three. Hubs producing technical talent into Moniepoint at a cost-per-hire that justifies the investment, and into the wider industry at a scale and quality that defines what a corporate-funded university programme can look like in Nigeria. Model documented and ready to expand if leadership chooses.

What Moniepoint can offer you
• The opportunity to shape one of the most consequential talent infrastructure investments in Nigerian technology.
• A dynamic, diverse, and collaborative environment where every team member's voice is recognised and valued.
• Continuous learning and career growth opportunities.
• Competitive salary, individual performance bonuses, and firmwide performance bonus.
• Company-covered health insurance plans. Pension plans.

What to expect in the hiring process
• A preliminary conversation with one of our recruiters.
• An interview with the hiring manager, our Head of Corporate Affairs.
• A case study or written exercise on operating model design for the hubs.
• An interview with our Group COO.
• A final conversation with our CEO.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Risk Strategy (Buy/Sell Crypto)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

Singapore based, we are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager – AI Risk Strategy to lead the evolution of OKX Buy/Sell Crypto risk control capabilities. You will own the end-to-end risk strategy across transaction risk, fraud prevention, review operations and AI-powered decision making.

At OKX, you will have the opportunity to build next-generation AI-native risk systems that protect millions of users worldwide. You will play a key role in redefining how AI Agents, Large Language Models and intelligent decision engines transform fraud prevention and operational efficiency across one of the world's leading crypto platforms. This role is highly data-driven and requires strong ownership. You will independently analyze risk data, identify fraud patterns, design and optimize risk strategies, and drive the transformation from traditional manual review to AI Agent-powered intelligent review. You will work closely with Engineering and Risk Operations teams to build scalable, intelligent and efficient risk systems.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Own the end-to-end risk strategy for Buy/Sell Crypto products, including transaction risk control, fraud prevention, review workflows and decision engines.
• Design and continuously optimize the risk control architecture, including rule engines, policy engines, model orchestration and review systems.
• Independently analyze large-scale transaction and risk data to identify fraud patterns, emerging attack vectors and strategy optimization opportunities.
• Design, implement and iterate risk policies based on data-driven insights to improve fraud detection while minimizing user friction.
• Define and optimize model policies, decision thresholds, confidence scores and human-in-the-loop review mechanisms.
• Conduct root cause analysis, monitor risk performance and perform A/B testing to continuously improve strategy effectiveness.
• Lead the transformation of manual review into AI Agent-powered intelligent review by designing LLM-driven workflows, reviewing policies and operational processes.
• Drive continuous optimization of AI Agents through prompt engineering, policy iteration, feedback loops and model evaluation.
• Improve operational efficiency by increasing automation, optimizing resource utilization and reducing manual review costs.
• Partner closely with Engineering teams to deliver scalable, reliable and intelligent risk systems.

 

What We Look For In You
• Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Mathematics or a related discipline.
• 5+ years of experience in Risk Strategy, Fraud Detection, Risk Product Management, Trust Safety or related fields.
• Strong experience designing transaction risk strategies, fraud detection systems or review platforms.
• Proven ability to independently analyze large datasets, identify risk patterns and translate insights into effective risk strategies.
• Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with data analysis. Experience with Python, Spark or other analytical tools is a strong plus.
• Experience designing and optimizing rule engines, policy engines, risk scoring or decision engines.
• Strong understanding of fraud prevention, transaction risk, payment risk, account security or related risk domains.
• Experience designing model policies, evaluation metrics and strategy iterations for machine learning or AI-based systems.
• Hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, policy design, model evaluation and production iteration.
• Experience designing or implementing AI Agent workflows, AI-assisted review systems or intelligent operational processes.
• Strong analytical thinking with the ability to perform root cause analysis and make data-driven decisions.
• Excellent problem-solving skills with a high level of ownership and execution.
• Fluent in both English and Mandarin to support cross-functional collaboration in a global environment.

 

Nice to Haves
• Experience in cryptocurrency, fintech, payments, banking or internet risk control.
• Experience building AI-native products or AI-powered operational systems.
• Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agent orchestration, tool calling and model evaluation frameworks.
• Experience with A/B testing, strategy experimentation and online/offline model evaluation.
• Knowledge of AML, KYC, payment fraud, account takeover, scam prevention or identity risk.
• Experience working with AI coding assistants or automation tools to improve product development efficiency.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: AML Manager
jobs.description:

Your key objective is to ensure the effective assessment and mitigation of risks related to high-risk customers, while strictly adhering to AML/CFT regulations and aligning with Wise’s risk appetite and internal policies. The specialists on your team will possess an in-depth understanding of the unique risks associated with complex business structures, varied customer types and activities, and country-specific challenges, as well as the strategies required to mitigate these risks effectively.

In this leadership role, you will act as a vital connector between your operational team, which includes team leads and specialists, and Wise's senior leadership. This involves clearly communicating the overarching strategic objectives to your team and transforming these goals into actionable and pertinent directives that drive process optimization and performance improvement.

You'll be instrumental in aligning Wise’s overall mission and strategy with performance expectations, ensuring that your team’s efforts are efficiently strategized and executed for optimal success. This includes developing and owning a strategic roadmap spanning several quarters your team, enhancing processes, and cultivating a positive and empowering work environment. You will support your team’s growth and independence through comprehensive training, mentoring, coaching, delegation, and recognition.

As an experienced operations manager, you will design and implement customer-focused processes while maintaining a vigilant awareness of the risks inherent in the financial industry, specific product offerings, and regulatory requirements. Your approach will ensure that Wise's operations continually meet the expectations of our partners and regulatory bodies.

Job Responsibilities
• Leadership and people development: Drive team performance and cultural excellence to support sustainable business growth. Lead by example, demonstrating values and work ethic that inspire accountability, proactive problem-solving, and a growth mindset. Manage and develop a high-performing team by role modeling success behaviors. Focus on cultivating a high-performance culture through talent development, career check-ins, and recommendations for growth. Build strong teams by hiring, coaching, and fostering skills and competencies. Promote continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and inclusion to empower your team to innovate and excel.
• Performance management: Foster a culture of excellence in your team by consistently meeting KPIs and SLAs in our metrics-driven environment. Refresh performance expectations to match business needs and address underperformance with clear action plans. Implement strong performance frameworks, provide actionable feedback, and ensure every team member operates efficiently.
• Operational management: In this role, you'll turn high-level plans into actionable changes and lead your team to success. You'll create phased implementation plans to minimize disruption and set clear metrics to track progress. Focus on optimizing team structure by managing recruitment and strategically placing staff. Continuously identify and address redundancies and inefficiencies. You'll develop scalable, compliant processes and collaborate with product and operational teams to enhance customer experience, boost automation, and meet financial and service goals. Strong data literacy is essential for analyzing complex data and making informed decisions. Governance is crucial; you'll escalate issues promptly, provide clear updates to senior leadership, and contribute to a customer-focused culture that balances regulatory objectives with excellent customer service.
• Quality assurance: Ensure the highest quality standards for your group's tasks by making decisions within established frameworks. Lead root cause analysis, turn insights into improvements, and mitigate risks. Ensure quality standards are integrated into processes, tools, and initiatives. Understand impacts, focus on findings, and propose actions for better outcomes. Collaborate with other functions, offering expertise to enhance processes and elevate quality across the team and organization
• Domain knowledge and expertise: Be a subject matter expert in Financial Crime areas with the ability to train and coach your team. Maintain a comprehensive understanding of our regulatory obligations and internal policies. Apply a risk-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Be able to represent the operational team processes and policies when working with internal auditing and testing parties. Retain an understanding of the wider Financial Crime and regulatory landscape and take on best practices to your team. Own operational incident management: from initial detection to response and remediation. Liaise effectively with functions and stakeholders, ensuring clear and timely communication throughout. Be responsible for developing action plans, driving remediation efforts, and providing context and subject matter expertise during and after incidents. The Senior Lead supports product-related incident management, ensuring a response to all critical events.
• Project management: Effectively Lead projects from start to finish, prioritizing tasks and maintaining documentation. Communicate milestones, address blockers, and delegate tasks while monitoring progress. Articulate project impact and value, and engage with stakeholders from technical teams to senior management. Negotiate and influence cross-functional teams to drive momentum and align with strategic goals.
• Planning and execution: Ensure operational area plans are set in place and provide insights to other stakeholders. Take full accountability in delivering, updating and making sure your area is making progress on their goals by measuring the effectiveness of the output of the team. There is a clear strategy within your domain that is connected with the wider organisational key objectives, including impactful OKRs and goals based on these plans, and being able to confidently present plans to varied audiences.
• Stakeholder management and communication: Lead complex projects with multiple stakeholders, setting priorities and ensuring timely delivery. Partner with Product to support group objectives and advocate for customer success. Manage diverse relationships, anticipate issues, and share key insights. Engage stakeholders promptly and lead discussions effectively. Communicate clearly and tailor messages to the audience, using data to deliver impactful and concise messages. Adapt to diverse stakeholders with confidence, ensuring professional and effective interactions.

jobs.title: Scheme Compliance Function Lead

This role will focus on leading issuer-side scheme compliance and card disputes frameworks across Visa and Mastercard programs. It's a unique opportunity to build on your regulatory and commercial expertise, help deliver Wise’s mission of money without borders, and grow within a global, fast-paced environment while ensuring our card issuance operations remain compliant, secure, and built to scale.

Wise is a fast-growing business, so we expect that the right candidate will be able to clearly demonstrate exceptional behaviors and risk leadership that have resulted in scalable, compliant outcomes and material risk reduction in prior organizations.

Your mission:

At Wise, our mission is to make money borderless — and Scheme Compliance plays a key role in making that happen. We establish robust control frameworks and operational governance that ensure Wise meets scheme obligations, protects customer outcomes, and drives maximum value from our card issuance ecosystem. Our goal? To make launching and operating card programs at Wise as compliant, resilient, and frictionless as sending money across borders.

Scheme Compliance sits within our Spend & Card Issuance function, overseeing issuer obligations, monitoring programs, launches, and vendor governance. We’re a dedicated team that supports the business across all Visa and Mastercard product flows.

This is your chance to help shape what Scheme Compliance looks like at Wise — providing high evidence standards, building scalable processes, driving product integrity, and helping us create a best-in-class global issuer compliance function!

Your mission is to enable, protect, and empower the business and people of Wise by ensuring our card products meet scheme rules, mitigate fraud and dispute risks, flow through frictionless operations, and support our global growth.

About

the Role:
• Develop and execute a 1–3 year Spend Scheme Compliance strategy that aligns with Wise's business objectives and translates into clear quarterly priorities.
• Act as the accountable leader and key stakeholder for all issuer-side scheme topics across Visa and Mastercard programs, including BIN management, thresholds, and rule interpretations.
• Manage and develop a team of Compliance Product Specialists, helping them navigate complex scheme environments through effective coaching, performance management, and clear role definitions.
• Own Card Disputes Compliance end-to-end across fraud and non-fraud disputes, ensuring rules are operationalised, risks are governed, and recovery rates are optimised.
• Lead launch integrity for new issuance initiatives (BINs, chip profiles, market expansions), ensuring correct-first-time scheme submissions and go/no-go readiness.
• Oversee scheme compliance across the issuer supply chain, including processors, 3DS/authentication providers, tokenisation partners, and card personalisation vendors.
• Establish early-warning monitoring programs for scheme KPIs (fraud, disputes, thresholds) to prevent fee escalation or enforcement actions.
• Lead high-stakes negotiations and external relationship management with Visa and Mastercard, setting the tone for Wise advocacy and commitment tracking.
• Design and maintain a robust control framework, leading audit readiness and managing executive responses for scheme, external, and internal queries.
• Drive continuous improvement by establishing scalable mechanisms, including automated dashboards, standardised templates, and playbooks that reduce manual tasks and single points of failure.

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Choose your path to impact. As a Lead, you’ll take ownership from day one, backed by smart, curious people across Wise while enjoying high levels of autonomy.
• Be extremely hands-on. We don't have far-away leaders at Wise; you’ll be directly leading escalations, shaping controls, and executing solutions yourself.
• Be part of our mission to make money without borders the new normal.
