jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect - Engine by Starling
jobs.description:
Starling Bank is the UK’s first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking with more than 3,000 people in our UK offices and 4 MILLION customers in the UK! We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way. Now we present… Engine by Starling.

Engine by Starling is Starling’s software-as-a-service (SaaS) business, the technology that was built to power Starling Bank, and over a year ago we split out as a separate business. We are on a mission to find and work with leading banks all around the world who have the ambition to build rapid growth businesses, on our technology.

This SaaS technology platform is now available to banks and financial institutions all around the world, enabling them to benefit from the innovative digital features, and efficient back-office processes that has helped achieve Starling's success.

At Engine by Starling, our technologists are at our very heart and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Engine is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, and discovering to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Engine - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of place of work in London, so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person. Supporting these activities on client sites means the role will require travel around Europe, and occasional further travel.

About the role

As a Solution Architect (SA) you will use your understanding of the Engine technology and architecture to explain the Engine product, uncover client requirements and support the design of client solutions.

You will be involved in both the sales and delivery phases of a project as well as ongoing client success, collaborating with teams across Engine in Technology, Delivery, Product, Client Success and Business Development.

What you'll get to do:

This role blends deep technical expertise with strong communication and collaboration skills. You'll become an Engine expert, understanding its architecture, technology, and functionality, allowing you to effectively communicate its capabilities and value to both technical and non-technical audiences.

You’ll lead on technical designs during the Engine implementation phase, building relationships with a variety of stakeholders within clients and SI partners such as their Engineering leads and Service Owners. 

You will work closely with our clients and SI partners on the technical detail of implementing Engine, providing solutions to identified requirements and working with our Product and engineering teams to fulfil them. Your contributions will also extend to shaping Engine's product roadmap and supporting existing clients with additional capabilities to meet their strategic aims. You’ll help them maximise Engine’s current and future capabilities to solve their requirements and meticulously document scope and roadmap decisions to guide subsequent delivery waves, bringing in expertise from our Product Owners and engineering teams where required.

You will also be a technical champion for our existing clients, ensuring their ongoing success. This includes taking ownership of the technical aspects of client deliveries, collaborating closely with our SI partners to overcome challenges and achieve seamless integrations. You'll provide expert guidance to client engineering teams, using documentation, API specifications, and sequence diagrams to foster a deep understanding of Engine's architecture and functionalities. Additionally, you will collaborate closely with our Client Success team to troubleshoot technical issues, translate client needs into new technical requirements, and architect innovative solutions that enhance the Engine platform.

Must Have:
• Experience of end-to-end software engineering / solution architecture across the software delivery lifecycle
• Experience with software service design and integration, such as RESTful APIs, OpenAPI specification and sequence diagrams
• Experience of cloud infrastructure and large-scale cloud applications
• Experience working in a client-facing role and building relationships with stakeholders
• Strong interpersonal communication and collaboration skills. Experience delivering complex messaging to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• You possess fluent English language skills, and are fluent in at least one relevant regional European language (ideally French or Spain)

Nice to Have:
• Experience relating to retail or business banking, core banking, card processing or payments.
• Experience of delivery and implementation of core banking or large-scale digital transformation programmes, application migration and solution integration
• Commercial acumen with experience of building business cases
• Experience in a SaaS organisation in a Client Solutions or Client Engineering role
• Knowledge of financial regulations around the world
• Speaking multiple european languages is a massive plus

About you:
• You have a focus on delivery and getting things done for a client
• You have the ability to work well with people from a variety of levels, roles and technical backgrounds
• You’re able to communicate clearly about technical subjects
• You’re comfortable working in a varied role, collaboratively in a team, with a flat structure
• You’re comfortable travelling nationally to our London office (initial upskilling will require a period of time working with our Engineers & Product team in London)
• You’re comfortable travelling internationally

Interview Process: 

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:
• First Interview (45 mins) - Phone/Video call with existing Engine team members.
• Second Architecture Interview, including small presentation/system design (90 mins)
• Final Interview (60 mins)
• 33 days holiday (including public holidays, which you can take when it works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Incentives refer a friend scheme
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasing

 

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

Starling is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Starling are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. When you provide us with this information, you are doing so at your own consent, with full knowledge that we will process this personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice. 

By submitting your application, you agree that Starling may collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Be the Group subject matter expert for Global Tax (Pillar Two, Indirect Tax, Direct Tax, Transfer Pricing, DSTs, and crypto-specific taxes) and provide clear, timely, and strategic guidance to executive stakeholders and other departments on complex financial and tax-related issues.
• Direct regional and cross-regional financial tax management systems, providing oversight of global tax compliance to ensure proper collection, controls, and reporting across 4+ financial management modules.
• Lead enterprise engagements with tax authorities and tax consultants globally on group tax matters, and direct global tax controversy defense strategies.
• Shape group policy and strategy in response to new global tax legislation (including crypto/digital economy developments), evaluate its group-wide implications, and brief executive leadership and the wider business as appropriate.

• Spearhead group-wide tax initiatives, implementing best-in-class tax processes and SOPs while refining common team challenges into standardized solutions and promoting them internally.
• Drive cross-regional implementation and governance of tax determination engines and automation tools for key group tax compliance reporting (Indirect Tax, CbCR, Pillar 2).

 

What We Look For In You
• Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Law, Economics, or Taxation; Master’s in Tax, LL.M., or professional qualification (CPA, CA, CTA) strongly preferred.
• At least 12–15+ years of relevant experience in international and group tax, with proven leadership within a multinational organization and/or Big 4.
• Technically strong with deep group-level mastery across global tax regulations, with proven experience delivering results across 4+ financial management modules.
• Experience leading global tax strategy and compliance in digital or financial services; crypto/fintech exposure is a strong plus.
• Ability to solve difficult, complex financial and tax issues in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and evolving environment, extending solution frameworks to non-finance departments.
• Be proactive, strategic, and able to direct cross-regional financial systems independently.
• Must demonstrate willingness to be hands-on, mentor teams, and promote standardized solution plans cross-functionally.
• Proficiency in English as a working language and fluency in Mandarin, in order to communicate effectively with Mandarin-speaking executive stakeholders.

 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Android Engineer - Design Systems
jobs.description:
We are looking for a talented Android Engineer to join our Design Systems team.

Wise.com and the Wise iOS and Android apps are the shop-window of Wise. With ever-growing demands to continue to expand on, scale up and build out different parts of our website and apps, it has been essential to build a dedicated design system. 

As a Design Systems team, we continuously explore, design, and author a wide range of foundations, building blocks, and tooling used by all our products and landing pages. But it’s not just about meeting the product team’s feature needs – as brand guardians, we must ensure that everything we release reinforces the trust gained from our customers over the years. To achieve that, we tend to look at problems from different angles, be it UX, scalability, efficiency, consistency, performance, widely understood accessibility, motion, design and technical documentation, and more.

Being a member of Mobile engineering, you are encouraged to influence other parts of the app, collaborate with 60+ other mobile engineers and help raise both the UX and code quality across all Wise customers. You’ll also be responsible for ensuring the solutions you build scale and fit well in order to achieve a high quality global product and collaborate often with your peers across other teams as well. Our work requires close partnerships with technical, as well as non-technical, audiences: Product Designers, Content Designers, Brand/Creative Designers, Web, iOS, and Android Engineers, Design Tooling Specialists, Vulnerable Customers, and more. 

As a Design Systems Android Engineer, you will:
• Participate in or lead other engineers through the full lifecycle of a feature, from its discovery and technical specification to authoring, testing, documenting, releasing, presenting, and eventually maintaining it.
• Help troubleshoot, fix, and support other product teams in resolving problems related to our work.
• Represent and champion Design Systems initiatives in front of both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Collaborate closely with teams across the company to deliver impactful experiences to the Design Systems’ internal and external consumers.
• Support new Wise engineers, helping them ramp up on the Design System, tooling, and best practices.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Product Data Platform
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level — from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Seattle Office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday.

As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

What you’ll do

This opportunity is on our Product Data Platform (PDP) team, which builds and operates the high-performance data, query, and search infrastructure that powers critical Brex product experiences, including AI-powered data products like our agentic reporting experience. PDP's mission is to make Brex customizable, scalable, and reliable for finance teams, and that requires deeply optimized, production-grade distributed systems.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll shape the technical direction of the platform across multiple teams. Your mandate is to identify the highest-impact architectural problems across the data products group, including the cross-cutting ones that fall between teams, and drive them to resolution. You'll be accountable for the group's technical quality, move between long-horizon strategy and hands-on execution, and lead through influence rather than authority.

Responsibilities:
• Lead technical strategy for critical PDP initiatives, balancing long-term architecture with near-term delivery across multiple teams.
• Identify and resolve systemic performance, consistency, and scalability problems, including cross-team gaps no single team can own.
• Own architecture direction for query performance: query plans, execution paths, cost models, indexing strategies, and schema and access-pattern design.
• Design and evolve distributed systems with thoughtful tradeoffs around consistency, latency, caching, cost, and failure modes.
• Raise the technical bar across the group through design reviews and architecture decisions, and dive in hands-on where it matters most, including P95/P99 latency issues in production.
• Proactively identify scaling risks and reliability gaps, and turn findings into plans the group aligns behind.
• Mentor senior engineers and grow the next generation of technical leaders within PDP.
• Contribute directly on high-stakes initiatives and critical path decisions, primarily in the JVM ecosystem (Kotlin/Java).

Requirements:
• 8+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating production systems at scale, including as a technical leader on multi-team initiatives.
• Track record of leading architecture and delivery for large-scale distributed systems in a platform or infrastructure environment.
• Deep hands-on expertise with relational databases (Postgres or Aurora strongly preferred), including query plan analysis, indexing strategies, and real-world optimization.
• Ability to drive ambiguous, cross-cutting problems to resolution without a defined charter.
• Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence stakeholders and align teams without direct authority.
• Experience mentoring senior engineers.

Bonus:
• Hands-on experience with OpenSearch / Elasticsearch or similar systems in production.
• Experience with streaming data platforms (Flink, Kafka) or semantic/analytics layers in production.
• Experience with multi-tenant or data-heavy platforms in regulated environments.
• Experience building platform foundations for AI or agentic product experiences.

Compensation:
• The expected salary range for this role is $240,000 - $300,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level — from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Vancouver Office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday.

As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

What you’ll do

This opportunity is on our Product Data Platform (PDP) team, which builds and operates the high-performance data, query, and search infrastructure that powers critical Brex product experiences, including AI-powered data products like our agentic reporting experience. PDP's mission is to make Brex customizable, scalable, and reliable for finance teams, and that requires deeply optimized, production-grade distributed systems.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll shape the technical direction of the platform across multiple teams. Your mandate is to identify the highest-impact architectural problems across the data products group, including the cross-cutting ones that fall between teams, and drive them to resolution. You'll be accountable for the group's technical quality, move between long-horizon strategy and hands-on execution, and lead through influence rather than authority.

Responsibilities:
• Lead technical strategy for critical PDP initiatives, balancing long-term architecture with near-term delivery across multiple teams.
• Identify and resolve systemic performance, consistency, and scalability problems, including cross-team gaps no single team can own.
• Own architecture direction for query performance: query plans, execution paths, cost models, indexing strategies, and schema and access-pattern design.
• Design and evolve distributed systems with thoughtful tradeoffs around consistency, latency, caching, cost, and failure modes.
• Raise the technical bar across the group through design reviews and architecture decisions, and dive in hands-on where it matters most, including P95/P99 latency issues in production.
• Proactively identify scaling risks and reliability gaps, and turn findings into plans the group aligns behind.
• Mentor senior engineers and grow the next generation of technical leaders within PDP.
• Contribute directly on high-stakes initiatives and critical path decisions, primarily in the JVM ecosystem (Kotlin/Java).

Requirements:
• 8+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating production systems at scale, including as a technical leader on multi-team initiatives.
• Track record of leading architecture and delivery for large-scale distributed systems in a platform or infrastructure environment.
• Deep hands-on expertise with relational databases (Postgres or Aurora strongly preferred), including query plan analysis, indexing strategies, and real-world optimization.
• Ability to drive ambiguous, cross-cutting problems to resolution without a defined charter.
• Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence stakeholders and align teams without direct authority.
• Experience mentoring senior engineers.

Bonus:
• Hands-on experience with OpenSearch / Elasticsearch or similar systems in production.
• Experience with streaming data platforms (Flink, Kafka) or semantic/analytics layers in production.
• Experience with multi-tenant or data-heavy platforms in regulated environments.
• Experience building platform foundations for AI or agentic product experiences.

The North America Risk team is a critical engine within Wise, focusing on our largest and most dynamic market: North America.

 

About the Team 

Our mission is to protect our customers and the business by staying ahead of financial crime. We handle billions of volume through robust risk and fraud prevention systems that operate at the speed of our customers. 

What we do

• Cross-Functional collaboration

experience:

• ML Fluency: Since we deploy models for Instant ACH and transaction monitoring, familiarity with machine learning basics: data pipelines, feature engineering, precision/recall.
• Data Lake

Experience:

Experience with OLAP databases or data lakes (like Apache Iceberg) with Kafka ingestion is an advantage.

 

What does success look like?

jobs.title: Malaysia Country Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Country Manager to lead our business in Malaysia. This is not a traditional hands-off executive role. 

Based in Kuala Lumpur, you will be responsible for Wise’s overall success in the country, enabling Malaysian customers to experience the best way to move and manage their money across borders. You will be expected to grow the business by orchestrating appropriate go-to-market strategies while also improving and expanding our product offering and customer experience. 

Reporting to the Head of Southeast Asia Expansion, you will be in a regulatory accountable role and responsible for the governance of Wise’s Malaysia subsidiaries. You will represent us with key regulatory bodies, and act as the chief spokesperson for Wise in local media and public forums. You will partner closely with global and regional product, engineering, compliance, risk, marketing and operations teams to expand our presence in the market.

What will you be doing?
• Risk, Compliance & Subsidiary Governance
• Entity Governance & Board Management: Serve as the CEO for Wise’s relevant licensed entity and as a Board Director, if needed, for Wise’s Malaysia subsidiaries. Direct and prepare local board materials, and ensure subsidiary governance standards meet both regulatory expectations and Wise’ global standards.
• Regulatory Compliance Oversight: Own risk, compliance, and governance for our Malaysia entities, partnering with global Product, Risk, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure absolute compliance with local regulations through robust product design, systemic controls, and oversight.
• Corporate Structure Strategy: Evaluate and optimise Wise’ corporate structure in Malaysia, assessing impact on both local licensed operations and the wider Wise Group.
• Regulator Relationships: Manage our key relationships with the Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM), Securities Commission and any other relevant regulatory or government bodies. Lobby these organisations for progressive regulatory changes to achieve our mission.
• Operational Resiliency: Collaborate with Risk and Compliance teams to develop, implement, and maintain robust Business Continuity Plans (BCP) to handle unexpected operational or systemic service disruptions in the local market.
• Operational Leadership: Have oversight on the day-to-day operations of Wise in Malaysia. Guide strategy and provide cross-functional leadership to colleagues supporting Malaysia operations, many of whom are based in our regional or global offices.
• Commercial Growth & Product Delivery
• Financial Partner & SLA Management: Lead commercial and operational negotiations with our partnersand the national payment network. Hold both external financial institutions and internal global service providers accountable to strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
• Licensing Strategy & Acquisition: Proactively assess expansion roadmaps and future commercial strategies to identify regulatory licensing requirements; own and lead the end-to-end strategy, preparation, and application process for any new local licenses required to unlock and scale these opportunities.
• Product Prioritisation & Execution: Collaborate closely with global product and engineering squads to prioritise and execute new product or feature launches.
• Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy: Partner with Product and Marketing leaders to devise and execute the GTM strategy to grow our customer base in Malaysia including defining target audiences, refining positioning, and optimising acquisition channels.
• Customer Experience Optimisation: Work closely with Servicing Operations leaders to ensure the end-to-end customer journey - from digital onboarding to payment speed - meets Wise's global standards and exceeds local expectations.
• Brand Advocacy & Public Relations: Act as the chief public spokesperson for Wise in Malaysia. Partner with Public Relations, Government Relations, and Marketing teams to build brand awareness by participating in media interviews, public policy forums, customer meetups, and industry events.
• Office Leadership & Culture: Play a leading role in the Malaysia office culture, talent attraction and retention along with relevant functional and People team leaders.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Risk Assessment Platform
jobs.description:

You will set product KPIs, own the roadmap, and work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Risk, Compliance, Product Compliance, and Internal Audit.

You will translate complex regulatory, operational, and technical requirements into scalable platform products while keeping governance simple and efficient for users.

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Analyst
jobs.description:
Wise Platform takes all of the world-class payments products Wise has built over the last 15 years and enables hundreds of millions of consumers and businesses to access them in the places where they already move and manage their money - with banks and online platforms.

Today, we’re already powering payments for some of the world’s top neobanks like Monzo, N26, and Nubank, alongside a growing list of leading global banks such as UniCredit, Morgan Stanley and Standard Chartered. In the online platforms space, we’re powering payments for partners across a whole range of industry verticals and use cases. Whether that’s leading marketplaces like Google, Agoda, or Upwork, workforce management tools like Deel, or investment platforms like Interactive Brokers - we’re bringing the power, simplicity, and transparency of Wise to even more people and businesses.

And, we’re just getting started! Wise Platform is one of the newest and fastest growing products at Wise. We’re a global and highly cross-functional team, spearheading Wise next phase of growth!

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Regional Analyst (Northam) to join our deal-flow analytics team in Wise Platform. You will partner with our Commercial and Delivery teams based in North America, empowering them with data and insights to drive growth. Your analysis and sales intelligence will enable us to optimise sales and delivery processes, reduce time to revenue and drive team performance. If you’re a commercially minded analyst, with a knack for bringing data life and passion for helping businesses grow, we’d love to hear from you! 

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
• You will deliver high-impact, scalable data solutions such as building and maintaining robust reporting models and data products that directly support the sales and delivery team's efficiency and effectiveness.
• You will design and implement key performance indicators (KPIs) for our commercial and delivery teams, with a laser focus on revenue as a core metric, ensuring clear measurement and understanding of team performance, alongside providing actionable recommendations to drive commercial objectives.
• You will be leveraging advanced analytics, crafting dashboards and visualisations that bring commercial performance data to life, tell a clear story, and offer diagnostic power:
• For the Sales Team: Analysing sales pipeline health, deal velocity, stage conversion rates, and win/loss reasons. You'll build reports to track individual sales representative performance against quotas, identify top performers, and pinpoint areas for improvement. This includes leveraging Salesforce's opportunity management, forecasting, and activity tracking features.
• For the Pre-Sales Team: Monitor engagement metrics (e.g., number of RFIs, technical discussions), the impact of pre-sales activities on deal progression and win rates, and the efficiency of their resource allocation. You'll create visibility into their contribution to the sales cycle and quantify their impact.
• For the Implementation/Delivery Team: Track, monitor and predict key metrics and data points across the project lifecycle. Work with the team to identify risks and opportunities to improve the speed and quality of implementations, which ultimately allows us to reduce time to revenue and successfully scale solutions with partners.
• You will collaborate with analysts in the team to enhance our forecasting capabilities. This allows us to performance manage the business, teams and partners - alongside supporting operational teams to capacity plan effectively.
• You will shape how we leverage data to sell Wise Platform, identifying key insights and crafting compelling data-driven narratives that empower commercial teams to convert prospects into partners.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Money Laundering Detection
jobs.description:
Why we think you’ll want to join us
• Meaningful team mission with huge global reach: You’ll be fighting money laundering, terrorism financing and human exploitation across Wise’s £145B+ annual cross-border volume. You’ll be working with global regulators and law enforcement across 65+ licenses and 160+ countries.
• Cutting edge tech: You’ll be developing state of the art systems to prevent and detect crime in real time, spanning machine learning, LLMs and anything else your team feels is needed to tackle the problem.
• Product led company: Wise lives and breathes empowerment. Our growth and progress is all down to autonomous product teams investing in what they believe will get us to our mission. You and the team have full authority to decide and the responsibility to get results.
• Learn from experienced product leadership: You’ll work directly with product management veterans who will invest in your growth and development. You’ll work with Surbhi and Susana, and learn from Gergő and Nilan.
• Beloved products: Imagine every time you tell someone you work at Wise being showered with compliments about how much they love the product. Our most recent Net Promoter Score was 65+, and over 70% of new customers come through “word-of-mouth”.

 

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Squad to make a meaningful dent in global financial crime.

Wise moves £145B+ annually across borders and customers love us for how easy and how cheap it is. You know who else loves moving money cheaply across borders? Criminals looking to launder proceeds of crime.

This is where you come in. Our vision is clean money without borders. We have made great progress in developing a general crime catching machine learning model, and now we need to dig deeper, and get a whole lot more specific. You’ll dive deep into criminal typologies, become an expert in how international crime takes place, and build advanced systems that catch hyper-targeted, regional, criminal behaviour.

 

About the team
• The AML Squad works across our offices in London and Tallinn. We are growing the Squad, and adding new teams to make faster progress in our fight against crime.
• The AML Squad owns all anti-money laundering, terrorism financing and human exploitation typologies and risks. This includes customer risk scoring, risk prevention, live risk detection, investigations and reporting to Financial Intelligence Units across the globe.
• You’ll be joining one of the cross-functional product teams in the squad focused on detection.
• We measure success by two metrics: AML Recall and Cost of Suspicious Activity Report (SAR).
• AML Recall measures how much of the crime we actually catch. We want this to be as high as possible, and are rapidly expanding our coverage of hyper specific crime detection in addition to our already strong general model.
• Cost of SAR measures how much it costs us to detect, investigate and report a criminal to the relevant authorities. We want this to be as low as possible, and are investing a lot in high precision automation including some cool stuff with LLMs.

 

You’ll own the challenge of
• Setting new standards of live detecting hyper specific and regional crime at scale, in a way that satisfies our regulatory obligations globally and works financially for our business.
• Working with regional compliance officers (known in the industry as the second line of defense) to deliver global controls that have a strong reputation with local regulators and law enforcement.
• Working with data scientists, product analysts, product designers, product compliance managers, operations leads and software engineers to ensure the team ship the best possible product.

 

This role will give you the opportunity to
• Choose your own path to success - you’ll have the freedom to define the vision and the responsibility for making it happen
• Be flexible in how and where you work, we understand everyone needs a little something different so we’ll do our best to make it happen
• Travel to work with our teams in London and Tallinn as well as meet various partners and organisations globally when needed
• Inspire teams with your ideas, knowledge and self-starting attitude

jobs.title: Senior Manager (Controllership)
jobs.description:
About Fam
 
Fam (previously FamPay) is India's first payments app for everyone above
11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ youngest users in India to kickstart their financial journey early in their lives. Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder's Capital, and angels including Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.
 
Role Overview
 
We are looking for a hands-on Chartered Accountant to own core controllership execution end-to-end – statutory
audits, financial reporting and the upcoming transition to Ind AS, month-end close, investor and MIS reporting,
taxation and compliance, treasury, and internal financial controls. This is an execution-heavy individual-
contributor role for someone who takes full ownership of deliverables, keeps every number backed by
documented inputs, and anticipates audit and governance issues before they surface.
 
Must-Haves
Chartered Accountant with 5–6 years of post-qualification experience in controllership, audit or financial
reporting.
Demonstrated experience handling statutory audits with Big 4 or comparable audit firms (either from within
industry or from practice at a Big 4 / mid-tier firm).
Strong Ind AS proficiency, with practical application to standalone and consolidated financials; exposure to a first-time Ind AS transition rom Indian GAAP is a strong advantage.
Hands-on experience handling investor relations and MIS reporting
Experience managing direct and indirect tax risk (RPT, MAT, transfer pricing, GST) and coordinating filings and
statutory / ROC compliance with external experts.
Strong command of Excel / Google Sheets and comfort building linked, self-updating trackers and models;
exposure to Zoho Books ERP.
Sharp eye for detail with the discipline to keep every number backed by a documented input.
Good to Haves
Experience in a start-up, high-growth or restructuring environment where controllership is built and scaled
rather than inherited
Exposure to IFC / IFCR implementation and to an RBI-regulated or otherwise regulated set-up.
Exposure to treasury / cash-flow management and to ROC / Companies Act and secretarial compliance.

Roles & Responsibilities
1. Statutory Audit & Assurance
• Independently handle statutory audits with Big 4 or comparable audit firms end-to-end – planning, preparing
 schedules and reconciliations, resolving queries, and driving timely, clean closure with no major escalations.
• Serve as the primary finance point of contact for auditors; pre-empt audit and governance matters that have a
 direct bearing on the financials and ensure the team is audit-ready at all times.
• Coordinate tax, GST and other statutory audits alongside the respective experts and consultants.
2. Financial Reporting & Ind AS Transition
• Prepare standalone and consolidated financial statements, including multi-period and multi-entity
 consolidations. The company currently reports under Indian GAAP (notified Accounting Standards).
• Lead the transition from Accounting Standards (Indian GAAP) to Ind AS – first-time adoption under Ind AS,
 GAAP-to-Ind AS difference analysis, restatement of comparatives, and assessment of the impact on financials
 and disclosures.
• Apply Ind AS to complex areas – revenue recognition, ESOP accounting, financial instruments, leases, expected
 credit loss and related-party disclosures.
• Track changes in accounting standards and assess their impact on the company's financials.
3. Month-End Close & Books
• Own a timely and accurate monthly close; support the transition of accounting in-house for real-time closure
 after each month-end.
• Prepare and review key reconciliations, accruals and provisions; ensure every projection and output has a
 documented, saved input with nothing left ad-hoc.
4. Investor Relations & MIS Reporting
• Handle investor reporting and MIS – prepare periodic investor decks, board and management MIS, and
 performance dashboards accurately and on schedule.
• Respond to ad-hoc investor, board and regulatory (e.g. RBI / CoC) requirements – consolidated and standalone
 financials, projections and write-ups – within tight turnaround times.
5. Taxation & Statutory Compliance
• Manage direct and indirect tax risk end-to-end – related-party transaction (RPT) amendments, MAT exposure,
 transfer-pricing documentation and GST structuring – owning the underlying analysis and outcomes while
 working with external experts on execution.
• Oversee timely, accurate direct and indirect tax filings (income tax, TDS, GST) and coordinate tax and GST audits
 and assessments.
• Coordinate statutory, ROC / Companies Act and secretarial compliances with the company secretary and
 consultants; track related-party and regulatory documentation requirements.
6. Treasury & Cash Flow
• Support treasury and cash-flow management – fund-flow planning, working-capital tracking and banking
 relationships – and maintain accurate visibility of escrow and restricted balances.
7. Internal Controls, Policy & Process
• Support the design, roll-out and testing of Internal Financial Controls (IFC / IFCR) and build a structured, audit-
 ready control environment.
• Establish and maintain the accounting policy framework, SOPs and delegation-of-authority matrix; keep robust
 documentation and process notes to strengthen governance and reduce audit and litigation risk.
• Drive ERP / accounting-system improvements and automation with appropriate system controls to enable
 faster, more reliable reporting.
8. Planning & Budgeting
• Maintain a working knowledge of the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and budgeting cycle; partner with cross
 functional teams on projections and budget-versus-actual variance analysis, with well-documented
 assumptions.
Why Join Us
Work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with high ownership and responsibility.
Competitive compensation and accelerated career growth for ambitious finance talent.

jobs.location: Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR; Singapore, Singapore
jobs.description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

We are seeking a Director of AI Enablement — a hands-on builder who turns AI strategy into shipped reality across business units. This is not a strategy-only or purely advisory role. We need someone who rolls up their sleeves: mapping how teams actually work today, spotting where AI can remove friction or unlock value, and then building — or driving the build of — the solution alongside the team that will use it.

The ideal candidate sits between execution and delivery: technical enough to prototype a working solution themselves, and operationally sharp enough to partner with engineering when a problem needs real infrastructure. Not a theorist, not a pure PM — someone who ships.

What You’ll Be Doing
1. AI Transformation Execution

Own execution of AI adoption projects end-to-end, business unit by business unit:
• Embed with business teams (e.g. Compliance, Legal, CS) to understand existing workflows in detail and identify concrete gaps and pain points.
• Translate identified gaps into practical AI-driven solution ideas — not abstract recommendations, but scoped proposals with a clear path to delivery.
• Work directly alongside business teams to implement solutions (AI products, copilots, automated workflows, internal tools) and drive adoption post-launch.
• Track and report on impact — efficiency gains, time saved, quality improvements — to justify continued investment and prioritize the next use case.
• Build reusable playbooks and templates from each transformation project so lessons scale across other business units.
2. System Building Technical Execution

Operate as the technical bridge between business needs and delivery, choosing the right execution path for each problem:
• For larger, cross-functional initiatives: act as an AI PM — deeply understand business requirements, map them against existing company tech infrastructure, and partner with the relevant engineering/R D teams to scope, prioritize, and drive delivery.
• For smaller, high-velocity needs: personally build quick-win solutions (vibe-coding internal tools, lightweight automations, prompt-based workflows) and hand them directly to business teams for immediate use.
• Maintain working knowledge of the company's AI tooling and infrastructure (internal copilots, MCP servers, knowledge base systems, agent frameworks) to know what can be reused vs. what needs to be built new.
• Continuously evaluate emerging AI tools and techniques for applicability to internal use cases, and pilot them quickly and cheaply before recommending broader investment.
3. Organizational AI Enablement Adoption

Support the broader AI enablement agenda at the ground level:
• Help run AI literacy and enablement activities for non-technical business units, translating capability into concrete, adoptable use cases.
• Contribute to and maintain internal AI playbooks, prompt libraries, and tooling documentation.
• Act as a first point of contact for business units with an AI use-case idea — helping them scope it, prioritize it, and find the fastest path to a working solution.
• Share learnings and reusable components back into the broader AI enablement function to avoid duplicated effort across teams.

What We Look For In You
• 4+ years of experience in a role combining project execution, product management, or technical delivery, with meaningful hands-on exposure to AI/LLM-based tools or products.
• Demonstrated ability to independently build and ship practical AI-powered solutions (e.g. internal copilots, automation scripts, prompt-driven tools) — comfortable "vibe coding" a working prototype without waiting on a full engineering team.
• Strong stakeholder management skills — able to sit with a non-technical business team, extract real requirements, and translate them into a scoped, deliverable solution.
• Working understanding of the modern AI stack: LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, and agentic/automation frameworks — enough to have informed conversations with engineering, not necessarily to architect systems from scratch.
• Comfortable operating with ambiguity and switching between "hands-on builder" and "AI PM working with R D" depending on the size and complexity of the initiative.
• Bachelor's degree in a related field (Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or equivalent practical experience).

 

Nice-To-Haves
• Experience in fintech, crypto/blockchain, or another regulated industry.
• Prior experience working cross-functionally with Compliance, Legal, GBS, or similar non-P E functions.
• Familiarity with internal enterprise tooling ecosystems (Lark/Feishu, MCP-based integrations, internal data platforms).
• Experience running or contributing to an internal AI Center of Excellence, enablement program, or similar cross-team initiative.

About the Opportunity

Lifecycle marketing at OKX is evolving. We're not looking for someone to run campaigns — we're looking for someone to fundamentally rethink how we engage traders across the US market on one of the world's leading crypto platforms.

 

This is a leadership role for a marketer who thinks in systems, not sends. Someone who is comfortable defining a US-market engagement strategy as well as getting into the work to make it happen. Reporting to the Global Head of Lifecycle Marketing, you'll help define the vision, strategy, and output of lifecycle marketing for the US. Your execution layer is AI agents, cross-functional partners, and co-operating with the broader Lifecycle marketing team. That means your ability to train, direct, brief and critique is as important as your ability to set direction.

 

If your default mode is execution and program management or pure strategy and handoff, this isn't the role for you. If your default mode is leading from the front, and you have the craft and judgment to shape the work through strategic problem-solving, AI-native thinking, and a relentless focus on what quality looks like to actually move users — read on.

 

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Lifecycle Strategy Vision Define how OKX engages US users from acquisition through activation, retention, and reactivation — across segments and products. You'll set the strategic framework for the US market, working in close alignment with the Global Head of Lifecycle to ensure regional strategy ladders into global priorities. This means deeply understanding US crypto user behavior, identifying the highest-leverage moments in the lifecycle, and building programs that compound over time.
• AI-Native Ways of Working You will lead by example in embedding AI into every layer of lifecycle marketing — from ideation and content development to segmentation, testing, and analysis. Critically, this includes building and training agentic AI workflows: multi-step, autonomous systems that execute lifecycle programs at scale. You'll know the outcomes of poorly trained agents. You won't just adopt AI tools; you'll help determine which ones we build, which we leverage for each task, and how we use them to raise the ceiling on what a lean, high-performing team can deliver.
• Insight-Led Decision Making You'll be the person in the room who can translate user behavior data into a point of view — and then into a program. You'll develop a deep understanding of our user segments, their motivations, and the signals that predict engagement, conversion, and churn. Reporting and dashboards are a starting point, not the destination.
• Cross-Functional Leadership Lifecycle doesn't work in isolation. You'll build genuine partnerships with Product, PMM, Data, BI, Design, Legal, and regional teams — not just as a stakeholder manager, but as a strategic voice in how OKX grows. You'll influence roadmaps, shape go-to-market planning, and ensure lifecycle has a seat at the table early.

 

What We Look For In You
• Strategic instinct. You've led lifecycle programs that were defined by a clear strategic thesis. You can articulate why a program is designed the way it is, what user problem it solves, and how it ladders to business outcomes.
• Demonstrated AI fluency. You actively use AI in your day-to-day work, including agentic tools and autonomous workflows. You've built or directed the development of AI-powered systems/processes and can speak specifically to how you've trained agents, trained co-workers to use them, where you've course-corrected poor outputs, and where AI genuinely creates leverage versus where it doesn't. Using AI chat tools is a baseline, not a differentiator.
• A user behavior obsession. You think about users before you think about channels. You can read engagement data and form a hypothesis. You know the difference between a segment and a persona, and you know how to use both.
• Ability to execute with speed and excellence: You can look at a lifecycle program, a campaign brief, a piece of copy, or a targeting strategy and know immediately what's working and what isn't — and articulate why. • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward action. OKX moves fast. The crypto landscape moves faster. You'll be expected to make smart decisions with incomplete information, move quickly, and refine as you go — not wait for perfect conditions.
• Demonstrated leadership through strategic change. You can point to specific moments where you reoriented a team or program mid-flight, held quality standards under pressure, and came out with momentum intact.
• Global perspective, local instinct. You've worked across multiple markets and understand that a single lifecycle strategy rarely fits all. You know how to build frameworks that scale globally while giving regional teams the flexibility to be relevant locally.

• Meaningful AI adoption in your own workflows — you should be able to speak specifically to how you use it and what it's changed

• • 
Database Architecture Design Optimization
• Design, deploy, and optimize cloud databases on Alibaba Cloud (RDS, PolarDB, Redis, MongoDB) and AWS (RDS, Aurora, ElastiCache, DynamoDB).

• Automation Cost Management
• Automate database deployment and operations using Terraform, Ansible, or cloud-native tools (Alibaba Cloud ROS, AWS CloudFormation).
• Optimize cloud costs via auto-scaling, reserved instances, and storage tiering (e.g., AWS S3 Glacier).

jobs.title: Frontend Business Lead
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

 

About the Role

We're looking for a technical lead who can own the frontend across OKX's core crypto business verticals. You'll be deeply involved in the full frontend delivery lifecycle across Trading, Web3, Payment, and beyond — not just writing code, but helping teams and products find the right direction, make the right calls, and execute with speed and precision.

This role demands the rigor of an engineer, the strategic thinking of a product manager, and the market instincts of a crypto practitioner. You don't need to carry a full-stack title, but you must genuinely understand frontend, have enough backend fluency to hold your own in architecture discussions, and — above all — understand the business.

 

Core Responsibilities

Business Team Leadership Own the overall frontend team across core business verticals including Trading and Payment, covering hiring, development, and pipeline building. Partner effectively with Product, Backend, Security, and Compliance — driving cross-functional outcomes through technical judgment, not just execution.

 

Product Delivery Technical Execution Lead technical design and delivery for core business features including trading system frontend experience, wallet and asset management, AI-powered trading products, payment gateway integrations, and KYC/AML frontend implementation. Stay deeply sensitive to business metrics and user experience, making sound trade-offs between speed and quality.

Product Engineering Thinking in the AI Era Demonstrate deep understanding of how AI is reshaping product paradigms — changing user expectations, product form factors, and R D efficiency. Integrate AI into product decisions and design, not merely as a productivity tool.

Technical Judgment Standard-Setting Drive tech stack alignment and evolution. Proactively identify and address technical risk. Establish high engineering quality standards in complex crypto security contexts — private key security, frontend attack prevention, compliance auditing, and more.

 

Cross-Team Influence Build dual technical and business influence at the company level. Communicate technical value and business judgment clearly to engineers, product managers, and senior leadership alike. Participate in industry engagements to attract high-potential talent who are genuinely passionate about crypto.

 

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree or above in CS or related field; 10+ years of engineering experience including 5+ years managing technical teams; solid full-stack capabilities with frontend depth
• Deep command of core frontend technologies (React/Vue internals, engineering toolchains, performance optimization, cross-platform solutions), with enough backend and API fluency to drive substantive technical discussions
• Proven track record leading frontend for products with DAU 1M+ in high-concurrency, high-availability environments
• Demonstrated experience driving cross-team collaboration and standard adoption through technical influence rather than organizational authority

Industry Background (Partial Core)
• (Core) Genuine understanding of and enthusiasm for crypto — familiar with CEX/DEX trading mechanics, Web3 wallet and signing mechanisms, and mainstream payment gateway ecosystems
• Experience owning frontend delivery for trading, fintech, payments, or crypto products; comfortable navigating the tensions between compliance, security, and user experience
• Familiarity with the Web3 frontend ecosystem (ethers.js / wagmi / viem, WalletConnect, EVM contract interactions, etc.)
• Global product experience — understands the complexity of multi-language, multi-currency, multi-jurisdiction compliance requirements

Engineering Competencies for the AI Era (Core)
• Deep understanding of how AI is reshaping product design; can integrate AI into product decisions rather than treating it purely as a development accelerator
• Strong ability to model and frame complex problems; defines the right problem boundaries and system abstractions before reaching for solutions
• Proven ability to constrain, guide, and evaluate AI outputs — decomposing complex engineering requirements into AI-executable task sequences
• Experience establishing team-level AI working patterns; familiar with and having practiced AI Spec-Driven Development
• Maintains high standards for code quality and system design integrity alongside — not despite — AI-assisted development

Soft Skills (Core)
• Strong ownership: treats team goals as personal goals — proactive, accountable, clears obstacles without being asked
• Sound judgment: makes high-quality decisions under incomplete information — decisive and accountable
• Execution muscle: makes things actually land, not just live in decks and proposals
• Fast learner: thrives in a fast-moving industry; rapidly absorbs new technologies, business dynamics, and regulatory shifts and converts them into team action
• Bilingual: fluent English for technical discussions, documentation, and international collaboration (written and verbal at working proficiency)

About the Role

As part of the Institutional Relationship Management team, you will serve as the primary point of contact for our institutional partners. Your mission is to cultivate long-term relationships, drive revenue growth through proactive sales and strategic engagement, and ensure a seamless operational experience for institutional clients.

This role sits at the intersection of institutional sales, client relationship management, and product collaboration, acting as a bridge between client needs and internal product capabilities. Performance will be evaluated through a balanced KPI framework focused on growth, new business development, and client service excellence to support sustainable revenue generation and operational quality.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

Business Development Growth
• Identify and qualify new institutional leads, managing the full sales cycle from initial outreach through to closing and post-sales client success.
• Coordinate the end-to-end onboarding process for institutional clients, including verification and account activation.
• Monitor client activity and trading patterns to identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.
• Develop strategic initiatives to expand institutional client relationships and drive trading activity.

Product Relationship Management
• Serve as the dedicated relationship lead for assigned institutional accounts, resolving day-to-day inquiries and operational issues within defined SLAs.
• Proactively educate clients on new product launches, platform features, and market developments to support optimal platform usage.
• Analyze client feedback and operational challenges, identifying meaningful signals that can drive product improvements and commercial outcomes.
• Develop deep expertise in OKX’s product suite, trading infrastructure, and risk framework to provide informed guidance to institutional clients.
• Manage dedicated client communication channels (Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, WeChat) and coordinate with internal teams including Product, API, Legal, and Compliance to deliver solutions and improvements.
• Advocate internally for initiatives that enhance client experience, increase trading activity, and support long-term client retention.

Compliance Governance
• Ensure all client engagements strictly adhere to company policies, Terms of Service, and local regulatory requirements.
• Support due diligence processes including DDQs, partnership agreements, and audit requests in collaboration with Legal and Compliance teams.
• Maintain high standards of documentation, operational transparency, and regulatory alignment.

 

What We Look For In You

Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in institutional sales, relationship management, or business development within crypto, fintech, or financial markets.
• Strong understanding of digital asset trading products, institutional client workflows, and exchange infrastructure.
• Proven experience managing institutional or high-value client relationships.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify commercial opportunities from client insights.
• Ability to work cross-functionally with product, engineering, compliance, and legal teams in a fast-paced environment.
• Experience working with institutional crypto clients such as funds, market makers, trading firms, or fintech platforms.

Nice to Have
• Familiarity with APIs, trading infrastructure, and liquidity solutions.
• Background in regulated financial markets or digital asset platforms.

• Own the global bank relationship book as a portfolio.

• Build the cultural bridge between bank and exchange.

• Drive strategic banking workstreams.

• Coverage / Financial Institutions Group / Senior Relationship Management — Sector strategy, account planning, executive escalation. The senior-banker register.
• Prime Brokerage / Securities Services / Triparty Custody — Financing, securities lending, security interest, triparty mechanics.

• How to establish long-term trust with G-SIBs as a crypto exchange counterparty;
• Bank KYC and onboarding committee decision-making;
• Counterparty credit treatment of a crypto exchange;
• Triparty custody mechanics and security-interest structures;
• Settlement, reconciliation, and intraday flow differences between bank and crypto ops;
• Media hit handling and reputational risk;
• Sanctions screening and AML interface between bank and exchange.
• Meaningful experience in building credibility and fluency across Crypto and TradFi spaces.

As the Product Manager, you will be responsible to discover new markets and revenue opportunities and innovate new products to address the market needs. Act as an internal champion to build consensus and influence senior management for new product ideas. Identify, define, implement and instrument market research, product design, product implementation and product release processes.

Define, build and scale OKX's payment systems that powers money movement globally to help our customers gain access to a wide array of crypto assets. The scope of this role includes defining managing product roadmaps, features including user experience and end to end integration with local international payment providers while proactively managing the risk associated with your product. Tracking KPIs and driving growth of your product features is at the core of PM’s at OKX, while collaborating with multiple key stakeholders like designers, engineering, legal, risk, compliance, marketing, customer support finance across the organization and get them aligned on your product roadmap and deliverables.

• Be the owner of your payment products (ACH, Cards, Wire, SEPA, FAST, PIX, etc), you truly own it!
• Define drive every aspect of your product from developing the roadmap/backlogs/iterations in order to hit your goals KPIs

About The Opportunity

Event Contracts are one of the fastest-growing financial innovation categories globally over the past two years, showing significant potential across crypto, politics, sports, and macro events. We are building our own Event Contract product line from the ground up. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who understands both financial products design, trading systems and market microstructure to take the business line to the next growth phase.

What You’ll Be Doing 

Own the full lifecycle of this business line — from mechanism design and liquidity build-out to user growth and experience optimization — driving the end-to-end planning and execution of the Event Contract product line.
• Product Mechanism Design: Own the overall design of Event Contract products, including but not limited to product specs for Up-Down, Between (range), and Hit; strike price generation logic; settlement mechanism design; and the specs of contracts on crypto, equities, and other underlyings.
• Market Depth Liquidity Framework: Design and drive the Market Maker incentive and obligation framework (spread, depth, uptime, and other obligation metrics); continuously monitor order book quality (spread / depth / uptime) to keep the product competitive on key liquidity metrics.
• Business Growth: Own user experience, user growth, and business scaling for this category — including defining and executing user growth campaigns, acquisition/retention/activation strategies, and coordinating channel and operations resources; accountable for core business metrics such as trading volume and user count.
• Competitive Research, Data-Driven Decisions Cross-Team Collaboration: Continuously track the product mechanisms, fee structures, volume composition, and growth strategies of leading domestic and international competitors, translating industry best practices into product iteration plans for our platform; conduct in-depth analysis of internal trading data to produce actionable product and growth recommendations; work closely with Trading Engine, Frontend, Risk/Settlement, Liquidity/Market Making, and Operations teams to drive execution and iteration.
• New Business Exploration: Explore opportunities to combine event contracts with other product formats (e.g., structured products, social/community mechanics, copy trading, broker distribution partnerships) to open up new growth curves for the platform.

What We Look For In You
• Experience building complex backend systems from 0 to 1 (e.g. trading systems, ad systems, e-commerce systems, or payment systems). Candidates with internet product growth experience, having led acquisition/retention/activation campaigns and owned business outcomes and metrics, have a strong advantage.
• Exceptional learning ability, logical reasoning, and quantitative skills. Strong ability to abstract and translate real-world business scenarios into elegant data structures and business logic.
• Deep understanding of financial derivatives principles, and experience owning the 0-to-1 design or large-scale overhaul of futures/options trading systems is preferred. Alternatively, strong learning ability and transferable methodology from building similar complex systems are welcome.
• Strong drive and leadership. Excellent data analytical skills.
• Strong insight and judgment, and able to identify hot topics and market opportunities amid constant change. Sustained interest in and understanding of event contracts underlying such as crypto, macro events, sports, and politics.
• Ability to systematically produce AI tools to improve personal work output and efficiency (AI leverage) — e.g. using AI to support data analysis, documentation, and code/query writing in day-to-day work.
• Experience investing or trading in equities, FX, crypto spot/derivatives, or quantitative trading is preferred.

Nice-To-Haves
• Experience in options product design or trading, or hands-on trading/research/industry experience with similar event contracts platforms is a plus.
• Experience designing Market Maker strategies or liquidity incentive mechanisms is a plus.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

About The Opportunity

We are looking for Senior Product Managers to drive institutional client growth, manage market maker and VIP programs, and deliver credit and lending products for OKX's institutional client base — including hedge funds, trading firms, asset managers, and financial institutions. 
Depending on background, the role may focus on: (a) Institutional client management — VIP programs, market maker programs, and fund/asset manager operations; (b) Institutional credit products — VIP Loan, Credit Line, Post-Trade Settlement; or (c) Growth strategy and cross-team initiatives — Driving quarterly growth plans in partnership with Core Trading, Retail, and Earn teams.

This is a strategic and hands-on role where you'll collaborate closely with engineering, risk, compliance, sales/BD, and relationship management teams to deliver secure, scalable, and client-centric solutions that power OKX's institutional offerings.

What You’ll Be Doing 

Product Strategy and Delivery
• Understand the institutional market landscape by analysing client needs, competitor offerings, and market trends. Identify differentiation opportunities in partnership with Sales/BD and Relationship Management teams.
• Design and optimize VIP fee tier programs, market maker incentive structures, and institutional client retention strategies. Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle for assigned product lines (e.g. VIP Loan, Credit Line, Delayed Settlement, MM programs, or fund management tools).
• Gather and prioritise product and client requirements using data-driven analysis. Manage the institutional client lifecycle: onboarding, activation, engagement, upsell, and retention — Translating client pain points into roadmap priorities with clear business impact.
• Work closely with engineering, risk, and product teams to drive both technical and financial product requirements. Build and maintain products with end-to-end risk management and operational workflows.
• Develop financial and non-financial metrics and KPIs to track progress and alignment to firm’s overall strategy and goals. Solicit both internal and external client feedback, understand the various challenges and opportunities and re-prioritise the roadmap iteratively to optimise results. Manage technical backlogs and prioritise new features vs technical debt to eliminate workflow friction.

Client Engagement and Growth
• Develop strategic partnerships and maintain relationships with key institutional clients. Coordinate with RM/BD teams on client onboarding, tier management, and retention strategies.
• Drive quarterly growth strategies in collaboration with Core Trading, Retail Growth, and Earn teams, including cross-sell initiatives, incentive program design, and institutional product bundling.
• Build business cases for product and partnership investments with clear ROI frameworks. Quantify the revenue and AUM impact of product features to drive prioritisation decisions. Own the commercial logic of assigned institutional product lines.

What We Look For In You
• Proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product launch throughout its lifecycle. Adept at translating product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes. Experience with institutional credit products (margin lending, secured financing, delayed settlement, or credit line structures) is preferred.
• Proven experience engaging directly with institutional clients — Conducting business reviews, gathering requirements on-site, and translating client pain points into product roadmap priorities. Experience working with sales/BD/relationship management teams in a B2B institutional environment.
• Ability to think logically, work in a team and communicate effectively. Strong written and verbal skills for producing high quality documents, plans, roadmaps and presentations with impact. Comfortable working across time zones and cultural contexts.
• Understanding of institutional crypto market dynamics — Fee structures, market making, prime brokerage models, and custody solutions.
• Deep understanding of crypto exchange products (spot, margin, futures, perpetual swaps, options) and institutional trading workflows. TradFi experience in FX, Equities, or Fixed Income covering trading and middle/back office is a strong plus.
• Hands-on experience leveraging AI/LLM tools for product operations, e.g. building automated workflows, using AI for data analysis, or prototyping AI-powered features. We value PMs who actively use AI to multiply their output and embed it into business processes.
• A Bachelor's degree in business, technology, finance or related discipline.

Nice-To-Haves
• Experience building a zero-to-one product is a strong plus.
 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

Please note that Hong Kong is a group-level service hub, and OKX does not carry on a business of operating a virtual asset trading platform in Hong Kong.
