jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer - Rules Platform
jobs.description:
We're looking for an experienced Senior Backend Engineer to join our Rules Platform Team.

This team is responsible for Wise's critical rules engine, which includes the tool used to manage our risk assessment rules.

As a senior member of this team, you will be a key technical voice. You will lead and contribute to impactful, cross-functional engineering initiatives, drive critical system architecture and technical design decisions, and ensure high service standards by monitoring and optimizing the system performance. You will also actively participate in strategic planning, shaping the product roadmap and defining the future evolution of the platform.

What will you be working on?

You will join the team at an exciting time of growth, as we scale our core risk assessment capabilities. The core challenge is to evolve our rules engine and internal libraries to support growing demand and complexity from teams across Wise.

Your immediate impact will be to:
• Drive Complex Initiatives: Lead the design and implementation of complex backend initiatives that form the foundation of our risk platform.
• Own Core Components: Take ownership of maintaining and evolving the internal libraries and shared components consumed by multiple teams, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and well-documented.
• Design for Scale: Contribute directly to the architectural design and scaling of our risk assessment services, ensuring they meet high standards for performance, reliability, and data consistency.
• Collaborate for Impact: Work as a key technical partner with multiple stakeholders—including Product, FinCrime, and other engineering teams—to deliver robust, cross-functional solutions.

You'll work in a collaborative environment where you can influence key technical decisions, mentor other engineers, and help define how we scale our platform. It's a strong opportunity to grow into greater technical leadership and work on complex, meaningful problems at scale.

jobs.title: Security IT Support Engineer
jobs.description:
At Crypto.com, our dedication to user security is led by our highly experienced Security Team. Comprising an international roster of seasoned cybersecurity experts, our team leads the company's Security, Privacy, and Security Compliance endeavors. 

The team includes holders of international patents for technologies integrated in our security architecture. Under the stewardship of a distinguished CISO recognized by the Forbes Technology Council and among the Global Top 100 CISOs, our team has consistently championed industry standards, acquiring certifications like ISO27001, ISO27701, ISO22301, PCI:DSS 3.2.1 (Level 1), NIST Tier 4, and SOC 2 Type II, in addition to the MPI License from Singapore MAS. Our Chief Information Security Officer reports directly to the CEO, underscoring the prioritization of security in our organization's hierarchy. 

Our Security Team not only places great emphasis on credentials and expertise but also deeply values hands-on experience, rapid cognition, and dynamic learning. The challenges in the world of crypto are ever-evolving, and as such, our team prides itself on quick adaptability and robust teamwork, ensuring that we stay ahead of potential threats and always safeguard our user base.

We're looking for someone who knows IT support inside out and takes security seriously. You'll keep the environment running day to day — endpoints, access, patching, support — while also owning vulnerability management across our devices, servers, and virtual desktops.
AI is part of how we work now. That means you'll also help us make sure the AI tools our teams are adopting are being used safely. You don't need to be a researcher. You just need to understand the risks and be willing to engage with them.

What We Offer
A role where security and IT are genuinely treated as the same thing — not separate teams with separate priorities. You'll work directly with a senior team that's been doing this at scale for years, and you'll have real ownership from day one.
The AI side of this role is still being shaped. If you're someone who wants to help define how that works rather than follow someone else's playbook, this is a good place to be.
 
#LI-CY2

Life @ Crypto.com
 
Empowered to think big. Try new opportunities while working with a talented, ambitious and supportive team.
Transformational and proactive working environment. Elevate employees to find thoughtful and innovative solutions.
Growth from within. We help to develop new skill-sets that would impact the shaping of your personal and professional growth.
Work Culture. Our colleagues are some of the best in the industry; we are all here to help and support one another.
One cohesive team. Engage stakeholders to achieve our ultimate goal - Cryptocurrency in every wallet. 
 
 
Are you ready to kickstart your future with us? 
 
Benefits
 
Competitive salary 
Medical insurance package with extended coverage to dependents 
Attractive annual leave entitlement including: birthday, work anniversary
Work Flexibility Adoption. Flexi-work hour and hybrid or remote set-up
Aspire career alternatives through us. Our internal mobility program can offer employees a diverse scope. 
Work Perks: crypto.com visa card provided upon joining 
 
Our Crypto.com benefits packages vary depending on region requirements, you can learn more from our talent acquisition team.
 
About Crypto.com:
 
Founded in 2016, Crypto.com serves more than 80 million customers and is the world's fastest growing global cryptocurrency platform. Our vision is simple: Cryptocurrency in Every Wallet™. jobs.description:
About Fam
Fam (previously FamPay) is India's first payments app for everyone above
11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ youngest users in India to kickstart their financial journey early in their lives. Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder's Capital, and angels including Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.
Role Overview
We're looking for a Head of Business Development to build and scale Fam's partnerships and alliances engine. This is a 1→10 role — you'll define the strategy, close high-impact partnerships, and turn them into meaningful growth, engagement, and revenue. This role sits at the intersection of growth, product, and brand, and demands someone who can walk into a room with a CMO or CEO and own the conversation. You'll own both the revenue partnerships charter and the user acquisition engine, working directly alongside founders and leadership to make Fam the definitive financial platform for India's next generation.
Must-Haves
15+ years in business development, ad sales, partnerships, or strategic alliances
Strong, proven network across large media and brands agencies 
Deep understanding of digital advertising and ad monetisation- ability to package and sell Fam's platform traffic, clicks, and impressions as a high-value media asset to brands and agencies
Track record of building and scaling revenue-generating partnerships with large advertisers 
Exceptional storytelling and strategic thinking — able to lead CXO-level conversations with authority
Raw intelligence and sharp product and business instincts — comfortable operating alongside founders and C-suite
Data-driven approach to evaluating and structuring deals
Strong negotiation skills and high ownership mindset
Builder mentality — thrives in ambiguity and moves fast
Strong network across consumer platforms and brands
Good to Haves
Prior experience in working in a consumer internet, product-led companies
Familiarity with creator ecosystems or youth-first brands
AI-native mindset
Roles & Responsibilities
1. Revenue Partnerships
Own and drive the revenue partnerships charter — co-branded campaigns, affiliate deals, and advertiser relationships
Build direct relationships with large brand marketing teams and agency partners
Sell Fam's platform (impressions, engagement, reach among India's youngest consumers) as a media and distribution vehicle
Structure sustainable, high-value commercial deals that compound over time
2. Brand & Lifestyle Alliances
Position Fam as a lifestyle brand deeply resonant with younger audiences
Drive partnerships with fashion, music, content, and youth-first brands
Conceptualize and execute high-impact co-branded campaigns
3. Merchant & Payments Ecosystem
Expand Fam's presence across teen-friendly online and offline merchants
Drive partnerships with QSR chains, e-commerce platforms, OTT, and gaming brands
Increase transaction frequency and stickiness through relevant merchant coverage

Build alliances with schools, colleges, coaching institutes, and youth communities
Drive trust-led onboarding at scale
5. User Acquisition via Partnerships
Build partnerships that unlock high-quality user acquisition at scale
Identify and onboard partners across gaming, edtech, creator ecosystems, and youth platforms
Create scalable distribution funnels via integrations and co-branded experiences
What Success Looks Like
Revenue is the scoreboard — own it, grow it, and be accountable to it from day one
Significant share of new user acquisition driven via partner channels
Reduction in CAC through scalable alliances
Growth in monthly transactions per user
Strong brand recall among younger audiences
Why Join Us
Rare opportunity to build a category-defining brand for the next generation in India
Work directly with founders and leadership — high visibility, high impact
Own a critical growth and revenue lever from day one
Access to the best AI tools and an AI-native work culture — we move faster because we build smarter
Fast-paced, high-ownership culture where builders thrive

jobs.title: AI Data Scientist
jobs.description:
About us:
Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.
The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals.
Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.
As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies.

About

the role:

We're looking for a data-driven, curious, and collaborative Data Scientist to support product and business decision-making through analytics, experimentation, and applied data science. In this role, you will be responsible for defining new metrics, validating data to generate insights, and owning the end-to-end lifecycle of our data infrastructure—from creating and maintaining Tableau dashboards to building and adapting data fields and tables. Furthermore, as AI capabilities reshape how data teams operate, you'll play an active role in designing and deploying AI-powered agentic workflows to automate these analysis, maintenance, and modeling tasks at scale.
Key Responsibilities
- Design and deploy AI agent workflows to automate recurring analytical tasks, data summarization, and insight generation pipelines.
- Evaluate and integrate LLM-based tools into the data team's workflow, assessing their reliability, accuracy, and fitness for analytical use cases.
- Collaborate with product and business teams to define analytical questions, success metrics, and KPIs.
- Build and maintain analytics foundation using SQL and dbt, enabling reliable reporting and self-serve analytics.
Design, build, and perform weekly maintenance of Tableau dashboards to bring metrics to life, ensuring data accuracy and platform stability for day-to-day decision-making.
- Perform A/B testing and experimentation, including experiment design, statistical inference, significance testing, and result interpretation.
- Perform ad-hoc, exploratory, and statistical analyses to uncover insights and validate hypotheses.
- Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating data into actionable recommendations.
- Partner with stakeholders to design, develop, and iterate on key metrics, interactive dashboards, and data analyses to support evolving business needs.
Qualifications

Join us as a KYC/KYB Analyst to protect Qonto's regulated growth while keeping onboarding fast and fair for our clients. You'll review enhanced due diligence and KYBC cases, decide who can safely open or keep a Qonto account, and flag financial-crime risks the moment you spot them, working closely with our Lead EDD. 
➡️ What you'll do
Decide on high-risk files: Review EDD cases for onboarding and lifecycle reviews, then approve, reject, or send them back to L1 for missing or invalid documents.
Handle KYBC edge cases fast: Assess alternative documents and gray-activity requests, closing decisions within a 48-hour SLA when clients are blocked.
Focus where it matters: Automation handles the routine files, so you'll concentrate your judgment on the riskiest ones during your weekly control checks.
Cross-check the numbers: Compare declared turnover and financial documentation against real account activity to spot inconsistencies.

Fluent in French and English, including legal reading: You read bylaws, RCS extracts, and legal documentation as comfortably as any other business document, in French, and work just as easily in English.
Risk judgment under ambiguity: You reason through gray-area cases instead of defaulting to blanket rejection or blanket approval.
AFC/KYC/KYB fundamentals: You're curious about AFC/KYC/KYB topics and ready to learn on the job.
Attention to detail: You catch missing documents, invalid evidence, and inconsistencies that others might miss.
AI-native mindset: You're comfortable letting AI handle routine cases so you can focus on the ones that need real judgment.

Real autonomy, fast: Reach independent decision-making on routine files within a few months, with complex cases escalated together.
A growing scope: As Qonto's credit products expand, you'll take on larger companies and more complex corporate structures over time.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
This role is open for LATAM based candidates
 
About us:
 
Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.
The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals.
 
Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.
 
As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies. 
 
About the Role
 
We're looking for an Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, and maintain our cloud infrastructure and platform systems. You'll work closely with development teams to create scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure that powers our products.
 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Designs, implements, and manages AWS cloud infrastructure, including VPCs, EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, Lambda, and other foundational services.
Develops and maintains Terraform modules to provision and manage infrastructure in a repeatable, version-controlled manner.
Deploys, manages, and optimizes Kubernetes clusters (EKS), handling workload orchestration, autoscaling, and resource management.
Builds and improves continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to enable fast, safe, and automated releases.
Implements logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions to ensure system health and enable rapid incident response.
Applies strict infrastructure security best practices, manages secrets, and ensures compliance with internal security policies.
Writes scripts and tools to automate operational tasks, reducing manual toil and improving the overall developer experience.
Creates and maintains runbooks, architecture diagrams, and technical documentation.
Partners with development teams to improve platform reliability and streamline application deployments.
Participates in an on-call rotation schedule to respond to production incidents and ensure continuous system reliability.
Designs and provisions cloud infrastructure specifically tailored to support scalable AI/LLM workloads and agentic systems, ensuring optimized compute resource allocation and high availability.
Evaluates and integrates AI-driven DevOps tools and LLM-assisted automations into the platform workflow to accelerate incident response, infrastructure provisioning, and operational troubleshooting.
 
Qualifications
Location: This role is fully remote and open exclusively to candidates based in LATAM.

Experience:

4+ years of proven experience in infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering.
Strong proficiency with AWS services and modern cloud architecture patterns.
Hands-on experience utilizing Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Solid understanding of Kubernetes concepts (deployments, services, ingress, RBAC, Helm charts) and containerization utilizing Docker.
Proficiency in TypeScript and Bash scripting.
Familiarity with standard CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD).

We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.
Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.
AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Join us as a Credit Fraud Analyst to help protect Qonto's credit products as we become a bank. You'll own the operational efficiency of our credit fraud processes end-to-end, reporting to Thibault, Head of Fraud.
➡️ What you'll do
Own credit fraud operations end-to-end: You'll supervise the day-to-day efficiency of our credit fraud processes.
Sharpen our AI fraud detection: You'll partner with Tech to continuously improve the AI tool we use to catch credit fraud and defaults.
Rework eligibility, not just enforce it: You'll analyze credit defaults and declined financing to challenge and rework our eligibility criteria.
Build and run fraud controls: You'll design and implement the controls that keep our credit products safe as we scale.
Be the cross-market go-to on credit fraud: You'll act as the point of contact for Risk, Product and Customer Care across all our markets.
➡️ What we're looking for
You've worked credit fraud or default cases hands-on: You know how to read a case, question it, and act — not just follow a checklist.
You bring a critical mind and real curiosity: You question existing criteria and processes instead of taking them at face value.
You communicate with confidence: You'll work directly with Risk, Product and Customer Care, so clarity and conviction matter.
You're curious about AI: You're comfortable using AI tools to spot patterns in data, and keen to help us sharpen the AI tool we use to catch fraud.
➡️ What we can offer you
A function you get to build, not inherit: As Qonto becomes a bank, you'll shape the credit fraud function from the ground up.
Real ownership, real trust: Your manager gives real autonomy — you'll be the team's go-to expert, not someone executing a fixed brief.
A seat at the table across the business: You'll work directly across teams, with visibility across markets.
A front-row seat to Qonto becoming a bank: You'll join at a pivotal moment as we launch new credit products.
➡️ Your future manager
You will work directly with Thibault Mosser, our Head of Fraud, who has been with Qonto for 7 years and has led the fraud team through an impressive growth phase. He has led the successful separation of Fraud and AML and implemented modern fraud detection systems. Thibault is known for his supportive leadership style that grants teams great autonomy, and brings deep understanding of international fraud management. With him as your manager, you will benefit from a leader who understands both operational details and strategic direction.

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs.description:
About us: 
Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.
The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals.
 
Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.
 
As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies.

About

the Role:

The Senior QA Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of the company's software products. This role involves close collaboration with product and engineering teams to define clear acceptance criteria, develop and execute comprehensive test strategies, and build robust automated testing frameworks for a modern web application and its backend services. The engineer plays a critical role in maintaining high standards for product releases and improving the overall quality assurance process, while actively pioneering the integration of AI and LLM tools into the testing lifecycle.
 
What you’ll be responsible for, the QA engineer: 
- 
Analyzes product specifications to derive comprehensive and testable acceptance criteria.
Collaborates with product managers and developers to clarify requirements and identify potential edge cases.
Designs, implements, and maintains a robust suite of automated tests, including end-to-end, integration, and regression tests.
Performs manual testing for complex or new features prior to the establishment of full automation coverage.
Monitors, analyzes, and improves test coverage, reliability, and performance over time.
Contributes to the continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) process by integrating automated tests into the deployment pipeline.
Enhances overall product quality by creating detailed bug reports, providing constructive feedback, and maintaining clear testing documentation.
Designs and deploys AI-assisted testing workflows to automate recurring tasks such as test case generation, test data synthesis, and log analysis.
Evaluates and integrates LLM-based testing and coding tools into the QA team's workflow, assessing their reliability, accuracy, and fitness for automated testing and edge-case discovery use cases.
 
Experience and skills required:
- 
Proven experience as a Senior QA Engineer (5+ Years of experience) or similar role, specifically testing modern web applications and backend services.
Strong proficiency with test automation frameworks such as Cypress, Playwright, or similar tools.
Deep understanding of backend services, APIs (REST and GraphQL), and their common failure scenarios.
Ability to read and comprehend frontend and backend code to assist in debugging and test creation.
Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD tools and processes.
Hands-on experience with AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar) and demonstrated ability to build, deploy, or thoroughly validate agent-assisted testing systems in a near-production context.
Proactive and highly detail-oriented mindset.
Advanced proficiency in the English language.
 
Applicants must be based in South, North or Central America 
(applications from other locations will not be considered).
This is a fully remote role, reporting to our Tech Lead.

Unsere Mission und Kunden: Wir schaffen die Freiheit für KMUs, erfolgreich zu sein - mit Europas führendem Finanz-Workspace, der Banking als Kern mit leistungsstarken Finanztools verbindet. Wir sind stolz auf unsere Trustpilot-Bewertung von 4,8, die auf über 55.000 Rezensionen basiert. Kundenzufriedenheit steht im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns(und hier) - belegt durch einen Net Promoter Score von
75. Unser Weg: 2017 von Alexandre und Steve gegründet, ist Qonto auf über 1.700 Qontoers gewachsen, die mehr als 750.000 Kunden in acht europäischen Ländern betreuen. Seit 2023 sind wir profitabel - und das ist erst der Anfang.
Unsere Überzeugungen: Wir stellen nach Fähigkeiten und Potenzial ein. Mit über 80 Nationalitäten, 45 % Frauen im Unternehmen und 56 % Frauen in unserem Leadership-Team ist Diversität kein Programm – sie ist Teil unserer DNA. Wir haben einen diskriminierungsfreien Einstellungsprozess aufgebaut, weil die besten Teams auf Leistung basieren. 
KI bei Qonto: KI ist fest in unsere Arbeitsweise integriert (hier). Jede/r Qontoer/in hat unbegrenzten Zugang zu den besten KI-Tools. Wir suchen Menschen, die experimentieren, ohne auf Erlaubnis zu warten, KI über das Offensichtliche hinaus nutzen und wissen, wann man ihr vertrauen kann - und wann man sie hinterfragen sollte. 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Werde Teil von Qonto als Customer Success Manager und baue das Portfolio unserer deutschen Geschäftskund:innen aus, während Qonto den Weg zur Banklizenz geht. Mit proaktivem, vertrauensbasiertem Kontakt treibst du Aktivierung und Umsatz voran und berichtest an Nicole Ostrowska, die unser Customer Success & Management Team in Berlin leitet.
➡️ Was du bei uns bewirkst
Erste Ansprechperson für dein Kundenportfolio sein: Du betreust deine deutschen Geschäftskund:innen von A bis Z und sorgst dafür, dass jede und jeder von ihnen bei Qonto einen erstklassigen Service erlebt, vom ersten Gespräch bis zur langfristigen Partnerschaft.
Kund:innen helfen, das Beste aus Qonto herauszuholen: Du erkennst, was deine Kund:innen wirklich brauchen, und empfiehlst die passenden Lösungen, ob Abonnements, Karten oder FX. So wachsen ihr Erfolg und unser Umsatz gemeinsam.
Strategische Partnerschaften aufbauen: In regelmäßigen Strategiegesprächen (QBRs) blickst du mit deinen Kund:innen auf ihre Ziele und zeigst ihnen neue Möglichkeiten auf. Du wirst zur vertrauten Beraterin oder zum vertrauten Berater an ihrer Seite.
Kundenbeziehungen langfristig sichern: Du erkennst früh, wenn Kund:innen unzufrieden sind, und findest gemeinsam mit ihnen Lösungen, damit sie langfristig gerne bei Qonto bleiben.
Mit KI den Unterschied machen: Du nutzt KI täglich, um Chancen zu erkennen, Gespräche vorzubereiten und deine Kundenkommunikation noch persönlicher und wirkungsvoller zu gestalten.
➡️ Was du mitbringst
Portfolio-Erfahrung im CSM oder Account Management: Du hast bereits ein Kundenportfolio verantwortet und weißt, wie man es strategisch weiterentwickelt.
Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau: Du führst Kundengespräche und Verhandlungen sicher auf Deutsch. Außerdem sprichst du fließend Englisch, unsere Arbeitssprache bei Qonto.
Stark am Telefon, mit kommerziellem Gespür: Du schaffst schnell Vertrauen, erkennst, was Kund:innen wirklich brauchen, und siehst Abwanderungsrisiken oder Upselling-Chancen, bevor sie offensichtlich sind.
Erfahrung in Fintech, Banking oder SaaS: Du sprichst bereits die Sprache der Finanzprodukte oder bist genauso versiert im SaaS-Bereich.
KI-affin: Du nutzt KI täglich, um schneller zu arbeiten, nicht als nachträglichen Gedanken.
➡️ Was wir dir bieten
Ein Portfolio mit echtem Gewicht: Du betreust Beziehungen, die Qontos Weg zur Banklizenz tragen.
Einblick in laufende Initiativen: Du wirkst an strategischen Projekten mit, die den deutschen Markt für Qonto voranbringen.
Gestaltungsspielraum bei KI: Das Team baut seine KI-Praxis aktiv aus, und du kannst das mitgestalten.
Echte Eigenverantwortung: Kleines Team, große Verantwortung. Du bist Teil eines erfahrenen Teams, in dem du dein Portfolio wirklich selbst verantwortest.
Hyper-Growth Umfeld: Ein dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du komplexe Deals und kommerzielle Lösungen in der sich schnell entwickelnden Fintech-Branche strukturierst.
➡️ Deine zukünftige Führungskraft
Du berichtest an Nicole, unsere Team Lead. Sie hält einen MBA der University of Aberdeen und bringt 7 Jahre E-Commerce-Erfahrung im Key Account Management bei Playern wie Amazon, Zalando und Idealo mit.
Ihr Hintergrund: Nicole ist Expertin für die Entwicklung von Wachstumsstrategien, Verhandlungsführung und Business Analysis.
Ihr Führungsstil: Sie legt großen Wert auf Autonomie und Eigeninitiative und gibt ihrem Team den nötigen Freiraum, eigene Themen zu treiben, während sie stets Unterstützung für die persönliche Weiterentwicklung bietet.
Teamkultur: Nicole fördert eine offene Kommunikationskultur, in der man sich gegenseitig unterstützt und Erfolge, auch bei Teamevents, gemeinsam feiert.

Komplexe Kundenanfragen bearbeiten: Kontopfändungen, blockierte Zahlungen, Kontoschließungen, erweiterte Sorgfaltspflichtprüfungen — du bearbeitest anspruchsvolle Fälle mit Sorgfalt und Präzision.

Erfahrung im Kundenservice: Mindestens ein Jahr in einem kundenorientierten Bereich, idealerweise im Finanz- oder Dienstleistungssektor. Du hast komplexe Fälle bearbeitet, nicht nur Standardanfragen.

Abwechslungsreiche, anspruchsvolle Fälle: Pfändungen, Compliance-Prüfungen, blockierte Zahlungen — das ist kein First-Level-Support. Die Komplexität deiner Arbeit ist von Tag eins an hoch.
Direkter Einfluss auf das Kundenerlebnis: Qontos Kundenzufriedenheit im deutschen Markt hängt direkt von der Qualität deiner Arbeit ab. Dein Feedback fließt in Produkt- und Prozessverbesserungen ein.

Deine Managerin wird Sanja Kadžibanov sein, die das Customer Care Team Deutschland leitet.

Join Juliette’s Anti-Financial Crime (AFC)France team as an expert to protect Qonto and its users. As a second-line expert, you will validate our Enhanced Investigations and suspicious activity reports before they reach the French Financial Intelligence Unit (Tracfin), and shape how we detect and investigate financial crime — from complex risk scenarios to better procedures.
👩‍💻🧑‍💻 As an AFC Expert (France) at Qonto, you will
Validate: Review, correct and autonomously validate the Enhanced Investigations drafted by the AFC team before they are declared to Tracfin.
Report: Draft, review and validate Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) for Tracfin, including the most complex cases (large networks, tax fraud involving several groups), and handle complex authority requests.
Control quality: Run systematic quality controls on our second-line work and, occasionally, on alerts handled by the first-line AML and Fraud teams, so that standards and regulatory deadlines are always met.
Improve detection: Propose complex risk scenarios and emerging trends for our transaction monitoring and customer risk rating, update our investigation procedures, and drive improvement projects end to end (for example AI and network analysis) that fit your interests and specialisation.
Coach: Be the go-to reference for junior colleagues and give detailed methodology feedback to the AML and Fraud teams, and share what you learn.
🤔 What you can expect
Fast-paced environment: We operate in a dynamic fintech setting where reactivity and adaptability are key; you will work through a high volume of cases without compromising on quality ("Go fast but do it right").
Collaborative culture: You will join Juliette’s close-knit AFC team that values peer support, with weekly team meetings and regular 1-on-1s to foster your growth.
Influence & development: Your feedback and procedures directly shape how AML, Fraud and Onboarding work. You will see a variety of cases (AML, tax fraud, corruption, scams, fraud in general) and can deepen the specialisation that fits you through projects.
Tools: You will work with our internal proprietary back-office tools and communicate via Slack.
🤝 About your future manager
Your future manager will be Juliette, Head of Anti-Financial Crime France
Her path: After a Law degree and a Business School diploma, Juliette discovered her passion for Compliance and Financial Crime. Previously, she was a Compliance Officer at Coinhouse, a crypto-specialised fintech, and worked in the white-collar department of a law firm. At Qonto, she has done in-depth investigations in our Financial Security team and worked on building tools and processes.
What she brings to the team: Juliette values teamwork and builds a collaborative environment. Her law and compliance background helps her navigate the complexity of the financial industry. She puts communication and knowledge sharing first, and fosters a culture that encourages growth and development.
🏅 About You
Languages:You speak French fluently with impeccable writing skills (our authorities only work in French, so spelling, grammar and syntax are non-negotiable). You also speak English fluently.
Background: A Master’s degree in Law is a plus.

Experience:

You have 2–3 years of experience in second-line Anti-Financial Crime compliance, you know the job, and you have already written Enhanced Investigations and suspicious activity reports.
Analytical mindset: You are rigorous and detail-oriented, you synthesise complex information into clear, regulator-ready reports, and you can challenge colleagues’ work constructively.
Initiative: You anticipate needs, flag issues and propose improvements rather than waiting for direction. You are curious about AI and automation, and you stay accountable for your decisions when using them. You want to deepen your expertise in an area such as tax fraud, corruption or fraud.

Join us as a Site Reliability Engineer on our Storage team to keep the databases Qonto runs on resilient, safe, and always available. Solid PostgreSQL production

experience:

You write code: You're comfortable shipping features, not just scripts, for the internal platform tools your team builds.
Calm, rigorous incident response: You've handled production incidents on stateful systems and stay composed when the pressure is on.

Join us as Lead Workforce Manager to own the global capacity planning framework across all of Qonto's Ops factories. You'll set the methodology every factory uses, hold the consolidated budget view, and be the senior owner of BPO relationships at a strategic and contractual level. This is a hands-on build-and-run role: you'll design the model and direct its rollout, under the guidance of Marie Piquemil, our Head of Operations Enablement.
➡️ What you'll do
Design and own the capacity planning framework: You'll build the reference model and set the forecasting cadence, templates, and definitions every factory's WFM analyst works from.
Optimise the internal vs. BPO capacity mix: You'll build the system that determines the right balance of internal agents and BPO capacity to cover workload at the lowest sustainable cost and risk, across all factories.
Own the global BPO budget view: You'll hold the actuals-vs-plan picture for exec reporting, interface with Finance on planning and reconciliation, and surface cross-factory cost inefficiencies invisible at the local level.
Lead BPO relationships at a strategic level: You'll be the senior point of contact for BPO partners on capacity, contracts, and escalations — and define the invoice validation standard used across all factories.
Enable and align factory-level WFM analysts: You'll set the standards and operating cadence for factory analysts through dotted-line governance, and run the monthly cross-factory alignment ritual covering forecast review, capacity risk, and invoice anomalies.
➡️ What we're looking for
WFM leadership with BPO depth: You’ve led Workforce Management with hands-on exposure to both BPO-managed and internal-agent capacity models. You’ve managed outsourcing relationships at a contractual and strategic level, and held partners accountable to real standards.
Methodology builder, not just operator: You’ve designed or significantly overhauled a capacity planning framework. You know what it takes to build one from scratch, not just run what’s already there.
Influence-based leader: You’re effective without direct authority. You set standards, coach local relays, and drive adoption across semi-autonomous teams who don’t report to you.
AI-curious: You look for ways to use AI to work faster and smarter, and you’re ready to keep adapting as the role evolves with it.
French and English fluency: You have a strong command of both French and English.
➡️ What we can offer you
A founding mandate in a brand-new, centralized operations function — you'll help shape how it works from day one.
Direct line of sight into Qonto's banking license transition, raising the bar on operational rigor as the company scales.
Real autonomy over a strategic mission with executive visibility into the outcome.
A seat at the table as a genuine business partner to Finance and factory leadership, not just an operator.
➡️ Your future manager
Your manager will be Marie Piquemil, our Head of Operations Enablement.
Her path? Marie spent five years as COO at Morning, then built and led an international CX operations team at Swile (7 people across France and Brazil, five post-merger integrations). Most recently as VP Operations at Combo, she ran RevOps, Enablement, and Data teams, drove a post-merger integration, and launched a new Payroll Business Unit from scratch. She's been an operator, a builder, and a manager of managers.

Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).
Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.
Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.
AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Join us as an Operations Tooling Engineer to turn Qonto's Operations Enablement run into a self-improving system — one where every recurring request becomes an opportunity to automate, and where AI and scripting progressively replace manual, repetitive work.
You will work closely with Lucas, and join the Operations Engineers team, part of Central Operations Enablement — the transversal pillar that equips Qonto's Operations factories with the tools, data access, and technical standards they need to scale. Our team acts as a Technical Product Partner to those factories: we own the architecture and data flows behind our back-office platform, our ticketing tool (Zendesk), and our telephony tool (Aircall), and we scale what one factory builds into something every factory can rely on.
➡️ What you'll do
Handle the run with rigor: triage and resolve day-to-day requests from the run backlog — operational tooling access/config issues, dashboard requests, and ad hoc data queries — with speed and quality, helping Operations Engineers, and Operations Enablement more broadly, scale.
Spot the patterns: identify recurring request types within the backlog and quantify their volume, time cost, and risk to prioritize what's worth automating.
Design and ship automations: turn repeatable manual tasks into supervised automations via low-code, scripts, and AI tools, documenting how each one is designed, used, and maintained so the team can rely on them without you — reducing lead time and manual effort on the run.
Run a continuous improvement loop: for each automation, scope the solution, estimate the expected gain, deploy it, measure the actual impact, keep the documentation up to date, and move to the next candidate; following a "treat → detect pattern → automate → measure → repeat" cycle.
Grow into department-wide improvement projects: as you build expertise in AI and operations automation, take on small improvement initiatives, complete with guides and how-tos, that extend the tools and automations built for our team to other Operations factories.
➡️ What we're looking for

Experience:

You have 1-2 years of experience, with a background in engineering or a business school, and you're comfortable being hands-on with tools and data from day one.
Technical curiosity & tooling: You're comfortable navigating and troubleshooting operational tools (back-office platforms, Zendesk, Aircall, or equivalent CRM/ticketing/telephony platforms) and are excited to script and automate rather than repeat manual steps.
Data & querying: You can run data analysis to investigate issues, build dashboards, and size the impact of a problem before deciding whether it's worth solving.
Automation mindset: You have some exposure to low-code, iPaaS, Python, or similar tools, and you naturally ask "how do I make this happen without me?" when faced with a repetitive task.
Structured problem-solving: You can scope a small project end-to-end — from noticing a recurring pain point to shipping and measuring a fix — with autonomy and follow-through.
Languages: Fluent English is required; French and/or another European language is a huge plus.
➡️ What we can offer you
Team & market context: You'll join the Operations Engineers team within Central Operations Enablement, the technical backbone that keeps tooling and processes running smoothly, connected and scaling for teams across the Operations department.
Methodologies: We work in a continuous improvement loop; treat, detect patterns, automate, measure, repeat. And we act as a proactive partner to Operations factories, one step ahead rather than waiting to be tasked.
Growth path: Grow from day-to-day operations into AI-driven automation and cross-factory projects, mentored by Lucas and experienced colleagues who have scaled operational processes.
Tools: back-office platforms, Zendesk, Aircall, dashboarding tools, iPaaS (Zapier, Make), SQL, and full access to AI tools to build faster.
➡️ Your future manager
Your Team Lead will be Lucas, our Lead Ops Engineering.
Their background? After a first experience in Supply Chain optimization in a consulting company, Lucas joined Qonto 5 years ago as an Operations Engineer specializing in the payment system, before growing into Team Lead of the Operations Engineers team.
What do they bring to the team? Lucas is known for balancing technical feasibility with real business and operational constraints, and for spotting systemic improvements that go beyond what was initially asked. He makes a point of investing time in mentoring, so the team builds that same instinct for framing problems and grounding decisions in data.

At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
 
By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
🔒 Your security matters to us
Recruitment scams are on the rise. Keep in mind, we will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates.
If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Qonto, please report it right away (support@qonto.com)

jobs.description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).
Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.
Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.
AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Join us as a Customer Care Manager in the Account Management team to give our French market clients the kind of support that makes them feel genuinely taken care of. You'll resolve production tickets, untangle complex problems, and help shape the way our Account Management team operates, under the guidance of Axelle, our Team Lead. 
➡️ What you'll do
Resolve client tickets end-to-end: Solve problems across chat, email, and occasional video calls for clients in the French market.
Investigate before you answer: Dig into account activity, company profiles and transaction history to find the right solution.
Go beyond the obvious fix: Proactively recommend products or solutions based on what each client actually needs.
Partner with Product and Tech to resolve bugs and feature requests that need cross-functional problem-solving.
Fix what's broken around you: Contribute to "broken windows" projects like improving CRM workflows or building better internal databases.
➡️ What we're looking for
A natural problem-solver: You’ve worked directly with clients in a customer care or a similar role, and you enjoy solving tricky, ambiguous problems rather than passing them on.
Sharp communication: You speak and write fluently in French and English, with a clear, professional style whether you’re on chat, email or a call.
AI-fluent mindset: You're keen to use AI tools to work faster and rethink how the job gets done, not just to tick a box.
Flexible availability: You're comfortable working outside of standard office hours and on weekends when clients need support.
➡️ What we can offer you
Real specialization, fast: Move beyond foundation-level work within months as you build full-scope expertise.
Trust-based autonomy: Once trained, you'll own your tickets and projects without anyone looking over your shoulder.
A clear path forward: Foundation work here can lead into product, project ownership, or other specialized tracks.
Hands-on mentorship: You'll be coached directly by senior teammates invested in your growth.
➡️ Your future manager
Your manager will be Axelle, Team Lead in Account Management, based in Barcelona.
Her background? Axelle joined Qonto as a Customer Care Manager. In less than two years she went from Customer Care Manager to Senior and then to Team Lead. Along the way she ran Account Management trainings and was the go-to person between Product and Customer Care for feature launches.
What does she bring to the team? Axelle gives clear guidance and regular coaching, then trusts her team to own their work independently. She knows the role from the inside, so she can help you ramp up fast and grow at your own pace.

At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
 
By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
🔒 Your security matters to us
Recruitment scams are on the rise. Keep in mind, we will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates.
If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Qonto, please report it right away (support@qonto.com)

Komplexe Onboarding-Anfragen bearbeiten: Anspruchsvolle Fälle rund um Firmengründung, Kontovalidierung, Stammkapitalzahlungen und Kontoaktivierung mit hoher Sorgfalt und Präzision lösen.

Flexibilität: Zwei Bürotage pro Woche in Belgrad, ansonsten remote in Serbien.

Davor war er Technical Support Representative bei Majorel und Hotel Specialist in Bayern. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, basiert in Barcelona.

Join us as Partner Success Lead - Chartered Accountants and turn Qonto’s network of accounting firms into its strongest growth channel. You’ll lead a team of 7 Partner Success Managers, own the customer acquisition and revenue they generate, and shape the partnership strategy alongside Charles, our Business Unit Director.
➡️ What you’ll do
Lead and grow the team: Coach 7 Partner Success Managers through onboarding, performance, and career moves.
Co-own the channel strategy: Define the Chartered Accountant partnership ambition with the Business Unit Director.
Own the numbers: Drive referrals, KYBs, retention, and partner revenue across the portfolio, using AI to turn partner data into sharper targeting.
Build the next playbook: Design scalable ways for firms to engage with Qonto that go well beyond asking them for referrals.
Support high-stakes partner meetings: Join your team in video calls or in-person meetings with managing partners and C-level stakeholders when strategic opportunities or challenges call for your involvement.
Work across the company: Partner with Sales, Marketing, SalesOps, GrowthOps and Product on activation, escalations, and market insights, and advocate for the resources your team needs.
➡️ What we’re looking for
Portfolio growth: You’ve spent 5+ years growing partners or accounts in B2B, and you’re customer centric and you grow portfolios over the long term.
Real management

experience:

You’ve already led or mentored a team (of at least 5 people), and the technical side of people management doesn’t faze you.
Driven by initiative and a proactive mindset: You challenge the status quo and bring ideas to leadership.
Senior stakeholder ease: You’re comfortable in the room with managing partners and C-level decision-makers.
Accounting know-how (a plus): You understand bookkeeping, accounting workflows and invoicing regulations, or you're eager to learn them quickly.
Field-ready: You can travel occasionally, and you're open to a hybrid field role as the accountant channel develops.
AI-fluent and business-minded: You use AI tools in your daily workflow and think in referral rates, portfolio health, and partner revenue potential.
Languages: You’re fluent in French (native at least C2 level) and comfortable in English (at least C1 level).
➡️ What we can offer you
A high-visibility leadership role at the centre of Qonto’s growth strategy for the accountant channel.
Real ownership: you shape the strategy with the Business Unit Director rather than just executing it.
A builder’s mandate — there’s still plenty to design, test, scale, and hire for.
The chance to build Qonto’s field presence with accounting firms from the ground up.
➡️ Your future manager
You’ll report to Charles Macaire, Business Unit Director. An École Polytechnique graduate, Charles started out at EDF and Air Liquide, then ran a several-hundred-million-euro P&L and B2B commercial teams at Amazon, before leading global Sales & Customer Success at Sleek in Singapore. He’s looking for someone who is proactive and business oriented.

11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ young users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.

We’re reimagining how the next generation experiences fintech—going beyond payments to build a lifestyle brand that blends money, identity, and everyday experiences into one seamless, intuitive journey.

Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors.

You don't come across a company every day that puts content and communication on top of its priorities. We believe communication is the most powerful tool and can be a total game changer.

We're looking for a copy intern with a sharp eye for words, a good sense of what makes Gen Z stop and read, and the itch to craft content that feels less like marketing and more like a conversation with a friend.

Every once a while, a product comes to life that makes people think, why this was not done earlier? The users love it, the investors dream about the great returns and the team feels the joy and pride every day. We have strong indicators for users and investors and we are building the team, that will have stories to tell all their life.

We’re proud to be supported by renowned investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital, and esteemed angels Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.

You will be working with a small, but highly technical team. We have 250k users and work to ensure continuous uptime, and constant improvement. • Build robust and scalable software in Python
• Design and create services and system architecture for your projects, and contribute to existing infrastructure
• Help improve our code quality through writing unit tests, automation and performing code reviews
• Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas to our technology, algorithms and products
• Dive into difficult problems and successfully deliver results on schedule

Sprachen: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

Ein Team, das wächst: Wir bauen unser Inbound- und Account-Growth-Team in Deutschland aus, und du gestaltest Ansätze und Prozesse mit.
Klare Ziele, schnelles Feedback: Du arbeitest mit transparenten KPIs wie Reaktionszeit auf Leads und Konversion.
Variable Vergütung ab 50 % der Zielerreichung: Sie wird monatlich ausgezahlt, damit sich deine Leistung schnell bezahlt macht.

➡️ Deine zukünftige Führungskraft
Du berichtest an Mattia Ferrario, unseren Inbound Sales Lead, mit fundierter Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Skalierung von Sales-Operationen in Europa. Er führt ein Team von 7 Personen und steht für klare Standards, kontinuierliches Feedback und hands-on Unterstützung, damit du in deiner Rolle erfolgreich startest.
Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Sales-Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

The role focuses on implementing effective collections, restructuring and recovery strategies to support customers in bringing their lending facilities up to date, while protecting the Bank’s exposure.

Where customers cease trading or arrears become unmanageable, the role will involve coordinating recovery activity with third parties including solicitors, Insolvency Practitioners and debt collection agencies, including the enforcement and realisation of security where appropriate.

All activity must be conducted in line with internal policy, regulatory requirements and the principles of Treating Customers Fairly.

 - Where necessary, terminating finance agreements on AF exposures and working with the Asset Manager to recover and sell assets to maximise sale proceeds.

 - Keep Watchlist up to date and assist the team and Head of Collections & Recoveries with monthly report to Credit Risk meeting.

 - Liaising with insolvency practitioners and collection agents, as well as instructing Solicitors where required.

 - Ensure that the portfolio delinquency ageing is categorised accurately to support IFRS 9 reporting.

 - Anticipate and react to regulatory or legislative changes that could affect lending; develop contingency plans and strategic responses to change.

 - Ensuring that fees, and recovery income and expense is in line with budget.

 - Continually evaluate market conditions and recognise and react to emerging risks in the portfolio.

 - Change management supporter; to improve processes and procedures in a rapid manner through developing improvements with the business line mission squad.

As part of the risk function within Commercial Mortgages, this role is critical to ensure we can deliver on our objectives in a safe manner.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

The purpose of the role is to underwrite borrowing requests received via a variety of channels, including online in line with the Bank’s approved Credit Policy and in accordance with the Banks asset portfolio (including but not limited to commercial mortgages, commercial investment loans, commercial loans against leasehold properties) .

PRINCIPLE ACCOUNTABILITIES

 - Assess and underwrite direct credit loan applications within personal discretion, in line with the all regulatory requirements, the Bank’s credit appetite policy and underwriting policies utilising appropriate credit data and analytical tools.

 - Produce clear, accurate and concise written documentation, making clear recommendations to the Credit team for loan application requests falling outside of personal discretion or outside of credit policy, escalating cases where necessary to the appropriate Delegated Lending Authorities.

 - Manage and own the end to end application process, from initial enquiry to completion, liaising effectively with the panel solicitors in terms of required security instructions and ensure loans are appropriately documented and borrowing is fully secured before draw-down.

 - Liaise with the Credit team as required in managing the credit risk environment, concentration risk and developing credit policy.

 - Undertake regular checks and monitor agreed controls to ensure the Bank’s risk and customer requirements are met at all times; escalating immediately any areas of concern

The Full Stack Engineer contributes to the design and delivery of products within a squad, helping to build secure, reliable, and accessible software while maintaining high engineering standards and a good developer experience.

Department Description

Platform Engineering is the centralised team that builds, provisions and runs the infrastructure every other engineering team at Allica depends on. Whether a product serves a business banking customer or a colleague inside the bank, it lands on a platform this team designed. The team owns both halves of that, building the platform and running it, against the availability and resilience standards a regulated bank is held to. Well-architected is the operating standard, not an aspiration: reliability, security, cost and operational excellence are design inputs from the start. 

The job is to make the right thing the easy thing, through paved roads, self-service provisioning, sensible defaults, and controls encoded in the platform rather than bolted on afterwards. Every control the platform enforces is one a product team does not have to think about, and one we can evidence on demand. Role Description The Lead Platform Engineer is the senior technical leader for a core domain of Allica's platform. You set its technical direction, you are accountable for how it behaves in production, and you build it yourself.

 This is a hands-on role. Expect to spend a real share of your week in infrastructure as code, pipelines and live systems, and the rest setting standards, reviewing designs and making the calls that are too consequential to delegate. Your customers are internal. Product engineering and data engineering choose whether to use what you build, so adoption and the friction you remove are the measures that matter.

 Principal Accountabilities

 Platform Architecture and Engineering 

 - Own the architecture of Allica’s Cloud platform: landing zones, subscriptions and network topology, container runtime, and the integration and resilience patterns that sit on top. Design again Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework as working disciplines. 

 - Build the reusable core: Terraform modules, deployment templates and platform services that let a team stand up production-grade infrastructure without reinventing the security, networking and observability plumbing each time. 
 
 Infrastructure as Code and Automation  

 - Deliver and manage all infrastructure through Terraform and secure CI/CD, so that every change is automated, repeatable, version-controlled, tested, and reversible. Drive manual change and configuration drift towards zero.  

 - Set and evolve engineering standards for the function: code quality, peer review, policy as code and, release management.
 
 Security, Governance, and Compliance  

 - Embed security, governance, and compliance throughout the platform lifecycle, implementing effective policies, access controls, encryption, vulnerability management, monitoring, and configuration standards.  

 - Collaborate with Allica’s Security, Engineering, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure platforms meet organisational, regulatory, and control requirements, supported by clear documentation and auditable evidence.  

 - Identify and manage architectural risks, security vulnerabilities, control gaps, and technical debt, ensuring remediation actions are prioritised, tracked, and completed. 
 
 Platform Operations and Service Ownership  

 - Own availability, reliability, and run cost for the platform, backed by service objectives, monitoring you can operate from, and tested recovery arrangements. 

 - Lead the response to complex incidents, own the root-cause analysis, drive out repeat causes rather than repeat fixes.  

 - Use service data, operational experience, and FinOps practices to continuously improve platform automation, resilience, engineering standards, cost visibility, forecasting, and resource optimisation. 
 
 Team Leadership  

 - Lead, mentor, and develop a team of platform engineers while remaining personally hands-on in architecture, design reviews, and the hardest technical problems. 

 - Set the technical bar and raise it, through coaching, design review and the example of your own work.
 
 
 
 Personal Attributes & Experience  

 - A strong track record architecting, and running production Azure environments at scale.

 - Fluent in landing zone and subscription design, private networking, containerised compute, API management and resilience patterns across zones and regions. 

 - Line Management Experience

 - Extensive hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure at scale, infrastructure as code, containerised runtimes, identity and observability.  

 - Has carried production accountability for systems that matter. Comfortable in handling incidents.  

 - Treats developer experience as a product.

 - Talks to engineering teams, watches how they actually work and designs for adoption rather than mandate.  

 - Treats regulatory and security requirements as engineering constraints to design around, not obstacles to route past. 

 - Prior regulated or high-assurance experience helps but is not a prerequisite. 

 - Gets adoption by building things engineers want to use and by making a clear case, not by escalation. 

 - Prefers the boring, well-understood solution unless the problem genuinely demands otherwise. Willing to remove things. 
 
 Desirable Experience  

 - Architecture or engineering experience with Google Cloud Platform.  

 - Experience working in complex, regulated, or security-sensitive environments.

 - Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable CI/CD technologies.  Familiarity with FinOps, operational resilience, regulatory compliance, and cloud-control frameworks.  Relevant Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Terraform, security, or architecture certifications.

The successful candidate will plan and execute a portfolio of testing activities, communicate findings clearly to stakeholders, and agree, monitor, and support action plans through to resolution. Principal Accountabilities

 - Communicate Outcomes Based Testing results clearly to relevant stakeholders, ensuring findings are understood and owned. 

As part of the risk function within Commercial Mortgages, this role is critical to ensure we can deliver on our objectives in a safe manner.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

The purpose of the role is to underwrite borrowing requests received via a variety of channels, including online in line with the Bank’s approved Credit Policy and in accordance with the Banks asset portfolio (including but not limited to commercial mortgages, commercial investment loans, commercial loans against leasehold properties) .

PRINCIPLE ACCOUNTABILITIES

 - Assess and underwrite direct credit loan applications within personal discretion, in line with the all regulatory requirements, the Bank’s credit appetite policy and underwriting policies utilising appropriate credit data and analytical tools.

 - Produce clear, accurate and concise written documentation, making clear recommendations to the Credit team for loan application requests falling outside of personal discretion or outside of credit policy, escalating cases where necessary to the appropriate Delegated Lending Authorities.

 - Manage and own the end to end application process, from initial enquiry to completion, liaising effectively with the panel solicitors in terms of required security instructions and ensure loans are appropriately documented and borrowing is fully secured before draw-down.

 - Liaise with the Credit team as required in managing the credit risk environment, concentration risk and developing credit policy.

 - Undertake regular checks and monitor agreed controls to ensure the Bank’s risk and customer requirements are met at all times; escalating immediately any areas of concern

 - Manage a portfolio of advances to a defined arrears and collections policy.

 - Liaise effectively with applicants (or their brokers) and valuers in requests for additional relevant information to support the credit decisioning process.

 - Deliver an excellent service is given to customers, their brokers and Relationship Managers, building and maintaining strong relationships in line with the Bank’s values and defined customer experience standards.

 - Ensure compliance with all mandatory policies and adherence to credit procedures to maintain internal credit controls.

 - Fully understand and comply with operational procedures, requirements and SLA’s.

 - Help develop appropriate MI and KPI indicators and reporting, maintaining suitable MI to enable a detailed understanding of Mortgage processing pipeline

 - Actively search for areas of improvement for the Bank and your team and take ownership for delivery of these, setting a good example by displaying appropriate values and behaviour

PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES & EXPERIENCE

 - Exposure/knowledge of underwriting, with experience in the SME sector, with an understanding of the competitor landscape and the dynamics and trends of the SME market.

 - Excellent credit/financial analysis skills including the analysis of financial accounts, budgets and cashflow forecasting, Understanding of the loan underwriting process and the risks involved and be able to assess applications within a personal discretion and make recommendations and take commercial decisions.

 - Experience of escalating and presenting at Credit Committee level and Arrears Management.

 - Strong analytical, verbal and written communication skills.

 - Ability to build strong and lasting relationships with internal stakeholders such as the distribution team, operations team and senior management, plus 3rd party suppliers such as Intermediaries, Valuers and Solicitors.

 - Understand and comply with all regulatory requirements, plus internal policies / procedures, guidelines, risks and controls and service levels.

 - Good understanding of TCF, AML, KYC and Conduct risk.

jobs.title: Staff Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Technology sits at the centre of Allica. We design and build the platforms that power the bank, working closely with every part of the business to deliver real impact for customers. Our teams move quickly, focus on outcomes, and take ownership from concept through to delivery. We solve complex problems, modernise processes, and enable the business to scale with confidence.

What makes us different is the level of influence and autonomy engineers have. We work without the weight of legacy systems, which means we can focus on building for the future. Everyone contributes ideas and helps shape how we operate, and roles evolve as the organisation grows. This is a place for people who want to have a tangible impact and do their best work in a modern, collaborative environment.

Role Description

The Staff Full Stack Engineer is responsible for setting technical direction across multiple squads, typically overseeing 2–3 squads and line-managing 3–5 Full Stack Engineers. The role exists to shape architecture, ensure the success of these squads, and drive consistent, secure, and compliant delivery across Allica’s digital products.

You will use your expertise in Spring Boot microservices (Java/Kotlin) and modern web technologies (React/TypeScript) to define and evolve cross-squad patterns, shared tooling, and platform capabilities.

Our backend microservices are containerised and deployed to Azure Container Apps, and our web applications are deployed to Azure Static Web Apps; you will help define and uphold the standards that make these platforms robust, cost-effective, and easy to operate.

You will own key cross-cutting concerns such as authentication, observability, performance, accessibility, and regulatory compliance, ensuring our systems meet the standards expected of a UK bank.

You are hands-on: you design and review architectures, pair with engineers, and contribute code to high-impact initiatives.

You work closely with Product, Design and other engineering leaders to align technical direction with business goals and to unblock delivery.

You drive the responsible adoption of GenAI and agentic engineering practices (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot), setting organisation-wide standards and measuring impact.

Success in this role is reflected in simpler architectures, improved delivery consistency and reliability, stronger engineering effectiveness, and the growth and performance of your direct reports and squads.

Set and evolve cross-squad technical patterns and guardrails for:

 - Backend services (Kotlin/Java Spring Boot microservices, REST/OpenAPI, messaging, integrations).

 - Frontend architectures (React/TypeScript, shared design system, Nx, micro frontends where appropriate).

 - Authentication/authorisation, API gateways and API governance (versioning, contracts, deprecation).

 - Define and maintain organisation-wide standards for performance, reliability, security, accessibility, and operational excellence, in partnership with Architecture, InfoSec, Risk, and Compliance.

 - Establish and improve SLOs, error budget policies, and incident management practices across key services; lead post-incident reviews and drive follow-through on structural fixes.

 - Lead cross-squad system design for complex initiatives, ensuring coherent architectures, well-managed dependencies, clear domain boundaries, and effective interactions between services and frontends.

Define and champion responsible AI-assisted engineering practices, including:

 - Standards for using Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot and other approved GenAI tools.

 - Expectations for review and validation of AI-generated code.

 - Extensive experience designing and delivering distributed systems at scale using Spring Boot (Kotlin/Java) and modern web technologies (React/TypeScript).

 - Experience designing and governing APIs at scale (REST, OpenAPI, API gateways, versioning, backwards compatibility, service contracts).

 - Demonstrated ability to lead technical programmes or initiatives that span multiple teams and systems, delivering measurable improvements to reliability, performance, or developer productivity.

 - Experience introducing and scaling the use of new tools and standards across organisations, including GenAI technologies (e.g. GitHub Copilot) with appropriate guardrails.

experience:

jobs.title: Technology Risk Officer
jobs.description:
At bunq, we're on a mission to Make Life Easy for our users by creating the most user-centric banking experience out there. To deliver on that promise, our services must be reliable 100% of the time.

That's where you come in. We're looking for a Technology Risk Officer who takes ownership of making sure our ICT infrastructure can withstand and recover from disruption. As second line of defense, you'll test whether our controls actually work, not just whether they exist on paper, so weaknesses are found before they become incidents, protecting user's trust and letting bunq scale without operational risk growing alongside it.

As a Technology Risk Officer, you'll show bunq's excellence both inside and out by keeping our critical systems resilient and our controls effective. This role is yours to own, we'll show you the tools and the end goal, but how you get there is up to you. Here's how you'll do it:

Continuously test and challenge bunq's ICT infrastructure to surface weaknesses before they affect our users, going beyond "are we compliant" to verify controls actually work, and use AI to automate testing, monitoring, and evidence collection at scale.

When something goes wrong, dig into what really happened in the engineering process, interpret results to separate meaningful risk from noise, and prioritize remediation accordingly.

Lead business continuity and disaster recovery testing, designing realistic drills for technology, business processes, and critical suppliers.

Coordinate across technical and business teams, challenging control owners and driving weaknesses through to resolution, this role is yours to own end to end.

You have deep knowledge of operational and ICT resilience, and you think like an engineer, you want to understand what actually happened in a system, not just whether a checkbox was ticked.

You have proven skills in automated control testing and monitoring, and can design continuous tests and alerts that catch control failures early.

You have deep expertise in business continuity and resilience testing, and can design realistic drills across technology, process, and supplier risk.

You have strong risk judgement and analytical skills, and can prioritize remediation based on what actually matters.

You have proven stakeholder management and challenge skills, comfortable pushing engineering teams directly and holding the line, and you're comfortable using AI to design and scale risk processes.
