jobs.title: Senior Product Design Manager, Growth
jobs.description:
ABOUT KOHO

We’re on a mission to make financial services better for every Canadian. That means no hidden fees, no predatory interest rates - just financial products designed to help our users spend smart, save more, and build real wealth. We’re a performance organization with a strong heart: we care deeply about outcomes, and everything ties back to our mission - to financially empower a generation of Canadians.

At KOHO, we’re not your average 9-5. We believe real impact comes from people who are trusted, empowered, and supported to do their best work - without sacrificing their lives to do it. We prioritize work-life integration, not just work-life balance. That means asynchronous collaboration, flexible hours, and a remote-first setup built around autonomy and high trust.

KOHO is entering its next chapter - leaner, smarter, more AI-integrated. We’re building for impact, not bureaucracy. If you thrive in environments that value clarity, ownership, and bold thinking, you’ll fit right in.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Senior Product Design Manager, you will lead design across a complex portfolio that combines two very different but deeply connected challenges: helping teams create and grow new customer experiences, and building the systems that allow excellent design to scale across KOHO.

You will lead and develop product designers working across zero-to-one, growth, onboarding, and other high-leverage product opportunities. At the same time, you will provide strategic leadership and support to the KOHO Design System team, helping the system evolve as a practical, adopted, high-quality foundation across app and web.

This is a role for a design leader who can move fluidly between ambiguity and scale. You will help teams turn uncertain opportunities into clear product directions, design experiments that create real learning, and make thoughtful trade-offs between velocity, quality, customer trust, and long-term experience coherence. You will also understand when a solution should be explored as a local experiment and when it needs to become a reusable pattern that improves the whole product.

You will work closely with Product managers, Engineering, Data, Research, Marketing, and other functional teams. As part of KOHO’s Product, Design, and Engineering partnership, you will shape strategy, create clarity across multiple teams, and raise the quality of the experience without making teams dependent on process or central approval.

What You’ll Do

 - Lead and develop product designers across multiple teams or a large, complex area, creating the conditions for people to grow, make decisions with confidence, and do exceptional work.

 - Set a clear design direction across zero-to-one and growth initiatives, helping teams move from ambiguous opportunities to compelling product experiences and measurable learning to accelerate KOHO in its mission to be the bank of choice for all Canadians, across app and web.

 - Coach teams through experimentation, using customer insight, research, data, prototypes, and product outcomes to decide what to build, what to test, and what to change next.

 - Balance growth velocity and unit economics with customer value, craft quality, trust, accessibility, and long-term experience health; know when to move quickly and when Coll or clarity cannot be compromised.

 - Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Marketing, and other teams to shape strategy, scope initiatives, make trade-offs, and deliver customer value. Respect, understand and incorporate varying perspectives in the work outputs.

 - Represent Design in roadmap, resourcing, timeline, and quality discussions, ensuring design has a meaningful voice from the beginning.

 - Support the KOHO Design System team through strategic direction, prioritization, critique, coaching, and cross-functional partnership, helping the system serve real product needs across app and web.

 - Build the operating practices, feedback loops, and decision frameworks that help teams move quickly, learn continuously, and scale quality.

 - Identify the capabilities KOHO needs as the organization grows and help attract, hire, onboard, and develop the designers and design leaders who will build them.

 - Use AI-enabled tools responsibly to accelerate exploration, synthesis, prototyping, design-system maintenance, communication, and decision-making while applying strong human judgment.
 

WHO YOU ARE

 - You have 8+ years experience designing and shipping consumer-facing digital products, ideally across mobile and web, in fintech, financial services, or another complex domain.

 - You bring significant experience leading and developing product design teams (4+ years), including designers working on ambiguous, high-impact, or consequential problems.

 - You have meaningful zero-to-one and/or growth experience. You have helped teams discover opportunities, launch new experiences, improve acquisition or activation, and learn through experimentation rather than relying only on intuition or incremental optimization.

 - You understand growth as a product and design problem, not simply a funnel or conversion problem. You can connect customer motivation, product value, trust, behavior, and business outcomes.

 - You have deep design-systems expertise and have helped build, scale, govern, adopt, or materially evolve a design system used by multiple teams.

 - You operate with strong agency and sound judgment. You can create clarity without waiting for perfect information, make decisions with appropriate context, and know when to involve others.

 - You have expertise influencing product strategy, roadmap decisions, scope, and prioritization through clear communication and customer-centered reasoning.

 - You build strong, trust-based relationships with Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners.

 - You are an excellent communicator who can create alignment across designers, Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Marketing, and senior leadership.

 - You are comfortable using modern AI tools to accelerate workflows, explore more possibilities, prototype, and increase the scale of your impact while applying sound judgment around privacy and quality.

 - You scale your impact of craft, quality, judgement, AI-leveage, and elevate those you lead and those around you

The budgeted salary range for this role is $170,000 - 220,000 CAD / year. 

At KOHO, we are dedicated to providing pay transparency to all candidates. Compensation at KOHO is determined through various factors including but not limited to: comparable salary market data within Canada, technical skill assessment, a holistic view of previous work history, and internal pay equity with other KOHO team members.

DESCRIPTION DE POSTE EN FRANÇAIS

À PROPOS DU RÔLE

À titre de gestionnaire principal(e) du design de produit, vous dirigerez le design au sein d’un portefeuille complexe qui réunit deux défis très différents, mais profondément liés : aider les équipes à créer et à développer de nouvelles expériences client, et bâtir les systèmes qui permettent de déployer un design de grande qualité à l’échelle de KOHO.

Vous dirigerez et développerez des designers de produit œuvrant dans la création d'expériences de toutes pièces (« zero-to-one »), la croissance, l’accueil (« onboarding ») et d’autres occasions de produit à fort impact. En parallèle, vous assurerez un leadership stratégique auprès de l’équipe du système de design de KOHO pour l'aider à évoluer en tant que fondation pratique, adoptée et de haute qualité sur l'application web et mobile.

Ce rôle s’adresse à un(e) leader en design capable de naviguer aisément entre l’ambiguïté et la mise à l’échelle. Vous aiderez les équipes à transformer des occasions incertaines en orientations de produit claires, à concevoir des expériences générant de vrais apprentissages et à faire des compromis judicieux entre rapidité d'exécution, qualité, confiance des clients et cohérence de l’expérience à long terme. Vous saurez également reconnaître quand une solution doit être testée localement et quand elle doit devenir un modèle réutilisable qui améliore l’ensemble du produit.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec la gestion de produit, l'ingénierie, les données, la recherche, le marketing et d’autres équipes fonctionnelles. Dans le cadre du partenariat entre les équipes de produit, de design et d’ingénierie de KOHO, vous façonneza la stratégie, apporterez de la clarté entre plusieurs équipes et réhausserez la qualité de l’expérience sans rendre les équipes dépendantes de processus rigides ou d’approbation centrale.

VOS RESPONSABILITÉS

 - Diriger et développer des designers de produit au sein de plusieurs équipes ou d’un sous-ensemble vaste et complexe, en créant les conditions propices à leur épanouissement, à une prise de décision confiante et à la réalisation d’un travail d’exception.

 - Établir une direction de design claire pour les initiatives de création (« zero-to-one ») et de croissance, en aidant les équipes à passer d’occasions ambiguës à des expériences de produit attrayantes et à des apprentissages mesurables, afin d'accélérer la mission de KOHO de devenir la banque de choix pour tous les Canadiens, sur l'application web et mobile.

 - Encadrer les équipes à travers l’expérimentation, en utilisant les informations client, la recherche, les données, les prototypes et les résultats produit pour déterminer quoi bâtir, quoi tester et quoi modifier ensuite.

 - Équilibrer la rapidité de la croissance et la rentabilité unitaire avec la valeur client, la qualité de réalisation, la confiance, l’accessibilité et la pérennité de l’expérience; savoir quand agir rapidement et quand la clarté ou la qualité ne peuvent être compromises.

 - Collaborer avec les équipes de produit, d'ingénierie, de données, de recherche, de marketing et d’autres équipes pour façonner la stratégie, définir la portée des initiatives, faire des compromis et offrir de la valeur aux clients. Respecter, comprendre et intégrer des perspectives variées dans les livrables.

 - Représenter l’équipe de design lors des discussions sur la feuille de route, le recrutement, les échéanciers et la qualité, en veillant à ce que le design ait une voix influente dès le départ.

 - Soutenir l’équipe du système de design de KOHO par le biais d'orientations stratégiques, de priorisation, de critiques constructives, de mentorat et de partenariats transversaux, afin que le système réponde aux besoins réels des produits sur le web et l’application.

 - Établir les pratiques opérationnelles, les boucles de rétroaction et les cadres décisionnels qui aident les équipes à avancer rapidement, à apprendre en continu et à maintenir la qualité à grande échelle.

 - Identifier les compétences dont KOHO aura besoin au fur et à mesure que l’organisation grandit, et participer à l'attraction, à l'embauche, à l'intégration et au développement des designers et des leaders en design qui les bâtiront.

 - Utiliser les outils basés sur l’intelligence artificielle de manière responsable pour accélérer l’exploration, la synthèse, le prototypage, la maintenance du système de design, la communication et la prise de décision, tout en appliquant un jugement humain rigoureux.
 
 

VOTRE PROFIL

 - Vous possédez plus de 8+ ans d’expérience dans la conception et le lancement de produits numériques destinés aux consommateurs (idéalement sur mobile et web) dans le secteur des technologies financières (fintech), des services financiers ou un autre domaine complexe.

 - Vous comptez une expérience significative dans la gestion et le développement d’équipes de design de produit (4 ans et plus), incluant le soutien à des designers travaillant sur des enjeux ambigus, à fort impact ou déterminants.

 - Vous avez une solide expérience dans la création de produits (« zero-to-one ») ou en croissance. Vous avez aidé des équipes à découvrir des occasions, à lancer de nouvelles expériences, à améliorer l’acquisition ou l’activation, et à apprendre par l’expérimentation plutôt que de vous fier uniquement à l’intuition ou à l’optimisation incrémentale.

 - Vous percevez la croissance comme un défi de produit et de design, et pas simplement comme un problème de tunnel de conversion. Vous savez lier la motivation des clients, la valeur du produit, la confiance, le comportement et les résultats d'affaires.

 - Vous détenez une expertise approfondie des systèmes de design et avez contribué à bâtir, mettre à l'échelle, régir, faire adopter ou faire évoluer de manière tangible un système utilisé par plusieurs équipes.

 - Vous faites preuve d’une grande autonomie et d’un jugement sûr. Vous savez apporter de la clarté sans attendre d'avoir une information parfaite, prendre des décisions avec le contexte approprié et savoir quand impliquer les autres.

 - Vous avez l'habitude d'influencer la stratégie de produit, les décisions relatives à la feuille de route, la portée des projets et la priorisation grâce à une communication claire et un raisonnement centré sur le client.

 - Vous bâtissez des relations solides et fondées sur la confiance avec vos partenaires interfonctionnels des équipes de produit, d'ingénierie, de données, de recherche et de marketing.

 - Vous êtes un(e) excellent(e) communicateur(trice) capable de rassembler et d'aligner les designers, la gestion de produit, l'ingénierie, les données, la recherche, le marketing et la haute direction.

 - Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’utilisation des outils modernes d’IA pour accélérer vos flux de travail, explorer davantage de possibilités, prototyper et amplifier votre impact, tout en appliquant un sens aigu du jugement concernant la confidentialité et la qualité.

 - Vous démultipliez l'impact de votre savoir-faire, de votre exigence de qualité, de votre jugement et de votre utilisation de l'IA, tout en élevant les membres de votre équipe et les collègues qui vous entourent.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer - Finance
jobs.description:
BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work.

THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

We’re looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to join Kraken’s Finance Data Eng & Analytics team within Data Platform. You’ll build trusted financial data products, using automation and AI to reduce manual work and improve the close process.

Working at the intersection of data engineering and accounting, you’ll turn complex financial data into reliable pipelines, models and automated reconciliations. You’ll use AI-assisted tools to accelerate development and investigations, keeping financial outputs tested and traceable.

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - You’ll work closely with Data Engineers, Finance and Platform Accounting to improve reporting and decision-making. Clear communication and collaboration will help you agree priorities, explain findings and drive adoption.

 - Partner with Finance to understand workflows, identify pain points and translate business needs into practical data and automation solutions.

 - Build and maintain automated workflows for data preparation, reconciliations, reporting and follow-ups, with clear controls, monitoring and exception handling.

 - Build intuitive dashboards and visualizations that help stakeholders understand performance, investigate issues and make decisions.

 - Resolve finance data issues and reconciliation breaks with Finance, Product and Engineering, addressing root causes and communicating progress.

 - Build scalable, reliable pipelines to collect, transform and curate data from internal platforms and external systems.

 - Support the design and rollout of a trusted finance data lake, with clear definitions, ownership and quality checks.

 - Improve data timeliness, enabling near-real-time insights where they add business value.

 - Evaluate new technologies, including AI-assisted automation, and prototype solutions to Finance needs that can be reliably supported in production.

 

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 7+ years of experience in data analytics and data management within financial services or a regulated industry, working directly with Finance teams.

 - Strong SQL and Python skills, including writing, debugging and maintaining production code.

 - Solid experience with Git, merge requests, and code reviews, supported by strong software engineering practices, including testing and documentation.

 - Hands-on experience building and operating pipelines and models using dbt, Spark, Airflow or comparable tools.

 - Direct experience with finance or accounting data, such as reconciliations, subledgers, cost basis or month-end close, including investigating discrepancies and validating outputs with accounting stakeholders.

 - A track record of owning pipelines end to end, making sound technical decisions and improving reliability as requirements and systems evolve.

 - Judgment and autonomy to lead complex work, navigate ambiguity and remain accountable for production outcomes.

 - Experience supporting recurring financial close activities, combined with a proactive approach to identifying manual processes and replacing them with reliable, sustainable automation.

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across Engineering and Finance, explain complex technical issues, articulate financial implications, and recommend actionable solutions.

 

NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with cryptocurrency transaction data and how digital-asset activity flows into financial records and reconciliations.

 - Experience processing large volumes of financial transactions using distributed frameworks such as Spark or PySpark.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

OUR COMMITMENT

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Connect on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/kraken-exchange/

Kraken Pro is where serious traders live. Millions of them. But a great product only wins if the right traders find it, trust it, and actually fund an account. Right now, our organic engine isn’t pulling its weight.

You’re going to fix that.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re seeking a hands-on Head of Organic Growth to own how Kraken Pro gets discovered and how curious traders become active ones. At Kraken, understanding our brand ethos, mission, and the traders we serve is essential. Organic is where brand and acquisition meet.

We’re looking for a player-coach who moves fast but thinks long-term, gets in the weeds while leading from the front, and knows that traffic means nothing if it doesn’t convert. This role demands sharp B2C acquisition instincts, a product-first mindset, an obsession with UX, and a self-starter attitude.

 - Own organic acquisition. Build and run the strategy across SEO, content, social, community, referrals, and partnerships to bring high-intent traders to Kraken Pro.

 - Find out if people convert. Map the funnel from first touch to first trade, report on it clearly, and figure out where traders drop off and how to win them back.

 - Make UX your edge. Work with Product and Design to audit and improve landing pages, sign-up flows, onboarding, and in-product moments. Great acquisition dies in bad UX, and you know it.

 - Acquire through brand. Make every growth channel a brand-building one. Reach is easy to buy; trust is what makes traders stay.

 - Know the product cold. Use Kraken Pro like a trader would, understand what makes it better, and turn those strengths into growth levers.

 - Lead a lean, scrappy team. Set direction, coach, and unblock a small team, while staying hands-on enough to ship, test, and fix things yourself.

 - Test and learn. Run experiments across channels and funnel steps, double down on what works, and kill what doesn’t.

 - Report what matters. Build clear dashboards and insights that show leadership what’s driving growth, what isn’t, and what to do next.

 - Ship responsibly. Partner with Legal/Comms to ensure compliant, accurate, and aligned messaging across regions and platforms.
 
 

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 5+ years in B2C acquisition or growth marketing, ideally in fintech, crypto, trading or gaming with experience in a player-coach role leading a small team.

 - Product savvy. You understand how products work, why people use them, and how to turn features into growth.

 - UX instinct. You can spot friction in a flow from a mile away and brief Product and Design on how to fix it.

 - High AI competency. Enabling you to multiply your impact and keep up with demand.

 - Analytical rigor. Comfortable with funnels, cohorts, attribution, and experimentation, and able to turn data into decisions and clear stories.

 - Speed under pressure. Markets don’t wait for approval cycles and neither do you.

 - Range as a marketer. SEO, content, social, lifecycle, partnerships. You know enough about each to direct the work, and you can roll up your sleeves when needed.

 - Taste. Knowing which channels and tactics not to pursue is as valuable as knowing which to scale.

 - Familiarity trading culture, and the language traders use.

 - Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to align cross-functional teams around a shared growth goal.

jobs.description:
BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work.

THE TEAM

Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.

Payward's Payments & Blockchain team owns the first and last mile of every dollar that moves in or out of its products. That means dozens of banking partners, PSPs and local rails powering deposits and withdrawals for millions of users.

The team is looking for a product manager to shape the future of this platform, from the architecture underneath to the API layer internal clients build on. At the center is Payward's in-house PSP: a scalable, multi-tenant payments backend with hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs, so any Payward business can plug in and reach pay-in and payout rails worldwide.

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Own the product vision and roadmap for the Payward payments platform, covering both the shared backend and the integration surfaces internal clients build on (hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs)

 - Map requirements across internal clients and use them to evolve the platform's vision and capabilities so it serves a growing range of use cases

 - Partner with engineering to turn the target vision into a sequenced, high-impact roadmap, with milestones every client team can plan against

 - Prioritize across competing client needs, make the trade-offs visible, and say no with a clear rationale

 - Shape the client experience end to end, from first conversation to go-live, so teams can adopt the platform without heavy hand-holding

 - Work with the banking and partnerships teams so each new PSP or bank integration is built once on the platform and reaches every Payward business

 - Bring compliance, risk and legal requirements across Payward's entities and jurisdictions into the roadmap early, before they become launch blockers

 - Set and track platform success metrics, such as time to launch a rail for an existing client, time for a new client to go live, share of rails available through the platform, and payment success rates

 
 

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in a platform, API or infrastructure role where your customers were other internal teams or developers

 - Working knowledge of payments: pay-ins and payouts, PSPs and acquirers, bank rails (ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT and local methods), and how money flows between them

 - Strong technical fluency. You can read an RFC, challenge an architecture decision, and write an API spec that engineers respect

 - Experience shipping developer-facing products such as APIs, SDKs, or embeddable UI components

 - Clear, structured writing. You turn complex system designs into docs that product, compliance and business stakeholders can all act on

 - Skill at managing many stakeholders with different priorities, and building alignment without direct authority

 - Comfort working with data to set goals and measure platform adoption and performance

 
 

NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience at a PSP, payment orchestrator or payments infrastructure company, or building one in-house

 - Background with multi-tenant SaaS or B2B2C platforms

 - Familiarity with crypto, stablecoins or on/off-ramps

 - Experience working across multiple regulated legal entities or licensing regimes

If you are ready to take on this challenging and impactful role, we look forward to your application.

 - Review and evaluate incoming subpoenas, court orders, and other global legal document requests to verify their legitimacy and authority.

 - Determine the scope of records requested and coordinate directly with serving agencies to clarify scope, format, and required deadlines.

 - Research Kraken's internal systems thoroughly to identify and compile the records responsive to each request, in line with global laws and regulations.

 - Log and maintain accurate, detailed records of every request and communication in Kraken's law enforcement request management platform (Kodex), from intake through closure.

 - Follow up as needed with serving agencies and internal departments to keep requests moving and deadlines on track.

 - Support departmental projects related to legal request processing, including maintaining procedures and preparing management information reporting as assigned.

 - Understand and adhere to Kraken's risk and regulatory standards, policies, and controls; identify and escalate risk where appropriate.

 - Partner with Compliance, Legal, Corporate Security, and other Kraken teams to answer questions and resolve issues tied to subpoenas and other record requests.

 - Escalate complex or sensitive issues to management promptly, maintaining confidentiality throughout.

 - Contribute feedback to ongoing improvements in the internal policies and processes that govern how legal document requests are handled.

 

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 2+ years of experience at a crypto exchange, financial services company, law enforcement/regulatory liaison role, or as a paralegal, preferred.

 - Familiarity with U.S. and/or European court systems is a plus

 - High level of comfort with technology and computer systems, including intermediate proficiency with MacOS, Microsoft and Google applications.

 - Excellent organizational and time-management skills with the ability to plan, prioritize, and track a high volume of concurrent requests without letting details slip.

 - Detail oriented and able to communicate with tact and professionalism.

 - Comfortable working under tight, often shifting deadlines across multiple concurrent requests.

 - Takes ownership of their work product and consistently delivers results.

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We're looking for a Head of Exchange Infrastructure to own the layer every Kraken product is built on: the matching engine, core infrastructure, third-party custody, the algo engine and the API engine. Kraken grew up as a set of vertically integrated products, each with its own engine and its own APIs. This role consolidates them into a single exchange stack that serves every product and every interface. You will lead a team of four to five product managers, partnered with an engineering manager. It is a senior, independent team, which means you get leverage quickly and you are expected to stay close to the work.

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Own the product vision and roadmap for the exchange layer: matching engine, core infrastructure, third-party custody, algo engine and API engine

 - Lead and grow a team of four to five product managers, and set the bar for product craft across the layer

 - Lead the consolidation of multiple matching engines into one, starting with US derivatives, then international derivatives, then spot

 - Build interface-agnostic, so every product team and every interface can build on the same platform rather than their own

 - Define success metrics (p99 latency, throughput, uptime, resiliency) and hold teams accountable to them

 - Partner with engineering leaders across exchange and core infrastructure to sequence the migration without disrupting live markets

 - Partner with Risk and Credit Infrastructure so a client can hold one account and trade every product against it

 - Anticipate industry shifts and shape our platform to stay ahead

 - Align cross-functional teams (product, engineering, risk, compliance) around the exchange strategy

 

WHAT YOU BRING

 - Senior product leader with experience in exchange, trading, or high-performance platforms

 - Experience managing and developing product managers, on a team senior enough to run without you in the room

 - Happy to be a player-coach. This team is independent, so you will own roadmaps and write specs yourself at times, not only review them

 - Proven ability to set product vision and translate it into a long-term roadmap

 - Strong understanding of matching engine and market data architecture, and the tradeoffs low latency forces

 - Experience building platforms for internal customers, with the judgment to tell a platform from a series of bespoke builds

 - Excellent communication skills — can influence technical and non-technical stakeholders

 - A passion for crypto markets, market structure, and building the next generation of infrastructure

 

NICE TO HAVES

 - Engineering background before moving into product, so you've built or operated high-performance systems yourself and not just specced them

 - Experience across both spot and derivatives venues, with the market structure differences that come with each

 - Time at a crypto exchange operating at comparable scale, volume and uptime expectations

 - Track record building platform roadmaps that interlock with adjacent product orgs rather than running in isolation

The Pro Verifications team decides whether a business signing up on the Pro side is who it says it is, and whether we're allowed to onboard it. That means figuring out who actually owns the business, running it against sanctions and watchlists, and doing all of it fast enough that a real customer doesn't lose patience and leave. Every Pro customer hits these systems, so slow or wrong is very visible — and the team is early, which means whoever joins gets to decide how a lot of it works instead of inheriting it.

How We Work

 - We deploy constantly, almost always behind a flag, in pieces small enough to pull back fast.

 - Security and compliance show up at design time, not as a gate at the end.

 - Every story is tied to a metric it's meant to move — if work isn't on the board, it doesn't get staffed.

 - At this level, you're expected to shape these standards, not just work inside them.

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Staff Engineer on Pro Verifications, you'll own the technical direction for how verification is built here — the architecture, the patterns other engineers work inside, and the calls about what we own versus what we lean on a vendor for. You'll be hands-on across the stack, drive out entire classes of recurring failure rather than patching them one at a time, and design the fail-closed and audit behavior that keeps regulators satisfied.

This is a high-impact, hands-on technical leadership role for engineers who've built where being wrong has real consequences, and who want to shape a system that stays fast, safe, and defensible as it grows.

 - Set the shape of the verification services and their contracts across the KYC/KYB flow.

 - Decide how we abstract KYC and KYB vendors so a bad provider day doesn't turn into an outage.

 - Design fail-closed behavior and audit trails that hold up under regulatory scrutiny.

 - Identify the classes of failure that keep recurring and remove them for good.

 - Write and drive architecture decisions (ADRs), and hold the line on security and compliance at design time, not as a late gate.

 - Mentor and raise the bar for senior engineers through design reviews, code, and direct feedback.

 - Be measured on whether verification gets faster, more of it decides itself, fewer decisions are wrong, and the systems stay up — and on whether the team got stronger for you being on it.

 

WHAT YOU BRING

 - Around eight years building and running production systems, with a track record of owning a domain's technical direction, not just delivering inside one.

 - Deep, fluent expertise in Rust, with the versatility to work across TypeScript and React where verification meets the customer.

 - You've set architecture other people build on, and it held up — you can point to specific classes of failure you designed out, not just incidents you fixed.

 - You've made teams faster through patterns, tooling, or mentoring — engineers around you got better and shipped more because of calls you made.

 - You've built where being wrong had real consequences: compliance, payments, security, or anywhere a bad call costs more than a rough user experience.

 - Strong on distributed systems, service contracts, and secure design — you've integrated third-party APIs that couldn't be trusted, with real timeouts, retries, idempotency, circuit breakers, and backup paths that actually get tested.

 - Comfortable with, or able to quickly ramp on, gRPC, Temporal, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, MySQL/MariaDB, Redis, and GitLab CI.

 

NICE TO HAVES

 - Direct experience with KYC, KYB, or fraud work, including integrating providers like Trulioo, Persona, or ComplyAdvantage.

jobs.description:
BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work.

THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Enterprise Transformation owns Kraken's internal AI platform. AI tooling is deployed at scale across the org. Tiered spend controls are live, a governed integration gateway is in production, and a system inventory is being built against real regulatory obligations. The next constraint is not access. It's capability. The frontier moves every few weeks, and most of what arrives is a protocol, API, or primitive that someone has to turn into something the rest of the company can safely use.

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Design and build the technical layer of the AI platform, from integration surface to production runbook. Identify capability gaps between what's possible and what the organization can safely use, then close them by evaluating vendors or building internally.

 - Own the governed integration gateway as an engineering surface. You'll handle connector onboarding, authentication flows including OAuth and federated identity, reliability, and vendor escalation when things break.

 - Build internal tooling that extends the platform. Think agent scaffolding, reusable skills and prompt assets, evaluation harnesses for model changes, provisioning automation, and integrations between AI tooling and your systems of record.

 - Configure and operate tiered spend controls across the AI estate. Set caps by role and tier, build alerting rules, manage exception queues, run monthly reconciliation against vendor commitments, and eliminate the current single author risk in cap automation.

 - Implement the technical controls behind policy on data handling, retention, and model eligibility. This means identity integration, SSO and SCIM, entitlement by role and tier, and workspace configuration where retention terms differ by model class.

 - Work directly with teams to unblock them. Sit with them, understand the workflow, build or configure the thing that enables them to get real leverage from the tools.

 - Run technical enablement. Deep dives for tool rollouts, office hours for model releases, and authority over the engineering detail in knowledge base material.

 - Administer the enterprise AI estate end to end. Model turn ups, feature enablement, deprecation, provisioning queue, vendor configurations, and seat true ups.

 

WHAT YOU BRING

 - Enterprise SaaS administration at 1,000+ seats, ideally including an AI or LLM platform.

 - Demonstrated ability to build and ship working software, not just configure vendor products. Python or a comparable language should be natural to you. Version control, CI, containers, and secrets management are everyday tools.

 - Experience integrating against LLM and SaaS APIs with working familiarity of agent and tool use patterns, including MCP or equivalent tool calling architectures.

 - Working knowledge of identity and access. Okta or an equivalent IdP, OAuth, SCIM, SSO, and federated machine identity are things you've worked with.

 - Operational discipline. You understand intake queues, SLAs, runbooks, escalation hygiene, and the instinct to document a fix the first time you make it.

 - Genuine teaching ability. You can explain a technical capability three different ways on the same day to compliance, traders, and backend engineers.

 - Clear written communication for technical documentation, runbooks, and policy pages.

 - Judgment about what to build. You can tell the difference between a capability the organization actually needs and a demo that will be abandoned in a month.

 

NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience standing up an internal developer or AI platform, including the self service and guardrail layers.

 - Exposure to FinOps or software asset management practice.

 - Experience with low code or workflow automation platforms.

 - Atlassian administration depth in Jira, Confluence, or JSM.

 - Familiarity with regulated industry audit and evidence work in financial services.

requirements:

 - A product-building mindset with strong product judgment. You start with the client problem rather than the ticket, understand what we're actually trying to solve, know when to challenge requirements or simplify solutions, and work with Product and Design to turn ambiguous requirements into strong engineering solutions.

 - Evidence of product impact. You can explain not only what you've built, but why you built it and what happened afterwards. You're comfortable using metrics, experimentation and client behaviour to evaluate the impact of your work.

jobs.description:
BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work.

THE TEAM

Derivatives and Trading products sit in one of the most heavily regulated and fastest-moving parts of Payward's regulatory perimeter, and the estate is still expanding across a US venue and clearing stack, a UK venue, EEA distribution and a Bermuda entity. Today that work is owned in fragments. This is a net-new, function-owning role created to put global derivatives structuring strategy to a single senior owner. This DGC will be responsible for the global suite of derivatives products as well as Payward’s trading products.

Products. Futures and options across the group, and margin in the US, and a set of trading products, including but not limited to leveraged and liquidity products, prediction markets, indices and market data, evaluation-based trading services and structured yield. The DGC will help define the delineation of these products between the new function and the existing Product Legal team.

Entities and regulators. A US venue and clearing stack (FCM/NFA, DCM, DCO), a UK FCA-authorised derivatives venue, EEA derivatives distribution under CySEC permissions, and a Bermuda DABA entity serving the rest of world and others. The general counsel of our acquired US futures brokerage (NinjaTrader) reports into this function.

Team. Senior derivatives and trading counsel across the US, UK and EEA, with the function set to grow, and the general counsel of the acquired US futures brokerage.

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Own global derivatives structuring strategy — product structure, venue and entity architecture, clearing models, and how a single coherent derivatives offering is delivered to clients across several separately licensed entities.

 - Together with Payward’s Regulatory Legal team, solve the cross-entity problems that sit in no single product — hub-and-spoke architecture, unified balances, cross-margining, and where risk and client relationships actually sit across the group. These are the hardest questions we answer.

 - Be the named senior legal owner for the derivatives and trading product lines, wired into the product launch process from the start rather than consulted at the end, and the single senior route into Legal for derivatives and trading.

 - Lead and build the team — hire, level and develop senior derivatives counsel across jurisdictions, and build depth and succession into a function that is currently thin at the top.

 - Partner with Global Policy and Government Relations as the senior legal counterpart for derivatives regulatory engagement with the CFTC, NFA, FCA, BMA, CySEC and others, pre-socialising positions with regulators and internal leadership before they land, not after.

 - Support the supervised estates that carry derivatives permissions, working with Regulatory Legal on continuous supervisory relationships and on new permissions and variations tied to product launches.

 - Bring structuring judgement in-house, and direct external counsel where genuinely specialist input is required.

 - Additional duties and responsibilities as assigned

 

WHAT YOU BRING

 - Attorney admitted to practice in the US, or qualified lawyer (Solicitor/Barrister of England & Wales, Irish Solicitor/Barrister, or equivalent admitted in an EU Member State).

 - 18+ years’ post-qualification experience (PQE) in financial services regulatory law gained at a regulated financial services institution, major liquidity provider or in a law firm/private practice supporting such clients, with demonstrated ability to independently own BAU regulatory workstreams.

 - Experience supporting regulator engagement (e.g., with the CFTC, NFA, FCA, Cysec, or an equivalent EU competent authority), including notifications, information requests, and supervisory correspondence.

 - Substantial senior in-house or equivalent experience in derivatives legal, with demonstrated ownership of structuring strategy rather than transactional execution alone.

 - Deep, expert-level command of at least one of the following derivatives regulatory regimes — US (CFTC, NFA; FCM, DCM and DCO structures), UK (FCA), EEA, or an offshore regime (e.g., Bermuda) — together with a high degree of fluency in at least one other. No single regime is treated as the required one; what matters is genuine mastery of one and strong working command of a second.

 - Direct experience with virtual asset markets. This combination is scarce and it is the core of the role.

 - Experience structuring a product offering across multiple licensed entities in different jurisdictions, and holding a view on where activity, risk and the client relationship should sit.

 - A track record of building or materially scaling a legal function or team, including hiring, levelling and succession.

 - The range to operate at function level, setting strategy for the function as a whole, organising it to stay ahead of the regulatory perimeter, and holding senior lawyers to account for results and behaviour, not only for output.

 - Credibility with regulators and the judgement to take positions in front of them.

 - Comfort operating as the senior legal voice in a fast-moving, product-led business where the regulatory perimeter changes underneath you, and comfort staying close to the work rather than managing at a distance.

 

NICE TO HAVES

 - Exposure to prediction markets, margin lending, or tokenized and structured products.

 - Experience integrating acquired regulated entities, and their legal teams, into a group legal function.

jobs.description:
BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work.

 

THE TEAM

Kraken's Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design. We turn growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, and we hold the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

As our Staff Brand Designer, you come to the table with a strong design vision and set the visual standard for Kraken. You design static and 3D work for launches, campaigns and always-on activity, and you make sure it looks like one brand wherever someone meets it. You can take a brief or proactive idea to a finished, approved asset set, and you're equally comfortable building a clean, systemized layout in Figma and modeling and rendering a hero 3D asset in Cinema 4D. 

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and ownership: you set the bar for brand and 3D quality on the team, you build systems others can work from, and you're the person colleagues come to with design questions.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design static 2D and 3D creative for Kraken Consumer and Krak across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

 - Concept, model, light, texture and render 3D assets in Cinema 4D, from hero visuals to reusable asset libraries and templates.

 - Apply and extend the Kraken Consumer brand across surfaces, from organic social, lifecycle and web to illustration and foundational projects like key visual updates, keeping everything cohesive and recognizable without making it repetitive.

 - Design initiative-specific work, including a distinct look and partner-branded assets for launches such as IPOs, and purpose-built illustration for go-to-market and product moments.

 - Build scalable systems: Figma component libraries, marketing templates and modular campaign kits with localization-ready layouts, so other designers, other teams and our automated workflows can produce on-brand work quickly.

 - Use AI-assisted production as a core part of how the brand gets made, and know when it speeds the work up and when it doesn't.

 - Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Push back with a point of view when a brief is unclear or the idea can be stronger.

 - Version and localize work across markets, languages and formats, with layouts that hold up under translation and market-specific requirements.

 - Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.

 - Collaborate closely with our motion, web, performance and AI video designers so 3D and static work travels well across formats.

 - Hold a high craft bar on your own work and give clear, constructive feedback on others'.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 7+ years of brand, static and 3D design experience at a high-volume in-house team or agency, ideally in fintech, crypto or another regulated category (a competitor or similar company is a big plus).

 - A portfolio that proves it, submitted with your application. Include the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you're able to share it. We'd like to see brand and static work, at least one 3D piece with a short note on your process, an example of work you adapted for multiple formats or markets, and an example of a system or template set that other people built from.

 - Command of Cinema 4D and the surrounding 3D workflow (modeling, lighting, materials, rendering), with shipped work to show for it.

 - Be the fastest voice in the room. When a chain halts, a listing drops, or the market goes vertical, you're posting before the screenshots start circulating. Speed with accuracy, not vibes.

 - Build the inner circle. Stand up an ambassador and power-user program: the market makers, quant desks, and high-volume traders who'll tell you the truth about the product. Give them a reason to stay loud.

 - Run the room in public. AMAs, live trading sessions, feature launches, competitions, post-mortems when we get something wrong. Own the format, don't just attend it.

 - Close the loop with Product. You'll be the first to hear that the order entry flow is broken. Your job is to get it to the PM with receipts, then go back and tell the community what happened.

 - Write things people screenshot. Threads on microstructure, teardowns of new features, release notes that don't read like release notes.

 - Prove it worked. Sentiment, share of voice, community-sourced signups, retention of the accounts that matter. You bring the numbers to the table before anyone asks.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - You trade. Actual positions, actual scars. You can hold a conversation about funding rates, maker/taker economics, slippage, and latency without reaching for a glossary.

 - 3+ years running community or social for a product with a technical, skeptical audience. Crypto, fintech, gaming, or dev tools all count.

 - You write fast and well. Short-form that lands, long-form that holds up under scrutiny from people smarter than the average follower.

 - You have thick skin and good instincts. Crypto community management means getting yelled at with an audience watching. You de-escalate without going corporate and you know when to push back.

 - You've built something from a standing start, not just maintained an existing account.

 - You operate without a brief. Markets don't wait for approval chains, and neither should you… because you know where the line is and you don't need a committee to find it.

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. Growth at Kraken is being rebuilt around an AI-native platform. Instead of people manually building audiences, writing copy, adjusting budgets, and scheduling sends, agents find opportunities, make decisions, and execute across paid, organic, and lifecycle channels. They learn from every result and keep going.

People still run the system. Operators use a central hub to set the rules the agents follow, review and approve what they produce, and handle exceptions when something doesn’t fit. The platform also has to work across many markets and languages, and it operates in a regulated industry, so there are compliance checks and approval steps built in.

The team is a small, cross-functional group of growth, product, and engineering people who build this platform and run it day to day. We ship often, learn fast, and raise the quality bar with every release. You will work most closely with the engineers building the platform, the product team defining how operators use it, and the operators who rely on it every day. QA and operations is how the whole team knows the platform can be trusted.

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

You will own day-to-day operations and QA for our internal growth platform. You test it, catch problems before our customers do, keep approvals and exception queues moving, and report on how it’s performing. You will work closely with product, engineering and operators to make sure the platform works and keeps working.

 - This is a hands-on, detail-focused role. You will spend your days in the product, testing what’s new, checking what should already work, and writing up what you find so it gets fixed.

 - Test the platform regularly. Cover new releases, rule changes, and edge cases, and run regression checks to make sure existing features still work.

 - Find bugs and document them clearly, with steps to reproduce, severity, and impact. Follow them through until engineering fixes them and you’ve verified the fix.

 - Monitor platform performance and agent activity, flag anything that looks wrong, and escalate it to the right person.

 - Work the approval queues daily. Keep items moving and make sure nothing is left unreviewed.

 - Check agent output against defined checklists and standards, and escalate anything unclear or risky.Note where flows are confusing or inconsistent, and flag them to the team.

 - Write and maintain documentation: test plans, QA checklists, runbooks, and release notes.

 

WHAT YOU BRING

 - Experience in QA, testing, operations, support, or analytics, ideally on a software product or complex system

 - Exceptional attention to detail. You notice what others miss and double-check your work.

 - A structured approach to testing. You can create and follow a test plan, and think about what could break.

 - Clear written communication. Your bug reports and documentation should be easy for anyone to follow.

 - Comfort with data. You can read a dashboard and tell when a number looks off.

 - Fast learner. You pick up new tools and systems quickly and ask thoughtful questions.

 - AI-native habits. You use AI tools in your own work every day, and you’re curious about where they get things wrong.

 - Prompt engineering curiosity, you don't need to be an engineer, but you are willing to learn how to communicate with AI systems precisely and improve their outputs

 - Reliability. You keep to a routine, keep your queues clear, and tell people early when something is stuck.

 

NICE TO HAVES

Kraken’s VIP team supports the firm’s highest-value private clients: high-net-worth individuals who expect a premium, secure, and deeply tailored experience. We ensure Kraken remains the exchange of choice for VIPs through white-glove relationship management, personalized trading enablement, and high-impact benefits.

We are looking for a Head of VIP, Asia to lead and grow Kraken’s VIP presence across the region. This is a player-coach role: you will build and lead a small, high-performing team while personally owning strategic client relationships, originating new business, and shaping the regional growth playbook.

You will set the standard for how Kraken serves, retains, and grows its most valuable private clients in Asia. You will be equally comfortable in a senior client meeting, building an introducer network, coaching a relationship manager, hosting a VIP event, and partnering internally to remove the product or operational barriers that cost us high-value business.

Kraken’s VIP program is unique, and we intend to keep it that way. We don’t copy what other exchanges and desks do. You’ll take what makes our program different and adapt it to how Asia’s VIP clients actually trade, network, and build trust. That means testing new ideas, learning fast, dropping what doesn’t work, and scaling what does. If you’re bold, comfortable with ambiguity, and humble enough to fail fast and move on, this is your seat.

 
 

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Lead, coach, and develop VIP relationship managers in Asia; establish clear standards for client coverage, pipeline management, service quality, and commercial performance.

 - Build the operating model for VIP growth across Asia, including territory coverage, account segmentation, referral strategy, events, and performance reporting.

 - Own regional AOP growth, net deposits, client assets, trading volume, retention, and revenue performance.

 - Build a repeatable pipeline of qualified high-value clients through direct outreach, referrals, introducers, family offices, proprietary trading firms, OTC desks, miners, project treasuries, and high-volume traders.

 - Represent the voice of Asia’s VIP client base internally: identify competitive threats, regional market dynamics, product gaps, and opportunities that influence where private-client capital trades.

PERSONALLY OWN STRATEGIC CLIENT RELATIONSHIPS

jobs.description:
BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work.

THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken's Compliance Operations teams, including the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU), investigations and enhanced due diligence, are the front line of how Kraken detects and responds to financial crime. The systems they run on sit within Core Services Product, alongside the engineering teams who build them. That covers alert ingestion, case management, investigator tooling and a growing set of automation and AI tools.

 

This role owns the product for that investigation platform. That means how an alert is created, enriched, grouped and suppressed. How it becomes a case. How an investigator reaches and documents a decision. And how every step is evidenced to a regulator or auditor. You'll start with the FIU, where the workflows are most complex and the audit bar is highest, then extend the platform across Compliance Operations.

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Own the investigation-platform roadmap end to end. Sequence it and defend it, and re-sequence it when a regulator or the RCO raises a P0.

 - Define "done" before build starts. Write phased deliverables and acceptance criteria that Compliance signs off, and hold the line when scope moves.

 - Get requirements in before engineering starts. Build the intake between Compliance policy, monitoring rules and case management so that changes don't reach investigators before their workflows are ready.

 - Understand the process before building. Reconcile policy and SOPs against what investigators actually do and what the system actually does. Know the difference between a process fix and a technical one, and say which requests are in scope for engineering.

 - Understand the pipeline well enough to challenge it: ingestion, profile and transaction resolution, suppression and grouping logic, and reconciliation between vendor output and case management. Be able to walk an auditor through it with live examples.

 - Make auditability a first-class requirement: audit trail, data lineage, evidence retention, reviewer attribution, change-management controls, and validation of filtering and suppression logic.

 - Ship automation and AI into regulated workflows with controls that hold up in Compliance, IT and privacy audits. That means human-in-the-loop design, explainability and ongoing monitoring.

 - Run the operating rhythm: a shared forum with engineering and adjacent product managers, a regular stakeholder update, and one delivery status that everyone reads the same way.

 

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 4+ years of product management, including 2+ years on financial-crime systems such as transaction monitoring, investigations, case management, KYC/EDD or sanctions screening.

 - Working knowledge of how an AML programme is examined, including the questions regulators, internal audit and model validation ask about monitoring, filing and control systems.

 - The technical fluency to go deep on data flows and system design with engineers, and to spot when a design won't meet the requirement.

 - A track record of shipping internal tools or operational platforms that measurably changed how an operations team works.

 - Clear, concise writing, from PRDs and phase plans to audit walkthroughs and executive updates.

 - The judgement to tell a senior stakeholder a timeline isn't realistic because the requirements aren't written yet, and to keep the relationship intact.

 
 

NICE TO HAVES

 - Direct FIU experience, such as alert disposition, SAR/STR filing or leading investigators.

 - Crypto or digital-asset experience, such as blockchain analytics, wallet-level transaction analysis or focal vs counterparty logic.

 - Experience shipping AI or ML into a regulated investigative workflow, including the control design.

 - Build-vs-buy and vendor evaluation for monitoring or case-management tooling.

 - Experience with programmes that span jurisdictions (UK, EU/MiCA, US).

Kraken's Compliance Operations teams, including the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU), investigations and enhanced due diligence, are the front line of how Kraken detects and responds to financial crime. The systems they run on sit within Core Services Product, alongside the engineering teams who build them. That covers alert ingestion, case management, investigator tooling and a growing set of automation and AI tools.

This role owns the product for that investigation platform. That means how an alert is created, enriched, grouped and suppressed. How it becomes a case. How an investigator reaches and documents a decision. And how every step is evidenced to a regulator or auditor. You'll start with the FIU, where the workflows are most complex and the audit bar is highest, then extend the platform across Compliance Operations.

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Own the investigation-platform roadmap end to end. Sequence it and defend it, and re-sequence it when a regulator or the RCO raises a P0.

 - Define "done" before build starts. Write phased deliverables and acceptance criteria that Compliance signs off, and hold the line when scope moves.

 - Get requirements in before engineering starts. Build the intake between Compliance policy, monitoring rules and case management so that changes don't reach investigators before their workflows are ready.

 - Understand the process before building. Reconcile policy and SOPs against what investigators actually do and what the system actually does. Know the difference between a process fix and a technical one, and say which requests are in scope for engineering.

 - Understand the pipeline well enough to challenge it: ingestion, profile and transaction resolution, suppression and grouping logic, and reconciliation between vendor output and case management. Be able to walk an auditor through it with live examples.

 - Make auditability a first-class requirement: audit trail, data lineage, evidence retention, reviewer attribution, change-management controls, and validation of filtering and suppression logic.

 - Ship automation and AI into regulated workflows with controls that hold up in Compliance, IT and privacy audits. That means human-in-the-loop design, explainability and ongoing monitoring.

 - Run the operating rhythm: a shared forum with engineering and adjacent product managers, a regular stakeholder update, and one delivery status that everyone reads the same way.

 

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 4+ years of product management, including 2+ years on financial-crime systems such as transaction monitoring, investigations, case management, KYC/EDD or sanctions screening.

 - The technical fluency to go deep on data flows and system design with engineers, and to spot when a design won't meet the requirement.

THE TEAM

Payward Services (PWS) is the Infrastructure arm of Payward, the parent company of Kraken, whose businesses span trading, payments, custody, banking, asset management, and services. PWS gives regulated businesses direct API access to the infrastructure that has powered Kraken for 15+ years.

Payward holds 100+ regulatory licences, operates in 190+ jurisdictions, and processes $2T+ in annual volume. Payward has also applied for a national trust company charter to offer custody and trust services to institutional and high-net-worth clients across the U.S. The company is backed by strategic investors including Citadel Securities, Jane Street, Deutsche Börse, and Nasdaq.

Operated through Paywards’s regulated entities, custody combines segregated client accounts, institutional-grade key management and cold storage, independent audit and control reporting, and direct connectivity into Kraken's exchange, staking, and financing rails. Clients get the security posture of a dedicated custodian alongside the liquidity and product depth of one of the longest-running exchanges in crypto.

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

As Senior Sales Lead, Custody & Wealth Management, you will lead the go-to-market efforts for Payward custody offering, including qualified custody, across two motions:

Institutional custody sales: Sell to banks, neobanks, fintechs, payment companies, brokerages, exchanges, asset managers, and any business that needs regulated digital asset custody, globally.

B2B2C wealth solutions: Work with Product to design and launch embedded custody and digital asset solutions. Private banks, wealth managers, family offices, and platforms serving high-net-worth clients can offer these to their own clients under their own brand, alongside PWS staking, trading, payments, and tokenized assets.

You will report to the Global Head of Sales, Payward Services, as a senior individual contributor. You will work closely with Solution Engineering, Product, Legal, Compliance, and Onboarding, and act as the voice of the custody and wealth market in roadmap discussions.

Lead and help define the global GTM strategy for Custody across institutional segments, asset managers, ETF and fund issuers, hedge funds, market makers and prop firms, banks and wealth platforms, corporates and treasuries, family offices, token issuers and foundations, and exchanges requiring third-party custody. 

This role will be expected to:

 - Grow assets under custody and custody revenue as the primary outcomes, with clear ownership of targets, forecasting, and pipeline discipline

 - Develop commercial frameworks across custody, trading, and yield products including vaults and staking.

 - Lead revenue across a range of relationships from long cycle RFP driven enterprise mandates to mid-market motion for funds, corporates, and crypto-native clients who need to onboard fast.

 - Own the full client lifecycle from qualification and diligence through agreement negotiation, onboarding, and expansion into staking, trading, collateral, and settlement.

 - Build and scale a revenue growth in the custody and wealth management vertical across a global Sales and BD organization, with an AI-first approach to tooling, pipeline management, and operational efficiency.

 - Establish Payward as the default custodian across the institutional ecosystem, fund administrators, wealth managers, family offices, consultants, prime brokers, OTC desks, and the service providers who shape custodian space.

 - Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Finance to align commercial strategy with platform capability and the regulatory perimeter of each entity

 - Expand Payward’'s custody footprint across the UK, Europe, US and APAC and other priority markets, with a clear view on licensing constraints and how to sequence market entry

 - Feed the product roadmap with structured client demand: asset and chain coverage, staking, reporting and integrations, collateral mobility, and off-exchange settlement

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 7+ years of experience building and scaling B2B or B2B2C revenue organizations within digital asset custody, Wealth management, traditional custody and asset servicing, or regulated financial infrastructure

 - Proven track record closing and expanding complex, long-cycle mandates with institutional clients where security, regulatory, and operational diligence sit at the center of the buying decision

 - Deep understanding of the wealth management space, how institutions actually select a custodian, risk and investment committees, operational due diligence, asset segregation and bankruptcy remoteness, insurance, audit and control reporting, and multi-custodian mandates

 - Deep experience structuring custody economics: AUC-based pricing, minimums, revenue-share models, and multi-product commercial agreements

 - Strong commercial judgment, negotiation skills, and executive presence at the C-suite and board level

 - Experience building and leading high-performing global Sales and BD teams

 - Demonstrated ability to implement AI-first sales tooling, CRM discipline, and scalable go-to-market systems

 - International experience strongly preferred; US and European market knowledge

 - Genuine conviction in crypto and the future of financial market infrastructure or deep, transferable expertise from traditional custody, fund services, or prime brokerage with a clear path to crypto fluency

NICE TO HAVES

 - Direct experience selling qualified custody, staking, or prime brokerage services to institutional clients

 - Relationships across the institutional service provider ecosystem: fund administrators, auditors, consultants, transfer agents, and ETF issuers

 - Experience selling into token issuers, foundations, and protocol treasuries alongside traditional financial institutions

It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We are looking for a Deputy Regional Information Security Officer to own ICT security, operational resilience, and regulatory compliance across a portfolio of entities at different stages of maturity, from established licensed operations to new markets launching under frameworks. This is not a support function. You will be the named security officer for your entities, accountable to their boards and their regulators.

This is a high visibility, high trust role for a security governance professional who thrives at the intersection of technology, compliance, and financial services, and who is energised by applying established group frameworks to the local needs of a growing regulated entity.

Payward is one of the world's most trusted and secure digital asset platforms, operating across a growing network of regulated entities spanning Europe, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific. As we expand into new markets and deepen our regulatory footprint, the demand for embedded, senior-level ICT security leadership at the entity level has never been higher.

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Prepare, contribute and report to regional risk governance and board committee meetings, highlighting control status, risk exposure, and readiness

 - Execute risk assessments and control testing across UAE operations in line with VARA cybersecurity guidelines and security best practices

 - Maintain and review Business Impact Assessments (BIA), integrating findings into global resilience planning

 - Contribute to Business Continuity Plan (BCP) documentation, testing, and updates, including entity-specific scenarios

 - Collaborate with Group Security and IT to:
 
 - Align UAE-specific regulatory controls with global policies and control frameworks
 
 - Contribute to the development of security policies to meet international and UAE compliance requirements

 - Conduct security control validation and document evidence for internal/external audits

 - Prepare and present security and resilience reports for internal governance committees and local entity management

 - Liaise with compliance and legal teams to interpret regulatory changes and propose control adaptations

 - Participate in the regional incident response process, assist with post-incident reviews, and support continuous improvement activities

 - Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders to embed security requirements into operational processes

 - Act as the primary point of contact for VARA and other relevant regulatory authorities on ICT and security matters -- including examinations, inspections, licensing interactions, and ongoing supervisory dialogue
 
 - Support entity go live processes by implementing and localizing established group ICT governance frameworks for new market launches, ensuring they meet UAE regulatory requirements and entity specific needs
 
 - As the portfolio evolves, engage with additional regulatory frameworks with support from the broader RISO team

 - ICT Risk and Security
 
 - Lead ICT and security risk assessments for your appointed entity, escalating material risks through local governance and the Global RISO Lead
 
 - Maintain and adapt entity level policies and procedures to align with group standards and UAE regulatory requirements
 
 - Coordinate control testing, evidence documentation, and audit preparation with global security and compliance teams
 
 - Manage the classification, escalation, and regulatory reporting of ICT-related incidents within the timeframes required by applicable regulators

 - Operational Resilience
 
 - Lead business impact assessments, critical function mapping, and business continuity planning at the entity level
 
 - Oversee continuity and recovery testing, ensuring outputs meet regulatory expectations and feed back into global resilience planning
 
 - Maintain oversight of ICT third-party dependencies and outsourcing arrangements in line with regulatory requirements

 - Group Liaison

 - Drive local implementation of group frameworks, policies, and resilience standards, adapting them where jurisdiction-specific requirements demand
 
 - Represent entity priorities in group-led security initiatives and governance forums

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 7+ years of experience in information security governance, ICT risk management, or regulatory compliance in a regulated financial services, fintech, or virtual asset environment

 - Direct experience as a named regulatory contact, involvement in regulatory examinations, supervisory interactions, licensing processes, or equivalent

 - Familiarity with UAE regulatory frameworks. Experience with VARA or other virtual asset / crypto-native regulatory regimes is a significant advantage and strongly preferred

 - Demonstrated ability to implement, adapt, and maintain compliance or governance frameworks within a regulated environment

 - Experience conducting risk assessments, business impact analyses, and resilience planning at the entity level

 - Ability to translate technical risk into board-level narrative and regulatory-grade documentation

jobs.description:
BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
