THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We’re hiring a Product Manager with deep UX and interaction design expertise to build social experiences around investing and trading at Kraken.

You should be comfortable designing flows yourself, building interactive prototypes, and working through interaction details with designers and engineers. You’ll also own the product decisions: which customer problem to solve, what to ship first, and how to measure whether the experience improved.

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Design complete social journeys. Work through how someone discovers a person, decides to follow them, shares an idea or trade, receives a response, and returns. Connect these interactions into an experience users understand without explanation.

 - Make the interaction details work. Shape navigation, information hierarchy, copy, defaults, gestures, and feedback. Specify what happens when a feed is empty, a post fails, content loads slowly, or someone changes their mind.

 - Prototype before committing to a build. Turn ideas into interactive prototypes that communicate the intended behavior. Explore alternatives, test the uncertain parts, and give engineering clear flows, states, and acceptance criteria.

 - Use psychology to improve participation. Understand why people hesitate to post, seek recognition, follow strangers, or respond to others. Translate those motivations into decisions about audience visibility, prompts, reputation, feedback, and the effort required to contribute.

 - Observe users and fix what gets in their way. Run usability sessions, watch people complete tasks, and combine those observations with funnel data. Identify where people misunderstand the product, lose confidence, or abandon an action.

 - Design for first use and repeated use. Make the experience useful before someone has connections. Keep sharing lightweight during an active trading session, with clear control over what becomes public. Test the twentieth interaction as carefully as the first.

 - Connect design decisions to measurable outcomes. For each significant change, define the expected behavior and how to test it. Track task completion, abandonment, first follows, first contributions, responses, and subsequent retention. Work with data science to evaluate experiments and effects on both contributors and their audiences.

 - Take the experience through launch. Choose a focused initial scope, resolve trade-offs with engineering, review the implementation against the intended design, and use post-launch evidence to decide what to improve next.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - Has designed and shipped consumer social experiences. Your portfolio shows your contribution to feeds, profiles, sharing, messaging, discovery, or communities—and how the experience changed after launch.

 - Has strong interaction design craft. You can explain why a flow is structured a particular way, what users will notice first, what they need to understand, and which decisions or steps can be removed.

 - Can build realistic interactive prototypes. You use Figma, code, AI tools, or a combination to make behavior tangible and testable, including transitions, empty states, and failure states.

 - Understands behavior through evidence. You can show where user research challenged your assumptions and changed a design.

 - Can own product outcomes. You can prioritize a problem, define success, interpret funnel and cohort data, and explain whether an experiment produced a meaningful improvement.

 - Understands the context of social finance. You account for how credibility, incentives, reputation, and visibility of financial activity affect what people trust and choose to share.

jobs.description:
BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work.

THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 
 

THE OPPORTUNITY

As our Senior Performance Video Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid video for Kraken and Krak. You ideate, generate, edit and ship, and you treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and speed leadership: you set the bar for paid video on the team, work with AI-enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with video questions.

 

 - Own paid video for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

 - Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform’s specs and native feel.

 - Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets.

 - Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn’t. Keep your tooling current as the models change, and build repeatable workflows the rest of the team can reuse.

 - Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, including experimental ones alongside BAU work, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

 - Version and localize video at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you’ll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.

 - Build creative with testing in mind. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts.

 - Flex into AI-assisted paid static when a campaign calls for it, working from the team’s brand baselines.

 - Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.

 - Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.

 
 

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5+ years in performance video creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

 - A portfolio submitted with your application. Paid video above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you’re able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.

 - Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.

 - High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.

 - Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

 - Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You’re fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.

 - Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic instincts and a feel for what’s about to feel dated.

xStocks brings real-world assets on-chain as tokenized securities that are regulated, fully-backed, and tradable across multiple blockchains. Built within Payward, the xStocks team runs the infrastructure that issues, custodies, and settles these instruments across EVM, Solana, TON, Tron, and more. The platform moves real value, so security is not a feature bolted on at the end. It is a property of everything the team ships. This is a hybrid engineering and security seat built for someone who is genuinely both: you ship products alongside the engineering team when the security queue is quiet, and you own security work end to end when it lands. You report into engineering and partner closely with the Payward security, CISO, and compliance functions.

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Own security deliverables end to end. Coordinate and review smart-contract audits, respond to security questionnaires and due-diligence requests, support CISO and compliance initiatives, and turn findings into tracked, closed-out fixes.

 - Run offensive assessments against our own platforms. Pentest the web apps, APIs, backend services, and on-chain components, and build the tooling to do it repeatedly rather than once.

 - Continuously assess posture. Threat-model new and existing systems, review architecture and key-management flows, and maintain a living view of the risks and their mitigations.

 - Review code for security. Be a default reviewer on changes touching auth, cryptography, custody, signing, and fund movement across our chains.

 - Harden the platform. Improve secrets handling, IAM and least-privilege, dependency and supply-chain hygiene, and detection and logging for security-relevant events.

 - Secure custody and signing workflows. Review and harden transaction signing flows, MPC and HSM integrations, signer permissions, admin roles, approval policies, and break-glass procedures.

 - Contribute to product engineering. Pick up regular backlog work in TypeScript so you stay close to the codebase you are defending.

 - Support incidents. Help with detection, triage, response, and post-mortems, and feed the lessons back into the program.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - An engineer first. You write and review production code comfortably, TypeScript and Node.js in our stack, and you understand systems deeply enough to break them.

 - Strong application and infrastructure security fundamentals. The OWASP-class vulnerability landscape, authn and authz, injection, SSRF, supply-chain risk, and secure design. You have done real offensive work in pentesting, vuln research, or red-team.

 - Applied cryptography and blockchain security. Symmetric and asymmetric primitives, hashing, signatures, and key management, plus the security model of EVM, Solana, and ideally TON or Tron. You can read a smart contract and reason about how it fails.

 - Ownership. You can take an ambiguous security item, an audit, a questionnaire, or an incident, and drive it to closure without being managed through it.

 - Clear communication. You can explain a risk to engineers, to a CISO, and to an auditor, and tailor the message to each.

 - An automation instinct. You do not want to catch the same issue manually twice, so you turn findings into tests, alerts, controls, documentation, or platform improvements.

 - Risk judgment. You can tell a theoretical issue from a material one, and communicate severity, likelihood, impact, and remediation tradeoffs clearly.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience commissioning or remediating third-party smart-contract audits.

 - Familiarity with custody and signing infrastructure such as HSMs, MPC, and ForDefi-style providers, and with on-chain transaction security.

 - Cloud security depth in GCP or AWS, IAM, and container and runtime hardening.

 - Detection engineering and security observability, including SIEM and log-based detections.

 - Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, or GWAPT.

 - Prior work in a regulated fintech or tokenization/DeFi environment.

experience:

 - Push hospital workflows into the modern age: Rethink and rewire how data moves between nurses, doctors, and administrators - and turn confusing, click-heavy workflows into fast, intuitive experiences.

Experience:

- Minimum of 10 years of professional software engineering experience.

 - Proficiency with object oriented and functional programming, with the ability and willingness to use and adopt new technologies. We use tools such as Phoenix, Elixir, Python, Erlang, Javascript, Node.js and more.

 - Exceptional problem-solving skills, with a track record of tackling challenging engineering problems. 

 - Intellectually curious with a growth mindset - able to tackle entirely novel challenges that lack prior precedent through applying strong fundamentals and first principles thinking.

 - Familiarity with open-source technology and a desire to explore and experiment with new solutions.

 - Push hospital workflows into the modern age: Rethink and rewire how clinicians move through the software - and turn confusing, click-heavy workflows into fast, keyboard-driven, intuitive experiences that clinicians love, not tolerate.

 - Render real-time clinical data, instantly: Build interfaces that reflect live patient data - vitals, orders, labs, alerts - the moment it changes, with no lag, in environments like the ED, ICU, and OR where a half-second matters. Architect the data layer, caching, and subscription patterns over GraphQL that make that possible.

 - Make interfaces that never fail under pressure: Engineer for accessibility, resilience, and performance so the UI holds up in high-stakes, high-stress settings - including degraded networks and edge cases that would break an ordinary web app.

 - Turn complexity into clarity: Take dense clinical and operational data and shape it into clear, glanceable, decision-ready interfaces for doctors, nurses, pharmacists, and administrators.

 - Define the frontend from first principles: Set the patterns, state management, and rendering architecture - balancing developer velocity against the reliability bar of mission-critical software.

Your

Experience:

- Minimum of 10 years of professional software engineering experience, with deep focus on frontend.

 - Expertise across the frontend stack including TypeScript, JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS, browser internals, rendering performance, state management and building real-time, reactive UIs against GraphQL APIs

 - Comfortable adopting new tools as needed (we use Elixir/Erlang, Phoenix, Postgres and AWS in the backend).

 - Experience with client-side data loading and management: caching, freshness, ownership, and how to optimize push updates

 - Understanding of the browser rendering cycle, how and when the DOM decides what to repaint, and the instinct to profile and optimize for a responsive, data-dense interface.

 - Well-versed in modern React patterns and functional programming principles, including advanced use of custom hooks to build performant, maintainable, and reusable component architectures at scale.

 - Deep fluency with async control flow in JavaScript (Promises, async/await) and a track record of diagnosing race conditions, ordering issues, and unhandled rejections in real-time systems.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
ABOUT MEOW

Meow is business banking built for global crypto companies. FDIC-insured accounts through our banking partners, real yield on idle cash, and support for US and offshore entities. You can also send and receive crypto straight from your fiat checking balance and it converts automatically, so you never have to hold crypto on your balance sheet.

Companies like Solana, Optimism, QuickNode, Starknet, and DoubleZero already run on Meow. More social proof at meow.com/for-crypto.

Everyone on the team is exceeding quota, it's time to pour gas on the fire with new tactics across lead generation, closing, and account management. 

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a quota-carrying Account Executive role based in our Soho, NYC office. You'll own deals end to end, from meeting booked to close, selling Meow to founders, CFOs, and treasurers at crypto companies. You'll work outbound, warm intros, and the NYC event circuit, with the product, the customer logos, and the team behind you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build a pipeline of crypto companies from first touch to funded account

 - Run sharp discovery and pitch Meow to skeptical, technical buyers who care about trust and social proof, not feature lists

 - Work warm paths through people who trust you instead of blasting cold

 - Show up at the dinners and events, follow up, and turn handshakes into accounts

 - Feed what you learn back to the team so the pitch keeps getting sharper

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 2 to 5 years in sales or BD with quota you actually carried and hit

 - You get finance and crypto. You can explain stablecoins, yield, and why FDIC insurance matters without reading off a sheet

 - Hungry. You'd rather figure it out than wait to be told

 - Well connected, or able to build a network fast and thoughtfully

 - Comfortable owning a number and closing sharp, skeptical buyers

 - Someone who can balance following a working playbook with enough creativity to test new strategies and bring them to the team. 

COMPENSATION

$110K to $150K base depending on experience, with $250K OTE all-in. Commission is uncapped and revenue-based, so the more you close, the more you make, with no ceiling. You'd be the 7th hire on the sales team. 

WHY NOW

The next wave of crypto companies is being built right now, and almost none of them have a long term banking partner with crypto rails. The product works, the logos are real, and the seat is open. If that sounds like your kind of problem, let's talk.

This is an entry-level Go to Market role based in our Soho, NYC office, five days a week minimum. No formal sales experience required. We'll teach you everything: how to sell, how to build pipeline, how to outbound thoughtfully, and how the fintech banking and crypto world actually works.  - People like you. You're the kind of person who can build a relationship and a network from zero, and show interest in others so they want to keep talking to you.

 - You're hungry and you outwork the room. You figure it out instead of waiting to be told.

 - You're coachable. You take feedback in real time and get better, fast.

 - You want to be in New York, in the office, in the startup world at events and meetups. This is a build-it-in-person team.

 - What it takes to grow from your first deal to getting creative and building new strategies for the team

jobs.title: Controller
jobs.description:
About Meow

Meow is a business banking platform that brings checking, corporate cards, global payments, treasury, invoicing, and accounting integrations into a single dashboard. Startups, small and mid-sized businesses, investment funds, and international companies use Meow to run their finances in one place. Banking services are provided by FDIC-insured partner banks; Meow Technologies is a financial technology company, not a bank.

About the role

Meow is hiring a Controller to own finance and financial operations across the company. You'll be accountable for the accuracy of our books, our control environment, our financial audit and SOC 1, payroll and benefits, tax, and the reporting our board and leadership use to run the business.

Today we run lean: outsourced bookkeepers handle day-to-day accounting and the monthly close, and outside CPAs handle tax. You'll direct these partners, decide what to bring in-house, and build the processes, policies, and systems our finance function needs as we grow. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants full ownership of finance at a fast-moving fintech.

What you'll do

Accounting and close

 - Manage our outsourced bookkeepers: set the close calendar, review each monthly close, and sign off on the financial statements

 - Review revenue recognition and other key accounting judgments for accuracy and GAAP compliance

 - Make sure every balance sheet account is reconciled and supported each month

 - Evaluate over time which accounting work should move in-house

Audit and SOC 1

 - Serve as the primary contact for our external financial auditors, preparing PBC lists and schedules and supporting fieldwork

 - Own SOC 1 readiness and the annual examination: document controls, coordinate testing, and remediate findings

 - Design and maintain internal controls, including approval limits, segregation of duties, and finance policies

Payroll and benefits

 - Administer payroll, including approvals, employee records, and accurate tax withholdings and filings

 - Administer health insurance and benefits, including open enrollment, broker and carrier relationships, and employee questions

 - Ensure payroll and benefits are recorded correctly in the books

Tax and corporate compliance

 - Manage outside CPAs on federal and state income tax, R&D credits, Delaware franchise tax, and state registrations

 - Own 1099 filings and keep entities in good standing, including annual reports and registered agents

Reporting and planning

 - Produce monthly management reports and the financials for board meetings and investor updates

 - Own budgeting and forecasting, and track profitability, margins, and cash flow

 - Lead finance diligence for fundraising and strategic partnerships

Finance operations

 - Oversee accounts payable, vendor payments, corporate cards, and expense management

 - Maintain stock compensation accounting, coordinate 409A valuations, and keep the cap table tied to the books

 - Manage corporate insurance renewals, including D&O, E&O, and cyber

At Neo, we’re on a mission to build a more rewarding financial future for all Canadians. Life at a rapidly scaling tech startup isn’t for everyone. It’s complex, fast-paced, high-pressure, but also incredibly fulfilling. Since its founding in 2019, Neo has gained incredible traction and is one of the fastest-growing fintech companies in Canada.

 - #1 on Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50 for 2023, 2024, and 2025 https://www.newswire.ca/news-releases/neo-financial-achieves-first-ever-three-peat-win-as-number-one-on-deloitte-s-technology-fast-50-list-889692540.html — the first company ever to achieve a three-peat at the top!

 - #1 Fastest Growing Company in Canada for 2024 by Globe & Mail https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240927952651/en/Neo-Financial-Ranks-No.-1-on-The-Globe-and-Mail%E2%80%99s-2024-List-of-Canada%E2%80%99s-Top-Growing-Companies

 - Top-ranked mobile apps and credit cards

 - Team of 500+ people

 - 1M+ customers

 - 10K+ retail partners
 
 

Average On-Target Earnings: $36.00/hour CAD ($74,880/year equivalent) 

 

Compensation: $20.00/hour CAD base wage + uncapped instant commission 

 

Job Type: (Contract) Full-time hours or Part-time hours

The Role

We are seeking motivated Sales Representatives to act as the face of Neo Financial. You will be directly responsible for customer acquisition by signing people up for Neo Credit card, Neo Money account, and other Neo products!

Key Perks

 - Instant Commission: Track your performance in real-time and get paid into your Neo App the moment a customer signs up using your link.

 - Flexible Scheduling: We offer customizable full-time and part-time schedules tailored to high-performing, sales-driven individuals.

What We Are Looking For

 - A strong motivation to earn money and hit performance targets.

 - Enthusiasm for sharing financial products and technology within your local community.

 - Ability to travel to various event locations across your city.

 - Previous experience in direct sales, door-to-door sales, retail, telemarketing, or marketing is an asset.

WORKING AT NEO:

The people who thrive at Neo are resourceful, growth-oriented, and driven to win. We hold ourselves to high standards because we’re on a mission that matters: to build a more rewarding financial future for all Canadians. As individuals and as a team, we constantly challenge ourselves and each other to raise the bar and deliver exceptional experiences for our customers. Our commitment to customer success drives everything we do, from building world-class products to providing exceptional support at every step of their journey. If this resonates with you, keep reading. 

We trust, respect, and support each other. This means honest conversations, constructive input, and empowering each other to move fast and think big. You’ll be surrounded by people who push you to be your best. We primarily collaborate in person across our Calgary, Winnipeg, and Toronto offices, where ideas move quickly and teams build momentum together. As we continue to scale and evolve, we’re looking for builders, innovators, and problem solvers who thrive on challenge–people who would rather blaze a trail through uncertainty than follow a well-paved path. 

At Neo, ownership is part of how we think and operate. For select roles, equity participation reinforces that mindset by giving employees a direct stake in the company’s long-term success. Regardless of role, every team member is expected to think like an owner and make decisions that move the business forward.

APPLY WITH US:

We believe in equal opportunity and are committed to creating an inclusive climate where everyone can thrive. Customers trust us with their finances, so successful candidates for this position will be required to undergo a security screening, including a criminal records check and a credit check. 

By continuing with your application, you agree to the Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.neofinancial.com/candidate-privacy-policy.pdf, which guides how we process your personal information for the purpose of your application. 

Neo Financial leverages artificial intelligence (AI) to reinforce our candidate evaluation process, including the initial assessment of applications and screening of candidates. These tools support our recruitment team; however, all final hiring decisions are made by humans and are not based exclusively on automated processing. If you require further information regarding our data processing practices, please contact us.

We are hiring for an open, vacant position.

The Role

Neo's data science org sits inside products millions of Canadians already use. Data scientists, analytics leaders, and ML platform engineers work as one embedded function: production models, insight that shapes decisions, and the path from prototype to a monitored service. Not a reporting desk. Not a lab on the side.

There's a version of this work that stops at a notebook, a dashboard, or a handoff. Future roles here don't. They run from an ambiguous business question to something that actually runs — through the data, the constraints, and the commercial trade-offs.

At this level you frame the problem, ship the work, and stand behind the result. The people in this pipeline have taken models from working to reliable to material. They know a clever fit from a system the business can trust.

THE WORK

Neo is rebuilding financial services from scratch. We've shipped a full-stack banking platform (credit cards, savings, mortgages, personal loans, cash back) at a pace most financial institutions can't match in a decade. Data science is inside that loop, not adjacent to it.

The problems span credit risk, fraud, marketing and loyalty, executive decisioning, and the ML platform that keeps models alive in production. They run against real financial outcomes for millions of Canadians. Correctness isn't optional. Neither is commercial impact. The work doesn't get easier as we scale.

We don't have a handoff culture. You partner with Product, Engineering, Risk, Marketing, Finance, and operations. Models ship. Insights change decisions. You own the path from prototype to something the company can run on.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - A meaningful surface area with real business impact : risk, fraud, growth, analytics strategy, or the platform that productizes the work

 - The full loop: problem framing, method, delivery, and the validation and monitoring that keep it honest after launch

 - Standards that compound: reproducibility, metric consistency, model governance, and documentation , not one-off heroics

 - Mentorship that raises the bar: code review, experimental design, and developing the people around you

 - Cross-functional alignment. You translate. You don't throw work over the wall.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

If you're a Senior, Staff, or Principal Data Scientist, you own models end to end — design, training, validation, and production. You can defend a validation strategy to a peer who will try to break it, and explain the result to an executive without hiding behind metrics. You mentor. You don't wait for someone else to make the work real.

If you lead analytics, you are not running a service desk. You set the strategy, build the team, and move the company from reactive reporting to insight that changes decisions. You zoom out to company strategy and zoom in to the pipeline and the spreadsheet. You hold the line on metric definitions, experimentation, and quality when the business wants the number yesterday.

If you build ML platforms, you own the path from experiment to production — pipelines, observability, drift, registries, infrastructure-as-code. You make data scientists faster without lowering the bar. You've run production ML on cloud infrastructure, and you treat reliability as part of the model, not a follow-up project.

At every level:

 - Deep technical fluency in Python and SQL, and enough cloud and data-platform literacy to ship, not just present

 - Experience in fintech, lending, payments, or another regulated environment where a wrong number has consequences

 - A track record of taking things from working to reliable to growing — through ambiguity, not around it

 - Low ego, high standards: you do the unglamorous work and hold others to the same

HOW WE HIRE FOR THIS ROLE

We're looking for a rare combination and we won't compromise on fit to move fast. Applying here puts your profile in front of our team and keeps you in consideration as our data science organization grows. It doesn't guarantee an immediate interview, and it won't lock you to a single role. If your background matches a current or emerging opportunity, we'll reach out directly.

We aim to respond to every application, but given the selective nature of this search, timelines may vary.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff/Principal Software Developer
jobs.description:
SENIOR/STAFF/PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE DEVELOPER

Calgary, AB — Full-time

 

THE ROLE

Financial software runs underneath the biggest decisions people make. When it's good, it saves real money over years. When it's not, those losses compound just as quietly. Most of it was built to capture value, not create it. Neo is building the alternative.

Neo has been Canada's fastest-growing company three years running. The platform behind that growth is built entirely in-house: 150 services in production, hundreds of pull requests merged every week, tens of millions of transactions processed every month. The engineers here own their services from architecture decisions through to production. There's no QA team to hand work off to, no DevOps team to manage your deploys. You work on what matters. The priorities are real and the autonomy to execute is yours.

This role is for an experienced developer who has shipped real systems at scale, has strong opinions about how to build them, and is ready to be accountable for what goes live. Our stack is GraphQL, Mongo, Node.js, TypeScript, React, and React Native on AWS. If you've spent time at a company where good ideas died in committee and you know you could be going faster, this is the environment those engineers tend to thrive in.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Build and own services and clients end to end: API and schema design, production delivery, long-term technical health.

 - Serve as code owner for one or more repos, setting the standard for quality and architecture in your area.

 - Write thorough automated tests as a core part of how you build, not as a follow-up step.

 - Conduct code reviews that genuinely improve the work: alternative approaches, edge cases, performance, security.

 - Own your services in production: build observability in from the start: alerting thresholds, dashboards, tracing, logging.

 - Anticipate downstream risks to reliability, scalability, and security; raise them and advocate for the work to get on the roadmap.

 - Go beyond the ask: identify missing requirements, write the work that got missed, push back on scope that doesn't make sense.

 - Contribute beyond your squad: drive core tooling improvements, architect shared libraries, and mentor other engineers through deliberate pairing and code review.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - You care deeply about what you do and about making banking better for everyone.

 - You've shipped production systems at real scale and can speak clearly about what the hard parts were.

 - You write tests as part of how you build, not after the fact.

 - You're opinionated about architecture, can defend a position, and can change it when the argument is better.

 - You give code reviews that actually move the work forward, not just green-check it.

 - You take production seriously. When something breaks on your watch, you fix it and figure out how to prevent it.

 - You don't wait for a ticket to find the problem. If something is missing or broken, you surface it.

 - You contribute to the people around you: documentation, knowledge sharing, mentorship.

 - You're current on your tech stack and treat AI as a force multiplier. Engineers who leverage modern AI tooling to move faster go further here.

This is not the right role if you want steady state and fully scoped requirements before writing a line. The engineers who thrive here find that kind of environment frustrating.

 

WHY NEO

No compromises on tooling: Cursor, Claude with unlimited tokens, CodeRabbit, GitHub Enterprise, Datadog, Wiz, Sentry, Snowflake, AWS. MacBook Pros.

Deploys are independent and automated. One button to ship when your work is ready, not when someone schedules a release window.

Competitive salaries (up to CA$275,000) that lead the Calgary market. Roles are eligible for STIP (cash bonuses tied to company milestones) and equity through stock options that are in the money from day one. At our trajectory, your 4-to-5-year total comp is designed to significantly outpace traditional tech tracks.

Three consecutive years as Canada's fastest-growing company on the Deloitte Fast 50. $400M+ raised. Over one million customers.

Relocation support available for candidates moving to Calgary.
Comprehensive health benefits, 21 days PTO, and parental top-up.

Must be a Canadian citizen, Permanent Resident or have a valid work permit.

Successful candidates will be required to complete a security screening including a criminal record check and credit check.

By continuing with your application, you agree to the Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.neofinancial.com/candidate-privacy-policy.pdf, which guides how we process your personal information for the purpose of your application.

 - Maintain all operational reporting to track performance of strategies against internal forecasts, ensuring no consistent breaches in credit risk KPIs.
 
 - Develop insightful analysis to actively monitor portfolio performance and drive actionable outcomes.

 - Operational Execution & Collaboration
 
 - Serve as the key liaison with the Credit Operations team, ensuring seamless execution and monitoring of all new strategies.
 
 - Oversee exception and manual review processes, setting clear guidelines for applications that fall outside automated decisioning.

Experience:

jobs.title: Senior / Staff React Native Developer
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

Financial software runs underneath the biggest decisions people make. When it's good, it saves real money over the years. When it's not, those losses compound just as quietly. Most of it was built to capture value, not create it. Neo is building the alternative.

As a Senior / Staff React Native Developer, you will own the experience that millions of Canadians interact with daily. We don't build wrappers or standard CRUD apps; we build ultra-responsive, highly secure, and visually flawless mobile experiences from the ground up. You will set the technical direction for our React Native architecture, bridge the gap between JS and native modules when performance demands it, and mentor engineers who are obsessed with shipping world-class code.

Our engineering teams are small by design. You'll work closely with product and design to turn complex financial mechanics into seamless, high-performance interactions.

WHY NEO

 - Small teams with real ownership: You are not managing a function inside a function. You own your services and clients end-to-end—from architecture decisions and schema design through to production.  - Team of 500+ people

 - 1M+ customers

 - 10K+ retail partners

THE ROLE:

Neo is looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to join our team in Calgary, AB. This is a unique opportunity to support a broad range of practice areas including Neo’s corporate, commercial, regulatory, employment, privacy matters. Our Legal team excels in an exciting and fast-paced environment, and knows how to switch gears to adapt to any scenario. We’re motivated leaders who want to make things better, simpler and stronger. Make your mark with transformative products and technologies, alongside some of Canada’s most successful leaders and tech minds.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

 - Provide practical, clear and accurate legal advice on a broad range of practice areas including corporate/commercial, regulatory, employment and privacy matters

 - Independently structure, draft, negotiate and review financing, partnership and customer-facing agreements, including identifying legal and business risks and collaborating with business and other lawyers on solutions to commercial and legal problems

 - Anticipate, elucidate and address legal issues to protect the interests of Neo and reduce exposure to legal risks

 - Draft internal policies and guidelines to ensure compliance with legal requirements

 - Support legal updates to all customer facing disclosures and agreements

 - Develop and maintain form agreements, contract management systems, and other databases

 - Develop and implement processes for efficient and streamlined operations surrounding contract negotiation

 - Conduct legal research and provide concise and fit-for-purpose legal advice to internal stakeholders, in a timely manner

 - Manage external legal counsel, as required

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 - Bachelor’s Degree in Law (L.LB) or Juris Doctor (J.D.)

 - A member of, or eligible for membership in, the Law Society of Alberta

jobs.title: Senior Designer
jobs.description:
SENIOR ART DIRECTOR, MARKETING

ABOUT NOVO

Small businesses are the backbone of the US economy, comprising almost half of the GDP and the private workforce. Yet, big banks don't provide the access, assistance and modern tools that owners need to successfully grow their business.

We started Novo to challenge the status quo—we're on a mission to increase the GDP of the modern entrepreneur by creating the go-to banking platform for small businesses (SMBs). Novo is flipping the script of the banking world, and we're excited to lead the small business banking revolution.

At Novo, we're here to help entrepreneurs, freelancers, startups and SMBs achieve their financial goals by empowering them with an operating system that makes business banking as easy as iOS. We developed modern bank accounts and tools to help save time and increase cash flow. Our unique product integrations enable easy access to tracking payments, transferring money internationally, managing business transactions and more. We've made a big impact in a short amount of time, helping thousands of organizations access powerfully simple business banking.

Why Novo?

 - 250,000+ business customers using the platform

 - $30B+ in transactions processed

 - Profitable, with $170M raised to date

 - Backed by firms including Valar Ventures, Crosslink Capital, Stripes, BoxGroup, RRE Ventures, and Notable Capital

 - Global team with offices in New York, India, and Colombia

 - We work with modern tools technologies, of course.. AI

 - We provide learning and development budgets to help you grow and bond with your team

THE ROLE

Novo's brand needs someone to own it. We're hiring a Senior Designer / Art Director to set the creative vision and direction for the brand and lead our digital creative across marketing: paid, owned, and everything in between.

You'll decide how Novo looks, feels and shows up everywhere a business owner meets us. You'll turn business goals into campaigns that stop the scroll, convert prospects, and make customers proud to bank with us.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real influence. You won't manage a team, but you'll be the creative lead for marketing and the standard-bearer for the brand across the company. You'll work closely with our Director of Integrated Marketing and Senior Copywriter, and with growth, lifecycle and product marketing partners.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

SET THE CREATIVE VISION FOR THE NOVO BRAND

 - Own Novo's creative direction and visual identity, and evolve it as the company grows

 - Define the brand's look, feel and point of view, and hold the bar across every touchpoint

 - Build and maintain a scalable visual system and brand guidelines that keep marketing consistent while still pushing creative boundaries

 - Present work to leadership and stakeholders, and argue for creative decisions with clarity and conviction

LEAD DIGITAL CREATIVE ACROSS MARKETING

 - Lead creative for campaigns across paid (paid social, display, video, SEM) and owned channels (web, landing pages, email, lifecycle, organic social)

 - Concept and deliver high-impact work for brand, growth and product marketing, from brief to final assets

 - Design and iterate on landing pages, campaign visuals, ad creative and brand content tied to measurable results

 - Create motion and video for ads, product launches and social

 - Partner with growth marketing to produce, test and optimize ad creative at scale, balancing craft with velocity

 - Use generative AI across the process (ideation, moodboards, variations, production) to move faster without lowering the bar

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - In your first 90 days, you've audited Novo's brand across channels and aligned the team on a clear creative direction

 - Campaigns ship faster, look unmistakably Novo, and beat their performance benchmarks

 - The rest of the company reaches for your brand system and templates by default

MUST HAVE

 - 7–9+ years in design focused on brand, marketing or advertising creative, ideally in tech, fintech or a high-growth startup

 - Experience setting creative direction for a brand, not just executing it

 - A portfolio that shows range: brand campaigns, performance ads, web/landing pages, and motion

 - Expert in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro)

 - Strong motion design and video editing for social, paid and product storytelling

Small businesses are the backbone of the US economy — nearly half of GDP and the private workforce — yet big banks don't give owners the access, assistance, or modern tools they need to grow. We started Novo to change that. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the modern entrepreneur by building the go-to banking platform for small businesses.

Novo is a fintech, not a bank. We give entrepreneurs, freelancers, and SMBs an operating system for their money: no-fee business checking, debit and credit cards, loans and funding, payments across every rail (ACH, wires, FedNow), invoicing, bill pay, expense management, and integrations with the tools they already run their business on. We've helped hundreds of thousands of businesses get powerfully simple banking, and we're just getting started.

WHY NOVO?

 - A mission-driven team building for the people big banks pretend don't exist

 - Real ownership: we make decisions that affect real businesses every day, and we trust people to act on that

 - A flat culture where ideas win on merit — hierarchy is not authority

 - Modern stack, modern tooling, and a team that takes AI seriously as part of how we work

 - Competitive salary and stock options for every full-time employee

 - Medical, dental, and vision coverage

 - Learning and development budget

 - Offices in NYC and India, with Wednesday team lunches that rotate cuisines

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to be the highest-leverage individual contributor on our product design team. You'll own the hardest, most ambiguous design problems at Novo — the ones that cut across checking, payments, credit, and invoicing, and across web, iOS, and Android — and you'll set the bar for what great looks like for everyone else.

This is not a management role. It is a role with real authority over the quality and coherence of the product. You'll partner directly with product leads, engineering leads, data, and compliance to shape what we build, not just how it looks. You'll multiply the team's output by making the design system, the patterns, and the standards stronger than any one designer could on their own.

You'll know you're succeeding when Novo feels like one product instead of a collection of features, when a small business owner can move money, get paid, and access capital without ever having to think about how banking works underneath, and when other designers ship better work because of the foundations you built.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Lead design on Novo's most complex problems

 - Own end-to-end design for cross-surface initiatives — onboarding and account opening, money movement, lending and credit, invoicing and getting paid — from problem framing through shipped, measured outcomes

 - Turn ambiguous business goals and regulatory constraints into clear product strategy, information architecture, and interaction models

 - Work upstream with product and engineering leads to shape the roadmap, not just execute it

Set and raise the bar for craft

 - Define what "done well" means for interaction, visual, and content design at Novo, and hold the team (and yourself) to it

 - Run design critique that makes people better and work sharper

 - Ship polished, accessible (WCAG-conformant), production-ready design across web and native mobile

Own the design system

 - Lead the evolution of Novo's design system: tokens, components, patterns, documentation, and the process by which it grows

 - Partner with engineering to keep Figma and production in lockstep, and to retire the inconsistencies that accumulate in a fast-moving product

 - Make the system the default path — faster for designers and engineers to use it than to go around it

Design for a regulated product

 - Work hand-in-hand with Compliance, Risk, and Legal so that disclosures, consent, KYC/KYB, and error states are designed with care rather than bolted on

 - Treat trust as a design surface: security, clarity around fees and terms, and honest handling of edge cases

Use AI as part of the craft

 - Fluency across the AI design stack — Figma AI, Claude/ChatGPT, Cursor or Claude Code for prototyping, generative tools for exploration — with a clear point of view on where they accelerate the work and where they don't

 - Help the team build repeatable AI-assisted workflows for research synthesis, exploration, prototyping, and documentation

 - Contribute design thinking to Novo's own AI-powered product experiences

Multiply the team

 - Mentor senior and mid-level designers through pairing, critique, and feedback

 - Write and codify the principles, patterns, and playbooks that make good design repeatable at Novo

 - Be the design voice in cross-functional and leadership conversations

MUST HAVE

 - 10+ years of product design experience, with at least 3 operating at a staff or lead scope — owning cross-team, cross-platform problems as an IC

 - A portfolio of shipped, complex products that shows the full arc: research and problem framing, systems thinking, interaction design, visual polish, and business results

 - Deep experience building and scaling design systems across web and native mobile (iOS and Android)

 - Expert-level Figma, strong prototyping skills, and enough technical fluency to pair effectively with engineers and understand what's cheap versus expensive to build

 - Data fluency: you read funnels, frame experiments, and use quantitative and qualitative signals to make design decisions defensible

 - Experience designing in a regulated environment — fintech, financial services, healthcare, or similar — including disclosures, consent flows, and identity verification

 - Hands-on AI fluency in your daily design work, with sound judgment about when it adds value and when it introduces risk

 - Exceptional communication: you present clearly, give and take hard feedback well, and influence without authority

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and speed, without letting quality slide
 

NICE TO HAVE

 - Direct experience designing lending, credit, payments, or business onboarding products

 - Experience working with distributed teams across time zones

jobs.description:
ABOUT NU

About the team

This role sits within Global Platforms Engineering: Engineering Enablement, under Eric Young https://www.linkedin.com/in/ericcyoung/ (CTO, Global Platforms Engineering). The AI Developer Experience (AIDE) pillar is the AI-native counterpart to the separately led Developer Infrastructure pillar: a standing topic in CTO org-design reviews.

Reports to a Senior Director, Engineering Enablement and dotted line to Rahul Ahlawat https://www.linkedin.com/in/rahul-ahlawat, Engineering Senior Director & Chief of Staff to the CTO. Leads a team of approximately 10–15 engineers today, spanning five workstreams, scaling with 8 committed "Deep Forge" headcounts plus external hiring. This is green-field scope with established backing: the charter, budget conversations, and headcount pipeline already exist. The Director shapes execution and strategy, not just strategy alone, and has real decision-making authority over team structure, build-vs-buy calls, and workstream prioritization. The Director will also engage directly with third-party AI vendors (e.g., Factory.ai, Devin-class tools) and with ICs across the five core workstreams.

 

About the role

Nubank is one of the few companies with the scale (3,500+ engineers), AI ambition, and executive air cover to build a genuinely AI-native developer

experience:

not a bolt-on pilot. This role is responsible for defining and leading the AI Developer Experience pillar within Engineering Enablement, transforming how Nubank's engineers write, review, deploy, and operate software.

The Director inherits a mandate, a growing team, and a seat at the table with the CTO. The pillar already has real momentum: an early production win in the Vector agentic coding platform, an urgent context-infrastructure buildout, and direct executive sponsorship.

Key responsibilities and Expectations
Own and scale the AI Developer Experience pillar, with an initial focus on measurably increasing shipped PRs per engineer per week through automation, and improving token efficiency as AI spend scales.

Build the team from the ground up, converting today's borrowed, part-time contributors into a dedicated, full-time organization; the CTO has personally committed to reallocating direct reports and unlocking headcount.

Run the build-vs-partner motion: stand up fast, structured engagements with third parties to benchmark, accelerate, and in some cases co-build: while defining objective eval criteria so decisions aren't subjective.

Core workstreams:

 - NuContext: the knowledge and context-extraction layer (docs, Confluence, Jira, code) that everything else depends on; currently the single highest-priority area for Nubank's long-term AI strategy. Owns ontology definition, context curation standards, knowledge graph traversal/retrieval, and context update mechanisms.

 - Vector (agentic coding & hosted environment): sandboxing, harness, memory/retrieval, and system-prompt optimization for AI-assisted coding.

 - Agentic Code Review: AI-assisted PR review to cut defect rates and cycle time, a direct lever on the org's top-line change failure rate (CFR) goal.

 - AI SRE: moving from vendor evaluation to AI-native incident detection, diagnosis, and remediation at scale.

 - Prompt Classification & Model Routing and 3rd-party AI tooling vendor management: scope and placement still being finalized; the Director will help shape this boundary.

 - Longer term, the AI Enablement Platform (routing, marketplace, authentication) is expected to fold into this scope as leadership bandwidth allows.

 

Qualifications

Professional Experience & Education:

 - Proven leadership of AI-native developer tooling or platform teams, ideally at a company operating at meaningful engineering scale.

 - Track record building full-time, dedicated engineering teams out of fragmented, part-time, or borrowed resourcing: including experience in allocating teams, stellar in people leadership to do it without burning teams out.

 - Real experience structuring and running third-party vendor partnerships (evaluation, integration, managing lock-in risk) alongside first-party build.

 - Hands-on technical credibility in agentic coding systems, context/retrieval infrastructure, or developer-facing AI tooling: able to go deep with ICs, not just manage from a distance.

 - Comfort operating in a high-velocity, ambiguous, and high-executive-visibility organization; ability to align and mobilize teams to take on new challenges and scale impact.

 - High accountability and ownership mindset, coupled with the ability to move fast under pressure.

 - Comfort with an honest, unsolved problem space: even leading peer companies are far from 100% AI-authored code; this role is about the challenge and the resourcing to attack it, not a pre-solved problem.

 - A track record that positions the Director as the natural next-step candidate for the broader Engineering Enablement M6 role.

 - A builder's instinct for evaluation rigor: experience designing evals/benchmarks that replace subjective quality judgments with objective, repeatable measurement.

 - Experience with sandboxed agentic execution environments, retrieval-augmented systems, or LLM-based code review tooling (nice-to-have).

 - Familiarity with token-cost management as AI spend scales (nice-to-have).

 - Prior exposure to fintech, regulated environments, or large legacy codebases where AI adoption is harder to get right (nice-to-have).

 

Core Leadership Skills

The following executive leadership skills serve as a reference for senior leadership levels at Nubank, setting expectations that grow with increasing complexity, ambiguity, and influence.

BUSINESS ACUMEN

Drives strategic business alignment at Nubank by analyzing market dynamics, identifying opportunities, and ensuring informed decision-making to influence organizational direction.

COMMUNICATION

Masters complex communication, mentoring others, fostering open dialogue, and adapting strategies to enhance organizational effectiveness.

AGILE ADAPTABILITY

Leads with agility, pioneering solutions, fostering a culture of learning, collaboration, and continuous value delivery.

 

Role Location 

Palo Alto, US: adhering to company policy for in-office attendance (2026: 2x/week; 2027 onwards: 3x/week).

The Blockchain Security team sits within the Product Security & Assurance BA, part of the Information Technology and Security (ITSec) BU. As a Senior Security Engineer on this team, you own the security posture of our crypto operation. You are the person who thinks like an attacker so our products can withstand real ones: finding vulnerabilities before adversaries do, embedding product security into how crypto products are designed and built, and making sure our controls satisfy both internal risk standards and external regulatory requirements. You won't just run security tools. You'll build and operate the ones that protect our crypto products, from hardened ingress and monitoring/alerting systems to secure secret-management and automated security-review tooling. Your work directly protects customer funds and Nu's ability to run crypto products at scale.

 - Driving product security across the crypto portfolio: threat modeling, security-by-design reviews, and embedding secure practices into the development lifecycle.

 - Building, operating, and improving in-house security services and tooling that integrate directly with our crypto products, for example hardened ingress/edge controls, security monitoring and anomaly alerting, secure secret-management, and automated security-review tooling.

 - Ensuring our crypto operation meets regulatory

requirements:

mapping controls to applicable regulations, supporting audits, and producing the evidence regulators and internal risk teams expect.

 - Collaborating with product and engineering teams to design secure blockchain architecture and embed security-by-design into new products.

 - Contributing to security policies, standards, and guidelines that govern blockchain security operations.

 - Using AI to raise the leverage and quality of security work: building and running AI-assisted tooling for tasks like threat modeling, code and vulnerability review, and attack simulation, and helping the team push the frontier of what AI-first security engineering looks like.

 - Staying current on emerging attack vectors, exploits, and best practices across product and blockchain security, and sharing that knowledge across the team.

Must have

 - Strong product security and/or offensive security background (penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, attack simulation, incident response).

ENGENHARIA NO NUBANK

Soluções simples de se usar são complexas de serem construídas. No Nubank, buscamos práticas de desenvolvimento de software que permitam com que nossos produtos simplifiquem a vida dos nossos clientes. Isso significa que no ambiente de trabalho se preze por utilizar uma variedade de tecnologias, ferramentas e metodologias de trabalho que venham a atingir esses objetivos.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte do nosso time e não trabalha com as tecnologias que utilizamos aqui, não se preocupe! Temos uma trilha de aprendizado interna para oferecer suporte nessa jornada conosco! Confira um pouco mais do que utilizamos aqui:

 - Microsserviços escaláveis escritos em Clojure

 - Comunicação entre serviços com Kafka

 - Integração e deploy contínuo com AWS

 - Armazenamento de dados com Datomic e DynamoDB

 - Monitoramento e observabilidade com Prometheus

 - Manutenção de uma infraestrutura com alta-disponibilidade em Kubernetes

 - Moldar a experiência dos clientes interagindo com o app usando Flutter

 

RESPONSABILIDADES

 - Trabalhar com sistemas de larga escala e distribuídos

 - Colaborar na construção de microsserviços

 - Praticar conhecimentos em metodologias ágeis

 - Trabalhar com entrega contínua e infraestrutura como código

 

ESTAMOS BUSCANDO PROFISSIONAIS QUE

 - Sejam pessoas com deficiência (PcD);

 - Conhecimento prático em linguagens de programação para backend;

 - Prática em frameworks utilizados no desenvolvimento de backend;

 - Possuam habilidade de escrever um código de fácil entendimento e manutenção;

 - Que já tenha vivenciado ou estudado sobre práticas ágeis;

 - O Inglês é um diferencial. É importante que você esteja confortável em participar de ambientes com comunicação em inglês, e que tenha interesse em desenvolvê-lo, uma vez que o Nubank é uma empresa global. Oferecemos um programa de idiomas interno, o NuLanguage;

 - Disponibilidade para jornada de trabalho em tempo integral;

BENEFÍCIOS

 - Chance de ganhar capital no Nubank;

 - Cartão Alimentação/Refeição (Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação)

MODELO DE TRABALHO PARA ESTA POSIÇÃO

jobs.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

About the team
At Nubank we heavily rely on Data, Machine Learning, and increasingly on Generative and Agentic AI to drive our strategy and deliver the best experience and products to our customers. The Model Risk team plays a crucial role in ensuring the risks associated with our models and AI systems are understood and under control. We are now building a dedicated AI Risk Management capability to address the emerging risks of advanced AI — including LLM-powered and autonomous agentic systems — with a focus on AI quality, model and agent behavior, and the platform controls that keep these systems safe and reliable across internal and customer-facing use cases.

About the role 
This is a senior, hands-on technical position. You will help define what model risk management looks like for AI and Agentic AI at Nubank — building and enhancing the frameworks, not just inheriting them. You will perform independent assessments of AI systems for quality, behavior, and robustness, and help design the guardrails and platform-level controls that govern their safe use. You'll act as a credible technical peer to first-line engineering and AI development teams, providing practical guidance on AI risk without slowing responsible innovation. This role focuses on AI quality, agentic behavior, and platform controls; cybersecurity, data privacy, and fraud-specific matters sit with partner functions and are out of scope.

What you will do

AI Risk Framework & Governance

 - Build and continuously enhance the risk management framework for AI and Agentic AI systems, including inventory standards, assessment methodologies, control design, and issue management.

 - Inventory and map Nubank's AI use cases to surface gaps, materiality, and the most critical risks, and define prioritized mitigation actions.

 - Assess whether first-line monitoring is effective, proportionate to model risk, and sufficient to keep AI systems fit for purpose over time.

Independent AI Assessment

 - Perform independent technical assessments across generative AI, and agentic workflows, covering data, assumptions, methodology, testing, behavior, and monitoring.

 - Assess risks in LLM-powered applications, including RAG pipelines, tool use, autonomy boundaries, model/agent quality, human oversight, and hallucination risk.

 - Identify and document model limitations, failure modes, and emerging AI risks, including drift, instability, fairness, and robustness concerns.

Controls, Platform & Enablement

 - Influence first-line teams on platform architecture and embedded controls for the safe deployment and monitoring of AI.

 - Build Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and metrics for continuous monitoring of AI risk.

 - Develop tools, evals, analyses, and playbooks (including AI-enabled automation) to improve the speed, scale, and effectiveness of AI governance and validation.

Advisory & Advocacy

 - Serve as a trusted advisor across the AI/ML lifecycle, evaluating new use cases for materiality and governance requirements prior to deployment.

 - Discuss and report AI risk status and independent opinions to stakeholders, including senior managers and, where relevant, regulators.

 - Champion AI risk management as a strategic enabler of safe and scalable AI adoption, and build AI risk literacy across engineering, product, and risk teams.

 - Work in a multicultural, diverse, and highly skilled environment.

jobs.title: AI Research Manager - Machine Learning
jobs.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE ROLE

As AI Research Manager, you will own the operating health and execution of Nubank's ML research agenda. This is a dedicated people-management role for a small, high-talent-density team of world-class researchers, partnering closely with senior technical leads who drive the scientific direction.
The team works on a portfolio of research bets on a one-to-four-quarter horizon. This work compounds into the production capabilities Nubank will depend on. Current and upcoming bets include:

 - Next-generation nuFormer architectures: proprietary transformers that learn from raw transaction sequences and power key production credit decisions

 - Multitask and multi-target modeling: single models serving many high-impact prediction tasks at once

 - Training and inference efficiency: distillation, quantization, sparsity, and parallelism to run state-of-the-art models economically at our scale

 - Causal modeling and policy optimization: moving beyond prediction to the decisions and policies those predictions should drive

 - World models: open-ended models that reason about a customer's full financial life

 - Recommendation systems: extending the backbone to app events, engagement, and personalization signals

 - Embeddings and representation learning: semantic IDs, contrastive learning, and reusable representations used across the bank

 - Real-time and continual learning: low-latency inference and models that adapt over time

Your job is to make exceptional science happen: build the conditions, focus, and operating rhythm that researchers do great work.
Location: Palo Alto, US

YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

PEOPLE & TEAM LEADERSHIP

 - Lead, mentor, and advocate for a team of world-class ML researchers, fostering an environment of psychological safety, high ambition, and rigorous scientific inquiry.

 - Own the operating health of the team, including performance, career growth, hiring, and compensation cycles for elite individual contributors who often operate at staff-and-above technical depth.

 - Attract and retain top-tier research talent in a competitive market, and build a reputation for the team as a place the best researchers want to be.

RESEARCH OPERATIONS & EXECUTION

 - Own the operating cadence of a portfolio of two-to-three concurrent, quarter-scale research bets, from problem framing and OKRs through progress tracking and clear go/no-go decisions.

 - Allocate scarce, high-value resources, most notably GPU capacity, across competing research priorities, balancing exploration against the bets most likely to compound.

 - Protect deep-focus research time. Sustaining a long-term agenda in a fast-moving company means deliberately creating the space for rigorous, multi-quarter work, so the team can pursue ambitious bets instead of being fully absorbed by short-term applied demands.

 - Raise the bar on research rigor and communication: strong experimental design, peer review, and reproducibility.

 - Cultivate the team's standing in the broader research community. Real-world impact is our primary measure of success, but we actively encourage publishing, open-source contribution, and conference presence that build a reputation reflecting the quality of the work and help attract the best researchers.

STRATEGY & CROSS-TEAM COLLABORATION

 - Partner closely with senior technical leads who drive architecture and scientific direction, aligning operational execution with the long-term research roadmap so that scientific and operating decisions reinforce each other.

 - Ensure clean handoffs from research into production, so breakthrough results land reproducibly in the hands of applied teams rather than stalling as one-off experiments.

 - Translate complex, frontier technical progress (training efficiency, causal inference, novel architectures) into clear, high-impact narratives for executive leadership, connecting research milestones to business outcomes.

 - Bridge foundational research and long-term business strategy, ensuring the team's technical inputs directly enable Nubank's AI-first direction.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PERSON WHO HAS

You are an experienced research or engineering manager working at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and Applied ML. You lead brilliant, highly autonomous researchers without micromanaging, and you know what it takes to sustain an ambitious, long-horizon research agenda inside a fast-moving company. You measure your success by what your team ships and discovers, not by your own keystrokes.

BASIC

QUALIFICATIONS:

-

Experience:

3+ years of direct people-management experience leading applied AI research or core machine learning teams at big tech companies, frontier labs, or comparable high-scale environments.

 - Education: M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, with a strong working understanding of core AI methodologies.

 - Track record: Proven ability to build, scale, and retain high-performing research or advanced applied-science teams.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

- Technical depth: This is a management-first role, but deep conceptual familiarity with at least one of our core research areas is highly valued:
 Foundation models & LLMs: pre-training from scratch, scaling laws, training-optimization frameworks, and large GPU-cluster workflows.
 Behavioral & sequential models: sequence models, recommendation systems, and large-scale representation learning for very large user bases.
 Decisioning & optimization: causal inference, policy optimization, constrained optimization, or reinforcement learning.
 Training & inference efficiency: model sparsification, quantization, distillation, or parallelism and partitioning design.

 - Communication: Exceptional storytelling skills, with a track record of translating complex technical milestones into business impact for senior and C-level audiences.

 - Environment: Experience operating in global, distributed teams and navigating the path from foundational research to scalable, production-grade systems.

WHY THIS ROLE

This is a rare chance to lead frontier AI research with a clear, compounding mission: building the intelligence layer of one of the world's largest digital banks. You'll work alongside strong ML researchers, with the data, compute, and executive backing to pursue genuinely ambitious bets, and to see those bets reach more than 130 million customers.

LOCATION

About the Role

Nubank is seeking a Staff Security Engineer to contribute in the Identity and Access Management security function across a financial technology organization serving over 100 million customers in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. 
This is a senior individual-contributor role with organizational-level technical influence, responsible for supporting a multi-year IAM security strategy, directing its execution across multiple engineering teams, and ensuring that identity and access controls meet the security, regulatory, and operational requirements of a globally operating financial institution.

The Staff Security Engineer is expected to bring a demonstrated history of delivering consequential security programs — including programs that encountered setbacks — and the technical judgment that only sustained, hands-on experience in the domain produces. 
Critically, this role requires a security engineering philosophy grounded in business enablement: the conviction that security done well accelerates what the organization can do, not merely protects it. This means rigorously distinguishing between controls that reduce real risk and those that create the appearance of compliance without reducing exposure, taking genuine ownership of outcomes rather than delegating accountability through policy, and continuously questioning inherited assumptions about what security measures are necessary, sufficient, or proportionate.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Defining, communicating, and executing a multi-year security strategy (especially in the IAM field) aligned with the organization's risk posture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions.

 - Designing and maintaining the core identity infrastructure with the durability and operational discipline required at organizational scale: enterprise Identity Provider, PKI and X.509 certificate lifecycle automation, mutual TLS for service-to-service authentication, and credential management systems engineered to remain sound as the organization grows.

 - Translating least-privilege access from a principle into a measurable, organization-wide program — with defined metrics, visible adoption curves, and accountability structures that allow Security and Engineering leadership to track and act on the organization's access risk posture over time.

 - Designing and maintaining a security engineering framework — comprising technical mechanisms, policies, incentives, and assurance processes — that ensures security properties are durable, verifiable, and operationally sound, rather than dependent on individual vigilance or periodic audits.

 - Leading technical incident response for identity and access security events, including critical vulnerabilities in remote access infrastructure, ensuring thorough investigation, documented root cause analysis, and structural improvements that reduce the likelihood and impact of recurrence.

 - Designing and facilitating large-scale preparedness exercises grounded in realistic attack paths — involving engineering, operations, and executive functions — to identify genuine gaps in IAM controls, not merely satisfy a compliance requirement.

 - Providing technical mentorship and coaching to senior engineers; lead innovative projects with universities and actively collaborate in hiring and career decisions in order to maintain a high technical standard throughout the safety organization.

 - Serving as the technical authority in engagements with Legal, Compliance, internal audit, and external regulators on matters related to identity, authentication, and access control.

 - Expert-level knowledge of IAM and authentication protocols: OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, FIDO2/WebAuthn, mTLS, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI).
